name: Abercrombie & Fitch Authentic Man Eau de Toilette for Men
Abercrombie & Fitch Authentic Moment Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text: Abercrombie & Fitch's Authentic Moment Man perfume for men is the latest scent in the market. Launched in 2022, the fragrance was created by the expert nose of Yves Cassar. Its top notes are Cinnamon, Apple, Cypress, and Bergamot, complemented by Neroli as its middle note, and a base of Amberwood, Sandalwood, Musk, and Vanilla.

name: Abercrombie & Fitch Authentic Night Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text: Authentic Night Femme by Abercrombie & Fitch is a captivating Chypre Floral fragrance designed for women. Introduced in 2020, this new scent features an alluring blend of top notes including Black Currant, Apple, and Pink Pepper. The heart of the fragrance reveals floral notes of Tuberose, Jasmine Sambac, and Magnolia, while the base is crafted from rich Patchouli, Sandalwood, and Cedar.

name: Abercrombie & Fitch Authentic Night Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text: Authentic Night Homme by Abercrombie & Fitch is a Amber Fougere fragrance for men. This is a new fragrance. Authentic Night Homme was launched in 2020. Top notes are Apple, Rhubarb and Lotus; middle notes are Vanilla, Lavender and Clary Sage; base notes are Tonka Bean, Leather and Oakmoss.

name: Abercrombie & Fitch Away Man Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text: The new fragrance for men, Away Man by Abercrombie & Fitch, was released in 2021 and features an invigorating Woody Aromatic scent. Atop this base are Violet, Pineapple and Grapefruit top notes, and the depths are filled with Geranium, Ginger, Pepper, Vetiver, Woody Notes and Sandalwood middle and base notes.

name: Abercrombie & Fitch Fierce Eau de Cologne for Men

notes.source_text:
Abercrombie & Fitch Fierce is a fresh, woody aromatic that became a modern classic.
Bruno Jovanovic and Christophe Laudamiel created it in 2002. Fir, lemon, orange, cardamom, petitgrain and sea notes open fresh, rosemary, jasmine, rose and sage form the heart, and musk, vetiver, oakmoss and sandalwood give it a clean finish.
A daytime favorite for spring and summer, the office and weekends.

Fierce by Abercrombie & Fitch is a Woody Aromatic fragrance for men. Fierce was created by Christophe Laudamiel and Bruno Jovanovic. Top notes are petitgrain, cardamom, lemon, orange, fir and sea notes; middle notes are jasmine, rosemary, rose, lily-of-the-valley and sage; base notes are vetiver, musk, oakmoss, brazilian rosewood and sandalwood.

name: Abercrombie & Fitch First Instinct Blue Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
The scent balances an energetic opening, a spicy development and an
addictive trail. Frozen apple, combined with juicy bergamot and aromatic
cardamom, gives an exciting first impression. A mix of pepper, rosemary
and crisp lavender brightens up the heart while giving it an effortless
flair. At the base, addictive amber, supported by rich Sandalwood and
Tonka Beans, leaves a deeper trail of unexpected tones. It is
Abercrombie’s fragrant interpretation of the moment of exhilaration when
you feel the sky’s the limit. A fresh, one-of-a-kind Fougere scent for
the adventurous man whose lives by his First Instinct.
Head Notes: Frozen Apple, Cardamom, Bergamot
Heart Notes: Crisp Lavender, Rosemary, Pepper
Base Notes: Addictive Amber, Tonka Beans, Sandalwood

name: Abercrombie & Fitch First Instinct Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
'First Instinct' is the first fragrance to be sold outside of
the Abercrombie & Fitch boutiques. This addictive and irresistible
fragrance is a fougere aromatic amber. Blended for the man who lives by
his first instinct. This modern fragrance opens with electronic gin and
Tonic combined with kiwano melon. In the heart, szechuan pepper ignites
the spark to attraction while violet leaves bring depth and a citrus
twist. The base is made up of suede musk and sleek warm amber, creating
the perfect blend of fresh elements of fougere and oriental warmth.
Top notes: Gin, Tonic, Kiwano Melon
Heart notes: Violet Leaves, Szechuan Pepper
Base notes: Cashmere Woods, Sleek Amber, Sueded Musk
Woody/Earthy scent
Spray fragrance

name: Abercrombie & Fitch First Instinct Extreme Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
An intriguing and charismatic, intensely masculine fragrance.
The opening notes create an instant rush of invigorating pepper,
followed by an unforgettable development of warm cardamom. The base
notes leave an irresistible trail of sensual leather. It is
Abercrombie’s fragrant take on the charismatic personality of a man who
is naturally attractive. It's a genuinely intriguing and addictive woody
spicy oriental, blended for the man who is driven by his First
Instinct.
Head Notes: Invigorating Pepper, Mandarin Leaf, Star Fruit Heart Note: Violet Leaves, Saffron Powder Warm Cardamom, Spicy Pepper
Base Notes: Sensual Leather, Cashmere Wood, Extreme Amber, Coconut Water

name: Abercrombie & Fitch First Instinct Together Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text: First Instinct Together Eau de Parfum For Her by Abercrombie & Fitch is a delightful Floral Fruity fragrance designed for women. Introduced in 2020, this new scent features top notes of Pineapple and Red Currant, followed by a heart of Lily-of-the-Valley and Peony. The fragrance concludes with a warm base of Musk, Amber, and Sandalwood.

name: Abercrombie & Fitch First Instinct Together Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text: First Instinct Together Eau de Toilette For Him by Abercrombie & Fitch is a Woody Aromatic fragrance for men. This is a new fragrance. First Instinct Together Eau de Toilette For Him was launched in 2020. Top notes are Green Apple, Pineapple Leaf, Grapefruit and Cardamom; middle notes are Lavender and Orange Blossom; base notes are Musk, Sandalwood and Cedar.

name: Acqua di Parma Ambra Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: The 2019 Ambra Eau de Parfum by Acqua di Parma is a Woody Aromatic fragrance meant to be worn by both men and women. At first, it carries with it a blend of Orange, Calabrian Bergamot and Petitgrain. Followed by a combination of Cedar, Cypriol Oil or Nagarmotha, Rose and Patchouli at the heart of the fragrance. Finally, the scent complements the aroma with Ambergris, Sandalwood, Musk, Vanilla and Labdanum at the base.

name: Acqua di Parma Blu Mediterraneo Arancia Di Capri Eau de Toilette Unisex

notes.source_text:
This unisex perfume introduced in 1999 is
full of fresh, aromatic and encouraging notes. Top notes bring us juicy
freshness of orange, Sicilian mandarin, bergamot and luminous, bitter
grapefruit. A heart is composed of petit grain and cardamom, while a
base carries notes of caramel and musk.

name: Acqua di Parma Blu Mediterraneo Bergamotto di Calabria Eau de Toilette Unisex

notes.source_text:
The land of Calabria is strong and intense. Only here does authentic
bergamot find its natural habitat. Its sparkling notes appear at the
onset of this joyful and uplifting fragrance and are enhanced by the
freshness of citron, red ginger, and cedarwood. At the base, an
unprecedented combination of vetiver, benzoin, and musk emerges.
Notes:
Bergamot, Citron, Red Ginger, Cedarwood. Vetiver, Benzoin, and Musk.
Style:
Joyful. Uplifting. Unique.

name: Acqua di Parma Blu Mediterraneo Cedro Di Taormina Eau de Toilette Unisex

notes.source_text:
The
latest fragrance in the Blu Mediterraneo collection is inspired by
Taormina—a spectacular landscape where the unique and lush nature of the
Mediterranean vegetation blends with the impressive strength of
volcanic rock formations.
Fresh citrus essences and aromatic basil capture the landscape’s vibrant
fragrance and sunlit radiance. In the heart of the fragrance, black
pepper and lavender create a sparkling, spicy experience and blend
perfectly with the elegant, intense base notes of cistus labdanum,
vetiver, and Virginia cedarwood.
Notes:
Italian Citron, Black Pepper, Virginia Cedarwood, Elemi Resin, Vetiver, Guaiac.
Style:
Vibrant. Fresh. Sparkling.

name: Acqua di Parma Blu Mediterraneo Chinotto Di Liguria Eau de Toilette Unisex

notes.source_text: Chinotto di Liguria by Acqua di Parma is a Chypre Floral fragrance for women and men. Chinotto di Liguria was launched in 2018. Top notes are mandarin orange and chinotto; middle notes are jasmine, geranium, cardamom and rosemary; base notes are patchouli and musk.

name: Acqua di Parma Blu Mediterraneo Cipresso di Toscana Eau de Cologne Unisex

notes.source_text: Acqua di Parma Blu Mediterraneo - Cipresso di Toscana by Acqua di Parma is a Woody Aromatic fragrance for women and men. Acqua di Parma Blu Mediterraneo - Cipresso di Toscana was launched in 2005. The nose behind this fragrance is Bertrand Duchaufour. Top notes are Rosemary, Basil, Sage, Grapefruit and Petitgrain; middle notes are Pine Tree, Lavender, Coriander, Cardamom, Jasmine and Lily-of-the-Valley; base notes are Cypress, Silver Pine, Vetiver, Cedar, Oakmoss and Patchouli.

name: Acqua di Parma Blu Mediterraneo Fico Di Amalfi Eau de Toilette Unisex

notes.source_text:
Acqua di Parma Fico di Amalfi is a sunny blend of citrus and fig.
Launched in 2006, it opens with grapefruit, bergamot, citron and lemon. Fig nectar, jasmine and pink pepper form a juicy heart, and fig tree, cedar and benzoin give it a soft, woody finish.
A summer favorite for everyday wear and the gym.

The Amalfi Coast: it’s one of the most breathtaking places on Earth.
This floral, woody, and citrusy fragrance calls to mind this
breathtaking stretch of Mediterranean coastline with a strong,
energizing effect.
A unique combination of notes, including bergamot, lemon, grapefruit,
and citron open the fragrance. Fig nectar, pink pepper, and jasmine
petals are blended at the heart and base notes of fig wood, cedarwood,
and benzoin follow.
Notes:
Bergamot, Lemon, Grapefruit, Citron, Fig Nectar, Pink Pepper, Jasmine Petals, Fig Wood, Cedarwood, and Benzoin.
Style:
Strong. Energizing. Unique.

name: Acqua di Parma Blu Mediterraneo Mandorlo di Sicilia Eau de Toilette Unisex

notes.source_text:
Sicily is a crossroads of art and culture, with the almond as part of the local tastes and traditions.
Known in Italian as Mandorlo di Sicilia, the soothing appeal of Sicilian
almond opens this delicious fragrance. Its sweet caress joins notes of
star anise, bergamot, and orange. The fragrance’s heart blends green
Mediterranean almond and ylang-ylang before base notes of cedarwood,
vanilla, and white musk emerge.
Notes:
Sicilian Almond, Star Anise, Bergamot, Orange, Green Mediterranean Almond, Ylang-Ylang, Cedarwood, Vanilla, and White Musk.
Style:
Delicious. Sweet. Soothing.

name: Acqua di Parma Blu Mediterraneo Mirto Di Panarea Eau de Toilette Unisex

notes.source_text:
Panarea
near Sicily is an an island suspended in time. The smallest and oldest
of the Eolie islands, its essence is brought to life in this
revitalizing fragrance.
A scent characterized by the aromatic notes of myrtle and basil, it
opens with lemon and bergamot. At the heart, a sea breeze accord melts
with jasmine and rose. Its intense base includes lentisc and juniper
with cedarwood and amber.
Notes:
Myrtle, Basil, Lemon, Bergamot, Sea Breeze Accord, Jasmine, Rose, Lentisc, Juniper, Cedarwood, and Amber.
Style:
Revitalizing. Intense. Aromatic.

name: Acqua di Parma Buongiorno Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Acqua di Parma Buongiorno is a fresh, herbal scent made for bright mornings.
Launched in 2025, it opens with basil, spearmint, petitgrain, lemon and rosemary. Mandarin leaf and wild lavender form the heart, and cedarwood, white musk and amber give it a clean finish.
A daytime favorite for spring and summer.

name: Acqua di Parma Buongiorno Gioco Del Destino Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Buongiorno Gioco del Destino by Acqua di Parma is a new citrus fragrance created for both women and men. Introduced in 2026, it blends bright yellow mandarin, green mandarin, and lemon with soft musk and wheat for a fresh and distinctive composition.

name: Acqua di Parma Camelia Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Camelia Eau de Parfum by Acqua di Parma is a Floral fragrance for women and men. Camelia Eau de Parfum was launched in 2019. Top notes are Calabrian bergamot, Yellow Mandarin, Pink Pepper and Cardamom; middle notes are Camelia, Jasmine Sambac and Clary Sage; base notes are Musk and Benzoin.

name: Acqua di Parma Colonia Ambra Eau de Cologne For Men

notes.source_text: Colonia Ambra by Acqua di Parma is a Amber fragrance for men. Colonia Ambra was launched in 2015.

name: Acqua di Parma Colonia Assoluta Eau de Cologne Unisex

notes.source_text:
Acqua di Parma Colonia Assoluta by Acqua di Parma is a Citrus Aromatic fragrance for women and men. Acqua di Parma Colonia Assoluta
was launched in 2003. Acqua di Parma Colonia Assoluta was created by
Bertrand Duchaufour and Jean-Claude Ellena. Top notes are Bitter Orange,
Bergamot, Lemon Verbena and Sweet Orange; middle notes are Ylang-Ylang,
Vetiver, Jasmine, Cedar, Cardamom, Pink Pepper and Paprika; base notes
are Oakmoss, resins, White Musk and Patchouli.

name: Acqua di Parma Colonia C.L.U.B. Eau de Cologne for Men

notes.source_text: Colonia C.L.U.B. by Acqua di Parma is a Woody Spicy fragrance designed for men. Introduced as a fresh addition to the lineup in 2022, this scent opens with vibrant top notes of Pink Pepper, Lemon, Bergamot, and Black Pepper. Its heart is enriched with Shiso and Rosemary, while the base features the grounding notes of Cedar and Musk.

name: Acqua di Parma Colonia Club Eau de Cologne for Men

notes.source_text:
Colonia Club captures bold masculinity and a modern style inspired by
one of the most exclusive sports clubs in the world—horse dressage. The
fragrance is a fresh, timeless classic for the stylish, modern
gentleman.
Notes:
Sicilian Lemon, Petit Grain, Bergamot, Sicilian Mandarin, Mint,
Neroli, Lavander, Geranium, Shiso, Carvi, Galbanol, Haitian Vetiver,
Musk, Ambergris Accord.
Style:
Fresh. Vibrant. Masculine.

name: Acqua di Parma Colonia Eau de Cologne Unisex

notes.source_text:
Acqua di Parma Colonia Eau de Cologne Natural Spray is a fresh, refined and timeless fragrance for the pragmatic and successful man who loves tradition. It is a composition born from sunny Sicilian fruits and a harmonious blend of floral essences such as lavender and damask rose that merge with woody notes of vetiver, sandalwood and patchouli.
Notes: bergamot, lemon, bitter orange, sweet orange, English lavender, Bulgarian rose, verbena, ylang-ylang, clary sage, rosemary, cedarwood, patchouli, sandalwood, vetiver, oakmoss.
An elegant timeless scent filled with a fresh, luminous blend of natural ingredients like Bulgarian rose, Sicilian citrus fruits, lavender, and verbena.
Notes:Bergamot, Citrus, Lemon, Bitter Orange, Sweet Orange, English Lavender, Bulgarian or Damascene Rose, Verbena, Clary Sage, Rosemary, Cedarwood, Patchouli, Sandalwood, Vetiver, Oakmoss.Style:Classic. Timeless. Natural.

name: Acqua di Parma Colonia Ebano Eau de Cologne Concentree for Men

notes.source_text:
Colonia Ebano by Acqua di Parma is a Woody fragrance for men. Colonia Ebano
was launched in 2017. Top notes are resins, Red Pepper, Petitgrain and
Bergamot; middle notes are Ebony and Honey; base notes are Vetiver and
Patchouli.

name: Acqua di Parma Colonia Essenza Eau de Cologne for Men

notes.source_text:
Acqua di Parma Colonia Essenza is a richer, more refined take on the classic Italian cologne.
Launched in 2015, it opens with mandarin, orange, petitgrain, bergamot and grapefruit. Neroli, sage, jasmine, rose and rosemary form an elegant heart, and clove, moss, patchouli, vetiver and amber give it depth.
A polished daytime scent for spring and summer and a natural fit for the office.

The newest Eau de Cologne from Acqua di Parma is hand crafted in the
same tradition as the original and iconic Colonia, representing the
essence of Italian luxury and style. Colonia Essenza is a woodsy citrus
fragrance, using only the finest and purest essences for the formula.
Notes:
Bergamot, Lemon, Mandarin, Orange,
Grapefruit, Petitgrain, Neroli, Rosemary, Clove, Lilly of the Valley,
Rose Accord, Jasmine Accord, Patchouli, Vetiver, White Musk, Amber.
Style:
Refined. Elegant. Stylish.

name: Acqua di Parma Colonia Futura Eau de Cologne Unisex

notes.source_text: Colonia Futura by Acqua di Parma is a Citrus Aromatic fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Colonia Futura was launched in 2020. Top notes are Lemon, Bergamot, Grapefruit and Pink Pepper; middle notes are Lavender and Sage; base note is Vetiver.

name: Acqua di Parma Colonia Il Profumo Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Colonia Il Profumo by Acqua di Parma is an Aromatic Fruity fragrance designed for both women and men. This fresh scent was introduced in 2025. The top notes feature vibrant Orange, Bergamot, Lemon, Petitgrain, and Pineapple, while the heart of the fragrance blooms with Verbena, Neroli, Lavender, Ylang-Ylang, and Rose. The base notes create a rich foundation with Moss, Vetiver, Cedar, Patchouli, Leather, and Sandalwood.

name: Acqua di Parma Colonia Intensa Cologne for Men

notes.source_text:
Colonia Intensa by Acqua di Parma is a Woody fragrance for men. Colonia Intensa
was launched in 2007. Colonia Intensa was created by Alberto Morillas
and Francois Demachy.
Top notes are Citruses, Bergamot, Cardamom, Ginger
and Sicilian Lemon;
Middle notes are Neroli, Cedar, Myrhh, Guaiac Wood
and Artemisia;
Base notes are Leather, Benzoin, Musk and Patchouli.

name: Acqua di Parma Colonia Leather Eau de Cologne for Men

notes.source_text:
Acqua
Di Parma presents an original creation born from the unconventional
pairing of fresh citrus notes from the iconic Colonia fragrance and the
rich and sensual caress of aromatic leather. Colonia Leather Eau de
Cologne Concentrée recalls the artistic luxury and traditions of
handcrafted leather and accessories.
Notes:
Sicilian Lemon, Italian Orange, Raspberry, Honeysuckle, Petit Grain, Rose, Leather, Cedarwood, Birchwood, Gaiac Wood, Labdaum.
Style:
Stylish. Elegant. Masculine.

name: Acqua di Parma Colonia Mirra Eau de Cologne For Men

notes.source_text: Colonia Mirra by Acqua di Parma is a Amber Woody fragrance for men. Colonia Mirra was launched in 2017. Top notes are Orange Blossom and Citruses; middle notes are Myrhh and Nutmeg; base notes are Amber and Patchouli.

name: Acqua di Parma Colonia Oud Eau de Cologne for Men

notes.source_text:
Colonia Oud, crafted by Acqua di Parma, is an enticing Amber Woody fragrance designed for men. Introduced in 2012, this captivating scent was created by perfumer Francois Demachy. It opens with fresh top notes of Calabrian bergamot and Italian orange, leading into a heart of agarwood (oud), amyris, and coriander. The fragrance concludes with a rich base of leather, Atlas cedar, sandalwood, musk, and Indonesian patchouli leaf.

Hailing from Southeast Asia, Oud is rare and widely sought after. It is
said to cost more than its weight in gold. A new interpretation of
Colonia Intensa, Colonia Oud combines the unique freshness of Colonia
Intensa with one of the world’s most cherished ingredients, Oud, for an
unforgettable fragrance that is both fresh and richly aromatic.
A touch of masculine elegance. The traditional Acqua di Parma
Colonia Intensa bottle shape is distinguished with a deep matte brown
finish on the glass and cap. Colonia Intensa Oud is presented in a hand
crafted box lined with luxurious brown satin.
Notes:
Bergamot from Calabria, Italian Orange, Haitian Amyris
Oil, Russian Coriander, Agarwood Oil, Moroccan Cedarwood, Indonesian
Patchouli Oil, Leather Accord, Sandalwood Accord, Musk.
Style:
Luxurious. Fresh. Masculine.

name: Acqua di Parma Colonia Pura Eau de Cologne Unisex

notes.source_text:
Acqua di Parma Colonia Pura is a Unisex fragrance, The fragrance launched in 2017, The nose behind this fragrance is Francois Demachy,
Top Note: Ozonic notes, Bergamot, Orange, Petitgrain
Heart Note: Narcissus, Jasmine Sambac, Coriander
Base Note: White Musk, Cedar, Patchouli

name: Acqua Di Parma Colonia Quercia Eau de Cologne Concentree for Men

notes.source_text:
Colonia Quercia by Acqua di Parma is a Amber Spicy fragrance for men. Colonia Quercia
was launched in 2016. Top notes are Bergamot, Lemon, Petitgrain and
Pink Pepper; middle notes are Geranium, Cedar and Cardamom; base notes
are Oakmoss, Tonka Bean and Patchouli.

name: Acqua di Parma Colonia Quercia Eau de Cologne for Men

notes.source_text: Colonia Quercia, crafted by Acqua di Parma, is an amber-spicy fragrance designed for men. Introduced in 2016, this scent opens with lively top notes of Bergamot, Lemon, Petitgrain, and Pink Pepper. The heart reveals a captivating blend of Geranium, Cedar, and Cardamom, while the base features deep, earthy notes of Oakmoss, Tonka Bean, and Patchouli.

name: Acqua di Parma Colonia Quercia Eau de Parfum Concentree Unisex

notes.source_text: Quercia Eau de Parfum by Acqua di Parma is a Woody Aromatic fragrance for women and men. Quercia Eau de Parfum was launched in 2019. Top notes are Lemon, Pink Pepper, Calabrian bergamot and Petitgrain; middle notes are Cardamom, Cedar and Geranium; base notes are Moss, Tonka Bean and Patchouli.

name: Acqua di Parma Gelsomino A Freddo Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Gelsomino A Freddo, crafted by Acqua di Parma, is a unisex fragrance that debuted in 2025. This captivating scent opens with vibrant top notes of Pink Pepper, Artemisia, and Lemon. At the heart, you'll find a delightful blend of Jasmine, Iris, and Black Tea, while the foundation comprises rich base notes of Patchouli, Guaiac Wood, and Nagarmotha.

name: Acqua di Parma Gelsomino Nobile Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Acqua di Parma Gelsomino Nobile is a Floral Woody Musk fragrance designed for women, introduced in 2011. The scent was crafted by renowned perfumers Michel Almairac and Francois Demachy. The fragrance opens with vibrant top notes of Mandarin Orange and Pink Pepper, leading into a heart of exquisite Jasmine, Tuberose, and Orange Blossom. The composition is anchored by a warm base of Musk and Cedar.

Acqua di Parma Gelsomino Nobile by Acqua di Parma is a Floral Woody Musk fragrance for women. Acqua di Parma Gelsomino Nobile was launched in 2011. Acqua di Parma Gelsomino Nobile was created by Michel Almairac and Francois Demachy. Top notes are Mandarin Orange and Pink Pepper; middle notes are Jasmine, Tuberose and Orange Blossom; base notes are Musk and Cedar.

name: Acqua di Parma Iris Nobile Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Acqua di Parma Iris Nobile by Acqua di Parma is a Floral Woody Musk fragrance for women. Acqua di Parma Iris Nobile
was launched in 2006. Acqua di Parma Iris Nobile was created by
Francoise Caron and Francis Kurkdjian. Top notes are iris, Star Anise,
Bergamot, Orange and Mandarin Orange; middle notes are Tuberose, Orange
Blossom, Mimosa, Ylang-Ylang, Hibiscus and Cedar; base notes are Vanilla
and Amber.

name: Acqua di Parma Leather Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Leather Eau de Parfum by Acqua di Parma is a unisex fragrance that embodies the essence of leather. Introduced in 2019, this scent opens with vibrant top notes of Raspberry, Brazilian Orange, and Sicilian Lemon. The heart features a floral blend of Rose, Red Thyme, Honeysuckle, and Petitgrain, while the base is enriched with warm notes of Leather, Guaiac Wood, and Cedar.

Leather Eau de Parfum by Acqua di Parma is a Leather fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Leather Eau de Parfum
was launched in 2019. Top notes are brazilian orange, sicilian lemon
and raspberry; middle notes are red thyme, honeysuckle, petitgrain and
rose; base notes are leather, cedar and guaiac wood.

name: Acqua di Parma Lily Of The Valley Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Lily of the Valley by Acqua di Parma is a Floral fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Lily of the Valley was launched in 2021. Top notes are Black Currant, Grapefruit and Bergamot; middle notes are Lily-of-the-Valley, Jasmine, Geranium and Magnolia; base notes are Cedar and Musk.

name: Acqua di Parma Luce di Rosa Unisex

notes.source_text: Luce di Rosa by Acqua di Parma is a captivating Floral Woody Musk scent suitable for both women and men. Introduced in 2024, this new fragrance opens with vibrant top notes of Pink Pepper, Bergamot, Black Pepper, Mandarin, and Cardamom. The heart features a beautiful blend of Bulgarian Rose and Geranium, while the base is a warm and earthy combination of Guaiac Wood, Vetiver, Cedar, and Musk.

name: Acqua di Parma Magnolia Nobile Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Acqua di Parma Magnolia Nobile by Acqua di Parma is a Floral Fruity fragrance for women. Acqua di Parma Magnolia Nobile
was launched in 2009. The nose behind this fragrance is Antoine
Maisondieu. Top notes are Citron, Lemon and Bergamot; middle notes are
Magnolia, Jasmine, Rose and Tuberose; base notes are Vetiver,
Sandalwood, Patchouli and Vanilla.

name: Acqua di Parma Mirto di Panarea La Riserva Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Mirto di Panarea La Riserva by Acqua di Parma is a fresh and citrusy aromatic fragrance suitable for both women and men. This innovative scent was introduced in 2025. The fragrance opens with top notes of Citron, Juniper Berries, and Sage, leading into a heart of Lavender, Myrtle, and Myrrh. The base is enriched with Patchouli, Labdanum, and Mastic (Lentisque).

name: Acqua di Parma Note di Colonia I Eau de Cologne Unisex

notes.source_text: Note di Colonia I by Acqua di Parma is a Chypre Floral fragrance for women and men. Note di Colonia I was launched in 2016. Top notes are Bergamot and Neroli; middle notes are Violet, Damask Rose and Lavender; base notes are Patchouli and Cedar.

name: Acqua di Parma Note di Colonia III Eau de Cologne Unisex

notes.source_text: Note di Colonia III by Acqua di Parma is a Amber fragrance for women and men. Note di Colonia III was launched in 2016. Top notes are Mandarin Orange and Ginger; middle notes are Olibanum, Vetiver and Jasmine; base notes are Myrhh, Labdanum and Tonka Bean.

name: Acqua di Parma Note di Colonia IV Eau de Cologne Unisex

notes.source_text: Note di Colonia IV by Acqua di Parma is a Amber Floral fragrance for women and men. Note di Colonia IV was launched in 2017. Top notes are Mandarin Orange and Bergamot; middle notes are Orange Blossom and Turkish Rose; base notes are Opoponax, Labdanum and Patchouli.

name: Acqua di Parma Osmanthus Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Osmanthus Eau de Parfum by Acqua di Parma is a Floral fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Osmanthus Eau de Parfum
was launched in 2019. Top notes are Neroli and Green Mandarin; middle
notes are Ambrette (Musk Mallow), Peony and Pink Pepper; base notes are
Osmanthus and Patchouli.

name: Acqua di Parma Oud & Spice Eau de Parfum for Men

fascinating notes. The sweet essence of vanilla is extracted from the
cloves and combined with notes of bergamot, mandarin, neroli and jasmine
sambac for an enveloping and warm composition. An artistic combination
celebrating Madagascar's precious essence.

notes.source_text:
Her Highness Red Perfume by Afnan, As we walked along the plaza outside
the opulent Burj Khalifa, the tallest building in the world, a cool
breeze
wafted in from the
ocean. Evening fell, and we found ourselves dazzled by the Dubai
Fountain, perhaps the most extravagant and beautiful man-made water and
light show in existence. I’ll never forget that magical evening! Afnan
Her Highness Red Perfume captures the enchantment and scents of the best
the United Arab Emirates has to offer. Sea salt and
a breath of ocean opens the fragrance in a crisp and breathlessly fresh
top. Sweet and powdery heliotrope carries the heart, along with
undertones of juicy fruits and a bouquet of white florals. Elegant and
soft musk creates a memorable base. Unusual and intriguing, this perfume

notes.source_text:
Supremacy Incense - is a burning heat, embracing passion and alluring sensuality.
The warm spice at the beginning shows a spicy oregano combined with a
slightly bitter bergamot, into which the majestic, velvety ambergris
melts the honey heat. Crispy green apple and seductive blackcurrant
stalked with delicious pineapple are added.
The softness of the
trees embraces and attracts, but at the same time deepens the aroma
especially with the touches of oud oil, whose chords are smooth in this
composition. The echoes of flowers, headed by roses and Moroccan
jasmine, float to the trees.
Smoke from smoldering rare trees,
skin with undertones of apricots and a sensual musk charge, accompanied
by a few nuances of vanilla pods, enters the scene.
The final
parade shows earthy shades of oak moss, herbal spice patchouli with
bitterly leathery labdan, whose interconnected smell will make a special
touch of mystery.

notes.source_text:
Afnan Violet Bouquet for Women is opened by tones of jasmine
swaying in the waves of seduction, from the initial sweetness of
fully-flowing white-blooming, intoxicating tufts of flowers, through
still-flushed flower buds whose fragrance encircles earth and green with
a blend of flowers and twig petals. tenderness with falling twilight,
when jasmine lightly sleeps together with the intertwining bittersweet
saffron, with undertones hidden in flashes of skin.
The velvety powdery chord melts into the honey bed of noble ambergris,
in which floral nuances will once again sound, this time in the main
tones of graceful violets.
Rare woody plants, turning their tones into majestic cedars and a spicy
green aroma of firs with their balsamic-resinous notes, which also
contain some forest moisture, which is chased by dry mosses.

name: Amouage Beach Hut Man Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Amouage Beach Hut Man is a green, mossy fragrance that captures a wild coastline.
Elise Benat created it in 2017. Mint, galbanum and orange blossom open fresh and green, ivy, vetiver and moss form an earthy heart, and woods, myrrh and patchouli give it depth.
A refreshing daytime scent for spring and summer, the office and everyday wear.

When is a beach scent more than just
a beach scent? When it's part of Amouage's stunningly inventive suite
of new releases. Beach Hut Man, the newest from the Midnight Flower
collection, is no mere salty aquatic- instead, as told by Creative
Director Christopher Chong, it's "the story of an iridescent aromatic
idyll that unfolds in the fragrant wild garden of a beach hut." What
does that mean in plain language? It means that Beach Hut Man is equal
parts oceanic and intensely green, for an utterly unique and exciting
new masculine that invigorates and relaxes in equal measure.
Beach Hut Man  Notes
Mint, orange blossom, galbanum, vetiver, moss, ivy, patchouli, myrrh, dry woods

notes.source_text:
Beloved Man opens with a robust but restrained burst of fresh, spicy and
aromatic notes, as pepper and cardamom add kick to a brightly tart
grapefruit and piney, terpenic elemi. As the subtly sophisticated floral
heart notes kick in, a rich chord of saffron gives savory depth. A
stout, gently earthy base featuring leather and guaiac exudes effortless
masculinity. All in all, Beloved Man feels exactly as it was intended:
like the comfort and contentment that comes from a relationship that is
strong, supportive and permanent. We're thrilled to finally have the
opportunity to share this exclusive gem with you.
Beloved Man  Notes
Orange, grapefruit, elemi, geranium, jasmine, orris, saffron, cedar, guaiac, leather, patchouli, musk, vetiver

name: Amouage Fate Man Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
In the final creation that expresses
the end of the first cycle of the Amouage narrative, “Fate” for man and
woman explores the uncertainty of the future and the universal
principal by which the order of things is inescapably prescribed. The
immutable fragrances are presented in Amouage's iconic clear
glass-crystal bottles with a rainbow undertone with gold plated caps
accented with an aurora borealis inspired Swarovski crystal.
Fate Man is one of those rare perfumes where you just have to
try it to understand it. It begins with an opening salvo of absinthe and
herbs through a heart of immortelle swathed in the most luxurious
frankincense. The wheel of fortune that is Fate Man ends up on cedar and
licorice to bring this stunning perfume to a close. Despite being
labeled as masculine, Fate Man is a true shared fragrance and if you are
a fan of Amouage-- this is a must try. Fate Man is as ever-changing as
the swirling colors on the rainbow coated flacon; the experience is
slightly altered every time you wear it.
Fate Man  Notes
Mandarin,
saffron, absinth, ginger, cumin, everlasting flower, rose, frankincense,
lavandin, cistus, copahu, labdanum, cedarwood, liquorice, tonka bean,
sandalwood, musk

name: Amouage Gold Man Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
With Gold Man, Amouage shows it understands that sometimes the softer touch is the sexier. Instead of bombarding us with the typical hallmarks of a macho fragrance, Gold Man gently seduces with its blend of deep, dark jasmine, iris, and rose, grounded by civet, ambergris, musk, and Omani's celebrated silver frankincense. A hint of patchouli and oakmoss brings to mind the classic chypres of the 1930s. The overall feel of Gold Man is of luxury and mystery, like seeing an Aston Martin speeding through a warm night on a road above the ocean. The man who wears Gold is confident and sophisticated and doesn't need to flaunt his masculinity. We wouldn't rule out Gold for a certain type of femme fatale, either. A deeply luxurious and elegant Chypre.
Gold Man Notes
Frankincense, Rock Rose, Lily of the Valley, Orris, Myrrh, Musk, Cedarwood, Sandalwood, Patchouli, Oakmoss, Ambergris and Civet.

name: Amouage Gold Woman Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Every woman needs a Grand Perfume in
her arsenal, a fragrance that will make her feel like Jean Harlow in a
satin gown descending a marble staircase. Gold Woman is just that
fragrance. Legendary perfumer Guy Robert created Gold using the highest
quality ingredients that money could buy. He artfully melded more than
120 essences into an opulent perfume he calls the "crowning glory" of
his career. Gold opens with a champagne-like burst of greens and lily of
the valley, giving way to a floral symphony rich with rose and jasmine
but so lushly orchestrated that it's difficult to isolate any one note.
As Gold settles, it begins to purr with the warmth of sandalwood and
frankincense. Gold lasts for hours and hours, and a little goes a long
way. Gold Woman is a marriage of French tradition and Omani luxury that
no 1930s movie, no matter how glamorous, could top. So, go ahead. Dab a
few drops of Gold behind your ears and make an entrance they'll never
forget.
Gold Woman is housed in majestic gold glass bottle and the cap is crystallized by a single white opal Swarovski jewel.
Gold Woman  Notes
Frankincense, Rock Rose, Lily of the Valley, Orris, Jasmine, Myrrh, Musk, Cedarwood, and Sandalwood.

notes.source_text:
Amouage Guidance 46 is a rich, glowing extrait of pear, rose and creamy woods.
Quentin Bisch created it in 2024. Pear, rose water, bitter almond, hazelnut, frankincense and pink pepper open warm and luminous, rose, osmanthus, saffron and jasmine sambac form a lush heart, and sandalwood, vanilla, labdanum and ambergris give it a deep, lasting base.
Opulent but wearable, it works day or night in any season.

name: Amouage Guidance Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Amouage Guidance is a luminous blend of pear, hazelnut and osmanthus.
Quentin Bisch created it in 2023. Pear, hazelnut and olibanum open warm and glowing, osmanthus, rose, saffron and jasmine sambac form a rich floral heart, and sandalwood, vanilla, akigalawood and ambergris give it a creamy finish.
Opulent but easy to wear, it is a luxurious everyday signature.

name: Amouage Honour 43 Extrait de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text: Amouage introduces their Floral fragrance for women - Honour 43 Woman - released in 2021. Created by Alexandra Carlin, the scent opens with Rhubarb Leaf, Pepper and Coriander, followed by Tuberose, Lily-of-the-Valley, Jasmine and Carnation, concluding with Sandalwood, Vetiver, Labdanum, Opoponax, Olibanum and Leather.

name: Amouage Honour Man Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Honour Man, the regal, dramatic
masculine fragrance with a spicy, woody character, is heir to Amouage's
ongoing (soap) operatic narrative that began with Jubilation, and
continued on with Lyric, Epic, and Memoir.
With an intensely peppery, dark opening, Honour Man creates
olfactory storm clouds of disquiet, confusion, and drama befitting its
back story, which was written by the perfume house's creative director
Christopher Chong and inspired by Puccini's tragic opera Madame
Butterfly.
In Chong's melodramatic creative brief, Honour is the son of
Madame Butterfly, Puccini's tragic heroine who commits suicide when the
American soldier who abandoned her years before returns to take their
son. Honour has come back, so the narrative goes, to confront his
mother's tragedy and to come to terms with his identity.
After the blast of pepper, Honour Man allows a fresh,
rosy-floral note from geranium to peek through the dark clouds, followed
by a succession of warm, woody, and spicy notes, including an intense
patchouli that reminds us that Honour is still a fiery young man. Chong
suggests that these comforting, beautifully blended base notes represent
the reconciliation of our hero's troubled quest with his “filial elegy
to honour his mother.” Its dry down does indeed feel like the denouement
to a stormy, existential drama.
Honour Man is housed in a white crystal bottle with a gold-plated cap affixed with a white opal Svarovski crystal.
Honour Man  Notes
Pink pepper, black pepper, geranium, elemi, nutmeg, patchouli, frankincense, cedarwood, vetiver, tonka bean, musk

name: Amouage Honour Woman Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text: Honour Woman by Amouage is a sophisticated fragrance with an Amber Floral profile, skillfully crafted for women. This exquisite scent made its debut in 2011, brought to life by the creative perfumers Alexandra Carlin and Violaine Collas. The scent opens with a vibrant blend of top notes featuring the sharp tang of Rhubarb, spicy Pepper, and aromatic Coriander. As the fragrance unfolds, it reveals a heart overflowing with the scents of lush Gardenia, creamy Tuberose, delicate Jasmine, the fresh florals of Lily-of-the-Valley, and the spicy sweetness of Carnation. The fragrance culminates in a rich base of warm Amber, mystical Incense, the exotic resin of Opoponax, earthy Vetiver, and the smoothness of Leather, ensuring a lasting impression.

name: Amouage Imitation Man Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
One moment, one sensory experience,
can completely alter a child's perception of the world. For Amouage
Creative Director Christopher Chong, that moment happened the first time
he experienced New York City as a child in the 1970's- the vibrant
street culture, the breathtaking diversity, and the very sights, sounds
and smells of the greatest city in the world during a tumultuous and
consequential era threw open a door to life's infinite possibilities.
Imitation is his attempt to capture that vibrancy.
Imitation Man represents '70s NYC in bold, sensual, refined
leather tones, opening with electric citrus and tingling spices that
evoke blinding sunshine on bustling asphalt streets. The leather at the
center of the fragrance is rich, soft suede, refined with lush rose,
buttery orris and bright violet. An atmospheric base of spicy, smoky,
animalic notes gives the thrilling authenticity of a smoke filled
discotheque. Imitation Man will take you away to a time and place of
chaos and beauty- and the endless adventures that follow.
Imitation Man  Notes
Citron, nutmeg, black pepper, rose, orris, violet, myrrh, leather, vetiver, patchouli, castoreum

name: Amouage Imitation Woman Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Imitation for Woman by Amouage is a Chypre Floral fragrance for women. Imitation for Woman
was launched in 2018. The nose behind this fragrance is Pierre Negrin.
Top notes are Ylang-Ylang, Orange Blossom, Jasmine and Rose; middle
notes are Black Currant, Aldehydes and Licorice; base notes are Incense,
Patchouli and Sandalwood.

name: Amouage Interlude 53 Extrait de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Amouage Interlude 53 is a smoky, intense extrait of incense and resins.
Pierre Negrin created it in 2020. Pimento, oregano and bergamot open spicy, opoponax, amber, incense and labdanum form a resinous heart, and smoke, leather, oud, patchouli and sandalwood give it depth.
Made for fall and winter nights.

Interlude 53 by Amouage is a Amber Woody fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Interlude 53 was launched in 2020. The nose behind this fragrance is Pierre Negrin. Top notes are Pimento, Oregano and Bergamot; middle notes are Opoponax, Amber, Incense and Labdanum; base notes are Smoke, Leather, Agarwood (Oud), Patchouli and Sandalwood.

name: Amouage Interlude Black Iris Man Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Amouage Interlude Black Iris Man is a dark, smoky iris with leather and incense.
Pierre Negrin created it in 2020. Violet leaf, rosemary and bergamot open fresh, orris, olibanum, myrrh, labdanum and amber form a resinous heart, and leather, oud, sandalwood and patchouli give it a deep finish.
Made for fall and winter nights.

Interlude Black Iris Man by Amouage is a Oriental Woody fragrance for men. This is a new fragrance. Interlude Black Iris Man was launched in 2020. The nose behind this fragrance is Pierre Negrin. Top notes are bergamot, rosemary and violet leaf; middle notes are orris, amber, olibanum, labdanum, myrhh and vanilla; base notes are leather, agarwood (oud), patchouli, sandalwood and cedar.

name: Amouage Interlude Man Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Amouage Interlude Man is a smoky, resinous blend of incense, oregano and oud.
Pierre Negrin created it in 2012. Oregano, pepper and bergamot open bright and herbal, incense, opoponax, amber and labdanum form a smoky heart, and leather, oud, sandalwood and patchouli give it a deep finish.
A bold scent for fall and winter nights and date nights.

The Scoop
Interlude Man is a spicy – woody
fragrance that opens with zesty bergamot, oregano and pimento berry oil,
perpetuating intervals of conflict which are countered by aromatic
notes of amber, frankincense, opoponax, cistus and myrrh. Eternal notes
of leather, agarwood smoke, patchouli and sandalwood in the base add
lasting layers of depth and texture.
“I interpret what I see and feel into scents. All the social and
natural chaos and disorder surrounding us today can be translated to a
much more intimate level. The interlude moment is a reflection of all
the trials and tribulations one overcomes to attain personal
satisfaction and achievement.” He also explained the use of ingredients:
“Amouage has established an enviable reputation for re-inventing
accustomed scents. Frankincense and Myrrh traditionally smell spiritual
and religious but in Interlude, they have been reconstructed to feel
contemporary yet sophisticated.” –Christopher Chong
Interlude Man  Notes
Bergamot, Oregano, Pimento Berry Oil, Amber, Frankincense, Cistus, Opoponax, Leather, Agarwood Smoke, Patchouli, Sandalwood.

name: Amouage Interlude Woman Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Interlude Woman is a floral chypre
fragrance that reveals an interlude moment of unity and serenity. The
sweetness of bergamot and bitterness of grapefruit in the top notes
(together with ginger and tagete) create turbulent tensions while rose,
frankincense, jasmine, orange blossom, helichrysum, opoponax and
sandalwood in the intricate heart are masqueraded with an unconventional
combination of nut, coffee, kiwi, honey and agarwood. An opulent base
of sumptuous vanilla, benzoin, amber, sandalwood, oakmoss, leather,
tonka and musk inject warmth to the fragrance's contradicting accords.
Interlude Woman  Notes
Bergamot,
Grapefruit, Ginger, Tagete, Frankincense, Rose Absolute, Orange Blossom,
Nut, Kiwi, Coffee, Honey, Opoponax, Vanilla, Benzoin, Amber,
Sandalwood, Agarwood, Oakmoss, Leather, Tonka Beans, Musk

name: Amouage Journey Man Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
The Scoop
Like a Chinese dragon, Journey Man
opens with a fiery roar filled with Sichuan peppers and bold spices in a
golden, boozy flame. The peppers tingle and gently bite, while a richly
fruited sweetness intoxicates you with a cognac note. It's a visual of
gold and red, but darkness lurks all around, thanks to swirls of
incense, an oud-like cypriol woodiness, and a streak of leathery resins
in the base. Tobacco, a sprinkling of cardamom, and the juiciness of
neroli orange are the final touches to a complex fragrance that grabs
your attention from the start.
Journey is slowly transformed by a beautiful creaminess which
tames the dragon's fiery bite. A smooth layer of tonka vanilla coats the
peppers, dry woodiness, incense, and spices. The cognac booziness turns
into ambered warmth, and the perfume lingers more softly on the skin.
Over time, Journey turns into a creamy, tonka sweetness with woods,
spices, and just a hint of fruit mingle together. It's a bold fragrance
whose initial intensity gives way to softness in a rich mix that feels
very much like an Amouage.
Journey Man  Notes
Sichuan pepper,
Bergamot, Cardamom, Neroli Bigarade, Juniper Berries, Incense,
Geraniol, Tobacco Leaves, Ambrox, Cyriol, Tonka Bean Abstract

name: Amouage Jubilation 25 Woman Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text: Jubilation for Women by Amouage is a Oriental Floral fragrance for women. Jubilation for Women was launched in 2008. The nose behind this fragrance is Lucas Sieuzac. Top notes are ylang-ylang, rose, tarragon and lemon; middle notes are labdanum, rose, artemisia and incense; base notes are amber, patchouli, musk, vetiver and myrrh.

name: Amouage Jubilation 40 Extrait de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Amouage Jubilation 40 is a rich extrait of blackberry, incense and resins.
Bertrand Duchaufour created it in 2023. Blackberry, labdanum, black currant, orange, davana and rosemary open dark and fruity, frankincense, bay leaf, cinnamon, clove and rose form the heart, and opoponax, patchouli, myrrh, oud and ambergris give it depth.
Made for spring, fall and winter, day or night.

name: Amouage Jubilation XXV Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Amouage Jubilation XXV is a rich, opulent blend of incense, honey and spice.
Bertrand Duchaufour created it in 2008. Blackberry, olibanum, orange and labdanum open dark and fruity, honey, cinnamon, clove, rose and orchid form a lush heart, and opoponax, oud, myrrh, patchouli and ambergris give it a deep, resinous finish.
A grand scent for fall and winter, perfect for date nights and special evenings.

Jubilation XXV is a masculine fragrance by Amouage. The scent was launched in 2007 and the fragrance was created by perfumer Bertrand Duchaufour
Created for the enigmatic man carrying the essence of his philosophy and sophistication across all eras and cultures.
- Top notes: labdanum ciste, coriander, orange, davana, frankincense, blackberry- Middle notes: honey, bay, cinnamon, orchid, rose, clove, celery seeds, guaiac wood- Base notes: patchouli, opoponax, myrrh, atlas, cedarwood, musk, moss, ambergris, oud wood, immortelle

name: Amouage Lilac Love Woman Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Lilac Love by Amouage is a fragrance for women. Lilac Love
was launched in 2016. Top notes are Heliotrope, Lilac, Gardenia, Peony,
Jasmine and Rose; middle notes are Cacao, Tonka Bean and Orris; base
notes are Vanilla, Patchouli and Sandalwood.

name: Amouage Line 618 Essence De Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Line 618 by Amouage is a unisex Woody fragrance that made its debut in 2026. Crafted by perfumer Nathalie Lorson, this scent introduces a captivating blend of notes. The top notes feature an intriguing mix of Frankincense, Pineapple, Black Pepper, Peach, and Plum, while the heart reveals a creamy combination of Coconut Milk, Heliotrope, and Pine. Finally, the fragrance is anchored by a rich base of Sandalwood, Leather, Guaiac Wood, and Patchouli.

name: Amouage Lineage Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Lineage, crafted by the prestigious brand Amouage, is a bold Amber and Spicy scent suitable for both women and men. Recently unveiled in 2023, this fragrance is the creative brainchild of perfumer Karine Vinchon Spehner. Its composition begins with an invigorating medley of top notes, featuring the zest of Ginger, the bite of Sichuan Pepper, the exotic richness of Saffron, and the warmth of Peruvian Pepper. The heart of the fragrance is a resonant blend of sacred Olibanum, aromatic Fenugreek, and the deep, mystical essence of Myrrh. The scent concludes with a robust foundation of base notes, including the reverent duo of Olibanum and Myrrh, complemented by earthy Vetiver, resinous Labdanum, sweet Benzoin, and the grounding touch of Patchouli.

name: Amouage Love Delight Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text: Love Delight by Amouage is a Floral Fruity Gourmand fragrance designed for women. Introduced in 2024, this is a fresh addition to the fragrance scene. Created by perfumer Pascal Gaurin, the scent opens with top notes of ginger, mandarin orange, cinnamon, and rose water. The heart of the fragrance reveals heliotrope, jasmine, and rose, while the base is composed of vanilla, cacao, rum, and cypriol oil (also known as nagarmotha).

name: Amouage Love Hibiscus Eau de Parfum For Women

notes.source_text: Love Hibiscus by Amouage is an Oriental Floral scent designed for women. This is a fresh addition to their fragrance collection, introduced in 2026. The composition opens with delightful top notes of Salted Caramel, Passionfruit, and Bergamot. The heart reveals a captivating blend of Hibiscus, Frankincense, and Orris, while the base lingers with warm notes of Vanilla, Sandalwood, and Cypriol.

name: Amouage Love Mimosa Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Love Mimosa by Amouage is a Oriental Floral fragrance for women. This is a new fragrance. Love Mimosa
was launched in 2019. The nose behind this fragrance is Elise Benat.
Top notes are Cascalone, Violet Leaf and Orris; middle notes are Mimosa,
Pear and Paradisone; base notes are Heliotrope, Ambroxan and
Ylang-Ylang.

name: Amouage Love Tuberose Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Amouage Love Tuberose is a creamy blend of tuberose and whipped vanilla.
Launched in 2018, it opens with tuberose, gardenia and jasmine. Whipped cream and vanilla form a soft heart, and sandalwood and cedar give it a warm finish.
A lush daytime scent for spring and fall.

Love Tuberose by Amouage is a Floral Fruity Gourmand fragrance for women. Love Tuberose was launched in 2018. Top notes are Tuberose, Gardenia and Jasmine; middle notes are Whipped cream and Vanilla; base notes are Sandalwood and Cedar.

name: Amouage Lustre Essence de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Lustre by Amouage is a unisex Woody Floral Musk fragrance. Released in 2024, this newly introduced scent was crafted by Julien Rasquinet and Paul Guerlain. It opens with top notes of Cardamom and Orris, followed by a heart of Sandalwood, Cedarwood, and Patchouli. The base features a rich blend of Myrrh, Ambrarome, Vanilla, Tonka Bean, Benzoin, Cypriol, Labdanum, and Styrax.

name: Amouage Lyric Man Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Amouage Lyric Man is a rich, spicy rose with incense and woods.
Daniel Visentin created it in 2008. Lime and bergamot open fresh, rose, angelica, ginger, saffron, orange blossom and nutmeg form the heart, and musk, incense, pine, sandalwood and vanilla give it a smooth finish.
Versatile in spring, fall and winter, perfect for date nights.

Lyric Man is the rarest of species- a
masculine rose. Deep, daring and dangerous, this is a spicy, oriental
rendition of the flower. Infused with angelica, pine and galbanum, the
perfume has a striking green, earthy quality that makes it appear very
classic, European and urbane. By contrast, the spices, nutmeg and
saffron, and frankincense place the scent much further East, infusing it
with the brooding sultriness that we find irresistible. The velvety
accord of vanilla, sandalwood and musk, in the base of the scent, gives
the fragrance unexpected softness. Audacious and harmonious, this is a
rose like no other. Although undeniably masculine, the scent will be
enjoyed by women who like dry, spicy, resinous florals.
Lyric for Men  Notes
Bergamot, lime,
rose, angelica, orange blossom, green galbanum, spicy ginger, nutmeg,
saffron, pine, sandalwood, vanilla, musk, frankincense

name: Amouage Lyric Woman Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
With Lyric Woman, Amouage is
redefining the use of rose in perfume by rendering the traditional note
in a completely unique manner. Spicy and resinous, Lyric Woman is an
oriental rose, rich, complex and intricate. The piquant character of the
composition is apparent immediately: the top notes blend bracing
bergamot with tangy ginger and contrast this cool accord with warm,
velvety spiciness of cardamom and cinnamon. The regal, crimson rose,
surrounded by a creamy, opulent posse of ylang ylang, jasmine and orris,
retains that spicy character in the heart of the fragrance, due to the
presence of fiery geranium. The base of the scent, which includes the
luxurious signature note of Amouage, frankincense, finishes the
beautiful melody on a deep, sensual note. The drydown of woods, resins,
vanilla and patchouli, paired with rose, is decadently rich, the epitome
of Oriental luxury.
Lyric for Women  Notes
Bergamot, spicy
cardamom, cinnamon, ginger, rose, angelica, jasmine, ylang-ylang,
geranium, orris, oakmoss, musk, wood, patchouli, vetiver, sandalwood,
vanilla, tonka bean, frankincense

name: Amouage Material Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text: Material by Amouage is a Amber Vanilla fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Material was launched in 2021. The nose behind this fragrance is Cécile Zarokian. Top notes are Patchouli and elemi; middle notes are Madagascar Vanilla and Benzoin; base notes are Tonka Bean, Incense, Guaiac Wood, Labdanum, Agarwood (Oud) and Osmanthus.

name: Amouage Meander Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Meander by Amouage is a Oriental Fougere fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Meander
was launched in 2020. The nose behind this fragrance is Mackenzie
Reilly. Top notes are Olibanum, Carrot Seeds, Pink Pepper and Black
Pepper; middle notes are Orris, Cypriol Oil or Nagarmotha, Rose and
Narcissus; base notes are Sandalwood, Olibanum and Vetiver.

name: Amouage Memoir Man Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Amouage Memoir Man is a smoky, aromatic blend of wormwood, incense and leather.
Karine Vinchon Spehner created it in 2010. Wormwood, mint and basil open green, incense, lavender and rose form the heart, and tobacco, leather, sandalwood, vetiver, amber and oakmoss give it depth.
Made for fall and winter, day or night.

The Scoop
The releases from the house of
Amouage over the past three years have had a uniting thread:
uncomporomised richness and beauty. Their new series Memoir presents a
new chapter in this narrative as conceived by Creative Director,
Christopher Chong. Turning the industry norm of a dominant woman's
fragrance on its head, Chong instead conceived the two Memoir fragrances
from an inherently male point of view. Together, the Memoir fragrances
offer a new interpretation of the ‘space' between man and woman, one
that is almost impossible to resist.
Memoir Man is a Fougère, one that fractures the standard mix of
Lavender and Oakmoss into bright shards by the addition of Basil and
Mint and the further aspect of Absinth. Like a tray of unset gems the
topnotes sparkle on the skin, leading into heart notes of Woods and a
rich, smooth base of Vanilla, Amber and the traditional Oakmoss.
Inspired by Baudelaire's flâneur who walked the city in order to
experience it, the scent brings to mind the richness that is Paris. As
the "Gentleman stroller" he is a living duality: both observer and
observed, spectator and participant. Won't you take his hand?
Memoir Man  Notes
Basil, mint, frankincense, lavender, rose, oakmoss, leather, tobacco, absinth, wormwood, sandalwood, guaiac wood, vanilla, amber

name: Amouage Myths Man Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Myths Man is a surreal mirage of
oriental elements intoxicated with enigmatic tones of smoke and wood,
creating a fusion of dream and ambivalence.
Myths Man, represented by the celestial Chinese dragon, a symbol
of enlightenment and honour, opens with the classical beauty of
Chrysanthemum and Orris. The fragrance paves the way to an intoxicating
heart defined by an interpretation of a thorny rose accord. The
culmination is a base projecting both peace and calamity with Labdanum,
Ashes, and Leather.
Myths Man  Notes
Chrysanthemum, orris, rum, rose, vetiver, elemi, labdanum, ashes and leather.

name: Amouage Opus V Woods Symphony Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: The Library Collection Opus V Woods Symphony by Amouage is a fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. The Library Collection Opus V Woods Symphony was launched in 2022. The nose behind this fragrance is Jacques Cavallier. Top notes are Orris Root and Rum; middle notes are Orris Root, Rose and Jasmine; base notes are Dry Wood, Agarwood (Oud) and Civet.

name: Amouage Opus VII Eau de Parfum Unisex

middle: fenugreek that flow into the bottom notes of nutmeg
key: fenugreek that flow into the bottom notes of nutmeg
notes.source_text: Allow the alluring unisex fragrance of Amouage Library Opus VII to surround you in a luxurious scent to lift your mood and brighten your day. Introduced in 2013, the design house of Amouage blended together top notes of galbanum and pink pepper while adding middle notes of cardamom and fenugreek that flow into the bottom notes of nutmeg. This composition gives you the feeling of success and confidence whether you are at your office on a special date.

name: Amouage Opus VII Reckless Leather Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: The Library Collection Opus VII Reckless Leather by Amouage is a Leather fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. The Library Collection Opus VII Reckless Leather was launched in 2022. The Library Collection Opus VII Reckless Leather was created by Alberto Morillas and Pierre Negrin. Top notes are Galbanum, Fenugreek, Cardamom, Nutmeg and Pink Pepper; middle notes are Agarwood (Oud), Leather, Ambroxan, Ambergris and Patchouli; base notes are Cypriol Oil or Nagarmotha, Olibanum, Sandalwood, Costus and Musk.

name: Amouage Opus XII Rose Incense Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Amouage Opus XII Rose Incense is a smoky rose with olibanum and myrrh.
Bruno Jovanovic created it in 2019. Olibanum, an ink accord and elemi open dark, Damask rose and olibanum form the heart, and myrrh, vanilla, cedar and sandalwood give it a warm finish.
A rich choice for cooler days and evenings.

name: Amouage Opus XIII Silver Oud Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Amouage Opus XIII Silver Oud is a smoky, leathery oud with vanilla.
Cécile Zarokian created it in 2022. Cypriol, patchouli and Virginia cedar open earthy, oud and Madagascar vanilla form the heart, and castoreum, birch, ambrarome and guaiac wood give it a smoky finish.
A rich choice for cooler evenings.

name: Amouage Opus XIV Royal Tobacco Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Amouage Opus XIV Royal Tobacco is a rich, layered tobacco with spice and resins.
Cécile Zarokian created it in 2022. Anise, bergamot, olibanum, cardamom and basil open aromatic, lavender, rose, licorice, tobacco and osmanthus form the heart, and Peru balsam, labdanum, oud, vetiver, tonka bean and vanilla give it a deep finish.
Made for fall and winter nights.

name: Amouage Opus XV King Blue Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Amouage Opus XV King Blue is a fruity, leathery oud.
Hamid Merati-Kashani and Alexis Grugeon created it in 2023. Pink pepper, mandarin and black currant open bright, amber and frankincense form the heart, and oud, sandalwood, leather, oak and patchouli give it depth.
Versatile in spring, fall and winter, day or night.

name: Amouage Opus XVI Timber Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Amouage Opus XVI Timber is a fresh, resinous woody fragrance.
Alexis Grugeon created it in 2025. Cypress, cardamom, pink pepper, juniper and cocoa open crisp, fir, lavender and frankincense form an aromatic heart, and palo santo, vanilla, sandalwood, patchouli and cedarwood give it a warm finish.
Versatile in spring, fall and winter, day or night.

name: Amouage Outlands Essence de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Amouage Outlands is a bold, resinous journey of spice, leather and incense.
Cécile Zarokian created it in 2024. Cardamom, lemon, elemi, Sichuan pepper and frankincense open bright and spicy, patchouli, saffron, rose, cumin and orange blossom deepen the heart, and vanilla, benzoin, birch, oud, labdanum and amber leave a rich, smoky finish.
A statement scent for spring, fall and winter, day or night.

name: Amouage Overture 41 Extrait de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Amouage Overture 41 is a rich extrait of saffron, calvados and leather.
Annick Menardo created it in 2026. Saffron, cinnamon, frankincense and calvados open warm, benzoin, rose, sandalwood and geranium form the heart, and labdanum, vanilla, leather and patchouli give it depth.
Made for fall and winter nights.

name: Amouage Overture Man Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Amouage Overture Man is a rich, smoky blend of cognac, spice and incense.
Karine Vinchon Spehner created it in 2019. Cognac, cumin, cardamom, nutmeg, saffron, ginger and grapefruit open warm, myrrh, cinnamon, mastic, benzoin and labdanum form a resinous heart, and smoke, sandalwood, incense and leather give it a deep finish.
Made for fall and winter nights.

Overture Man by Amouage is a Woody Spicy fragrance for men. Overture Man was launched in 2019. The nose behind this fragrance is Karine Vinchon Spehner. Top notes are Cognac, Cumin, Cardamom, Nutmeg, Saffron, Ginger and Grapefruit; middle notes are Myrrh, Cinnamon, Mastic or Lentisque, Benzoin, Labdanum, Patchouli and Geranium; base notes are Smoke, Animal notes, Sandalwood, Incense, Leather and Clary Sage.

name: Amouage Overture Women Eau de Parfum

notes.source_text: Overture Women by Amouage is an Amber Woody perfume designed for women, launched in 2020. Created by perfumer Annick Menardo, this contemporary fragrance features an intriguing blend of notes. The top notes include Brandy, Apple, Saffron, and Bergamot, while the heart reveals May Rose, Benzoin, Myrrh, Cinnamon, and Geranium. The scent is anchored with base notes of Leather, Olibanum, and Labdanum.

name: Amouage Portrayal Man Eau de Parfum for Men

top: Portrayal Man emits a dandy yet masculine impression
key: Portrayal Man emits a dandy yet masculine impression
notes.source_text:
The fifth chapter of the second cycle of the Amouage narrative by Creative Director Christopher Chong, Portrayal is a manifestation of a person’s orientation to him or herself. A reflection of his or her unique authenticity, it is about breaking free from the cages of solitude society sets around people because their truths are often seen as shockingly unconventional.
Portrayal embodies an artist’s ability to reconnect fragments from different times and places. When society is barren, they are able to transport themselves and immerse in the freedom of rebellion that can be compared to London’s Roaring 1920’s and New York’s grooving 1980’s. With the flamboyant, glamorous and often disaffected companionship of Bright Young People, the artists lose themselves. Desperately seeking something to fill the void, they synergies with art, culture and themselves in order to recreate something infinitely indefinable.
Portrayal Man is an olfactive depiction of 1920s bohemian culture. Its woody and leather aroma exudes an air of exquisite audacity. It is about the arrogance and social tension in the world’s cultural discourse. With Vetiver at its heart and top notes of Violet Leaves, Portrayal Man emits a dandy yet masculine impression. Its light spicy facet enriches its woody base of Cade, allowing the fragrance to illustrate an enlightening energy that is unforgettable.
Amouage’s signature glass crystal bottles are introduced in an iridescent pearl finish adorned with a blue Swarovski crystal for Portrayal. The boxes are a delicate dusty blue with an elegant art deco inspired jacquard.
The nose behind this fragrance is Pierre Negrin.

name: Amouage Purpose 50 Extrait de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Amouage Purpose 50 is a refined extrait of incense, suede and warm woods.
Quentin Bisch created it in 2025. Frankincense, pimento, pink pepper and bergamot open bright and spicy, papyrus, sandalwood, vetiver and rose form a dry heart, and akigalawood, suede, vanilla and saffron give it a soft, luxurious base.
Sophisticated and calm, it suits special occasions and everyday luxury alike.

name: Amouage Purpose Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Amouage Purpose is a refined blend of incense, papyrus and suede.
Quentin Bisch created it in 2023. Bergamot, olibanum, pimento and pepper open bright and spicy, papyrus, vetiver, rose and sandalwood form a dry heart, and saffron, akigalawood, suede and Mystikal give it a soft finish.

name: Amouage Reasons Essence de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Reasons by Amouage is a Woody Spicy fragrance designed for both women and men. This newly released scent made its debut in 2024. Crafted by the perfumer Bertrand Duchaufour, the fragrance opens with top notes of Hazelnut, Cardamom, Pink Pepper, and Cinnamon. The heart of the fragrance includes Pine, Davana, Cashmeran, Cypriol, White Amber, and Patchouli. The base is composed of Palo Santo, Cedarwood, Sandalwood, Musk, Benzoin, Oakmoss, Myrrh, Vetiver, and Labdanum.

name: Amouage Reflection 45 Extrait de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Amouage Reflection 45 is the richer, deeper extrait take on the Reflection signature.
Lucas Sieuzac created it in 2021. Lavender, juniper, clary sage, cardamom and pink pepper open aromatic and fresh, iris, jasmine, neroli, tonka and vanilla form a smooth heart, and olibanum, myrrh, patchouli, sandalwood and vetiver give it depth.
Elegant and versatile, it works in every season, day or night.

Reflection 45 by Amouage is a Amber Spicy fragrance for men. This is a new fragrance. Reflection 45 was launched in 2021. The nose behind this fragrance is Lucas Sieuzac. Top notes are Lavender, Juniper Berries, Benzoin, Clary Sage, Cardamom and Pink Pepper; middle notes are iris, Jasmine, Neroli, Angelica, Tonka Bean and Vanilla; base notes are Olibanum, Myrrh, Opoponax, Patchouli, Cedar, Sandalwood and Vetiver.

name: Amouage Reflection Man Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Amouage Reflection Man is a refined floral-woody fragrance with a fresh, spicy opening.
Created in 2007, it opens with rosemary, pink pepper and petitgrain. Jasmine, neroli, orris root and ylang-ylang give it a soft, powdery floral heart, and sandalwood, vetiver, cedar and patchouli finish it with quiet depth.
Reflection Man is clean and elegant rather than loud, with a soft floral warmth that feels quietly luxurious. Wear it in the daytime from spring through fall, or save it for a special occasion.

The Scoop
The quintessence of masculine
elegance, Reflection Man captures the seductive power of a man's inner
strength. Edgy and classic, the composition juxtaposes coldness of
citrus with the warmth of spices. Top notes of rosemary, red pepper and
bitter orange leaves are chilly and bracing, a jolting breath of icy air
in the midst of summer. The piquancy, which is apparent from the start,
is rich and fiery, but never sharp, smoothed and softened by the
presence of velvety orris and creamy ylang-ylang. Floral notes
contribute to the sun-drenched, summery feel of the blend without
compromising its undeniably masculine feel. The base of vetiver,
patchouli and sandalwood, combined with the spices and orris, is dark,
enveloping, and sensual. Virile and unexpectedly soft at the same
time...a luxurious modern classic.
Reflection Man  Notes
Rosemary, red
pepper berries, bitter orange leaves, neroli, orris, jasmine, ylang
ylang, vetiver, patchouli, sandalwood, cedarwood.

name: Amouage Sunshine Man Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
The Scoop
Fresh and also warm, bright and also
dark, Sunshine Man is a striking new scent from the house of Amouage as
gorgeously contradictory as the solar eclipse from which it draws
inspiration. Built around a boozy, syrupy note of orange brandy, an
herbaceous kick of clary sage and juniper, and a rich yet fresh base of
cedar, tonka and vanilla, Sunshine Man is dramatically different in
composition from the frankincensed opulence of past releases, and yet,
in its sensuality and sophistication, it is clearly every bit an
Amouage, with originality and longevity to spare. With each contrasting
element playing off its counterpart, Sunshine Man achieves ideal
balance- the kind of spectacular scent that can cool off a hot summer
day or warm up a cold winter night. Another triumph for creative
director Christopher Chong and Amouage, Sunshine Man is a versatile new
addition to your wardrobe.
Sunshine Man  Notes
Lavender, orange brandy, everlasting flower, bergamot, juniper berry, clary sage, cedarwood, tonka bean, vanilla

name: Amouage The Library Collection Opus II Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: The composition of Opus II fragrance is a fougere one. This fragrance is created by the perfumer Michele Saramito. The olfactory journey begins with essential oils of lavender, wormwood, pink pepper and bay leaves. In the heart are the floral aromas of jasmine and rose spiced with cinnamon and cardamom, while the base features cedar, amber, musk, incense and patchouli.

name: Amouage The Library Collection Opus III Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Opus III is the third fragrance of the luxurious Amouage Library Collection, created by the perfumer Karine Vinchon Spehner. Floral notes of mimosa and broom introduce us into the world of this composition, together with cloves, nutmeg and thyme. Violet, jasmine, ylang-ylang and orange blossom essences are t the heart. The base is created with rich oriental notes of ambrette, papyrus, musk, notes of cedar wood, sandalwood and Guaiac, with the warm embrace of balsamic benzoin and soft vanilla. The Library Collection Opus III was launched in 2010.

name: Armaf Club de Nuit Eau de Toilette for Men

As it settles, the heart reveals a warm blend of aromatic Cinnamon, piquant Cloves, invigorating Ginger, and a hint of bold Pepper. Anchoring the fragrance, its foundation is built upon the rich warmth of Amber, a melange of spicy accords, the classic depth of Leather, the earthy essence of Patchouli, and a collection of woody notes that linger on the skin.

name: Armaf Club de Nuit Milestone Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text: Club De Nuit Milestone Cologne by Armaf, Go big with a fragrance that exudes sophistication and a down-to-earth vibe. An opening of fruit notes and sea salt instantly captures your attention. It transitions to a woodsy heart of iris, mandarin orange, bergamot and Sicilian lemon. Musk combined with sea tones creates the base. It’s a pleasant yet non-offensive scent that complements humid weather and blazing sun rays.

The heart of the fragrance includes rich middle notes of oak moss, White Wood, Anise, Jasmine, and Lily of the Valley. notes.source_text: Oud by Armaf is a Amber Fougere fragrance for women and men. Top notes are Spicy Notes, Caraway, Sage and Bergamot; middle notes are Black Pepper, Cedar and iris; base notes are Amber, Vanilla, Leather and Patchouli.

name: Armaf Shades Blue Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text: Shades Wood by Armaf is a Woody Spicy fragrance for men. Top notes are Rose, Geranium and Citruses; middle notes are Cloves, Cumin and Pepper; base notes are Agarwood (Oud), Sandalwood and Cedar.

name: Armaf Tag Him Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text: Tag-Him by Armaf is a Woody Spicy fragrance for men. Top notes are Grapefruit, Lemon, Pink Pepper and Bergamot; middle notes are Ginger, Mint, Nutmeg and Lavender; base notes are Vetiver, Sandalwood, Patchouli and Cedar.

name: Armaf The Pride of Armaf Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text: The Pride of Armaf For Men by Armaf is a Amber Spicy fragrance for men. Top notes are Bergamot, Lemon and Lemon Verbena; middle notes are Nutmeg, Cinnamon and Oakmoss; base notes are Tonka Bean, Vanilla and Sandalwood.

name: Armaf Tres Jour Pour Femme Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text: Armaf's Tres Jour is a women's scent that elegantly combines floral, woody, and musky elements. The initial burst of freshness comes from the top notes of Green Tea, zesty Lemon, and the slightly citrusy Neroli. At the heart of the fragrance lie the aromatic White Flowers, the intoxicating aroma of Jasmine, and the rich, creamy essence of Tuberose. Anchoring the scent, the base notes bring warmth and depth with the sensual Musk, the earthy Cedar, the sweet allure of Vanilla, and the exotic richness of Patchouli.

name: Armaf Tres Nuit Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text: Tres Nuit by Armaf is an aromatic and spicy scent designed for men. Its top notes consist of lemon verbena, iris, and lemon, while its middle notes include lavender, violet, and spicy notes. The fragrance is completed by Ambergris and sandalwood as its base notes.

name: Armaf Tres Nuit Lyric Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text: Armaf's Tres Nuit Lyric is an invigorating Floral Aquatic scent made for men, released in 2020. Its heady blend of Bergamot, Watery Notes, Mandarin Orange, Rosemary, Lavender, Cypress, Musk, Patchouli, and Amber gives the fragrance an unforgettable aroma.

name: Armaf Ventana Pour Homme Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text: Ventana Pour Homme by Armaf is a Woody Aromatic fragrance for men. Ventana Pour Homme was launched in 2017. Top notes are Grapefruit, Lemon and Mandarin Orange; middle notes are Lavender, Geranium, Vetiver and Patchouli; base notes are Cedar, Amber and Precious Woods.

name: Armani Mania Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text: Mania by Giorgio Armani is a Amber Spicy fragrance for women's. Mania was released in 1999. The Master Perfumer for this fragrance is Jacques Cavallier. Top notes are Labdanum, Vanilla, Orange Blossom and Bergamot. Middle Notess are Nutmeg, Saffron, Cloves and Amber. Base Notes are White Musk, Guaiac Wood, Vanilla and iris.

name: ArteOlfatto Paropamiso Extrait de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: ArteOlfato introduces Paropamiso, a unisex Woody scent that was released in 2015. Its heady aroma is composed of Bergamot, Apple, Lemon, Pink Pepper, Magnolia, Bergamot Blossom, Musk, Woody Notes, and Patchouli.

name: ArteOlfatto Vanesya Extrait de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text: The fragrance Vanesya, created by ArteOlfatto for women, was released in 2013. Featuring top notes of Narcissus, Mango, Peach and Mandarin Orange, as well as middle notes of Peony, Osmanthus, Rose and Pink Pepper, it ends with base notes of White Musk, Ambrette (Musk Mallow) and Patchouli for a floral-fruity scent.

name: Atelier Cologne Ambre Nue Cologne Absolue Unisex

notes.source_text: Ambre Nue by Atelier Cologne is a Amber Floral fragrance for women and men. Ambre Nue was launched in 2012. Top notes are Mandarin Orange, Tagetes and Bergamot; middle notes are Benzoin, Cinnamon and Orchid; base notes are French labdanum, Tonka Bean and Patchouli.

name: Atelier Cologne Cafe Tuberosa Cologne Absolue Unisex

Top notes are Precious Woods and Nutmeg; middle notes are Styrax, Guaiac Wood, Cedar Needles and Cedar; base notes are Tobacco Leaf and Vetiver.

name: Atelier des Ors Choeur Des Anges Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Atelier des Ors' Choeur Des Anges is a unisex scent with a floral essence. This fragrance made its debut in 2018. It opens with the zesty sweetness of Blood Orange, complemented by the freshness of Pear and the tartness of Black Currant. At the heart, you'll find a delicate blend of Osmanthus, earthy Carrot Seeds, and the gentle aroma of Orange Blossom. The scent settles into a rich base of warm Honey, deep Amber, and woody Cedar notes.

name: Atelier Des Ors Iris Fauve Eau de Parfum Unisex
