Top notes are iris, Cinnamon and Bergamot; middle notes are Haitian Vetiver, Cypriol Oil or Nagarmotha and Patchouli; base notes are Myrrh, Labdanum, Musk and Liatris.

name: Atelier Des Ors Rose Omeyyade Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Rose Omeyyade by Atelier des Ors is a Amber Floral fragrance for women and men. Rose Omeyyade was launched in 2015. The nose behind this fragrance is Marie Salamagne. Top notes are Rose, Raspberry and Pink Pepper; middle notes are Brown sugar, Patchouli and Guaiac Wood; base notes are Agarwood (Oud), Amber and Sandalwood.

name: Azzaro Forever Wanted Absolu Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Azzaro Forever Wanted Absolu is a rich blend of whiskey, vanilla and incense.
Launched in 2026, it wraps whiskey, vanilla, incense, woods and amber into a warm, smooth and slightly smoky scent.
Made for fall and winter nights.

name: Azzaro Forever Wanted Elixir Masculine

notes.source_text:
Azzaro Forever Wanted Elixir is a fruity, leathery aromatic.
Launched in 2025, it opens with raspberry, green mandarin and bergamot. Cardamom, lavender and clary sage form the heart, and leather, wolfwood and vetiver give it a smooth finish.
Versatile in spring, fall and winter, day or night.

name: Azzaro The Most Wanted Eau de Parfum Intense for Men

notes.source_text:
Azzaro The Most Wanted Eau de Parfum Intense is a warm, sweet toffee and spice fragrance.
Launched in 2021, it opens with cardamom, moves into a rich toffee heart and settles into amberwood for a warm, addictive finish.
Made for fall and winter nights.

The Most Wanted by Azzaro is a Amber Spicy fragrance for men's. This is a new fragrance. The Most Wanted was released in 2021. Top note is Cardamom. Middle Notes is Toffee. Base Note is Amberwood.

name: Azzaro The Most Wanted Intense Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text: Azzaro's The Most Wanted Intense is a masculine scent that falls within the Woody Aromatic category. Recently introduced to the market in 2024, this fragrance opens with the citrusy zing of Bergamot at the top. It then transitions into the heart of the scent, featuring the soothing aroma of Lavender. Anchoring the fragrance are base notes of rich Liquor and earthy Moss, adding depth and intensity to its olfactory profile.

name: Azzaro The Most Wanted Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Azzaro The Most Wanted Parfum is a warm, sweet blend of ginger, woods and vanilla.
Launched in 2022, it opens with a spicy kick of ginger, moves into a smooth woody heart and settles into a rich Bourbon vanilla base. Simple, magnetic and easy to like.
The Most Wanted Parfum is simple, magnetic and easy to like, with a sweet warmth that draws people in. It is a night-out favorite from fall through spring.

The Most Wanted Parfum by Azzaro is a Woody Spicy fragrance for men. This is a new fragrance. The Most Wanted Parfum was launched in 2022. Top note is Ginger; middle note is Woodsy Notes; base note is Bourbon Vanilla.

name: Azzaro Wanted By Night Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Azzaro Wanted by Night is a warm, spicy blend of cinnamon, tobacco and red cedar.
Michel Girard and Quentin Bisch created it in 2018. Cinnamon, mandarin, lavender and lemon open warm, fruity notes, incense, red cedar and cumin form the heart, and tobacco, vanilla, leather and benzoin give it a rich finish.
Made for fall and winter nights.

Wanted by Night by Azzaro is a Woody Spicy fragrance for men's. Wanted by Night was released in 2018. Wanted by Night was created by Quentin Bisch and Michel Girard. Top notes are Cinnamon, Mandarin Orange, Lavender and Lemon. Middle Notess are Fruity Notes, Incense, Red Cedar and Cumin. Base Notes are Tobacco, Vanilla, Cedar, Leather, Benzoin, Iso E Super, Cypress and Patchouli.

name: Azzaro Wanted Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text: Azzaro's Wanted Eau de Parfum is a fresh and woody aromatic scent for men, released in 2023. Its captivating composition features top notes of juniper berries, a middle note of sage, and a base note of vetiver.

name: Azzaro Wanted Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text: Wanted by Azzaro is a Woody Spicy fragrance for men's. Wanted was released in 2016. The Master Perfumer for this fragrance is Fabrice Pellegrin. Top notes are Lemon, Ginger, Lavender and Mint. Middle Notess are Apple, Juniper, Guatemalan Cardamom and Geranium. Base Notes are Tonka Bean, Amberwood and Haitian Vetiver.

name: Azzaro Wanted Tonic Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text: Wanted Tonic by Azzaro is a Woody Spicy fragrance for men's. This is a new fragrance. Wanted Tonic was released in 2020. Top note is Lime. Middle Notes is Ginger. Base Note is Patchouli.

name: Balenciaga Florabotanica Eau de Parfum For Women

notes.source_text:
Florabotanica by Balenciaga is a Floral Green fragrance for women. Florabotanica was launched in 2012. Florabotanica was created by Olivier Polge and Jean-Christophe Herault. Top note is Mint; middle notes are Rose, Carnation and cannabis; base notes are Vetiver and Amber.
A very interesting edition announced for September 2012 and aimed at younger audience arrives from the Balenciaga Company. Balenciaga, in collaboration with Coty, Prestige and IFF created the new fragrance FLORABOTANICA which attracts attention with its modern, attractive flacon and unusual ingredients.
The composition was developed by perfumers of the house of IFF, Olivier Polge and Jean-Christophe Herault, who composed it of such accords as mint, carnation, hybrid rose, caladium leaves, amber and vetiver. It was envisaged that the composition would offer floral character, which is also very seductive and its flowers will not be just beautiful, but also very dangerous.
The advertising campaign is decorated with three metal sculptures resembling the Ghesquière floral print created a few years ago. Photos for the campaign were taken by Steven Meisel, and the advertising face is young actress Kristen Stewart. She is wearing a dress from the floral collection and holding her hands in her pockets.

name: Baxter of California Pacific Cannabis Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Pacific Cannabis by Baxter of California is an Aromatic Aquatic fragrance designed for both women and men. Introduced in 2019, this scent opens with top notes of Pink Pepper, Rosemary, and Bergamot. The heart of the fragrance features Sage, Cannabis, and Lavender, while the base is composed of Driftwood, Patchouli, and Tonka Bean.

name: BDK Parfums 312 Saint Honore Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: BDK Parfums' 312 Saint-Honoré presents a contemporary Amber Floral scent that caters to both men and women. Recently introduced in 2024, this perfume marks the latest addition to the fragrance line. Crafted by perfumer Alexandra Carlin, the aroma opens with the spicy zing of Pink Pepper and the earthy essence of Angelica Root. At its heart, the blend showcases the rich texture of Iris, the sweet zest of Orange Blossom, and the creamy depth of Tonka Bean. It settles into a warm base where the gentle caress of White Musk meets the complexity of Ambroxan and the proprietary blend of Ambrostar™, culminating with the exotic woody touch of Thailand Oud.

name: BDK Parfums Ambre Safrano Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: The newest scent from BDK Parfums, Ambre Safrano, is a unisex perfume of woody and spicy notes, released in 2022.

name: BDK Parfums Bouquet de Hongrie Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Bouquet de Hongrie by BDK Parfums is a Floral fragrance for women. Bouquet de Hongrie
was launched in 2016. The nose behind this fragrance is David Benedek.
Top notes are Pear, Strawberry and Cassis; middle notes are Turkish
Rose, Jasmine Sambac and Lorenox; base notes are Musk, Cedar and Amber.

name: BDK Parfums Citrus Riviera Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:

was launched in 2020. The nose behind this fragrance is Ralf Schwieger.
Top notes are Italian Lemon, Neroli, Italian Mandarin and Fig; middle
notes are Watery Notes, Orange Blossom, Eucalyptus, Green Accord,
Immortelle, Jasmine and Strawberry; base notes are Haitian Vetiver,
Indonesian Patchouli Leaf, Tonka Bean and White Musk.

name: BDK Parfums Creme de Cuir Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Crème de Cuir by BDK Parfums is a Leather fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Crème de Cuir
was launched in 2018. The nose behind this fragrance is Violaine
Collas. Top notes are Pineapple, Mandarin Orange, Grapefruit and
Bergamot; middle notes are White Suede, Sandalwood, Pink Pepper and
Pepper; base notes are Cashmeran, Vanilla, Birch, White Musk and Gray
Musk.

name: BDK Parfums French Bouquet Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: French Bouquet by BDK Parfums is a Chypre Floral fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. French Bouquet was launched in 2020. The nose behind this fragrance is Amelie Bourgeois. Top notes are Aldehydes, Coriander and Bergamot; middle notes are Jasmine, Rose and Orange Blossom; base notes are Labdanum, Tobacco, Tonka Bean, Sandalwood, Patchouli, Violet and Vetiver.

name: BDK Parfums Gris Charnel Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
BDK Gris Charnel is a soft, sensual blend of fig, black tea and creamy woods.
Mathilde Bijaoui created it in 2019. Cardamom, fig and black tea open with a gentle spice, iris and Bourbon vetiver give the heart a powdery, earthy texture, and sandalwood and tonka bean leave a warm, skin-like finish.
Gris Charnel is intimate and comforting, the kind of scent people lean in to notice. It works day or night in spring, fall and winter and makes an easy unisex signature.

Gris Charnel by BDK Parfums is a Oriental Spicy fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Gris Charnel
was launched in 2019. The nose behind this fragrance is Mathilde
Bijaoui. Top notes are Cardamom, Fig and Black Tea; middle notes are
iris and Bourbon Vetiver; base notes are Sandalwood and Tonka Bean.

name: BDK Parfums Gris Charnel Extrait de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
BDK Gris Charnel Extrait is the richer, creamier version of the sensual fig-and-tea favorite.
Mathilde Bijaoui created it in 2022. Cardamom, black tea and fig open soft and spicy, Bourbon vetiver, iris and cistus deepen the heart, and sandalwood, cedar, Madagascar vanilla, patchouli and tonka bean give it a warmer, longer-lasting finish.
The extrait is deeper and sweeter than the original Gris Charnel, with a creamy vanilla warmth. Wear it day or night in spring, fall and winter.

Gris Charnel Extrait by BDK Parfums is a Woody Spicy fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Gris Charnel Extrait was launched in 2022. The nose behind this fragrance is Mathilde Bijaoui. Top notes are Cardamom, Black Tea and Fig; middle notes are Bourbon Vetiver, iris and Cistus Incanus; base notes are Sandalwood, Cedar, Madagascar Vanilla, Indonesian Patchouli Leaf and Tonka Bean.

name: BDK Parfums Impadia Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
BDK Impadia is a fruity, rosy blend of pear and vanilla.
Jordi Fernández created it in 2025. Pear, mandarin and bergamot open bright, Bulgarian and Turkish rose and African orange flower form the heart, and akigalawood, vanilla absolute and sandalwood give it a warm finish.
Versatile from spring through fall, day or night.

name: BDK Parfums Nuit de Sable Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Nuit De Sable by BDK Parfums is a fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Nuit De Sable
was launched in 2019. The nose behind this fragrance is Marie Schnirer.
Top notes are Sandalwood, Guatemalan Cardamom and Nutmeg; middle notes
are Turkish Rose, Rose and Sand; base notes are Nutmeg, Tonka Bean,
Ambroxan and Musk.

name: BDK Parfums Oud Abramad Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Oud Abramad by BDK Parfums is a Oriental fragrance for women and men. Oud Abramad
was launched in 2016. The nose behind this fragrance is David Benedek.
Top notes are Saffron and Ginger; middle notes are Cumin and Turkish
Rose; base notes are Agarwood (Oud), Guaiac Wood, Incense, Labdanum,
Patchouli, Ambroxan and Castoreum.

name: BDK Parfums Oud Paradisio Absolu de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Oud Paradisio, crafted by BDK Parfums, is an Oriental Woody fragrance designed for both women and men. This enchanting scent debuted in 2026, featuring the talented nose of Jordi Fernandez. The fragrance opens with vibrant top notes of pineapple, ice cream, incense, saffron, and bergamot. At its heart, you'll find the luxurious aromas of Bulgarian and Turkish roses, while the base envelops you in rich oud and cocoa.

name: BDK Parfums Pas Ce Soir Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
BDK Pas Ce Soir is a warm, fruity floral with quince and jasmine.
David Benedek created it in 2016. Mandarin, ginger and black pepper open bright, quince, Moroccan jasmine and orange blossom form the heart, and cashmeran, amberwood and patchouli give it a warm finish.
A lovely daytime scent for spring and fall.

Pas ?e Soir by BDK Parfums is a Floral fragrance for women. Pas ?e Soir
was launched in 2016. The nose behind this fragrance is David Benedek.
Top notes are Mandarin Orange, Ginger and Black Pepper; middle notes are
Quince, Moroccan Jasmine and Orange Blossom; base notes are Cashmeran,
Amberwood and Singapore Patchouli.

name: BDK Parfums Pas Ce Soir Extrait Unisex

notes.source_text: The newly released Pas Ce Soir Extrait by BDK Parfums is a captivating Amber Floral scent, suitable for both men and women. Launched in 2023, this fragrance was crafted by the talented nose Violaine Collas. Its top notes of Mandarin Orange, Pear, Ginger, Black Pepper and Cacao Pod are wonderfully complemented by middle notes of Quince, Moroccan Jasmine, Orange Blossom and Peach. Finishing off this aroma are base notes of Cashmeran, Indonesian Patchouli Leaf, Ambroxan, Vanilla and Benzion.

name: BDK Parfums Rouge Smoking Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
BDK Rouge Smoking is a sweet, powdery blend of cherry and vanilla.
Amélie Bourgeois created it in 2018. Cherry, pink pepper and bergamot open juicy, black vanilla, heliotrope and orange blossom form the heart, and tonka bean, cashmere wood, white musk and labdanum give it a warm finish.
Made for fall and winter, day or night.

Rouge Smoking by BDK Parfums is a Amber fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Rouge Smoking
was launched in 2018. The nose behind this fragrance is Amelie
Bourgeois. Top notes are Cherry, Pink Pepper and Bergamot; middle notes
are Black Vanilla Husk, Heliotrope and Orange Blossom; base notes are
Tonka Bean, Cashmere Wood, White Musk, Violet, Labdanum and Ambroxan.

name: BDK Parfums Rouge Smoking Extrait de Perfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
BDK Rouge Smoking Extrait is a richer, boozier version of Rouge Smoking.
Amélie Bourgeois and Margaux Le Paih Guérin created it in 2024. Cherry, almond, pink pepper, red mandarin and bergamot open sweet, Peru balsam, milk, tonka bean and labdanum form the heart, and oud, rum, vanilla and amber give it depth.
Made for fall and winter nights.

name: BDK Parfums Stellar Silk Absolu de Parfum Unisex

The fragrance concludes with a warm base note of White Sandalwood.

name: Bentley Beyond The Collection Majestic Cashmere Eau de Parfum Unisex

The top notes of Gardenia, Mandarin Orange, Bergamot and Cassis open the aroma, with heart notes of Raspberry, Elemi and Pink Pepper, all grounded with a base of Heliotrope, Vanilla, Praline, Ambrette (Musk Mallow) and Violet Leaf.

The blend of top notes includes Cassis, Bergamot, Mandarin Orange and Violet Leaves; middle notes consist of Red Peony, Lily-of-the-Valley, Jasmine, Damask Rose and Hibiscus; and base notes are Sandalwood, Patchouli, Musk and Moss.

name: Bentley Beyond The Collection Wild Vetiver Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Launched in 2019, Bentley's Wild Vetiver is a sophisticated Woody Aromatic fragrance for men and women crafted by perfumer Sidonie Lancesseur.

name: Bentley Momentum Unlimited Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text: Created by Bentley in 2018, Momentum Unlimited is a woody aromatic fragrance for men composed by the esteemed Michel Almairac. Its refreshing top notes include green apple, grapefruit, and cardamom, and its heart notes are cedar, vetiver, and sandalwood. Finally, its base notes are leather, musk, and ambroxan.

name: Better World Fragrance House Summer Mink Unisex

notes.source_text: Summer Mink, crafted by Better World Fragrance House, is an Oriental scent designed for both women and men. Launched in 2025, this captivating fragrance is the creation of perfumer Michael Carby. It opens with a blend of Clary Sage, Citrus, and Petitgrain, followed by heart notes of Jasmine Sambac, Rose, and a touch of Spices. The fragrance settles into a rich base of Musk and Vetiver.

name: Beyonce Ce Noir Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Introducing Cé Noir by Beyoncé, an enchanting new fragrance designed
exclusively for women. Launched in 2023, this exquisite scent is a
symphony of carefully selected notes, beginning with the sweet allure of
Honey and the zesty freshness of Clementine. At its heart lies a
captivating blend of Jasmine Sambac and Rose, evoking an essence of
feminine elegance. The fragrance elegantly concludes with the deep, warm
undertones of Myrrh and Amber, leaving a lasting impression of
sophistication and allure. Experience the magic of Cé Noir, a modern
classic in the making.

name: Bond No 9 Beekman Place Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Beekman Place by Bond No. 9 is a unisex fragrance introduced in 2024. The scent features top notes of pear, pineapple, bergamot, and black currant, followed by a heart of watery notes, driftwood, lemon, basil, pepper, and geranium. Its base notes include sandalwood, musk, tonka bean, leather, patchouli, amber, and oakmoss.

name: Bond No 9 Bond No.9's Island Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Bond No.9's Island by Bond No 9 is an aromatic aquatic fragrance designed for both women and men. This new scent was introduced in 2024. Crafted by perfumer Claude Dir, the fragrance opens with top notes of white ginger, basil, and water mint. Its heart reveals middle notes of seaweed, champaca, and green nuances. The base consists of amber, moss, and sandalwood.

name: Bond No 9 Brooklyn Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Brooklyn by Bond No 9 is a captivating Amber Spicy fragrance suitable for both men and women. Launched in 2008, this scent was created by the talented perfumer Laurice Rahme. It opens with invigorating top notes of Cardamom and Grapefruit, followed by a complex heart of Cypress, Gin, Juniper, and Geranium. The fragrance concludes with a warm base of Cedar, Guaiac Wood, and Leather.

Bond No. 9 has now designed its own eau de parfum. Unisex with a desirably masculine attitude, Brooklyn the scent is romantic, sexy, and distinctive--built in a very contemporary way to display its entire composition, rather than individual notes. But for those who want us to name names,it's officially a woody, spicy-filled oriental that mingles cardamom, geranium leaves, and cedarwood while grapefruit and juniper leaves accelerate the scent, and South American guaiacwood and leather bring a tender, beckoning touch. On the cutting-edge of perfumery, Brooklyn also has what's known in the trade as sillage, which is to say, it doesn't cling to the skin, but rather diffuses, leaving a trail behind it.
New York's legendary city within a city, home to a century or more of
strivers, dreamers, and Nobel laureates, its reinventing itself,
neighborhood by neighborhood, as an edgy metropolis.
A
longlasting woody, spicy, male-but-loved-by-females kind of scent,
as edgy as the borough it’s named for.
Notes: Grapefruit, Cardamom, Cypress-wood, Geranium Leaves, Juniper Berrie, Cedarwood, Leather and Guaiacwood

name: Bond No 9 Bryant Park Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Bryant Park by Bond No 9 is a Chypre Floral perfume designed for women. Introduced in 2007, it was created by perfumer Michel Almairac. The fragrance opens with vibrant top notes of Rhubarb, Pink Pepper, and Lily-of-the-Valley, transitioning into a heart of Rose and Patchouli. The scent concludes with a warm base of Raspberry and Amber.

Bond No. 9 has devoted its 28th perfume to Bryant Park, the
uptown part of New York where the Fashion Week takes place two times a
year. This fragrance is mainly oriented and connected to fashion. The
perfume is built on the harmony of rose and patchouli, spiced with pink
pepper added to discord the composition. The main notes are lily of the
valley, pink pepper and rhubarb in the top; rose and patchouli in the
heart; and raspberry and amber in the base. The rhubarb brings in a fine
tart note that contrasts the earthy note of patchouli. Together with
pink pepper they create a fine balance to sweet and decadent raspberry
and flowers.

name: Bond No 9 Chelsea Flowers Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text: Chelsea Flowers by Bond No 9 is a women's floral fragrance introduced in 2003. Crafted by perfumer Laurent Le Guernec, this scent captures the essence of blossoming elegance.

name: Bond No 9 Fire Island Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Fire Island, crafted by Bond No 9, is an amber fragrance suitable for both women and men. It was introduced in 2006, with Michel Almairac serving as the perfumer behind this scent.

The warm, golden-yellow colored bottle carries a sun in its middle, indicating that this is a fragrance dedicated to beach, laying the clothes aside and giving up to the sun rays. Near New York, about 90 km away from the center of the city, there is the Fire Island where the New Yorkers spend their weekends enjoying beaches and vacation. Dedicated to the sun, this perfume warms us with sweet spicy cardamom and ozone. The heart is made of fresh sweet neroli and white musk, and the base is formed of musk, leather, honey, sensual tuberose and patchouli. Michael Almairac is the creator of this oriental unisex perfume. It has been on the market since 2006. The nose behind this fragrance is Michel Almairac.

name: Bond No 9 Gold Street Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Gold Street by Bond No. 9 is a unisex leather fragrance that made its debut in 2024. Created by perfumer Vincent Schaller, this fresh scent features an opening with notes of blueberry, leather, jasmine, and pink pepper. The heart reveals a delightful blend of salted caramel fudge, iris, suede, and ambrette, while the base is enriched with tolu balsam, vanilla, musk, and oakmoss.

name: Bond No 9 Good Oud Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Good Oud by Bond No 9 is an Oriental Woody fragrance suitable for both women and men. Introduced in 2025, this scent features the creative vision of perfumer Miroslav Petkov. The fragrance opens with top notes of Magnolia, Osmanthus, Cinnamon, Sumac, Bark, and Cumin. Its heart reveals a blend of Pomegranate, Peru Balsam, Myrrh, Resin, and Clary Sage, while the base unfolds with Wild Berries, Labdanum, Vanilla Bean, Resin, Oud, and Patchouli.

name: Bond No 9 Hudson Yards Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text: Launched in 2014, Hudson Yards by Bond No. 9 is a luminous floral tribute to one of New York City's most ambitious landmarks, brought to life by the talented perfumer Aurélien Guichard. The scent opens with a fresh, spirited blend of lily-of-the-valley, freesia, and a subtle hint of pink pepper, before blossoming into a lush, romantic heart of peony, litchi, and Bulgarian rose. The fragrance then gracefully settles into a soft, elegant base of white musk, orange blossom, and iris — a beautifully feminine composition that captures the modern energy and sophistication of the city that never sleeps.

name: Bond No 9 Madison Square Park Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text: Madison Square Park by Bond No 9 is a floral perfume designed for women, introduced in 2011. Crafted by perfumer Laurent le Guernec, this fragrance opens with top notes of Grass, Blueberry, and Hyacinth. The heart of the scent features notes of Rose and Pink Tulip, while the base is composed of Teak Wood and Vetiver.

name: Bond No 9 New York Chic Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: New York Chic by Bond No 9 is an Oriental Woody scent designed for both women and men. This captivating fragrance made its debut in 2025, crafted by perfumer Miroslav Petkov. The composition opens with delightful top notes of Tobacco Leaf, Heliotrope, and Davana. The heart reveals rich middle notes of Immortelle, Tuberose, and Cognac, while the base features an enticing blend of Tobacco Leaf, Patchouli, Musk, and Oud.

At its heart, gardenia and rose offer a rich floral bouquet, while the base notes of vanilla and vetiver provide a warm and grounding finish.

name: Bond No 9 New York Secret Gardens Eau de Parfum Unisex

It opens with vibrant top notes of Kir Royal, Green Anjou Pears, Clementine, and Ivy, followed by a lush heart of Star Jasmine, Tuberose, and Grasse Rose. The fragrance concludes with warm base notes of Musk, Tuscan Iris, and Amber.

name: Bond No 9 Number One Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Bond Number One by Bond No 9 is a unisex Floral Woody Musk fragrance that was introduced in 2024. Created by perfumer Vincent Schaller, this new scent features top notes of Ylang-Ylang and Bergamot, complemented by middle notes of Musk, Bulgarian Rose, Tonka Bean, and Jasmine. Its base notes include Vanilla, Patchouli, and Cashmere Wood.

name: Bond No 9 Oud Supreme Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Oud Supreme by Bond No 9 is a unisex fragrance, suitable for both women and men. Introduced in 2025, this scent was created by perfumer Miroslav Petkov. The composition opens with vibrant top notes of Pink Pepper, Cassis, and Lemon. At its heart, it reveals a beautiful blend of Turkish Rose, Geranium, and Carrot, leading to a deep, rich base of Oud, Patchouli, Benzoin, and Resin.

name: Bond No 9 Park Avenue South Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text: Park Avenue South from Bond No. 9 is a floral fragrance designed for women, introduced in 2015. It opens with the crisp scent of green apple, followed by the captivating blend of peach and jasmine at its heart. The fragrance is rounded off with a base of musk and amber.

notes.source_text:
Perfumista Avenue by Bond No 9 is an alluring Amber Floral fragrance designed for women, introduced in 2013. The scent opens with vibrant top notes of Saffron, Nutmeg, Plum, and Artemisia. The heart features a rich blend of Rose, Rose Water, Peony, and Jasmine, while the base is a warm and inviting combination of Patchouli, Musk, Amber, and Mate.

Perfumista Avenue was created with the idea of uniting East
Side, West Side and Manhattan, with a composition in which the intense
notes of plums are supported by fine gourmet spices. Vivid union of
elegance of the Upper East Side, cultural facilities of the Upper West
Side, dynamism and energy that the center of town exudes with a bohemian
spirit that characterizes the region from the center to the edges of
the city, will be depicted with a shift of layers in the composition.
Its opening is gourmet spicy; the heart is intense, lush and floral,
while the base notes reflect the elegant blend of wood, musk and tea
flavors. Fusion of notes of the new fragrance that celebrates the 10th
anniversary of the brand literally reflects the city streets and blocks
highlighting the diversity of styles, architecture, people and
facilities.

name: Bond No 9 The Scent Of Peace Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
The Scent of Peace by Bond No. 9 is a Floral Woody Musk fragrance designed for women, introduced in 2006. Created by perfumer Michel Almairac, this scent features top notes of Black Currant and Grapefruit, a heart of Lily-of-the-Valley, and a base of Musk and Virginia Cedar.

The most beautifully civic-minded unisex fragrance ever devised. Notes of sparkling, energizing grapefruit and blackcurrant are balanced by the sheer loveliness of lily of the valley, and mellow base notes of cedar wood and musk. Eau de Parfum.
The Scent Of Peace Perfume by Bond No. 9, Bright, soft, and balanced, The Scent of Peace is a woody floral perfume that’s suitable for daytime or evening wear. It introduces itself with piquant notes of grapefruit and blueberry, followed by a green heart of clean and silky lily of the valley. Cedar and musk add a masculine nuance that rounds out the base of this distinctive blend.
This perfume was created in memory of the 9/11 victims killed or injured in the terrorist attack on the World Trade Center. The fragrance for women was released in 2006, and in a humanitarian gesture, Bond No. 9 donated every two dollars sold from each bottle to UNICEF. The company later released a version of the fragrance for men in 2013. The New York perfume house, founded in 2003 by veteran perfumer Laurice Rahmé, has a deep connection to its mother city and is known for commemorating New York landmarks with its novel fragrances and vibrant bottles.

Easy to wear in every season, day or night.

name: Bond No 9 Tuxedo Park Parfum Unisex

Its heart reveals a rich blend of Jasmine Sambac, Pink Pepper, Petitgrain, Tuberose, and Crystalfizz, while the base is a luxurious combination of Oud, Saffiano Leather, Musk, and Ambroxan.

name: Bond No 9 Wall Street Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Wall Street by Bond No. 9 is an Aromatic Aquatic scent designed for both women and men. Introduced in 2004, this fragrance was crafted by perfumer David Apel.

A unisex scent with strong masculine orientation. Wall Street, the first
financial fragrance, invests in the brisk energy and bravura of New
York's teeming financial district. With top notes of sea kale and
cucumber mingling freshly with a heart of ozone, a hint of leather and
marine aroma, finished with base notes of vetiver and ambergris, Wall
Street is at once both enticing and soothing. Signature bottle with gold
token accents.

A feminine scent perfect for her.

name: Bond No. 9 New York Forever Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: "New York Forever" by Bond No 9 is a contemporary unisex fragrance that debuted in 2023. The scent, crafted by perfumer Domitille Michalon Bertier, encapsulates the vibrant spirit of New York City. It opens with a spicy burst of cinnamon, setting a warm and inviting tone. The heart of the fragrance is a rich blend of patchouli and vanilla, adding depth and a touch of sweetness. The base is complex, featuring earthy notes alongside amber, labdanum, honey, moss, and musk, creating a multifaceted and enduring finish. This fragrance is a tribute to the timeless allure of New York, designed for both women and men.

for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Bond No 9 New York Nights
was launched in 2017. Top notes are gardenia, carnation and jasmine;
middle notes are flowers, sea notes, patchouli and sandalwood; base
notes are coffee and caramel. Imported.

name: Bond No. 9 New York Oud Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Bond No. 9 transformed itself into a smooth, full-throttle New York-centric perfume, New York Oud. A sumptuous rose bouquet which spins off to a dry-down of a dense and syrupy oud with musky teakwood and earthy vetiver to create a lingering urban-forest accord.
Notes: red plum, saffron, orange zest, oud, red rose, orris, patchouli, musk, honey, vetiver.

name: Bond No. 9 New York Patchouli Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
It's a trusted aphrodisiac and chi-balancer. It captivated Napoleon and
Belle Epoque fashionistas. And now comes Bond No. 9's updated, 21st
century New York Patchouli, all set to spice up the art of urban
seduction. Note of: Bergamot, rose water, litchi, patchouli, lilies,
lilac, amber, sandalwood, musk, atlas cedar

name: Bond No. 9 New York Sandalwood Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
New York Sandalwood by Bond No 9 is a Oriental Woody fragrance for women and men. New York Sandalwood
was launched in 2014. Top notes are Carrot, Orris and Cardamom; middle
notes are Sandalowood, Fig and Papyrus; base notes are Amber, Oakmoss
and Musk.

name: Bond No. 9 New York Signature Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Bond No. 9 Perfume by Bond No 9 is a Amber Floral fragrance for women and men. Bond No. 9 Perfume was launched in 2009.

name: Bond No. 9 Nolita Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Bond No. 9 Nolita is a bright, floral bouquet of lily and jasmine.
Launched in 2017, it opens with tangerine and freesia. Lily, jasmine sambac and rose form the heart, and amber, musk and sandalwood give it a soft finish.
A daytime favorite for spring.

Nolita by Bond No 9 is a Floral Woody Musk fragrance for women. Nolita
was launched in 2017. Top notes are Tangerine and Freesia; middle notes
are Lily, Jasmine Sambac and Rose; base notes are Amber, Musk and
Sandalwood.

name: Bond No. 9 Nuits de Noho Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Nuits de Noho by Bond No 9 is a Floral Woody Musk fragrance for women. Nuits de Noho
was launched in 2003. The nose behind this fragrance is Robertet. Top
notes are Pineapple Leaf, Mandarin Orange and Bergamot; middle notes are
Jasmine and Brazilian Rosewood; base notes are Patchouli, Vanilla and
Musk.

name: Bond No. 9 Off-Broadway Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Bond No 9's Off-Broadway is a fragrant amalgamation of Amber Floral scents that was released in 2021. This new aroma has a blend of Black Currant and Grapefruit blossom as top notes; Lily, Osmanthus and Nutmeg as middle notes; and Musk, Patchouli, Sandalwood, and Vetiver as the base notes, creating a unique scent for both women and men.

name: Bond No. 9 Queens Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Queens by Bond No 9 is a Amber Floral fragrance for women and men. Queens was launched in 2014. The nose behind this fragrance is Laurent Le Guernec. Top notes are Blackberry, Cardamom and Bergamot; middle notes are Tuberose, Champaca and Osmanthus; base notes are Musk, Benzoin, Sandalwood and Amber.

name: Bond No. 9 Sag Harbor Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Sag Harbor by Bond No 9 is a Amber Floral fragrance for women and men. Sag Harbor was launched in 2012. Top notes are Ivy, Bay Leaf and Bergamot; middle notes are Peony, Magnolia, Grapes and Honeysuckle; base notes are Amber, Sandalwood and Agarwood (Oud).

name: Bond No. 9 Soho Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Soho by Bond No 9 is a Floral Woody Musk fragrance for women and men. Soho was launched in 2016. Top notes are petitgrain, sweet orange and cassis; middle notes are jasmine, orris root and orange blossom; base notes are amber, moss, cedar and vetiver.

name: Bond No. 9 Spring Fling Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Spring Fling by Bond No 9 is a Floral fragrance for women. Spring Fling
was launched in 2018. Top notes are Fruity Notes, Lily-of-the-Valley
and Passion Flower; middle notes are Honeysuckle, Jasmine and Freesia;
base notes are Musk, Amber and Teak Wood.

name: Bond No. 9 Success Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Success has been introduced in 2013 as a new fragrance by the house of Bond No9 which is as sweet and alluring as dollar sign. Success breaks all the rules of romantic fragrances and just like money, the fragrance is universal (for both sexes).
The fragrance is constructed as spicy-gourmand; it allures and
intoxicates the one who smells it. Top notes introduce spices and
citruses: mandarin, lemon, coriander and cardamom, leading to a heart
composed of honey scents of tuberose and rose spiced with gourmand
accords of plum and pimento. The base provides an oriental tone with a
combination of vanilla, patchouli and amber.

name: Bond No. 9 Sutton Place Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Bond No. 9 Sutton Place is a fruity, leathery blend of cassis and pineapple.
Launched in 2016, it opens with cassis, bergamot, tangerine, pink pepper and pineapple. Patchouli, jasmine and lily form the heart, and leather, musk, vanilla and amber give it a smooth finish.
Easy to wear from spring through fall, for the office and everyday.

Top notes: Bergamot, cassis
Middle notes: Jasmine, lily, patchouli
Base notes: Amber, leather, vanilla
Eau de Parfum

name: Bond No. 9 The Nomad Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text: NoMad by Bond No 9 is a Amber Floral fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. NoMad was launched in 2021. Top notes are Quince, Black Currant and Pear; middle notes are Rose, Agarwood (Oud), Orris and violet leaves; base notes are Amber, Vanilla and Sandalwood.

name: Bond No. 9 The Scent Of Peace for Him Eau de Parfum for Men
tags: The Scent Of Peace for Him

notes.source_text:
Bond No. 9 The Scent of Peace for Him is a fresh, fruity aromatic with pineapple and juniper.
Michel Almairac created it in 2013. Pineapple, juniper berries and bergamot open bright, currant buds form a green heart, and cedar and vetiver give it a clean, woody finish.
Easy to wear for spring and summer days, from the office to date night.

At Bond No. 9, we're peacekeepers as well as perfumers. So now at last we're introducing The Scent of Peace for Him-the male counterpart of our No. 1 bestseller. That's what we call conflict-resolution.
Notes: Bergamot, pineapple, juniper berry, blackcurrant, cedarwood, vetiver, patchouli, moss, musk
The Scent Of Peace for Him is a masculine fragrance by Bond No. 9. The scent was launched in 2013

name: Bond No. 9 The Scent Of Peace Natural Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: The Scent Of Peace Natural by Bond No 9 is a fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. The Scent Of Peace Natural was launched in 2022. The Scent Of Peace Natural was created by Michel Almairac and Romain Almairac. Top notes are Black Currant Blossom, Petitgrain and Lemon; middle notes are Raspberry and Damask Rose; base notes are Ambroxan, Cedar and Musk.

name: Bond No. 9 Tribeca Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Bond No. 9 Tribeca is a sweet blend of cacao, hazelnut and caramel.
Michel Almairac created it in 2020. Cacao and hazelnut open warm, cedar and jasmine sambac form the heart, and ambroxan, caramel and moss give it a sweet finish.
Made for fall and winter, day or night.

TriBeCa by Bond No 9 is a Amber Vanilla fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. TriBeCa was launched in 2020. The nose behind this fragrance is Michel Almairac. Top notes are Cacao and Hazelnut; middle notes are Cedar and Jasmine Sambac; base notes are Ambroxan, Caramel and Moss.

name: Bond No. 9 west side Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Music to your Nose. You've heard the West Side... Now Smell it. (Bond No. 9's West Side, that is.) A melodious full-bodied coloratura perfume, with dark-light, high-low, sweet-sharp floral and woody notes.
Notes: Rose, ylang ylang, peony, sandalwood, amber, vanilla, musk
Bond sure knows how to do Rose fragrances! West Side is quite a boozy
Rose, like a sweet red wine. The Rose petals are floating on top of a
vanilla infused beverage, which makes the fragrance unique and
irresistible. It's soft, radiant and stunningly beautiful. Men and women
alike love this one, for it is a charming scent with just enough bite
to get the attention you deserve.

name: Bond No9 Greenpoint Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Greenpoint by Bond No 9 is a unisex fragrance that was introduced in 2025. Crafted by perfumer Claude Dir, this fresh scent presents a vibrant blend of notes. It opens with refreshing top notes of bergamot, pear, pimento leaf, and cardamom. The heart of the fragrance reveals a captivating mix of marine notes, star jasmine, magnolia, and rose. Finally, the scent is anchored by a warm base of cedar, roots, musk, amber, ambrettolide, moss, and vetiver.

name: BORNTOSTANDOUT Burnt Roses Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Verified fragrance notes for BORNTOSTANDOUT Burnt Roses Eau de Parfum Unisex: aldehydes, ozonic notes, black pepper, salt, bulgarian rose, lavender, cinnamon, oakmoss, incense, cashmeran, olibanum, ambergris, sandalwood, patchouli.

name: BORNTOSTANDOUT Drunk Lovers Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Verified fragrance notes for BORNTOSTANDOUT Drunk Lovers Eau de Parfum Unisex: cognac, red berries, juniper, grapefruit, bergamot, lemon, pepper, ginger, cypress, clary sage, vanilla, sandalwood, amber, virginian cedar, musk, benzoin, vetiver, cardamom, patchouli, cinnamon.

name: BORNTOSTANDOUT Hinoki Shower Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: The Hinoki Shower scent from BORNTOSTANDOUT® offers a unique olfactory experience designed to appeal to both men and women. As a recent addition to the world of perfumery, it made its debut in 2022 with the expertise of perfumer Frank Voelkl. The fragrance starts with a refreshing blend of top notes, including cypress, pine, and camphor. It then transitions into a heart characterized by the aromas of cedar, assorted woodsy elements, and a hint of thyme. The scent culminates in a rich base comprised of tobacco, vetiver, and the earthy touch of moss.

name: BORNTOSTANDOUT Naked Neroli Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Unveiled by BORNTOSTANDOUT®, Naked Neroli is a contemporary unisex scent, freshly introduced in 2022. This fragrance was artfully composed by perfumer Daphné Bugey. It opens with a refreshing array of top notes, including zesty Citron, cool Mint, crisp Bergamot, and sweet Mandarin Orange. At its heart lies a rich blend of middle notes featuring the eponymous Neroli, delicate Bulgarian Rose, creamy Tuberose, aromatic Petitgrain Paraguay, and the fragrant Orange Blossom. The scent settles into a warm and inviting base of exotic Jasmine, herbal Basil, smooth Musk, and the woody essence of Guaiac Wood.

name: BORNTOSTANDOUT Sex & Cognac Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Sex & Cognac, a distinctive unisex scent from BORNTOSTANDOUT®, represents the brand's latest olfactory creation. Introduced to the world in 2022, the artisan behind this aromatic journey is Hamid Merati-Kashani. The fragrance opens with an inviting top note of Saffron, progresses into a heart that seamlessly blends Leather with Papyrus, and finishes with a rich foundation of Cognac and Laotian Oud.

name: BORNTOSTANDOUT Unholy Oud Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Verified fragrance notes for BORNTOSTANDOUT Unholy Oud Eau de Parfum Unisex: incense, lemon, bergamot, laotian oud, turkish rose, bulgarian rose, sandalwood, patchouli, vanilla, palisander rosewood, tonka bean, heliotrope.

name: Bortnikoff Classica Extrait de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Classica by Bortnikoff is a Leather fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Classica was launched in 2021. The nose behind this fragrance is Dmitry Bortnikov. Top notes are Neroli, Lemon and Bergamot; middle notes are Heliotrope, Rose de Mai, Orange Blossom, iris, Sandalwood and Olibanum; base notes are Musk, Vanilla, Labdanum, Tonka Bean, Castoreum, Palisander Rosewood, Ambergris, Patchouli, Birch Tar and Vetiver.

name: Bortnikoff Cologne de Feu Extrait de Cologne Unisex

notes.source_text: The new Citrus Gourmand fragrance for both women and men, Cologne de Feu by Bortnikoff, was released in 2022. Created by Dmitry Bortnikov, the top notes of this fragrance are Blood Orange, Bigarade, Tangerine, Litsea Cubeba, Bitter Orange, Lemon and Petitgrain; middle notes consist of Tea, Sorbet, Peach, Raspberry and Jasmine; while the base notes are Oakmoss, Cedar, Sandalwood, Guaiac Wood and Woody Notes.

name: Bortnikoff Coup de Foudre Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Coup de Foudre by Bortnikoff is a Citrus Gourmand fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Coup de Foudre was launched in 2020. The nose behind this fragrance is Dmitry Bortnikov. Top notes are Sweet Orange, Green Tea, Lemon, Bergamot, White Grapefruit and Black Pepper; middle notes are Champaca, Jasmine, Rose de Mai, Lily-of-the-Valley, Ylang-Ylang and Tuberose; base notes are Cinnamon, Benzoin, Labdanum, Guaiac Wood, Pink Lotus, Turmeric, Sandalwood, Vanilla, Agarwood (Oud), Tolu Balsam, Tonka Bean and Pine.

name: Bortnikoff Dream Elixir Unisex

notes.source_text: Dream, crafted by Bortnikoff, is a unisex scent with a rich Amber Floral profile. Freshly unveiled in 2023, this fragrance is an avant-garde addition to the olfactory world. The creative force of perfumer Dmitry Bortnikoff is palpable in its composition. The fragrance greets you with an opening of Mysore Sandalwood and Champaca. At its heart, a harmonious blend of Pistachio and Black Currant unfolds. Laying the foundation, the base is composed of luxurious Vanilla Absolute, Caraway, and Benzoin.

name: Bortnikoff Lao Oud Extrait de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Lao Oud by Bortnikoff is a Amber Woody fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Lao Oud was launched in 2021. The nose behind this fragrance is Dmitry Bortnikov. Top notes are Magnolia and Pink Pepper; middle notes are Cacao, Chamomile, Peru Balsam, Beeswax and Cinnamon; base notes are Agarwood (Oud), Indian Oud, Coffee, Vanilla Absolute, Tonka Bean, Birch Tar, Guaiac Wood and Woody Notes.

name: Bortnikoff Marrakesh Elixir Unisex

notes.source_text: Bortnikoff's Marrakesh is a unisex scent characterized by its Woody Spicy profile. Recently introduced to the market in 2023, this fresh fragrance has been expertly crafted by perfumer Dmitry Bortnikoff. It opens with an invigorating blend of Black Pepper, Nutmeg, and Tunisian Orange Blossom at the top. The heart of the scent is a harmonious fusion of elemi, succulent Nectarine, airy Hedione, and intoxicating Jasmine. Anchoring the composition are the rich and deep base notes of Oud, luscious Vanilla Absolute, and warm Benzoin.

name: Bortnikoff Musk Khabib Extrait de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Musk Khabib by Bortnikoff is a fragrance for women and men. Musk Khabib was launched in 2019. The nose behind this fragrance is Dmitry Bortnikov. Top notes are Bergamot, Nutmeg and Cardamom; middle notes are Ylang-Ylang, Tolu Balsam and Cedar; base notes are Natural Musk, Ambergris, Vanilla, Tonka Bean, Oakmoss and Vetiver.

name: Bortnikoff Mysterious Oud Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Launched in 2018, Bortnikoff's Mysterious Oud is a unisex fragrance created by the talented Dmitry Bortnikov. Top notes of Orange, Amber, Cardamom and Bergamot blend into a heart of Castoreum, Myrrh, Cinnamon, Cloves, Tonka Bean, Rose, Nutmeg, Jasmine and Pink Pepper, before settling onto base notes of Agarwood (Oud), Opoponax, Indian Oud, Tolu Balsam, Labdanum, Cedar, Sandalwood, Lotus and Vanilla.

name: Bortnikoff Oud Cologne Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Created by Dmitry Bortnikov, Oud Cologne is a unisex Citrus Aromatic fragrance that was released in 2021. Refreshing top notes of Bitter Orange, White Grapefruit, Bergamot, Juniper Berries and Pink Pepper introduce the scent, followed by Pine needles, Geranium, Nutmeg and Rose in the middle. Finishing off the scent are the base notes of Ambergris, Thailand Oud, Tonka Bean, Siam Benzoin and Vetiver.

name: Bortnikoff Oud Loukoum Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Bortnikoff's Oud Loukoum is a combination of Amber and Woody aromas, suitable for both women and men. Launched in 2020, the fragrance was created by Dmitry Bortnikov. It opens with a blend of Dried Fruits and Tobacco, the heart of Ylang-Ylang, and the deep base of Peru Balsam, Agarwood (Oud), Guaiac Wood, Cedar and Indian Oud.

name: Bortnikoff Oud Maximus Extrait de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Released in 2018, Oud Maximus by Bortnikoff is a unisex Amber Woody fragrance composed by nose Dmitry Bortnikov. Sweet Orange, Jasmine Sambac, Pink Pepper, Bergamot and Cardamom make up the top notes, while the middle notes consist of Rose, Rose de Mai, Tea Rose, Frangipani, Magnolia, Clove and Tonka Bean. Indian Oud, Agarwood (Oud), Civet, Natural Musk, Birch Tar, Tolu Balsam and Vanilla make up the base.

name: Bortnikoff Oud Monarch Parfum Unisex

base: Labdanum round off this beautiful fragrance
key: Labdanum round off this beautiful fragrance
notes.source_text: Bortnikoff's Oud Monarch is an exquisite fragrance for both men and women, released in 2019. Created by the renowned perfumer Dmitry Bortnikov, this scent opens with the inviting top notes of Frangipani and Magnolia. The heart is a spicy blend of Cinnamon, Rose de Mai, Rose and Tobacco, while the base notes of Cacao Pod, Agarwood (Oud), Vanilla, Castoreum, Civet and Labdanum round off this beautiful fragrance.

name: Bortnikoff Oud Sinharaja Extrait de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Oud Sinharaja by Bortnikoff is a Amber Woody fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Oud Sinharaja was launched in 2020. The nose behind this fragrance is Dmitry Bortnikov. Top notes are Bergamot, Grapefruit and Cardamom; middle notes are Frangipani, Jasmine Sambac and Magnolia; base notes are Agarwood (Oud), Atlas Cedar and Labdanum.

name: Bortnikoff Rich Elixir Unisex

notes.source_text: Bortnikoff's 'Rich' is a unisex scent that falls within the Woody Floral Musk olfactory family and represents the latest addition to their fragrance line, having been released in 2023. The creation of this scent is credited to the olfactory expertise of Dmitry Bortnikoff. It begins with an invigorating blend of top notes featuring Sichuan Pepper, Bergamot, and Cardamom, evolving into a heart composed of rich Oud, delicate Jasmine, and earthy Patchouli. The scent comes to a close with a robust base that includes the deep tones of Leather, the forest-like notes of Oakmoss, the warm allure of Amber, and the grassy nuances of Vetiver.

name: Bortnikoff Santa Sangre Extrait de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Santa Sangre by Bortnikoff is a fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Santa Sangre was launched in 2021. Santa Sangre was created by Dmitry Bortnikov and Rajesh Balkrishnan. Top notes are Jasmine Sambac, Pink Grapefruit and Vanilla Flower; middle notes are Pink Lotus and White Lotus; base notes are Dragon Blood Resin, Sandalwood and Siam Benzoin.

name: Bortnikoff Sayat Nova Extrait de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Sayat Nova by Bortnikoff is a fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Sayat Nova was launched in 2020. Sayat Nova was created by Dmitry Bortnikov and Rajesh Balkrishnan.

name: Bortnikoff Tabac Dore Extrait de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Tabac Doré by Bortnikoff is a Amber Vanilla fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Tabac Doré was launched in 2021. The nose behind this fragrance is Dmitry Bortnikov. Top notes are Ambrette (Musk Mallow), Vanilla Absolute and Pink Pepper; middle notes are Tobacco, Benzoin, Cinnamon and Fig; base notes are Peru Balsam, Agarwood (Oud), Tolu Balsam, Labdanum, Cedar and Sandalwood.

name: Bortnikoff Triad Extrait de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Triad, a new Amber Woody fragrance for both women and men created by Dmitry Bortnikov, was released in 2020. Its top note is Agarwood (Oud), while the middle notes consist of Rose de Mai, Agarwood (Oud) and Magnolia. The base notes of Triad are Thailand Oud, Hyrax, Benzoin and Tonka Bean.

name: Bottega Veneta Eau Sensuelle Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Bottega Veneta Eau Sensuelle Eau de Parfum is a floral fruity chypre fragrance with a delicate mix of jasmine and gardenia, blended to a joyful and elegant peach note. It leaves behind a distinctive and lasting leathery trail of patchouli and vanilla. Floral.
Notes:
- Top: gardenia, jasmine.
- Middle: peach.
- Base: leather, vanilla, patchouli.

name: Bottega Veneta Illusion for Her Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text: Illusione for Her by Bottega Veneta is a Floral Woody Musk fragrance for women. Illusione for Her was launched in 2019. Illusione for Her was created by Amandine Clerc-Marie and Annick Menardo. Top notes are Bergamot and Black Currant; middle notes are Fig Leaf and Orange Blossom; base notes are Olive Tree and Tonka Bean.

name: Bottega Veneta Illusione Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text: Launched in 2019, Illusione for Him by Bottega Veneta is a Woody fragrance created by the renowned nose Antoine Maisondieu. Enticing top notes of Bitter Orange and Lemon greet the wearer, complemented by the warm middle notes of White Cedar Extract and Fir Resin. Finally, the enticing combination of Vetiver and Tonka Bean linger as the base note of this captivating scent.

name: Bottega Veneta Parco Palladiano I Magnolia Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Parco Palladiano I: Magnolia by Bottega Veneta is a Floral fragrance for women and men. Parco Palladiano I: Magnolia was launched in 2016. The nose behind this fragrance is Michel Almairac. Top notes are Grapefruit, Bergamot and Orange; middle notes are Magnolia, Lily-of-the-Valley and Rose; base notes are Green Notes, White Musk and Iso E Super.

name: Bottega Veneta Parco Palladiano V: Lauro Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Bottega Veneta's Parco Palladiano V: Lauro is a unisex scent with an aromatic green essence. This fragrance made its debut in 2016 and was crafted by the skilled perfumer Daniela (Roche) Andrier. It opens with fresh top notes of mint and labdanum, unfolds to a herbal heart featuring laurel, sage, rosemary, pepper, tea, and geranium, and settles into a rich vetiver base note.

name: Bottega Veneta Parco Palladiano XI Castagno Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Parco Palladiano XI: Castagno by Bottega Veneta is a Woody Spicy fragrance for women and men. Parco Palladiano XI: Castagno was launched in 2018. The nose behind this fragrance is Alexis Dadier. Top notes are Ginger, Orange and Lemon; middle notes are Black Pepper, Hedione and Green Notes; base notes are Chestnut, Oak, Olibanum, Cedar, Vanilla and Cumin.

name: Bottega Veneta Parco Palladiano XIII Quadrifoglio Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Parco Palladiano XIII: Quadrifoglio by Bottega Veneta is a Aromatic Green fragrance for women and men. Parco Palladiano XIII: Quadrifoglio was launched in 2018. The nose behind this fragrance is Aurelien Guichard. Top notes are Bergamot, Basil and Grapefruit; middle notes are Green Notes, Geranium and Hedione; base notes are Iso E Super, Incense, Coumarin and Amberwood.

name: Bottega Veneta Parco Palladiano XV Salvia Blu Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Parco Palladiano XV: Salvia Blu by Bottega Veneta is a Woody Floral Musk fragrance for women and men. Parco Palladiano XV: Salvia Blu was launched in 2018. The nose behind this fragrance is Quentin Bisch. Top notes are Pear, Apple, Sage and Lavender; middle notes are Rose, Green Notes, Freesia and Magnolia; base notes are Iso E Super, Musk and Violet.

name: Bottega Veneta Pour Homme Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text: Bottega Veneta Pour Homme by Bottega Veneta is a Leather fragrance for men. Bottega Veneta Pour Homme was launched in 2013. Bottega Veneta Pour Homme was created by Daniela (Roche) Andrier and Antoine Maisondieu. Top notes are Siberian Pine, Juniper and Calabrian bergamot; middle notes are Canadian Fir, Clary Sage and Pimento; base notes are Leather, Patchouli and Labdanum.

name: Bottega Veneta Pour Homme Extreme Eau de Toilette

notes.source_text:
Bottega Veneta Pour Homme Extreme is a sophisticated leather fragrance for men, introduced by Bottega Veneta in 2015. Crafted by perfumers Daniela (Roche) Andrier and Antoine Maisondieu, this scent opens with fresh notes of Pine Tree, Juniper Berries, and Bergamot. The heart features a warm blend of Fir, Nutmeg, and Pimento, while the base is enriched with rich Leather, Patchouli, and Labdanum.

Bottega Veneta Pour Homme Extreme Cologne
by Bottega Veneta, Embrace a more intense and vibrant aspect of yourself
with Bottega Veneta Pour Homme
Extreme, a captivating
men’s fragrance. This dark, robust elixir combines woody, musky and
leathery accords for a distinctive male aroma that will draw attention
from miles away. Top notes of sparkling bergamot, ripe juniper berries
and sharp pine tree open the cologne for a refreshing and exhilarating
atmosphere. Heart notes of spicy nutmeg, fir
resin and red pimento incorporate an Oriental, exotic flair that’s
entirely rejuvenating. Finally, the base notes of delicate labdanum,
green patchouli and leather complete the fragrance for a long-lasting
masculine aroma that’s electrifying and seductive to the core.
Launched in 2015, this delectable cologne was a more extreme version of
its earlier predecessor from Bottega Veneta. Formed and signed by
Daniela Andrier and Antoine Maisondieu, it comes ready to be worn day or
night for maximum effect. Encased in a stunningly clear glass flacon
with a gray hue, this sophisticated and charming elixir both looks and
smells luxurious.

name: Boucheron Ambre D'Alexandrie Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Ambre D'Alexandrie by Boucheron is a Amber fragrance for women and men. Ambre D'Alexandrie was launched in 2017. The nose behind this fragrance is Jean-Christophe Hérault. Top notes are Vanilla, Tobacco and Benzoin; middle notes are Amber and Labdanum; base notes are Ambergris and Musk.

name: Boucheron Feve Tonka de Canaima Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Canaima's Feve Tonka by Boucheron presents a unisex scent in the Amber Vanilla olfactory family. Recently introduced to the market in 2022, this novel scent is the creative work of perfumer Alexis Dadier. It opens with the crisp scents of Bitter Almond and delicate Violet. The heart of the fragrance is a rich blend of Tonka Bean, earthy Patchouli, and elegant Rose. Anchoring the composition are the warm and comforting base notes of creamy Vanilla, smooth Sandalwood, and resinous Labdanum.

name: Boucheron Iris de Syracuse Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Iris de Syracuse, a unisex scent by Boucheron, blends floral, woody, and musky aromas. Unveiled in 2017, this fragrance was crafted by perfumer Nathalie Lorson. It opens with a refreshing cocktail of pear, pepper, and mandarin orange. The heart blossoms with a harmonious mix of iris, heliotrope, and jasmine, leading to a warm finish of white musk, vanilla, and patchouli in the base notes.

name: Boucheron Oud de Carthage Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Oud de Carthage by Boucheron is a Amber fragrance for women and men. Oud de Carthage was launched in 2017. The nose behind this fragrance is Dominique Ropion. Top notes are Honey and Incense; middle notes are Tonka Bean and Labdanum; base notes are Agarwood (Oud) and Leather.

name: Boucheron Rose d'Isparta Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Verified fragrance notes for Boucheron Rose d'Isparta Eau de Parfum Unisex: Somalian frankincense, Ambrette, Ginger, Turkish rose, Cinnamon, Saffron, Freesia, Hawthorn, Vanilla, Amber, Musk, Sandalwood, Tonka bean.

name: Brioni Brioni for Men Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
Brioni Cologne by Brioni, Launched in 2009
as a limited-edition, self-titled cologne, Brioni is a refined and
masculine fragrance that evokes
timeless elegance and
polish. Created with confident men in mind, this scent combines classic
notes that render it ideal for daytime wear at events such as client
meetings and after-dinner appointments. It opens with refreshing,
citrusy top notes of Sicilian lemon and Calabrian bergamot followed by a
woody, aromatic heart comprised of galbanum, lavender,
patchouli, vetiver, verbena and nutmeg. An elegant base of tonka bean
and oakmoss rounds out this intensely sophisticated cologne.
Italian-based fashion house Brioni was established by Gaetano Savini and
Nazareno Fonticoli in 1945. This fragrance was designed in
collaboration with renowned perfumer Raymond Matts and is the first
released by the company since the 1950s. Packaged within a simple yet
charming glass bottle, it contains a distinct olfactory blend that
enables wearers to exude poise and quiet confidence throughout the day
and into the evening.

name: Brioni Eau de Parfum Brioni for Men

notes.source_text: The Brioni Eau de Parfum for men, released in 2021, is an enticing Woody Spicy scent created by Michel Almairac. Its unique blend of Ozonic notes, Pink Pepper, Green Apple, Violet, Ambroxan, Cedar, Musk and Tonka Bean provide a truly captivating experience.

name: Brioni Eclat Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text: Brioni's Eau de Parfum Eclat is a contemporary men's scent, freshly released in 2022. Conceived by the renowned perfumer Michel Almairac, this modern fragrance opens with the zesty and invigorating scents of Grapefruit, the mystic allure of Olibanum, and a hint of spicy Pink Pepper. At its heart lies a harmonious blend of earthy Patchouli with the subtle elegance of Rose. The scent deepens into a warm, sensual base where the softness of Musk, the modern touch of Ambroxan, and the rich woody tones of Sandalwood culminate. This nuanced and exquisitely crafted cologne by Brioni represents a new chapter in their fragrance line.

name: Brunello Cucinelli Brezza Gentile Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Brezza Gentile, crafted by Brunello Cucinelli, is a captivating Chypre fragrance designed for both women and men. Introduced in 2024, this scent was created by the talented perfumer Daphne Bugey. The fragrance opens with vibrant notes of Bitter Orange and Lemon, leading into a heart of Patchouli, Pink Pepper, and Ambergris. The base is composed of warm Ambroxan, smooth Clearwood, and rich Benzoin, creating a harmonious and sophisticated aroma.

name: Burberry Garden Roses Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Garden Roses by Burberry is a captivating Floral fragrance designed for both women and men. Introduced in 2017, this exquisite scent is the creation of renowned perfumer Francis Kurkdjian. The fragrance opens with refreshing top notes of Italian Lemon, Grapefruit, and Bergamot. The heart reveals a harmonious blend of Bulgarian Rose, Green Notes, Black Currant, Apple, and Lily-of-the-Valley. Finally, the base notes feature a soothing combination of Vetiver, White Musk, and Cedar.

name: Burberry Goddess Amber Vanilla Eau de Parfum Intense for Women

notes.source_text: Goddess Amber Vanilla by Burberry is a Oriental Vanilla fragrance for women. This is a new fragrance. Goddess Amber Vanilla was launched in 2026. Top notes are Maple syrup and Lavender; middle notes are Vanilla Absolute, Vanilla and Vanilla Caviar; base note is Amber.

name: Burberry Goddess Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Burberry Goddess is a soft, layered vanilla with lavender.
Amandine Clerc-Marie created it in 2023. Vanilla and lavender open fresh, vanilla caviar forms the heart, and vanilla absolute gives it a rich, creamy finish.
Easy to wear in every season, day or night.

name: Burberry Goddess Intense Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Burberry Goddess Intense is a deeper, earthier take on Goddess.
Amandine Clerc-Marie created it in 2024. Lavender opens fresh, several vanillas form a rich heart, and patchouli gives it an earthy finish.
Made for fall and winter, day or night.

name: Burberry Goddess Parfum for Women

notes.source_text: Goddess Parfum by Burberry is a captivating Oriental Vanilla fragrance designed for women, introduced in 2025. Crafted by perfumer Amandine Clerc-Marie, this scent features top notes of Raspberry and Lavender, leading into a heart of Vanilla, Vanilla Absolute, and Vanilla Caviar. The fragrance is anchored by a base note of Suede, creating a luxurious and alluring composition.

name: Burberry Her Burberry Eau de Parfum

notes.source_text:
Her Burberry is a sweet, juicy red berry fragrance.
Francis Kurkdjian created it in 2018. Blackberry, strawberry, mandarin, sour cherry, raspberry and black currant open juicy, violet and jasmine form the heart, and woods, vanilla, cashmeran, patchouli and musk give it a soft finish.
A daytime favorite from spring through fall.

name: Burberry Her Elixir Eau de Parfum Intense for Women

notes.source_text:
Burberry Her Elixir is a rich, juicy blend of red berries and vanilla.
Jérôme Di Marino and Maïa Lernout created it in 2022. Strawberry and blackberry open sweet, jasmine forms the heart, and amber, vanilla and sandalwood give it a warm finish.
Easy to wear in every season, day or night.

name: Burberry Hero Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Burberry Hero Eau de Parfum is a smoky, woody fragrance built on three cedars.
Aurélien Guichard created it in 2022. Pine needles and olibanum open fresh and resinous, benzoin and incense form a warm heart, and Atlas, Himalayan and Virginia cedar give it a dry, smoky finish.
Made for fall and winter nights.

name: Burberry Hero Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
Burberry Hero Eau de Toilette is a fresh, woody fragrance built on three cedars.
Aurélien Guichard created it in 2021. Bergamot opens bright, black pepper and juniper form the heart, and Virginian, Himalayan and Atlas cedar give it a dry, clean finish.
A daytime favorite from spring through fall.

name: Burberry Hero Elixir De Perfum Intense for Men

notes.source_text: Burberry's Hero Elixir is a modern leather fragrance designed for men, introduced in 2026. This innovative scent features top notes of Vanilla and Leather, complemented by a heart of Cedarwood. The base reveals rich notes of Amber and Tonka Bean.

name: Burberry Hero Parfum for Men

notes.source_text: Hero Parfum, crafted by Burberry, presents itself as a distinctively Amber Woody scent tailored for the modern man. A fresh addition to their fragrance lineup, Hero Parfum made its debut in 2024. Upon the first spritz, one is greeted with the inviting aroma of Amyris. The fragrance then unfolds into a robust heart of Cedarwood, before settling into the deep, earthy essence of Cypriol Oil, also known as Nagarmotha, which serves as its foundational base note.

name: Burberry Hero Parfum Intense for Men

notes.source_text: Hero Parfum Intense, crafted by Burberry, is a captivating woody-spicy fragrance designed for men. Introduced in 2025, this scent features a bold top note of black pepper, complemented by a rich heart of leather, and anchored by a warm base of cedarwood.

name: Burberry Mr. Burberry Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Introducing Mr. Burberry Eau de Parfum. An intense interpretation of
the original Mr. Burberry, the fragrance captures the essence and
anticipation of London at nighttime.
A warm, sensual, and woody
scent with fresh and aromatic top notes of tarragon and comforting,
spicy cinnamon, layered delicately on rich patchouli with a base of
amber and smoky vetiver.
Fragrance Family:
Warm & Spicy
Scent Type:
Cool Spices
Key Notes:
Cinnamon, Lavender, Vetiver

name: Burberry Mr. Burberry Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
Mr. Burberry by Burberry is a Woody Aromatic fragrance for men. Mr. Burberry
was launched in 2016. The nose behind this fragrance is Francis
Kurkdjian. Top notes are Grapefruit, Cardamom, Tarragon and Mint; middle
notes are Cedar, Birch Leaf, Nutmeg and Lavender; base notes are
Vetiver, Guaiac Wood, Sandalwood, Amberwood, Benzoin and Oakmoss.

name: Burberry Mr. Burberry Indigo Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
Mr. Burberry Indigo by Burberry is a Woody Aromatic fragrance for men. Mr. Burberry Indigo
was launched in 2018. The nose behind this fragrance is Francis
Kurkdjian. Top notes are Rosemary, Lemon, Bergamot and Grapefruit;
middle notes are Mint, Violet, Water Notes, Sage, Tea and Hedione; base
notes are Oakmoss, Iso E Super and Amber.

name: Burberry Snow Blossom Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Snow Blossom by Burberry is a newly released Floral fragrance designed for both women and men. Debuting in 2023, this scent opens with top notes of Bergamot and Mate. The heart reveals middle notes of Violet Leaves and Mimosa, while the base is composed of Akigalawood, Suede, and Madagascar Vanilla.

name: Bvlgari Aqva Amara Eau de Toilette for Men

middle: concludes with a rich base of Olibanum
Rich Water - An enrichment of exquisite raw minerals that creates a sense of well-being
key: concludes with a rich base of Olibanum
Rich Water - An enrichment of exquisite raw minerals that creates a sense of well-being
notes.source_text:
Aqva Amara, a fragrance for men by Bvlgari, embodies a Woody Aquatic essence. Introduced in 2014, it was crafted by perfumer Jacques Cavallier. The scent opens with vibrant Sicilian Mandarin, transitions into refreshing middle notes of Watery Notes and Neroli, and concludes with a rich base of Olibanum and Indonesian Patchouli Leaf.

A fragrance
inspired by the infinite opulence of the Mediterranean. Aqva Amara is
enriched with noble ingredients and is a provocative blend of Italian
citrus and woods. This woody aquatic scent is an unexpected contemporary
expression for the modern man.
Top Notes: Sicilian
Mandarin and Essence of Neroli - Neroli comes from the bitter orange
tree and prolongs the zesty freshness of Mandarin
Heart Notes: Rich Water - An enrichment of exquisite raw minerals that creates a sense of well-being
Dry
Down: Indonesian Patchouli and Frankincense - Patchouli's earthiness
and noble elegance is enriched with Frankincense which gives density and
radiance to the base note

name: Bvlgari Aqva Marine Pour Homme Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
Aqva Pour Homme Marine by Bvlgari is a Aromatic Aquatic fragrance for men. Aqva Pour Homme Marine
was launched in 2008. The nose behind this fragrance is Jacques
Cavallier. Top notes are Grapefruit, Neroli, Mandarin Orange and
Petitgrain; middle notes are Water Notes, Seaweed and Rosemary; base
notes are Virginia Cedar and Amber.

name: Bvlgari Aqva Pour Homme Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
Aqva Pour Homme by Bvlgari is a Aromatic Aquatic fragrance for men. Aqva Pour Homme
was launched in 2005. The nose behind this fragrance is Jacques
Cavallier. Top notes are Mandarin Orange, Orange and Petitgrain; middle
notes are Seaweed, Lavender and Cotton Flower; base notes are Virginia
Cedar, Woodsy Notes, Patchouli, Clary Sage and Amber.

name: Bvlgari Bvlgari Man Black Orient Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
After the success of Bvlgari Man In Black fragrance from 2014,
presented as a flanker of the original Bvlgari Man from 2010, Bvlgari
launches its two new editions in 2016. First came Bvlgari Man Black
Cologne, an unusual summer, oriental-fresh Eau de Toilette, and that is
now followed by Bvlgari Man Black Orient, a lush oriental Eau de Parfum for the fall season. The fragrances are developed by Alberto Morillas.
Sophisticated and mysterious, Bvlgari Man Black Orient has a
spicy aromatic opening thanks to the rich notes of rum (a standard for
the collection) and peppery cardamom. The opulent floral heart includes
lavish tuberose and oriental Taif rose, laid on the intensive masculine
basis of oud and leather.

name: Bvlgari Eau Parfumee Au the Blanc Eau de Cologne Unisex

notes.source_text: Eau Parfumee au The Blanc by Bvlgari is a Floral Woody Musk fragrance for women and men. Eau Parfumee au The Blanc was launched in 2003. The nose behind this fragrance is Jacques Cavallier.

name: Bvlgari Eau Parfumee Au The Bleu Eau de Cologne Unisex

notes.source_text:
Eau Parfumée au Thé Bleu is a new fragrance of tea collection by Bvlgari
arriving after the following editions: Eau Parfumee au The Vert, Eau
Parfumee au The Blanc, Eau Parfumee au The Rouge which will, as
announced by the brand Bvlgari .
The latest edition Eau Parfumée au Thé Bleu is based on notes of Oolong
tea (Chinese Fujian tea), combined with blue tea, iris blossom and
aromatic lavender, and is created by perfumer Daniela Andrier.

name: Bvlgari Eau Parfumee Au The Vert Eau de Cologne Unisex

notes.source_text:
Bvlgari Eau Parfumée au Thé Vert is a fresh, delicate green tea classic.
Jean-Claude Ellena created it in 1992. Bergamot, cardamom, lemon, coriander and orange blossom open fresh, jasmine, lily of the valley and rose form the heart, and green tea, musk, cedar and sandalwood give it a clean finish.
A daytime favorite for spring and summer.

name: Bvlgari Eau Parfumee The Vert 2025 Eau de Toilette Unisex

notes.source_text: Eau Parfumee The Vert 2025 by Bvlgari is an aromatic green fragrance designed for both women and men. Launched in 2025, this scent is a fresh addition to the Bvlgari collection, crafted by renowned perfumer Jean-Claude Ellena.

name: Bvlgari Goldea The Roman Night Absolute Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text: Goldea The Roman Night Absolute by Bvlgari is a Chypre Floral fragrance for women. This is a new fragrance. Goldea The Roman Night Absolute was launched in 2018. The nose behind this fragrance is Alberto Morillas. Top notes are Plum and Orange Blossom; middle notes are Madagascar Vanilla and Jasmine Sambac; base notes are Black Musk, Patchouli and Moss.

name: Bvlgari GOLDEA The Roman Night Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
BVLGARI is writing a new chapter in its olfactory narrative with a
floral musky chypre, the first for the brand. The fragrance features a
more contemporary signature for women who find its bold character both
appealing and intriguing. The fragrance evokes the Eternal City and its
ebullient energy emanating from the frenzy etched into its nights. The
scent embodies the new goddess of the night, a spontaneous and
instinctive woman who stands by her choices.
Fragrance Family:
Floral
Scent Type:
Warm Florals
Key Notes:
Black Musk, Lucious Mulberry, Blooming Jasmine

name: Bvlgari Kobraa Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text: Bvlgari's Kobraa is a Fougere Amber men's fragrance created by the esteemed nose Jacques Cavallier and launched in 2020. The top note of this scent is Geranium, the middle note is Olibanum, and the base note is Agarwood (Oud).

name: Bvlgari Le Gemme Ambero Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text: Ambero by Bvlgari is a Amber Woody fragrance for men. Ambero was launched in 2016. The nose behind this fragrance is Jacques Cavallier.

name: Bvlgari Le Gemme Amunae Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Amunae, created by Bvlgari, is a unisex fragrance that blends floral, woody, and musky elements. This new scent was introduced in 2025 and was crafted by perfumer Sophie Labbe. The fragrance opens with fresh notes of Aldehydes and Olibanum, transitions to a heart of Jasmine and Ambrette (Musk Mallow), and finishes with a rich base of Black Musk and Oak.

name: Bvlgari Le Gemme Azaran Eau de Parfum for men

notes.source_text: Azaran by Bvlgari is a Amber Woody fragrance for men. This is a new fragrance. Azaran was launched in 2021. The nose behind this fragrance is Jacques Cavallier. Top notes are Saffron and Bergamot; middle notes are Cedar and Green Tea; base notes are Leather, Woody Notes and Beeswax.

name: Bvlgari Le Gemme Desiria Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text: Desiria by Bvlgari is a Floral fragrance for women. Desiria was launched in 2016.

name: Bvlgari Le Gemme Empyr Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text: Le Gemme Empyr by Bvlgari is a Woody Spicy fragrance for men. Le Gemme Empyr was launched in 2021. The nose behind this fragrance is Jacques Cavallier. Top note is Ginger; middle note is Ginger; base notes are Sandalwood and Labdanum.

name: Bvlgari Le Gemme Falkar Eau de Parfum for Men

top: while a heart of Cypriol Oil or Nagarmotha
key: while a heart of Cypriol Oil or Nagarmotha
notes.source_text: Created by renowned perfumer Jacques Cavallier in 2019, Falkar by Bvlgari is a warm, woody fragrance designed just for men. Nutmeg and Cinnamon embrace the senses at top notes, while a heart of Cypriol Oil or Nagarmotha and Olibanum provides a sensual complexity. The amber base of Saffron, Agarwood (Oud) and Black Musk creates a mesmerizing trail of scent.

name: Bvlgari Le Gemme Garanat Men Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text: Garanat by Bvlgari is a Oriental Floral fragrance for men. Garanat was launched in 2016. The nose behind this fragrance is Jacques Cavallier. The fragrance features damask rose, rose and incense.

name: Bvlgari Le Gemme Gyan Men Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text: Gyan by Bvlgari is a Oriental Woody fragrance for men. Gyan was launched in 2016. The nose behind this fragrance is Jacques Cavallier. The fragrance features jasmine sambac, patchouli and incense.

name: Bvlgari Le Gemme Opalon Eau de Parfum For Men

notes.source_text: Opalon by Bvlgari is a Amber Floral fragrance for men. This is a new fragrance. Opalon was launched in 2019. The nose behind this fragrance is Jacques Cavallier. Top notes are Neroli and Ginger; middle notes are Lemongrass and Geranium; base notes are Ambergris and White Musk.

name: Bvlgari Le Gemme Orom Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text: Le Gemme Orom by Bvlgari is a Amber Vanilla fragrance for men. This is a new fragrance. Le Gemme Orom was launched in 2022. Top note is Bourbon Vanilla; middle note is Siam Benzoin; base note is Agarwood (Oud).

name: Bvlgari Le Gemme Rubinia Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text: Rubinia by Bvlgari is a Amber Woody fragrance for women. Rubinia was launched in 2018. The nose behind this fragrance is Alberto Morillas. Top note is Sicilian Mandarin; middle notes are Copaiba balm, Sandalwood, Orange Blossom and Jasmine; base notes are Vanilla, Tonka Bean, Saffron, Violet and Agarwood (Oud).

name: Bvlgari Le Gemme Sahare Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Sahare by Bvlgari is an Amber Floral fragrance designed for both women and men. Launched in 2024, this scent is a recent addition to the Bvlgari collection, crafted by perfumer Yann Vasnier. The fragrance opens with zesty notes of Lemon and Bergamot, leading into a heart of Black Pepper and Taif Rose, and concludes with a warm base of Ambergris and Myrrh.

name: Bvlgari Le Gemme Splendida Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text: Splendia by Bvlgari is a Floral fragrance for women. Splendia was launched in 2016.

name: Bvlgari Le Gemme Tygar Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Bvlgari Le Gemme Tygar is a radiant grapefruit and woody amber fragrance.
Jacques Cavallier Belletrud created it in 2016 around sparkling grapefruit, ambroxan and woods. The result is bright and clean, with a glowing citrus-amber trail.
A luxurious everyday scent that feels fresh and confident.

name: Bvlgari Le Gemme Tygar Extrait Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Bvlgari Le Gemme Tygar Extrait is a richer, creamier take on Tygar's grapefruit.
Launched in 2025, it opens with vibrant grapefruit. Ginger and ambrette seed form the heart, and ambroxan, white musk and vetiver give it a clean, woody finish.
A polished daytime scent in any season.

name: Bvlgari Le Gemme Yasep Eau de Parfum for men

notes.source_text: Yasep by Bvlgari is a Amber fragrance for men. This is a new fragrance. Yasep was launched in 2019. The nose behind this fragrance is Jacques Cavallier. Top notes are Sicilian Mandarin and Sichuan Pepper; middle notes are Sandalwood and Cedar; base notes are Musk, Amyris and Vetiver.

name: Bvlgari Man Glacial Essence Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Bvlgari Man Glacial Essence Eau de Parfum takes on a new olfactory
territory along with the raw strength and mesmerizing power of the vital
element of Air. The fragrance is inspired by and crafted to emulate
this element that represents the connection of body and mind, to give
man the confidence to take that deep breath and the strength to achieve
greatness while living life to the fullest.
Top - juniper berry, ginger extract, geranium essence
Middle - Australian sandalwood, rare orris, Artemisia essence
Base - Alaskan cedarwood essence, clearwood accord, musks

name: Bvlgari Man in Black Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Bvlgari Man in Black is a warm, spicy blend of rum, leather and tuberose.
Launched in 2015, it opens with spices and rum. Leather, iris and tuberose form the heart, and guaiac wood, tonka bean and benzoin give it a smooth finish.
