A rich choice for cooler evenings.

name: Bvlgari Man in Black Parfum for Men

notes.source_text: Bvlgari Man In Black Parfum, introduced by Bvlgari in 2024, is a captivating Amber Woody fragrance designed for men. Created by the renowned perfumer Alberto Morillas, this scent features an intriguing blend of top notes that include spices and elemi. The heart reveals the floral richness of tuberose and iris, while the base is anchored by the warm, deep aromas of Siam benzoin and dark woods.

name: Bvlgari Man Rain Essence Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text: Bvlgari Man Rain Essence by Bvlgari is a fragrance for men. This is a new fragrance. Bvlgari Man Rain Essence was launched in 2023. The nose behind this fragrance is Alberto Morillas. Top notes are Green Tea and Orange; middle notes are White Lotus and Musk; base notes are Amber and Guaiac Wood.

name: Bvlgari Man Terrae Essence Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text: Bvlgari Man Terrae Essence by Bvlgari is a Woody fragrance for men. This is a new fragrance. Bvlgari Man Terrae Essence was launched in 2021. The nose behind this fragrance is Alberto Morillas. Top notes are Citron and Calamansi; middle notes are Vetiver and Orris; base notes are Earthy Notes and Styrax.

name: Bvlgari Man Wood Essence Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
The house of Bvlgari launches their new fragrance Bvlgari Man Wood Essence
in July 2018, as a part of the Bvlgari Man collection. The philosophy
of the new fragrance is based on the balance between the urban life of a
modern man and the call of nature.
Bvlgari Man Wood Essence combines an accord of woods – wood
barks, resins and essences – mixed with spicy notes. Italian citrus zest
along with coriander leaf gives a fresh, green character in the
opening, leading to an intense woody cypress, vetiver and cedar accord
based on benzoin resins.

name: Bvlgari Man Wood Essence Parfum for Men

notes.source_text: Bvlgari Man Wood Essence Parfum is a contemporary woody fragrance designed for men, introduced by Bvlgari in 2026. Crafted by the renowned perfumer Alberto Morillas, this scent features a blend of invigorating top notes of Sichuan Pepper and Coriander. The heart of the fragrance reveals a rich combination of Cashmere Wood and Cypress, while its foundation is composed of deep base notes including Guaiac Wood, Patchouli, Cedarwood, and Vetiver.

name: Bvlgari Man Wood Neroli Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text: Bvlgari Man Wood Neroli by Bvlgari is a Woody Floral Musk fragrance for men. This is a new fragrance. Bvlgari Man Wood Neroli was launched in 2019. The nose behind this fragrance is Alberto Morillas. Top notes are bergamot and neroli; middle notes are orange blossom, virginia cedar and cypriol oil or nagarmotha; base notes are leather, white musk, amber, ambergris and woody notes. >

name: Bvlgari Omnia Coral Eau de Toilette for Women

notes.source_text: Bvlgari's Omnia Coral is a floral, fruity scent intended for women, released in 2012. Perfumer Alberto Morillas composed this fragrance, which combines top notes of bergamot and goji berries, middle notes of pomegranate, hibiscus, and water lily, and base notes of musk and Virginia cedar.

name: Bvlgari Onekh Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text: Launched in 2016, Onekh by Bvlgari is a Leather scent for men crafted by renowned perfumer Jacques Cavallier.

name: Bvlgari Pour Femme Eau de Toilette

notes.source_text:
Bvlgari Pour Femme is a classic feminine Floral fragrance
created in 1994 by renowned perfumer Sophia Grojsman for the Jewelry and
Fragrance house of Bvlgari. It has an aorma profile that is powdery,
violet, floral, iris, woody, white floral, rose, vanilla, amber, and
fruity. It has been discontinued and is now listed as a vaulted
fragrance by Bvlgari.

name: Bvlgari Pour Homme Eau De Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Bvlgari pour Homme Eau de Parfum is a refined blend of tea, ginger and musk.
Jacques Cavallier Belletrud created it in 2024. Darjeeling tea and ginger open fresh, black tea and guaiac wood form the heart, and white musk and ambrette give it a clean finish.
A daytime favorite from spring through fall.

name: Bvlgari Pour Homme Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text: Released in 1996, Bvlgari Pour Homme is a Woody Floral Musk fragrance created for men by Jacques Cavallier. At the top of this scent, you'll detect Tea, Aldehydes, Bergamot, Lavender, Nutmeg Flower, Orange Blossom and Mandarin Orange. The middle notes include Pepper, Iris, Guaiac Wood, Brazilian Rosewood, Coriander, Geranium, Cyclamen, Cardamom and Carnation. The bottom of the composition contains Musk, Vetiver, Cedar, Oakmoss, Amber and Tonka Bean.

name: Bvlgari Pour Homme Extreme Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text: The woody aromatic men's fragrance Bvlgari Extreme was released in 1999, crafted by the talented nose Jacques Cavallier. At the top, the scent opens with tea, grapefruit, bergamot, neroli, petitgrain, lavender, coriander and galbanum, blending into balsam fir, guaiac wood, pepper, nutmeg, Brazilian rosewood and cardamom at the heart, and rounding out with musk, cedar, iris, oakmoss and sandalwood at its base.

name: Bvlgari Tygar x Refik Anadol Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text: Tygar x Refik Anadol, a collaboration by Bvlgari, is a refreshing Citrus fragrance designed for men. Launched in 2025, this innovative scent was crafted by renowned perfumer Jacques Cavallier Belletrud. It opens with a vibrant top note of Grapefruit, followed by intriguing middle notes of Ginger and Ambrette. The fragrance concludes with a rich base of Ambroxan, Musk, Patchouli, and Vetiver.

name: By Kilian A Kiss from a Rose Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text: "A Kiss from a Rose by By Kilian presents itself as a freshly introduced floral scent tailored for women. Unveiled in 2021, this fragrance is a recent addition to the olfactory world. The creative perfumer Alberto Morillas is credited with its conception. The scent captivates with initial top notes of verdant Green Notes and ripe Black Currant. At its heart, the enchanting scents of May Rose and Jasmine Sambac bloom. It culminates in a delicate foundation, where the woody essence of Cypriol Oil, also known as Nagarmotha, intertwines with the purity of White Musk."

name: By Kilian A Taste of Heaven for Men

notes.source_text: A Taste of Heaven, created by By Kilian, is an Amber Fougere scent designed for men. Introduced in 2007, this fragrance was crafted by perfumer Calice Becker.

name: By Kilian Amber Oud Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Verified fragrance notes for By Kilian Amber Oud Eau de Parfum Unisex: Oud, Amber, Spices, Vanilla, Benzoin, Cedar.

name: By Kilian Angels' Share Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
By Kilian Angels' Share is a warm, boozy gourmand inspired by cognac.
Benoist Lapouza created it in 2020. Cognac opens rich and smooth, cinnamon, tonka bean and oak form a warm, spiced heart, and praline, vanilla and sandalwood finish it with a creamy sweetness.
Angels' Share is cozy, sweet and festive, like a warm drink by the fire. It is perfect for fall and winter nights, holidays and special evenings.

Angels' Share by By Kilian is a Oriental Vanilla fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Angels' Share
was launched in 2020. The nose behind this fragrance is Benoist
Lapouza. Top note is Cognac; middle notes are Cinnamon, Tonka Bean and
Oak; base notes are Praline, Vanilla and Sandalwood.

name: By Kilian Angels' Share On The Rocks Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
By Kilian Angels' Share On the Rocks is a cooler, brighter twist on the famous cognac scent.
Launched in 2025, it blends cognac and tonka bean with fresh grapefruit, bergamot and sparkling aldehydes, grounded by a touch of myrrh. It keeps the warm, boozy soul of Angels' Share but feels lighter and more refreshing.
Easy to wear in every season, day or night.

name: By Kilian Angels' Share Paradis Extrait de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Angels' Share Paradis by By Kilian is a unisex Floral Fruity Gourmand fragrance. Recently introduced in 2025, this new scent is crafted by perfumer Benoist Lapouza. It opens with top notes of Cognac, Liquor, and Raspberry, transitions into heart notes of Tonka Bean, Bulgarian Rose, and Oakmoss, and concludes with base notes of Praline, Oak, and Sandalwood.

name: By Kilian Apple Brandy on the Rocks Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
By Kilian Apple Brandy on the Rocks is a cool, boozy blend of apple and brandy.
Sidonie Lancesseur created it in 2021. Cardamom and bergamot open fresh, apple, rum, pineapple, brandy, vanilla and moss form the heart, and ambroxan and cedar give it a clean finish.
Versatile in spring, fall and winter, day or night.

Apple Brandy on the Rocks by By Kilian is a Aromatic Fruity fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Apple Brandy on the Rocks was launched in 2021. The nose behind this fragrance is Sidonie Lancesseur. Top notes are Cardamom and Bergamot; middle notes are Apple, Rum, Pineapple, Brandy, Vanilla and Moss; base notes are Ambroxan and Cedar.

name: By Kilian Back to Black Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
By Kilian Back to Black is a Unisex fragrance, The fragrance launched in 2009, The nose behind this fragrance is Calice Becker,
Top Note: white honey, Tobacco, Cherry, Vanilla, Raspberry, Almond, Gingerbread, Amber, Tonka Bean, Nutmeg, Chamomile, Benzoin, Saffron, Cardamom, Patchouli, French labdanum, Olibanum, Oak, Virginia Cedar, Coriander, Geranium, Bergamot
Heart Note: Atlas Cedarwood, Honey, Moss, Oilban, Patchouli, Vetiver
Base Note: Almond, Amber, Cistus Labdanum, Tobacco, Vanilla

name: By Kilian Bad Boys Are No Good But Good Boys Are No Fun Eau de Parfum for Women
tags: Bad Boys Are No Good But Good Boys Are No Fun

notes.source_text:
Kilian launches My Kind Of Love in 2018, five new fragrances inspired
by seduction games, bold declarations of love and a way to love
freely.
The lower-priced line comes out at Sephora in August 2018 named My
Kind of Love. The concept is to choose a flavor of love which
corresponds with the different scents: fun, sparkling, hot and sweet.
"I wanted to invite you to take a walk on the wild side with a scent
made for misbehaving. Boys is a very sexy and very fresh scent thanks to
the instantly recognizable cola accord made of nutmeg, cinnamon, and
lime."— Kilian Hennessy.

name: By Kilian Bamboo Harmony Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Bamboo Harmony is inspired by The Tale of the Bamboo Cutter, a
Japanese folk tale. The bamboo stands as the symbol of human perfection
and is in Chinese culture the means to practice calligraphy with, it
being the main material out of which calligraphy brushes are made of.
It symbolizes therefore art, beauty and the "men of letters".
The fragrance Bamboo Harmony by Kilian focuses on the
olfactory impression of a sip of white tea drunk off bamboo, with fresh
top notes of notes of bergamot, neroli and Bigarade. The white tea
leaves being renowned for their sumptuous taste and delicate refinement
are here accented with a hint of spice. Coupled with white tea there are
Maté notes in Bamboo Harmony , interwoven with fig leaves and oakmoss, making us savour a serene moment of spirituality in a drop of fragrance.

name: By Kilian Beyond Love Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text: Beyond Love by By Kilian is a captivating floral scent designed for women. Introduced in 2007, this fragrance was expertly crafted by perfumer Calice Becker.

name: By Kilian Black Oud Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Black Oud by By Kilian is an enchanting Amber fragrance suitable for both women and men. Introduced in 2014, this scent features top notes of Rose, Cardamom, Pink Pepper, and Geranium. The heart is composed of Papyrus, Patchouli, Cedar, and Methyl Pamplemousse, while the base notes include Agarwood (Oud), Incense, Moss, Sandalwood, Musk, and Labdanum.

name: By Kilian Black Phantom Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
By Kilian Black Phantom is a dark, gourmand blend of coffee, rum and chocolate.
Sidonie Lancesseur created it in 2017. Dark chocolate, rum, caramel, coffee and sugar cane blend with almond, heliotrope and sandalwood for a rich, sweet and slightly smoky scent.
Made for fall and winter nights and date nights.

On turbulent seas, an inescapably transient pirate ship braves black
waters, leagues deep in mystery. Black Phantom "Memento Mori" reveals
its hidden treasures to the curious nose in waves—a gourmand woodsy
harmony. Rum accord from Martinique—akin to ‘pirates water’—spikes the
scent of strong coffee at its heart, balanced by vetiver essence. A
deadly bite of cyanide accord hides menacingly, like the smile from
death itself. Smile back as sugar cane and dark, creamy sandalwood
assures each trying journey holds a sweet reward.
The Black Phantom, Memento Mori Eau de Parfum is made for daring
people who need a partner's in crime for their nocturnal adventures.
Fragrance Family:
Warm & Spicy
Scent Type:
Woody Spice
Key Notes:
Rum, Coffee, Vetiver

name: By Kilian Blue Moon Ginger Dash Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: By Kilian's Blue Moon Ginger Dash is a unisex scent created in 2023 by perfumer Sidonie Lancesseur. Bright Lemon and Calone open the scent, while spicy Ginger and Vodka comprise the middle notes. Finally, Ambroxan and White Musk create a cozy, musky base.

name: By Kilian Born to be Unforgettable Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Under the creative direction of Kilian Hennessy, KILIAN PARIS unveils Born to be Unforgettable—a vibrant fragrance that captures the effervescent rush of a refreshing cola. This daring composition delivers an immediate sensory impact, embodying bold character while reimagining the beloved cola experience through sophisticated olfactory artistry. The result is a memorable scent that exudes cool confidence and leaves an indelible impression.
The composition opens with an invigorating burst of fresh lime, creating an instant sense of energy and vitality. This bright introduction seamlessly transitions into the fragrance's heart—a masterfully crafted blend of warming Cinnamon, aromatic Nutmeg, and creamy Vanilla that authentically recreates the distinctive cola sensation. The journey concludes with rich, woody Cedarwood notes that provide depth, warmth, and exceptional longevity to the composition.

name: By Kilian Can't Stop Loving You Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text: Can't Stop Loving You by By Kilian is a Amber Vanilla fragrance for women. This is a new fragrance. Can't Stop Loving You was launched in 2023. The nose behind this fragrance is Alberto Morillas. Top notes are Orange Blossom and Paradisone; middle note is Honey; base notes are Madagascar Vanilla, Olibanum and Oakmoss.

name: By Kilian Cruel Intentions Unisex

notes.source_text: Cruel Intentions by By Kilian is an Amber Woody fragrance designed for both women and men, launched in 2007. The scent is crafted by perfumer Sidonie Lancesseur. It opens with captivating top notes of Rose, Violet, Bergamot, and African Orange flower. The heart features rich middle notes of Agarwood (Oud), Guaiac Wood, and Papyrus. Finally, the fragrance is anchored by a deep base of Vetiver, Sandalwood, Vanilla, Castoreum, Styrax, and Musk.

name: By Kilian Dark Lord Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
By Kilian Dark Lord is a dark, smoky leather with rum and pepper.
Alberto Morillas created it in 2018. Bergamot, pepper and Sichuan pepper open spicy, rum, jasmine sambac and davana form the heart, and leather, vetiver, cypriol, cedar and patchouli give it depth.
Made for fall and winter nights and date nights.

By Kilian launches Dark Lord in summer 2018.
"Dark Lord "Ex Tenebris Lux' is a gentleman of the night. Meet
him in the most surprising of circumstances and his mystery slowly
unfolds: A head-twisting mix of shadows and light, it seduces in seconds
with its elegant, long-lasting accords of leather and strong vetiver,
its jasmine drenched in rum, and a dandyish entrance of bergamot and
pepper. Under lock and tasseled key, a 1.7 oz. flacon is carved with the
Achilles’ Shield as a symbol of protection and finished with
monogram-engraved gunmetal details. A smiling skull rises like a
monument atop a black lacquered wooden coffret, illuminating a display
of grim magnificence."

name: By Kilian Fievre Verte Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: The newest Woody Aromatic fragrance for both men and women, Fièvre Verte by By Kilian, was released in 2023 and was crafted by Mathieu Nardin. Its top notes are Wormwood and Cypress, its middle notes are Licorice and Violet Leaf, and its base notes are Vetiver, Patchouli, Vanilla, Sandalwood and Tonka.

name: By Kilian Flower of Immortality Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
With Flower of Immortality, Kilian
pays homage to the Chinese tale “A Tale of the Fountain of the Peach
Blossom Spring”. It is recounted that a fisherman from Wu Ling loses his
way along a stream and, unexpectedly, finds himself rowing alongside a
lush peach tree forest. He decides to explore further and, at the end of
the forest, lands at the fountainhead of the stream. There, he
disembarks and just steps beyond, discovers a haven of peace, a utopian
paradise where people live apart from the exterior world.
For Kilian, Flower of Immortality is, above all, an olfactory
homage to the peach blossom and its very strong symbolism in China. This
blossom, whose pink petals are unveiled only in the middle of the
winter, is believed to have the power to bewitch the human soul and to
make it immortal. It is the set of symbols and myths that surround the
flower that Kilian wanted to recreate in this new fragrance.
Flower of Immortality was composed as the memory of the utopian
paradise, where the fragrance of peach blossoms brings a promise of
hospitality and immortality. The smooth and juicy scent of White Peach,
interweaved by the sweet and powdery notes of Carrot and Iris. A
dazzling breeze of Blackcurrant Bud absolute refreshes while the
exquisite Rose Crystal is softened by the Tonka Bean and the scent of
Vanilla beans drying in the sun.
- Top: peach blossom, blackcurrant buds, peach.
- Middle: iris, rose, carrot.
- Base: tonka bean, vanilla.

name: By Kilian Forbidden Games Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text: Forbidden Games by By Kilian is a Floral Fruity Gourmand fragrance for women. Forbidden Games was launched in 2012. The nose behind this fragrance is Calice Becker. Top notes are apple, peach, plum and cinnamon; middle notes are bulgarian rose, bourbon geranium and jasmine; base notes are vanilla, honey and opoponax.

name: By Kilian Gold Knight Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text: Gold Knight by By Kilian is a Oriental Woody fragrance for men. Gold Knight was launched in 2017. The nose behind this fragrance is Pascal Gaurin. Top notes are anise and bergamot; middle notes are honey and vanilla; base note is patchouli.

name: By Kilian Gold Oud Unisex

notes.source_text: Gold Oud by By Kilian is an Amber Floral scent designed for both women and men. This fragrance was introduced in 2014.

name: By Kilian Good Girl Gone Bad Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
The uninhibited Good Girl Gone Bad finds herself in a luscious floral
whirlwind in the garden of good and evil. Half-innocent,
half-voluptuous, the apricot-tinged osmanthus absolute, orange blossom,
and rose of may absolute that opens the fragrance are beholden by the
ultimate temptress, an explosion of the three-sirens of flowers:
tuberose absolute, jasmine and narcissus.
The perfect fragrance for good girls who dare to turn bad and sexy,
to be worn wherever they want to be kissed. The Good girl gone Bad Eau
de Parfum will last until the end of the night.
Fragrance Family:
Floral
Scent Type:
Classic Florals
Key Notes:
Rose ,Tuberose, Jasmine

name: By Kilian Good Girl Gone Bad Eau Fraiche Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text: By Kilian's Good Girl Gone Bad Eau Fraiche is a brand new Floral fragrance specifically created for women in 2020. Masterfully crafted by Alberto Morillas, this scent is a blend of Tunisian Orange Blossom, Turkish Rose, Moroccan Rose, Watery Notes, Egyptian Jasmine, Tuberose, and Musk.

name: By Kilian Good Girl Gone Bad extreme Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
KILIAN pushes two of its heritage fragrances to their olfactive extremes.
Good girl gone Bad - EXTREME, is dipped in a delicious elixir of pure milky toffee goodness. Take the uninhibited whirlwind of flowers in Good girl gone Bad and envelope it in a luscious, milky facet. It opens with a pink and white bouquet of roses of May, and the most beautiful orange blossoms carried by the song of three sirens, calling from its core: tuberose, Egyptian jasmine sambac, and narcissus. These exquisite flowers are wrapped in a milky toffee elixir, making them half-innocent, half-voluptuous, and now—a delicious temptress altogether.
PERFUMER
Alberto Morillas
The jet-black perfume flacon can be tucked and carried away in a dedicated, black lacquer clutch adorned with the seductress’s ultimate partner-in-crime: a snake, as if emerging from the depths of desire.

name: By Kilian Good Girl Gone Bad Splash of Neroli Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Good Girl Gone Bad, crafted by By Kilian, is a Floral Fruity perfume designed for women. Introduced in 2012, this fragrance features top notes of Osmanthus, Jasmine, and May Rose, complemented by middle notes of Indian Tuberose and Narcissus, while the base settles into warm Amber and Cedar.

name: By Kilian Her Majesty Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text: Her Majesty by By Kilian is a Chypre Floral scent designed for both women and men. Introduced in 2026, this fragrance is a fresh addition to the collection. The creator behind this exquisite scent is Caroline Dumur. The fragrance opens with top notes of White Peach, Rum, and Aquatic elements, followed by a heart of Rose and Ambrette. Its base features rich notes of Oakmoss, Cedar, Papyrus, and Cypriol.

name: By Kilian I Don't Need A Prince By My Side To Be A Princess Eau de Parfum for Women
tags: I Don't Need A Prince By My Side To Be A Princess

notes.source_text: By Kilian, the Estée Lauder -owned fragrance artisanal brand, launched a lower-priced line at Sephora in August 2018 named My Kind of Love. The concept is to choose a flavor of love which corresponds with the different scents: fun, sparkling, hot and sweet.

name: By Kilian Imperial Tea Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Imperial Tea by By Kilian is an aromatic green fragrance designed for both women and men. Launched in 2014, this scent was crafted by perfumer Calice Becker.

name: By Kilian In the City of Sin Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text: In the City of Sin by By Kilian is a Floral Fruity Gourmand fragrance for women. In the City of Sin was launched in 2012. The nose behind this fragrance is Calice Becker. Top notes are bergamot, pink pepper and guatemalan cardamom; middle notes are apricot, plum, turkish rose and incense; base notes are atlas cedar and patchouli.

name: By Kilian Incense Oud Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Incense Oud by By Kilian is a Oriental fragrance for women and men. Incense Oud was launched in 2011. The nose behind this fragrance is Sidonie Lancesseur.
Top notes are geranium, cardamom, pink pepper and rose; middle notes
are patchouli, virginia cedar, papyrus and methyl pamplemousse; base
notes are musk, french labdanum, sandalwood, oak moss, incense and
agarwood (oud).

name: By Kilian Intoxicated Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
By Kilian Intoxicated is a warm, spiced coffee with cardamom and cinnamon.
Calice Becker created it in 2014. Cardamom, coffee, nutmeg and cinnamon blend into a rich, spicy and comforting scent.
Made for fall and winter, perfect for date nights.

No coffee tastes as good as it
smells: but this sublime fragrance tantalizes the senses. Addicts crave a
substance either as a prop against the harshness of life or to enhance
its pleasures.
INTOXICATED is emphatically the latter.
Kilian Hennessy and Calice Becker conjure up the steam from an
eggshell cup of rich viscous Turkish coffee laced with green cardamom in
double strength - in oil and absolute - to glow as the opulent heart of
the scent. Around this swells the warm spicy fragrance of
hallucinogenic nutmeg & powdered cinnamon. At the base is the
crystal sweetness of burnt caramelized sugar.
Coffee so rich and strong it will hold a silver spoon upright.
Coffee and scent both sensual and vigorous. Coffee as a stimulant,
aphrodisiac and sleeping draught.

name: By Kilian Kologne Shield of Protection Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Kologne, Shield of protection by By Kilian is a Citrus Aromatic fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Kologne, Shield of protection was launched in 2022. The nose behind this fragrance is Calice Becker.

name: By Kilian L'Heure Verte Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: L'Heure Verte by By Kilian is a Woody Aromatic fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. L'Heure Verte was launched in 2021. The nose behind this fragrance is Mathieu Nardin. Top note is Absinthe; middle notes are Licorice and Violet Leaf; base notes are Patchouli, Vetiver, Woody Notes and Sandalwood.

name: By Kilian Liaisons Dangereuses Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Created by Kilian Hennessy, heir to the Hennessy cognac family, this
luxurious scent has notes of Egyptian geranium and cinnamon. Inspired by
plum from Damascus, a delicate fruit with a smooth note redolent of an
alcove inhabited by languid lovers
Liaisons Dangereuses  Notes
Coconut flesh,
prune absolute, plum, blackcurrant buds absolute, crystallized peach,
cinnamon bark oil, ambrette seeds absolute, rose Damascus, geranium
bourbon, Australian sandalwood oil, oakmoss extract, vetiver java oil,
clear woods, vanilla extract, white musks

name: By Kilian Light My Fire Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Light My Fire by By Kilian is a Oriental Woody fragrance for women and men. Light My Fire was launched in 2014. The nose behind this fragrance is Sidonie Lancesseur. The fragrance features cumin, hay, patchouli, vetiver, honey, vanila and tobacco.

name: By Kilian Love and Tears Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Love and Tears, crafted by By Kilian, is a captivating Floral fragrance designed for both women and men. Introduced in 2010, this scent was created by perfumer Calice Becker. Its top notes feature Petitgrain, Bergamot, Galbanum, and Lavender, while the heart reveals a bouquet of Jasmine, Water Jasmine, Lily-of-the-Valley, Narcissus, Orange Blossom, and Ylang-Ylang. The fragrance concludes with earthy base notes of Oakmoss, Cedar, and Styrax.

name: By Kilian Love Don't Be Shy Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
By Kilian Love, Don't Be Shy is a sweet, creamy orange blossom with caramel and vanilla.
Calice Becker created it in 2007. Neroli, pink pepper and bergamot open bright, orange blossom, jasmine, honeysuckle and rose form the heart, and caramel, vanilla, sugar and musk give it an irresistible, marshmallow-soft finish.
Perfect for fall and winter, date nights and evenings out.

Love by Kilian by By Kilian is a Oriental fragrance for women. Love by Kilian
was launched in 2007. The nose behind this fragrance is Calice Becker.
Top notes are Neroli, Pink Pepper, Bergamot and Coriander; middle notes
are Orange Blossom, Jasmine, Honeysuckle, Rose and iris; base notes are
Caramel, Vanilla, Sugar, Musk, Civet and Labdanum.

name: By Kilian Love Don't Be Shy Eau Fraiche Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text: By Kilian's Love Eau Fraîche, a Floral-scented fragrance for women released in 2019, was created by the nose Calice Becker. It opens with Neroli and Petitgrain followed by heart notes of Jasmine, Peony and Freesia. The base of Marshmallow and White Musk rounds out the perfume.

name: By Kilian Love Don't Be Shy Extreme Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text: Love Don't Be Shy Extreme by By Kilian is a Amber Vanilla fragrance for women. This is a new fragrance. Love Don't Be Shy Extreme was launched in 2021. The nose behind this fragrance is Calice Becker. Top notes are Neroli and Bergamot; middle notes are Orange Blossom and Bulgarian Rose; base notes are Marshmallow, Vanilla, Musk and Pomegranate.

name: By Kilian Midnight Espresso Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Midnight Espresso by By Kilian is an Oriental Vanilla fragrance designed for both women and men. Launched in 2026, this scent is a fresh addition to the fragrance world, crafted by perfumer Mathieu Nardin. The composition opens with enticing top notes of Coffee and Rum, transitioning into a rich heart of Chocolate and Hazelnut, and finally settling into a warm base of Vanilla and Siam Benzoin.

name: By Kilian Moonlight in Heaven Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Fragrance Family: Fresh
Scent Type: Fresh Citrus & Fruits
Key Notes: Mango, Coconut Milk, Rice
Fragrance Description: The fresh perfume of tasty mango and the fresh scent of powdered sambac jasmine are mixed with coconut milk and rice all wrapped in tonka bean and the delicacy of vetiver. Both unique and familiar, this fresh perfume with an exotic fragrance pushes you to open the doors of paradise.
About the Bottle: The bottles of Kilian's Fresh Citrus family are adorned with a distinctive Klein-blue lacquer and meticulously engraved on each side with the representation of the Achilles shield. Like Kilian Hennessy says, "In perfumery, it is as much about seduction as it is about protection."
About the Fragrance: Moonlight In Heaven is part of Kilian’s Fresh Citrus family. Fresh aromas reminiscent of a sip of sparkling citrus fruits, aquatic notes, or refreshing aldehydes bring freshness, lightness, and a serene feeling to these compositions. The Perfumer is Calice Becker.

name: By Kilian Musk Oud Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Kilian Musk Oud Perfume by Kilian, Citric and woody, Kilian Musk Oud is a
flowery and musky fragrance suited for both men and women
. Its high notes are
characterized by crisp lemon and coriander alongside rich cardamom,
while its heart notes include softer florals like rose, artemisia and
geranium. Both sillage and endurance are on the heavier side with this
fragrance, imprinting the air around the wearer with a warm, complex
atmosphere well after the initial application. When the bottom notes
emerge, patchouli, incense and rum are among the most striking aromas.
While the complexity and richness of the scent lends exceptionally well
to autumn use, this fragrance can be enjoyed in any season.

name: By Kilian Old Fashioned Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Old Fashioned by By Kilian is an Oriental Fougere scent designed for both women and men. This fragrance, which debuted in 2024, features the artistry of perfumer Sidonie Lancesseur. The fragrance opens with top notes of Wheat and Davana, followed by a heart of Immortelle and Cedar, and concludes with base notes of Tolu Balsam and Styrax.

name: By Kilian Pearl Oud Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text: Pearl Oud by By Kilian is a Oriental Woody fragrance for women and men. Pearl Oud was launched in 2015. The nose behind this fragrance is Christian Provenzano. Top notes are black pepper and saffron; middle notes are iris, turkish rose, rose and ylang-ylang; base notes are agarwood (oud) and castoreum.

name: By Kilian Pina Paraiso Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Pina Paraiso by By Kilian is an Oriental Vanilla fragrance designed for both women and men. This intoxicating scent made its debut in 2026, crafted by the talented nose of Mathieu Nardin. It opens with vibrant top notes of Pineapple and Rum, followed by a lush heart of Coconut and Frangipani. The fragrance settles into a warm base of Bourbon Vanilla and Tonka Bean, creating a harmonious and alluring aroma.

name: By Kilian Playing With Devil Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text: "White Collection" In The Garden of Good & Evil by the house of By Kilian presents the fourth edition this year, called Playing With The Devil, inspired by forbidden fruit interpreted in modern, imaginative way. The concept of god and evil is recognized in this composition in which on the one side the creator offers sweet, fruity tamed accord sprinkled with insolence and lecherous heat of resin and hot spices.

name: By Kilian Prelude to Love Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Prelude to Love by By Kilian is a captivating Floral Fruity fragrance suitable for both women and men. Introduced in 2008, this scent was expertly crafted by perfumer Calice Becker. The fragrance opens with refreshing top notes of Bergamot, Amalfi Lemon, Orange, and Bitter Orange. Its heart reveals a harmonious blend of Neroli, Orange Blossom, Lavender, Freesia, Cardamom, Pink Pepper, and Rose. Finally, the base notes of Iris, Musk, Russian Leather, and Cypriol Oil (Nagarmotha) provide a rich and enduring finish.

name: By Kilian Pure Oud Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Dark, enigmatic, charismatic and
moody. No, we're not talking exes— we're talking oud. The rare and
precious oil found in agarwood has been inspiring perfumers of late,
leading to a bounty of scents based on this compelling note. One of our
favorites is this luxurious potion by Calice Becker. She has mastered
the critical element of balance – showcasing all of the wonderful
strangeness of oud, while taming it just enough to keep it from becoming
overwhelming. Pure Oud opens with the dark glitter of obsidian, as
saffron swirls over a deep animalic growl, then takes us on a long and
twisty journey to secret places: a deliciously murky lair filled with
mysterious smoke; a hidden chamber redolent with ink, leather and
ancient wood. Make no mistake, this is powerful stuff: the ink is
extremely inky, the leather is enveloping and rich, the animalic
elements are so vivid that you can feel the lion's breath on your neck—
and yet Becker has taken all of these prickly components and spun them
into velvet. The end result is so astonishingly smooth and well-blended
that you could wear it every day. Oud lovers will adore this, naturally,
but this also gets our vote for the oud fragrance most likely to win
new converts-- not because it is a simplified version, but because it
gets all the complications perfectly right. Magical.
Pure Oud  Notes
Saffron, Oud Oil, Cypriol, Gaiac Wood, Copahu Balm, Ciste, Myrrh.

name: By Kilian Rolling in Love Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Rolling in Love by By Kilian is a Oriental Floral fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Rolling in Love was launched in 2019. name: By Kilian Straight To Heaven for Men Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
By Kilian Straight to Heaven is a boozy, woody blend of rum, nutmeg and patchouli.
Sidonie Lancesseur created it in 2007. Rum, dried fruits and nutmeg open warm, vanilla adds a smooth heart, and amber, musk, patchouli and Virginia cedar give it a rich, woody finish.
Versatile from spring through winter, for everyday wear and date nights.

Key Notes:
Dark Rum, Nutmeg, Spicy Patchouli
About:
Moments of ecstasy envelop the senses with Straight to Heaven, White Cristal. Smoldering with addictive sensuality, a burning splash of rich dark rum defines the opening. Its sweet gourmand chord is softened by creamy vanilla and dried fruit. Spicy patchouli pairs with the fresh, woodsy scent of cedarwood to finish, finding animalic harmony at long last.
The Straight to Heaven, white cristal Eau de Parfum is made for people who dare to explore their forbidden desires—throughout the day and night.
Each set contains:
- Eau de Parfum
- Lacquered coffret

name: BYREDO 1996 Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
1996 transports the wearer to another plane and, like the image it is inspired by, combines polar opposites, as the Northern hemisphere gives way to creamy orris and soft, slightly flirtatious violets. The soul of this fragrance is a warm, almost viscous black amber, its deep cognac rapture envelops the wearer and time stands still for just a moment until the journey concludes in the softly sensual leather and patchouli of the Orient.
Style: Woody, aromatic.
Notes:
- Top: juniper berries, black pepper.
- Middle: violet, leather accord, orris.
- Base: patchouli, black amber, vanilla.

name: BYREDO Accord Oud Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Byredo's Accord Oud presents a
striking set of olfactory opposites. The warm sweetness of blackberry
and boozy rum pair with a camphorous glow from patchouli. And saffron's
rounded softness is set against the sharp and smoky birch of a leather
accord. Powdery musks resolve and fill in some of these opposites, and
notes like clary sage complement the birch and patchouli.
A resinous, aromatic, fruity leather, Byredo's Accord Oud suggests that
oud is as much a mysterious set of olfactory characteristics — sweet,
medicinal, soft, and dark — as it is an actual perfume note.
Accord Oud  Notes
Blackberry, Saffron, Rum, Leather Accord, Clary Sage, Patchouli, Powdery Musks

name: Byredo Alto Astral Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Byredo Alto Astral is a bright, airy blend of coconut water, musk and incense.
Jérôme Epinette created it in 2025. Coconut water and aldehydes open fresh, musk, jasmine and incense form a soft heart, and cashmeran, sandalwood and amber give it a warm finish.
A daytime favorite from spring through fall.

name: BYREDO Animalique Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: The newest fragrance from Byredo, Animalique, is a luxurious scent meant for both men and women. Launched in 2023, the top notes of Bergamot and Lemon blend into the heart of Violet and Mimosa. The base is comprised of Suede, Tobacco Leaf and Amber for a truly alluring aroma.

name: BYREDO Bal D'Afrique Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
BYREDO Bal d'Afrique is a sunny, joyful floral built on citrus, violet and cedar.
Jérôme Epinette created it in 2009. Amalfi lemon, bergamot, black currant and African orange flower open bright and sparkling, violet, cyclamen and jasmine form a soft floral heart, and vetiver, amber, musk and cedar give it a gentle, woody finish.
Bal d'Afrique feels light-hearted and sunny, a little like a warm afternoon outdoors. It is a daytime favorite for spring and summer, easy to wear to the office or on weekends.

A mix of Parisian avantgardism and African culture shaped a unique and
vibrant expression. The intense life, the excess and euphoria is
illustrated by Bal d'Afrique's neroli, African marigold and Moroccan
cedarwood.
Style: Floral.
Notes:
- Top: bergamot, lemon, neroli, African marigold, bucchu.
- Middle: violet, jasmine petals, cyclamen.
- Base: black amber, musk, vetiver, Moroccan cedarwood.

name: Byredo Bal DAfrique Absolu Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Byredo Bal d'Afrique Absolu is a richer, warmer take on the sunny Bal d'Afrique.
Jérôme Epinette created it in 2025. Black currant, bergamot and lemon open bright and juicy, praline, musk and violet bring a soft, sweet heart, and black amber, cedarwood and vetiver give it a deeper, longer finish.
It keeps the joy of the original but adds body and warmth, so it works in every season, day or night.

name: BYREDO Baudelaire Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
The Scoop
“…A lazy isle to which nature has
given singular trees, savory fruits, men with bodies vigorous and
slender, and women in whose eyes shines a startling candor.”
The poet Charles Baudelaire, famously a lover of perfume and the
exoticism of faraway lands, was by turns cerebral, sensual, perverse,
and sentimental. Byredo's homage to the French dandy reflects this
mercurial nature with its multiple olfactory dimensions.
A gentle sweetness lies at the heart of Baudelaire, with
hyacinth warmed by amber and a touch of fruit. This sentimental center
gives way to the aromatics of caraway, patchouli, and juniper berries,
with their green whiff of the brisk outdoors. Baudelaire's base truly
provides a counterpoint to its initial warmth, the way that his poetry
often launches into philosophy: sensuality gives way to aridity, with a
dry, incense-y base of leather, patchouli and papyrus.
Earthy yet worldly, warm yet sophisticated, Baudelaire is as elegant as a dandy's walking stick.
Baudelaire  Notes
Juniper berry, Black pepper, Caraway, Incense, Hyacinth, Leather, Papyrus, Patchouli, Black amber

name: BYREDO Bibliotheque Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
BYREDO Bibliothèque is a soft, fruity leather that evokes an old library.
Launched in 2017, it opens with plum and peach. Violet and peony form a powdery heart, and leather, vanilla, patchouli and musk give it a warm finish.
Cozy for fall and winter days, the office and everyday wear.

Sheltered from the passage of time, libraries have the power to
teleport us to a world in suspension. The velvety quality of the paper
embodied in a touch of peach, plum and vanille, and the omnipresent
patchouli like a backbone that runs through the composition.
Style: Woody, aromatic.
Notes:
- Top: peach, plum.
- Middle: peony, violet.
- Base: leather, patchouli, vanilla

name: Byredo Black Saffron Absolu Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Black Saffron Absolu by Byredo is an Oriental Spicy scent designed for both women and men. Launched in 2025, this new fragrance features top notes of Saffron, Pomelo, and Juniper Berries. Its heart reveals a captivating blend of Leather, Rose, and Black Violet, while the base notes include Blonde Woods, Vetiver, and Raspberry.

name: BYREDO Black Saffron Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
BYREDO Black Saffron is a warm, fruity leather with saffron.
Launched in 2012, it opens with saffron, juniper berries and grapefruit. Leather and black violet form the heart, and raspberry, cashmeran and vetiver give it a smooth finish.
Versatile in spring, fall and winter, for the office and everyday.

At its heart lies black violet fused with a leather accord, the dark,
dry composition born aloft by the delicate transparency of cristal rose.
At the base, blonde woods add radiant warmth and harmony, punctuated by
staccatoed flashes of luscious raspberry. The journey concludes with
the gentle, earthy evocations of Haitian vetiver. Saffron is holy to all
Hindus. It is the color of Buddhist robes and has become a symbol for
India. It has always been a part of BYREDO's founder's Indian
upbringing, both in smell, taste and color. Black Saffron is a fragrance
inspired by the very idea of sublime unity.
Style: Oriental.
Notes:
- Top: pomelo, saffron, juniper berry.
- Middle: black violet, accord cuir, cristal rose.
- Base: blonde woods, raspberry, vetiver.

name: Byredo Blanche Absolu de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Byredo Blanche Absolu is a richer, creamier version of Blanche.
Launched in 2025, it opens with aldehydes, neroli and black pepper. Jasmine, violet and rose form a soft heart, and musk, ambroxan, cashmeran and cashmere wood give it a warm finish.
Clean and elegant in every season, day or night.

name: BYREDO Blanche Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
BYREDO Blanche is a crisp, clean floral that smells like fresh white linen.
Launched in 2009, it opens with aldehydes, rose and pink pepper. Peony, violet and orange flower form a soft heart, and musk, woods and sandalwood give it a pure, airy finish.
Effortless for spring and summer days, the office and everyday wear.

With this fragrance, Gorham wanted to capture the innocence and
untainted side of a specific person he had in mind with a scent that is
almost transparent. According to Gorham, this pure, simple eau de parfum
is structurally simple, yet its character is extreme.
Style: Floral.
Notes:
- Top: white rose, pink pepper, aldehyde.
- Middle: violet, neroli, peony.
- Base: blonde woods, sandalwood, musk.

notes.source_text: "Byredo's Deep Viola is a contemporary unisex scent that belongs to the Amber Floral olfactory family. It represents one of the brand's recent creations, having been introduced in the year 2020. The fragrance opens with a vibrant blend of top notes including the earthy green of Angelica, the rich warmth of Saffron, and the citrusy zest of Bergamot. At its heart, it features a harmony of floral and refined notes with Violet and Iris, accompanied by the bold character of Leather. The scent culminates in a deep, enchanting base where the resinous essence of Olibanum meets the exoticism of Agarwood (Oud) and the sweet, creamy undertones of Vanilla."

name: BYREDO Flowerhead Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Flowerhead is inspired by the traditional Indian wedding where flower heads are strung together on giant leis. Couples are often showered with petals by the groom’s brother for a spiritual protection and flowers are abundant. From the mandap wedding canopy, which is entirely covered in exotic blooms, to the spiritual pooja rooms and verandahs, the explosion of colour is wildly celebratory and the scent is overwhelming.
Top notes: Angelica seeds, Sicilian lemon, lingonberry
Middle notes: Jasmine sambac, tuberose, rose petals
Base notes: fresh amber and suede
Eau de Parfum

Gypsy Water by Byredo is a Woody Aromatic fragrance for women and men. Gypsy Water
was launched in 2008. Top notes are bergamot, lemon, pepper and
juniper; middle notes are incense, pine needles and orris root; base

name: BYREDO Inflorescence Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
To celebrate the beginning spring, nature's perennial and powerful
rebirth, perfumer Ben Gorham designed a floral scent that would capture
the strength and beauty of wild garden blossoms just as they reach their
dramatic peak. The result, the wonderfully entitled Inflorescence, is
an arcadian stroll through untamed bowers of full-blown, rambling roses,
interspersed by the intoxicating, honeyed notes of pink freesias in
their prime. Two of spring's very first flowers lie at the heart. The
creamy-soft allure of the magnolia blossom, its petals fully open about
to drop onto beds of quivering lily of the valley, or may bells in the
language of flowers, symbolic of a return to happiness and the joy
associated with the onset of spring. Finally and most unusually, Ben
Gorham has used jasmine at the base. Again luxuriant and overgrown, a
veritable riot of fresh sweetness that supports the structure and
furnishes a heady close.
Style: Floral.
Notes:
- Top: rose petals, pink freesia.
- Middle: magnolia, lily of the valley.
- Base: fresh jasmine.

name: BYREDO Mojave Ghost Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Byredo Mojave Ghost is a soft, airy floral inspired by the quiet beauty of the desert.
Launched in 2014, it opens with juicy sapodilla and ambrette. Magnolia, violet and sandalwood form a gentle, powdery heart, and ambergris and cedar leave a clean, woody trail.
Light and understated, it is a daytime favorite for spring and summer, the office and everyday wear.

Details & Care
What it is: A woody, aromatic perfume that pays homage to the bewitching Mojave Ghost flower.
Fragrance story:
In the xeric wilderness of the Mojave desert, trees and vegetation more
ancient than many civilizations defy conditions that prey on human
vulnerability. The ghost flower is a rare species that dares to blossom
above this baked, hard ground. Despite its arid surroundings and
inability to produce nectar, the ghost flower, or mohavea confertiflora,
maintains its perfect, majestic beauty and thrives year after year. In
an astonishing feat of ingenuity, the flower uses mimicry to attract the
pollinators of a neighboring plant species by developing markings that
resemble those of a female bee genus attracted to its subject and duping
the male bee into following suit. This moving human-like behavior and
captivating tale of survival lies in the foundation that inspired Mojave
Ghost, an homage to this most bewitching flower.
Style: Woody, aromatic.
Notes:
- Top: ambrette, Jamaican nesberry.
- Middle: violet, sandalwood, magnolia.
- Base: chantilly musk, crisp amber, cedarwood.
Made in France
