name: BYREDO Oud Immortel Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Oud Immortel by Byredo is a Woody Chypre fragrance for women and men. Oud Immortel
was launched in 2010. Top notes are Limoncello, Incense and Cardamom;
middle notes are Agarwood (Oud), Patchouli, Papyrus and Brazilian
Rosewood; base notes are oak moss and Tobacco.

name: BYREDO Palermo Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
In the ancient Mediterranean city of
Palermo, the regional capital of Sicily, the orange trees that Berber
and Moorish emirs planted long ago still grow. Their bergamot and
bigarade fruits light up Byredo's Palermo, a scent as close to olfactory
happiness as you can get, a perfume played in the highest, brightest
keys.
Palermo's citrus grove sits alongside a rose garden, its rose
bushes greened up in spring with the smell of crushed orange tree leaves
and sliced fruits: lemon, lime, grapefruit, and maybe even aromatic
pomelo. In its opening, an effervescent freshness of citrus juice is
layered with cut citrus rinds, their zest oils conveying a more intense
richness, bitterness, and spice.
During your walk in the garden, as the sun warms your skin, a
warm musk rises up, slightly powdery, softening the bracing freshness of
the hesperidic top notes of Palermo and helping the freshness to linger
with the warmth. This is a unisex fragrance perfect for warmer months.
Palermo  Notes
Sicilian bergamot, bigarade, fresh rose absolute, skin musk, ambrette flower

name: BYREDO Pulp Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Pulp is the epitome of ripe fruit,
bottled. Imagine that you have just bitten into the juiciest, ripest
plum, felt the snap of a crisp apple in your teeth, indulged in a
handful of berries ready to explode, all fresh from the fields and
orchards, the kiss of the sun still on them. Now put it all in your
mouth at the same time and you have the cacophony of fruit that is Pulp.
This is grown-up fruit: no sugar-coating, no syrup, just a tiny hint of
sweetness to bring out the nuances.
With a whiff of blossom
and a touch of bark, you can sense an olfactory arc of how the fruit
begins, grows, and ripens. Pulp will make you smile and feel a bit
giddy, because there is nothing else quite like it.
Pulp  Notes
Bergamot, cardamom, black currant, fig, red apple, tiara, cedar wood, praline, peach flower

name: BYREDO Reine de Nuit Extrait de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Night Veils perfume extract- When the last rays of sun have gone, the most intense fragrance is diffused. Jasmine, lily and rose: many flowers in a powerful sillage unveil their mysteries once night falls. Inspired by those hours impregnated with floral particles, the Night Veils collection by BYREDO offers a new perfume ritual.
TOP NOTES
Blackcurrant
Saffron
HEART NOTES
Incense
Rose
BASE NOTES
Ambrette see

name: BYREDO Rose Noir Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
An updated take on the classic symbol of love and devotion, this fragrance darkens the character of the traditional olfactory rose, the Damascene, making it potent and contemporary once again. Rose Noir becomes a decadent, dirty rose with intense and animalic quality.
Top notes: Grapefruit, freesia
Middle notes: Rose damascene
Base notes: Cistus, moss, musk
Eau de Parfum

name: Byredo Rose Of No Man's Land Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Byredo Rose of No Man's Land is a peppery, modern rose.
Launched in 2015, it opens with Turkish rose and pink pepper. Raspberry blossom and rose form the heart, and amber and papyrus give it a dry, woody finish.
Versatile for spring and fall days, from the office to date night.

Details & Care
What it is: A floral fragrance that opens with notes of pink pepper and Turkish rose petals.
Fragrance story:
A journey to a far away, desolate place, devoid of spirit and natural
beauty. Suddenly from the void appears a single rose, full of emotion
and life. This singular flower immediately provides strength, hope and
light. It transforms the bleak landscape to one of cherished beauty.
With top notes of spicy pink pepper and fresh rose petals this sensual
yet fresh fragrance is eternally optimistic. The balance of Turkish rose
with pink spice, red fruit and white amber lends a sophisticated
intensity that is captivating.
Style: Floral.
Notes:
- Top: pink pepper, Turkish rose petals.
- Middle: raspberry blossom, Turkish rose absolute.
- Base: papyrus, white amber.
Made in France

name: Byredo Rose of No Mans Land Absolu Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Byredo Rose of No Man's Land Absolu is a richer, fruitier version of the peppery rose.
Launched in 2025, it opens with black currant, pink pepper and saffron. Peony and raspberry form the heart, and black amber, patchouli and papyrus give it a warm finish.
Versatile in every season, day or night.

name: Byredo Rouge Chaotique 2025 Extrait de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Rouge Chaotique 2025 by Byredo is an Oriental Woody scent designed for both women and men. This fragrance, which debuted in 2025, features a top note of Cassis, a middle note of Oak, and base notes of Papyrus, Oud, and Patchouli.

name: BYREDO Rouge Chaotique Extrait de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Introducing Byredo's Rouge Chaotique, a brand-new Woody Spicy fragrance for both men and women, that was launched in 2023. This exhilaratingly unique scent features top notes of Saffron, Cassis, Bergamot and Lemon; followed by middle notes of Plum, Praline and Oak; before ending in a grounding blend of Agarwood (Oud), Papyrus and Patchouli.

name: BYREDO Sellier Extrait de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Woody and aromatic, Night Veils Sellier opens with notes of black tea
and cashmeran followed by a heart of leather accord and tobacco and a
base of oakmoss and birch tree.
Style: Woody, aromatic.
Notes:
- Top: black tea, cashmeran.
- Middle: leather accord, tobacco leaves.
- Base: oakmoss, birch tree.

name: BYREDO Seven Veils Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
The story behind the scent is based on the biblical tale about Salome's dance, that is known as "the dance of the Seven Veils".
The composition includes: carrot seed, pimento berries, Tahitian
vanilla flower, laurier rose, glycine, tiger orchid, sandalwood and
vanilla. Seven Veils was launched in 2011.

name: Byredo Sister Dreamer Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Sister Dreamer by Byredo is a unisex fragrance that combines floral, woody, and musky elements. Introduced in 2026, this fresh scent opens with vibrant top notes of pink pepper, juniper berry, and frankincense. The heart reveals a bouquet of Turkish rose, geranium, and freesia, while the base offers a warm blend of healing wood, amberwood, and sandalwood.

name: BYREDO Slow Dance Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
A top note of opoponax, or sweet myrrh, provides an immediate,
honeyed and smoky sensuality in a rich, intoxicating amber signature. A
heart of labdanum reinforces and encourages the scent to stay true with a
creamy softness, while geranium provides a sparkling freshness.
Swathing all is a veil of violet, a magical note that provides a
universal balance. A base of vanilla and patchouli anchors the scent,
utilizing the universal sweet appeal of vanilla against the mysterious
compulsion of patchouli, the known and unknown, the light and dark
together.
Style: Oriental.
Notes:
- Top: opoponax.
- Middle: geranium, labdanum, violet.
- Base: vanilla, patchouli.

name: BYREDO Sunday Cologne Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Byredo's Sunday Cologne, released in 2011, is a Woody Aromatic scent for both men and women. It has top notes of Bergamot, Star Anise and Cardamom, middle notes are of Lavender, Geranium, and Incense, and base notes of Vetiver, Oak Moss and Patchouli.

name: BYREDO Sundazed Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Say hello to endless summer. Sundazed, the newest scent from Byredo, is an infectiously joyful blend of bright citrus, sugared florals, and a sparkling skin musk that fans of Blanche already know and love. It's a love letter to spontaneous daytrips and wholesome indulgences- the citrus is zesty, mouthwatering, and energetic, the neroli heart rich, romantic, and made deliciously sweet with a sugared note of fresh-spun cotton candy. And it all dries down to a clean, soft musk that glows for hours with the gentle warmth of sun-kissed skin after a long day of outdoor adventures. And when we say "endless summer, " that's exactly what we mean- since Sundazed is now part of Byredo's permanent collection, you can experience this little slice of beachside bliss whenever you want. So whenever you need to change your mood- or keep the good times rolling- this is the one to reach for.
Sundazed Notes
Mandarin, lemon, neroli, jasmine sambac, cotton candy, skin musk

name: BYREDO Super Cedar Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
BYREDO Super Cedar is a soft, powdery cedar with a touch of rose.
Launched in 2016, it opens with rose, moves into a clean heart of Virginian cedar and settles into Haitian vetiver and musk for a calm, woody finish.
Easy to wear from spring through fall, every day.

Super Cedar by Byredo is a Woody Floral Musk fragrance for women and men. Super Cedar was launched in 2016. Top note is rose; middle note is virginian cedar; base notes are haitian vetiver and musk.

name: BYREDO Tobacco Mandarin Extrait de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Tobacco Mandarin by Byredo is a Oriental Woody fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Tobacco Mandarin
was launched in 2020. Top notes are Cumin, Mandarin Orange and
Coriander; middle notes are Tobacco, Labdanum and Leather; base notes
are Olibanum, Sandalwood and Agarwood (Oud).

name: BYREDO Unnamed Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Byredo by Byredo is a fragrance for women and men. Byredo was launched in 2016. The nose behind this fragrance is Jérôme Epinette. Top notes are Gin and Pink Pepper; middle notes are Violet and Orris Root; base notes are Balsam Fir and Oakmoss.

name: BYREDO Vanille Anitque Extrait de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Vanille Antique by Byredo is a Amber Woody fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Vanille Antique was launched in 2022. Top notes are Plum and Musk; middle notes are White Wood and Labdanum; base notes are Amber and Vanilla.

name: Byredo Vanille Antique 2025 Unisex

notes.source_text:
Byredo Vanille Antique is a deep, resinous vanilla with oud and tuberose.
Launched in 2025, it opens with freesia and plum. Amber, oud, cashmere wood and tuberose form a rich heart, and Madagascar vanilla and labdanum give it a warm, lasting finish.
Made for fall and winter nights.

name: BYREDO Velvet Haze Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Velvet Haze by Byredo is a Oriental Woody fragrance for women and men. Velvet Haze
was launched in 2017. The nose behind this fragrance is Jerome
Epinette. Top notes are Coconut, Hibiscus and Bergamot; middle notes are
Patchouli, Tuberose and Osmanthus; base notes are Patchouli, Musk,
Cacao Pod, Ambrette (Musk Mallow) and Cashmeran.

name: BYREDO Young Rose Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
BYREDO Young Rose is a soft, airy rose with a peppery twist.
Launched in 2021, it opens with ambrette and Sichuan pepper. Damask rose and iris form the heart, and ambroxan and musk give it a clean finish.
A daytime favorite for spring and summer.

Young Rose by Byredo is a Floral Woody Musk fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Young Rose was launched in 2021. Top notes are Ambrette (Musk Mallow) and Sichuan Pepper; middle notes are Damask Rose and iris; base notes are Ambroxan and Musk.

name: Calvin Klein CK One Shock For Him Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
One of the most successful fragrances from Calvin Klein is CK
One, the citrus unisex fragrance from 1994. CK One Shock is a surprise
for all the fans of CK One line. It is not an unisex edition, but two
separate oriental compositions: CK One Shock For Her and CK One Shock For Him.
CK One Shock For Him is built around aromatic, spicy and deep
oriental nuances. It opens with citrusy clementine, fresh cucumber and
energy drink accord. The heart of black pepper, black basil and cardamom
is placed on the base of masculine tobacco, musk, patchouli and ambrene
wood.

name: Calvin Klein Contradiction Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
Calvin Klein Contradiction is a Masculine fragrance, The fragrance launched in 1999, The nose behind this fragrance is Carlos Benaim, Pierre Wargnye,
Top Note: Lime, Lavender, Lemon, Clary Sage, Mandarin Orange
Heart Note: Cardamom, Pepper, Coriander, Nutmeg
Base Note: Vetiver, Musk, Sandalwood, Ebony Wood

name: Calvin Klein Defy Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text: Defy Eau de Parfum by Calvin Klein is a fragrance for men. This is a new fragrance. Defy Eau de Parfum was launched in 2022. The nose behind this fragrance is Pascal Gaurin. Top notes are Black Pepper and Mandarin Orange; middle notes are Suede and saffiano leather; base note is Haitian Vetiver.

name: Calvin Klein Defy Parfum for Men

notes.source_text: Calvin Klein's Defy Parfum is a fresh Woody Aromatic scent for men, which was released in 2023 by the perfume-maker Pascal Gaurin. This captivating cologne features top notes of Pink Pepper, middle notes of Lavender, and base notes of Cacao.

name: Calvin Klein Eternity Cologne for Him Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text: Eternity Cologne For Men by Calvin Klein is a Aromatic Fougere fragrance for men. This is a new fragrance. Eternity Cologne For Men was launched in 2020. Eternity Cologne For Men was created by Julie Masse, Ralf Schwieger and Veronique Nyberg. Top notes are ginger, aldehydes and juniper berries; middle notes are mastic or lentisque, bourbon geranium and cardamom; base notes are moss, ambroxan and lorenox.

name: Calvin Klein Eternity Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Sophisticated and profoundly masculine, Eternity Eau de Parfum for
men maintains a signature fougere essence while introducing a new modern
woody note to the composition. The iconic fougere signature is
re-interpreted with an alluring sage providing a crisp freshness while
the majestic cypress creates a masculine and sensual middle and the
suede accord unleashes an elegant and powerful woody trail.

name: Calvin Klein Eternity Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text: Eternity For Men by Calvin Klein, an Aromatic Fougere scent for men, was introduced to the world in 1990. The creator of this fragrance is Carlos Benaim, who designed the aroma to begin with Lavender, Lemon, Bergamot, and Mandarin Orange and be followed by Sage, Juniper Berries, Basil, Geranium, Coriander, Jasmine, Orange Blossom, Lily, and Lily-of-the-Valley as its middle notes. Finally, the base notes of Sandalwood, Vetiver, Musk, Brazilian Rosewood, and Amber complete the composition.

name: Calvin Klein Eternity Flame for Him Eau de Toilette for Men
Calvin Klein Eternity Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Eternity Parfum For Men by Calvin Klein is a fragrance for men. This is a new fragrance. Eternity Parfum For Men
was launched in 2022. Eternity Parfum For Men was created by Alberto
Morillas and Frank Voelkl. Top note is Lavender; middle note is Rum;
base note is Vanilla Absolute.

name: Calvin Klein Euphoria Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Exotic floral-fruity fragrance Euphoria was launched in 2005. The fragrance is luminous and luscious like fruits notes of which are captured in it. Euphoria
is mysterious and appealing like dark exotic flowers. It invites you to
enjoy in joys of life. The main notes are rose hip, Japanese apple,
green leaves, Lotus, black orchid, red woods, black violet and amber

name: Carner Barcelona Ambar Del Sur Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Ambar Del Sur by Carner Barcelona is a fragrance for women and men. Ambar Del Sur was launched in 2018. Top note is Bergamot; middle notes are Amber, Indonesian Patchouli Leaf, Australian Sandalwood and Water Jasmine; base notes are Myrrh, Madagascar Vanilla, Tonka Bean and Spanish Labdanum.

name: Carner Barcelona Besos Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Besos by Carner Barcelona is a Floral fragrance for women and men. Besos was launched in 2017. The nose behind this fragrance is Shyamala Maisondieu. Top notes are Italian Mandarin and Madagascar Pepper; middle notes are iris and Jasmine Sambac; base notes are Musk, Benzoin and Vanilla.

name: Carner Barcelona Bestium Extrait de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Bestium by Carner Barcelona is a Amber Woody fragrance for women and men. Bestium was launched in 2020. Top notes are Turkish Rose, Bulgarian Rose, Saffron and Bergamot; middle notes are Chinese Osmanthus, Indonesian Patchouli Leaf and Incense; base notes are Agarwood (Oud), Spanish Labdanum and Incense.

name: Carner Barcelona Black Calamus Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Black Calamus by Carner Barcelona is a Aromatic Spicy fragrance for women and men. Black Calamus was launched in 2016. Top notes are Calamus, Papyrus, Black Pepper and Coriander; middle notes are Labdanum, Spanish Labdanum, Turkish Rose and Osmanthus; base notes are Agarwood (Oud), Incense, Juniper and Mexican Vanilla.

name: Carner Barcelona Botafumeiro Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Botafumeiro by Carner Barcelona is a fragrance for women and men. Botafumeiro was launched in 2018. Top notes are Indonesian Nutmeg, Pink Pepper and Bergamot; middle notes are Spanish Labdanum, Indonesian Patchouli Leaf, Freesia and Lily-of-the-Valley; base notes are Incense, Styrax and Musk.

name: Carner Barcelona Costarela Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Costarela by Carner Barcelona is a Citrus Aromatic fragrance for women and men. Costarela was launched in 2016. The nose behind this fragrance is Shyamala Maisondieu. Top notes are Bergamot and Saffron; middle notes are Sea Notes and Sand; base notes are Ambroxan, Virginia Cedar and Amber.

name: Carner Barcelona Danzatoria Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Danzatoria by Carner Barcelona is a Amber Floral fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Danzatoria was launched in 2020. Top notes are Ylang-Ylang, Pink Pepper and Pimento; middle notes are Orange Blossom, Jasmine Sambac and Lily-of-the-Valley; base notes are Madagascar Vanilla, Musk and Patchouli.

name: Carner Barcelona Felino Extrait de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Carner Barcelona's Felino is a unisex Amber Floral fragrance released in 2020. Its opening notes of Absinthe, Hazelnut and Bergamot give way to a heart of Leather, Clove, Jasmine and Ylang-Ylang, before its woody, sweet base of Myrrh, Opoponax, Civet, Styrax and Vanilla complete the scent.

name: Carner Barcelona Latin Lover Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Latin Lover by Carner Barcelona is a Floral fragrance for women and men. Latin Lover was launched in 2017. The nose behind this fragrance is Jórdi Fernandez. Top notes are Magnolia, Ylang-Ylang and Bergamot; middle notes are Jasmine Sambac, Lily-of-the-Valley, Violet and French Narcissus; base notes are White Musk, Benzoin and Indonesian Patchouli Leaf.

name: Carner Barcelona Megalium Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Megalium by Carner Barcelona is a Amber Floral fragrance for women and men. Megalium was launched in 2018. Top notes are Cinnamon, Cinnamon Leaf, Calamus and Mandarin Orange; middle notes are Nutmeg, Pimento, White Pepper and Bulgarian Rose; base notes are Myrrh, Olibanum, Opoponax and Styrax.

name: Carner Barcelona Rose & Dragon Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Rose & Dragon by Carner Barcelona is a Amber Floral fragrance for women and men. Rose & Dragon was launched in 2016. Top notes are Wild Strawberry, Saffron, Cumin and Cinnamon; middle notes are Bulgarian Rose, Turkish Rose, Honey and Incense; base notes are Leather, Labdanum, Castoreum and Amber.

name: Carner Barcelona Sweet William Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Sweet William by Carner Barcelona is a Floral fragrance for women and men. Sweet William was launched in 2017. The nose behind this fragrance is Rodrigo Flores-Roux. Top notes are White Pepper, Chinese Cinnamon Wood, Cardamom and Galanga; middle notes are Ylang-Ylang, Tobacco blossom, Rose Water and Fringed Pink; base notes are Tuscan Iris, Vanilla Absolute, Styrax and Ambrarome.

name: Carner Barcelona Tardes Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text: Tardes by Carner Barcelona is a Floral Woody Musk fragrance for women. Tardes was launched in 2010. The nose behind this fragrance is Daniela (Roche) Andrier. Top notes are Almond, Brazilian Rosewood, Rose and Geranium; middle notes are Plum, Virginia Cedar and Celery; base notes are Heliotrope, Tonka Bean and Musk.

name: Carolina Herrera 212 Heroes Forever Young Eau de Toilette For Men

top: Ginger are heightened by Lemon Haze Cannabis
key: Ginger are heightened by Lemon Haze Cannabis
notes.source_text:
212 Heroes by Carolina Herrera is a Aromatic Fruity fragrance for men. This is a new fragrance. 212 Heroes was launched in 2021. 212 Heroes was created by Domitille Michalon Bertier, Juliette Karagueuzoglou and Carlos Benaim. Top notes are Pear and Ginger; middle notes are Geranium and Sage; base notes are Musk and Leather.
"Feel forever young with 212 Heroes, a fresh new masculine scent that celebrates youth, freedom and authenticity. Contained inside a striking skateboard-shaped bottle and represented by a diverse cast of talented creatives, this innovative, vegan fragrance is proof that nothing is more heroic than being authentic.
212 Heroes reinvents Fougères with a new olfactive genre: Fougère Fruity Woody. Youthful top notes as Pear Elixir and Ginger. The heart features an innovative, fresh accord of Geranium Oil Madagascar, leading to a leathery and woody base.
A revolutionary fragrance calls for a revolutionary bottle. 212 Heroes opens a new chapter in industrial design with an innovative glass and chrome bottle that evokes the silhouette of a skateboard and captures the spirit of a new generation." - a note from the brand.

212 Heroes by Carolina Herrera is a Aromatic Fruity fragrance for men. This is a new fragrance. 212 Heroes was launched in 2021. 212 Heroes was created by Domitille Michalon Bertier, Juliette Karagueuzoglou and Carlos Benaim. Top notes are Pear, cannabis and Ginger; middle notes are Geranium and Sage; base notes are Musk and Leather.
"Feel forever young with 212 Heroes, a fresh new masculine scent that celebrates youth, freedom and authenticity. Contained inside a striking skateboard-shaped bottle and represented by a diverse cast of talented creatives, this innovative, vegan fragrance is proof that nothing is more heroic than being authentic.
212 Heroes reinvents Fougères with a new olfactive genre: Fougère Fruity Woody. Youthful top notes of Pear Elixir and Ginger are heightened by Lemon Haze Cannabis. The heart features an innovative, fresh accord of Geranium Oil Madagascar, leading to a leathery and woody base.
A revolutionary fragrance calls for a revolutionary bottle. 212 Heroes opens a new chapter in industrial design with an innovative glass and chrome bottle that evokes the silhouette of a skateboard and captures the spirit of a new generation." - a note from the brand.

name: Carolina Herrera 212 Men Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
Carolina Herrera presents a whole new 212 just for men. In a boldly
masculine silver container, this innovative woodsy scent compliments and
intertwines with 212 for women. With the personality of sandalwood, the
spirit of incense and the sensuality of gaiac, its character of cool
gardenia is balanced by warm spices. It's subtle and unique.

name: Carolina Herrera 212 Men Surf Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
Inspired by vacation and fun on the water, Carolina Herrera in collaboration with the house of Puig is launching fragrant pair 212 Surf: CAROLINA HERRERA 212 SURF FOR HER and CAROLINA HERRERA 212 SURF FOR HIM.
The limited fragrant duo will provide two new compositions inspired by
sea aromas, excitement and summer companionship, dedicated to younger
population. The line is described as 'fresh, youthful and carefree, a
collection that retells a fun, characteristic story inspired by summer
memories'.
The edition for men provides aromatic marine aromas mixing with
sparkling grapefruit and patchouli. The editions are announced as very
optimistic, lively and addictive.

name: Carolina Herrera 212 Sexy Men Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
212
Sexy Men is a sensual fragrance for the modern man. Its lingering scent
exudes the mystery and sophistication of mythical New York City nights.
Weaving notes of fresh citrus, spicy sensuality, and woody orientals,
the scent emits a sensation of solidity, strength, and quality that can
be worn for any occasion.
Notes:
Bergamot, Mandarin, Green Leaf, Cardamom, Flower Petals, Pepper, Sandalwood, Vanilla, Musk, Amber
Style:
Sensual. Oriental. Fresh.

name: Carolina Herrera 212 VIP Black Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text: 212 VIP Black by Carolina Herrera is a Aromatic Fougere fragrance for men. 212 VIP Black was launched in 2017. 212 VIP Black was created by Carlos Benaim and Anne Flipo. Top notes are Absinthe, Anise and Fennel; middle note is Lavender; base notes are Black Vanilla Husk and Musk.

name: Carolina Herrera 212 VIP Black Elixir For Men

notes.source_text: 212 VIP Black Elixir by Carolina Herrera is a captivating Oriental Fougere fragrance designed for men. Newly introduced in 2025, this scent features a top note of Lavender, a heart of Black Licorice, and a rich base of Vanilla.

name: Carolina Herrera 212 VIP Black Extra Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
212 VIP Black Extra is announced as an intense and fierce
fragrance to be worn at night parties. Accords of Rum&Cola with
citruses are combined with black leather, moss, and sensual cacao and
musk notes.
"Why blend in when you can be EXTRA? An explosion of spectacular, 212 VIP Black Extra parades your inner superstar. Basics join the party, Extras own the party."

name: Carolina Herrera 212 VIP Black I Love NY Edition Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text: This classic Aromatic Fougere scent for men, 212 VIP Black, was launched in 2017 by the esteemed Carolina Herrera. Its unique formulation was conceived by the noses Carlos Benaim and Anne Flipo, and features notes of Absinthe, Anise, Fennel, Lavender, Black Vanilla Husk, and Musk.

name: Carolina Herrera 212 VIP Men Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
Signature scent that you will recognize on the dance floor and won't
forget once you leave the party. 212 VIP Men is an explosive cocktail
of vodka, caviar lime, frozen mint, black pepper, hot ginger, apple,
king wood, salty amber and tonka beans.

name: Carolina Herrera 212 VIP Men Party Fever Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
12 Party
Fever For Men by Carolina Herrera, 212 Party Fever for men was launched
in 2018 and is fresh and spicy that is a lovely warm weather, perfect
for a night out on the town spent partying with friends. It opens with
the top notes of bittersweet tamarind, citrus notes, crisp red apple,
refreshing juniper berries, and spicy ginger. It then transitions to the
intriguing middle notes of nutty cannabis, peppery freesia, and light
geranium. The base notes add a touch of warmth and contain hints of
exotic tonka bean, earthy musk, woody cedar, smoky vetiver, and
olibanum.

name: Carolina Herrera 212 VIP Red Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text: VIP Black Red by Carolina Herrera is a Woody Spicy fragrance for men. This is a new fragrance. VIP Black Red was launched in 2020. Top notes are Allspice, Cardamom and Ginger; middle note is Absinthe; base notes are Leather and Guaiac Wood.

name: Carolina Herrera 212 VIP Rosé Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text: 212 VIP Rose by Carolina Herrera is a Floral Fruity fragrance crafted for women, introduced in 2014. Created by perfumer Lucas Sieuzac, this scent opens with notes of Champagne Rose and Pink Pepper, unfolds with heart notes of Peach Blossom and Rose, and finishes with a base of White Musk and Woody Notes.

name: Carolina Herrera 212 VIP Wins Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text: 212 VIP Men Wins by Carolina Herrera is a Aromatic Fougere fragrance for men. This is a new fragrance. 212 VIP Men Wins was launched in 2021. 212 VIP Men Wins was created by Juliette Karagueuzoglou and Carlos Benaim. Top notes are Yuzu, Basil and Mandarin Orange; middle notes are Lavender and Madagascar Pepper; base notes are Skin and Tonka Bean.

name: Carolina Herrera 212 Women Eau de Toilette for Women

notes.source_text: 212 by Carolina Herrera is a Floral Woody Musk fragrance for women. 212 was launched in 1997. The nose behind this fragrance is Alberto Morillas. Top notes are Orange Blossom, Cactus Flower, Bergamot and Mandarin Orange; middle notes are Lily, Freesia, Gardenia, Jasmine, White Camelia, Lily-of-the-Valley, Rose and Peony; base notes are Musk and Sandalwood.

name: Carolina Herrera Alegria de Vivir Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text: Alegria de Vivir by Carolina Herrera is a Floral Woody Musk fragrance for women. This is a new fragrance. Alegria de Vivir was launched in 2022. The nose behind this fragrance is Alexandra Monet. Top notes are Litchi and Mandarin Orange; middle notes are Peony, Cedar and Rose; base notes are Steam accord and Rice.

name: Carolina Herrera Amber Desire Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Amber Desire by Carolina Herrera is a Amber fragrance for women and men. Amber Desire was launched in 2015. The nose behind this fragrance is Anne Flipo.

name: Carolina Herrera Amethyst Haze Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Amethyst Haze by Carolina Herrera is a Woody Spicy fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Amethyst Haze was launched in 2021. Amethyst Haze was created by Véronique Nyberg and Alex Lee. Top notes are Cardamom and Pink Pepper; middle notes are Coffee and Lavender; base notes are Bourbon Vanilla, Cashmere Wood and Patchouli.

name: Carolina Herrera Bad Boy Cobalt Absolute Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text: Bad Boy Cobalt Absolute, created by Carolina Herrera, is an Oriental Woody fragrance designed for men. Launched in 2025, this new scent features top notes of Blue Lavender, Blue Sage, and elemi. The heart of the fragrance comprises Truffle, Oud, and Geranium, while the base is enriched with Oak, Vanilla, and Vetiver.

name: Carolina Herrera Bad Boy Cobalt Eau de Parfum Electrique for Men

notes.source_text:
Carolina Herrera Bad Boy Cobalt Électrique is a fresh, earthy blend of lavender and plum.
Domitille Michalon-Bertier created it in 2022. Lavender and pink pepper open fresh, plum and geranium form the heart, and truffle, vetiver, cedar and oak give it a woody finish.
Versatile from spring through fall, day or night.

Bad Boy Cobalt Parfum Electrique by Carolina Herrera is a Woody Aromatic fragrance for men. This is a new fragrance. Bad Boy Cobalt Parfum Electrique was launched in 2022. The nose behind this fragrance is Domitille Michalon Bertier. Top notes are Lavender and Pink Pepper; middle notes are Plum and Geranium; base notes are Truffle, Vetiver, Cedar and Oak.

name: Carolina Herrera Bad Boy Cobalt Elixir for Men

notes.source_text: Carolina Herrera introduces Bad Boy Cobalt Elixir, an alluring new scent for men, which debuted in 2024. The fragrance begins with a vibrant blend of Black Pepper and Sage at the top. Its heart is a sophisticated mix featuring the rich, earthy aroma of Truffle, accompanied by the essence of Woodsy Notes. Anchoring the fragrance, the base reveals a warm and inviting combination of Vanilla and Frankincense.

name: Carolina Herrera Bad Boy Dazzling Garden for Men

notes.source_text: Carolina Herrera's Bad Boy Dazzling Garden is a brand-new fragrance designed specifically for men. Launched in 2023, this fragrance is composed of top notes of White Pepper, Black Pepper and Bergamot; middle notes of Sage and Cedarwood; and base notes of Cacao, Tonka Bean and Amber.

name: Carolina Herrera Bad Boy Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
Bad Boy is a fragrant expression of duality, representing the bold nature of the modern man. At once strong and sensitive, confident and relaxed, the bad boy embraces his contrasting characteristics with assured ease. Bad Boy Eau de Toilette is a fragrance of layered notes inspired by the bad boy's complexity and harmoniously combined for a distinctive blend of modern sophistication. Bad Boy represents the rebellious men who chart their own path and design their own principles. A complex journey for the senses, Bad Boy opens with alluring notes of black and white pepper, blended with the citric vibrancy of Italian green bergamot. Characteristics of duality continue at the fragrance heart, where cedarwood and sage bring a magnetic elegance. The true secret lies in the base of the scent, with a sensual blend of tonka bean and absolut of cocoa, resulting in a fragrance of refined masculinity with a hint of edge.
Top Notes: Black Pepper, White Pepper, Italian Green Bergamot
Middle Notes: Cedarwood, Sage
Bottom Notes: Tonka Bean, Absolut of Cocoa
Mood: Bold & Sophisticated

name: Carolina Herrera Bad Boy Elixir Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text: Bad Boy Elixir by Carolina Herrera is an Oriental Woody scent crafted for men. This is a recent addition to their fragrance line, having been introduced in 2025. The fragrance opens with a top note of sage, transitions to a heart of leather, and is grounded by a base note of cedarwood.

name: Carolina Herrera Bad Boy Extreme Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text: Bad Boy Extreme by Carolina Herrera is a Amber fragrance for men. This is a new fragrance. Bad Boy Extreme was launched in 2022. Bad Boy Extreme was created by Quentin Bisch, Louise Turner and Yann Vasnier.

name: Carolina Herrera Bad Boy Gold Fantasy Limited Edition Eau de Toilette

notes.source_text: Bad Boy Gold Fantasy by Carolina Herrera is a Amber Woody fragrance for men. This is a new fragrance. Bad Boy Gold Fantasy was launched in 2022. The nose behind this fragrance is Quentin Bisch. Top note is Lava; middle note is White Pepper; base notes are Tonka Bean and Rose.

name: Carolina Herrera Bad Boy Le Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Bad Boy Le Parfum by Carolina Herrera is a Leather fragrance for men. This is a new fragrance. Bad Boy Le Parfum
was launched in 2021. Bad Boy Le Parfum was created by Fanny Bal, Bruno
Jovanovic and Nicolas Beaulieu. Top notes are cannabis and Grapefruit;
middle notes are Black Pepper and Geranium; base notes are Vetiver and
Leather.

name: Carolina Herrera Bad Boy Sparkling Ice Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text: Bad Boy Sparkling Ice by Carolina Herrera is a fresh addition to the world of men's fragrances, characterized by its Woody Aromatic scent profile. Released in 2024, this innovative fragrance opens with the invigorating top notes of Grapefruit and White Pepper. At its heart, you'll find the earthy and sophisticated blend of Clary Sage and Vetiver. The scent concludes with rich base notes of Cocoa and Tonka Bean.

name: Carolina Herrera Bad Boy Superstar Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text: Bad Boy Superstar Collector's Edition by Carolina Herrera is a Aromatic fragrance for men. This is a new fragrance. Bad Boy Superstar Collector's Edition was launched in 2021.

name: Carolina Herrera Blond Jasmine Eau de Toilette Unisex

notes.source_text: Blond Jasmine by Carolina Herrera is a Floral fragrance for women and men. Blond Jasmine was launched in 2017. Top notes are Jasmine, Citron and Mandarin Orange; middle notes are Jasmine Sambac and Jasmine; base notes are Vetiver and White Musk.

name: Carolina Herrera Burning Rose Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Burning Rose encapsulates elegance amidst adversity. This scent evokes a reminiscent aura of New York City's groundbreaking era during the 70s and 80s, a period marked by cultural shifts and bold innovations in the realm of pop culture and beyond. Merging the quintessential qualities of charm, sophistication, and allure, Burning Rose creates a fragrance that embodies the essence of grace and style.

name: Carolina Herrera Call Me Darling Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text: Call Me Darling by Carolina Herrera is a Floral fragrance for women. This is a new fragrance. Call Me Darling was launched in 2022. The nose behind this fragrance is Sonia Constant. Top note is Cherry Milk; middle note is Orange Blossom; base note is Tonka Bean.

name: Carolina Herrera Carolina Herrera Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text: Carolina Herrera by Carolina Herrera by Carolina Herrera is a Floral fragrance for women. Carolina Herrera by Carolina Herrera was launched in 1988. Carolina Herrera by Carolina Herrera was created by Carlos Benaim, Clement Gavarry and Rosendo Mateu. Top notes are Apricot, Orange Blossom, Green Notes, Brazilian Rosewood and Bergamot; middle notes are Indian Tuberose, Jasmine, Spanish Jasmine, Ylang-Ylang, Honeysuckle, Narcissus, Hiacynth and Lily-of-the-Valley; base notes are Civet, Musk, Oakmoss, Amber, Sandalwood, Vetiver and Cedar.

name: Carolina Herrera CH Beasts Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
CH Beasts by Carolina Herrera is an Amber Spicy fragrance designed for men, introduced in 2020. The scent opens with top notes of Juniper Berries, Angelica, and Black Pepper, while the heart reveals refreshing Watery Notes, Balsam Fir, and Violet Leaf. The fragrance concludes with a base of Cashmere Wood, Madagascar Vanilla, and Labdanum.

Enjoy CH Beasts, the new limited edition fragrance by
Carolina Herrera. In this universe of color and elegance, women, and men
come together in a utopia that rises from the lushest vegetation.
?
Top Notes:
Spicy: Black Pepper, Angelica Roots & Juniper Berries
Heart Notes :
Watery / Green Balsam: Aquatic Accord, Violet Leaves & Fir Balsam
Bottom Notes :
Woody / Oriental: Cashmeran Wood, Madagascar Vanilla & Ciste Labdanum

name: Carolina Herrera CH Eau de Toilette for Women

notes.source_text: CH by Carolina Herrera is a Amber Floral fragrance for women. CH was launched in 2007. CH was created by Olivier Cresp and Rosendo Mateu. Top notes are Tropical fruit, Bergamot, Grapefruit, Amalfi Lemon and Water Notes; middle notes are Praline, Cinnamon, African Orange Flower, Jasmine and tincture of rose; base notes are Suede, Patchouli, Cashmere Wood, Sandalwood, Musk, Virginia Cedar and Amber.

name: Carolina Herrera CH Hot! Hot! Hot! Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text: CH Hot! Hot! Hot! by Carolina Herrera is a new fragrance specifically designed for women. It was launched in 2022 and created by Veronique Nyberg and Violaine Collas. The scent is a mix of top notes such as Neroli, Grapefruit and Aloe Vera; middle notes include Ylang-Ylang, Raspberry and Coconut; while base notes consist of Vanilla, Sandalwood and Myrhh.

name: Carolina Herrera CH Kings Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
CH Kings by Carolina Herrera is a Aromatic Spicy fragrance for men. This is a new fragrance. CH Kings
was launched in 2019. Top notes are pink pepper, black pepper, cardamom
and violet; middle notes are pineapple, lavender, clary sage, cacao and
coffee; base notes are tonka bean, amber and musk.

notes.source_text: CH Carolina Herrera (New) was introduced in 2009 as a men's cologne that simultaneously emphasizes rich elegance with a dash of eccentricity. Offering a perfect solution for evening wear needs, this enticing cologne from Carolina Herrera features distinctive top notes of bergamot and grapefruit and familiar base notes such as vanilla and amber. Heart notes of jasmine and violet make this cologne a must-have pick for men who aim to cultivate their personal style.

name: Carolina Herrera CH Men Hot! Hot! Hot! Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text: Carolina Herrera presents a new fragrance for men, CH Men Hot! Hot! Hot!, which was launched in 2022. Created by perfumer Emilie Bevierre-Coppermann, the scent opens with scintillating top notes of Grapefruit, Rhubarb Leaf and Violet Leaf, followed by Sichuan Pepper and Angelica in the middle, and settling into leathery, woody base notes of Sandalwood and Madagascar Vetiver.

notes.source_text: Ch Sport Cologne by Carolina Herrera, Show your appreciation for the great outdoors with CH Sport, an invigorating men’s cologne . This captivating fragrance combines citrus, herbal and marine accords for a refreshing and exuberant scent that’s still entirely masculine and seductive. Top notes of sparkling bergamot, grapefruit and potent sage introduce the fragrance for a revitalizing and zesty atmosphere that’s sure to fire you up for the next great adventure. Meanwhile, heart notes of Sichuan pepper, clean juniper berries and sea notes expand the elixir with their exotic, botanical nature. Finally, base notes of vetiver, oakmoss and sandalwood dry down the intensity with a soothing touch for an all-around spirited and charming cologne that’s perfect for any sports enthusiast with a young heart of gold

name: Carolina Herrera CH Men Under The Sea Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text: Carolina Herrera introduces a new Woody Aromatic scent for men, CH Men Under The Sea, released in 2021. This fragrance opens with Juniper and Angelica, and develops into a heart of Sea Notes and Violet Leaf, all lying on a warm base of Cashmeran and Vanilla.

name: Carolina Herrera CH Pasion Eau de Parfum for Men

top: a hint of zesty Pink Pepper
key: a hint of zesty Pink Pepper
notes.source_text: CH Pasión for Him by Carolina Herrera embodies a bold Amber Woody scent crafted for the modern man. This freshly introduced cologne made its debut in the fragrance world in 2023. The creative minds behind its unique aroma are perfumers Antoine Maisondieu and Christophe Raynaud. The olfactory journey of CH Pasión for Him begins with invigorating top notes of aromatic Olibanum, vibrant Tunisian Neroli, and a hint of zesty Pink Pepper. As the scent evolves, the heart reveals a harmonious blend of elegant Iris, the warm, balsamic essence of Myrrh, and the woody tones of Texas Cedar. The fragrance gracefully settles into a rich and sensual base of smooth Australian Sandalwood, indulgent Bourbon Vanilla, delightful Tonka Bean, coupled with the deep resonance of Amberwood and mysterious dark woods.

name: Carolina Herrera CH Pasion Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text: Carolina Herrera introduces a fresh addition to their collection with CH Pasión for Her, a captivating Amber Floral scent crafted for the modern woman. This latest perfume, unveiled in 2023, is the brainchild of perfumers Quentin Bisch and Nisrine Bouazzaoui Grillié. It starts with a harmonious blend of Pear, Bergamot, and Violet Leaf at the top, transitioning into a heart composed of exotic Madagascar Pepper, refined Haitian Vetiver, alluring Jasmine Sambac, and the floral touch of Petalia. The fragrance settles on a rich foundation that fuses the creamy sweetness of Vanilla and Vanillin with the deep notes of Leather and Musk, creating an enchanting trail that lingers.

name: Carolina Herrera CH Prive Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
CH Men Prive, crafted by Carolina Herrera, is a sophisticated leather fragrance designed for men. Launched in 2015, this scent opens with vibrant notes of Whiskey, Grapefruit, and Pomelo. The heart of the fragrance features an intriguing blend of Cardamom, Lavender, Sage, and Red Thyme, while the base is composed of rich Leather, Tonka Bean, Benzoin, and warm Woody Notes.

Ch Prive Cologne by Carolina Herrera, Step into a world of classic elegance and refinement with CH Prive, a daring men’s cologne
. This intoxicating
fragrance blends citrus, herbal and musky accords for a seductive and
aromatic scent that will instantly draw attention. Top notes of tart
grapefruit, pomelo and savory whiskey open the cologne with a sharp
energy that quickly awakens the senses. Middle notes of cardamom seed,
red thyme, sage and cooling lavender lend a soothing and earthy vibe
that’s robust, pure and sophisticated. Finally, base notes of tonka
bean, benzoin and various woody tones balance the aroma only to be
further enhanced by the inclusion of fine, masculine leather. Overall,
this intoxicating fragrance is sure to please, perfect for a late night
rendezvous out on the town.
This majestic scent, released in
2015, is a dignified fragrance from the innovative fashion house of
Carolina Herrera. Established in 1980, the brand has expanded from
simple clothing into accessories, home goods and designer fragrances.

name: Carolina Herrera CH Privée Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text: CH Privee by Carolina Herrera is a luxurious leather fragrance designed for women. It was introduced in 2017 and created by renowned perfumer Dominique Ropion.

name: Carolina Herrera Chic Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text: Chic is light, but elegant, coloured in red, of course, because this colour is very feminine; it is not virgin-like, but passionate. The real chic lies in constrasts: when the simple becomes complicated, because it encourages thinking and has a magical, influential power. For this purpose the simple and magical red colour was chosen, the shape of the bottle is simple, and the fragrance itself is a perfect balance between freshness and graceful sensuality. The top notes include Bulgarian rose and red freesia, the middle ones mandarin blossom and orange; the base voluptuous vanilla and white musk. Chic was created by Alberto Morillas and Jacques Cavallier.

name: Carolina Herrera Fearless & Fabulous Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text: Fearless and Fabulous by Carolina Herrera is a Floral Fruity fragrance for women. This is a new fragrance. Fearless and Fabulous was launched in 2022. Fearless and Fabulous was created by Fanny Bal and Julien Rasquinet. Top notes are Pear and Pink Pepper; middle note is Gardenia; base notes are Cashmere Wood and Patchouli.

name: Carolina Herrera Flore Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text: Flore by Carolina Herrera is a Floral fragrance for women. Flore was launched in 1994. Flore was created by Rosendo Mateu and Carlos Benaim. Top notes are Green Notes, Aldehydes, Fruity Notes and Bergamot; middle notes are Lily-of-the-Valley, Jasmine, Lilac, iris and Rose; base notes are iris, Musk, Woodsy Notes and Sandalwood.

name: Carolina Herrera Gold Incense Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Gold Incense by Carolina Herrera is a Amber fragrance for women and men. Gold Incense was launched in 2017. The nose behind this fragrance is Pierre-Constantin Guéros. Top notes are Cinnamon, Marigold, Angelica and Bergamot; middle notes are Labdanum and Atlas Cedar; base notes are Incense, Madagascar Vanilla and Sandalwood.

name: Carolina Herrera Gold Myrrh Absolute Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Gold Myrrh Absolute by Carolina Herrera is a Amber fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Gold Myrrh Absolute was launched in 2021. Gold Myrrh Absolute was created by Alex Lee and Veronique Nyberg. Top notes are Black Pepper and Immortelle; middle notes are Cacao Pod and Licorice; base notes are Vanilla and Myrrh.

name: Carolina Herrera Good Girl Blush Bowtastic Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text: Introducing the Good Girl Blush Bowtastic Edition by Carolina Herrera, a delightful Floral Fruity Gourmand fragrance designed for women. This fresh scent made its debut in 2025 and is a collaborative creation by perfumers Quentin Bisch, Christophe Raynaud, and Shyamala Maisondieu. The fragrance opens with vibrant notes of Bitter Almond, Bergamot, and Mandarin, transitions into a heart of Peony, Ylang-Ylang, and Rose Water, and concludes with a warm base of Tonka and Vanilla.

name: Carolina Herrera Good Girl Blush Crystal Class Eau de Parfum for Women
tags: Good Girl Blush Crystal Class Collector s Edition

notes.source_text: The Good Girl Blush Crystal Class Collector's Edition by Carolina Herrera is an Oriental Floral fragrance designed for women, debuting in 2026. This new scent has been crafted by perfumers Shyamala Maisondieu, Quentin Bisch, and Christophe Raynaud. It opens with top notes of Bitter Almond, Bergamot, and Mandarin, transitioning into a heart of Peony, Rose, and Ylang-Ylang, before settling into a warm base of Tonka Bean and Vanilla.

name: Carolina Herrera Good Girl Blush Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Carolina Herrera Good Girl Blush is a soft, sweet blend of peony and vanilla.
Shyamala Maisondieu, Christophe Raynaud and Quentin Bisch created it in 2023. Bergamot and bitter almond open fresh, peony and ylang-ylang form the heart, and coumarin and vanilla give it a warm finish.
A daytime favorite for spring and summer.

name: Carolina Herrera Good Girl Blush Elixir Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text: Carolina Herrera introduces Good Girl Blush Elixir Eau de Parfum, a captivating new fragrance for women. Launched in 2024, this scent opens with refreshing top notes of Bergamot and Mandarin Orange. The heart of the fragrance blooms with alluring Ylang Ylang and Rose, while a warm base of Vanilla and Patchouli rounds out this exquisite perfume.

notes.source_text: Good Girl Colormania by Carolina Herrera is a Floral Fruity Gourmand fragrance designed for women. Newly introduced in 2024, this captivating scent features Almond as its top note, complemented by middle notes of Tuberose and Jasmine Sambac. The fragrance is anchored by a rich base of Cacao and Tonka Bean.

This fragrance, which debuted in 2026, is the creation of perfumer Louise Turner. Its composition opens with vibrant top notes of Bergamot, Almond, Coffee, and Lemon. The heart of the fragrance features a captivating blend of Orange Blossom, Tuberose, Cinnamon, Jasmine, Praline, and Rose. Finally, the scent settles into a rich base of Sandalwood, Tonka Bean, Patchouli, Cashmeran, Cedarwood, Amber, Cocoa, and Musk.

name: Carolina Herrera Good Girl Dazzling Garden Eau de Parfum

notes.source_text: Carolina Herrera introduces Good Girl Dazzling Garden, a contemporary women's perfume. Freshly released in 2023, this scent opens with the luminous aromas of Jasmine and Tuberose. Almond delicately emerges as the heart note, while a rich blend of Cacao, Tonka Bean, and Coffee forms the base, creating a lasting impression.

name: Carolina Herrera Good Girl Dot Drama Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Good Girl Dot Drama by Carolina Herrera Perfume.
Step into something
truly breathtaking when you lavish your skin in Good Girl Dot Drama, a
mesmerizing women's fragrance. This complex perfume blends spicy,
floral, citrus and woody accords for a spellbinding combination that
will leave you feeling chic and confident with every step you take
Notes:
- Top: sambac jasmine, tuberose crystal.
- Middle: velvet almond.
- Base: tonka bean, cocoa, coffee.

name: Carolina Herrera Good Girl Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Carolina Herrera Good Girl is a seductive blend of tuberose, coffee and cacao.
Louise Turner created it in 2016. Almond, coffee, lemon and bergamot open warm, jasmine sambac, orange blossom, rose and tuberose form the heart, and cacao, vanilla, tonka bean, sandalwood and praline give it a rich finish.
Made for fall and winter nights and date nights.

Black and White? Good Girl, Bad Girl. Good Girl is a sensual,
evocative fragrance born of the beautiful contradictions and the
ever-present duality of modern women and modern life. Both freshly light
and moodily dark, this innovative fragrance captures a woman's wondrous
complexity with surprising and exceptional ingredients. The sweet,
alluring qualities of jasmine give Good Girl its brightness and
femininity. The darker side of Good Girl is created with richly fragrant
cocoa and intoxicating tonka. Almond and coffee bring Good Girl its
immediate vibrancy. Tuberose, extracted in a new way that creates a rich
delicacy, is the fragrance's wild card, bringing fluidity and
femininity.

name: Carolina Herrera Good Girl Fantastic Pink Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text: Good Girl Fantastic Pink by Carolina Herrera is a Oriental Floral fragrance for women. This is a new fragrance. Good Girl Fantastic Pink was launched in 2020. The nose behind this fragrance is Louise Turner. Top notes are almond, coffee, bergamot and lemon; middle notes are jasmine sambac, tuberose, orris, bulgarian rose and orange blossom; base notes are tonka bean, cacao pod, sandalwood, vanilla, praline, cinnamon, cedar, cashmere wood, patchouli, amber and musk.

name: Carolina Herrera Good Girl Gold Fantasy Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text: Carolina Herrera's Good Girl Gold Fantasy is an alluring Amber Floral fragrance created for women. Launched in 2022, this new scent is crafted by renowned perfumer Louise Turner. Opening with the scents of Almond and Coffee, its heart blooms with Jasmine Sambac and Tuberose. This captivating aroma is settled on a soft base of Tonka Bean and Cacao.

name: Carolina Herrera Good Girl Jasmin Absolute Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Good Girl Jasmine Absolute Eau de Parfum by Carolina Herrera celebrates
10 years of irresistible allure with a bold, ambery gourmand twist on
the House's signature jasmine and the original icon. This rich and
radiant scent opens with bright mandarin and juicy blackcurrant before
melting into an indulgent heart of jasmine and bitter almond. At the
base, caramelized toffee and roasted tonka bean create an enveloping
warmth and an intoxicatingly sensual trail. Dressed in sleek black and
crowned with a pearl-white jasmine flower, the iconic stiletto bottle
embodies Good Girl's duality — confident, hypnotic, and impossible to
ignore. It's so good to be bad!

name: Carolina Herrera Good Girl Légere Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Good Girl Legere by Carolina Herrera is an enchanting Amber Floral fragrance designed for women, introduced in 2018. Created by perfumer Louise Turner, this scent features an exquisite blend of top notes including Ylang-Ylang, Mandarin Orange, Bergamot, and Lemon. The heart of the fragrance is composed of Tuberose, Jasmine, Orange Blossom, and Bulgarian Rose, while the base offers a rich combination of Dulce de leche, Praline, Tonka Bean, Cinnamon, Sandalwood, Cashmeran, Amber, Musk, Patchouli, and Cedar.

Carolina Herrera celebrates female empowerment with a breakthrough in
perfumery. Good Girl Eau de Parfum Légère inaugurates a new phase in
perfumery and in House of Herrera with the creation of an Oriental
Floral constructed around the DNA of Good Girl. This scent is built
around the eloquent pair of jasmine, the emblem of Carolina Herrera, and
tonka, an intoxicating and surprising note. In a market ruled by fast
fashion and where perfumes are launched nearly every day, Good Girl Eau
de Parfum has become a classic and one of the most sold scents in the
world. A milestone that Carolina Herrera wants to repeat with the
incorporation of a new type of Jasmine in Eau de Parfum Légère: jasmine
sambac imperial, a softer flower with an exquisite high quality.
Légère pays homage to strong women, and invites us to be who we want to
be. An innovative fragrance, signed by women, it invites all women to
have fun and be naughty, because... it’s good to be bad.
Fragrance Family:
Floral
Scent Type:
Fruity Floral
Key Notes:
Mandarin, Sambac Jasmine, and Sandalwood

name: Carolina Herrera La Bomba Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text: La Bomba by Carolina Herrera is an Oriental Floral scent designed for women. This fragrance is part of a new collection and was introduced in 2025. Crafted by perfumers Christophe Raynaud, Quentin Bisch, and Louise Turner, La Bomba opens with a top note of Pitahaya, followed by heart notes of Red Peony and Frangipani. name: Carolina Herrera Very Good Girl Eau de Parfum For Women

notes.source_text:
Carolina Herrera Very Good Girl is a fruity rose with lychee and red currant.
Louise Turner and Quentin Bisch created it in 2021. Lychee and red currant open juicy, rose forms the heart, and vanilla and vetiver give it a soft finish.
A fun choice for spring and summer, day or night.

Very Good Girl by Carolina Herrera is a Floral Fruity fragrance for women. This is a new fragrance. Very Good Girl was launched in 2021. Very Good Girl was created by Quentin Bisch and Louise Turner. Top notes are Litchi and Red Currant; middle note is Rose; base notes are Vanilla and Vetiver.
At the beginning of February 2021, Carolina Herrera presents a new flanker in an attractive bright red stiletto bottle. Red is definitely a trend in 2021 because many houses have decided to offer new creations in red bottles.
Very Good Girl is a new olfactory adventure that takes a surprising turn: Where previous fragrances in the family explored the subversive power of jasmine or the tonka bean, this new Eau de Parfum ups the ante, drawing its strength from the potency of the rose, a distinctive scent, which here treads on entirely new ground.
VERY GOOD GIRL arrives after last year's creation, Good Girl Suprême, and Good Girl Légère from 2018. They stand out as different compositions from the other editions of the collection, which were limited edition bottles of the original Good Girl creation from 2016.
As the brand explains: "Rose and vetiver: an idyllic contrast. Very Good Girl is a Floral Fruity fragrance. Its aromatic journey starts with the currant, a playfully mischievous wild berry that’s joined by the exotic lychee in a unity of confidence. It’s at this point that the singular yet mysterious qualities of the rose come into play. As one of the most important raw ingredients in the history of perfumery, it has previously seen countless interpretations. All-encompassing and seductive, its unique scent is an ace up any sleeve, which is exactly what perfumers Quentin Bisch and Louise Turner capitalized on for this new chapter in the Good Girl universe."
"Here, it’s the creamy and powdery nuances of the rose that come to the fore, with an indulgent romanticism that’s as warm and silky as the world’s most seductive red lipstick.
There’s no need to justify a declaration of love for this most luxurious of ingredients, and even if this were reason enough to create a fragrance, Quentin Bisch and Louise Turner are anything but a conformist. Hence why the final burst in Very Good Girl is a veiled background of vetiver, the raw form of which evokes the smell of wood, and is often used in men’s perfumery. It’s a key ingredient of Bad Boy, for example, but also of Good Girl Suprême, providing a surprising and contemporary counterpoint that in this new fragrance creates an alliance with the warmth of vanilla.
The result is a floral fragrance that enhances the natural beauty of its raw ingredients, but without forgoing creativity."
As Carolina Herrera famously said, “Fashion is evolution, not revolution,” a maxim that fully applies to this new fragrance. Just as when Wes Gordon modernizes timeless materials such as silk or leather when designing fashion for the brand, the rose is used with a completely contemporary aesthetic. This is why Very Good Girl is not only a tour de force for the senses, it’s also a fragrance that’s ready to wear and enjoy in the modern world.

intimate and sensual. Chloé Eau de Parfum begins with a combination of

more sensual side of the rose. The distinctive character of this unique
rose is accompanied by magnolia and lily of the valley, as well as
subtle intimations of warm amber and elegant cedarwood.
