name: Christian Dior Ambre Nuit Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Dior Ambre Nuit is a warm, sensual amber with a rich Turkish rose.
François Demachy created it in 2018. Amber and Turkish rose blend into a warm, glowing and slightly spicy scent that feels elegant and intimate.
Made for fall and winter nights.

Ambre Nuit by Dior is a Amber fragrance for women and men. Ambre Nuit
was launched in 2009. Top notes are Bergamot and Grapefruit; middle
notes are Damask Rose and Pink Pepper; base notes are Guaiac Wood,
Cedar, Ambergris and Patchouli.

name: Christian Dior Ambre Nuit Limited Edition 2022 Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: The new limited edition Ambre Nuit New Look by Dior presents a unisex scent, belonging to the Amber Floral olfactory family. Freshly introduced to the world in 2022, this latest creation carries the signature craftsmanship of perfumer Francois Demachy. It starts with vibrant top notes of Bergamot and Grapefruit, leading into a heart of exquisite Turkish Rose paired with the spicy zing of Pink Pepper. The scent culminates in a rich base featuring warm Amber, the woody essence of Guaiac Wood, alongside earthy Patchouli, and the soft, balsamic tones of Cedar.

name: Christian Dior Balade Sauvage Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Balade Sauvage by Christian Dior is a fragrance for women and men. Balade Sauvage
was launched in 2018. The nose behind this fragrance is Francois
Demachy. Top notes are Ozonic notes, Petitgrain and Bergamot; middle
notes are Fig Tree, Fig, Solar notes, Sea Notes, Peach, Hedione, Orange
Blossom and Rose; base notes are Pebbles, Labdanum, Amberwood and
Vanilla.

name: Christian Dior Belle de Jour Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Belle De Jour by Dior is a fragrance for women and men. Belle De Jour was launched in 2018. The nose behind this fragrance is Francois Demachy.

name: Christian Dior Bois D'Argent Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Dior Bois d'Argent is a soft, elegant blend of iris, myrrh and honey.
Annick Menardo created it in 2004. Iris, cypress and juniper open fresh, myrrh and patchouli form a resinous heart, and woods, honey, vanilla, amber, musk and leather give it a smooth finish.
A refined daytime scent for spring and fall.

name: Christian Dior Cologne Royale Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: La Collection Couturier Parfumeur Cologne Royale by Dior is a Citrus Aromatic fragrance for women and men. La Collection Couturier Parfumeur Cologne Royale was launched in 2010. The nose behind this fragrance is Francois Demachy.

name: Christian Dior Cuir Cannage Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Cuir Cannage by Dior is a Leather fragrance for women and men. Cuir Cannage was launched in 2014. The nose behind this fragrance is Francois Demachy. Top notes are Ylang-Ylang, Orange Blossom and Bergamot; middle notes are Leather, iris, Jasmine and Rose; base notes are Leather, Birch, Juniper, Tobacco, Violet and Cade oil.

name: Christian Dior Eden-Roc Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Eden-Roc by Dior is a Amber Floral fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Eden-Roc was launched in 2021. The nose behind this fragrance is Francois Demachy. Top notes are Sea Salt, Citruses and Mineral notes; middle notes are Jasmine, Mastic or Lentisque and Coconut; base notes are Pine Tree and Labdanum.

name: Christian Dior Feve Delicieuse Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: F?ve D?licieuse (2018) by Dior is a Amber fragrance for women and men. F?ve D?licieuse (2018) was launched in 2018. The nose behind this fragrance is Francois Demachy. Top notes are Lavender, Mint and Calabrian bergamot; middle notes are Cherry, Freesia and Jasmine; base notes are Tonka Bean, Madagascar Vanilla, Caramel, Dark Chocolate, Benzoin, Leather, Coconut, Sandalwood and Cedar.

name: Christian Dior Grand Bal for Eau de Parfum Women

notes.source_text: Dior Grand Bal by Dior is a Floral Woody Musk fragrance for women. Dior Grand Bal was launched in 2012. The nose behind this fragrance is Francois Demachy.

name: Christian Dior Granville for Eau de Parfum Women

notes.source_text: La Collection Couturier Parfumeur Granville by Dior is a Aromatic fragrance for women. La Collection Couturier Parfumeur Granville was launched in 2010. The nose behind this fragrance is Francois Demachy. Top notes are Lemon, Rosemary and Thyme; middle notes are Pine Tree and Dyer’s Greenweed; base notes are Pepper, Sandalwood and Woody Notes.

name: Christian Dior Gris Dior Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Dior Gris Dior is an elegant chypre of rose, oakmoss and patchouli.
François Demachy created it in 2017. Rose and bergamot meet earthy oakmoss and patchouli, with cedar, sandalwood and amber adding a soft, refined warmth.
Chic and timeless, it works day or night from spring through fall.

Gris Dior by Dior is a Floral fragrance for women and men. Gris Dior was launched in 2017. The nose behind this fragrance is Francois Demachy.

name: Christian Dior Happy Hour Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Happy Hour by Dior is a Floral Fruity fragrance for women and men. Happy Hour was launched in 2018. The nose behind this fragrance is Francois Demachy.

name: Christian Dior Holy Peony Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Dior Holy Peony is a fresh, delicate peony and rose fragrance.
François Demachy created it in 2019. Peony, rose, red fruits, apricot, green leaves, musk and woods blend into a soft, airy floral.
A daytime favorite for spring.

Holy Peony by Dior is a Floral Woody Musk fragrance for women. This is a new fragrance. Holy Peony was launched in 2019. The nose behind this fragrance is Francois Demachy.

name: Christian Dior Jasmin Des Anges Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Dior Jasmin des Anges is a sunny blend of jasmine, apricot and peach.
François Demachy created it in 2018. Bergamot opens bright, jasmine, apricot, osmanthus and peach form a lush heart, and white musk and vanilla give it a soft finish.
A daytime favorite for spring and summer.

Jasmin Des Anges by Dior is a Floral fragrance for women and men. Jasmin Des Anges was launched in 2018. The nose behind this fragrance is Francois Demachy. Top note is Bergamot; middle notes are Jasmine, Apricot, Osmanthus and Peach; base notes are White Musk and Vanilla.

name: Christian Dior La Colle Noire Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: La Colle Noire by Dior is a Floral Woody Musk fragrance for women and men. La Colle Noire was launched in 2016. The nose behind this fragrance is Francois Demachy. Top note is Lemon; middle notes are May Rose, Spices, Peony, Lily-of-the-Valley, Black Currant, Raspberry and Peach; base notes are White Musk, Sandalwood, Amber, Heliotrope and Agarwood (Oud).

name: Christian Dior Leather Oud Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Leather Oud by Dior is a Amber fragrance for women and men. Leather Oud was launched in 2018. The nose behind this fragrance is Francois Demachy. Top note is Bergamot; middle notes are Cardamom, Cloves, Jasmine and Geranium; base notes are Leather, Agarwood (Oud), Smoke, Birch, Patchouli, Amberwood, Sandalwood and Sand.

name: Christian Dior Lucky Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Dior Lucky is a fresh, airy lily of the valley.
François Demachy created it in 2018. Lily of the valley, white flowers and airy notes blend into a clean, green and luminous floral.
A daytime favorite for spring and summer.

name: Christian Dior New Look 1947 Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: New Look 1947 by Dior is a Amber Floral fragrance for women and men. New Look 1947 was launched in 2018. The nose behind this fragrance is Francois Demachy. Top note is Pink Pepper; middle notes are Ylang-Ylang, Jasmine, Rose, Tuberose and Gardenia; base notes are Benzoin and Vanilla.

name: Christian Dior Oud Ispahan Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Oud Ispahan by Dior is a Amber Floral fragrance for women and men. Oud Ispahan
was launched in 2012. The nose behind this fragrance is Francois
Demachy. Top note is Labdanum; middle notes are Rose, Patchouli and
Saffron; base notes are Agarwood (Oud), Sandalwood and Cedar.

name: Christian Dior Oud Rosewood Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Oud Rosewood by Dior is a Amber Woody fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Oud Rosewood was launched in 2020. The nose behind this fragrance is Francois Demachy. Top notes are Raspberry and Quince; middle notes are Sandalwood and Animal notes; base notes are Agarwood (Oud) and Palisander Rosewood.

name: Christian Dior Patchouli Imperial Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Patchouli Imperial by Dior is a Amber Woody fragrance for women and men. Patchouli Imperial was launched in 2018. The nose behind this fragrance is Francois Demachy. Top notes are Mandarin Orange and Bergamot; middle notes are Coriander, Cinnamon and Rose; base notes are Patchouli, Amber, Smoke, Benzoin, Cedar, Sandalwood, Tonka Bean and Vanilla.

name: Christian Dior Purple Oud Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Purple Oud by Dior is a Amber Woody fragrance for women and men. Purple Oud was launched in 2018. The nose behind this fragrance is Francois Demachy.

name: Christian Dior Rose Gipsy Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Rose Gipsy by Dior is a Floral fragrance for women and men. Rose Gipsy was launched in 2018. The nose behind this fragrance is Francois Demachy.

name: Christian Dior Rose Kabuki Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Dior Rose Kabuki is a fresh, dewy rose with soft musk.
François Demachy created it in 2018. Rose, dewy notes and musk blend into a clean, watery and delicate floral.
A daytime favorite for spring and summer.

name: Christian Dior Rouge Trafalgar Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Dior Rouge Trafalgar is a bright, juicy red-fruit fragrance.
Launched in 2020, it opens with raspberry, strawberry, cherry and mandarin. Black currant and grapefruit form a fresh heart, and musk and patchouli give it a soft finish.
Playful and fresh, it is perfect for spring and summer days.

Rouge Trafalgar by Dior is a Chypre Fruity fragrance for women. This is a new fragrance. Rouge Trafalgar was launched in 2020. Top notes are Raspberry, Strawberry, Cherry and Mandarin Orange; middle notes are Black Currant and Grapefruit; base notes are Musk and Patchouli.

name: Christian Dior Sakura Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Sakura by Dior is a Floral fragrance for women and men. Sakura was launched in 2018. The nose behind this fragrance is Francois Demachy. Top note is Green Notes; middle notes are Japanese Cherry Blossom, Rose, Jasmine and Hedione; base notes are Mimosa, Violet and White Musk.

name: Christian Dior Santal Noir Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Santal Noir by Dior is a fragrance for women and men. Santal Noir was launched in 2018. The nose behind this fragrance is Francois Demachy.

name: Christian Dior Spice Blend Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Dior Spice Blend is a warm, boozy blend of rum, ginger and spices.
François Demachy created it in 2019. Rum and ginger open warm, pink pepper, cinnamon, black pepper, clove, nutmeg and coriander form a spicy heart, and bay leaf and woods give it a dry finish.
Made for fall and winter nights.

name: Christian Dior Terra Bella Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Terra Bella by Dior is a Aromatic Fruity fragrance for women and men. Terra Bella was launched in 2018. The nose behind this fragrance is Francois Demachy.

name: Christian Dior The Cachemire Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: The Cachemire by Dior is a Floral fragrance for women and men. The Cachemire was launched in 2018. The nose behind this fragrance is Francois Demachy. Top notes are Petitgrain, Bergamot, Lemon and Bitter Orange; middle notes are White Tea, Hedione, Honeysuckle, Rose, Black Currant and Magnolia; base notes are Mate, Iso E Super, Musk, Smoke and Orris.

name: Christian Dior Tobacolor Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Dior Tobacolor is a sweet, honeyed tobacco with soft fruits and smoke.
François Demachy created it in 2021. Tobacco leaf, honey, plum, peach and citrus blend with a light smoke and warm amber for a rich, cozy scent.
Made for fall and winter nights.

Tobacolor by Dior is a Amber fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Tobacolor was launched in 2021. The nose behind this fragrance is Francois Demachy.

name: Christian Dior Vanilla Diorama Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Dior Vanilla Diorama is a rich, boozy vanilla with rum and cacao.
François Demachy created it in 2021. Orange, pink pepper and lemon open bright, rum, cacao and cardamom form a gourmand heart, and Bourbon vanilla, sandalwood and patchouli give it a warm, smooth finish.
Made for fall and winter, day or night.

Vanilla Diorama by Dior is a Amber Vanilla fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Vanilla Diorama was launched in 2021. The nose behind this fragrance is Francois Demachy. Top notes are Orange, Pink Pepper and Lemon; middle notes are Rum, Cacao and Cardamom; base notes are Bourbon Vanilla, Sandalwood and Patchouli.

name: Clive Christian 1872 Basil Parfum for Men

notes.source_text: 1872 Basil by Clive Christian is a Woody Aromatic fragrance for men. 1872 Basil was launched in 2018. Top notes are Basil, Bergamot, Grapefruit, Lime, Black Pepper, Petitgrain and Nutmeg; middle notes are Sage, Tagetes, Cyclamen, Freesia and Jasmine; base notes are Patchouli, Cedar, Ambergris, Musk and Olibanum.

name: Clive Christian 1872 Crab Apple Blossom Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: In 2020, Clive Christian introduced a unisex fragrance, Crab Apple Blossom, composed by the perfumer Kamila Lelakova. At the top of the blend are aquatic notes, bergamot and apple blossom, while the middle notes feature mojito and rhubarb. Finally, the base is composed of driftwood and sandalwood.

name: Clive Christian 1872 for Women Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
A floral, fruity Citrus that combines fresh, clean top notes with the
intense bouquet of Rose de Mai, one of the rarest ingredients in nature.
The resulting aroma offers a deeply emotive experience for the wearer.
1872 for Women  Notes
Bergamot,
tangerine, lemon, pineapple, blueberry, rosemary, rose de Mai, lily of
the valley, jasmine, purple violet, freesia, cedarwood, sandalwood,
patchouli, erogen musk, and moss.

name: Clive Christian 1872 Mandarin Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
1872 Mandarin by Clive Christian is a Chypre Floral fragrance for women and men. 1872 Mandarin
was launched in 2016. The nose behind this fragrance is Beverley Bayne.
Top notes are Mandarin Orange, Bergamot, Nectarine, Lime, Basil,
Ginger, Lemon and Coriander; middle notes are Lavender, Rose, Freesia,
Orchid, Lily-of-the-Valley, Jasmine and Violet; base notes are Moss,
Vetiver, Cedar, Amber, Patchouli, Saffron and Musk.

name: Clive Christian 1872 Men Parfum for Men

notes.source_text: A fragrance with a classical DNA and a century-old tradition. This is precisely because it is created according to formulae and methods originally used by Crown Perfumery. All ingredients are strictly vegetable in order to perpetuate a lasting formula of fragrance.

name: Clive Christian 1872 Twist Bergamot Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
A sparkling fusion of bergamot and mandarin and rosemary and lavender,
which provides a clean herbal edge, this aromatic delight softens slowly
to reveal a heart of earthy clary sage.
Top Note: Bergamot
Heart Note: Neroli
Base Note: Patchouli

name: Clive Christian 20th Anniversary Collection Iconic Feminine Parfum

notes.source_text: 20 Iconic Feminine by Clive Christian is a captivating Amber Floral scent designed for women. Released in 2019, this fragrance opens with the rich aroma of Saffron. At its heart, it features a harmonious blend of Plum, Violet, and Damask Rose, creating a deeply floral bouquet. The fragrance settles into a warm base of Amber and Honey, enveloping the wearer in a luxurious and comforting aroma.

name: Clive Christian 20th Anniversary Collection Iconic Masculine Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Capturing the history, creativity and craftsmanship of the perfume house
the limited edition Anniversary Collection is a celebration of past,
present and future in perfumed form. Bottling nearly 200 years of haute
perfumery and paying tribute to Clive Christian's inspirational heritage
from the Crown Perfumery Company.
20 Iconic Masculine is a riot
of petitgrain twisted with sweet mandarin is lifted to fresh heights
with brilliant pink pepper. A juicy squeeze of yuzu with aromatic
rosemary delves into smooth cedar to create the masculine perfume of an
iconic pair.
Adorned with a platinum colored cage and crowned
with a platinum colored cap, the precious metal of a 20th anniversary.
The cage is a unique abstract design, a modern interpretation of the
decorative cages found on the Crown Perfumery Company perfume bottles in
1872.
Top Notes: Yuzu, pink pepper, cassis
Heart Notes: Elemi, mandarin petitgrain, juniper berry
Base Notes: Vetiver, rum, cedarwood

name: Clive Christian C for Men Woody Leather With Oudh Intense Parfum for Men
tags: C for Men Woody Leather With Oudh Intense

notes.source_text:
C Woody Leather With Oudh Intense
(formerly C For Men, though this is a wholly reimagined release) is a
painstakingly constructed, perfectly balanced masculine scent that
reminds us of the multi-dimensionality of fine niche fragrance. For
although C Woody Leather, in the end, is a wonderfully intense,
sensually smoky melange of tobacco and exotic woods, it guides us to
that richness along a carefully constructed trail of juicy citrus and
ravishing spice, displaying the sort of sophistication and wit that has
always separated Clive Christian from the competition.
C- Woody Leather  Notes
Mandarin, saffron, tobacco, oudh, leather

name: Clive Christian C for Women Green Floral With Scottish Heather Parfum for Women
tags: C for Women Green Floral With Scottish Heather

notes.source_text:
Clive Christian C Green Floral With Scottish Heather is a Feminine fragrance, The fragrance launched in 2017, The nose behind this fragrance is Beverley Bayne,
Top Note: Chamomile, Apple, Bergamot, Pear
Heart Note: Rose
Base Note: Green Grass, Dew Drop

name: Clive Christian C for Women Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
C for Women embraces the Clive Christian Perfume House accord
of rose and jasmine absolute, yet here it is pushed to crescendo in
union with violet and tuberose to reveal a perfume brimming with
voluptuousness and dangerous pleasure.
Top notes: bergamot,
coriander seed, lie de vin (cognac oil, wine sediment), narcisse
(daffodil), geranium, mandarin, petitgrain, tagete (marigold).
Heart
notes: tuberose, jasmine, rose, violet, osmanthus (apricot aroma),
ylang-ylang (placed on the beds of newlyweds in Indonesia), orange
flower, cistus (rock rose labdanum resin/gum with a smoky, marshy
scent).
Base notes: amber, vetiver (thin aromatic roots), vanilla, tonka bean, sandalwood, musk.

name: Clive Christian Contemporary 150 Anniversary Collection Limited Edition Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Dalai Lama by Parfums et Senteurs du Pays Basque is a Aromatic Fougere fragrance for men. Dalai Lama was launched in 2007. The nose behind this fragrance is Christian Louis.

name: Clive Christian Crown Collection Matsukita Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Matsukita by Clive Christian is a Woody Chypre fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Matsukita was launched in 2021. Top notes are Bergamot, Pink Pepper and Nutmeg; middle notes are Mate, Chinese Jasmine, Jasmine Sambac and Guaiac Wood; base notes are Musk, Woodsy Notes, Balsam Fir and Amber.

name: Clive Christian E Cashmere Musk Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: E Cashmere Musk by Clive Christian is a captivating Woody Spicy fragrance designed for both women and men. A fresh addition to the fragrance world, it made its debut in 2024. The scent opens with top notes of Bergamot, Ginger, Pink Pepper, Sichuan Pepper, and Blood Orange. The heart is an elegant blend of Flowers, Cashmeran, Green Leaves, and Egyptian Jasmine. The fragrance is rounded off with a rich base of Ambroxan, Musk, and Guaiac Wood.

name: Clive Christian E for Men Gourmand Oriental With Sweet Clove Parfum for Men
tags: E for Men Gourmand Oriental With Sweet Clove

notes.source_text:
Clive Christian’s E for Men
Gourmande Oriental with Sweet Clove is the gourmand to end all
gourmands. Are you a coffee lover? Well, this smells like the best cup
of coffee you’ve had in your life. Imagine walking through miles of
frozen tundra to a small, cozy log cabin, whereupon you’re handed a cup
of dark, rich coffee stirred with a maple leaf and sweetened slightly
with rough brown sugar. In a nutshell, that’s just how warm, intense,
and inviting this fragrance is.
E- Gourmande Oriental  Notes
rum, osmanthus, labdanum, cade, clove, cinnamon, oak, patchouli, oakmoss, vanilla, caramel, maple

name: Clive Christian E for Women Green Fougere With Aromatic Lavender Parfum for Women
tags: E for Women Green Fougere With Aromatic Lavender

notes.source_text:
Drawing on regal encounters that have permeated Clive Christian's
world, E Green Fougere references the elegenace of royal gardens with
fresh notes of rose, lavender and narcissus. E Green Fougere is based on
more feminine notes, designed to be worn in a pair with the more
masculine E Gourmande Oriental.
Clive Christian’s E for Women Green
Fougere with Aromatic Lavender is an interesting scent built around an
interesting idea – a fougere that women will want to wear. And want to
wear it they shall. Because somehow, perfumer Tom Gage has figured out
how to remove all the parts of a fougere that make it too masculine for
women, like geranium, cedar, and coumarin, replacing them with softer
herbal, floral, and earthy notes that retain the essential character of
the fougere while rendering it more universally appealing.
E- Green Fougere  Notes
rose, narcissus, pineapple, fir balsam, acacia, orris, hyssop, immortelle, cypress, lavender, moss, clover, vetiver

name: Clive Christian I for Men Amber Oriental With Rich Musk Parfum for Men
tags: I for Men Amber Oriental With Rich Musk

notes.source_text:
Clive Christian’s I For Men Amber
Oriental With Rich Musk is a spiced, mossy musk with an old school
masculine vibe. Its authentic 1970’s growl comes from that classic
combination of sweet and dirty. First, we have a gloriously powdery musk
that walks the tightrope between clean and filthy so perfectly that
memories of vintage Original Musk (Kiehl’s) and Musc Ravageur (Malle)
jump effortlessly to mind. This accord is thickened further with dried
fruit and davana, giving it a sweet booziness that will get you tipsy if
you lean in too closely. This is in turn balanced out by the bitterness
of fir balsam and the rubbery honk of cowboy leather.
I- Amber Oriental  Notes
Musk, amber,
davana, dried fruit, fir balsam, moss, Atlas cedarwood, leather,
vanilla, tonka, frankincense, patchouli, sandalwood, oakwood, juniper,
apple, whiskey, bergamot, grapefruit, mandarin, tagetes, pineapple

name: Clive Christian I Woody Floral Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
The Scoop
Clive Christian’s I For Women Woody
Floral With Vintage Rose is a scent as tender as rose petals dried
between the pages of a Jane Austen novel. Inspired by Clive Christian’s
experience as a master furniture designer, the scent represents the
delicate harmony between light and dark in an exquisite mahogany
marquetry inlaid with mother of pearl.
The light side of the equation is the rose, buried in soft,
opalescent layers of white ambers, musks, and vanilla, which give the
fragrance a tulle-like delicacy. Soft red fruits and a sprinkling of
boozy pink pepper nudge the vanilla-rose combination towards sparkling,
while orris introduces a light dusting of powder. The truffled edge to
the rose – not quite jammy but tilted towards rose lokhoum – gives the
scent a candied lipstick nuance, which in turn makes it feel romantic.
Now, if you’ve taken a peek at the notes list and suspect that oud and
cedarwood arrive to spoil the prettiness of this picture, then let us
set your mind at rest. Although the scent does turn woodier, the
darkness of the mahogany part of the equation never quite materializes.
Instead, a warmly earthy pairing of vetiver and patchouli tethers the
feathery rose, making sure it doesn’t just float off into space. There’s
indeed a hint of smoky wood but the outcome is clean rather than dirty.
The wood does its job unobtrusively, simply giving the fluffy florals
and musks something sturdy to drape themselves over. Deeply feminine and
even, dare we say it, ladylike, I For Women Woody Floral With Vintage
Rose would be perfect for those who love powdery, retro-styled roses
such as Lipstick Rose (Malle) or Paris (YSL).
I- Woody Floral  Notes
bergamot,
mandarin, red fruits, cardamom, pink pepper, black pepper, jasmine, lily
of the valley, orris, rose, cedarwood, amber, patchouli, oud, vetiver,
vanilla, musk

name: Clive Christian Jump Up And Kiss Me Hedonistic 2021 Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Clive Christian Jump Up and Kiss Me Hedonistic is a rich blend of cherry, tobacco and leather.
Julie Pluchet created it in 2021. Clary sage, citrus, maté, neroli, sour cherry and violet leaf open bright, tobacco, papyrus, orris and jasmine form the heart, and cashmere wood, labdanum, vanilla, sandalwood and leather give it depth.
Made for nights in spring, fall and winter.

name: Clive Christian L for Men Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Spicy Woods perfume with a heart of fir balsam and rose combined with
the warm and spicy notes of nutmeg and cardamom. In the base the smoky
and earthy facet of vetiver is blended with musk for sensuality, and
mixed with cedar Atlas, oud and spices to bring all base notes to life.
At the top, grapefruit enhances the natural citrus facet of vetiver,
while petitgrain mandarinier lends the perfume a modernand distinctive
edge.
Top Notes: grapefruit, petitgrain mandarinier.
Middle Notes: fir balsam, rose, nutmeg, cardamom.
Base Notes: vetiver, oud, Atlas cedarwood, musk.

name: Clive Christian L for Men Woody Oriental With Deep Amber Parfum for Men
tags: L for Men Woody Oriental With Deep Amber

notes.source_text:
Clive Christian’s L for Men Woody
Oriental with Deep Amber diverges quite a bit from the original L for
Men - a bright explosion of citrus against spice - by placing most of
the focus on woods. And what a beautiful specimen of wood it is: oily,
buttery, with the underbite of a greenish spice that the notes list
tells us is pepper (but our noses defiantly peg as cardamom). Strangely
enough, there’s no wood listed either, so we credit perfumer Mike Parrot
for being able to root out the woodiest elements of tobacco, pepper,
lavender, maple, and cade, and unite them all for the cleanest,
smoothest woods extravaganza that we’ve smelled in a while.
L- Woody Oriental  Notes
lemon, mandarin, pepper, lavender, geranium, magnolia, jasmine, orris, amber, tobacco, musk, maple, cade

name: Clive Christian L for Women

notes.source_text: Clive Christian's L for Women is an aromatic blend that falls under the Floral Fruity category, crafted specifically for the feminine olfactory experience. This scent was first introduced to the world in the year 2014. It opens with a spirited burst of Pink Pepper, Artemisia, Black Pepper, and White Pepper at the top. Progressing to the heart of the fragrance, one is enveloped in the luxurious essence of Damask Rose paired with the delicate allure of Jasmine. Concluding its fragrant journey, the base is anchored by the earthy richness of Patchouli and Vetiver, the woody tones of Cedar, and a final whisper of sweet Vanilla.

name: Clive Christian L for Women Floral Chypre With Rich Patchouli Parfum for Women
tags: L for Women Floral Chypre With Rich Patchouli

notes.source_text:
Drawing on the inspirations that have permeated Clive Christian's
world in the budding metropolis, L Floral Chypre is a bold fragrance,
built around jasmine sambac and rose shrouded in a patchouli base with a
twist of dry orris and frankincense, wrapped up in sensual vanilla and
musks. With more feminine notes, it is designed to be worn as a pair
with the more masculine L Woody Oriental.
Key notes: Jasmine sambac, rose, patchouli

name: Clive Christian No. 1 for Men Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Wanting to push the parameters of
what is acceptable, Clive Christian turned his creative design to having
a fragrance for the night. No. 1 was created with passion. It has great
personality; it is refined and without question highly distinctive and
original. It is a perfume which stands out from the crowd; it is the
fragrance of ultimate luxury.
No. 1 for Men  Notes
Bergamot, lime,
Sicilian mandarin, cardamom, nutmeg, thyme, lily of the valley, rose,
jasmine, ylang ylang, heliotrope, cedarwood, sandalwood, vetiver, ambery
woods, and vanilla.

name: Clive Christian No.1 Feminine Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
The Scoop
Undeniably feminine, with an
olfactory arc that moves from transporting and fresh-aromatic to
otherworldly, exotic and decadent, No. 1 for Women is a first-class
perfume ticket to a floral wonderland. The best Indian jasmine, Tahitian
vanilla, Rose Centifolia, carnation and ylang-ylang, make up No. 1's
heart, helping to explain the perfume's designation as the world's most
expensive, made without reference to cost. But this cost helps produce
an intoxicating scent experience that is recognizably special at first
spray.
No. 1 starts with a floral high that sustains itself
operatically, with subtle pineapple, plum and lemon revolving around
intense jasmine and ylang-ylang notes. It then evolves into an ambery
vanilla base touched with cedar, musk and the smoothest sandalwood. By
the time the perfume dries down, the marriage of these precious
ingredients is seamless, and the floral drama subsides into a
comforting, ambery-vanillic warmth that lasts. The Empress does have
clothes.
No. 1 for Women  Notes
Pineapple,
plum, mirabelle, bergamot, lemon, and cardamom, rose, jasmine, ylang
ylang, orris, orchid, vanilla, tonka seeds, cedarwood, sandalwood, musk,
amber

name: Clive Christian Noble Collection VII Cosmos Flower Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Beautifully feminine, universally
complex, Noble VII Cosmos Flower is a bold new offering from Clive
Christian, the venerable house's very first gourmand fragrance. Inspired
by the nobility of England's Queen Anne period and the wondrous gardens
that graced the homes of royals and elites, Cosmos Flower is built
around the titular flowers' sumptuously rich and mouthwatering
chocolatey scent. A delicious blend of sweet benzoin and caramel in the
base is given a chypre-like twise with bitter cocoa, dry amber and a
hidden touch of leather that unfurls as the fragrance warms. The bouquet
at the heart wraps around a deep and fruity rich plum accord that fuses
with the intensity of ylang-ylang, the sensuality of jasmine, the
fruitiness of osmanthus and the cosmos flower itself. True, natural
cocoa delivers both creamy gourmand notes but also a dark bitter edge,
enhancing the fruity character detectable in the opening, while a touch
of fiery rum brings warmth and delight. Extraordinarily sophisticated,
unapologetically British, this gorgeous gourmand represents both a bold
new step and also the continuation of the grand tradition of Clive
Christian.
Noble VII Cosmos Flower  Notes
Rum, mandarin, pink pepper, apple, jasmine, osmanthus, ylang-ylang, violet, plum, cocoa, benzoin, leather, amber, caramel

name: Clive Christian Noble Collection VII Rock Rose Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
A thoroughly modern interpretation
of a classically styled fougère, Noble VII Rock Rose is a dynamic,
arrestingly sensual scent designed for a man, but perfect for anyone
with a vibrant and sophisticated sense of style. Rock Rose opens with an
invigorating top of citrus oils anchored by the rich warmth of
bergamot, given a masculine edge with black pepper and the classic
cologne touch of neroli. The heart revolves around a fusion of clean
lavender, herbs, violet and the rich, resinous character of rock rose.
The base is a powerful combination of dark cocoa and patchouli with an
abundance of amber and a touch of sparkling vetiver to compliment the
top citrus notes. The results overall are striking, both direct and
powerful, but also complex and deeply resinous, ideal for a man of
sophisticated style and royal bearing. The world's tastemakers have
always flocked to Clive Christian for their dynamic, luxurious
fragrances. With Noble VII Rock Rose, a bold new chapter in their
prodigious history is written.
Noble VII Rock Rose  Notes
Bergamot, black pepper, neroli, lavender, violet, rock rose, clary sage, cocoa, patchouli, amber, vetiver

name: Clive Christian Noble Collection XX Art Nouveau Water Lily Parfum for Women
tags: Noble Collection XX Art Nouveau Water Lily

notes.source_text:
The Scoop
Clive Christian’s Noble XX Water
Lily Eau De Parfum is the type of big, luxurious floral chypre that
French perfume companies just don’t make anymore. If you mourn the
fall-from-fashion of powerful, statement-making scents like Eau de Soir
(Sisley), Odalisque or Number One (both Parfums de Nicolai), then say
hello to Water Lily. This is Perfume with a capital P; the kind worn
both by rich ladies to church and women dressed to kill on a night out,
all glossy red lips and high heels.
A burst of hairspray aldehydes ushers in a huge floral credenza
of creamy tuberose flushed with the salty, aquatic freshness of water
lily, all stretched over a surprisingly animalic base of cashmere woods,
musk, and patchouli. The name ‘Water Lily’ makes it sound as if it
might be a light, watery scent, but no - it has the density of velvet
folded many times over. Green leaves add a soapy freshness but fail to
make much of a dent in the thick, salty creaminess of the golden
florals. If you loved the potent civety floral chypres of the past – Eau
de Soir, Giorgio, Odalisque – and mourn what the restrictions on
oakmoss has done to this genre, then we highly recommend you get
acquainted with Clive Christian’s Noble XX Water Lily. To us, Water Lily
is less a perfume than the bugle call of a woman confident in her own
worth, allure, and place in the world.
Noble XX Water Lily  Notes
aldehydes, green leaves, iris, tuberose, heliotrope, water lily, cashmeran, vetiver, patchouli

name: Clive Christian Noble Collection XXI Art Deco Amberwood Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Clive Christian Noble XXI Art Deco Amberwood is a smooth, rich amber with tobacco and oud.
Launched in 2022, it opens with angelica, sage, bergamot and pink pepper. Woods, tobacco and patchouli form the heart, and tonka bean, vanilla, labdanum, oud, musk and cashmere wood give it a deep finish.

notes.source_text:

Made for fall and winter, day or night.

Top notes are Bitter Orange, Ginger, Cardamom, Pink Pepper, Olibanum, Rum, Bergamot and Grapefruit; middle notes are White tobacco, Tuberose, Dried Fruits, Jasmine, Sandalwood, Orris, Saffron and Osmanthus; base notes are Tonka Bean, Vetiver, Labdanum, Myrrh, Patchouli, Musk, Cedar and Vanilla.

name: Clive Christian Noble Collection XXI Art Deco Cypress Parfum for Men
tags: Noble Collection XXI Art Deco Cypress

notes.source_text:
The Scoop
Clive Christian Cypress is a
beautifully-made masculine that manages to capture the magic of a French
Riviera night, where the spicy greenness of the breeze sweeping through
tall cypress trees mingles with the effervescence of freshly-poured
champagne. Think F. Scott Fitzgerald and Zelda boozing it up in a citrus
grove in Nice, the tinkle of laughter and light jazz floating on the
warm night air, and that’s the mood board right there for the scent.
The opening to Cypress is surprisingly spicy, thick with cloves,
cinnamon, ginger root, and the anisic mintiness of fresh basil. But
it’s also immensely fresh and sour, a lively undercurrent of tart
bergamot playing off the green bitterness of cypress. Fans of the
balsamic soapiness of Jaipur Homme will recognize echoes in Cypress, but
where the Boucheron burrows deep into an opoponax base, Cypress swerves
into an elegant essay on the dry richness of woods. In the base, a
handsome pairing of oakwood and cedarwood knits together a rich weave of
smoke, toasted wood, and spice until you can’t tell where one ends and
the other begins. In the far reaches of the scent, rich amber swells up
to thicken the woods, adding weight but not sweetness. If anyone is
feeling short-changed by the dearth in good masculines these days, then
point them in the direction of Clive Christian Cypress – they won’t be
disappointed.
Noble XXI Cypress  Notes
petitgrain, bergamot, basil, cypress, clove, ginger, nutmeg, amber, oakwood, cedar

Based on more feminine notes, V Fruity Floral has a clean jasmine

with bergamot, black pepper, frankincense and brimming with aromatic

Key notes: Jasmine, cassis, palmarosa

name: Clive Christian V for Women Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Having shared her father's passion for perfume from an early age and
served as Ambassador for the Clive Christian Perfume House since its
renaissance in 1999, Clive asked his eldest daughter Victoria to select
two perfumes from his Private Collection that he ultimately named as a
tribute to her choice and to her namesake?Queen Victoria?who uniquely
crowned the perfumery in 1872.
"V" for Women?White Floral
Chypre?Orange blossom, traditionally associated with joy and betrothal,
is embraced by rose and jasmine and entwined with soothing chamomile and
bright lavender to impart a romantic and spirited perfume.

notes.source_text: In 2023, Coach released a fresh fragrance for men, Coach Green. Created by the expert nose, Marie Salamagne, this scent is an inviting mix of top notes of Kiwi and Bergamot, Rosemary and Geranium as middle notes, and Cedar and Moss as base notes.

name: Coach Men Eau de Toilette for Men

top: and a skin-like warm sensuality in the amber
key: and a skin-like warm sensuality in the amber
notes.source_text:
COACH FOR MEN Eau de Toilette takes you on a journey of endless
possibilities, evoking a sense of freedom that comes from the energy and
spontaneity of New York City. A modern fragrance which combines fresh,
energetic top notes and a skin-like warm sensuality in the amber, woody
base notes.
Masculine yet refined, the fragrance starts with
cool, fresh green Nashi pear, contrasted with spicy cardamom, and
finishes with a textured vetiver base note, creating an aromatic, woody
scent. The bottle design is emblematic of the Coach brand and features
several iconic codes: turnlock, hangtag, carriage logo engraving.
Fragrance Notes:
Top - Green nashi pear
Middle - Spicy cardamom
Base - Textured vetiver

name: Coach Open Road Eau de Toilette for Men

This scent was created by Jean-Christophe Hérault, with top notes of Lemon and Red Apple, middle notes of Sichuan Pepper, Clary Sage, and Lavender, and base notes of Vetiver, Cedar, and Patchouli.

name: Coach Platinum Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
oach Platinum takes you on a road trip across America that ends in New
York City. It's a distinctive woody & sensual fragrance that speaks
to a bold, daring and magnetic man.
It opens with an
impulsive cocktail of black pepper, pineapple, and juniper berries. The
luminous start is rapidly contrasted by the bold texture of refined
woody notes: patchouli & cashmere. A leathery haze of vanilla warms
it all, creating a sensual & elegant signature.
The
mirrored bottle is a stunning & luxurious object of design - bright
silver lacquer, smooth metallic touch & sleek glass. It references
many of Coach's iconic codes: a turn lock spray cap, faux-leather
hangtag, and Horse & Carriage logo engraving. The two-colored outer
packaging combines brushed silver and black-blue leather-grained sides
for a contrasting effect.

name: Costume National Scent Intense Red Edition Parfum for Man

name: Creed Absolu Aventus 2025 Eau de Parfum for Men

Creed Absolu Aventus 2025 is a fruity, spicy take on the Aventus family.
Launched in 2025, it opens with black currant, grapefruit, pineapple, bergamot, lemon and pink pepper. Cardamom, ginger and cinnamon form a warm, spicy heart, and patchouli and vetiver give it an earthy finish.
Versatile and confident, it works in every season, day or night.

name: Creed Absolu Aventus Eau de Parfum for Men

base: Vetiver linger to make a lasting impression
key: Vetiver linger to make a lasting impression

name: Creed Absolu Aventus Triple-Aged Batch Eau de Parfum for Men

name: Creed Acqua Fiorentina Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
The setting for this scent is 15th century Florence, Italy. An artful
portrait of the countryside, its orchards brimming lightly with sweet
plums, bergamot, and lemony blooms. A lively touch of apple marks sixty
vibrant years of Queen Elizabeth's reign, along with beautiful
Renaissance roses, greengage plums, Virginia cedar, and white carnation.
This long-awaited fruity-floral encore offers a fresh, youthful scent
that will delight for any occasion. Made in France.
TOP NOTES
Greengage plum
Apple
HEART NOTES
Rose
White carnations
Bergamot
Lemon
BASE NOTES
Virginia cedar
Sandalwood
White grapefruit

name: Creed Acqua Originale Vetiver Geranium Eau de Parfum For Women

notes.source_text: Drawing inspiration from the lush, untamed terrain of Indonesia, Vétiver Géranium brings an earthy, woody elegance to the Acqua Originale line. At its heart lies the wild vetiver that blankets Indonesia’s misty mountains, harmonized by the gentle, floral calm of geranium. The journey begins with a sparkling burst of crisp apple, bright bergamot, and zesty lemon, easing into a warmly spiced accord of cinnamon and delicate rose. Finally, a rich tapestry of patchouli, cedarwood, and soft musk weaves through the base, offering a captivating play of contrasts—where fresh vitality meets deep, grounding woods.

name: Creed Aventus Cologne Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Creed Aventus Cologne is a lighter, fresher take on the Aventus spirit.
Olivier Creed created it in 2018. Mandarin, ginger and pink pepper open bright and zesty, vetiver, patchouli and sandalwood form the heart, and musk, birch, tonka bean and styrax give it a clean, smoky finish.
A great daytime choice for spring and summer, the office and everyday wear.

Aventus Cologne by Creed is a Aromatic Fruity fragrance for men. This is a new fragrance. Aventus Cologne was launched in 2018. The nose behind this fragrance is Olivier Creed.
Top Notes: Pineapple, Green apple, mint, ginger, mandarin orange and
pink pepper;
Middle Notes Patchouli, sandalwood and vetiver
Base Notes Musk, styrax, birch and tonka bean.

name: Creed Aventus Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Creed Aventus is the smoky, fruity signature that became a modern legend.
Created by Olivier Creed and his son Erwin in 2010, it opens with juicy pineapple, black currant, bergamot and apple. Birch and patchouli bring the famous smoky edge, softened by Moroccan jasmine and rose, before a dry-down of musk, oakmoss, ambergris and a touch of vanilla.
Aventus is confident without trying too hard, which is why it works almost anywhere: the office, a weekend lunch or a night out. It shines from spring through fall, and a sample is the easiest way to see why so many people call it their signature.

The exceptional Aventus was inspired
by the dramatic life of a historic emperor, celebrating strength, power
and success. Introduced in 2010 and crafted by the deft hand of Sixth
Generation Master Perfumer Olivier Creed in collaboration with his son
Erwin, this scent has grown to become the best-selling fragrance in the
history of the brand. Olivier created its iconic name derived from A ("from") ventus
("the wind"), illustrating the Aventus man as destined to live a driven
life, ever galloping with the wind at his back toward success. Aventus
is a sophisticated blend for individuals who savor a life well-lived.
Aventus  Notes
Bergamot, blackcurrant leaves, apple, pineapple, pinkberries, birch, patchouli, jasmine, musk, oakmoss, ambergris, vanilla

name: Creed Aventus For Her Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Creed Aventus for Her is a bright, fruity floral with a green apple sparkle.
Olivier Creed created it in 2016. Green apple, bergamot, lemon, pink pepper and violet open fresh, musk, rose, sandalwood and styrax form the heart, and black currant, peach, amber, ylang-ylang and lilac give it a soft finish.
A daytime favorite for spring and summer, the office and everyday wear.

Details & Care
What it is: A fragrance that marks the irresistible feminine counterpart to the legendary Aventus.
Fragrance story:
Nearly three years in the making, this olfactory celebration of strong
women was highly anticipated before its triumphant unveiling by The
House of Creed. Aventus for Her is inspired by some of history's most
powerful women—empresses, queens and heads of state, who were Creed's
clients—as well as modern women everywhere who confidently shatter glass
ceilings. The Aventus for Her spirit lives in every woman. She is
poised with inner strength and radiance, and leaves an indelible mark on
all she touches. To be near her is to feel the presence of greatness.
Style: Floral, fresh.
Notes:
- Top: Egyptian green apple, pink berries, Indonesian patchouli, Italian bergamot.
- Middle: Bulgarian rose, Turkish rose, Indian sandalwood, styrax, musk.
- Base: sweet peach, cassis, lilac, amber, ylang-ylang.
Made in France

name: Creed Bois Du Portugal Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Creed Bois du Portugal is a refined, classic blend of lavender and woods.
Olivier Creed created it in 1987. Bergamot opens bright, lavender forms an elegant aromatic heart, and sandalwood, cedar, vetiver and ambergris give it a smooth, woody finish.
Timeless and versatile, it suits the office, weekends and evenings from spring through winter.

Bois Du Portugal Cologne by Creed,
Encounter a fantasy of rich woodland landscapes with Bois du Portugal, a
spirited men’s fragrance
. This warm and
sophisticated cologne dazzles the mind and the senses with its woody and
spicy accords. Opening with the fresh, rejuvenating scent of bergamot
evokes an atmosphere of high energy and sparkling refreshment.
Meanwhile, the middle note of soothing lavender contradicts that
intensity with its therapeutic floral remedy. Finally, base notes of
marine
ambergris, light cedar, sandalwood and vetiver balance the entire
fragrance with their neutral accords for an intoxicating aroma that’s
powerful yet not overbearing. Perfect for day wear at the office or a
casual weekend afternoon.
Created by the sixth generation family
member Olivier Creed, this 1987 Oriental stunner encompasses the
long-lasting artistry and vision of the Creed fragrance line. Founded in
1760, this innovative brand has produced over 79 fragrances for the
general public and royal figures alike, encased in elegant glass flacons
that represent the refined and authentic perfumes within.

name: Creed Carmina Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Creed Carmina is a rich, spicy rose with black cherry and saffron.
Launched in 2023, it opens with saffron, black cherry and pink pepper. May rose, peony, cashmere wood and violet form a lush heart, and myrrh, frankincense, amber and musk give it a warm finish.
Elegant and warm, it suits special evenings.

name: Creed Centaurus Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Creed Centaurus is a warm, spicy blend of tobacco, cinnamon and vanilla.
Launched in 2024, it opens with cinnamon, tobacco, cardamom and black pepper. Sandalwood, heliotrope, patchouli and jasmine form the heart, and benzoin, Bourbon vanilla, tonka bean and ambroxan give it a rich finish.
Made for fall and winter, day or night.

name: Creed Citrus Bigarade Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Citrus Bigarrade by Creed is a Citrus fragrance for women and men. Citrus Bigarrade was launched in 1901. The nose behind this fragrance is Henry Creed Fourth Generation. Top notes are Citruses and Bergamot; middle note is Neroli; base note is Ambergris.

name: Creed Delphinus Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Creed Delphinus is a refined blend of iris, incense and vanilla.
Launched in 2024, it opens with iris, moves into an incense heart and settles into a smooth vanilla.
Versatile in spring, fall and winter, day or night.

name: Creed Eladaria Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Creed Eladaria is a soft, powdery floral with a musky glow.
Launched in 2025, it opens with pink pepper, mandarin and bergamot. Rose, lily of the valley, powdery notes and peony form the heart, and ambroxan, cashmere wood, vanilla and musk give it a clean finish.
Elegant in every season, day or night.

name: Creed Erolfa Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Creed Erolfa is a fresh, aquatic citrus inspired by the sea.
Olivier Creed created it in 1992. Bergamot, lime, melon, lemon and green notes open bright, herbal notes, pine, ginger, jasmine and pepper form the heart, and ambergris, musk, sandalwood, oakmoss and cedar give it a clean finish.
A spring and summer favorite for the office, the gym and everyday wear.

Erolfa Cologne by Creed, With a refreshing
blend of aromas, Erolfa cologne is suitable for any man on any occasion.
This fragrance launched in 1992
. It composition includes notes of coriander, citrus, cedarwood and basil, making it perfect for wearing during the day.
This cologne comes from Creed, a luxury fragrance company that truly
lives up to that title. The company was first founded in 1760, and over
the course of several centuries, it has been passed down from father to
son. The brand
is
currently being led by the sixth generation in the family. The brand has
been responsible for developing fragrances based on royal commissions.
In fact, in 1781, the company received such a decree from King George
III, and the result was Royal English Leather. The brand’s royal status
was cemented further in 1885 when Queen Victoria declared the company as
the official supplier of perfumes to the British royal court.

name: Creed Fantasia de Fleurs Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text: Fantasia de Fleurs by Creed is a Floral fragrance for women. Fantasia de Fleurs was launched in 1862. The nose behind this fragrance is Henry Creed Third Generation. Top note is Bergamot; middle notes are Bulgarian Rose and Iris; base note is Ambergris.

name: Creed Fleur de The Rose Bulgare Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text: Fleur de The Rose Bulgare by Creed is a Floral Green fragrance for women. Fleur de The Rose Bulgare was launched in 1890. The nose behind this fragrance is Henry Creed Third Generation. Top notes are Bergamot and Citruses; middle notes are Bulgarian Rose and Green Tea Flower; base note is Ambergris.

name: Creed Fleurissimo Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
A sophisticated blend of high-fashion glamour and elegant aristocracy, the scent marries tuberose, violet, iris and Bulgarian rose. Fleurissimo will evoke the beautiful essence of a bride in any woman for her most special occasions, ensuring all eyes in the room are on her.
Style: Floral, fresh.
Notes:
- Top: bergamot, violet leaves.
- Middle: Bulgarian rose, tuberose, ylang-ylang.
- Base: Florentine iris, ambergris.

name: Creed Fleurs de Bulgarie Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text: Fleurs de Bulgarie by Creed is a Floral fragrance for women. Fleurs de Bulgarie was launched in 1845. The nose behind this fragrance is Henry Creed Third Generation. Top note is Bergamot; middle note is Bulgarian Rose; base notes are Musk and Ambergris.

name: Creed Fleurs de Gardenia Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Fleurs de Gardenia by Creed is a Floral Green fragrance for women. Fleurs de Gardenia
was launched in 2012. The nose behind this fragrance is Olivier Creed.
Top notes are Galbanum, Pink Pepper and Black Currant; middle notes are
Gardenia, Peony, Lily-of-the-Valley, Pink Jasmine and Rose; base notes
are Musk, Virginia Cedar and Patchouli.

name: Creed Floralie Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text: Creed Floralie is a unique new fragrance in partnership with Neiman Marcus department store. Floralie has notes of rose, tubeorse, and other florals and oriental basenotes such as amber and woods.

name: Creed Fragaria Eau de Parfum For Women

notes.source_text: Fragaria by Creed is a captivating Floral Fruity fragrance designed for women, introduced in 2025. This new scent features top notes of Pink Pepper, Mandarin, and Bergamot, evolving into a heart of Violet and Strawberry, and finishing with warm base notes of Vetiver and Cedarwood.

name: Creed Green Irish Tweed Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Creed Green Irish Tweed is a classic of clean, green elegance.
Olivier Creed and Pierre Bourdon created it in 1985. Lemon verbena and iris open crisp and bright, violet leaf gives it a cool green heart, and sandalwood and ambergris settle into a soft, fresh-woody finish.
Green Irish Tweed feels timeless and effortlessly put together. It is an easy daytime scent for the office, weekends and even the gym, from spring through fall, and it never feels overpowering.

Green Irish Tweed Cologne by Creed, This sporty mix is sure to make any man feel like a famous movie star
. With hints of violet
leaves, Mysore sandalwood, Florentine iris, ambergris, and French
verbena, Green Irish Tweed is known for its longevity and reasonable
sillage. Though certainly not overpowering, its refreshing and luxurious
aroma lingers on the mind long after its wearer has departed the room.
Furthermore, it's widely considered to be one of the defining scents of
the brand’s
catalogue. Green Irish Tweed was first released in 1985 and originally
made for Hollywood icon Cary Grant. Creed has a long and storied history
in the fragrance world with over 250 years in business. Founded by
James Henry Creed after designing a fragrance for King George III, the
company’s products present a modernized scent of past triumphs. Many
iconic figures throughout history have enjoyed the company's products,
including Queen Maria Cristina of Spain, Emperor Franz-Josef of
Austria-Hungary, and Empress Eugenie of France.

name: Creed Himalaya Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Creed Himalaya is a crisp, clean citrus with soft sandalwood and musk.
Olivier and Erwin Creed created it in 2002. Calabrian bergamot, grapefruit and Sicilian lemon open fresh, sandalwood forms a smooth heart, and cedar, musk and ambergris give it a clean finish.
Easy to wear from spring through fall, for the office, the gym and everyday.

Details & Care
What it is: Himalaya is the embodiment of pure confidence and rugged masculinity.
Fragrance story: Fusing the power of man and nature, Himalaya was created to commemorate master perfumer Olivier Creed’s daring climb in the beautiful but treacherous Himalayan mountains. A seductive scent of citrus mixes with warmer notes of sandalwood and cedarwood to recreate the snowcapped Tibetan landscape. It is presented in an attractive metallic bottle, co-designed with Erwin Creed, that resembles a climber’s canteen and the silvery look of alpine ice.
Style: Woody, fresh.
Notes:
- Top: begamot, grapefruit, lemon, mandarin.
- Middle: pinkberries, nutmeg, cedarwood, sandalwood, vetiver, pepper.
- Base: ambergris, musk, tonka bean.
Made in France

name: Creed Iris Debonair Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Creed Iris Debonair is an elegant aromatic built around iris, fig and lavender.
Launched in 2026, it opens with bergamot, pink pepper, cardamom and wormwood. Lavender, fig and violet leaf form a fresh, green heart, and iris pallida, amberwood and ambrette leave a soft, powdery finish.
Iris Debonair is refined and quietly confident, an easy way to wear iris for the first time. It works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

name: Creed Irisia Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text: Creed's Irisia presents a symphony of Floral Green scents tailored for feminine allure, first introduced to the world in 1968. The olfactory artistry of James Henry Creed gives life to this timeless aroma. An invigorating opening of Bergamot, Mandarin Orange, Peach, and Mimosa leads to a heart rich with the notes of iris, Violet, and Tuberose. Completing this elegant fragrance is a grounded finish featuring Oakmoss, Amber, Patchouli, Ambergris, Sandalwood, Cedar, and a whisper of Vanilla.

name: Creed Jardin D'Amalfi Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Creed expands the Royal Exclusives line with three limited
edition fragrances launched in 2011: Jardin d'Amalfi, Original Cologne
and White Flowers. These fragrances celebrate the 250th anniversary of
the house.
Jardin d'Amalfi celebrates the lush summer gardens of Italy's Amalfi coast.
A CREED Royal Exclusive, Jardin D’Amalfi is packaged in a hand-blown Pochet glass bottle etched with CREED’s crest. The cut-glass cap reveals an open-neck pour.
Top notes: mandarin, bergamot, lemon, pink pepper and petit grain.
Heart: cedar, rose and apple. Base: vetiver, white musk and cinnamon.

name: Creed Jasmin Imperatrice Eugenie Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text: Jasmin Imperatrice Eugenie by Creed is a Floral Woody Musk fragrance for women. Jasmin Imperatrice Eugenie was launched in 1989. The nose behind this fragrance is Olivier Creed. Top note is Bergamot; middle notes are Italian Jasmine, Ambergris and Bulgarian Rose; base notes are Sandalwood and Vanille.

name: Creed Love in Black Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Love in Black is a perfume for
women introduced in 2008. Inspired by former first lady Jacqueline
Kennedy, the fragrance is composed of ingredients from the places this
intriguing public figure visited and loved.
Top notes encompass Italian violet, night-blooming jasmine and cedar
from Virginia. The heart adds Florentine iris, cloves and Tonkin musk,
while the base introduces Bourgogne black currant and Bulgarian rose.
The flacon is created from black sand like that of the Greek isles. This
edition celebrates magic of each woman and evening elegance, which is
completed by a ribbon bow on the neck of the bottle. Love in Black was created by Olivier Creed Sixth Generation and Erwin Creed Seventh Generation.

name: Creed Love in White Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Creed Love in White is a soft, powdery white floral with a hint of rice.
Olivier and Erwin Creed created it in 2005. Orange peel opens bright, rice, iris, narcissus, magnolia, jasmine and rose form the heart, and vanilla, sandalwood and ambergris give it a soft finish.
Elegant for spring and summer days, the office and everyday wear.

What it is: An ode to Creed’s sophisticated
craftsmanship and passion for the world’s finest ingredients, Love In
White combines hand-selected essences from five continents, a fragrant
statement of global unity and peace.
Fragrance story:
The scent is pure freedom—a floral-fresh blend grounded by Florentine
iris, French daffodils, and subdued, powdery Tonkin rice. Love In White
was honored on its launch day by a tribute—New York City’s Empire State
Building illuminated by pure white lights.
Style: Floral, fresh.
Notes:
- Top: orange zest from Italy.
- Middle: Florentine iris, French daffodils, magnolia, Bulgarian rose, Tonkin rice.
- Base: vanilla, ambergris, Mysore sandalwood.
Made in France

name: Creed Love In White for Summer Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text: Love in White for Summer by Creed is a Floral fragrance for women. Love in White for Summer was launched in 2018. Top notes are Calabrian bergamot, Magnolia and Bulgarian Rose; middle notes are Rice, Tuscan Iris and Virginia Cedar; base notes are Apple, Ambergris, Sandalwood and Jasmine.

name: Creed Millesime 1849 Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Launched in 2013, Millesime 1849 by Creed is a Woody Aromatic fragrance crafted by the renowned nose Olivier Creed. It is designed for both women and men and its top note is Calabrian bergamot. Its middle notes are Ylang-Ylang, Jasmine, Patchouli and Cedar, while its base notes are Sandalwood, Bourbon Vanilla, Agarwood (Oud) and Musk.

name: Creed Millesime Imperial Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Creed Millésime Impérial is a sunny, salty citrus fragrance.
Olivier Creed created it in 1995. Fruity notes and sea salt open bright, Sicilian lemon, iris, bergamot and mandarin form the heart, and sea notes, musk and woods give it a clean, breezy finish.
A spring and summer favorite for the office, the gym, weekends and date nights.

Millesime Imperial Cologne by Creed, Warmth and romance exude throughout the composition for Millesime Imperial cologne
. It is a unisex
fragrance, making it appropriate for men and women alike. It opens with a
luxurious citrusy, marine aroma and includes top notes of sea salt and
fruits. The heart consists of mandarin orange, bergamot, lemon and iris.
It rounds out nicely in the base comprised of marine notes, woody
scents and musk. This fragrance came out in 1995, and it is meant to
evoke
imagery of spending time by the Sicilian oceanside.
This
cologne is made available by Creed, which is one of the oldest
fragrance manufacturers in the world. An even more impressive aspect is
the fact the company has remained within the same family for all those
centuries. It has been passed down from father to son ever since 1760.
It is currently on its sixth generation, and the brand is responsible
for creating fragrances meant for royalty.

name: Creed Neroli Sauvage Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Neroli Sauvage by Creed is a captivating Citrus Aromatic fragrance suitable for both women and men. Introduced in 1994, this scent was crafted by perfumer Olivier Creed. The fragrance opens with vibrant top notes of Bergamot and Grapefruit, leading into a heartfelt blend of Verbena and Neroli at its core, and concludes with a rich base note of Ambergris.

Neroli Sauvage Cologne by Creed, Released
in 1994, Neroli Sauvage, which means “wild orange tree blossom” in
Italian, was designed to bring out the
animalistic yet elegant
side of the masculine wearer. The blend opens with fresh notes of
bergamot and grapefruit, before cascading down into a heart of neroli
and lemon verbena notes. Base notes of ambergris give this untamed
fragrance a deep and mysterious essence while aromatically enhancing the
top and middle notes. This unique blend is ideal
for a fun night out on the town.
Creed,
the world’s only dynastic, privately owned luxury fragrance company,
was founded in 1760. The company has been passed down from generation to
generation for its entire lifeline, serving both the public and royalty
for the last 251 years. Queen Victoria of England appointed the brand
as the official supplier to the British Court in 1885. Today the brand
has over 70 fragrances in its collection. The most recent fragrance
launch was in 2017.

name: Creed Original Santal Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Creed Original Santal is a warm, spiced sandalwood with vanilla.
Olivier Creed, Erwin Creed and Pierre Bourdon created it in 2005. Juniper berries, cinnamon, sandalwood and coriander open warm, ginger, lavender, rosemary and petitgrain form an aromatic heart, and vanilla and tonka bean give it a smooth finish.
Versatile in spring, fall and winter, for the office and weekends.

India’s royal and spiritual splendor meet in Original Santal. Looking to Asia for inspiration, Olivier and Erwin combine Mysore sandalwood, fiery cinnamon, warm vanilla, and tonka bean. Prepare for compliments.
Style: Wood, oriental, rich.
Notes:
- Top: orange tree absolute, Jamaican ginger, Sicilian lemon.
- Middle: lavender, peppermint, rosemary, pinkberries.
- Base: Mysore sandalwood, Virginia cedar, vanilla, Siam benzoin, ambergris, Tonkin musk.

name: Creed Original Vetiver Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Creed Original Vetiver is a clean, crisp vetiver with fresh citrus and spice.
Olivier and Erwin Creed created it in 2004. Bergamot, ginger and mandarin open fresh, Haitian vetiver, sandalwood and iris form an elegant heart, and musk and ambergris give it a soft, clean finish.
A refined daytime scent for spring and summer and a natural fit for the office.

Creed Original Vetiver is a Unisex fragrance, The fragrance launched in 2004, The nose behind this fragrance is Erwin Creed, Olivier Creed,
Top Note: Bergamot, Ginger, Mandarin Orange
Heart Note: Haitian Vetiver, Sandalwood, iris
Base Note: Musk, Ambergris

name: Creed Oud Zarian Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Creed Oud Zarian is a warm, spiced oud with rose and frankincense.
Launched in 2025, it opens with frankincense, bergamot, ginger and spices. May rose forms the heart, and sandalwood, tonka bean, patchouli, licorice, myrrh and oud give it depth.
A rich choice for evenings.

name: Creed Pure White Cologne Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Pure White Cologne calls to mind the impeccable style of men during the Victorian Age, well-groomed and sharply tailored, like a crisp white shirt perfectly made to measure. This citrus-fresh blend gives way to an understated sweetness and powdery elegance reminiscent of the fine mist of a foggy London afternoon.
FRAGRANCE CATEGORY: Citrus/Fresh
TOP NOTES
Lemon
Bergamot
Grapefruit
HEART NOTES
Galbanum
Pear
Petite grain
BASE NOTES
Ambergris
White Musk
Rice powder

name: Creed Queen of Silk Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Creed Queen of Silk is a luxurious blend of magnolia, tuberose and oud.
Launched in 2024, it opens with magnolia, saffron and osmanthus. Passion fruit, tuberose, patchouli and oud form a rich heart, and myrrh, ambroxan, cedarwood, vanilla and incense give it a warm finish.
Elegant in spring, fall and winter, day or night.

name: Creed Royal Mayfair Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Royal Mayfair Cologne by Creed, Introduced
in 2015, Royal Mayfair is a fruity, floral fragrance that was created
for men and women
. Named after the posh,
London neighborhood of Mayfair, this gourmand scent is a fresh and
imaginative experience. This original scent was a bespoke creation for
the Duke of Windsor; however, 80 years after the original was made, it
is now available to you. The top notes are composed of gin, lime and
pine tree. The heart centers around the perfect floral experience
of a rose. The base notes finish with orange, cedar and eucalyptus.
Before becoming a niche fragrance house, Creed was a tailoring company
that was started in London, but eventually moved its headquarters to
Paris. Beginning in the 1980s, the business developed a positive
reputation around its colognes and perfumes. One of the reasons the
business can sometimes go years between releasing a new fragrance is
that it doesn’t follow a strict release schedule and only sells a
product when it’s ready.

name: Creed Royal Oud Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Creed Royal Oud is a refined, airy oud with bright citrus and spice.
Olivier Creed and Julien Rasquinet created it in 2011. Sicilian bergamot, lemon and pink pepper open fresh, angelica, cedar and galbanum form a green, woody heart, and musk, oud and sandalwood give it a smooth, elegant finish.
A sophisticated oud for spring, fall and winter, and a great choice for date nights.

Royal Oud Cologne by Creed, Released in 2011, Royal Oud is a synthesis of Parisian and Persian style and grace
. It incorporates
elements of a Persian palace with marble, wood, leather and gold along
with the historical components of its personal design house. The rarity
of oud makes it a treasured scent note, and to own a fragrance that
features it so strongly is a fortunate occurrence. The top notes are a
citrusy mixture of lemon, Sicilian bergamot and pink pepper. The heart
notes reach out
with galbanum, cedar and angelica root. The base is a luxurious finish of oud, sandalwood and musk.
For the last 250 years, Creed has been making bespoke fragrances for
royalty and savvy patrons. Using a rare infusion method to capture the
essence of many beautiful scents, the company sets itself apart from the
standard perfume company. Today, the entire production process is still
done by hand as an expert perfumer weights, measures, mixes, macerates
and filters to perfection.

name: Creed Royal Princess Oud Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Royal Princess Oud by Creed is a Oriental Floral fragrance for women. Royal Princess Oud was launched in 2015. The nose behind this fragrance is Olivier Creed .
Top notes are bergamot, rose and violet; middle notes are jasmine,
vanilla absolute, patchouli and tuscan iris; base notes are siam
benzoin, sandalwood, styrax and agarwood (oud).

name: Creed Royal Water Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Royal Water by Creed is a refreshing Citrus Aromatic fragrance suitable for both men and women. Launched in 1997, this scent was crafted by perfumer Olivier Creed. It opens with vibrant top notes of citrus and mint, transitions into a heart of juniper berries and basil, and settles into a warm base of musk and ambergris.

Royal Water Cologne by Creed, This stately, regal men’s fragrance was released in 1997
. Royal Water is an
inviting, invigorating blend, featuring fresh top notes of mint and
assorted citruses. Middle notes of basil and juniper berry add a heady
sharpness to the blend, while base notes of ambergris and musk provide a
solid, earthy foundation that combines with the top and middle to
create a luxuriously masculine fragrance both men and women will adore.
Creed is one of the oldest perfume houses
in
the business, having been founded in 1760 and passed down from
generation to generation since its beginnings. The brand was founded in
London, but relocated to Paris in 1854 at the request of a royal client.
The brand became well known around the world for catering to the royal
elite. In 1885, Queen Victoria of English named the brand as the
official supplier for the British court. Today the brand has 80
fragrances in its collection.

name: Creed Selection Verte Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Selection Verte by Creed is a Citrus Aromatic fragrance for women and men. Selection Verte was launched in 1901. The nose behind this fragrance is Henry Creed Fourth Generation. Top notes are Citruses, Neroli and Pepper; middle notes are Mint and Herbal Notes; base note is Ambergris.

name: Creed Silver Mountain Water Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Creed Silver Mountain Water is a crisp, sparkling scent inspired by fresh mountain air.
Olivier Creed created it in 1995. Bergamot and mandarin open bright, green tea and black currant form a cool, fruity heart, and musk, petitgrain, sandalwood and galbanum give it a clean, airy finish.
A daytime classic for spring and summer, easy to wear to the office, on weekends and after the gym.

Creed Silver Mountain Water is a Unisex fragrance, The fragrance launched in 1995, The nose behind this fragrance is Olivier Creed,
Top Note: Bergamot, Mandarin Orange
Heart Note: Green Tea, Black Currant
Base Note: Musk, Petitgrain, Sandalwood, Galbanum

name: Creed Spice and Wood Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Spice and Wood celebrates The House of CREED's long history of weaving scents into a fragrant story as part of the Les Royales Exclusives Collection. The blend's tenacious opening of sun-drenched lemon, warm clove and aromatic apple settles into rich notes of cedarwood, calling to mind the ancient banks of the timber-lined Nile. Spice and Wood mingles powerful depth with alluring refinement.
Style: Woody, fresh.
Notes:
- Top: apple, bergamot, lemon.
- Middle: angelic root, pinkberries, vetiver, patchouli, cloves, pimento (Jamaican pepper), birch.
- Base: iris, cedarwood, oakmoss, Tonkin musk.

name: Creed Spring Flower 2023 Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Spring Flower 2023 by Creed is a Floral Fruity fragrance for women. This is a new fragrance. Spring Flower 2023
was launched in 2023.
Top notes are Grapefruit, Lemon, Bergamot and
Green Notes.
Middle notes are White Flowers, Jasmine, Apricot and Peach.
Base notes are Ambergris, Musk and Cedar.

name: Creed Spring Flower Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
CREED made Spring Flower as the signature scent of a
film legend, fashion icon and renowned humanitarian. This pink and
pretty scent was released to the public many years later.
Spring Flower is a fresh and feminine fragrance that includes
notes of peach, melon and apple in the top. The heart includes jasmine
and rose. Musk and ambergris form the base.

name: Creed Sublime Vanille Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Those who encounter Sublime Vanille are powerless to resist its hypnotic spell, willfully surrendering to its heady decadence. A provocative blend of vanilla and Tonka bean, Sublime Vanille is rendered mysterious with sparkling notes of lemon. The result is a universal soft oriental, nearly gourmand scent for both him and her, from newcomers and devotees of vanilla to fragrance connoisseurs who wish to add a true asset to their curated collection.
Style: Soft oriental.
Notes:
- Top: vanilla from Comoros, Tonka bean.
- Middle: white bergamot, lemon.
- Base: Tonkin musk.

name: Creed Tabarome Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Creed Tabarome is a warm, classic blend of tobacco, ginger and leather.
Olivier Creed created it in 2000. Bergamot and tangerine open bright, ginger forms a spicy heart, and tobacco, sandalwood, ambergris, leather and patchouli give it a rich finish.
Versatile in spring, fall and winter, for the office and everyday.

Tabarome was originally created for a British statesman known for his love of brandy and fine cigars. The name "Tabarome" honors the tobacco aroma that gives this fragrance a touch of luxury.
The word millesime appears on many CREED fragrance
bottles and is a mark of quality. The millesime designation means that
the best crops from a particular year’s harvest were used in the
creation of that particular bottle of CREED fragrance.
The top notes of Tabarome include bergamot and tangerine. The
heart includes ginger. Base notes consist of sandalwood, patchouli,
ambergris, tobacco and leather. Tabarome was launched in 2000. The nose behind this fragrance is Olivier Creed Sixth Generation.

name: Creed Tubereuse Indiana Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text: Tubereuse Indiana by Creed is a Floral fragrance for women. Tubereuse Indiana was launched in 1980. The nose behind this fragrance is Olivier Creed. Top note is Bergamot; middle note is Indian Tuberose; base notes are Ambergris and Vanilla.

name: Creed Vanisia Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Vanisia by Creed is a Amber fragrance for women. Vanisia was launched in 1987. The nose behind this fragrance is Olivier Creed. Top note is Bergamot; middle notes are Bulgarian Rose and Jasmine; base notes are Amber, Sandalwood, Ambergris and Vanille.
From the Creed website: CREED created Vanisia for the queen of Spain who happened to be the great niece of Marie Antoinette of France. After assuming the throne, the Spanish queen wished to make a style statement like her French relative. She commissioned from CREED a fragrance that was rich, sensual and mysterious, with undertones of Spanish woods and rich vanilla: the unforgettable Vanisia.
The top note of Vanisia is Bergamot. Middle notes include jasmine and Bulgarian rose. Base notes encompass sandalwood, vanilla, amber and ambergris.

name: Creed Vetiver Geranium Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text: Vetiver Geranium by Creed is a Woody Floral Musk fragrance for men. Vetiver Geranium was launched in 2014. Top notes are Granny Smith apple, Lemon and Bergamot; middle notes are Geranium, Rose and Cinnamon; base notes are Cedar, Patchouli, Musk, Vetiver and Amber.

name: Creed Viking Cologne Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Creed Viking Cologne is a fresh, aromatic take on Viking.
Olivier and Erwin Creed created it in 2021. Mandarin, pink pepper, lemon and bergamot open bright, geranium, lavender, nutmeg, rosemary and sage form the heart, and olibanum, vetiver, sandalwood and cedar give it a clean finish.
Versatile from spring through fall, day or night.

Viking Cologne by Creed is a Aromatic Fougere fragrance for men. This is a new fragrance. Viking Cologne
was launched in 2021. Viking Cologne was created by Olivier Creed and
Erwin Creed. Top notes are Mandarin Orange, Pink Pepper, Lemon and
Bergamot; middle notes are Geranium, Lavender, Nutmeg, Rosemary and
Sage; base notes are Olibanum, Vetiver, Sandalwood, Cedar and Patchouli.

name: Creed Viking Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Creed Viking is a spicy, peppery fragrance with a fresh, minty opening.
Olivier Creed created it in 2017. Absinthe, pink pepper, bergamot, lemon, orange and spicy mint open bright, lavender, clove, allspice, jasmine and rose form the heart, and white musk, cedar, tonka bean and vetiver give it depth.
Versatile and confident, it works in every season, from the office to date night.

Viking Cologne by Creed, Viking by Creed is a powerful blend of aromatic and green accords
. Introduced in 2016, it
is an ultra-masculine fragrance, full of strong and robust scents. The
cologne opens with pink pepper, black currant and bergamot, starting the
fragrance with spiciness and tartness. Next, the heart opens up, with
rose, mint and more pepper. The fragrance finishes with lavender,
patchouli, vetiver and sandalwood. The floral scents are tempered by the
fresh green scents and warm
woody notes, creating a balanced ,manly cologne.
Creed was founded in 1760 by James Henry Creed. It has the distinction
of being one of the only perfume houses in which the art of fragrance
creation has been handed down, father to son, for over 250 years. Since
its founding, Creed has created fragrances for royalty and nobility
across Europe. It was not until the 1970s that the company began to
mass-produce fragrances for the public. Creed prides itself on using the
finest ingredients and age-old techniques.

name: Creed Virgin Island Water Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Creed Virgin Island Water is a tropical escape of coconut, lime and white rum.
Olivier and Erwin Creed created it in 2007. Coconut, lime, bergamot and mandarin open bright, ginger, ylang-ylang, jasmine and hibiscus form a sunny heart, and white rum, sugar cane and musk give it a sweet, breezy finish.
A summer favorite for daytime, the office and everyday wear.

Virgin Island Water Cologne by Creed, Virgin Island Water is an exotic paradise in aromatic form
. The bright, refreshing
cologne, released in 2007, brings you all of the delicious aromas of the
tropics. The composition starts with a fruity blend of white bergamot,
Sicilian mandarin, and Jamaican lime. Tropical copra adds the smooth,
milky scent of coconut. The heart is a rich blend of seductive florals.
Jasmine, ylang-ylang, and hibiscus add a velvety freshness before being
cooled by a spicy
jolt of crisp ginger. The sweet base is an irresistible mix of sugar
cane, white rum, and musk. Spritz this exciting cologne on any time you
need a relaxing escape.
James Henry Creed established his
perfumery in 1760 in London. The company is now based in Paris but has
been run by the same family since its beginning. It has seen seven
different generations of perfumers. The celebrated brand received its
first royal commission from King George III in 1781.

name: Creed White Amber Eau de Parfum Unisex
