notes.source_text: White Amber by Creed is a Oriental Floral fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. White Amber was launched in 2017. The nose behind this fragrance is Olivier Creed. Top note is fruits; middle notes are jasmine and benzoin; base notes are amber and sandalwood.

name: Creed White Flowers Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Crafted from hand-picked ingredients by sixth-generation master perfumer Olivier Creed, this crisp floral blend became the third bottle in Creed's Les Royals Exclusives collection. Serene and composed, White Flowers embraces its wearer like a jasmine vine with delicate divinity—a work of art in both form and fragrance.
Style: Floral, rich.
Notes:
- Top: violet leaves, green apple, lemon.
- Middle: jasmine, geranium, rose.
- Base: musk, sandalwood, narcissus.

name: Creed Wild Vetiver Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Creed Wild Vetiver is a fresh, fruity vetiver with a peppery sparkle.
Launched in 2026, it opens with bergamot, pink pepper and timur. Rose, geranium and black currant form a fruity heart, and amberwood, vetiver and cedarwood give it a clean, woody finish.
A daytime favorite for spring and summer.

name: Creed Wind Flowers Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text: Wind Flowers by Creed is a Floral fragrance for women. This is a new fragrance. Wind Flowers was launched in 2021. The nose behind this fragrance is Olivier Creed. Top notes are Jasmine, Orange Blossom and Peach; middle notes are Jasmine Sambac, Rose and Tuberose; base notes are Musk, Praline, Orange Blossom, Sandalwood and iris.

name: Creed Zeste Mandarine Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Zeste Mandarine by Creed is a Citrus Aromatic fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Zeste Mandarine
was launched in 2020. Top notes are Italian Orange and Lemon Leaf;
middle notes are Yellow Mandarin and Italian Lemon; base notes are
Indian Patchouli, Petitgrain Paraguay and Orangewood.

Zeste Mandarine Pamplemousse by Creed is a Citrus fragrance for women and men. Zeste Mandarine Pamplemousse
was launched in 1975. The nose behind this fragrance is Olivier Creed.
Top notes are Grapefruit, Bergamot and Mandarin Orange; middle note is
White Flowers; base note is Ambergris.

name: D.S. & DURGA Amber Kiso Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Amber Kiso by DS&Durga is a Woody Chypre fragrance for women and men. Amber Kiso was launched in 2018. The nose behind this fragrance is David Seth Moltz. Top notes are Cypress, Incense and Cedar; middle notes are Maple, Patchouli and iris; base notes are Leather, Hinoki and Moss.

name: D.S. & DURGA Amber Teutonic Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Amber Teutonic by DS&Durga is a Woody Spicy fragrance for women and men. Amber Teutonic was launched in 2018. The nose behind this fragrance is David Seth Moltz. Top notes are Cardamom, Cedar and Green Mandarin; middle notes are Silver Fir, Larch and Geranium; base notes are Opoponax, Pine and Musk.

name: D.S. & DURGA Bistro Waters Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: DS&Durga's Bistro Waters is an aromatic green scent for both men and women, debuting in 2022. It was created by the esteemed nose, David Seth Moltz, and features an inviting blend of Lime Blossom, Coriander, and Pear top notes; Green Pepper and Mandarin Orange middle notes; and a captivating base of Moss, Basil, and Nutmeg.

name: D.S. & DURGA Black Magenta Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Black Magenta, crafted by DS&Durga, is a unisex scent featuring Amber Woody tones. Recently introduced to the market in 2024, the creation of this fragrance is attributed to the olfactory expertise of perfumer David Seth Moltz. The scent's opening is characterized by a lively blend of Pineapple, Galbanum, and Black Pepper. At its heart, the perfume unveils a bouquet of Dianthus, Orris, and Orange Blossom. Anchoring the fragrance with depth and richness, the base notes consist of Black Amber, Tobacco, and Sandalwood.

name: D.S. & DURGA Bowmakers Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
D.S. & Durga Bowmakers captures a violin maker's workshop of varnish and wood.
David Seth Moltz created it in 2013. Violin varnish, mahogany and an outdoors accord open warm, amber pine rosin, maple wood and cypress form the heart, and spiced tree resin, cedar and moss give it a woody finish.
Made for fall and winter days.

Bowmakers by D.S. & Durga is a Woody Aromatic fragrance for women and men. Bowmakers was launched in 2013. The nose behind this fragrance is David Seth Moltz.

name: D.S. & DURGA Burning Barbershop Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text: Burning Barbershop by D.S. & Durga is a Aromatic fragrance for men. Burning Barbershop was launched in 2010. The nose behind this fragrance is David Seth Moltz.

name: D.S. & DURGA Coriander Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Coriander is a fresh and uplifting fragrance of green leaf notes and cracked coriander seed. It is a part of the Feminine Collection II Solos. The nose behind this fragrance is David Seth Moltz.
Notes
Russian coriander, pepper, juniper needle, geranium, clove stem, clary sage, musk, magnolia, and mace.

name: D.S. & DURGA Cowboy Grass Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Cowboy Grass by DS&Durga is a Woody Aromatic fragrance for men. The nose behind this fragrance is David Seth Moltz.

Cowboy Grass by D.S. & Durga is a Woody Aromatic fragrance for men. The nose behind this fragrance is David Seth Moltz.

name: D.S. & DURGA Crystal Pistil Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Crystal Pistil by D.S. & Durga is a Floral Aquatic fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Crystal Pistil was launched in 2020. Top notes are Orange Blossom, Water Notes and Pink Pepper; middle notes are Jasmine, Floral Notes and Paradisone; base notes are Ambrette (Musk Mallow), White Musk and Synthetic Civet.

name: D.S. & DURGA Debaser Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
D.S. & Durga Debaser is a creamy, sunny blend of fig, coconut milk and woods.
David Seth Moltz created it in 2015. Fig, coconut milk, white woods, iris and tonka bean blend into a soft, milky and slightly sweet scent.
Perfect for spring and summer days.

Debaser by D.S. & Durga is a Aromatic Fruity fragrance for women and men. Debaser was launched in 2015. The nose behind this fragrance is David Seth Moltz.

name: D.S. & DURGA Deep Dark Vanilla Eau de Parfum Unisex

base: the intense aroma of Dark Patchouli
key: the intense aroma of Dark Patchouli
notes.source_text: DS&Durga's Deep Dark Vanilla is a unisex Amber Vanilla scent that recently made its debut in 2023. Renowned perfumer David Seth Moltz crafted this alluring new scent. It opens with a delicate blend of Orchid, Cabreuva, and a hint of Pink Pepper for the top notes. The heart of the fragrance reveals a harmony of Cypress, the lushness of Vanilla Leaves, and a twist of Vine. Anchoring the fragrance are deep, rich base notes of pure Vanilla Absolute, the earthiness of Hay, and the intense aroma of Dark Patchouli.

name: D.S. & DURGA Durga Eau de Parfum for Women

base: drawing upon the richness of tuberose
the sweet intensity of jasmine sambac
key: drawing upon the richness of tuberose
the sweet intensity of jasmine sambac
notes.source_text: Durga, crafted by DS&Durga, is a women's fragrance that radiates with floral and green scents. It made its debut in 2017, with the olfactory expertise of perfumer David Seth Moltz. This scent opens with the fresh top notes of melon, tuberose, and chrysanthemum. It then transitions into a heart featuring the smooth blends of orris, ylang-ylang, and orange blossom. Anchoring the fragrance are the base notes, drawing upon the richness of tuberose, the sweet intensity of jasmine sambac, and the warmth of musk.

name: D.S. & DURGA El Cosmico Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
El Cosmico by D.S. & Durga is a Woody fragrance for women and men. El Cosmico
was launched in 2015. El Cosmico was created by David Seth Moltz and
Kavi Moltz. Top notes are Pine and Pepper; middle notes are Oak, Khella
and Creosote Bush; base notes are Khella and Sand.

name: D.S. & DURGA Freetrapper Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Before cowboys, there were free trappers. Renegade mountaineers of the Jacksonian era who cut trails through the wild in search of beaver pelts. This fragrance is dedicated to them. It consists of dark notes of cedar, pine, wild bergamot and snakeroot.
Freetrapper was launched in 2011. The nose behind this fragrance is David Seth Moltz.
Notes
Distilled incense, bergamot, bitter orange, dark cedar, snakeroot, osmanthus, amberwood, santal, and castoreum.

name: D.S. & DURGA Grapefruit Generation Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Grapefruit Generation by DS&Durga is a Citrus Aromatic fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Grapefruit Generation was launched in 2021. The nose behind this fragrance is David Seth Moltz. Top notes are Pomelo and Elm; middle notes are Paradisone, Tuberose and Hawthorn; base notes are Grapefruit, Cork and Natural Musk.

name: D.S. & DURGA I Don't Know What Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
D.S. & Durga I Don't Know What is a subtle enhancer that makes other scents glow.
David Seth Moltz created it in 2018. Bergamot opens bright, Iso E Super and vetiver form an airy heart, and amber, a soft civet accord and sandalwood give it a warm finish.
Wear it alone or layered, in any season.

I Don’t Know What by D.S. & Durga is a Woody Aromatic fragrance for women and men. I Don’t Know What
was launched in 2018. The nose behind this fragrance is David Seth
Moltz. Top note is Bergamot; middle notes are Iso E Super and Vetiver;
base notes are Amber, Synthetic Civet and Sandalwood.

name: D.S. & DURGA Italian Citrus Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Italian Citrus by D.S. & Durga is a Citrus fragrance for men. Italian Citrus was launched in 2011. The nose behind this fragrance is David Seth Moltz.

name: D.S. & DURGA Jazmin Yucatan Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Jazmin Yucatan by DS&Durga is a fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Jazmin Yucatan was launched in 2020. The nose behind this fragrance is David Seth Moltz. Top notes are Water Notes, Passion Flower and Bergamot; middle notes are Jasmine Sambac and Cloves; base notes are Copal, Snake Plant and Vetiver.

name: D.S. & DURGA Leatherize Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: In 2022, David Seth Moltz created Leatherize, a new Leather fragrance for both women and men, released by DS&Durga.

name: D.S. & DURGA Mississippi Medicine Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text: Mississippi Medicine by D.S. & Durga is a Oriental Woody fragrance for men. Mississippi Medicine was launched in 2011. The nose behind this fragrance is David Seth Moltz.

name: D.S. & DURGA Notorious Oud Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Notorious Oud by D.S. & Durga is a fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Notorious Oud was launched in 2019. Top notes are Saffron, Camphor and Galbanum; middle notes are Agarwood (Oud), Bulgarian Rose and Lavender; base notes are Papyrus, Cetalox and Civet.

name: D.S. & DURGA Pistachio Eau de Parfum Unisex

middle: rounding off with a base note of Pistachio
key: rounding off with a base note of Pistachio
notes.source_text: Pistachio, a brand new Aromatic Green fragrance from the house of DS&Durga, was released in 2022. Crafted by perfumer, David Seth Moltz, this unisex scent opens with a Pistachio top note, followed by a heart note of the same, and rounding off with a base note of Pistachio.

name: D.S. & DURGA Radio Bombay Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Transistor radio hewn of sandalwood radiates ragas in the Bandra heat. Hot copper tubes warm the soft wood releasing blooms of musk, cream, peach, ambrette, coco, cedar distillates.
Radio Bombay by D.S. & Durga is a Oriental Woody fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Radio Bombay was launched in 2016. The nose behind this fragrance is David Seth Moltz. Top notes are woody notes and cedar; middle notes are sandalwood, iris, boronia and peach; base notes are ambrette (musk mallow), sandalwood, ambergris, balsam fir, musk and coconut.

name: D.S. & DURGA Rose Atlantic Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Rose Atlantic by D.S. & Durga is a Floral Aquatic fragrance for women and men. Rose Atlantic
was launched in 2016. The nose behind this fragrance is David Seth
Moltz. Top notes are Rose Petals, Lemon and Bergamot; middle notes are
Rose, Lime (Linden) Blossom, Salt and Grass; base notes are Sea water,
Oakmoss and Musk.

name: D.S. & DURGA St. Vetyver Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: St. Vetyver by D.S. & Durga is a Amber Woody fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. St. Vetyver was launched in 2021. The nose behind this fragrance is David Seth Moltz. Top notes are Bitter Orange, Pink Pepper and Seagrass; middle notes are Hat straw, Reed and Clove Leaf; base notes are Vetiver, Breadnut and Rhum agricole.

name: D.S. & DURGA Steamed Rainbow Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: DS&Durga's Steamed Rainbow is a unisex scent with aromatic qualities that has only recently been released. The debut of this fragrance was marked in 2023. Created by perfumer David Seth Moltz, the composition opens with zesty top notes of Blood Mandarin, Orange, and Elemi. The heart of the fragrance features a blend of fresh Grass, delicate Almond Blossom, and robust Cedar. Completing the scent profile, the base is anchored by the gentle floral tone of Violet paired with the earthy essence of Vetiver.

name: D.S. & DURGA Sweet Do Nothing Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: The 2021 launch of Sweet Do Nothing by perfume creators DS&Durga is a unique Floral Woody Musk scent for both men and women. Composed by nose David Seth Moltz, this fragrance promises to be an exciting new addition to the world of scent.

name: D.S. & DURGA Vio Volta Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Vio Volta by D.S. & Durga is a Woody fragrance for women and men. Vio Volta was launched in 2017. The nose behind this fragrance is David Seth Moltz.

name: D.S. & DURGA White Peacock Lily Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
White Peacock Lily by D.S. & Durga is a Floral fragrance for women and men. White Peacock Lily
was launched in 2016. The nose behind this fragrance is David Seth
Moltz. Top notes are Nerium Oleander, Cabreuva and Grapefruit; middle
notes are White Lily, Egyptian Jasmine, Whipped cream and Violet; base
notes are Watery Notes, Ambrette (Musk Mallow) and Vanilla.

name: Daniel Josier Ambre Tabac Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text: Daniel Josier's Ambre Tabac is a scent for men with a warm, woody amber aroma. This fragrance was created by Daniel Josier himself. It features an opening of incense and bergamot, followed by a heart of sandalwood and patchouli, and a base of tobacco, amber and vanilla.

name: Daniel Josier Interdit Absente Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Interdit Absente, crafted by the perfumer Daniel Josier, is a unisex scent that falls within the aromatic fruity category. Daniel Josier himself is credited with the fragrance's creation. It opens with a refreshing blend of top notes consisting of mint, zesty pomelo, artemisia, and spicy pimento. The heart of the fragrance features a warming mixture of sharp ginger, aromatic fennel, juicy orange, and a touch of pink pepper. The base concludes with a soothing combination of frosty sorbet, creamy white woods, rich sandalwood, and sensual musk.

name: Daniel Josier Josune Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Verified fragrance notes for Daniel Josier Josune Eau de Parfum Unisex: jasmine, rose, bergamot, iris, patchouli, sandalwood, praline, vanilla, musk.

name: Daniel Josier Le Musk Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Le Musk, crafted by Daniel Josier, is a unisex fragrance that falls under the Floral Woody Musk olfactory category. Created with the artistry of Daniel Josier himself, the fragrance opens with the clean and airy scent of White Musk intertwined with the subtle herbal touch of Angelica. At its heart, the perfume balances the potent essence of Musk with the romantic allure of Rose and the depth of Woody Notes. Anchoring the scent, the base combines the rich warmth of Musk, the sweet balsamic tones of Tonka Bean, and the resinous complexity of Labdanum.

name: Daniel Josier Magnolia Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text: Daniel Josier's Magnolia is a blossoming scent crafted specifically for women, emanating a distinctly floral aroma. Conceived by the perfumer Daniel Josier himself, it opens with the zest of Bergamot, the tang of Lemon, and a burst of verdant Green Notes. Its heart flourishes with the soft and creamy petals of Magnolia, the exotic allure of Jasmine, the subtle rarity of Nard Himalayan (Jatamansi), and the classic romance of Rose. The fragrance then settles into an earthy foundation with the woody notes of Vetiver, the musky depth of Patchouli, the sweet whisper of Vanilla, and the rich warmth of Sandalwood.

name: Daniel Josier Mystery Oud Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Mystery Oud, crafted by Daniel Josier, is a unisex Amber Woody scent. The creator of this enchanting aroma is none other than Daniel Josier himself. It opens with a top note quartet composed of Violet, Cumin, Angelica, and Carrot Seeds. The heart of the fragrance beats with a blend of precious Agarwood (Oud), spicy Nutmeg, elegant Iris, mystical Incense, and warming Pimento. The scent culminates in a rich base where Agarwood (Oud) reemerges alongside Amber, supple Leather, resinous Labdanum, and sensual Musk.

name: Daniel Josier Tuberose Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Daniel Josier's Tuberose is a unisex scent that belongs to the Chypre Floral family of fragrances. Crafted by the perfumer Daniel Josier himself, this aroma opens with a vibrant blend of spice-driven top notes, featuring Nutmeg, Tagetes, zesty Grapefruit, and a hint of Pink Pepper. Transitioning into the heart of the fragrance, a lush bouquet emerges with the richness of Tuberose, the purity of White Flowers, the exotic allure of Ylang-Ylang, the sweet comfort of Heliotrope, and the subtle fruitiness of Osmanthus. The experience concludes with a warm and creamy base where Vanilla Flower dances with White Musk, deep Amber, and the earthy touch of Oakmoss.

name: Davidoff Cool Water Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Cool Water Parfum by Davidoff is a Aromatic Spicy fragrance for men. This is a new fragrance. Cool Water Parfum
was launched in 2021. Cool Water Parfum was created by Jean-Christophe
Herault and IFF. Top notes are Lemon and Pink Pepper; middle note is
Haitian Vetiver; base note is Sandalwood.

name: Dior Addict Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Dior Addict is a rich, sensual blend of orange blossom and vanilla.
François Demachy created it in 2012. Mandarin, orange blossom and silk tree blossom open bright, night-blooming cereus and Bulgarian rose form the heart, and vanilla, tonka bean and sandalwood give it a warm finish.
Made for fall and winter nights.

Dior Addict by Christian Dior is a Oriental Floral fragrance for women. Dior Addict
was launched in 2002. The nose behind this fragrance is Thierry Wasser.
Top notes are Blackberry and Mandarin Leaf; middle notes are Jasmine,
Night blooming Cereus, Orange Blossom and Rose; base notes are Vanilla,
Tonka Bean and Sandalwood.

name: Dior Addict Eau de Toilette for Women

notes.source_text:
Dior Addict Eau de Toilette by Christian Dior is a Oriental Floral fragrance for women. Dior Addict Eau de Toilette
was launched in 2014. The nose behind this fragrance is Francois
Demachy. Top note is Sicilian Mandarin; middle notes are Jasmine Sambac
and Tunisian Neroli; base notes are Vanilla and Sandalwood.

name: Dior Addict Eau Delice Eau de Toilette for Women

notes.source_text: Dior Addict Eau Delice by Dior is a Floral Fruity fragrance for women. Dior Addict Eau Delice was launched in 2013. The nose behind this fragrance is Francois Demachy. Top notes are Cranberry, Cherry, Orange and Bergamot; middle notes are Bitter Almond, Ylang-Ylang, Egyptian Jasmine, Indian Jasmine and Rose; base notes are White Musk, Vanilla and Cedar.

name: Dior Addict Eau Fraiche Eau de Toilette for Women

notes.source_text: Dior Addict Eau Fraiche 2012 by Dior is a Floral Fruity fragrance for women. Dior Addict Eau Fraiche 2012 was launched in 2012. The nose behind this fragrance is Francois Demachy. Top notes are Grapefruit and Bergamot; middle notes are Lotus, Pomegranate and Freesia; base notes are Musk and Woodsy Notes.

name: Dior Addict Peachy Glow Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text: Addict Peachy Glow Eau de Parfum by Dior is a captivating Floral Fruity Gourmand scent designed for women. Unveiled in 2025, this fragrance is a fresh addition to the collection, crafted by renowned perfumer Francis Kurkdjian. The scent opens with a vibrant top note of Peach, followed by a delicate heart of Jasmine, and finishes with luscious base notes of Whipped Cream and Vanilla.

name: Dior Addict Purple Glow Eau De Parfum for Women
tags: Addict Purple Glow Eau De Parfum

notes.source_text: Dior's Addict Purple Glow Eau De Parfum is a captivating Floral Fruity Gourmand scent designed for women. Launched in 2025, this fragrance is a delightful new addition to the collection. Renowned perfumer Francis Kurkdjian is the creative force behind this fragrance. The top notes feature a charming blend of Candied Flowers, Raspberry, and Powdered Sugar, while the heart reveals the elegant essence of Tuscan Iris. Finally, the fragrance settles into a warm base of Vanilla.

name: Dior Addict Rosy Glow Eau de Parfum For Women
tags: Addict Rosy Glow Eau de Parfum

notes.source_text: Addict Rosy Glow Eau de Parfum by Dior is a delightful Floral Fruity Gourmand fragrance designed for women. This enchanting scent is a recent addition, introduced in 2025. The talented perfumer Francis Kurkdjian crafted this fragrance, which features Lychee as the top note, a heart of Rose, and a warm base of Caramel.

name: Dior Addict Shine Eau de Toilette for Women

notes.source_text: Dior Addict Shine by Dior is a Floral Fruity fragrance for women. Dior Addict Shine was launched in 2007. The nose behind this fragrance is Francois Demachy.

name: Dior Aqua Fahrenheit Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
Aqua Fahrenheit by Dior is a captivating Woody Floral Musk scent designed for men, introduced in 2011. The fragrance was crafted by renowned perfumer Francois Demachy. It opens with invigorating top notes of Grapefruit and Mandarin Orange, transitioning into a heart of Violet, Mint, and Basil, before settling into a rich base of Leather and Vetiver.

Aqua Fahrenheit
Cologne by Christian Dior, Introduced in 2011, Aqua Fahrenheit by
Christian Dior is a lively, fiery fragrance for the adventurous man
.
Bold and explosive, this scent holds up well during the night but
struts its stuff best during daytime outings. Like the man who knows no
boundaries, this outgoing fragrance is up to the challenge of exploring
life during the energetic days of spring and summer. A long-lasting
scent with a moderate to heavy sillage, this creation from the nose of
Francois Demachy is for the confident man who dares to go boldly. Top
notes feature Mandarin orange and grapefruit. Heart notes are mint,
basil and violet. Base notes include vetiver and leather.

name: Dior Balade Sauvage Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Balade Sauvage by Christian Dior is a fragrance for women and men. Balade Sauvage
was launched in 2018. The nose behind this fragrance is Francois
Demachy. Top notes are Ozonic notes, Petitgrain and Bergamot; middle
notes are Fig Tree, Fig, Solar notes, Sea Notes, Peach, Hedione, Orange
Blossom and Rose; base notes are Pebbles, Labdanum, Amberwood and
Vanilla.

name: Dior Bois D'Argent Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Bois d'Argent by Christian Dior is a Woody Chypre fragrance for women and men. Bois d'Argent
was launched in 2004. The nose behind this fragrance is Annick Menardo.
Top notes are iris, Cypress and Juniper Berries; middle notes are Myrhh
and Patchouli; base notes are Woodsy Notes, Honey, Vanilla, Amber,
resins, Musk and Leather.

name: Dior Bois Talisman Eau de Parfum Unisex

top: a sweet middle note of Sugar
key: a sweet middle note of Sugar
notes.source_text: Bois Talisman by Dior is a unisex Oriental Woody fragrance that debuted in 2025. Created by renowned perfumer Francis Kurkdjian, this scent features a captivating top note of Vanilla, a sweet middle note of Sugar, and an alluring base of Cedarwood and Smoke.

name: Dior Cuir Saddle Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Cuir Saddle by Dior is a unisex leather fragrance that made its debut in 2025. Crafted by renowned perfumer Francis Kurkdjian, this scent offers a fresh aromatic experience for both women and men.

name: Dior Dior Homme Intense Eau de Parfum for Men

top: that is accentuated by middle heart notes of pear
dark base notes of Virginia cedar
key: that is accentuated by middle heart notes of pear
dark base notes of Virginia cedar
notes.source_text:
Launched by the design house of Dior in 2007, this fragrance is aptly named for the man who is vibrant, vital, and intense. Dior Homme Intense for him is a floral, woody, musky scent that he may find himself wanting to wear every day. Casual yet provocative, this alluring fragrance has a strong lavender top note that is accentuated by middle heart notes of pear, musk mallow, and iris, with deep, dark base notes of Virginia cedar and vetiver.
This product is made of high quality material
It is recommended for romantic wear
This Product Is Manufactured In France

name: Dior Dior Homme Sport 2021 Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
Dior Homme Sport is a bright, zesty citrus with clean woods.
Created by François Demachy, it opens with lemon, bergamot and aldehydes. Elemi and pink pepper form a spicy heart, and woods, olibanum and amber give it a smooth finish.
A daytime favorite from spring through fall.

name: Dior Dior Homme Sport Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
A sexy woody fragrance with a juicy, spicy freshness, Dior Homme Sport
is reinvented to more fully embody a life lived with sport as
philosophy, not a race for performance.
The composition plays on facets of fruity, spicy freshness while retaining the sexy, woody notes of Dior Homme's identity.
"Dior
Homme Sport is a story that starts off strong and fast, and never lets
up. A meteor that bursts with a lasting, intense pleasure."—François
Demachy, Dior Perfumer
Notes:
Citron, Cedarwood Accord, Ginger Accord.
Style:
Adventurous. Exhilarating. Free.

name: Dior Dior Paradise Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Dior Paradise is a sunny blend of citrus, bitter almond and tonka.
Francis Kurkdjian created it in 2026. Orange, lime and mandarin open bright, bitter almond and a sweet syrup accord form the heart, and tonka bean and woods give it a warm finish.
A summer favorite for daytime.

name: Dior Dioramour Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Dioramour by Dior is a unisex fragrance, designed to captivate both women and men. Introduced in 2018, this enchanting scent was crafted by the renowned perfumer Francois Demachy.

name: Dior Diorella Eau de Toilette for Women

notes.source_text:
Diorella by Christian Dior is a Chypre Floral fragrance for women. Diorella
was launched in 1972. The nose behind this fragrance is Edmond
Roudnitska. Top notes are Green Notes, Sicilian Lemon, Bergamot, Melon
and Basil; middle notes are Honeysuckle, Peach, Moroccan Jasmine,
Carnation, Cyclamen and Rose; base notes are Oakmoss, Vetiver, Patchouli
and Musk.

name: Dior Dioressence Eau de Toilette for Women

notes.source_text: Dioressence, a captivating Chypre Floral scent for women from Les Creations de Monsieur Dior by Dior, made its debut in 2009. The fragrance opens with the fresh, vibrant note of Geranium, unfolds into a warm heart of Cinnamon, and settles into the earthy depth of Patchouli at its base.

name: Dior Diorissimo Eau de Toilette for Women

notes.source_text:
Dior Diorissimo is the classic lily of the valley floral.
Edmond Roudnitska created it in 1956. Bergamot and green leaves open fresh, ylang-ylang, lily, lilac, jasmine and lily of the valley form the heart, and civet and sandalwood give it a soft finish.
A timeless daytime scent for spring.

Diorissimo by Christian Dior is a Floral fragrance for women. Diorissimo
was launched in 1956. The nose behind this fragrance is Edmond
Roudnitska. Top notes are Green Leaves and Bergamot; middle notes are
Lily-of-the-Valley, Lilac, Jasmine, Lily, Ylang-Ylang, Amaryllis,
Rosemary and Boronia; base notes are Civet and Sandalwood.

name: Dior Dioriviera Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Dior Dioriviera is a sunny blend of green fig and rose.
Francis Kurkdjian created it in 2023. Green notes, fig and rose blend into a fresh, fruity and gently woody scent that evokes the Riviera.
A perfect summer daytime scent.

name: Dior Dolce Vita Eau de Toilette for Women

notes.source_text:
Dolce Vita by Dior is an alluring Amber Woody fragrance designed for women, introduced in 1994. The fragrance was crafted by the talented perfumers Pierre Bourdon and Maurice Roger. It opens with a vibrant blend of Peach, Cardamom, Lily, Grapefruit, Bergamot, and Rose. The heart unfolds with rich notes of Cinnamon, Apricot, Brazilian Rosewood, Lily, Heliotrope, and Magnolia, while the base is warm and comforting, featuring Vanilla, Sandalwood, Cedar, and Coconut.

Dolce Vita by Christian Dior is a Oriental Woody fragrance for women. Dolce Vita
was launched in 1994. Dolce Vita was created by Pierre Bourdon and
Maurice Roger. Top notes are Peach, Cardamom, Lily, Grapefruit, Bergamot
and Rose; middle notes are Cinnamon, Apricot, Brazilian Rosewood, Lily,
Heliotrope and Magnolia; base notes are Vanilla, Sandalwood, Cedar and
Coconut.

name: Dior Dune Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text: Dune Pour Homme by Christian Dior is a Woody Floral Musk fragrance for men. Dune Pour Homme was launched in 1997. Dune Pour Homme was created by Olivier Cresp and Jean-Pierre Bethouart. Top notes are cassis, fig leaf, basil and sage; middle notes are fig wood bark, mignonette and rose; base notes are sandalwood, tonka bean, vanilla and cedar.

name: Dior Dune Eau de Toilette for Women

notes.source_text:
Dune by Dior is an enchanting Amber Woody scent designed for women. Introduced in 1991, this fragrance was crafted by the talented trio of Jean-Louis Sieuzac, Nejla Barbir, and Dominique Ropion. The fragrance opens with vibrant top notes of Brazilian Rosewood, Aldehydes, Mandarin Orange, Bergamot, and Peony. Its heart reveals a floral blend of Lily, Ylang-Ylang, Wallflower, Jasmine, and Rose, while the base is a warm and inviting combination of Sandalwood, Amber, Benzoin, Oakmoss, Vanilla, Patchouli, and Musk.

Dune by Christian Dior is a Oriental Woody fragrance for women. Dune
was launched in 1991. Dune was created by Jean-Louis Sieuzac, Nejla
Barbir and Dominique Ropion. Top notes are Brazilian Rosewood,
Aldehydes, Mandarin Orange, Bergamot and Peony; middle notes are Lily,
Ylang-Ylang, Wallflower, Jasmine and Rose; base notes are Sandalwood,
Amber, Benzoin, Oakmoss, Vanilla, Patchouli and Musk.

name: Dior Eau Sauvage Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
Dior Eau Sauvage is an elegant citrus-aromatic classic that still feels modern.
Edmond Roudnitska created it in 1966. Rosemary, basil, bergamot, lemon and caraway open crisp and bright, patchouli, rose, coriander, jasmine and orris form a refined heart, and musk, amber, vetiver and oakmoss give it a timeless finish.
A daytime classic for spring and summer.

Dior Sauvage Eau de Toilette is the fresh, peppery original that started the Sauvage line.
François Demachy created it in 2015. Calabrian bergamot and pepper open bright and spicy, Sichuan pepper, lavender, vetiver and geranium form an aromatic heart, and ambroxan, cedar and labdanum give it a clean, lasting finish.
Easy to wear from spring through fall, for the office, the gym and everyday.

This is a fresh perfume which can be easily recognized among other fresh fragrances. Clear and fresh scent of lemon and bitter-fresh rosemary are combined perfectly with masculine, woody nuances of a base.
The perfume was introduced in 1966 and created in cooperation with perfumer Edmond Roudnitska. The creator made the perfume legendary and characteristic for its fresh, citrusy notes, composed with spicy lavender on a masculine, woody base. The fragrance incorporates the following accords: lemon, basil, bergamot, cumin, lavender and fruit. A heart blooms with jasmine, rose, carnation, iris root, coriander, patchouli and sandalwood. Base notes bring us oak moss, vetiver, musk and amber.The flacon was designed by Pierre Dinand.

Raw and noble, all at once. Natural ingredients, selected with
extreme care, prevail in excessive doses. Radiant top notes burst with
the juicy freshness of Reggio di Calabria bergamot. Ambroxan, derived
from precious ambergris, unleashes a powerfully woody trail. Sauvage is
an act of creation inspired by wide-open spaces. An ozone-blue sky
sprawled above a rocky landscape, white-hot beneath the desert sun.Notes:
- Top: Reggio di Calabria bergamot.
- Middle: Sichuan pepper.
- Base: ambroxan.

name: Dior Eau Sauvage Extreme Intense 2010 Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text: In 2010, master perfumer Francois Demachy released Eau Sauvage Extreme 2010 for men. The fragrance is composed of sharp top notes of Bergamot, Sicilian Lemon and Grapefruit; followed by aromatic middle notes of Elemi, Lavender, Mint, Basil and Jasmine; and woody base notes of Virginia Cedar, Oakmoss, Patchouli and Vetiver.

name: Dior Eau Sauvage Parfum 2017 for Men

notes.source_text:
Dior Eau Sauvage Parfum is a refined blend of citron, lavender and vetiver.
François Demachy created it in 2017. Citron, bergamot and lavender open fresh, Haitian vetiver forms a smooth heart, and elemi gives it a resinous finish.
Elegant and versatile in every season, day or night.

name: Dior Eau Sauvage Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Eau Sauvage Parfum by Christian Dior is a Citrus Aromatic fragrance for men. Eau Sauvage Parfum
was launched in 2012. The nose behind this fragrance is Francois
Demachy. Top notes are Bergamot, Citron and Petitgrain; middle notes are
Vetiver, Lavender and Hedione; base notes are Myrrh, Patchouli and
Oakmoss.

name: Dior Escale A Portofino Eau de Toilette for Women

notes.source_text: Cruise Collection - Escale a Portofino by Dior is a Citrus Aromatic fragrance for women. Cruise Collection - Escale a Portofino was launched in 2008. The nose behind this fragrance is Francois Demachy. Top notes are Bergamot, Lemon and Petitgrain; middle notes are Orange Blossom, Juniper Berries and Almond; base notes are Cypress, Cedar, Galbanum, Musk and Caraway.

name: Dior Fahrenheit Cologne Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text: Fahrenheit Cologne by Christian Dior is a Woody Spicy fragrance for men. Fahrenheit Cologne was launched in 2015. The nose behind this fragrance is Francois Demachy. Top notes are sicilian mandarin, calabrian bergamot and lemon; middle notes are patchouli and french violet; base notes are haitian vetiver, virginian cedar, nutmeg and caraway.

name: Dior Fahrenheit Cologne for Men

notes.source_text: Dior's Fahrenheit Cologne is a captivating Woody Spicy fragrance designed for men, introduced in 2015. Created by renowned perfumer Francois Demachy, this scent opens with vibrant top notes of Calabrian bergamot, Sicilian mandarin, and lemon. The heart reveals an elegant blend of French violet and patchouli, while the foundation consists of rich base notes including Haitian vetiver, nutmeg, Virginian cedar, and caraway.

name: Dior Fahrenheit Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
Dior Fahrenheit is the bold, leathery classic with its famous gasoline-like violet leaf.
Jean-Louis Sieuzac and Michel Almairac created it in 1988. Nutmeg flower, lavender, cedar, mandarin and bergamot open warm, violet leaf, nutmeg, sandalwood and jasmine form the heart, and leather, vetiver, musk, amber and tonka bean give it depth.
Made for fall and winter, perfect for date nights.

From catwalk-inspired cosmetics to cutting-edge skin care and timeless fragrances, Christian Dior has brought us some of the most luxurious, trendsetting, and fashionable beauty products around. It's this magical mix of couture-meets-cosmetics that not only attracts celebrities, supermodels, and the society set, but also has solidified Dior's reputation as one of the most unabashedly stylish beauty brands in the world.
A resolutely contemporary fragrance characterized by a meeting of
extremes. Fresh, elegant notes blend in perfect harmony with bolder,
more virile overtones to create a scent that is warm, subtle, and
distinguished.
Notes:
Bergamot, Hawthorne, Honeysuckle, Nutmeg, Sandalwood, Violet, Cedar, Tonka Bean, Patchouli.
Style:
Classic. Sensual. Distinguished.

name: Dior Fahrenheit Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Dior Fahrenheit Parfum is a rich, dark take on Fahrenheit with licorice and rum.
François Demachy created it in 2014. Suede, licorice and Sicilian mandarin open warm, violet leaf, rum, coriander and cumin form the heart, and Bourbon vanilla gives it a smooth finish.
Made for fall and winter nights and date nights.

After summer versions and editions Aqua Fahrenheit and Fahrenheit
Absolute, creators of the house offer a new, even more intense version
this year – by introducing the latest addition, FAHRENHEIT LE PARFUM.
The latest version FAHRENHEIT LE PARFUM has arrived on the
market at the beginning of January 2014 and provides a characteristic
harmony of contrasts. The fragrance was created by perfumer of the house
of Dior, Francois Demachy
who accentuates oriental-leathery side of the composition and states:
"I did not want to create a caricature of Fahrenheit fragrance which
already has an assertive composition. Instead, I followed the original
structure by adding elements that enrich the story and highlight its
atypical personality." For composition Fahrenheit Le Parfum very
rare, natural ingredients were selected which would accentuate and
follow in sensual way hot leather and oriental rhythm woven with shades.
.

name: Dior Forever and Ever Dior Eau de Toilette for Women

notes.source_text: Forever and Ever Dior by Dior is a Floral fragrance for women. Forever and Ever Dior was launched in 2006. Top notes are Freesia, Jasmine and Ivy; middle notes are Rose Hip, Almond Blossom and Geranium; base notes are Vanilla, Musk and Amber.

name: Dior Gris Dior Esprit De Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Gris Dior Esprit De Parfum by Dior is a Chypre Floral scent designed for both women and men. As a recent addition to Dior's fragrance collection, it debuted in 2024. The mastermind behind this fragrance is Francis Kurkdjian. It opens with a top note of Bulgarian Rose, followed by a heart note of Atlas Cedar, and concludes with base notes of Patchouli and Amber.

name: Dior Higher Energy Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
Higher Energy by Christian Dior is a Woody Aromatic fragrance for men. Higher Energy
was launched in 2003. Higher Energy was created by Nathalie
Gracia-Cetto and Carlos Vinals. Top notes are Pineapple, Juniper
Berries, Grapefruit, Melon and Mint; middle notes are Nutmeg, Pepper and
Incense; base notes are Cedar, Vetiver, Sandalwood, Oakmoss, Musk and
Labdanum.

name: Dior Homme 2020 Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
Dior Homme 2020 is a clean, modern woody musk with a crisp, airy feel.
François Demachy created it in 2020. Bergamot, pink pepper and elemi open fresh, cashmere wood, Atlas cedar and patchouli form a smooth heart, and Iso E Super, Haitian vetiver and white musk leave a clean, radiant trail.
Polished and easy to wear, it is a daytime favorite from spring through fall.

Dior Homme, a powdery iris and woody scent for men, was introduced in
the original version in 2005 and then later came the new 2011 version.
The 2020 version of Dior Homme Eau de Toilette is announced with the
slogan "I'm Your Man." The 2011 edition remains on the shelves under the
name, Dior Homme Original.
The new Dior Homme is created by Dior in-house perfumer Francois Demachy
"This new Dior Homme has an unmistakably virile signature that does
not prevent it from developing tender, sensual accents. It basically
draws the portrait of a modern man." François Demachy, Dior
Perfumer-Creator
According to the perfumer, this is a fragrance overdosed with carnal
woody notes, and it represents a return to the basics: classic and
simplicity. It is clear, clean, gentle, and woody but also slightly
sweet, and wears like a second skin.

name: Dior Homme 2025 Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Dior Homme Parfum 2025 is a rich, refined blend of iris, amber and earthy woods.
Francis Kurkdjian created it in 2025. Iris opens soft and powdery, amber forms a warm heart, and patchouli and vetiver give it a deep, earthy finish.
Made for fall and winter nights.

name: Dior Homme Cologne Cologne for Men

notes.source_text:
Dior Homme Cologne is a light, clean burst of bergamot and grapefruit blossom.
François Demachy created it in 2013. Calabrian bergamot opens sparkling, grapefruit blossom forms a fresh floral heart, and musk gives it a soft, clean finish.
A summer favorite for the office and everyday wear.

Dior returns to the elegance of simplicity. Pure and radical, Dior Homme
Cologne brings the sparkling freshness of bergamot to the citrus
sweetness of grapefruit blossoms. Its enveloping trail reflects the
casual charm of a timeless white dress shirt—not ostentatious, but
stylish.
Grown in southern Italy, essence of bergamot is obtained by cold
expression of the peel. It brings a distinct, sweet freshness to the
fragrance and adds a special radiance to the citrus notes.
Notes:
Calabrian Bergamot, Grapefruit Blossom.
Style:
Simple. Elegant. Fresh.

name: Dior Homme Eau Eau de Toilette

notes.source_text:
Dior Homme Eau for Men is a Woody Aromatic scent designed for men, introduced by Dior in 2014. The fragrance was crafted by the renowned perfumer Francois Demachy. It opens with refreshing top notes of Coriander, Grapefruit, and Calabrian Bergamot, transitions into a refined heart of Tuscan Iris, and concludes with a rich base of Virginian Cedar and Amber.

Bold and refined, magnetic and charismatic, Dior Homme Eau for Men is
defined by its urban edge and immediate charm. The fragrance is a fresh
and gripping composition with incisive, spicy top notes of Moroccan
grapefruit, Calabrian bergamot, and Crimean coriander. The heart
unfolds with elegant, sexy Tuscan iris while the invigorating base of
Virginia cedarwood unfurls a masculine and sophisticated signature. Dior
Homme Eau for Men is the distinguished mark of a man with uninhibited
elegance.
Notes:
Moroccan Grapefruit, Calabrian Bergamot, Crimean Coriander, Tuscan Iris, Virginia Cedarwood.
Style:
Woody-Fresh. Sensual. Sophisticated.

name: Dior Homme Intense 2011 Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Dior Homme Intense is a velvety iris and lavender fragrance with timeless elegance.
François Demachy created it in 2011. Lavender opens soft and aromatic, iris, pear and ambrette form a powdery, almost lipstick-like heart, and Virginia cedar and vetiver give it a refined woody base.
Sophisticated and seductive, it is made for fall and winter nights and date nights.

name: Dior Homme Intense 2025 Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Dior Homme Intense 2025 is a refined iris, ambrette and cedar fragrance.
Launched in 2025, it opens with Tuscan iris, moves into a soft ambrette heart and settles into Virginia cedar for a powdery, elegant finish.
Polished and versatile, it works in every season, day or night.

name: Dior Homme Original Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
Dior Homme Original is a refined blend of iris, cardamom and vetiver.
François Demachy created it in 2021. Tuscan iris opens soft, Guatemalan cardamom forms a warm heart, and vetiver gives it an earthy finish.
Versatile in spring, fall and winter, day or night.

name: Dior Homme Parfum for Men

notes.source_text: Dior Homme Parfum, a leather based scent designed specifically for men, hit. Created by François Demachy, the fragrance has top notes of Tuscan Iris and Italian Orange, followed by middle notes of Leather and Rose, and finishing off with a base of Sandalwood, Ambrette (Musk Mallow), Agarwood (Oud) and Cedar.

name: Dior Hypnotic Poison Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text: Hypnotic Poison Eau de Parfum by Dior is an enchanting Amber Vanilla fragrance designed for women. Introduced in 2014, this captivating scent was crafted by the perfumer Francois Demachy. The fragrance opens with enticing notes of Licorice and Almond, flows into a heart of Jasmine Sambac and Orange Blossom, and culminates in a warm base of Vanilla and Tonka Bean.

name: Dior Hypnotic Poison Eau de Toilette for Women

notes.source_text:
Dior Hypnotic Poison is a seductive blend of almond, vanilla and coconut.
Annick Menardo created it in 1998. Coconut, plum and apricot open sweet, rosewood, jasmine, caraway and tuberose form the heart, and vanilla, almond, sandalwood and musk give it a rich finish.
Made for fall and winter nights and date nights.

Mysterious
and mesmerizing, extravagant and bewitching, Hypnotic Poison is a magic
potion for modern times. Audacious and profoundly feminine, the
fragrance is an unsettling harmony, a fusion of contrasting olfactory
facets.
Notes:
Bitter Almond, Caraway Spice, Sambac Jasmine, Cinnamon, Tuberose, Vanilla, Musk, Mosses, Jucarunda Wood.
Style:
Hypnotizing. Extravagant. Bewitching.

name: Dior J'adore 2011 Eau de Toilette for Women

notes.source_text: J'adore Eau de Toilette 2011 by Dior is a captivating floral fragrance designed for women. Launched in 2011, this scent features a refreshing blend of top notes that include citruses, mandarin orange, and neroli. The heart reveals a bouquet of jasmine, African orange blossom, ylang-ylang, tuberose, and rose, followed by a warm and inviting base of woody notes and vanilla.

name: Dior J'adore Absolu Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
J'Adore Absolu by Christian Dior is a Oriental Floral fragrance for women. This is a new fragrance. J'Adore Absolu
was launched in 2018. The nose behind this fragrance is Francois
Demachy. Top notes are Jasmine Sambac and Magnolia; middle notes are
Jasmine, Indian Tuberose and May Rose; base note is Orange Blossom.

name: Dior J'adore Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Dior J'adore is a luminous, iconic floral bouquet.
Calice Becker created it in 1999. Peach, magnolia, mandarin, pear, bergamot and melon open bright, rose, violet, freesia, plum, jasmine, orchid and tuberose form a lush heart, and cedar, blackberry, musk and vanilla give it a soft finish.
Elegant for spring and fall, day or night, from the office to everyday wear.

Fragrance Family:
Floral
Scent Type:
Fruity Florals
Key Notes:
Ylang-Ylang, Damascus Rose, Jasmine
About:
The ultimate expression of femininity and luxury. This eau de parfum
opens with the exotic, floral-fruity notes of ylang-ylang. Damascus Rose
and a duo of jasmines—jasmine grandiflorum and Indian jasmine
sambac—exude a seductive warmth. It is sensual without being too heavy,
floral yet mysterious. A confident signature to celebrate your feminine
allure.
"J'adore invents a flower that doesn't exist, an ideal."—François Demachy, Dior Perfumer-Creator.
The name means "I love." It is an exalted exclamation that bursts out: "J'adore!"

name: Dior J'adore Eau de Toilette for Women

top: captivate as blood orange essence awakens
key: captivate as blood orange essence awakens
notes.source_text:
Joyful top notes explode and captivate as blood orange essence awakens
the senses and whets the appetite. Neroli from Vallauris is an intense
flower that shines with a radiance as white as its petals and as warm as
the golden Mediterranean sun. It unfurls alongside orange blossom
absolute. The sweetness of magnolia, tinged with vanilla and lemon,
meets the delicate and lively beauty of the base note and essence of
J’adore, the Damascan Rose.
François Demachy, Dior Perfumer-Creator, wanted to accentuate the
luminous character of J’adore. With J'adore Eau Lumière, Demachy
highlighted its contrasts, fine-tuned its facets, and renewed its
freshness while staying true to its floral signature.
Notes:
Blood Orange Essence, Neroli from Vallauris, Damascena Rose Essence.
Style:
Floral. Romantic.

name: Dior J'adore In Joy Eau de Toilette for Women

notes.source_text: J'Adore In Joy by Dior is a Floral Fruity fragrance for women. J'Adore In Joy was launched in 2017. The nose behind this fragrance is Francois Demachy. Top note is Sea Salt; middle notes are Jasmine Sambac, Ylang-Ylang, Neroli and Tuberose; base note is Peach.

name: Dior J'adore Infinissime Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
J'Adore Infinissime by Christian Dior is a Oriental Floral fragrance for women. This is a new fragrance. J'Adore Infinissime
was launched in 2020. The nose behind this fragrance is Francois
Demachy. Top notes are Blood Orange, Bergamot and Pink Pepper; middle
notes are Tuberose, Jasmine Sambac, Ylang-Ylang, Lily-of-the-Valley and
Rose; base note is Sandalwood.

name: Dior J'adore L'eau Cologne Florale for Women

notes.source_text: J'adore L'eau Cologne Florale by Dior is a Floral fragrance for women. J'adore L'eau Cologne Florale was launched in 2009. The nose behind this fragrance is Francois Demachy.

name: Dior J'adore L'Or Essence de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text: Verified fragrance notes for Dior J'adore L'Or Essence de Parfum for Women: Orange Blossom, Jasmine Grandiflorum, Centifolia Rose.

name: Dior J'adore Parfum d'Eau Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text: Verified fragrance notes for Dior J'adore Parfum d'Eau Eau de Parfum for Women: Jasmine Sambac, Green Notes, Magnolia, Honeysuckle, Neroli, Rose.

name: Dior J'adore Voile de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text: J'Adore Voile de Parfum by Dior is a Floral fragrance for women. J'Adore Voile de Parfum was launched in 2013. Top note is Damask Rose; middle note is Tuscan Iris; base note is White Musk.

name: Dior Jadore Intense Parfum for Women

notes.source_text: J'adore Intense by Dior is a captivating Oriental Floral fragrance designed for women. Launched in 2026, this fragrance introduces a fresh interpretation crafted by renowned perfumer Francis Kurkdjian. The composition opens with a delightful top note of apricot, followed by heart notes of ylang-ylang, rose, and jasmine, which create a luxurious floral bouquet. The scent is anchored by rich base notes of honey, vanilla, and sandalwood, adding depth and warmth to this enchanting fragrance.

name: Dior Jasmin des Anges Esprit de Parfum Eau de Parfum Unisex
tags: Jasmin des Anges Esprit de Parfum

notes.source_text: Jasmin des Anges Esprit de Parfum by Dior is a contemporary Floral Fruity scent crafted for both women and men. Introduced in 2026, this fragrance is the creation of renowned perfumer Francis Kurkdjian. Its vibrant composition showcases notes of jasmine, peach, and strawberry, offering a fresh and alluring aroma.

name: Dior Joy Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Joy by Dior is a captivating Floral Woody Musk fragrance designed for women, introduced in 2018. Created by perfumer Francois Demachy, this scent features bright top notes of Bergamot and Mandarin Orange. The heart unveils a delightful blend of Jasmine, Grasse Rose, Peach, and Cassis, while the base is composed of rich notes of White Musk, Sandalwood, Cedar, Patchouli, and Benzoin.

Discover the new fragrance JOY by Dior. The feeling of joy is finally
captured in a perfume with enveloping softness and energy. Shining with
the vibrant smile of flowers and citrus fruits, the smooth caress of
wood, and the serenity of musks, the fragrance is faceted with a
thousand enveloping nuances that lead to a clean, simple expression.
Fragrance Family:
Floral
Scent Type:
Warm Florals
Key Notes:
Mandarin, Sandalwood, White Musk

name: Dior Joy Intense Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
The new Dior pillar fragrance Joy by Dior was launched in 2018,
dedicated to the pleasures of life. In 2019, the fashion house releases
its first flanker - JOY INTENSE - which aims to bring an increased dose
of elation and joy to the scent.
May rose and jasmine growing in Grasse form the heart of this
perfume, whose composition is signed by Dior in-house perfumer François
Demachy. According to the nose, Joy by Dior Intense is a sensual
composition with an extra note of neroli compared to the original, and
with a new balance of the familiar ingredients.
Top notes: bergamot, neroli
Heart: Grasse rose, Grasse jasmine
Base: tonka bean, vanilla, sandalwood, musk

name: Dior Jules (2026) Eau de Toilette For men

notes.source_text: Jules (2026) by Dior is an aromatic green fragrance designed for men, introduced as a brand-new scent in 2026. Created by renowned perfumer Francis Kurkdjian, this fragrance showcases a blend of moss, lavender, leather, and woody notes, complemented by cedar, vetiver, sandalwood, patchouli, spicy nuances, animalistic accords, amber, and tonka bean.

name: Dior Lucky Esprit De Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Lucky Esprit De Parfum by Dior is a captivating Floral Green scent designed for both women and men. Introduced in 2024, this fragrance is a fresh addition to the Dior lineup. Renowned perfumer Francis Kurkdjian crafted this elegant aroma, featuring a top note of Lily of the Valley, a heart of Leather, and rich Woody Notes as its base.

name: Dior Miss Dior Absolutely Blooming Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Miss Dior Absolutely Blooming is a captivating Floral Fruity scent for women, introduced by Dior in 2016. The fragrance was crafted by renowned perfumer Francois Demachy. It opens with vibrant top notes of Raspberry, Black Currant, Pomegranate, and Pink Pepper, leading to a heart of elegant May Rose and Peony. The composition is grounded by a base note of soft White Musk.

Bright and colorful, Miss Dior Absolutely Blooming is a floral delight you return to over and over. Its top notes of tangy red berry are joyful and striking. At its heart, a sublime duet of Grasse roses and Damascus roses embraces a sensuous peony accord. This infinite blooming of fresh flowers is comforted in a base of white musk notes.
Notes:
Red Berry Accord, Grasse Rose Absolute, Peony Accord, White Musk Accord.
Style:
Romantic. Sultry.

name: Dior Miss Dior Blooming Bouquet Eau de Toilette for Women

notes.source_text:
Fragrance Family:
Floral
Scent Type:
Fruity Florals
Key Notes:
Grapefruit, Musk
About:
Experience
the caress of a fresh rose dressed in peony flowers. This vivacious eau
de toilette unfurls with radiant Calabrian bergamot, revealing a tender
heart of peony and Damascus rose. Its lingering finish is edged with
white musk. A floral springtime signature, perfect for a flirty and
irresistibly charming Miss Dior.
Blooming Bouquet is a
composition designed like a dress embroidered with a thousand blossoms.
It pays tribute to Christian Dior's legendary love of flowers.

name: Dior Miss Dior Cherie Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
The new Miss Dior Eau de Parfum reveals the femininity of a sensual
floral. Its heart is a floral declaration that combines the beauty of
Grasse rose with the boldness of Damascus rose, both wrapped in a ribbon
of fresh notes of Calabrian bergamot. This handcrafted creation is
woven with rosewood from French Guiana and pink pepper from Réunion
Island for heightened character. A Miss Dior that will leave you
lovestruck.

name: Dior Miss Dior Eau de Parfum 2026 for Women

notes.source_text:
Dior Miss Dior Eau de Parfum 2026 is a warm, woody rose.
Francis Kurkdjian created it in 2026. Rose and rose de mai meet palisander rosewood, patchouli, sandalwood, vanilla and tonka bean for a smooth, elegant and softly sweet scent.
Easy to wear in every season.

name: Dior Miss Dior Eau de Parfum for Women

base: this fragrance is sure to make a statement
key: this fragrance is sure to make a statement
notes.source_text: The latest interpretation of the iconic Miss Dior Eau de Parfum (2021), released in 2021, is an Amber Floral scent for women crafted by the renowned perfumer, Francois Demachy. Composed of top notes of Iris, Peony and Lily-of-the-Valley, middle notes of Apricot, Rose and Peach, and base notes of Vanilla, Musk, Tonka Bean, Benzoin and Sandalwood, this fragrance is sure to make a statement.

name: Dior Miss Dior Essence de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text: Miss Dior Essence by Dior is a contemporary Chypre Floral fragrance designed for women. Launched in 2025, this new scent is crafted by renowned perfumer Francis Kurkdjian. It opens with vibrant top notes of Blackberry, Marmalade, and Black Elder, leading to a heart of Jasmine Sambac and traditional Jasmine. The fragrance settles into a rich base of Woody Notes and Oak, creating a captivating and sophisticated aroma.

name: Dior Miss Dior Parfum (2024) for Women

notes.source_text:
Dior Miss Dior Parfum is a juicy, sensual take on Miss Dior with wild strawberry.
Francis Kurkdjian and François Demachy created it in 2024. Mandarin, peach and apricot open bright, wild strawberry, florals and jasmine form the heart, and patchouli, amberwood, amber, moss and Atlas cedar give it a warm, chypre-like finish.
Versatile from spring through fall, day or night.

name: Dior Miss Dior Rose N'Roses Eau de Toilette for Women

notes.source_text:
Dior Rose N'Roses is a new addition to the Miss Dior line, announced as a fresh and radiant Eau de Toilette.
Top notes: Italian mandarin, bergamot, geranium essence
Heart: Grasse rose, Damask rose
Base: white musk
Miss Dior Rose N'Roses was launched in 2020. The nose behind this fragrance is Francois Demachy.

name: Dior New Look 2024 Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Introducing New Look 2024 by Dior, a captivating fragrance designed for both women and men. Launched in 2024, this is a fresh addition to the fragrance world, crafted by renowned perfumer Francis Kurkdjian. The perfume opens with a sparkling top note of Aldehydes, followed by a heart of Frankincense, and concludes with a warm base note of Amber.

name: Dior Oud Ispahan Esprit De Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Oud Ispahan Esprit De Parfum by Dior is an Oriental Floral fragrance suitable for both women and men. Released in 2024, this fragrance is a recent addition to the Dior collection. Crafted by the renowned perfumer Francis Kurkdjian, it features top notes of cumin and clove, a heart of rose, and a base composed of oud intertwined with spicy notes.

name: Dior Poison Eau de Toilette for Women

notes.source_text:
Some perfumes are born a myth. Heady, mysterious, and revolutionary since its creation, Poison is Dior’s ultimate weapon of seduction. Its exceptional, exotic alchemy is composed of a rich blend of spicy, fruity, and amber notes warmed by honey and musk—an unforgettable fragrance.
Notes:
Coriander, Tuberose, Opoponax.
Style:
Unexpected. Charismatic. Unforgettable.

name: Dior Poison Girl Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text: Poison Girl by Dior is an enticing Amber Vanilla fragrance designed for women, introduced in 2016. Created by renowned perfumer Francois Demachy, this fragrance features a vibrant blend of notes. The top notes consist of Bitter Orange and Lemon, leading into a heart of Damask Rose, Grasse Rose, and Orange Blossom. The scent concludes with a warm and rich base that includes Vanilla, Almond, Tonka Bean, Tolu Balsam, Sandalwood, Cashmeran, and Heliotrope.

name: Dior Poison Girl Eau De Toilette for Women

notes.source_text: Dior's Poison Girl Eau De Toilette is an enchanting Amber Vanilla fragrance designed for women, released in 2017. Crafted by perfumer Francois Demachy, this scent opens with vibrant notes of Frosted Orange, Bitter Orange, and Lemon. The heart features a bouquet of Neroli, Orange Blossom, Grasse Rose, and Damask Rose, while the base is a warm embrace of Vanilla, Caramel, Tonka Bean, Heliotrope, and Cashmeran.

name: Dior Poison Girl Unexpected Eau de Toilette for Women

notes.source_text:
Poison Girl Unexpected by Christian Dior is a Oriental Vanilla fragrance for women. Poison Girl Unexpected
was launched in 2018. The nose behind this fragrance is Francois
Demachy. Top notes are Ginger, Blood Orange and Lemon; middle note is
Damask Rose; base notes are Vanilla, Tonka Bean, Hazelnut and Cashmeran.

name: Dior Pure Poison Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Pure Poison by Dior is a captivating floral fragrance designed for women, introduced in 2004. This enchanting scent was crafted by the talented noses of Carlos Benaim, Dominique Ropion, and Olivier Polge. The fragrance opens with a vibrant blend of Jasmine, Orange, Bergamot, and Sicilian Mandarin, leading into a heart of Gardenia and Orange Blossom. The composition is anchored by base notes of Sandalwood, White Amber, Cedar, and White Musk, creating a sophisticated and alluring aroma.

For
the seductress within, here's a fragrance for a new generation of
seductress. Pure Poison is a modern floral based on a white flower
bouquet, infused with fresh amber. A radiant scent, it emits both purity
and seduction with a first impression of soft flowers and the lingering
allure of woody-amber and sexy musks.
Notes:
Sweet
Orange, Bergamot of Calabre, Mandarin of Sicily, Orange Flower, Jasmine
Sambac LMR, Hydroponic Living Gardenia, Sandalwood, White Amber, Musks.
Style:
Luminous. Textured. Seductive.

name: Dior Rose Star Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Rose Star by Dior is an Oriental Floral fragrance designed for both women and men. Introduced in 2025, this new scent was created by renowned perfumer Francis Kurkdjian. The fragrance opens with vibrant top notes of Sichuan Pepper, Pear, and Lemon, followed by a heart of enchanting Rose. It concludes with a warm base of Honey and Musk.

name: Dior Rouge Trafalgar Esprit De Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Rouge Trafalgar Esprit De Parfum by Dior is a captivating Floral Fruity scent designed for both women and men. Released in 2024, this innovative fragrance is crafted by the renowned perfumer Francis Kurkdjian. The fragrance opens with fresh notes of Cherry and Pink Pepper, leading into a heart of luxurious Bulgarian and Turkish Rose, and is anchored by a base of enticing Red Fruits.

name: Dior Sauvage Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Dior Sauvage Eau de Parfum is the warmer, smoother version of the modern classic.
François Demachy created it in 2018. Bergamot opens bright and fresh, Sichuan pepper, lavender, star anise and nutmeg add a spicy heart, and ambroxan and vanilla leave a smooth, lasting trail.
Versatile and easy to wear, it works in every season, day or night, from the office to date night.

Dior Sauvage is a Masculine fragrance, The fragrance launched in 2018, The nose behind this fragrance is Francois Demachy,
Top Note: Bergamot
Heart Note: Sichuan Pepper, Lavender, Star Anise, Nutmeg
Base Note: Ambroxan, Vanilla

name: Dior Sauvage Eau Forte for Men

notes.source_text: Sauvage Eau Forte by Dior is an aromatic fougère fragrance designed for men. This new addition to the Dior collection was introduced in 2024, crafted by the renowned perfumer Francis Kurkdjian. The fragrance opens with invigorating top notes of Elemi resin and spices, followed by a heart of soothing lavender. The scent is grounded with base notes of musky and woody aromas.

name: Dior Sauvage Elixir for Men

notes.source_text:
Dior Sauvage Elixir is the richest, spiciest take on Sauvage.
François Demachy created it in 2021, trading the original's bright freshness for warmth. Cinnamon, nutmeg and cardamom open over a flash of grapefruit, lavender sits at the heart, and licorice, sandalwood, amber, patchouli and Haitian vetiver settle into a smooth, long-lasting base.
Sauvage Elixir is dense and powerful, built for cool evenings and nights out from fall into spring. One or two sprays go a long way, and it lasts for hours.

Sauvage Elixir (Pure Parfum) by Dior is a Aromatic fragrance for men. This is a new fragrance. Sauvage Elixir was launched in 2021. The nose behind this fragrance is Francois Demachy. Top notes are Cinnamon, Nutmeg, Cardamom and Grapefruit; middle note is Lavender; base notes are Sandalwood, Licorice, Amber, Patchouli and Haitian Vetiver.

name: Dior Sauvage Extrait for Men

notes.source_text:
Dior Sauvage Extrait is a deep, woody take on Sauvage with a touch of oud.
Created by Francis Kurkdjian, it opens with fresh bergamot, crisp lavender and warm ambroxan. A heart of Vietnamese oud adds depth, and patchouli, smoky vetiver and Virginia and Atlas cedar give it a rich, earthy finish.
Made for fall and winter nights.

name: Dior Sauvage Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Dior Sauvage Parfum is the smooth, refined Parfum version of Sauvage.
François Demachy created it in 2019. Bergamot, mandarin and elemi open bright, sandalwood forms a creamy heart, and olibanum, tonka bean and vanilla give it a warm finish.
Versatile in spring, fall and winter, from everyday wear to date nights.

Dior Sauvage is a Masculine fragrance, The fragrance launched in 2019, The nose behind this fragrance is Francois Demachy,
Top Note: Bergamot, Mandarin Orange, elemi
Heart Note: Sandalwood
Base Note: Olibanum, Tonka Bean, Vanilla

name: Dior Spice Blend Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Spice Blend by Christian Dior is a Amber Spicy fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Spice Blend
was launched in 2019. The nose behind this fragrance is Francois
Demachy. Top notes are Rum and Ginger; middle notes are Pink Pepper,
Cinnamon, Black Pepper, Cloves, Nutmeg and Coriander; base notes are Bay
Leaf and Woodsy Notes.

name: Diptyque 34 Boulevard Saint Germain Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: 34 Boulevard Saint Germain Eau de Parfum, crafted by Diptyque, is an enchanting Amber Woody fragrance suitable for both women and men. Introduced in 2018, this scent opens with an invigorating blend of Cinnamon, Clove, Pink Pepper, Cassis, and Citruses. The heart reveals a floral medley of Iris, Geranium, Violet, Rose, and Tuberose, while the base is anchored by rich Woody Notes, Sandalwood, Amber, and Vanilla, creating a warm and inviting experience.

name: Diptyque 34 Boulevard Saint Germain Eau de Toilette Unisex

notes.source_text:
34 Boulevard Saint Germain by Diptyque is a captivating Chypre Floral fragrance designed for both women and men. Introduced in 2011, this scent was crafted by perfumer Olivier Pescheux. The fragrance opens with a vibrant blend of Clove, Cinnamon, Black Currant, Cardamom, Fig Leaf, Pink Pepper, Green Notes, and Citruses. The heart reveals floral notes of Geranium, Iris, Tuberose, Violet, and Rose, while the base is anchored by Resin, Woodsy Notes, and Eucalyptus.

34 boulevard Saint Germain by Diptyque is a Chypre Floral fragrance for women and men. 34 boulevard Saint Germain was launched in 2011. The nose behind this fragrance is Olivier Pescheux. Top notes are Clove, Cinnamon, Black Currant, Cardamom, Fig Leaf, Pink Pepper, Green Notes and Citruses; middle notes are Geranium, iris, Tuberose, Violet and Rose; base notes are Resin, Woodsy Notes and Eucalyptus.

name: Diptyque Benjoin Boheme Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Benjoin Bohème by Diptyque is an Oriental Woody fragrance for women and men, launched in 2015. It features a warm, resinous blend of benzoin, sandalwood, styrax, Indonesian patchouli leaf, and angelica.

name: Diptyque Bois Corse Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Bois Corse by Diptyque is a unisex Oriental Woody fragrance. This new scent debuted in 2024 and was crafted by perfumers Olivier Pescheux and Natalie Gracia-Cetto.

name: Diptyque Do Son Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Diptyque Do Son is a soft, breezy tuberose with a fresh, airy feel.
Fabrice Pellegrin created it in 2005. Orange flower, iris and rose open fresh, tuberose and pink pepper form a lush heart, and benzoin and musk give it a soft finish.
A daytime favorite for spring and summer.

"Tuberose asserts itself, expressing all its sunny, hazy, creamy,
indolent seductiveness. Anyone with blood in their veins will succumb to
the irresistible temptation of this insolently seductive white flower."
- a note from the brand.
Do Son Eau de Parfum was launched in 2013. The nose behind this fragrance is Fabrice Pellegrin.

name: Diptyque Do Son Eau de Toilette Unisex

notes.source_text:
Do Son by Diptyque is a Floral fragrance for women. Do Son
was launched in 2005. The nose behind this fragrance is Fabrice
Pellegrin. Top notes are African Orange flower, iris and Rose; middle
notes are Tuberose and Pink Pepper; base notes are Benzoin and Musk.

name: Diptyque Eau Capitale Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Diptyque Eau Capitale is a bright, modern chypre of bergamot, rose and patchouli.
Olivier Pescheux created it in 2019. Bergamot and pink pepper open sparkling, rose forms the heart, and patchouli gives it an earthy finish.
Versatile in spring, fall and winter, day or night.

name: Diptyque Eau de Lierre Eau de Toilette for Women

notes.source_text: Diptyque's Eau de Lierre Eau de Toilette is a Floral Green fragrance designed for women. This exquisite scent made its debut in 2006.

name: Diptyque Eau de Minthe Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Diptyque Eau de Minthe is a fresh, green blend of mint, geranium and patchouli.
Launched in 2019, it opens with mint and nutmeg. Geranium and rose form the heart, and patchouli gives it an earthy finish.
A refreshing choice for any day.

name: Diptyque Eau des Sens Eau de Toilette Unisex

notes.source_text:
Diptyque Eau des Sens is a bright, bittersweet orange blossom.
Olivier Pescheux created it in 2016. Orange blossom and bitter orange open bright, juniper berries add an aromatic heart, and angelica and patchouli give it a soft, woody finish.
A sunny daytime scent for spring and summer.

Eau des Sens by Diptyque is a Citrus Aromatic fragrance for women and men. Eau des Sens was launched in 2016. The nose behind this fragrance is Olivier Pescheux. Top notes are orange blossom and bitter orange; middle note is juniper berries; base notes are patchouli and angelica.

name: Diptyque Eau Duelle Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Eau Duelle Eau de Parfum by Diptyque is a Aromatic Spicy fragrance for women and men. Eau Duelle Eau de Parfum was launched in 2013. The nose behind this fragrance is Fabrice Pellegrin.

name: Diptyque Eau Duelle Eau de Toilette Unisex

notes.source_text: Eau Duelle by Diptyque is a Oriental Spicy fragrance for women and men. Eau Duelle was launched in 2010. The nose behind this fragrance is Fabrice Pellegrin. The fragrance features cardamom, elemi resin, olibanum, bergamot, pink pepper, juniper, saffron, black tea, musk, ambergris and bourbon vanilla.

name: Diptyque Eau Moheli Eau de Toilette Unisex

notes.source_text: Eau Moheli by Diptyque is a Floral Woody Musk fragrance for women and men. Eau Moheli was launched in 2013. The nose behind this fragrance is Olivier Pescheux.

name: Diptyque Eau Nabati Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Eau Nabati by Diptyque is a unisex fragrance, suitable for both women and men. This scent is a recent addition to their collection, having been introduced in 2023.

name: Diptyque Eau Rihla Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Eau Rihla Eau de Parfum by Diptyque is a Amber Woody fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Eau Rihla Eau de Parfum was launched in 2021. The nose behind this fragrance is Fabrice Pellegrin. Top notes are Saffron, Raspberry and Pink Pepper; middle notes are Leather, iris and Cedar; base notes are Vanilla and Musk.

name: Diptyque Eau Rose Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Diptyque Eau Rose Eau de Parfum is a fresh, dewy rose with a lychee twist.
Fabrice Pellegrin created it in 2022. Lychee opens juicy, Grasse rose, rose water, Damask rose, artichoke and chamomile form a fresh floral heart, and musk and woods give it a soft finish.
Light and pretty for spring and summer days.

name: Diptyque Eau Rose Eau de Toilette for Women

notes.source_text: Diptyque's Eau Rose is a women's scent that falls within the Floral Fruity category. This fragrance made its debut in 2012. It opens with the sweet and tart blend of Litchi, Black Currant, and Bergamot. The heart of the scent is composed of a floral trio featuring Rose, Geranium, and Jasmine. The foundation of the perfume is built on the warm and soothing scents of Musk, white honey, and Virginia Cedar.

name: Diptyque Fleur de Peau Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Diptyque Fleur de Peau is a soft, powdery musk that feels like warm skin.
Olivier Pescheux created it in 2018. Aldehydes, pink pepper, angelica and bergamot open bright, iris and Turkish rose form a velvety heart, and musk, ambrette, carrot, ambergris, leather and sandalwood give it a sensual finish.
Elegant and intimate, it is a daytime favorite for spring and fall.

Fleur de Peau by Diptyque is a Floral Aldehyde fragrance for women and men. Fleur de Peau
was launched in 2018. The nose behind this fragrance is Olivier
Pescheux. Top notes are Aldehydes, Pink Pepper, Angelica and Bergamot;
middle notes are iris and Turkish Rose; base notes are Musk, Ambrette
(Musk Mallow), Carrot, Ambergris, Leather, Sandalwood and Amberwood.

name: Diptyque Fleur de Peau Eau de Toilette Unisex

notes.source_text:
Diptyque Fleur de Peau multi-use fragrance is a soft, musky iris for body and hair.
Olivier Pescheux created it in 2020. Bergamot and aldehydes open fresh, jasmine, iris and lily of the valley form the heart, and musk and ambrette give it a skin-like finish.
Easy to wear in every season, day or night.

name: Diptyque Florabellio Eau de Toilette Unisex

notes.source_text: Released in 2015, the Florabellio Eau de Toilette from Diptyque exudes an intoxicatingly aromatic and spicy scent suitable for both men and women. Fabrice Pellegrin, the talented nose behind the fragrance, masterfully combined Sea Notes, Sea Salt, Fennel, Apple Blossom, Osmanthus, Roasted Coffee Beans, and Sesame to create an unforgettable experience.

name: Diptyque Geranium Odorata Eau de Toilette Unisex

notes.source_text:
Guaranteed to evoke mixed feelings, Geranium Odorata eau de toilette
celebrates a flower typically seen adorning a lapel, rather than
trailing in one's wake. It boldly challenges traditional norms by
complementing men's skin with a blend of citrus fruits and spices.
Simultaneously, akin to the versatility of a tuxedo, it stands out as an
exquisite fragrance choice for women.

name: Diptyque L'Eau de Neroli Eau de Toilette Unisex

notes.source_text: L'Eau de Neroli by Diptyque is an invigorating Citrus Aromatic fragrance suitable for both women and men, introduced in 2008. Crafted by the renowned perfumer Olivier Pescheux, the fragrance opens with a vibrant blend of Citruses, Bergamot, Lemon Verbena, Petitgrain, and Tarragon. The heart of the scent features delicate notes of Neroli, Orange Blossom, and Egyptian Pelargonium. The base is grounded with the warm and comforting aromas of Beeswax, White Musk, and Cedar.

name: Diptyque L'Eau des Hesperides Eau de Toilette Unisex

notes.source_text: L'Eau des Hesperides, crafted by Diptyque, presents a unisex aromatic scent that made its debut in 2008. Perfumer Olivier Pescheux is the mastermind behind its creation. The fragrance opens with a vibrant blend of top notes, including bitter orange, fresh grass, petitgrain, Mandarin orange, fragrant rosemary, zesty lemon, aromatic caraway, and a hint of pepper. At its heart lies a refreshing mix of mint along with a bouquet of floral notes. The scent concludes on a warm and earthy base with the distinct presence of immortelle, soft musk, and rich cedar.

name: Diptyque L'Eau Papier Eau de Toilette for Women

notes.source_text:
Diptyque L'Eau Papier is a soft, airy musk that feels like a blank page.
Fabrice Pellegrin created it in 2023. White musk, mimosa, toasted sesame and light woods blend into a gentle, powdery scent with a delicate floral warmth.
Quiet and comforting, it is perfect for anyone who wants a subtle, close-to-the-skin scent for everyday wear.

name: Diptyque L'Ombre dans L'Eau Eau de Toilette for Women

notes.source_text: L'Ombre Dans L'Eau ("Shadow in the water") is a female fragrance from 1983, based on the unusual and beautiful harmony of black currant leaf and Bulgarian rose, which blend perfectly together. This perfume was created by Serge Kalouguine, a famous French perfumer who dedicated 30 years of his life to the house of Fragonard. Read more about this fragrance in the article L'Ombre dans L'Eau ("Shadow in the water") from Diptyque.

name: Diptyque L'Ombre Dans L'Eau Limited Edition Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
L'Ombre Dans L'Eau Limited Edition by Diptyque is a Floral fragrance for women. This is a new fragrance. L'Ombre Dans L'Eau Limited Edition
was launched in 2019. Top notes are Cassis, Bergamot and Mandarin
Orange; middle notes are Black currant leaf, Rose and Black Currant;
base notes are Musk and Ambergris.

name: Diptyque Lazulio Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Lazulio by Diptyque is a floral scent designed for both women and men. This fresh fragrance debuted in 2025, crafted by the talented perfumer Quentin Bisch.

name: Diptyque Lilyphea Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Diptyque Lilyphea is a fresh, spicy vanilla with a green violet-leaf twist.
Olivier Pescheux and Nathalie Gracia-Cetto created it in 2024. Cardamom, ginger and violet leaf meet Bourbon vanilla in a bright, airy blend that stays fresh and green from start to finish.
Light and modern, it is perfect for spring and summer days.

name: Diptyque Orphéon Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Diptyque Orphéon is a soft, powdery woody fragrance with a quiet floral heart.
Launched in 2021, it opens with crisp juniper berries, moves into a soft jasmine heart and settles into powdery notes, cedar and tonka bean for a warm, polished finish.
Orphéon is understated and elegant, a scent that rewards people who stand close. It is a lovely daytime choice for spring and fall.

Orphéon by Diptyque is a Woody Chypre fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Orphéon was launched in 2021. Top note is Juniper Berries; middle note is Jasmine; base notes are Powdery Notes, Cedar and Tonka Bean.

name: Diptyque Orpheon Eau de Toilette Unisex

notes.source_text:
Diptyque Orphéon Eau de Toilette is a lighter, citrusy take on Orphéon.
Nathalie Gracia-Cetto created it in 2026. Pink pepper, ginger, yuzu, green mandarin and juniper open fresh, magnolia and rose form a soft heart, and cedar and musk give it a clean finish.
A daytime favorite for spring and summer.

name: Diptyque Oud Palao Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Oud Palao Eau de Parfum by Diptyque is a Amber Woody fragrance for women and men. Oud Palao Eau de Parfum was launched in 2015.

name: Diptyque Oyedo Eau de Toilette Unisex

notes.source_text:
Oyedo Eau de Toilette by Diptyque is a captivating Citrus Aromatic fragrance designed for both women and men. Introduced in 2000, this scent was crafted by perfumer Akiko Kamei. The fragrance opens with invigorating top notes of Mandarin Orange, Yuzu, Lemon, and Lime, followed by a heart of Thyme. The experience is rounded out with a warm base of woodsy notes.
