Oyedo by Diptyque is a Citrus Aromatic fragrance for women and men. Oyedo was launched in 2000. Top notes are lime, mandarin orange, lemon and yuzu; middle note is thyme; base note is woodsy notes.

name: Diptyque Philosykos Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Diptyque Philosykos Eau de Parfum is a green, milky fig that smells like a summer orchard.
Olivia Giacobetti created this eau de parfum in 2012. Fig leaf and ripe fig open fresh and green, the scent of the fig tree forms the heart, and woods and black pepper give it a dry, creamy finish.
A daytime favorite for spring and summer, the office and everyday wear.

One of the best fig scents ever made
and one of our favorite scents of all time, now even stronger and more
compelling. This ode to the fig groves of Greece is still a very green
fig – a fig just on the verge of being ripe. The opening is sharp with
the tart freshness of the leaves, and then the fig itself comes into
play – sweet enough to tantalize, but not overwhelm. The glossy green
leaves and succulent fruit intertwine with a dry wood note and a hint of
rich earth. You get the sense not only of the whole tree, but the whole
grove – the wood, the earth, the sky, the Mediterranean sun coaxing the
sweetness of the fruit along as it ripens. Many a superlative has been
used to describe this fragrance over the years and it deserves every
one. Outstanding.
Philosykos - Eau de Parfum  Notes
Fig tree leaves, wood, white cedar

name: Diptyque Philosykos Eau de Toilette Unisex

notes.source_text:
Diptyque Philosykos Eau de Toilette is the original fresh, green fig.
Olivia Giacobetti created it in 1996. Fig, fig leaf and fig tree wood blend into a green, milky and gently woody scent.
A daytime favorite for spring and summer.

Philosykos by Diptyque is a Woody Aromatic fragrance for women and men. Philosykos was launched in 1996. The nose behind this fragrance is Olivia Giacobetti. Top notes are fig leaf and fig; middle notes are coconut and green notes; base notes are cedar, woody notes and fig tree.

name: Diptyque Rose Roche Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Rose Roche by Diptyque is a unisex floral fragrance introduced in 2024. Created by perfumer Fabrice Pellegrin, this scent represents the brand's latest offering.

name: Diptyque Tam Dao Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Diptyque Tam Dao is a creamy, meditative sandalwood.
Daniel Molière created this eau de parfum in 2013. Sandalwood and cedar are warmed by amberwood, vanilla and musk, with a light touch of coriander, lime and ginger.
Calm and comforting, it is an easy everyday scent from spring through winter.

Diptyque Tam Dao is a Unisex fragrance, The fragrance launched in 2013, The nose behind this fragrance is Daniel Moliere,
Top Note: Sandalwood, Cedar, Amberwood, Coriander, Vanilla, Musk, Lime, Ginger
Heart Note: Sandalwood, Vanilla
Base Note: Amberwood, Cedar, Musk, Vanilla

name: Diptyque Tam Dao Eau de Toilette Unisex

notes.source_text:
Diptyque Tam Dao Eau de Toilette is a lighter, airier take on Diptyque's sandalwood.
Launched in 2003, it opens with Italian cypress, myrtle and rose. Sandalwood and cedar form a creamy heart, and rosewood, spices, amber and white musk give it a soft finish.
A calm daytime scent for spring, fall and winter.

Tam Dao by Diptyque is a Floral Woody Musk fragrance for women and men. Tam Dao was launched in 2003. Top notes are rose, myrtle and italian cypress; middle notes are sandalwood and cedar; base notes are spices, amber, white musk and brazilian rosewood.

name: Diptyque Tempo Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Diptyque Tempo is a modern, aromatic patchouli.
Olivier Pescheux created it in 2018. Clary sage, pink pepper, maté, bergamot and violet leaf brighten a clean, refined patchouli.
Versatile in spring, fall and winter, day or night.

name: Diptyque Vetyverio Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Vetyverio Eau De Parfum by Diptyque is a Floral Woody Musk fragrance for women and men. Vetyverio Eau De Parfum was launched in 2017. The nose behind this fragrance is Olivier Pescheux. Top notes are Grapefruit and Mandarin Orange; middle note is Turkish Rose; base notes are Haitian Vetiver, Vetiver and Patchouli.

name: Diptyque Vetyverio Eau de Toilette Unisex

notes.source_text: Vetyverio Eau de Toilette by Diptyque is a Floral Woody Musk fragrance for women and men. Vetyverio Eau de Toilette was launched in 2010. The nose behind this fragrance is Olivier Pescheux. Top notes are Grapefruit, Amalfi Lemon, Bergamot and Mandarin Orange; middle notes are Geranium, Rose, Ylang-Ylang, Nutmeg, Carrot Seeds and Clove; base notes are vetyver, Musk and Virginia Cedar.

name: Dolce & Gabbana Devotion Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text: Devotion Pour Homme, created by Dolce & Gabbana, is a captivating Woody Spicy scent for men. Introduced in 2025, this fragrance is a fresh addition to their collection. Renowned perfumer Olivier Cresp crafted this alluring scent, featuring a zesty Lemon as the top note, rich Coffee at its heart, and a warm base of Patchouli.

name: Dolce & Gabbana Devotion Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
The Dolce&Gabbana Devotion Eau de Parfum fragrance is a sensory
journey, seductive and reassuring, capable of evoking the positive
values to which Dolce&Gabbana hold dear, symbolized by the Sacred
Heart seal. An olfactory creation of exquisite contrasts, bright top
notes, sensual base notes.

name: Dolce & Gabbana Devotion Intense Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text: Devotion Intense by Dolce&Gabbana is an alluring Oriental Vanilla fragrance designed for women. Introduced in 2024, this scent is the latest creation from renowned perfumer Olivier Cresp. The fragrance opens with a delightful hazelnut note, followed by a heart of exquisite orange blossom, and concludes with a warm base of rich vanilla.

name: Dolce & Gabbana Dolce Garden Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text: Dolce&Gabbana's Dolce Garden is a luxurious Floral Fruity Gourmand fragrance created for women in 2018. Violaine Collas is credited as the nose behind this sophisticated scent which combines Magnolia, Mandarin Orange and Neroli as top notes; Coconut, Frangipani and Ylang-Ylang as middle notes; as well as Vanilla Absolute, Almond Milk and Sandalwood as base notes.

name: Dolce & Gabbana Dolce Lily Eau de Toilette for Women

notes.source_text: Dolce Lily by Dolce&Gabbana is a Floral Fruity fragrance for women. This is a new fragrance. Dolce Lily was launched in 2022. Dolce Lily was created by Natalie Gracia-Cetto and Nisrine Bouazzaoui Grillié. Top notes are Passionfruit, Lemon and Bergamot; middle notes are Rose and Pink Lily; base notes are Musk, Sandalwood and Vanilla.

name: Dolce & Gabbana Dolce Peony Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text: Dolce Peony by Dolce&Gabbana is a Floral Fruity Gourmand fragrance for women. Dolce Peony was launched in 2019. The nose behind this fragrance is Christophe Raynaud. Top notes are Pear, Cyclamen, Bergamot and Pink Pepper; middle notes are Peony, Freesia and Bulgarian Rose; base notes are Mirabelle, Honey, Ambroxan and Patchouli.

name: Dolce & Gabbana Dolce Rose Eau de Toilette for Women

notes.source_text: Dolce Rose, the newest fragrance from Dolce&Gabbana, is a Floral Fruity scent, perfect for women. Released in 2021, its top notes consist of Red Currant, Green Apple and Mandarin Orange; with a heart of Rose, May Rose, White Peach and Magnolia; and a base of Musk, White Wood and Sandalwood.

name: Dolce & Gabbana Dolce Shine Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text: Dolce&Gabbana introduces the new Floral Fruity fragrance, Dolce Shine, launched in 2020. Created by fragrance expert Marie Salamagne, this scent will captivate your senses. Top notes of Mango, Quince and Grapefruit mix with Solar, Ozonic, Sea Salt, Tuberose, Jasmine and Orange Blossom at the heart. Finally, White Musk, Australian Sandalwood and White Woods at the base round off this delightful composition.

name: Dolce & Gabbana Fruit Collection Lemon Eau de Toilette Unisex

notes.source_text: Introducing Lemon by Dolce&Gabbana, the citrus fragrance for him and her. Unveiling in 2020, this new scent was skillfully created by the nose of Jerome Epinette. An invigorating blend of Sicilian Lemon, Calabrian bergamot and Petitgrain start off the scent, followed by a zesty hint of Ginger. Haitian Vetiver provides a long-lasting base note.

name: Dolce & Gabbana K Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
K by Dolce & Gabbana Eau de Parfum by Dolce&Gabbana is a Woody Spicy fragrance for men. This is a new fragrance. K by Dolce & Gabbana Eau de Parfum
was launched in 2020. Top notes are lemon, sicilian lemon, blood
orange, cardamom, juniper berries and pimento; middle notes are
geranium, clary sage, lavender and fig nectar; base notes are cedar,
patchouli, vetiver and cypriol oil or nagarmotha.

name: Dolce & Gabbana K Eau de Parfum Intense for Men

notes.source_text: K by Dolce & Gabbana Eau de Parfum Intense is a men's fragrance that debuted in 2024. Crafted by perfumer Daphné Bugey, this new scent opens with refreshing top notes of Blood Orange and Sicilian Lemon. The heart features a captivating blend of Fig and Saffron, while the base is anchored by rich Leather and earthy Woody Notes.

name: Dolce & Gabbana K Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
"K by Dolce&Gabbana is a fragrance that captures the
essence of a man in his element. He is the king of his everyday life. He
follows his own path, cherishing his family and loved ones above all
else. Effortlessly charming, and not afraid to show his vitality, he
remains true to his roots, respecting tradition while embracing
modernity."
The opening notes of the composition include sparkling blood orange,
pressed Sicilian lemon and juniper berries. The heart reveals the
pimento essence combined with clary sage, geranium and lavandin, while
the base is woody and masculine combining the cedarwood, vetiver and
patchouli accords.

name: Dolce & Gabbana L'Eau The One Eau de Toilette for Women

notes.source_text: L'eau The One by Dolce&Gabbana is a Amber Floral fragrance for women. L'eau The One was launched in 2008. Top notes are Peach, Litchi, Tangerine and Bergamot; middle notes are Lily, Jasmine, Plum and Lily-of-the-Valley; base notes are Vanilla, Musk, Amber, Oakmoss and Vetiver.

name: Dolce & Gabbana L'Imperatrice Eau de Toilette for Women

notes.source_text: D&G Anthology L'Imperatrice 3 by Dolce&Gabbana is a Floral Aquatic fragrance for women. D&G Anthology L'Imperatrice 3 was launched in 2009. Top notes are Kiwi, Rhuburb and Pink Pepper; middle notes are Watermelon, Cyclamen and Jasmine; base notes are Lemon Tree, Musk and Sandalwood.

name: Dolce & Gabbana Light Blue Capri In Love Eau de Parfum for Men

top: transitions into a heart note of Fig
concludes with a rich base note of Patchouli
middle: concludes with a rich base note of Patchouli
key: transitions into a heart note of Fig
concludes with a rich base note of Patchouli
notes.source_text: Light Blue Capri In Love Pour Homme Eau de Parfum by Dolce & Gabbana is a captivating Woody Aromatic fragrance designed for men. Introduced in 2025, this new addition to the Light Blue collection features the creative touch of perfumer Alexandra Carlin. It opens with a vibrant top note of Black Pepper, transitions into a heart note of Fig, and concludes with a rich base note of Patchouli.

name: Dolce & Gabbana Light Blue Capri In Love Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text: Light Blue Capri In Love Eau de Parfum by Dolce & Gabbana is a delightful Floral Fruity scent crafted for women. Debuting in 2025, this new fragrance is the creation of perfumer Emilie Bevierre-Coppermann. The fragrance opens with the fresh aroma of Jasmine Tea, transitions to a heart of Apple, and concludes with the warm notes of Longoza.

name: Dolce & Gabbana Light Blue Discover Vulcano Pour Homme Eau de Toilette for Men
tags: Light Blue Discover Vulcano Pour Homme

notes.source_text:
Dolce & Gabbana is launching a new
fragrant pair for spring 2014 and it is inspired by the islands of
Vulcano and Panarea. The perfumes arrive in characteristic bottles as
limited editions with light compositions aimed at the summer period of
the year.
Edition for men is inspired by the island of Vulcano, the volcanos
were named after later on. This island is known for mud bath and the
crater with smoke. The name Volcano was given by the ancient Romans and
during the years it entered many modern languages. Romans used this
island to obtain high quality raw materials and timber. The fragrance
Vulcano depicts the atmosphere with a luminous blend of Italian lemon
and ginger, followed by an aromatic-woody blend of cypress and lavender.
The base closes with an elegant woody layer of vetiver and cedar.
Men's version Light Blue Discover Volcano can be purchased as 125ml Eau
de Toilette.

name: Dolce & Gabbana Light Blue Eau de Toilette for Women

notes.source_text:
A
stunning perfume, overwhelming and irresistible like the joy of living.
The scent is surprisingly colored with the liveliness of Sicilian
citron, the happiness of Granny Smith apple, and the spontaneity of
bluebells. Feminine and resolute notes are expressed with the intensity
of jasmine, the freshness of bamboo, and the charm of white rose. The
deep and true base embodies the character of cedarwood, the fullness of
amber, and the embrace of musk.
Notes:
Sicilian Citron, Bluebell, Granny Smith Apple, Jasmine Sambac, Bamboo, White Rose, Cedarwood, Amber, Musk.
Style:
Deep and true.

name: Dolce & Gabbana Light Blue Eau Intense Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Dolce & Gabbana Light Blue Eau Intense pour Femme is a juicy, crisp citrus with green apple.
Olivier Cresp created it in 2017. Lemon and Granny Smith apple open bright, marigold and jasmine form a fresh heart, and musk and amberwood give it a lasting finish.
A summer favorite for everyday wear and active days.

Sixteen years after the launch of Light Blue, master perfumer Olivier
Cresp writes a new chapter of the Light Blue saga with Light Blue Eau
Intense pour Femme. The fragrance opens with a sharp, addictive duo of
scents: luminous lemon and crisp Granny Smith apple. With its fruity and
floral facets, elegant marigold blends this accord into the heart
notes—a wave of glowing, heady jasmine petals. The signature trail of
lustrous amber woods and precious musk melts into sunkissed skin and
unfurls into a vibrant, sensuously scented wake.
Fragrance Family:
Fresh
Scent Type:
Fresh Floral
Key Notes:
Lemon, Jasmine Petals, Musk

name: Dolce & Gabbana Light Blue Eau Intense Pour Homme Eau de Parfum for Men
tags: Light Blue Eau Intense Pour Homme

notes.source_text:
Dolce & Gabbana Light Blue Eau Intense pour Homme is a deeper, saltier take on Light Blue.
Alberto Morillas created it in 2017. Grapefruit and mandarin open bright, sea water and juniper form a fresh, salty heart, and amberwood and musk give it a lasting finish.
A summer favorite for the office, the gym and everyday wear.

Fragrance Family:
Fresh
Scent Type:
Fresh Aquatics
Key Notes:
Grapefruit, Juniper, Musk
About:
This fragrance represents a new intensity of the iconic Light Blue Pour
Homme. Strong and deep, the watery and citrus freshness is combined
with a base of musky and woody notes for an irresistible and unique
fragrance for men.
What else you need to know:
Streamlined
and modern, the design of the new flacon fragrance reflects the scent’s
heightened intensity. Inside the cool frosted-glass bottle, it takes on
the evocative, light blue shade of the Mediterranean Sea.

name: Dolce & Gabbana Light Blue Forever Pour Femme Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text: Light Blue Forever by Dolce&Gabbana is a Floral Fruity fragrance for women. This is a new fragrance. Light Blue Forever was launched in 2021. The nose behind this fragrance is Olivier Cresp. Top notes are Lemon, Blood Orange and Green Apple; middle notes are Orange Blossom and White Flowers; base notes are White Musk, Cedar and Cashmeran.

name: Dolce & Gabbana Light Blue Italian Zest Pour Homme Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
A pure explosion of fresh bergamot boosts Light Blue Pour Homme’s
signature contrast of coolness and sensuality. Italian Zest brightens
the top notes of grapefruit and mandarin, while pepper and juniper add a
spicy tang to the rosemary and rosewood heart notes. By contrast, the
vibrant incense and musks of the drydown feel even more potent. Light
Blue Italian Zest is an invitation to make Summer sparkle with zest.
Fragrance Family:
Fresh
Scent Type:
Fresh Citrus & Fruits
Key Notes:
Bergamot of Calabria, Rosemary, Oak Moss

name: Dolce & Gabbana Light Blue Love Is Love Eau de Toilette for Women

notes.source_text: Dolce & Gabbana's Light Blue Love Is Love Pour Femme is a captivating scent for women that intertwines floral, woody, and musk essences. Recently introduced, this fragrance made its debut in 2020. It opens with the zesty brightness of lemon, the tart sweetness of Granny Smith apple, and the lush juiciness of red berries. At its heart is a delectable blend of creamy ice cream and tart raspberry, complemented by the delicate aroma of jasmine. The fragrance settles into a comforting finish of soft whipped cream paired with the sensual warmth of musk, complemented by the grounding presence of cedar and the rich, resinous tones of amber.

name: Dolce & Gabbana Light Blue Love is Love Pour Homme Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
Light Blue Love Is Love Pour Homme was presented in March
2020, as a irresistible summery edition. "The classic woody and musky
scent is boosted by vibrant citrus and crisp Granny Smith apple. A
surprising twist of apple gelato is contrasted by aromatic rosemary and
pink pepper notes, enhancing this fragrance’s passion and sensuality."
Top Notes: Bergamot, Grapefruit, Mandarin, Granny Smith apple
Heart Notes: Pink Pepper, Rosemary, Apple gelato accord
Base Notes: Creamy Musks, Amber Wood, Vanilla

name: Dolce & Gabbana Light Blue pour Homme Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
Drawing upon their native home of Italy, Dolce & Gabbana's
innovative design team has captured the sensuality of the Mediterranean.
A refreshing blend of citrus notes combines perfectly with masculine
woods and subtle spice to create a distinctive fragrance that epitomizes
relaxed sophistication.
Notes:
Sicilian Mandarin, Frozen Grapefruit Peel, Bergamot, Juniper, Rosemary, Szechuan Pepper, Rosewood, Musk Wood, Incense, Oak Moss.
Style:
Mysterious. Confident. Sensual.

name: Dolce & Gabbana Light Blue Pour Homme Summer Vibes Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text: Dolce&Gabbana released a brand new Woody Aromatic fragrance for men in 2023, titled Light Blue Pour Homme Summer Vibes. Created by perfumer Alberto Morillas, this scent is made up of Sicilian Lemon as the top note, Cypress as the middle note, and Amberwood as the base note.

name: Dolce & Gabbana Light Blue Summer Vibes Eau de Toilette for Women

notes.source_text: Dolce&Gabbana's Light Blue Summer Vibes is a fresh, Floral Woody Musk scent specifically designed for women and released in 2023. Master perfumer Olivier Cresp created the combination of Calabrian bergamot, Peach, and Cedar, making this fragrance a unique and memorable experience.

name: Dolce & Gabbana Light Blue Sun Eau de Toilette for Women

notes.source_text: Dolce & Gabbana's Light Blue Sun presents a delightful blend of floral and fruity scents, specifically crafted for women. This exquisite fragrance first graced the market in 2019. Upon the first encounter, one is greeted by the sweet essence of coconut nectar, the zest of lemon, the fresh ozonic whispers, and the crisp aroma of Granny Smith apples. Progressing into the heart of the fragrance, a bouquet blooms with the exotic allure of frangipani, the enchanting fragrance of jasmine, and the pure, subtle notes of white rose. Completing this olfactory journey, the base unfurls with the rich undertones of bourbon vanilla, the clean, soft scent of white musk, the woody warmth of cedar, and the intriguing maritime vibe of ambergris.

name: Dolce & Gabbana Light Blue Sun Pour Homme Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
This summer Dolce & Gabbana Beauty adds a solar twist to its cult
scent Light Blue with a Limited Edition: Light Blue Sun Pour Homme. A
cocktail of Italian bergamot and frozen grapefruit infused by coconut
water boosts Light Blue Pour Homme's signature contrast of coolness and
sensuality. Light Blue Sun invites you to live the passion of a young
summer crush on the island of Capri. Scent: Solar fresh woody. Made in
France.
TOP NOTES
Bergamot
Ginger
Frozen grapefruit
Ozonic accord
HEART NOTES
Rosemary
Cypress
Coconut water
Cedarwood
BASE NOTES
Vanilla
Vetiver
White musks
Oakmoss

name: Dolce & Gabbana Pour Femme Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text: Dolce&Gabbana Pour Femme by Dolce&Gabbana is a Floral fragrance for women. Dolce&Gabbana Pour Femme was launched in 2012. Dolce&Gabbana Pour Femme was created by Jean-Pierre Mary and Martine Pallix. Top notes are Raspberry, Neroli and Mandarin Orange; middle notes are Orange Blossom and Jasmine; base notes are Marshmallow, Vanilla, Sandalwood and Heliotrope.

name: Dolce & Gabbana Pour Homme Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text: Dolce&Gabbana Pour Homme (2012) by Dolce&Gabbana is a Aromatic Fougere fragrance for men. Dolce&Gabbana Pour Homme (2012) was launched in 2012. Top notes are Citruses, Bergamot, Neroli and Mandarin Orange; middle notes are Lavender, Sage and Pepper; base notes are Tobacco, Tonka Bean and Cedar.

name: Dolce & Gabbana Pour Homme Intenso Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Pure instinct; the power of an emotion that is freely expressed. It
is the force of a determined man, with a heart that is rooted in
tradition, yet revels in the modern world. This product is a woody
aromatic fragrance, whose profound appeal is defined by a brand new
discovery in the olfactory world: the Moepel accord which has been
re-created from the flowers and leaves of the milkwood tree using
headspace technology.
Top notes: Opens with luminous aquatic notes and green accents of
basil. This fresh feeling is completed with notes of marigold and
geranium
Heart: First come the notes of lavender and then the tobacco
masculinity is further defined with soft dry notes from absolutes of hay
and bran?
Base notes: Luxurious floral, balsamic, and honey accents. Intensity
and strength come from the profound combination labdanum, sandalwood
and cypress. A contrast of fresh, warm and rich, that completes the
composition of the fragrance and emphasizes its woody charm

name: Dolce & Gabbana Q Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text: Q by Dolce & Gabbana by Dolce&Gabbana is a Aromatic Fruity fragrance for women. This is a new fragrance. Q by Dolce & Gabbana was launched in 2023. The nose behind this fragrance is Daphné Bugey. Top notes are Sicilian Lemon, Blood Orange and Jasmine; middle notes are Cherry and Heliotrope; base notes are Musk and Cedar.

name: Dolce & Gabbana Q Parfum for Women

notes.source_text: Q by Dolce & Gabbana Parfum is a captivating Floral Fruity Gourmand scent designed for women. Introduced in 2025, this fragrance is the latest creation from Dolce & Gabbana, crafted by the talented perfumer Daphné Bugey. It opens with a vibrant top note of Cherry, transitions into a heart of Jasmine Sambac, and concludes with a warm base note of Vanilla.

name: Dolce & Gabbana Sicily Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text: Sicily by Dolce&Gabbana is a Floral Aldehyde fragrance for women. Sicily was launched in 2003. The nose behind this fragrance is Nathalie Lorson. Top notes are Banana, Honeysuckle, Orange Blossom, Bergamot and Aldehydes; middle notes are Nutmeg, Jasmine, Hiacynth, Hibiscus and Rose; base notes are Musk, Sandalwood and Heliotrope.

name: Dolce & Gabbana The One Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text: Dolce&Gabbana's The One fragrance for women was launched in 2006 and created by Christine Nagel. It features a delightful blend of top notes such as Peach, Litchi, Mandarin Orange and Bergamot; middle notes such as Lily, Plum, Jasmine and Lily-of-the-Valley; and base notes including Vanilla, Amber, Musk and Vetiver. The resulting scent is an exquisite Amber Floral.

name: Dolce & Gabbana The One Eau de Parfum Intense for Men

notes.source_text:
"The quintessence of masculine charisma and refined elegance, The One for Men Eau de Parfum Intense brings a striking new intensity to the Dolce&Gabbana
Beauty The One for Men line. Drawing on the olfactory inheritance of
The One for Men Eau de Toilette and Eau de Parfum, and The One Grey Eau
de Toilette Intense, it introduces a new expression of timeless
sophistication that heightens the irresistible magnetism of the man who
wears it.
The One For Men Eau de Parfum Intense finds its magnetic
appeal in a daring fusion of opposites. Intensely masculine, fascinating
yet authentic, it is a scent of extremes – warm neroli golden facets
with deep black leather in an enigmatic expression of olfactory
chiaroscuro.
Sharing the same clean geometric lines as the original The One for
Men fragrance, the bottle is now reimagined in black, the iconic colour
of Dolce&Gabbana. Symbolic of elegance, sensuality and
tradition, the sleek black form is accented with radiant gold details,
mirroring the distinctive facets of the fragrance within."

name: Dolce & Gabbana The One Essence Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text: The One Essence by Dolce&Gabbana is a Amber Floral fragrance for women. The One Essence was launched in 2015. Top notes are Peach, Litchi, Mandarin Orange and Bergamot; middle notes are Lily, Jasmine and Lily-of-the-Valley; base notes are Vanilla, Amber and Vetiver.

name: Dolce & Gabbana The One for Men Eau de Parfum Eau de Parfum for Men
tags: The One for Men Eau de Parfum

notes.source_text:
Dolce & Gabbana The One Eau de Parfum is a warm, spicy tobacco and amber classic.
Olivier Polge created it in 2015. Grapefruit, coriander and basil open fresh, ginger, cardamom and orange blossom form a spicy heart, and amber, tobacco and cedar give it a smooth, seductive base.
Made for fall and winter, ideal for date nights and evenings out.

Dolce & Gabbana launched The One for Men in 2008 as the fragrance intended to become a masculine classics. In 2015, The One for Men Eau de Parfum appears as an enhanced, denser version of the scent.
The elegant top notes of coriander, basil and grapefruit are leading to
the heart where there is a warm blend of ginger, orange blossom and
cardamom. Tobacco, sensual amber and cedar leave their mark at the base
of the perfume.

name: Dolce & Gabbana The One Gold For Men Eau de Parfum Intense

notes.source_text: The One Gold For Men by Dolce&Gabbana is a Aromatic Spicy fragrance for men. This is a new fragrance. The One Gold For Men was launched in 2021. The One Gold For Men was created by Rodrigo Flores-Roux, Michel Girard and Olivier Pescheux. Top notes are Blood Orange, Sicilian Bergamot and Ginger; middle notes are Clary Sage, Cardamom and Geranium; base notes are Patchouli, Amberwood and Haitian Vetiver.

name: Dolce & Gabbana The One Grey Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
Fragrance Family:
Earthy & Woody
Scent Type:
Citrus & Woods
Key Notes:
Grapefruit, Cardamom, Vetiver
About:
Joining the Dolce&Gabbana The One for Men line, The One Grey is
a celebration of modern elegance and charisma. It is a fusion of
opposites, grounding aromatic cardamom with earthy vetiver. The cardamom
opens the fragrance, combined with bitter citrus notes of grapefruit.
Lavandin and vetiver power the heart of the scent, while the base
reveals The One for Men’s signature sensuality with warm tobacco and
elegant grey woods accord.

name: Dolce & Gabbana The One Parfum For Men

notes.source_text:
Dolce & Gabbana The One Parfum is a warmer, deeper take on The One.
Jean-Christophe Hérault created it in 2025. Black pepper, nutmeg and Tarocco orange open warm, labdanum, patchouli and clary sage form the heart, and tobacco, vetiver and amber give it a deep, smoky finish.
Made for evenings in spring, fall and winter.

name: Dolce & Gabbana The One Sport Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
The One Sport’s opens with a clever and
unexpected pairing of rosemary with an aquatic accord, followed by the
dry, cool, green feel of sequoia tree bark and aromatic cardamom. The
sequoia’s cool demeanor relaxes the energy in this cologne into a
laid-back, contemplative, and calm profile.

name: Dolce & Gabbana The Only One 2 Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
The Only One fragrance that came out in late August 2018 as a new
flanker of the original The One from 2006, gets its sequel in the form
of the new edition The Only One 2. The first fragrance brought the
composition of a gourmand iris in combination with coffee, while chapter
2 introduces a scent of powdery rose and violet with a sweet coffee
note.
The composition symbolizes the scent of love, seduction and lust, presented with a bottle in ruby red colour.
Top notes: pear, red berries, blackberry, freesia
Heart: red rose, violet, coffee
Base: tonka, patchouli, ambergris, amber woods

name: Dolce & Gabbana The Only One Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text: The Only One by Dolce&Gabbana is a Oriental Vanilla fragrance for women. This is a new fragrance. The Only One was launched in 2018. Top notes are Violet, Bergamot and Orange; middle notes are Coffee, Pear, iris, Orange Blossom and Rose; base notes are Caramel, Vanilla and Patchouli.

name: Dolce & Gabbana The Only One Intense Eau de Parfum for Women
tags: The Only One Eau de Parfum Intense

notes.source_text:
The Only One Eau de Parfum Intense by Dolce&Gabbana is a Oriental Floral fragrance for women. This is a new fragrance. The Only One Eau de Parfum Intense
was launched in 2020. The nose behind this fragrance is Violaine
Collas. Top notes are Neroli, Italian Mandarin and Green Apple; middle
notes are Jasmine, Coconut and Orange Blossom; base notes are Vanilla,
Cashmere Wood and Cedar.

name: Dolce & Gabbana Velvet Black Patchouli Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Introducing Velvet Black Patchouli, a new and captivating unisex scent from Dolce & Gabbana, falling within the Amber Woody olfactory family. Unveiled to the world in 2021, this aromatic creation carries the masterful signature of perfumer Rodrigo Flores-Roux. At its opening, a blend of Davana, Blood Orange, and Papyrus greets the senses, heralding the heart where Patchouli mingles seamlessly with Clary Sage and a hint of Coriander. The experience culminates in a rich base of Vanilla, intertwined with the sweetness of Caramel and the depth of Tonka Bean.

name: Dolce & Gabbana Velvet Cypress Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Velvet Cypress, a creation by Dolce & Gabbana, is a unisex scent that belongs to the Woody Aromatic olfactory category. This fragrance made its debut in 2017. It features an opening with the zesty freshness of Sicilian Lemon and the citrusy tang of Bergamot. At its heart lies a blend of the lush, evergreen Cypress, the green sharpness of Galbanum, and the herbaceous warmth of Clary Sage. Anchoring the scent is the grounding essence of Cedar in its base note.

name: Dolce & Gabbana Velvet Exotic Leather Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Velvet Exotic Leather is inspired by male skin, his sensuality and elegance. The essence of a man, his scent and masculinity, enriched with the sophisticated touch of leather. Velvet Exotic leather is a sensual and elegant scent, with a complex heart of Black Leather accord. Rich and warm Cistus Labdanum, intense Styrax and deep woody Cade oil create its unique and masculine leather character. Fresh notes of Clary Sage and Lavender and refined and fruity Rum absolute recall a vintage liquor. While Olibanum and Incense extend a warm and enveloping touch
Velvet Exotic Leather fragrance notes
Black leather, Labdanum, Styrax, Cade, Clary sage, Lavender, Rum, Incense, Olibanum

name: Dolce & Gabbana Velvet Incenso Eau de Parfum for Men

base: the luxurious softness of cashmere wood
key: the luxurious softness of cashmere wood
notes.source_text: Velvet Incenso by Dolce & Gabbana presents itself as a masculine scent with an Amber Woody profile. Unveiled in 2018, its olfactory journey commences with the spicy warmth of black pepper and the citrus-like freshness of elemi at the top. As the fragrance unfolds, it reveals a heart rich with the sacred aromas of incense and the sweet, leathery nuances of labdanum. Anchoring this sophisticated blend are the comforting and deep base notes of resinous benzoin, the modern touch of amberwood, creamy vanilla, earthy patchouli, and the luxurious softness of cashmere wood.

name: Dolce & Gabbana Velvet Patchouli Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Velvet Patchouli by Dolce&Gabbana is a Chypre fragrance for women and men. Velvet Patchouli was launched in 2011. The nose behind this fragrance is Rodrigo Flores-Roux. The fragrance features patchouli and kephalis.

name: Dolce & Gabbana Velvet Rose Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text: Velvet Rose by Dolce&Gabbana is a Floral fragrance for women. Velvet Rose was launched in 2014. Top notes are Citruses and Lily; middle notes are May Rose, Moroccan Rose, Bulgarian Rose and Egyptian Pelargonium; base note is Musk.

name: Dolce & Gabbana Velvet Sublime Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Dolce&Gabbana's Velvet Sublime, a unisex Floral fragrance, was released in 2011 and crafted by renowned nose Rodrigo Flores-Roux.

Lemon by Dolce&Gabbana is a Citrus fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Lemon was launched in 2020. The nose behind this fragrance is Jérôme Epinette. Top notes are Sicilian Lemon, Calabrian bergamot and Petitgrain; middle note is Ginger; base note is Haitian Vetiver.

name: Dolce & Gabbana Velvet Tender Oud Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Velvet Tender Oud by Dolce&Gabbana is a Amber Woody fragrance for women and men. Velvet Tender Oud was launched in 2013. Top note is Sweet Almond; middle notes are Damask Rose and Rose de Mai; base notes are Agarwood (Oud) and Woody Notes.

name: Dolce Gabbana LImperatrice Limited Edition Eau de Toilette for Women

top: leading to a heart composed of Pink Peony
base: finish the experience with a blend of Musk
key: leading to a heart composed of Pink Peony
finish the experience with a blend of Musk
notes.source_text: L'Imperatrice Limited Edition by Dolce&Gabbana is a captivating Floral Fruity fragrance designed for women. Introduced in 2020, this fresh scent is crafted by perfumer Nathalie Lorson. The fragrance opens with delightful top notes of Watermelon and Strawberry, leading to a heart composed of Pink Peony, Magnolia, Damask Rose, and Cyclamen. The base notes finish the experience with a blend of Musk, Woody Notes, Sandalwood, and a hint of Smoke.

name: Dolce Gabbana Your Devotion Eau de Parfum Intense for Women
tags: Your Devotion Eau de Parfum Intense

notes.source_text: Your Devotion Eau de Parfum Intense by Dolce & Gabbana is a captivating Floral Fruity Gourmand fragrance designed for women. Introduced in 2026, this scent is the latest creation by renowned perfumer Olivier Cresp. The fragrance opens with refreshing top notes of Melon and Sicilian Mandarin, leading to a heart of Orange Blossom and Gardenia. Its rich base notes consist of Madagascar Vanilla, Vanilla, Milk, Sandalwood, and Oakmoss, creating a luxurious and unforgettable aroma.

name: Dolce&Gabbana K Parfum For Men

notes.source_text: K by Dolce & Gabbana Parfum is a captivating Oriental Vanilla fragrance designed for men. Launched in 2025, this new scent was created by perfumer Daphné Bugey. The fragrance opens with enticing top notes of Fig and Caramel, followed by a distinctive middle note of Licorice. The composition is anchored by rich base notes of Sandalwood and Woodsy Accords.

name: Dolce&Gabbana Light Blue Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Dolce & Gabbana Light Blue pour Homme Eau de Parfum is a deeper take on the Light Blue freshness.
Alberto Morillas created it in 2026. Grapefruit, bergamot, cardamom and yellow mandarin open bright, cypress, juniper and sea water form the heart, and ambroxan, patchouli and cedarwood give it a lasting finish.
A daytime favorite for spring and summer.

name: Dolce&Gabbana Light Blue Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text: Light Blue Eau de Parfum by Dolce&Gabbana is a captivating Floral Fruity scent designed for women. Introduced in 2026, this fragrance is the latest addition to the Light Blue collection, crafted by perfumer Olivier Cresp. It opens with invigorating top notes of Calabrian bergamot, Sicilian lemon, and pink pepper. The heart reveals a blend of frangipani, marigold, and a hint of cinnamon, while the base offers a warm foundation of amberwood and benzoin.

name: Dolce&Gabbana Light Blue Forever Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text: Light Blue Forever pour Homme, crafted by Dolce & Gabbana, is a refreshing Woody Aquatic scent designed for men. Introduced in 2021, this fragrance was masterfully created by perfumer Shyamala Maisondieu. The composition opens with vibrant top notes of Grapefruit and Bergamot, leading into a heart of Ozonic notes and Violet Leaf. The fragrance concludes with a rich base of Java vetiver oil, White Musk, and Patchouli.

name: Dolce&Gabbana Light Blue Forever Pour Homme Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Light Blue Forever pour Homme by Dolce&Gabbana is a Woody Aquatic fragrance for men. This is a new fragrance. Light Blue Forever pour Homme
was launched in 2021. The nose behind this fragrance is Shyamala
Maisondieu. Top notes are Grapefruit and Bergamot; middle notes are
Violet Leaf and Ozonic notes; base notes are White Musk, Patchouli and
Java vetiver oil.

name: Dolce&Gabbana Light Blue Italian Love Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
Light Blue pour Homme Italian Love by Dolce & Gabbana is an aromatic green fragrance designed for men. This new scent was introduced in 2022, crafted by perfumer Shyamala Maisondieu. The fragrance opens with vibrant top notes of grapefruit and Sicilian bergamot, transitioning into a heart of ozonic notes, violet leaf, green notes, and cashmeran. The base features rich notes of vetiver, musk, patchouli, and guaiac wood.

Light Blue pour Homme Italian Love by Dolce&Gabbana is a Aromatic Green fragrance for men. This is a new fragrance. Light Blue pour Homme Italian Love was launched in 2022. Top notes are Sicilian Bergamot and Grapefruit; middle notes are Violet Leaf, Ozonic notes, Green Notes and Cashmeran; base notes are Vetiver, Musk, Patchouli and Guaiac Wood.

name: Dolce&Gabbana Light Blue Italian Zest Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text: Light Blue Italian Zest Pour Homme, crafted by Dolce & Gabbana, is a refreshing Citrus Aromatic fragrance designed for men. Launched in 2018, this scent opens with vibrant top notes of Grapefruit, Bergamot, Mandarin Orange, and Lemon. The heart reveals a spicy blend of Sichuan Pepper, Rosemary, Hedione, Palisander Rosewood, and Freesia, while the base features a warm and earthy combination of Musk, Oakmoss, Incense, and Amberwood.

name: Dolce&Gabbana Light Blue Sunset in Salina Eau de Toilette for Women

notes.source_text: Light Blue Sunset in Salina by Dolce & Gabbana is a Floral Aquatic fragrance designed for women. Released in 2015, this scent opens with fresh notes of Vine and Violet Leaf, followed by a heart of Orange Blossom, Yellow Freesia, and Jasmine. The fragrance concludes with warm base notes of Amber, White Musk, and Cedar.

name: Dolce&Gabbana Light Blue Swimming in Lipari Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
Light Blue Swimming in Lipari by Dolce & Gabbana is an aromatic aquatic fragrance designed for men, introduced in 2015. This scent features refreshing top notes of sea salt and grapefruit, complemented by middle notes of mandarin orange and rosemary. The fragrance concludes with a warm base of ambergris, woody notes, and musk.

Dolce & Gabbana is launching new limited editions for Summer
2015 of their popular fragrances Light Blue from 2001 and Light Blue
Pour Homme from 2007. The new releases are named Light Blue Sunset in
Salina and Light Blue Pour Homme Swimming in Lipari.
Light Blue Pour Homme Swimming and Lipari is an invigorating aquatic
scent inspired by Mediterranean waters. It opens with accords of sea
salt enhanced by the freshness of grapefruit. The heart combines
mandarin and cool, aromatic rosemary. Ambergris, dry woods and musky
notes end the composition.

name: Dolce&Gabbana Q Eau de Parfum Intense for Women

notes.source_text: Q by Dolce & Gabbana Eau de Parfum Intense is an enticing fragrance designed for women, newly introduced in 2024. Created by perfumer Daphné Bugey, this scent opens with bright top notes of Sicilian Lemon, Orange, and Jasmine. The heart reveals a rich blend of Black Cherry and Heliotrope, while the composition settles into a warm base of Amber and Woody Notes.

name: Dolce&Gabbana Sicily Re Edition 2003 Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text: Dolce&Gabbana's Sicily Re-Edition 2003 is a Floral Aldehyde fragrance designed for women. This fresh scent was introduced in 2025, featuring the creative expertise of perfumer Nathalie Lorson. The fragrance opens with top notes of Aldehydes, Orange Blossom, and Calabrian Bergamot, leading into a heart of Jasmine, Honeysuckle, and Hyacinth. The base notes include White Musk, Heliotrope, and Sandalwood, creating a beautifully layered olfactory experience.

name: Dolce&Gabbana The One Eau de Parfum 2025 for Men

notes.source_text:
Dolce & Gabbana The One Eau de Parfum 2025 is a fresh, warm update to The One.
Jean-Christophe Hérault created it in 2025. Orange, cardamom and grapefruit open bright, clary sage, patchouli and geranium form the heart, and tobacco, amber and cedarwood give it a smooth finish.
Versatile in fall, winter and spring, day or night.

name: Dolce&Gabbana The One Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text: The One for Men by Dolce & Gabbana is a captivating Woody Spicy scent designed for men. Introduced in 2008, this fragrance is crafted by the nose of Olivier Polge. Its composition begins with refreshing top notes of Grapefruit, Coriander, and Basil, followed by a heart that features Ginger, Cardamom, and Orange Blossom. The fragrance concludes with rich base notes of Amber, Tobacco, and Cedar.

name: Dolce&Gabbana The One Gentleman Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
The One Gentleman by Dolce & Gabbana is an amber fragrance designed for men, introduced in 2010. It features a top note of Pepper, complemented by middle notes of Lavender, Cardamom, and Watercress. The base is anchored by warm notes of Vanilla and Patchouli.

The One Gentleman cologne by DOLCE & GABBANA is made for the sophisticated man who is of class and dignity.
The One Gentlemen by Dolce & Gabbana Cologne.
The One Gentleman men's fragrance from the world-renowned Dolce &
Gabbana house of design pays homage to the steadfast commitment of men
of high moral character. Wear it to present your core values during a
first date, a family get-together or a night out with your long-term
significant other. This 2010 fragrance has pepper, lavender, cardamom
and watercress notes which all contribute to the fragrance's crisp and
clean aroma that is also perfect for
everyday work wear.
FRAGRANCE NOTES
Lavender, pepper, cardamom, fennel, patchouli, and vanilla
FRAGRANCE DETAILS
Eau de toilette

name: Dolce&Gabbana The One Gold Eau de Parfum Intense for Women

notes.source_text: The One Gold by Dolce & Gabbana is a captivating floral scent designed for women. This enchanting fragrance made its debut in 2021, crafted by the talented perfumer Violaine Collas. The composition opens with vibrant top notes of plum, pink pepper, and Italian mandarin. The heart reveals a delicate bouquet of rose, jasmine, and lily-of-the-valley, while the fragrance concludes with an inviting base of patchouli, vanilla, and white musk.

name: Dolce&Gabbana The One Luminous Night Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
The One Luminous Night by Dolce & Gabbana is a captivating Amber Woody fragrance designed for men. This enticing scent made its debut in 2021 and was created by perfumer Jean-Christophe Herault. The fragrance opens with vibrant top notes of Black Pepper, Basil, and Bergamot. Its heart reveals a rich blend of Dates, Sage, and Geranium, while the base features warm notes of Amber, Incense, and Sandalwood.

The One Luminous Night by Dolce&Gabbana is a Amber Woody fragrance for men. This is a new fragrance. The One Luminous Night was launched in 2021. The nose behind this fragrance is Jean-Christophe Herault. Top notes are Black Pepper, Basil and Bergamot; middle notes are Dates, Sage and Geranium; base notes are Incense, Amber and Sandalwood.

name: Dolce&Gabbana The One Mysterious Night Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text: The One Mysterious Night, crafted by Dolce&Gabbana, is an Amber Spicy fragrance designed for men. Introduced in 2018, this scent features top notes of Saffron and Grapefruit, followed by a heart of Rose, Agarwood (Oud), and Clary Sage. The fragrance concludes with a rich base of Amber, Precious Woods, Labdanum, and Tonka Bean.

name: Dolce&Gabbana The One Royal Night Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
The One Royal Night by Dolce&Gabbana is a captivating Amber Woody fragrance designed for men, introduced in 2015. The scent opens with vibrant top notes of Cardamom and Basil, followed by a rich heart of Nutmeg and Pear Wood. The fragrance culminates in a warm base of Amber, Sandalwood, Cedar, and Labdanum.

Steeped in mystery, sophistication and masculinity, 'The One Royal
Night' is the new fragrance to join the iconic Dolce and Gabbana 'The
One' line. Available exclusively in selected stores worldwide, this new
addition to the world of 'The One' offers an olfactory journey to the
middle east, echoing its scents and sensations. Part of the oriental
woody scent family, this fragrance explores the multi faceted world of
spices and brings the richness of amber to life in a refined novel way.
It is the exclusive interpretation of precious middle eastern
ingredients with a long and rich heritage combined with new characters.
With a unique and enigmatic soul, the scent`s distinctive style lies in
its mystery and masculinity, it is strong but also smooth, traditional
and contemporary.

name: Dolce&Gabbana Velvet Amber Skin Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Velvet Amber Skin by Dolce & Gabbana is an amber fragrance designed for both women and men, introduced in 2017. The fragrance was created by perfumer Christophe Raynaud. It opens with top notes of lavender, citrus, bergamot, and silk tree blossom. The heart features a rich blend of resins, iris, leather, labdanum, rose, and jasmine, while the base is composed of warm notes including vanilla, tolu balsam, myrrh, cinnamon, opoponax, amberwood, honey, and clove.

name: Dolce&Gabbana Velvet Amber Sun Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Velvet Amber Sun by Dolce&Gabbana is a captivating Amber Woody fragrance suitable for both women and men. Introduced in 2017, this scent was crafted by perfumer Frank Voelkl. The top notes feature a blend of Vanilla, Labdanum, Ylang-Ylang, and Bergamot, leading into a heart of Smoke, Sandalwood, Pepper, and Coriander. The fragrance settles into a rich base of Amberwood, Myrrh, Opoponax, Agarwood (Oud), Benzoin, Olibanum, Tonka Bean, Patchouli, and Cinnamon.

name: Dolce&Gabbana Velvet Blue Musk Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Velvet Blue Musk, created by Dolce&Gabbana, is a captivating Woody Floral Musk scent designed for both women and men. Introduced in 2023, this fragrance features the artistry of perfumer Mathilde Bijaoui. The composition opens with invigorating top notes of Cardamom, Saffron, and Cumin, transitioning into a heart of Sandalwood, Damask Rose, and Cypriol Oil (Nagarmotha). The base is a rich blend of Musk, Tonka, and Cedar, adding depth and warmth to the fragrance.

name: Dolce&Gabbana Velvet Desert Oud Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Velvet Desert Oud by Dolce&Gabbana is an amber scent suitable for both women and men. This fragrance was introduced in 2013.

name: Dolce&Gabbana Velvet Mughetto Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Velvet Mughetto by Dolce & Gabbana is a captivating floral fragrance designed for both women and men. Introduced in 2020, this scent is a creation of perfumer Sidonie Lancesseur. It opens with fresh top notes of Bergamot, Pink Pepper, and Black Currant, transitioning into a heart of Lily-of-the-Valley, Magnolia, and Patchouli. The fragrance concludes with a warm base of Cashmeran and Sandalwood.

name: Dolce&Gabbana Velvet Passion Oud Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Velvet Passion Oud, crafted by Dolce & Gabbana, is an Oriental Woody fragrance designed for both women and men. Introduced in 2025, this fragrance features the artistry of perfumer Paul Guerlain. The scent opens with captivating top notes of Passionfruit, Tobacco Leaf, and Hookah, transitioning into a heart of Saffron and Rose, and finishing with deep base notes of Labdanum and Oud.

name: DS&Durga Brown Flowers Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Brown Flowers by DS&Durga is a unisex floral fragrance that debuted in 2025. Created by perfumer David Seth Moltz, this fresh scent features top notes of wild carrot and citron, complemented by middle notes of jasmine sambac, coffee blossom, and orchid. Its rich base combines roots, coffee, and musk for a distinctive experience.

name: DS&Durga Cognac Reign Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Cognac Reign, crafted by DS&Durga, is a unisex Woody Spicy fragrance that made its debut in 2025. The creative mind behind this scent is David Seth Moltz. It opens with top notes of Caramel, Bergamot, and Woody Notes, leading into a heart of Cognac and Orris, and finishing with rich base notes of Tonka Bean and Oak.

name: DS&Durga Debaser in Bloom Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Debaser in Bloom by DS&Durga is a captivating Floral Fruity Gourmand scent designed for both women and men. This fragrance is a recent addition to the line, having been launched in 2026. Created by perfumer David Seth Moltz, it opens with fresh top notes of Rosemary and White Currant, transitions into a heart of Fig, Gardenia, and Cream, and settles into a warm base of Coconut, Raspberry Leaf, and Musk.

name: Dumont Nitro Black Pour Homme Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text: Nitro Black by Dumont is a Aromatic fragrance for men. Nitro Black was launched in 2020. Top notes are Apple, Black Currant, Bergamot and Pineapple; middle notes are Patchouli, Birch, Lavender, Pepper, Rose and Jasmine; base notes are Amber, Musk and Vanilla.

name: Dumont Nitro Blue Pour Homme Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text: Nitro Blue by Dumont is a Amber Woody fragrance for men. Nitro Blue was launched in 2020. Top notes are Orange Blossom, Sage, Basil, Lemon and Cinnamon; middle notes are Woody Notes, Tolu Balsam, Black Cardamom and Praline; base notes are Sweet Notes, Patchouli, Black Amber and Brazilian Rosewood.

name: Dumont Nitro Pour Homme Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text: Nitro Pour Homme by Dumont is a Woody fragrance for men. Nitro Pour Homme was launched in 2020. Top notes are Lemon, Grapefruit, Mandarin Orange, Cardamom, Bergamot and Nutmeg; middle notes are Cedar, Orange Blossom and Jasmine; base notes are Cedar, Guaiac Wood, Tonka Bean, Musk and Sandalwood.

name: Dunhill Century Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Experience freshness like no other with the Dunhill London Century
Eau de Parfum Spray, an aromatic-woody fragrance for moments of clarity.
Dunhill Century is for the future you. Inspired by reflection, the
elegant composition is perfect for men that want to be their best. An
opportunity for change or to reinvent yourself, Century exudes the style
and confidence all men will wish to possess.
The Century Eau de Parfum makes an entrance with a citrus opening,
merging bright notes of bergamot, grapefruit and mandarin. This
luminosity continues in the heart with a neroli facet, before taking an
aromatic and spicy turn with the addition of cardamom and oilbanum. In
the base, sandalwood and musk smooth out the composition, while a nod of
exotic cypriol gives the scent a seductive edge.

name: Dunhill Driven Blue Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text: Driven Eau de Toilette by Alfred Dunhill is a Woody Aromatic fragrance for men. This is a new fragrance. Driven Eau de Toilette was launched in 2021. The nose behind this fragrance is Catherine Selig. Top notes are Green Apple, Bergamot and Black Pepper; middle notes are Juniper Berries, Orange Blossom and Clary Sage; base notes are Vetiver, Teak Wood and Amber.

name: Dunhill Icon Absolute Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Dunhill Icon Absolute by Alfred Dunhill is a Woody Spicy fragrance for men. Dunhill Icon Absolute
was launched in 2015. Top notes are bergamot and black pepper; middle
notes are saffron, black rose and jasmine; base notes are agarwood
(oud), tobacco leaf and leather.

name: Dunhill Icon Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text: Alfred Dunhill's Icon is a Woody Aromatic fragrance for men, released in 2015 and crafted by Carlos Benaim. Opening with Neroli, Bergamot, Black Pepper, and Petitgrain, the scent moves to a heart of Black Pepper, Lavender, Cardamom, Juniper Berries, and Sage before rounding off with a base of Vetiver, Oakmoss, Iris, Leather, and Agarwood (Oud).

name: Dunhill Icon Racing Blue Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text: Icon Racing Blue by Alfred Dunhill is a Woody Aromatic fragrance for men. This is a new fragrance. Icon Racing Blue was launched in 2021. Top notes are Lime, Bergamot and Ambroxan; middle notes are Sea Salt, Cardamom, Neroli and Coriander; base notes are Driftwood, Sandalwood, Ambergris and Patchouli.

name: Dunhill Icon Racing Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
The latest fragrance in our Icon collection, Racing is inspired by the speed, colour and history of British motoring. The bottle is classic dark green, finished in our signature Engine Turn Design. Icon Racing is a truly masculine scent.
Brand : Alfred Dunhill
Fragrance Type : Eau de Parfum
Targeted Group : Men
Fragrance Family : Woody & Musky

name: Dunhill Icon Racing Red Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text: Icon Racing Red by Alfred Dunhill is a Amber Woody fragrance for men. This is a new fragrance. Icon Racing Red was launched in 2021. Top notes are Solar notes, Mandarin Orange, Orange, Petitgrain, Black Pepper and Grapefruit; middle notes are Fern, Geranium, Pepper and Olibanum; base notes are Cedar, Amber, Vetiver, Moss, Tonka Bean and Musk.

name: Dunhill Mongolian Cashmere Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text: Alfred Dunhill's Mongolian Cashmere is a contemporary men's scent marked by its floral character. Recently introduced in 2022, this scent is the creative invention of perfumer Julie Pluchet. It opens with the crisp, citrusy aroma of Mandarin Orange, coupled with the spicy zing of Pink Pepper. The heart of the fragrance is a harmonious blend of Orris, Geranium, and Rose, leading to a rich base that combines the luxurious softness of Suede with the warmth of Musk and Amber.

name: Dunhill Nordic Fougere Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text: Nordic Fougère, a men's fragrance with aromatic fougere qualities, is a recent creation from Alfred Dunhill. Introduced in 2022, this scent is the collaborative brainchild of perfumers Michel Almairac and Jérôme Epinette. It opens with an invigorating blend of basil, cardamom, and black pepper at the top. The heart is a refreshing composition of bamboo leaf, kumquat, and geranium. The scent settles into a warm and earthy base where vanilla, sandalwood, and patchouli provide a rich finish.

name: Dunhill Signature Collection Agar Wood Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text: Agar Wood by Alfred Dunhill is a Woody fragrance for men. This is a new fragrance. Agar Wood was launched in 2020. The nose behind this fragrance is Gino Percontino. Top notes are Saffron, Pink Pepper, Bergamot and Ginger; middle notes are Black Iris, Violet Leaf and Cypress; base notes are Suede, Agarwood (Oud), Tobacco and Mastic or Lentisque.

name: Dunhill Signature Collection Amalfi Citrus Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text: Amalfi Citrus by Alfred Dunhill is a Woody Floral Musk fragrance for men. This is a new fragrance. Amalfi Citrus was launched in 2020. The nose behind this fragrance is Olivier Gillotin. Top notes are Lemon, Bergamot, Bitter Orange, Green Mandarin and Mandarin Orange; middle notes are Green Tea, Neroli, Cardamom, Jasmine and Rosemary; base notes are Vetiver, Woody Notes, Amber and Musk.

name: Dunhill Signature Collection Arabian Desert Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text: Alfred Dunhill's Arabian Desert is a bold and masculine Amber Floral fragrance released in 2019. It opens with bright and spicy Saffron and Pink Pepper, layered with sweet and floral Rose and Night Blooming Jasmine in its heart. The scent is completed by a robust base of Amber, Agarwood (Oud) and Incense to make it truly unforgettable.

name: Dunhill Signature Collection British Leather Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text: British Leather by Alfred Dunhill is a Woody Spicy fragrance for men. British Leather was launched in 2019. Top notes are Guatemalan Cardamom, Hazelnut, Juniper, Bergamot and Lemon; middle notes are Mate, Pepper, Lavender, Orange Blossom and Violet Leaf; base notes are Leather, Cypress, Patchouli, Sandalwood and Vetiver.

name: Dunhill Signature Collection Egyptian Smoke Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text: Alfred Dunhill's Egyptian Smoke is a spicy amber fragrance for men, which was launched in 2020. The perfumer behind this captivating creation is Jérôme Epinette. The top notes blend together Black Tea, Pink Pepper and Ginger, while the heart consists of Tobacco, Grasse Rose, Cacao and Papyrus. The fragrance is rounded off with a base of Vanilla, Tonka Bean, Palo Santo and Patchouli.

name: Dunhill Signature Collection Indian Sandalwood Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Indian Sandalwood by Alfred Dunhill is a Woody fragrance for men. This is a new fragrance. Indian Sandalwood
was launched in 2019. Top notes are Carrot and Bergamot; middle notes
are Orris and Moss; base notes are Sandalwood, Patchouli and Cypriol Oil
or Nagarmotha.

name: Dunhill Signature Collection Moroccan Amber Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text: Moroccan Amber by Alfred Dunhill is a Amber Spicy fragrance for men. Moroccan Amber was launched in 2019. Top notes are Ginger, Black Pepper, Cardamom and Coriander; middle notes are Hazelnut, Saffron and Immortelle; base notes are Amber, Agarwood (Oud), Leather and Coffee Tree.

name: Dunhill Signature Collection Valesole Lavender Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text: Valensole Lavender by Alfred Dunhill is a Woody Spicy fragrance for men. This is a new fragrance. Valensole Lavender was launched in 2020. The nose behind this fragrance is Jérôme di Marino. Top notes are Lemon, Saffron and Nutmeg; middle notes are Lavender, Sage and Cardamom; base notes are Amberwood, Guaiac Wood and Vetiver.

name: EIGHT & BOB Annicke 1 Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text: Annicke 1 from EIGHT & BOB is a sophisticated women's scent that belongs to the Floral Woody Musk olfactory family. This fragrance made its debut in the year 2018. It opens with the fresh and inviting aromas of Peony, Ivy, and Mandarin Orange at the top. Progressing to the heart of the perfume, one encounters the delicate and aromatic blend of Cyclamen, Jasmine, and Lily-of-the-Valley. The scent settles with a grounding harmony of Driftwood and White Musk serving as the base notes.

name: EIGHT & BOB Annicke 2 Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text: Annicke 2, crafted by EIGHT & BOB, is a women's fragrance with an Amber Floral scent profile. Introduced in 2018, this perfume opens with top notes of Hazelnut, Fig, and Mandarin Orange, transitions into a heart of Immortelle, Ylang-Ylang, and Tuberose, and settles into a warm base of Sandalwood, Vanilla, and Cedar.

name: EIGHT & BOB Annicke 3 Eau de Parfum for Women

top: the citrusy tang of Mandarin Orange
key: the citrusy tang of Mandarin Orange
notes.source_text: Launched in 2018, Annicke 3 from EIGHT & BOB is a sophisticated Chypre Floral scent specifically crafted for women. This enticing fragrance opens with a vibrant blend of top notes including succulent Red Berries, zesty Bergamot, and the citrusy tang of Mandarin Orange. At its heart lies a floral bouquet of pure White Rose, lush Gardenia, and the exotic allure of Jasmine. The composition gracefully settles into a warm and creamy foundation featuring opulent Cashmere Wood and smooth Sandalwood, enriched by the sweet whisper of Meringue notes in the base.

name: EIGHT & BOB Champs de Provence Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Champs De Provence by EIGHT & BOB is a Floral fragrance for women and men. Champs De Provence was launched in 2017. Top notes are Bergamot, Orange and Pear; middle notes are Orange Blossom, Jasmine and Rose; base notes are Mate, Ambroxan and Musk.

name: EIGHT & BOB Eight & Bob Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text: EIGHT & BOB by EIGHT & BOB is a Aromatic fragrance for men. EIGHT & BOB was launched in 2012. The nose behind this fragrance is Albert Fouquet. Top notes are Cardamom, Ginger, Lemon and Bergamot; middle notes are Cedar, Guaiac Wood, Hazelnut and Labdanum; base notes are Ambergris, Vanilla, Sandalwood and Patchouli.

name: Electimuss Alkout Extrait de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Alkout by Electimuss is a fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Alkout was launched in 2020.

name: Electimuss Amber Aquilaria Extrait de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Amber Aquilaria by Electimuss is a fragrance for women and men. Amber Aquilaria was launched in 2019. Top note is Bergamot; middle notes are Cognac and Rose; base notes are Ambergris, Agarwood (Oud), Bourbon Vanilla and Sandalwood.

name: Electimuss Aurora Extrait de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Aurora by Electimuss is a fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Aurora was launched in 2020. Top notes are Agarwood (Oud), Saffron, Cardamom and Cloves; middle notes are Rose, Patchouli and Sandalwood; base notes are Ambergris and White Musk.

name: Electimuss Auster Extrait de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Auster by Electimuss is a fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Auster was launched in 2020. Top notes are Star Anise and Lemon; middle notes are Cloves and Geranium; base notes are Patchouli, Ambergris and Cedar.

name: Electimuss Black Caviar Extrait de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Black Caviar by Electimuss is a fragrance for women and men. Black Caviar was launched in 2019. Top notes are Caviar, Agarwood (Oud) and Cedar; middle notes are Rosemary, Sage and Lavender; base notes are Vetiver, Patchouli and Oakmoss.

name: Electimuss Capua Extrait de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Capua by Electimuss is a fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Capua was launched in 2020. Top note is elemi; middle note is Cedar; base notes are Vetiver, Cedar, Cashmere Wood and Amber.

name: Electimuss Caspian Cherry Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Caspian Cherry by Electimuss is an Oriental Vanilla scent designed for both women and men. This new fragrance debuted in 2024, crafted by perfumer Kevin Mathys. Its top notes include Black Cherry, Amaretto, and Dark Chocolate, while the heart features Cinnamon, Coffee, Coconut, Honey, and Vetiver. The base is composed of White Chocolate, Tonka Bean, Sandalwood, and Patchouli.

name: Electimuss Celestial Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Electimuss released their newest fragrance, Celestial, in 2020, which can be enjoyed by both women and men.

name: Electimuss Fortuna Extrait de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Fortuna by Electimuss is a Floral Fruity fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Fortuna was launched in 2020. The nose behind this fragrance is Sofia Bardelli. Top notes are Saffron and Grapefruit; middle notes are Lily-of-the-Valley, Rose and Geranium; base notes are Agarwood (Oud), Musk, Patchouli and Vetiver.

name: Electimuss Gladiator Oud Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Electimuss released its newest scent, Gladiator Oud, in 2023. Created by renowned perfumer Julien Rasquinet, the woody fragrance for women and men is an invigorating blend of cumin and saffron in the top notes, followed by honey, hay, immortelle and geranium in the middle. The base notes are a deep combination of agarwood (oud), patchouli, Atlas cedar, Haitian vetiver and ambergris.

name: Electimuss Imperium Extrait de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Electimuss Imperium is a rich, luminous white floral with oud and vanilla.
Sofia Bardelli created it in 2020. Bergamot and coriander open bright, jasmine, lily, tuberose, saffron, neroli and rose form the heart, and vanilla, musk, guaiac wood, patchouli, oud and amber give it depth.
Versatile from spring through fall, day or night.

Imperium by Electimuss is a fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Imperium was launched in 2020. The nose behind this fragrance is Sofia Bardelli. Top notes are Bergamot and Coriander; middle notes are Jasmine, Lily, Tuberose, Saffron, Neroli and Rose; base notes are Vanilla, Musk, Guaiac Wood, Patchouli, Agarwood (Oud) and Amber.

name: Electimuss Jupiter Extrait de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Jupiter by Electimuss is a fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Jupiter was launched in 2020. The nose behind this fragrance is Sofia Bardelli. Top notes are Agarwood (Oud), Incense, Saffron, Davana and Labdanum; middle notes are Sandalwood, Vetiver, Patchouli and Cedar; base notes are Ambrette (Musk Mallow), Ambergris, Musk, Tonka Bean and Vanilla.

name: Electimuss Mercurial Cashmere Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Electimuss Mercurial Cashmere is a sweet, musky blend of violet, tuberose and caramel.
Sofia Bardelli created it in 2021. Bergamot, cardamom and pink pepper open bright, violet, ambergris, tuberose and iris form a soft heart, and cashmere wood, vanilla, oud, caramel, cedar and tonka bean give it a warm finish.
Cozy and elegant, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

name: Electimuss Octavian Extrait de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Electimuss Octavian is a rich, spicy rose with saffron, incense and oud.
Launched in 2020, it opens with saffron and pink pepper. Rose and olibanum form a warm, resinous heart, and oud and amber give it a deep finish.
Bold and elegant, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

Octavian by Electimuss is a fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Octavian was launched in 2020. Top notes are Saffron and Pink Pepper; middle notes are Rose and Olibanum; base notes are Agarwood (Oud) and Amber.

name: Electimuss Patchouli of the Underworld Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Electimuss Patchouli of the Underworld is a dark blend of patchouli, leather and labdanum.
Kevin Mathys created it in 2022. Black pepper, pink pepper, mandarin and cistus open spicy, patchouli, leather and carnation form a deep heart, and labdanum, castoreum and styrax give it a rich, animalic finish.
Intense and moody, it is made for fall and winter nights.

name: Electimuss Puritas Extrait de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Electimuss Puritas is a sweet, floral blend of tuberose, rose and incense.
Launched in 2020, it blends elemi, pink pepper, absinthe and olibanum with rose, Indian tuberose and geranium, finished with labdanum, patchouli, tonka and amber for a rich, sweet floral scent.
Elegant and warm, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

Puritas by Electimuss is a fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Puritas was launched in 2020.

name: Electimuss Rhodanthe Extrait de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Electimuss Rhodanthe is a fruity, spicy rose with raspberry, black tea and oud.
Sofia Bardelli created it in 2019. Clove, pear, lemon and bergamot open bright, Bulgarian rose, raspberry, saffron, violet and black tea form the heart, and oud, patchouli, amber, cedar, musk and vanilla give it a warm finish.
Rich and romantic, it is made for fall and winter, day or night.

Rhodanthe by Electimuss is a fragrance for women and men. Rhodanthe was launched in 2019. The nose behind this fragrance is Sofia Bardelli. Top notes are Cloves, Pear, Lemon and Bergamot; middle notes are Bulgarian Rose, Raspberry, Saffron, Pink Pepper, Violet and Black Tea; base notes are Agarwood (Oud), Patchouli, Amber, Cedar, Musk and Vanilla.

name: Electimuss Silvanus Extrait de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Electimuss Silvanus is a woody floral with saffron, oud and lily-of-the-valley.
Launched in 2020, it opens with saffron, oud and clove. Lily-of-the-valley, rosewood, cedar and sandalwood form a fresh woody heart, and ambergris and white musk give it a clean finish.
Refined and versatile, it is a great daytime scent year-round.

Silvanus by Electimuss is a fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Silvanus was launched in 2020. Top notes are Saffron, Agarwood (Oud) and Cloves; middle notes are Lily-of-the-Valley, Palisander Rosewood, Cedar and Sandalwood; base notes are Ambergris and White Musk.

name: Electimuss Summanus Extrait de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Electimuss Summanus is a spicy, woody rose with black pepper and sandalwood.
Launched in 2020, it opens with black pepper and cardamom. Rose and amber form a warm heart, and sandalwood, guaiac wood and cypriol give it a powdery, woody finish.
Elegant and moody, it is made for fall and winter nights.

Summanus by Electimuss is a fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Summanus was launched in 2020. Top notes are Black Pepper and Cardamom; middle notes are Rose and Amber; base notes are Sandalwood, Guaiac Wood and Cypriol Oil or Nagarmotha.

name: Electimuss Trajan Extrait de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Electimuss Trajan is a bright, sparkling citrus with saffron and ambergris.
Launched in 2020, it opens with blood orange, mandarin, lemon and bergamot. Saffron, sage and lavender form a warm, aromatic heart, and ambergris, oakmoss and cedar give it a smooth, salty finish.
Easy to wear year-round, day or night.

Trajan by Electimuss is a fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Trajan was launched in 2020. Top notes are Blood Orange, Mandarin Orange, Lemon and Bergamot; middle notes are Saffron, Sage and Lavender; base notes are Ambergris, Oakmoss and Cedar.

name: Electimuss Vici Leather Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Electimuss Vici Leather is a spicy leather with cinnamon, wormwood and tuberose.
Julien Rasquinet created it in 2022. Cinnamon, pink pepper and wormwood open aromatic, tuberose and leather form a rich heart, and balsamic notes and amber give it a warm finish.
Bold and refined, it is made for nights in spring, fall and winter.

name: Electimuss Vixere Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Electimuss Vixere is a sweet, sunny floral with citrus, heliotrope and vanilla.
Sofia Bardelli created it in 2020. Grapefruit, orange blossom, bergamot, mandarin and ylang-ylang open bright, heliotrope, violet, iris, jasmine and gardenia form a soft heart, and vanilla, sandalwood, tonka bean, patchouli and musk give it a warm finish.
Radiant and versatile, it works year-round, day or night.

name: Emporio Armani Because It's You Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Emporio Armani Because It's You is a sweet, fruity rose with raspberry and vanilla.
Anne Flipo created it in 2017. Raspberry, lemon and neroli open juicy, rose forms a romantic heart, and vanilla, musk and amberwood give it a warm finish.
Playful and pretty, it is a lovely everyday scent.

name: Emporio Armani Diamonds Black Carat Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
Emporio Armani Diamonds Black Carat is a spicy, woody blend of Sichuan pepper, cacao and vetiver.
Jacques Cavallier created it in 2011. Sichuan pepper and bergamot open bright, cacao and benzoin form a warm heart, and guaiac wood, amber, vetiver, cedar and oakmoss give it a woody finish.
Smooth and confident, it is a great everyday scent.

Emporio Armani Diamonds Black Carat for Him by Giorgio Armani is a Woody Spicy fragrance for men. Emporio Armani Diamonds Black Carat for Him was launched in 2011. The nose behind this fragrance is Jacques Cavallier. Top notes are Sichuan Pepper and Bergamot; middle notes are Cacao and Benzoin; base notes are Guaiac Wood, Amber, Vetiver, Cedar and Oakmoss.

name: Emporio Armani Diamonds Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Emporio Armani Diamonds is a fruity floral with litchi, raspberry and rose.
Thierry Wasser created it in 2007. Litchi and raspberry open juicy, rose, patchouli, freesia, cedar and lily-of-the-valley form a floral heart, and vanilla, amber and vetiver give it a warm finish.
Pretty and easy, it is a lovely everyday scent.

name: Emporio Armani Diamonds Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
Emporio Armani Diamonds for Men is a woody blend of bergamot, Sichuan pepper and cacao.
Jacques Cavallier created it in 2008. Bergamot and guaiac wood open fresh, Sichuan pepper, cedar and vetiver form a spicy, woody heart, and cacao and amber give it a warm finish.
Smooth and easy, it is a great everyday scent.

name: Emporio Armani He Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
Emporio Armani He is a fresh, aromatic blend of sage, yuzu and orris.
Alain Astori and Carlos Benaim created this version in 2020. Sage, yuzu and cardamom open bright, nutmeg, orris root and rose form a soft heart, and sandalwood, vetiver, white musk and tonka bean give it a smooth finish.
Easy and versatile, it works day or night from spring through fall.

Emporio Armani He by Giorgio Armani is a Amber Woody fragrance for men's. This is a new fragrance. Emporio Armani He was released in 2020. Emporio Armani He was created by Alain Astori and Carlos Benaim. Top notes are Yuzu, Sage and Cardamom. Middle Notess are Nutmeg, Rose and Orris Root. Base Notes are Vetiver, Sandalwood, White Musk and Tonka Bean.

name: Emporio Armani In Love With You Freeze Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Emporio Armani In Love With You Freeze is a fresh, fruity floral with cherry, pear and peony.
Launched in 2020, it opens with cherry, mandarin, bergamot and pear. Peony, jasmine sambac and lily-of-the-valley form a light floral heart, and patchouli, white musk, woods and vetiver give it a clean finish.
Bright and easy, it is made for spring and summer days.

In Love With You Freeze by Giorgio Armani is a Amber Floral fragrance for women's. This is a new fragrance. In Love With You Freeze was released in 2020. Top notes are Cherry, Mandarin Orange, Bergamot and Pear. Middle Notess are Peony, Jasmine Sambac and Lily-of-the-Valley. Base Notes are Patchouli, White Musk, Woody Notes and Vetiver.

name: Emporio Armani Remix for Him Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
Emporio Armani Remix for Him is a spicy, aromatic blend of star anise, cardamom and licorice.
Launched in 2006, it opens with star anise, bergamot and basil. Cardamom, nutmeg and lily-of-the-valley form a spicy heart, and vetiver, licorice, clove and white musk give it a warm finish.
Distinctive and smooth, it is a great daytime scent in spring and fall.

Emporio Remix for Him by Giorgio Armani is a Aromatic Fougere fragrance for men's. Emporio Remix for Him was released in 2006. Top notes are Star Anise, Bergamot and Basil. Middle Notess are Cardamom, Nutmeg and Lily-of-the-Valley. Base Notes are Vetiver, Licorice, Cloves and White Musk.

name: Emporio Armani She Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Emporio Armani She is a soft, powdery blend of pear, heliotrope and almond.
Daniela Andrier created it in 2020. Citrus and pear open bright, heliotrope, cardamom, angelica and jasmine form a powdery heart, and white musk, almond, vanilla, cedar and amber give it a warm finish.
Cozy and gentle, it is a lovely everyday scent.

name: Emporio Armani Stronger with You Absolutely Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Emporio Armani Stronger With You Absolutely is a boozy, warm blend of rum, chestnut and vanilla.
Launched in 2021, it opens with rum, elemi and bergamot. Lavender and davana form an aromatic heart, and chestnut, Madagascar vanilla, cedar and patchouli give it a sweet, smooth finish.
Stronger With You Absolutely is cozy, sweet and smooth, with a boozy warmth that is easy to love. It is made for fall and winter nights.

Emporio Armani Stronger With You Absolutely by Giorgio Armani is a Amber Fougere fragrance for men's. This is a new fragrance. Emporio Armani Stronger With You Absolutely was released in 2021. Top notes are Rum, elemi and Bergamot. Middle Notess are Lavender and Davana. Base Notes are Chestnut, Madagascar Vanilla, Cedar and Patchouli.

name: Emporio Armani Stronger With You Amber Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Emporio Armani Stronger With You Amber is a warm blend of amber, vanilla and lavender.
Launched in 2023, it pairs glowing amber with Madagascar vanilla and a touch of lavender for a smooth, powdery and cozy scent.
Warm and inviting, it is a great choice for evenings and cooler weather.

name: Emporio Armani Stronger With You Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
Emporio Armani Stronger With You is a warm, sweet blend of spices, chestnut and vanilla.
Cécile Matton created it in 2017. Cardamom, pink pepper, mint and violet leaf open fresh, pineapple, sage, melon, cinnamon and lavender form the heart, and vanilla, chestnut, cedar, amberwood and guaiac wood give it a cozy finish.
Smooth and inviting, it is made for fall and winter nights and date nights.

Emporio Armani Stronger With You by Giorgio Armani is a Aromatic Fougere fragrance for men's. Emporio Armani Stronger With You was released in 2017. The Master Perfumer for this fragrance is Cecile Matton. Top notes are Cardamom, Pink Pepper, Violet Leaf and Mint. Middle Notess are Pineapple, Cinnamon, Melon, Sage and Lavender. Base Notes are Vanilla, Chestnut, Amberwood, Cedar and Guaiac Wood.

name: Emporio Armani Stronger With You Freeze Eau de Toilette for Men
tags: Stronger With You Freeze Stronger With You

notes.source_text:
Emporio Armani Stronger With You Freeze is a cool, spicy citrus with a touch of chestnut.
Launched in 2020, it opens with ginger, lime, mandarin and apple. Lavender, cardamom, geranium and sage form an aromatic heart, and bourbon vanilla, amberwood, guaiac wood and candied chestnut give it a warm finish.
Fresh but cozy, it is an easy daytime scent for spring and fall.

Emporio Armani Stronger With You Freeze by Giorgio Armani is a Aromatic Fougere fragrance for men's. This is a new fragrance. Emporio Armani Stronger With You Freeze was released in 2020. Top notes are Ginger, Lime, Mandarin Orange and Apple. Middle Notess are Lavender, Cardamom, Bourbon Geranium and Sage. Base Notes are Bourbon Vanilla, Amberwood, Guaiac Wood and Marron glace.

name: Emporio Armani Stronger With You Intensely Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Emporio Armani Stronger With You Intensely is a sweet, spiced vanilla made for cooler nights.
Launched in 2019, it opens with pink pepper, juniper and violet. Toffee, cinnamon, lavender and sage form a warm, gourmand heart, and vanilla, tonka bean, amber and suede leave a soft, sweet finish.
