Stronger With You Intensely is cozy, sweet and very easy to like. It is a go-to for fall and winter evenings and date nights.

Emporio Armani Stronger With You Intensely by Giorgio Armani is a Amber Fougere fragrance for men's. This is a new fragrance. Emporio Armani Stronger With You Intensely was released in 2019. Top notes are Pink Pepper, Juniper and Violet. Middle Notess are Toffee, Cinnamon, Lavender and Sage. Base Notes are Vanilla, Tonka Bean, Amber and Suede.

name: Emporio Armani Stronger With You Leather Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Emporio Armani Stronger With You Leather is a warm blend of vanilla, leather and chestnut.
Cécile Matton created it in 2020. Vanilla, leather, guaiac wood and oud open rich, sage and lavender form an aromatic heart, and chestnut, elemi and spices give it a cozy, balsamic finish.
Smooth and sensual, it is made for fall and winter nights.

Emporio Armani Stronger With You Leather by Giorgio Armani is a Leather fragrance for men's. This is a new fragrance. Emporio Armani Stronger With You Leather was released in 2020. The Master Perfumer for this fragrance is Cecile Matton. Top notes are Chestnut, elemi and Spices. Middle Notess are Sage and Lavender. Base Notes are Vanilla, Leather, Guaiac Wood and Agarwood (Oud).

name: Emporio Armani Stronger With You Only Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
Emporio Armani Stronger With You Only is a warm blend of grapefruit, lavender and chestnut.
Launched in 2022, it opens with grapefruit. Lavender and geranium form an aromatic heart, and vanilla, chestnut and labdanum give it a sweet, balsamic finish.
Smooth and easy, it is a great everyday scent.

name: Emporio Armani Stronger With You Oud Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Emporio Armani Stronger With You Oud is a smooth blend of vanilla, oud and lavender.
Cécile Matton created it in 2022. Creamy vanilla meets soft oud and lavender for a warm, powdery scent with a gentle woody depth.
Rich and comforting, it is a strong choice for evenings and cooler weather.

name: Emporio Armani Stronger With You Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Emporio Armani Stronger With You Parfum is a rich, sweet blend of chestnut and vanilla.
Launched in 2025, it opens with pink pepper and mandarin. Lavender and sage form an aromatic heart, and chestnut and vanilla give it a warm finish.
Made for fall and winter nights.

name: Emporio Armani Stronger With You Tobacco Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Emporio Armani Stronger With You Tobacco is a warm, spicy tobacco with chestnut.
Launched in 2024, it opens with black pepper, cardamom, pink pepper, elemi and sage. Tobacco, chili pepper, chestnut and cinnamon leaf form the heart, and guaiac wood, Bourbon vanilla, benzoin and amber give it a rich finish.
Made for nights in spring, fall and winter.

name: Escentric Molecule 01 + Iris Eau de Toilette Unisex

notes.source_text:
Escentric Molecules Molecule 01 + Iris is a soft, woody skin scent with iris and Iso E Super.
Geza Schoen created it in 2021. Orris and Iso E Super blend into a clean, powdery and woody scent that feels close and personal.
Subtle and modern, it is a great daytime scent from spring through fall.

name: Escentric Molecules Cologne One Unisex

notes.source_text: Cologne One by Escentric Molecules is a fresh Citrus Aromatic scent designed for both women and men. Introduced in 2026, this fragrance was created by perfumer Geza Schoen. The composition features vibrant top notes of Lime, Lemon, Juniper Berry, Bergamot, Mandarin, and Ginger, followed by a heart of Hedione, Iris, and Water Lily. The base concludes with warm notes of Iso E Super, Musk, and Amber.

name: Escentric Molecules Escentric 01 Eau de Toilette Unisex

notes.source_text:
Escentric Molecules Escentric 01 is a clean, woody scent built around Iso E Super.
Geza Schoen created it in 2006. Iso E Super meets pink pepper, Amalfi lemon and iris, with hedione, orris, balsam and musk adding a soft, airy warmth that feels like your own skin, only better.
Subtle and versatile, it works for the office, the gym and everyday wear in spring and summer.

Escentric 01 by Escentric Molecules is a Woody Floral Musk fragrance for women and men. Escentric 01 was launched in 2006. The nose behind this fragrance is Geza Schoen. The fragrance features iris, amalfi lemon, pink pepper and iso e super.

name: Escentric Molecules Escentric 02 Eau de Toilette Unisex

notes.source_text:
Escentric Molecules Escentric 02 is a soft, ambery skin scent with ambroxan and iris.
Geza Schoen created it in 2008. Iso E Super and ambroxan blend with iris and jasmine for a clean, warm and powdery scent that sits close to the skin.
Easy and versatile, it suits the office, the gym and everyday wear in spring and summer.

Escentric 02 together with Molecule 02 represents the second completely synthetic fragrance pair, launched by Escentric Molecules. This time it was inspired by the basic scented component of grey amber, ambroxan. It is placen in the centre. The rest of the composition, just like in Escentric 01, is composed out of artful copies of the natural ingredients: a scent identical to the real musk - muscone, beautiful hedione (smells like jasmine), elderflower extract and orris. The fragrance is light with a shining and brisk opening (elderflower and hedoine) and a pleasantly warm finish. Read more about ambroxan here. The perfume was launched in 2008. The nose behind this fragrance is Geza Schoen.

name: Escentric Molecules Escentric 03 Eau de Toilette Unisex

notes.source_text:
Escentric Molecules Escentric 03 is a fresh, spicy blend of lime, ginger and vetiver.
Geza Schoen created it in 2010. Lime, ginger and pepper open bright, tea, iris and jasmine form a soft heart, and vetiver, Virginia cedar, leather, sandalwood and musk give it a woody finish.
Clean and modern, it is great for everyday wear, the office and the gym in spring and summer.

Escentric 03 opens with refreshing notes of ginger root, green peppercorn and Mexican lime. A heart is centered around orris surrounded by Egyptian jasmine and soft tea notes. A base is composed of vetiver as key ingredient, sandalwood, cedar, leather and musk.
The fragrance was created by perfumer Geza Schoen as a chypre. It is said to be spicy but fresh with warm balsamic undertones, and sensuous without sweetness.

name: Escentric Molecules Escentric 04 Eau de Toilette Unisex

notes.source_text:
Escentric Molecules Escentric 04 is a bright, aromatic blend of grapefruit, juniper and sandalwood.
Geza Schoen created it in 2017. Grapefruit, juniper, osmanthus, mastic, galbanum and rose open fresh, orris and rose form a soft heart, and Javanol, balsam, sandalwood and woods give it a creamy finish.
Crisp and easy, it is great for everyday wear, the office and the gym in spring and summer.

"Molecule instead of mass: "Less" is often "more" in the world of perfumes. At the heart of Escentric Molecules 04 is the molecule Javanol, which takes sandalwood into a new dimension. Molecule 04 contains pure Javanol, Escentric 04 surraunds it with aromas of grapefruit, juniper, osmanthus, rose, matic and galbanum." - a note from the brand.

Basil and Fig; middle notes are Cypress, Hedione, iris, Freesia and
Jasmine; base notes are Cashmeran, Iso E Super, Ambroxan, Musk, Mastic
or Lentisque and Labdanum.

name: Escentric Molecules Molecule 01 Eau de Toilette Unisex

notes.source_text:
Escentric Molecules Molecule 01 is a minimalist scent built on a single molecule, Iso E Super.
Geza Schoen created it in 2006. The result is a soft, woody, velvety aura that blends with your skin and smells slightly different on everyone.
Subtle and easy to wear every day, in any season, from the office to the gym.

Molecule 01 by Escentric Molecules is a Woody Floral Musk fragrance for women and men. Molecule 01 was launched in 2006. The nose behind this fragrance is Geza Schoen. The fragrance features iso e super.

name: Escentric Molecules Molecule 02 Eau de Toilette Unisex

notes.source_text:

Geza Schoen created it in 2008. Ambroxan alone gives it a warm, clean, ambery and slightly salty glow that sits close to the skin.
Subtle and easy to wear every day, at the office or the gym.

Molecule 02 is a perfume from the second, new series of synthetic fragrances from Escentric Molecules company. Together with the new Escentric 02, it revolves around ambroxan, separated as the central note, a component of ambergris. Molecule 02 contains only ambroxan, which is a great fixation, and therefore stays with you all day, very pleasant, velvety, warm and delightfully sweet, non-obtrusive. Read more about ambroxan here. The perfume was launched in 2008. The nose behind this fragrance is Geza Schoen.

name: Escentric Molecules Molecule 03 Eau de Toilette Unisex

Fresh and minimal, it is great for everyday wear, the office and the gym in spring and summer.

Molecule 03 was constructed around single scent ingredient, or aroma-chemical: vetiveryle acetate, a refined vetiver note which is celebrated at its purest in this fragrance.The fragrance was created by Geza Schoen

name: Etat Libre d'Orange Je Suis Un Homme Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Etat Libre d'Orange Je Suis un Homme is a bold blend of leather, citrus and cognac.
Antoine Lie created it in 2006. Leather, bergamot, lemon, clove, bitter orange and cognac meet birch, cinnamon, myrtle, patchouli and musk for a spicy, boozy and rugged scent.
Confident and distinctive, it is a great daytime scent in spring and fall.

Napoleon would spray himself with it before going to combat; Je suis un Homme
(I am a Man) is a reinterpretation of Cologne accords dear to his
heart. Citrus and bergamot top notes to summon up the guard and prepare
to storm an attack somewhere in between a Corsican scrub - on a myrtle
note - and a retreat from Russia. Birch wood and cognac evoke the smell
of saddle leather, boots and belts. The charge will be hasty and
imperial… in a rough and ready way! Energetic and clearly manly, Je suis un Homme
(I am a Man) suits men who assert themselves…and women who assume their
masculine side, ready to launch the offensive without being scared of
reversing roles.
Composition: Bergamot, orange, lemon, myrte, cinnamon, clove, cognac accord, leather, patchouli, animal notes...

name: Etat Libre d'Orange Tilda Swinton Like This Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Etat Libre d'Orange Tilda Swinton Like This is a warm, cozy blend of immortelle, pumpkin and ginger.
Mathilde Bijaoui created it in 2010. Immortelle, pumpkin, ginger and tangerine meet heliotrope, vetiver, musk, neroli and rose for a sweet, herbal and comforting scent.
Gentle and autumnal, it is perfect for fall days.

Etat Libre d’Orange launches a new fragrance in March 2010, second celebrity perfume in a row, this time inspired by the English actress Tilda Swinton. Her favorite scent is the scent of home, so she wanted a fragrance that will be a magical potion with that kind of smell. Mathilde Bijaoui created for her a composition of yellow tangerine, ginger, pumpkin, immortelle, Moroccan neroli, Grass rose, vetiver, heliotrope and musk.

name: Etat Libre d'Orange Une Amourette Roland Mouret Eau de Parfum Unisex

Daniela Andrier created it in 2017. Akigalawood, neroli, iris and vanilla absolute come together in a smooth, spicy and gently powdery woody scent.
Elegant and modern, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

name: Etat Libre d'Orange Vierges Et Toreros Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Etat Libre d'Orange Vierges et Toreros is a bold blend of leather, tuberose and spice.
Antoine Lie and Antoine Maisondieu created it in 2007. Leather, tuberose, nutmeg, cardamom, pepper, ylang-ylang, patchouli, vetiver, musk, labdanum and bergamot come together in a spicy, animalic and unusual scent.
Daring and distinctive, it works day or night in fall and winter.

The arena was flooded with sun and the clamour of the crowd rose
fromthe tiers like an offering.Wherewerewe? In Sevilla? In Puerto
SantaMaria ?Definitely somewhere in Andalusia, where the stature and
pride of men are compelling. On this particular Sunday of themonth of
May, the combat to be delivered did not have the aimof putting a bull to
death. The intention was a sensuous ritual act: to confront animal-like
notes with the influential power of a flower, one of the most odorant
in the vegetal world, the tuberose. Wood, musk and costus, in daring,
unreasonably abundant proportions, would once and for all bite the dust
in this arena dedicated solely to the glory of men. In this openly
sexual confrontation - me the woman, you the man-, one of the most
blasphemous of men’s perfumery, the purity of the tuberose is falsely
innocent so that in appearance only, thesemacho reputed notes seem to be
the only ones to be victorious. But smelling it tells a completely
different story… the nose instinctively knows who the victor is: signed
the Virgin and the Torero.
Composition: Bergamot, nutmeg, pepper, cardamom, ylang ylang, tuberose, leather, animalis, costus, patchouli, vetyver...

name: Ex Nihilo The Hedonist Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Fragrance Du Bois Minuit et Demi is a warm, boozy gourmand of caramel, coffee and vanilla.
Stéphane Bengana created it in 2020. Cardamom, pimento and bergamot open spicy, caramel and coffee form a rich heart, and Madagascar vanilla, cinnamon, tobacco, musk, liquor, cedar, cashmeran and vetiver give it a deep finish.
Indulgent and cozy, it is made for fall and winter nights.

Minuit et Demi by Fragrance Du Bois is a Amber Spicy fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Minuit et Demi was launched in 2020. The nose behind this fragrance is Stéphane Bengana. Top notes are Cardamom, Pimento and Bergamot; middle notes are Caramel and Coffee; base notes are Madagascar Vanilla, Vanilla, Cinnamon, Tobacco, Musk, Liquor, Cedar, Cashmeran and Vetiver.

name: Fragrance Du Bois New York 5th Avenue Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Fragrance du Bois New York 5th Avenue is a soft, woody rose with caramel and violet.
Shadi Samra created it in 2020. Rose and bergamot open bright, caramel, violet and cypriol form a sweet heart, and cashmere wood, musk, vanilla and guaiac wood give it a powdery finish.
Elegant and cozy, it works day or night in fall and winter.

New York 5th Avenue by Fragrance Du Bois is a Amber Spicy fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. New York 5th Avenue was launched in 2020. The nose behind this fragrance is Shadi Samra. Top notes are Rose and Bergamot; middle notes are Caramel, Violet and Cypriol Oil or Nagarmotha; base notes are Cashmere Wood, Musk, Vanilla and Guaiac Wood.

name: Fragrance Du Bois New York Intense Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Fragrance Du Bois New York Intense is a rich blend of blackberry, honey, spice and oud.
Pierre-Constantin Guéros created it in 2020. Blackberry, cinnamon, rose and orange open bright, clove, guaiac wood, olibanum, honey and vanilla form a warm heart, and oud, myrrh, patchouli and vetiver give it a deep finish.
Bold and cozy, it is made for fall and winter, day or night.

New York Intense by Fragrance Du Bois is a fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. New York Intense was launched in 2020. The nose behind this fragrance is Pierre-Constantin Guéros. Top notes are Blackberry, Cinnamon, Rose, Orange, Bay Leaf and Coriander; middle notes are Cloves, Guaiac Wood, Olibanum, Honey, Vanilla, Immortelle and Orchid; base notes are Agarwood (Oud), Myrrh, Patchouli, Vetiver, Musk and Cedar.

name: Fragrance Du Bois Oud Bleu Intense Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Fragrance Du Bois Oud Bleu Intense is a warm, resinous oud with citrus and spice.
Guillaume Flavigny created it in 2013. Mandarin, cardamom and nutmeg open bright, amber, olibanum, labdanum and myrrh form a balsamic heart, and oud, myrrh, styrax, opoponax and benzoin give it a deep finish.
Rich and glowing, it works day or night from spring through fall.

Oud Bleu Intense by Fragrance Du Bois is a Woody Aromatic fragrance for women and men. Oud Bleu Intense was launched in 2013. The nose behind this fragrance is Guillaume Flavigny. Top notes are Mandarin Orange, Cardamom and Nutmeg; middle notes are Amber, Olibanum, Labdanum and Myrrh; base notes are Agarwood (Oud), Myrrh, Styrax, Opoponax and Benzoin.

name: Fragrance Du Bois Oud Jaune Intense Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Fragrance Du Bois Oud Jaune Intense is a sunny, tropical floral with pineapple and soft oud.
Nathalie Gracia-Cetto created it in 2013. Tiare flower, fruity notes, pineapple and ylang-ylang open bright, jasmine, white flowers and orange blossom form a lush heart, and vanilla, musk and oud give it a warm finish.
Joyful and radiant, it is made for spring and summer, day or night.

Oud Jaune Intense by Fragrance Du Bois is a Amber Floral fragrance for women and men. Oud Jaune Intense was launched in 2013. The nose behind this fragrance is Nathalie Gracia-Cetto. Top notes are Tahitian Tiare Flower, Fruity Notes, Pineapple and Ylang-Ylang; middle notes are Jasmine, White Flowers, Amyl Salicylate and Orange Blossom; base notes are Vanilla, Musk and Agarwood (Oud).

name: Fragrance Du Bois Oud Noir Intense Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Fragrance Du Bois Oud Noir Intense is a smooth, spicy oud with rose and saffron.
François Merle-Baudoin created it in 2013. Cardamom and bergamot open fresh, rose and jasmine form a floral heart, and oud, musk, patchouli, sandalwood, saffron, amber and vanilla give it a rich, powdery finish.
Warm and elegant, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

Oud Noir Intense by Fragrance Du Bois is a Amber Spicy fragrance for women and men. Oud Noir Intense was launched in 2013. The nose behind this fragrance is Francois Merle-Baudoin. Top notes are Cardamom and Bergamot; middle notes are Rose and Jasmine; base notes are Agarwood (Oud), Musk, Patchouli, Sandalwood, Saffron, Amber and Vanilla.

name: Fragrance Du Bois Oud Orange Intense Extrait de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Fragrance Du Bois Oud Orange Intense is a sweet, creamy blend of fruit, coconut and vanilla.
Caroline Sabas created it in 2013. Fruity notes and coconut open bright, bourbon vanilla forms a smooth, creamy heart, and vanilla, musk and oud give it a soft, warm finish.
Comforting and easy, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

Oud Orange Intense by Fragrance Du Bois is a Amber fragrance for women and men. Oud Orange Intense was launched in 2013. The nose behind this fragrance is Caroline Sabas. Top notes are Fruity Notes and Coconut; middle note is Bourbon Vanilla; base notes are Vanilla, Musk and Agarwood (Oud).

name: Fragrance Du Bois Oud Rose Intense Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Fragrance du Bois Oud Rose Intense is a fruity, spicy blend of rose, sandalwood and oud.
Hamid Merati-Kashani created it in 2013. Fruity notes and bergamot open bright, rose, sandalwood, geranium and amber form a warm heart, and oud gives it a rich, woody finish.
Romantic and versatile, it works year-round, day or night.

Oud Rose Intense by Fragrance Du Bois is a Floral fragrance for women and men. Oud Rose Intense was launched in 2013. The nose behind this fragrance is Hamid Merati-Kashani. Top notes are Fruity Notes and Bergamot; middle notes are Rose, Sandalwood, Geranium and Amber; base note is Agarwood (Oud).

name: Fragrance Du Bois Oud Vert Intense Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Fragrance du Bois Oud Vert Intense is a fresh, green oud with ginger and vetiver.
Olivier Pescheux created it in 2013. Bergamot, cardamom and ginger open bright, nutmeg, coriander and geranium form an aromatic heart, and cedar, musk, oud and vetiver give it a woody finish.
Fresh and refined, it is a great daytime scent from spring through fall.

name: Fragrance Du Bois Oud Violet Intense Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Fragrance Du Bois Oud Violet Intense is a fresh, spicy oud with elemi and olibanum.
Alexandra Kosinski created it in 2013. Elemi, mandarin and black pepper open bright, olibanum, tonka bean and nutmeg form a warm heart, and oud, musk, amber and citrus give it a smooth finish.
Refined and versatile, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

Oud Violet Intense by Fragrance Du Bois is a Amber fragrance for women and men. Oud Violet Intense was launched in 2013. The nose behind this fragrance is Alexandra Kosinski. Top notes are elemi, Mandarin Orange and Black Pepper; middle notes are Olibanum, Tonka Bean and Nutmeg; base notes are Agarwood (Oud), Musk, Amber and Citruses.

name: Fragrance Du Bois PM Extrait de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Fragrance du Bois PM is a rich, ambery blend of leather, tuberose and labdanum.
Launched in 2022, it blends leather, tuberose, labdanum, juniper, cardamom, patchouli, orris, benzoin, lemon, cedar and amber into a warm, aromatic and woody scent.
Bold and sensual, it is made for nights in spring, fall and winter.

PM by Fragrance Du Bois is a Amber Woody fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. PM was launched in 2022.

name: Fragrance Du Bois Sahraa Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Fragrance Du Bois Sahraa is a warm, spicy oud with rose and saffron.
François Merle-Baudoin created it in 2013. Grapefruit opens bright, rose, geranium, patchouli and jasmine form a floral heart, and oud, saffron, amber, black pepper, vanilla and sandalwood give it a rich finish.
Bold and sensual, it is made for fall and winter nights.

Sahraa by Fragrance Du Bois is a Amber fragrance for women and men. Sahraa was launched in 2013. The nose behind this fragrance is Francois Merle-Baudoin. Top note is Grapefruit; middle notes are Rose, Geranium, Patchouli and Jasmine; base notes are Agarwood (Oud), Saffron, Amber, Black Pepper, Vanilla and Sandalwood.

name: Fragrance Du Bois Sahraa Extrait de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Fragrance du Bois Sahraa is a warm, spicy blend of rose, saffron and oud.
François Merle-Baudoin created it in 2013. Grapefruit opens bright, rose, geranium, patchouli and jasmine form a floral heart, and oud, saffron, amber, black pepper, vanilla and sandalwood give it a rich finish.
Opulent and intense, it is made for fall and winter nights.

Sahraa by Fragrance Du Bois is a Amber fragrance for women and men. Sahraa was launched in 2013. The nose behind this fragrance is Francois Merle-Baudoin. Top note is Grapefruit; middle notes are Rose, Geranium, Patchouli and Jasmine; base notes are Agarwood (Oud), Saffron, Amber, Black Pepper, Vanilla and Sandalwood.

name: Fragrance Du Bois Santal Complet Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Fragrance Du Bois Santal Complet is a creamy, powdery sandalwood with coconut and vanilla.
Launched in 2016, it opens with coconut and lemon. Violet and black pepper form a soft, slightly spicy heart, and sandalwood, vanilla, musk and amber give it a smooth, warm finish.
Comforting and easy, it works day or night from spring through fall.

Santal Complet by Fragrance Du Bois is a Amber Vanilla fragrance for women and men. Santal Complet was launched in 2016. Top notes are Coconut and Lemon; middle notes are Violet and Black Pepper; base notes are Sandalwood, Vanilla, Musk and Amber.

name: Fragrance Du Bois Secret Tryst Extrait de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Fragrance Du Bois Secret Tryst is a warm, spicy blend of saffron, rose and incense.
Launched in 2021, it opens with cardamom, saffron and bergamot. Vetiver, jasmine, rose and cedar form a rich heart, and olibanum, patchouli, vanilla and labdanum give it a resinous, ambery finish.
Sensual and warm, it is a great choice for evenings and cooler weather.

Secret Tryst Extrait de Parfum by Fragrance Du Bois is a Amber Floral fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Secret Tryst Extrait de Parfum was launched in 2021. Top notes are Saffron, Cardamom and Bergamot; middle notes are Vetiver, Jasmine, Rose and Cedar; base notes are Olibanum, Patchouli, Labdanum and Vanilla.

name: Fragrance Du Bois Siberian Rose Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Fragrance du Bois Siberian Rose is a rich floral with tuberose, rose and leather.
Shadi Samra created it in 2020. Pear, juniper, pink pepper and cinnamon open bright, tuberose, rose, leather and ylang-ylang form a lush heart, and moss, patchouli and amber give it a warm finish.
Bold and elegant, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

Siberian Rose by Fragrance Du Bois is a Amber Floral fragrance for women. This is a new fragrance. Siberian Rose was launched in 2020. The nose behind this fragrance is Shadi Samra. Top notes are Pear, Juniper, Pink Pepper and Cinnamon; middle notes are Tuberose, Rose, Leather and Ylang-Ylang; base notes are Moss, Patchouli and Amber.

name: Fragrance Du Bois Solstis Extrait de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Fragrance Du Bois Solstis is a bright, fresh blend of apple, citrus and spice.
Shadi Samra created it in 2022. Apple, mandarin, bergamot and pink pepper open crisp, nutmeg, neroli, pepper and cardamom form a spicy heart, and vanilla, sandalwood and vetiver give it a smooth finish.
Fresh and uplifting, it is made for spring and summer days.

Solstis by Fragrance Du Bois is a Woody Spicy fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Solstis was launched in 2022. The nose behind this fragrance is Shadi Samra. Top notes are Apple, Mandarin Orange, Bergamot and Pink Pepper; middle notes are Nutmeg, Neroli, Pepper and Cardamom; base notes are Vanilla, Sandalwood and Vetiver.

name: Fragrance Du Bois Tropiques Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Fragrance Du Bois Tropiques is a sweet, juicy blend of tropical fruits and caramel.
Launched in 2024, it opens with tropical fruits, mandarin and bergamot. Mahonial, lavender and rose form a fresh heart, and musk, caramel and amber give it a soft, sweet finish.
Cheerful and sunny, it is made for spring and summer days.

name: Fragrance Du Bois Wild Orange Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Fragrance Du Bois Wild Orange is a bright, juicy citrus with orange blossom and woods.
Shadi Samra created it in 2023. Orange, mandarin, lemon and bergamot open sparkling, orange blossom, lily-of-the-valley and cypress form a fresh heart, and sandalwood, cedar, patchouli and vetiver give it a smooth finish.
Uplifting and easy, it works day or night from spring through fall.

name: Fragrance One Black Tie Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Fragrance One Black Tie is a bright citrus with smooth woods and a hint of spice.
Alberto Morillas created it in 2020. Brazilian mandarin, orange oil and Italian lemon open sparkling, guaiac wood forms a smooth heart, and vetiver, cardamom and patchouli give it an elegant, earthy finish.
Polished and versatile, it works year-round, day or night.

Black Tie by Fragrance One is a Woody Spicy fragrance for men. This is a new fragrance. Black Tie
was launched in 2020. The nose behind this fragrance is Alberto
Morillas. Top notes are Brazilian Mandarin, Orange Oil and Italian
Lemon; middle note is Guaiac Wood; base notes are Cardamom, Vetiver and
Patchouli.

name: Fragrance One Club Extrait de Perfume for Men

notes.source_text:
Fragrance One Club is a warm, smooth blend of jasmine sambac and benzoin.
Launched in 2025, it pairs jasmine sambac with benzoin for a creamy, ambery and gently sweet floral scent with a vanilla-like warmth.
Smooth and versatile, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

name: Fragrance One Date for Men Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Fragrance One Date for Men is a bright citrus with warm spice, vetiver and oud.
Alberto Morillas created it in 2019. Juniper berry, mandarin, bergamot and lemon open fresh, cardamom and patchouli form a warm heart, and vetiver and oud give it a smooth, woody finish.
Confident and polished, it is made for date nights and evenings out in spring, fall and winter.

Fragrance One Date is a Masculine fragrance, The fragrance launched in 2019, The nose behind this fragrance is Alberto Morillas,
Top Note: juniper berry, Mandarin Orange, Bergamot, Lemon
Heart Note: Cardamom, Patchouli
Base Note: Vetiver, Agarwood (Oud)

name: Fragrance One Day for Women Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Fragrance One Day for Women is a soft, fruity floral with jasmine sambac, osmanthus and apricot.
Honorine Blanc created it in 2020. Jasmine sambac, osmanthus, apricot and benzoin come together in a creamy, fruity and gently ambery floral scent.
Bright and easy, it works day or night from spring through fall.

Day For Women is described by the Fragrance One brand as a solid mix of osmanthus, with its apricot-floral scent, blended with dark and sexual notes of benzoin and feminine sambac jasmine.
Day For Women was launched in 2020. The nose behind this fragrance is Honorine Blanc.

name: Fragrance One Most Masculine Extrait de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Fragrance One Most Masculine is a fruity, woody blend of citrus, pine and iris.
Launched in 2025, it blends lemon, sweet orange and red berries with clary sage, geranium, pine and iris over cedarwood, elemi and patchouli for a bright, sweet and woody scent.
Confident and versatile, it works year-round, day or night.

name: Fragrance One Night for Women Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Fragrance One Night for Women is a warm, powdery blend of vanilla, benzoin and jasmine.
Honorine Blanc created it in 2020. Vanilla, benzoin and jasmine come together in a smooth, ambery and gently floral scent.
Cozy and sensual, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

Night For Women takes a darker and sweeter turn than its partner fragrance Day For Women, with the emphasis on vanilla 'colored' benzoin and the floralcy of jasmine, omitting the osmanthus from the composition, as explained by the brand.
Night For Women was launched in 2020. The nose behind this fragrance is Honorine Blanc.

name: Fragrance One Office for Men Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Fragrance One Office for Men is a clean, polished woody amber.
Alberto Morillas created it in 2019. Ambroxan, bergamot and orris root open fresh, woods, florals, amber, jasmine and ambergris form the heart, and woods, musk and patchouli give it a smooth finish.
A daytime favorite for spring and summer, made for the office.

Office For Men is the first
fragrance by the youtube reviewer Jeremy Fragrance. The fragrance is
created by Alberto Morillias. It is light spicy woody fougere, featuring
modern synthetic molecule with a woody, ambery and spicy profile as
well as natural ingredients.
Office For Men was launched in 2019. The nose behind this fragrance is Alberto Morillas.

name: Fragrance One Unisex for Everybody Extrait de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Fragrance One Unisex for Everybody is a bright, spicy blend of bergamot, cinnamon and elemi.
Élise Benat created it in 2020. Bergamot opens fresh, cinnamon forms a warm, spicy heart, and elemi gives it a clean, resinous finish.
Easy and versatile, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

Unisex perfectly crosses the line between a feminine and masculine fragrance with a mix of Cinnamon, sexy Elemi (a Resin from Philippines with an orange flavor), Italian Bergamot for the fruity opening that everybody loves and more.

name: Francesca Bianchi Angel's Dust Extrait de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Francesca Bianchi Angel's Dust is a soft, powdery blend of iris, mimosa and vanilla.
Francesca Bianchi created it in 2016. Iris, mimosa, benzoin, tolu balsam, vanilla, sandalwood, rose, musk and black pepper come together in a warm, ambery and velvety scent.
Cozy and elegant, it is a lovely everyday scent.

name: Francesca Bianchi Byzantine Amber Extrait de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Francesca Bianchi Byzantine Amber is a rich, resinous amber with leather and incense.
Francesca Bianchi created it in 2023. Cinnamon and bergamot open warm, geranium forms the heart, and leather, labdanum, benzoin, styrax, ambergris and incense give it a deep, balsamic finish.
Opulent and enveloping, it is a strong choice for cooler days and evenings.

name: Francesca Bianchi Etruscan Water Extrait de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Francesca Bianchi Etruscan Water is an earthy, aromatic citrus with oakmoss and orris.
Francesca Bianchi created it in 2019. Oakmoss, orris, ambergris, bergamot, immortelle, vetiver, petitgrain, basil, musk, labdanum, caraway, jasmine, grapefruit and tangerine come together in a fresh, mossy and slightly salty scent.
Natural and distinctive, it is a great everyday scent.

name: Francesca Bianchi Libertine Neroli Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Francesca Bianchi Libertine Neroli is a leathery, musky take on neroli.
Francesca Bianchi created it in 2022. Bergamot and petitgrain open bright, Tunisian neroli, iris and geranium form a floral heart, and labdanum, leather, benzoin, animalic notes and oakmoss give it a sensual finish.
Distinctive and versatile, it is a great daytime scent year-round.

name: Francesca Bianchi Lost in Heaven Extrait de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Francesca Bianchi Lost in Heaven is a rich, animalic blend of beeswax, orange blossom and ambergris.
Francesca Bianchi created it in 2019. Cumin, beeswax, castoreum, orange blossom, ylang-ylang, opoponax, ambergris, mimosa, orris root, heliotrope, labdanum, jasmine and sandalwood come together in a warm, sweet and powdery scent.
Sensual and complex, it is a strong choice for evenings.

name: Francesca Bianchi Luxe Calme Volupte Extrait de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Francesca Bianchi Luxe Calme Volupté is a green, ambery blend of galbanum, hyacinth and iris.
Francesca Bianchi created it in 2021. Bitter orange and tangerine open bright, galbanum, tropical fruits, ylang-ylang and hyacinth form a green floral heart, and iris, benzoin, vetiver, opoponax and sandalwood give it a warm finish.
Elegant and serene, it is a lovely everyday scent.

name: Francesca Bianchi Sex and The Sea Extrait de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Francesca Bianchi Sex and the Sea is a warm, salty blend of coconut, ambergris and immortelle.
Francesca Bianchi created it in 2016. Coconut, ambergris, pineapple, mimosa, immortelle, iris, civet, vanilla, myrrh, benzoin, labdanum, sandalwood and rose come together in a sweet, powdery and sensual scent.
Sunny and seductive, it works day or night from spring through fall.

Sex and the Sea by Francesca Bianchi is a Amber Floral fragrance for women and men. Sex and the Sea was launched in 2016. The nose behind this fragrance is Francesca Bianchi.

name: Francesca Bianchi Sex And The Sea Neroli Extrait de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Francesca Bianchi Sex and the Sea Neroli is a sensual blend of neroli, coconut and ambergris.
Francesca Bianchi created it in 2019. Neroli, coconut, ambergris, honey, mimosa and petitgrain meet immortelle, vanilla, iris, benzoin, sandalwood, labdanum and a touch of civet for a warm, salty and powdery skin scent.
Sensual and sun-kissed, it is a lovely everyday scent.

name: Francesca Bianchi Sticky Fingers Extrait de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Francesca Bianchi Sticky Fingers is a warm, smoky blend of patchouli, tobacco and leather.
Francesca Bianchi created it in 2020. Patchouli, tobacco, orris, leather, tonka bean, castoreum, sandalwood, cinnamon, heliotrope, musk and coriander come together in a rich, powdery and woody scent.
Bold and cozy, it is made for fall and winter nights.

Sticky Fingers by Francesca Bianchi is a Leather fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Sticky Fingers was launched in 2020. The nose behind this fragrance is Francesca Bianchi.

name: Francesca Bianchi The Black Knight Extrait de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Francesca Bianchi The Black Knight is an earthy blend of leather, honey and orris.
Francesca Bianchi created it in 2019. Leather, orris root, honey, vetiver, beeswax, caraway, oakmoss, patchouli, artemisia, narcissus, cedar and Bulgarian rose come together in a dark, honeyed and animalic scent.
Bold and distinctive, it is a strong choice for cooler days and evenings.

name: Francesca Bianchi The Dark Side Extrait de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Francesca Bianchi The Dark Side is a warm, balsamic blend of incense, honey and iris.
Francesca Bianchi created it in 2016. Incense, honey, styrax, spices, iris, amber, violet, patchouli, vanilla, sandalwood, cedar and vetiver come together in a powdery, ambery and woody scent.
Rich and comforting, it is a strong choice for cooler days and evenings.

name: Francesca Bianchi The Lover's Tale Extrait de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Francesca Bianchi The Lover's Tale is a smoky, powdery blend of honey, orris and leather.
Francesca Bianchi created it in 2018. Honey, mimosa, aldehydes and bergamot open bright, orris, peach, heliotrope, jasmine and Bulgarian rose form a soft heart, and leather, castoreum, musk, labdanum, oakmoss and sandalwood give it a sensual finish.
Romantic and bold, it is a strong choice for evenings.

name: Francesca Bianchi Tyger Tyger Extrait de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Francesca Bianchi Tyger Tyger is a sweet, honeyed floral with peach, leather and oud.
Francesca Bianchi created it in 2020. Peach, honey, white flowers, leather, heliotrope, oakmoss, sandalwood, oud and patchouli come together in a warm, powdery and fruity scent.
Sensual and distinctive, it is a lovely everyday and evening scent.

name: Francesca Bianchi Under My Skin Extrait de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Francesca Bianchi Under My Skin is a warm, ambery blend of orris, leather and balsams.
Francesca Bianchi created it in 2017. Spices, black pepper, lavender and grapefruit open bright, orris root, carnation and Bulgarian rose form a powdery heart, and leather, castoreum, ambergris, Peru and tolu balsam, vanilla and costus give it a rich finish.
Sensual and intimate, it works day or night in fall and winter.

Under My Skin by Francesca Bianchi is a Amber Woody fragrance for women and men. Under My Skin was launched in 2017. The nose behind this fragrance is Francesca Bianchi. Top notes are Spicy Notes, Black Pepper, Lavender and Grapefruit; middle notes are Orris Root, Carnation and Bulgarian Rose; base notes are Leather, Castoreum, Ambergris, Peru Balsam, Tolu Balsam, Musk, Sandalwood, Vanilla, Costus, Oakmoss and Tonka Bean.

name: Frapin 1270 Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Frapin 1270 is a rich, sweet blend of dried fruits, hazelnut and honey inspired by cognac.
Sidonie Lancesseur created it in 2010. Pineapple, dried plum, cacao, tonka bean, orange and coffee open warm, dried fruits, spices, hazelnut and linden blossom form the heart, and white honey, vanilla and guaiac wood give it a smooth finish.
Cozy and indulgent, it is made for fall and winter, day or night.

1270 by Frapin is a Amber Spicy fragrance for women and men. 1270 was launched in 2010. The nose behind this fragrance is Sidonie Lancesseur. Top notes are Pineapple, Dried Plum, Resin, Cacao, Tonka Bean, Orange and Coffee; middle notes are Dried Fruits, Spices, Hazelnut, Lime (Linden) Blossom and Flowers; base notes are white honey, Vanilla, Woodsy Notes and Guaiac Wood.

name: Frapin 1270 Extreme Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Frapin 1270 Extrême is a richer, fruitier take on 1270 with pineapple and apple.
Jérôme Epinette created it in 2022. Pineapple, apple, elemi and bergamot open bright, cedar, jasmine sambac, vine and rose form the heart, and tonka bean, guaiac wood, vanilla and patchouli give it a warm finish.
Smooth and inviting, it works day or night in spring and fall.

1270 Extrême by Frapin is a Floral fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. 1270 Extrême was launched in 2022. The nose behind this fragrance is Jérôme Epinette. Top notes are Pineapple, Apple, Elemi resin and Bergamot; middle notes are Cedar, Jasmine Sambac, Vine and Rose; base notes are Tonka Bean, Guaiac Wood, Vanilla and Patchouli.

name: Frapin Checkmate Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Frapin Checkmate is a powdery blend of cardamom, leather and iris.
Anne-Sophie Behaghel created it in 2021. Cardamom, bergamot and lemon open bright, leather, iris and heliotrope form a soft heart, and suede, woods, cashmere wood and cedar give it a smooth finish.
Refined and calm, it is a lovely scent for fall.

Checkmate by Frapin is a Woody fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Checkmate was launched in 2021. The nose behind this fragrance is Anne-Sophie Behaghel. Top notes are Cardamom, Bergamot and Lemon; middle notes are Leather, iris and Heliotrope; base notes are Suede, Woody Notes, Cashmere Wood and Cedar.

name: Frapin If By R.k. Eau de Parfum Unisex

Smooth and versatile, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

IF by R.K. by Frapin is a Woody fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. IF by R.K. was launched in 2019. The nose behind this fragrance is Anne-Sophie Behaghel. Top notes are Ginger, Bergamot and Black Pepper; middle notes are Fig, Cashmeran and Cinnamon; base notes are Sandalwood, Guaiac Wood, Tonka Bean and Patchouli.

name: Frapin L'Humaniste Eau de Parfum Unisex

Sidonie Lancesseur created it in 2009. Amalfi lemon, bergamot, cardamom and pepper open crisp, juniper, nutmeg, thyme and peony form a herbal heart, and gin, oakmoss and tonka bean give it a clean finish.
Bright and refined, it is made for spring and summer days.

L'Humaniste by Frapin is a Aromatic Spicy fragrance for men. L'Humaniste was launched in 2009. The nose behind this fragrance is Sidonie Lancesseur. Top notes are Amalfi Lemon, Bergamot, Cardamom, Pink Pepper and Pepper; middle notes are Juniper Berries, Nutmeg, Thyme and Peony; base notes are Gin, Oakmoss and Tonka Bean.

name: Frapin Laskarina Eau de Parfum For Women

notes.source_text:
Frapin Laskarina is a bright, ambery floral with pear, orange blossom and olibanum.
Launched in 2017, it opens with pear, pink pepper, grapefruit and bergamot. Orange blossom and Bulgarian rose form a floral heart, and olibanum, black pepper, iris and ambroxan give it a warm finish.
Elegant and fresh, it is a lovely daytime scent in fall.

Laskarina by Frapin is a Amber Floral fragrance for women. Laskarina was launched in 2017. Top notes are Pear, Pink Pepper, Grapefruit and Bergamot; middle notes are Orange Blossom and Bulgarian Rose; base notes are Olibanum, Black Pepper, iris and Ambroxan.

Nevermore by Frapin is a Floral Woody Musk fragrance for women and men. Nevermore was launched in 2014. The nose behind this fragrance is Anne-Sophie Behaghel.

name: Frapin Parfums Bois Blanc Eau de Parfum Unisex

Frapin Bois Blanc is a fresh, aromatic blend of rosemary, eucalyptus and cedar.
Anne-Sophie Behaghel created it in 2020. Rosemary, ginger, eucalyptus, bitter orange and mandarin open bright, cedar, sage and violet leaf form an aromatic heart, and guaiac wood, ambroxan and cade oil give it a smoky finish.
Clean and refined, it works day or night in spring and fall.

Bois Blanc by Frapin is a Woody fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Bois Blanc was launched in 2020. The nose behind this fragrance is Anne-Sophie Behaghel. Top notes are Rosemary, Ginger, Eucalyptus, Bitter Orange and Mandarin Orange; middle notes are Virginia Cedar, Sage and Violet Leaf; base notes are Guaiac Wood, Ambroxan and Cade oil.

name: Frapin Parfums Isle Of Man Eau de Parfum For Men

notes.source_text:

Aliénor Massenet created it in 2017. Bitter orange, grapefruit and basil open bright, salt, violet and freesia form a breezy heart, and woods, vetiver and musk give it a clean finish.
Crisp and easy, it is a great daytime scent from spring through fall.

Isle of Man by Frapin is a Aromatic Green fragrance for men. Isle of Man was launched in 2017. The nose behind this fragrance is Alienor Massenet. Top notes are Bitter Orange, Grapefruit and Basil; middle notes are Salt, Violet and Freesia; base notes are Woodsy Notes, Vetiver and Musk.

name: Frapin The Orchid Man Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Frapin The Orchid Man is a fresh, mossy blend of bergamot, leather and jasmine.
Jérôme Épinette created it in 2015. Bergamot and black pepper open bright, leather and jasmine form a smooth heart, and oakmoss, patchouli and amber give it an earthy finish.
Refined and versatile, it is a great daytime scent from spring through fall.

The Orchid Man by Frapin is a Aromatic fragrance for women and men. The Orchid Man was launched in 2015. The nose behind this fragrance is Jérôme Epinette. Top notes are Bergamot and Black Pepper; middle notes are Leather and Jasmine; base notes are Oakmoss, Patchouli and Amber.

name: Frederic Malle Acne Studios Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Frédéric Malle Acne Studios is a soft, fruity blend of peach, orange blossom and musk.
Suzy Le Helley created it in 2024. Orange blossom, rose, violet, peach and aldehydes meet musk, sandalwood, vanilla and frankincense for a bright, sweet and gently musky scent.
Fresh and charming, it is a lovely daytime scent in spring.

name: Frederic Malle Angeliques Sous La Pluie Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Frédéric Malle Angéliques sous la Pluie is a cool, airy blend of angelica, juniper and pink pepper.
Jean-Claude Ellena created it in 2000. Angelica, juniper, pink pepper, cedar, coriander and musk come together in a fresh, aromatic and quietly woody scent.
Calm and refreshing, it is made for spring and summer days.

Angéliques Sous La Pluie by Frederic Malle is a Woody Floral Musk fragrance for women and men. Angéliques Sous La Pluie was launched in 2000. The nose behind this fragrance is Jean-Claude Ellena.

name: Frederic Malle Bigarade Concentree Eau de Toilette Unisex

notes.source_text:
Frederic Malle Bigarade Concentrée is a bright, bitter orange with rose and green hay.
Jean-Claude Ellena created it in 2002. Bitter orange opens sharp and juicy, rose softens the heart, and grass, hay and cedar give it a fresh, green finish.
Clean and lively, it is made for summer days.

Bigarade concentree by Frederic Malle is a Citrus Aromatic fragrance for women and men. Bigarade concentree was launched in 2002. The nose behind this fragrance is Jean-Claude Ellena. Top note is Bitter Orange; middle note is Rose; base notes are Grass, Hay and Cedar.

name: Frederic Malle Carnal Flower Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Frederic Malle Carnal Flower is a lush, creamy tuberose with a fresh, green edge.
Dominique Ropion created it in 2005. Tuberose leads, with eucalyptus, bergamot and melon adding a cool freshness, jasmine, ylang-ylang and orange blossom deepening the floral heart, and coconut and musk giving it a soft, sensual finish.
Bold and radiant, it is a beautiful choice for spring through fall, day or night.

If nature offers olfactive clashes, tuberose is probably the best
example of these. These pretty flowers exude an almost carnal smell,
superimposing in a quasi-miraculous way flower-shop freshness,
camphorous violence - spicy and animalic - and milky sweetness. This
mysterious equilibrium has always fascinated perfumers. 18 months were
necessary for Dominique Ropion to create a modern version of that theme,
an "olfactive Everest" that only the most talented perfumers are
capable of reaching.

name: Frederic Malle Cologne Bigarade Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Frédéric Malle Cologne Bigarade is a crisp, green blend of bitter orange, rose and hay.
Jean-Claude Ellena created it in 2001. Bitter orange opens bright, rose forms a soft heart, and grass, hay and cedar give it a fresh, woody finish.

Cologne Bigarade by Frederic Malle is a Citrus Aromatic fragrance for women and men. Cologne Bigarade was launched in 2001. The nose behind this fragrance is Jean-Claude Ellena. Top note is bitter orange; middle note is rose; base notes are cedar, grass and hay.

name: Frederic Malle Cologne Indelebile Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Frédéric Malle Cologne Indélébile is a long-lasting cologne of citrus, neroli and musk.
Dominique Ropion created it in 2015. Bergamot and lemon open bright, neroli, orange blossom and narcissus form a clean floral heart, and musk gives it a soft, lasting finish.
Fresh and polished, it is made for spring and summer days.

Cologne Indélébile by Frederic Malle is a Citrus fragrance for women and men. Cologne Indélébile was launched in 2015. The nose behind this fragrance is Dominique Ropion. Top notes are bergamot and lemon; middle notes are narcissus, orange blossom and neroli; base note is musk.

name: Frederic Malle Contre-Jour Eau de Parfum for Unisex

notes.source_text: Contre-Jour by Frederic Malle is a unisex fragrance released in 2026. Created by perfumer Annick Menardo, this scent features an opening note of Immortelle, complemented by a heart of Rose and Narcissus, and concludes with a warm base of Sandalwood.

name: Frederic Malle Dans Tes Bras Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Frederic Malle Dans Tes Bras is a soft, powdery blend of violet, cashmeran and musk.
Maurice Roucel created it in 2008. Violet, heliotrope and jasmine meet cashmeran, musk, pine, woods, patchouli, sandalwood and incense for a warm, skin-like scent that feels like a gentle embrace.
Intimate and quiet, it is lovely on spring and fall days.

Dans Tes Bras by Frederic Malle is a Woody Floral Musk fragrance for women and men. Dans Tes Bras was launched in 2008. The nose behind this fragrance is Maurice Roucel. The fragrance features heliotrope, jasmine, woodsy notes, patchouli, pine tree, cashmeran, sandalwood, musk, incense and violet.

name: Frederic Malle Eau de Magnolia Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Frederic Malle Eau de Magnolia is a fresh, citrusy floral with magnolia and vetiver.
Carlos Benaim created it in 2014. Calabrian bergamot opens bright, magnolia, vetiver and patchouli form the heart, and moss, cedar and amber give it a woody finish.

name: Frederic Malle En Passant Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Frédéric Malle En Passant is a soft, watery lilac with a green twist.
Olivia Giacobetti created it in 2000. Lilac, watery notes, cucumber, wheat and petitgrain blend into a fresh, green and delicate floral.
A gentle daytime scent for spring.

name: Frederic Malle French Lover Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Frédéric Malle French Lover is a dry, elegant blend of angelica, incense and vetiver.
Pierre Bourdon created it in 2007. Galbanum and spices open green, angelica, cedar and incense form the heart, and vetiver, oakmoss and white musk give it a refined finish.
A sophisticated daytime scent for spring and fall.

For the man who would not
normally wear perfume, who believes in naked attraction and relies on
the simple seductive power of his rugged appearance.
The spicy freshness of pimiento, angelica and juniper
flowers melts into a woody sea of cedar, patchouli and vetiver, bound by
galbanum and frankincense in a mysterious enhancement of men’s natural
scent.
Developed by Pierre Bourdon.
Top notes: pimiento, angelica, juniper.
Base notes: patchouli, vetiver, frankincense.

name: Frederic Malle Geranium Pour Monsieur Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Frederic Malle Géranium pour Monsieur is a cool, minty geranium with warm spice and musk.
Dominique Ropion created it in 2009. Mint, geranium and star anise open fresh and green, clove and cinnamon add warmth, and musk, sandalwood, incense, styrax and benzoin give it a clean, smooth finish.
Crisp and refined, it is great for everyday wear in spring and summer.

Frédéric Malle's Géranium pour Monsieur eau de parfum offers a
sophisticated alternative to the classic fern-type fragrances. Created
by Dominique Ropion, this fresh scent features a combination of notes
such as geranium, cinnamon, and white musk.
Notes: geranium, aniseed, mint, incense resinoid, styrax benzoin.

name: Frederic Malle Heaven Can Wait Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Frederic Malle Heaven Can Wait is a soft, fruity blend of plum, iris and musk.
Jean-Claude Ellena created it in 2023. Plum, carrot seed, clove, pimento and ambrette open warm, iris, vetiver and magnolia form an elegant heart, and musk, peach and vanilla give it a gentle finish.
Light and refined, it is a lovely daytime scent from spring through fall.

name: Frederic Malle Hope Eau de Parfum Unisex

Refined and moody, it works day or night in fall and winter.

name: Frederic Malle Iris Poudre Eau de Parfum for Women

Frederic Malle Iris Poudre is a soft, powdery iris with aldehydes and woods.
Pierre Bourdon created it in 2000. Ylang-ylang, carnation, rosewood, bergamot and orange open bright, aldehydes, violet, lily, magnolia, jasmine and rose form the heart, and iris, musk, sandalwood, vetiver, vanilla and amber give it a velvety finish.
Elegant and timeless, it is a lovely daytime scent in spring and fall.

Iris Poudre by Frederic Malle is a Floral Aldehyde fragrance for women. Iris Poudre
was launched in 2000. The nose behind this fragrance is Pierre Bourdon.
Top notes are Ylang-Ylang, Carnation, Palisander Rosewood, Bergamot and
Orange; middle notes are Aldehydes, Violet, Lily, Jasmine, Rose and
Magnolia; base notes are iris, Musk, Sandalwood, Vetiver, Vanilla, Amber
and ebony tree.

name: Frederic Malle L'eau D'hiver Eau de Toilette Unisex

notes.source_text:
Frederic Malle L'Eau d'Hiver is a soft, powdery blend of heliotrope, iris and honey.
Jean-Claude Ellena created it in 2003. Heliotrope, iris, white musk, angelica, honey, bergamot and jasmine come together in a light, warm and airy scent with a gentle sweetness.
Quiet and comforting, it is lovely on spring days.

L'Eau d'Hiver by Frederic Malle is a Floral Woody Musk fragrance for women and men. L'Eau d'Hiver was launched in 2003. The nose behind this fragrance is Jean-Claude Ellena.

name: Frederic Malle Le Parfum de Therese Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Frédéric Malle Le Parfum de Thérèse is a fruity, leathery blend of melon, plum and rose.
Created by Edmond Roudnitska, it was released in 2000. Melon and tangerine open juicy, plum and rose form a rich floral heart, and leather, vetiver and cedar give it a dry, woody finish.
Elegant and unusual, it is a lovely daytime scent in spring and fall.

Le Parfum de Therese is an unique perfume with a composition that was way ahead of its time, made by Edmond Roudnitska in 1950s (1957-1965). He made it for his wife, and up until Frederic Malle was founded, it was in Teresa’s personal use only. After many years Teresa decided to give the formula to Frederic Malle to include it to the collection and to insure immortality and glory for this beautiful Edmond Roudnitska’s creation. Fruity aquatic accords, discovered way earlier than fruity and aquatic fragrances became common, open the composition with tangerine and melon and lead to the heart of rose and plum. Cedar, vetiver and leather finish the composition. This unique fragrance is modern and beautifully antique at the same time. Le Parfum de Therese was launched in 2000.

name: Frederic Malle Lipstick Rose Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Frederic Malle Lipstick Rose is a playful, powdery blend of rose, violet and raspberry.
Ralf Schwieger created it in 2000. Violet, rose, iris and raspberry meet a bright touch of grapefruit, and amber, vanilla and white musk give it a soft, makeup-bag finish.
Glamorous and fun, it is great for everyday wear in spring, fall and winter.

A perfume that is both regressive and a modern take on Hollywood
glamour, Lipstick Rose smiles at you like a dash of lipstick with its
rose and violet-flavored candy scent. It embodies an alluring women,
part Gilda, part socialite. Grapefruit and violet enhance the
fragrance's rose note. The backdrop is musk and vanilla with a hint of
vetiver and amber. A vision of glamorized femininity in Technicolor.
Style: Fruity, floral, oriental
Notes: Grapefruit, violet rose, ambrette, iris, raspberry, heliotrope, white musk.
Mood: Energetic, alluring, social

name: Frederic Malle Lys Mediterranee Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Frederic Malle Lys Méditerranée is a fresh, salty lily with ginger and sea water.
Édouard Fléchier created it in 2000. Sea water and ginger open fresh, lily, lotus, angelica and orange blossom form a luminous heart, and musk and vanilla give it a soft finish.
Breezy and elegant, it is made for spring and summer days.

Lys Mediterranee by Frederic Malle is a Floral fragrance for women and men. Lys Mediterranee
was launched in 2000. The nose behind this fragrance is Edouard
Flechier. Top notes are Sea water and Ginger; middle notes are Lily,
Lotus, Angelica and Orange Blossom; base notes are Musk and Vanilla.

name: Frederic Malle Monsieur Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Frederic Malle Monsieur is a rich, deep patchouli with rum and tangerine.
Bruno Jovanovic created it in 2015. Rum and tangerine open bright and boozy, patchouli, incense, cedar and amber form a dense, earthy heart, and musk and vanilla give it a smooth finish.
Powerful and elegant, it is made for fall and winter, day or night.

Monsieur by Frederic Malle is a Oriental Vanilla fragrance for men. Monsieur
was launched in 2015. The nose behind this fragrance is Bruno
Jovanovic. Top notes are Rum and Tangerine; middle notes are Patchouli,
Incense, Cedar and Amber; base notes are Musk and Vanilla.

name: Frederic Malle Musc Ravageur Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Frédéric Malle Musc Ravageur is a sensual, spiced musk with warm vanilla.
Maurice Roucel created it in 2000. Lavender, tangerine and bergamot open bright, cinnamon and clove form a spicy heart, and vanilla, musk, tonka bean, amber and woods give it a warm, skin-like finish.
Made for fall and winter nights and date nights.

It is a sensual perfume, powerful yet perfectly controlled, dynamic
and mysterious. Composed by Maurice Roucel as an act of seduction and
generosity. Musc Ravageur is an uncompromising oriental, which runs
against current fads. Its explosive departure of bergamot, tangerine and
cinnamon is set against a backdrop of vanilla, musk and amber. A sexy,
turbulent perfume, in a word: ravageur.Style: Oriental, classical
Notes: Bergamot, mandarin, cinnamon, vanilla, tonka beans, sandalwood, amber, tonkitone musk.
Mood: Sexy, powerful, mysterious.

name: Frederic Malle Music For A While Eau de Parfum Unisex

Frédéric Malle Music for a While is a sweet, fruity blend of lavender, pineapple and caramel.
Carlos Benaim created it in 2018. Lavender, fruity notes, anise, mandarin and bergamot open bright, pineapple and geranium form a juicy heart, and patchouli, caramel, sugar, vanilla and labdanum give it a warm finish.
Playful and cozy, it is a lovely daytime scent in spring and fall.

Music For a While by Frederic Malle is a fragrance for women and men. Music For a While was launched in 2018. The nose behind this fragrance is Carlos Benaim. Top notes are Lavender, Fruity Notes, Anise, Mandarin Orange and Bergamot; middle notes are Pineapple and Geranium; base notes are Patchouli, Caramel, Sugar, Vanilla and Labdanum.

name: Frederic Malle Noir Epices Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Frédéric Malle Noir Épices is a spicy blend of clove, pepper and rose.
Michel Roudnitska created it in 2000. Orange, geranium and rose open fresh, clove, pepper, nutmeg and cinnamon form a spicy heart, and sandalwood, patchouli, cedar and vanilla give it a warm finish.
Elegant and warm, it works day or night in fall and winter.

Noir Epices by Frederic Malle is a Oriental Spicy fragrance for women and men. Noir Epices was launched in 2000. The nose behind this fragrance is Michel Roudnitska. Top notes are orange, rose and geranium; middle notes are nutmeg, cinnamon, pepper and cloves; base notes are sandalwood, patchouli, cedar and vanilla.

name: Frederic Malle Northern Love Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Frédéric Malle Northern Love is a warm, spicy gourmand with speculoos, jasmine and leather.
Bruno Jovanovic created it in 2026. Saffron, cinnamon, nutmeg and speculoos open spicy, jasmine and vanilla form a sweet heart, and Peru balsam, sandalwood, leather, styrax and patchouli give it a rich finish.
Cozy and refined, it is a great everyday and evening scent.

name: Frederic Malle Outrageous! Eau de Toilette Unisex

notes.source_text:
Frédéric Malle Outrageous! is a fresh, sparkling blend of lime, green apple and orange blossom.
Sophia Grojsman created it in 2007. Lime, green apple, grapefruit, mint and cinnamon open bright, neroli and orange blossom form a clean floral heart, and musk, aldehydes, cedar and amber give it a soft finish.
Crisp and cheerful, it is a great everyday scent.

name: Frederic Malle Portrait of a Lady Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Frédéric Malle Portrait of a Lady is a dramatic, spiced rose with incense and patchouli.
Dominique Ropion created it in 2010. Rose, raspberry, black currant, clove and cinnamon open rich and vivid, patchouli, incense and sandalwood deepen the heart, and musk, benzoin and amber leave a long, opulent trail.
A bold signature for fall and winter, beautiful for date nights and special evenings.

Frederic Malle is a true perfume connoisseur and creator of
the Editions de Parfums niche” fragrances without compromise"
collection. His line consists of 19 amazing perfumes so far, all
developed by, according to the Malle, the top ten noses of the world.
The collection expands in November with a new edition named Portrait of a Lady, signed by the famous perfumer Dominique Ropion. Dominique Ropion created the following collection of fragrances: Vetiver Extraordinaire, Carnal Flower, Geranium Pour Monsieur and Une Fleur de Cassie.
Portrait of a Lady is named after the novel by Henry James
from the 1881. The perfume deals with rose note and spices in a new,
modern way that varies between the oriental and chypre theme with
patchouli, natural and intense, dominating the heart of the composition.
Portrait of a Lady is a modern, elegant and unusual expression
of the Victorian novel, its heroine, Isabel Archer, her fate and the
quest for freedom. She smells of dark roses, mystical and intense.
The notes of this sensual modern classic include Turkish rose,
raspberry, black currant, cinnamon, clove, patchouli, sandalwood,
incense, ambroxan, benzoin and white musk.

name: Frederic Malle Promise Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Frederic Malle Promise is a deep, rich rose with apple, clove and patchouli.
Dominique Ropion created it in 2017. Apple, pink pepper and rosemary open bright, Turkish and Bulgarian rose and clove form a lush heart, and cypriol, patchouli, labdanum, castoreum and ambroxan give it a dark, earthy finish.
Bold and luxurious, it is made for fall and winter, day or night.

Promise by Frederic Malle is a Amber Floral fragrance for women and men. Promise was launched in 2017. The nose behind this fragrance is Dominique Ropion. Top notes are Apple, Pink Pepper and Rosemary; middle notes are Turkish Rose, Bulgarian Rose and Clove; base notes are Cypriol Oil or Nagarmotha, Patchouli, Labdanum, Castoreum and Ambroxan.

name: Frederic Malle Rose & Cuir Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Frédéric Malle Rose & Cuir is a spicy, green blend of rose and leather.
Jean-Claude Ellena created it in 2019. Geranium, black currant and Sichuan pepper open bright, leather and rose form a smooth heart, and vetiver and cedar give it a dry, woody finish.
Refined and distinctive, it is a great everyday scent.

name: Frederic Malle Rose Tonnerre Eau de Parfum Unisex

Frédéric Malle Rose Tonnerre is a dark, earthy rose with wine lees, honey and truffle.
Édouard Fléchier created it in 2021. Rose, wine lees and honey open rich, Turkish rose, geranium and truffle form a deep heart, and patchouli, castoreum, musk and vetiver give it an earthy, animalic finish.

name: Frederic Malle Superstitious Eau de Parfum for Women

Elegant and striking, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

name: Frederic Malle Synthetic Jungle Parfum Unisex
tags: UnisexFrederic Malle Synthetic Jungle Parfum Unisex

Frederic Malle Synthetic Jungle is a bold, green floral with galbanum and black currant.
Anne Flipo created it in 2021. Galbanum, basil and black currant open sharp and green, lily-of-the-valley, hyacinth, jasmine, ylang-ylang and almond form a lush heart, and oakmoss and patchouli give it an earthy finish.
