Synthetic Jungle by Frederic Malle is a Chypre fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Synthetic Jungle was launched in 2021. The nose behind this fragrance is Anne Flipo. Top notes are Galbanum, Basil and Black Currant; middle notes are Lily-of-the-Valley, Hyacinth, Jasmine, Ylang-Ylang and Almond; base notes are Oakmoss and Patchouli.

name: Frederic Malle Synthetic Nature Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Frédéric Malle Synthetic Nature is a fresh, green blend of basil, black currant and hyacinth.
Anne Flipo created it in 2024. Basil, black currant and lily-of-the-valley open crisp, hyacinth, jasmine and ylang-ylang form a floral heart, and patchouli gives it an earthy finish.
Fresh and lively, it is made for spring and summer days.

name: Frederic Malle The Moon Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Frédéric Malle The Moon is a fruity, leathery blend of raspberry, rose and oud.
Julien Rasquinet created it in 2019. Raspberry, litchi and saffron open juicy, violet, Turkish rose, olibanum and red berries form a rich heart, and oud, sandalwood, leather, patchouli and amber give it a deep finish.
Opulent and seductive, it is made for fall and winter nights.

name: Frederic Malle Uncut Gem Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Frédéric Malle Uncut Gem is a musky, aromatic blend of citrus, ginger and olibanum.
Maurice Roucel created it in 2022. Bergamot, nutmeg, mandarin, ginger and angelica open bright, olibanum, vetiver and leather form a woody heart, and musk and amber give it a warm finish.
Refined and versatile, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

name: Frederic Malle Une Fleur de Cassie Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Frederic Malle Une Fleur de Cassie is a soft, powdery floral built around mimosa and cassie.
Dominique Ropion created it in 2000. Mimosa, jasmine, cassis and rose meet sandalwood, vanilla, aldehydes and musk for a warm, sunny and slightly honeyed floral.
Graceful and distinctive, it is a lovely daytime scent in spring and fall.

Une Fleur de Cassie by Frederic Malle is a Floral fragrance for women. Une Fleur de Cassie was launched in 2000. The nose behind this fragrance is Dominique Ropion. The fragrance features mimosa, jasmine, rose, sandalwood, vanilla, cassis, musk and aldehydes.

name: Frederic Malle Une Rose Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Frederic Malle Une Rose is a deep, earthy rose with red wine, honey and truffle.
Édouard Fléchier created it in 2003. Rose, red wine, geranium and honey meet truffle, fruity notes, woods and musk for a rich, dark and natural-smelling rose.
Bold and romantic, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

Une Rose by Frederic Malle is a Floral fragrance for women. Une Rose was launched in 2003. The nose behind this fragrance is Edouard Flechier.

name: Frederic Malle Vetiver Extraordinaire Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Frédéric Malle Vetiver Extraordinaire is a crisp, refined vetiver.
Dominique Ropion created it in 2002. Bergamot and bitter orange open bright, vetiver, pink pepper and clove form a woody heart, and cedar, oakmoss, myrrh, sandalwood and musk give it a clean finish.
A polished daytime scent from spring through fall.

Vetiver Extraordinaire by Frederic Malle is a Amber Woody fragrance for men. Vetiver Extraordinaire
was launched in 2002. The nose behind this fragrance is Dominique
Ropion. Top notes are Bergamot and Bitter Orange; middle notes are
Vetiver, Pink Pepper and Cloves; base notes are Cedar, Oakmoss, Myrhh,
Sandalwood and Musk.

name: Giardini Di Toscana Almafolia Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Giardini di Toscana Almafolia is a creamy blend of tuberose, coconut and vanilla.
Silvia Martinelli created it in 2023. Tuberose, peach and sweet orange open bright, tuberose, ylang-ylang, jasmine, coconut, rosewood and white rose form a lush heart, and vanilla bean, white musk, amber and benzoin give it a warm finish.
Sweet and versatile, it works year-round, day or night.

name: Giardini Di Toscana Bianco Latte Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Giardini di Toscana Bianco Latte is a creamy, milky gourmand of caramel, honey and vanilla.
Silvia Martinelli created it as a soft, comforting blend. Caramel opens sweet, honey and coumarin form a warm heart, and white musk and vanilla leave a cozy, milky trail.
Made for fall and winter, day or night.

name: Giardini Di Toscana Bianco Oro Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Giardini di Toscana Bianco Oro is a musky, woody blend of pink pepper, rose and patchouli.
Silvia Martinelli created it. Bergamot and pink pepper open bright, black pepper and rose form a spicy heart, and Javanol, Cetalox and patchouli give it a smooth, musky finish.
Clean and sensual, it is made for fall and winter nights.

name: Giardini Di Toscana Blu Indaco Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Giardini di Toscana Blu Indaco is a sweet blend of frangipani, almond and vanilla.
Silvia Martinelli created it. Frangipani, bergamot and pink pepper open bright, vanilla and almond form a creamy heart, and musk and ambroxan give it a soft, radiant finish.
Sunny and easy, it is made for spring and summer days.

name: Giardini Di Toscana Blu Mare Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Giardini di Toscana Blu Mare is a fresh, marine blend of citrus, cypress and oakmoss.
Silvia Martinelli created it in 2024. Bergamot, grapefruit, lemon and pink pepper open bright, cypress and sea notes form a breezy heart, and oakmoss and ambergris give it a mossy finish.
Crisp and refreshing, it is made for spring and summer days.

name: Giardini Di Toscana Borabora Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Giardini di Toscana Borabora is a sweet, tropical blend of tiare flower, apricot and coconut milk.
Silvia Martinelli created it in 2023. Tiare flower, apricot, ylang-ylang and jasmine open sunny, white musk, jasmolactone and coconut milk form a creamy heart, and white musk, caramel, amber and vanilla give it a soft finish.
Relaxed and dreamy, it is made for spring and summer days.

name: Giardini Di Toscana Celeste Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Giardini di Toscana Celeste is a sweet, fruity blend of lime, raspberry and vanilla sugar.
Silvia Martinelli created it. Lime and sea water open fresh, violet, raspberry and exotic florals form a juicy heart, and vanilla sugar and ambroxan give it a sweet finish.
Playful and cozy, it works day or night in fall and winter.

name: Giardini Di Toscana Oro e Miele Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Giardini di Toscana Oro e Miele is a sweet blend of honey, coconut and vanilla.
Silvia Martinelli created it in 2026. Rose, heliotrope and almond blossom open soft, coconut, honey, vanilla and berries form a golden heart, and iris, white musk, tonka bean, sandalwood and benzoin give it a powdery finish.
Warm and indulgent, it is a great everyday and evening scent.

name: Giardini Di Toscana Rosso Rubino Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Giardini di Toscana Rosso Rubino is a fruity blend of citrus, wild berries and cacao.
Silvia Martinelli created it. Orange, lemon and bergamot open bright, wild berries, cacao pod and rose form a sweet heart, and coumarin, pink pepper, cashmeran, patchouli and oakmoss give it a woody finish.
Fun and juicy, it is a great everyday scent.

name: Giardini Di Toscana Shabby Chic Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Giardini di Toscana Shabby Chic is a soft, clean floral with peony and rose.
Silvia Martinelli created it. Peony opens fresh, Bulgarian rose and white flowers form a powdery heart, and cedar, Javanol and musk give it a clean, woody finish.
Light and versatile, it works year-round, day or night.

name: Giorgio Armani Acqua di Gio Absolu Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Armani Acqua di Giò Absolu is a deeper, woodier take on the fresh aquatic classic.
Alberto Morillas created it in 2018. Grapefruit, pear, sea notes, bergamot, lemon and apple open bright, geranium, lavender and rosemary form an aromatic heart, and woods, labdanum, amberwood, tonka bean and patchouli give it a warm finish.
Fresh yet grown-up, it is great for the office and everyday wear from spring through fall.

Acqua di Giò Absolu by Giorgio Armani is a Woody Aromatic fragrance for men's. Acqua di Giò Absolu was released in 2018. The Master Perfumer for this fragrance is Alberto Morillas. Top notes are Sea Notes, Bergamot, Pear, Grapefruit, Apple and Lemon. Middle Notess are Lavender, Rosemary and Geranium. Base Notes are Woody Notes, Tonka Bean, Patchouli, Amberwood and Labdanum.

name: Giorgio Armani Acqua di Gio Absolu Instinct Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Giorgio Armani Acqua di Giò Absolu Instinct is a marine, woody take on Acqua di Giò.
Alberto Morillas created it in 2019. Sea notes, lemon and bergamot open bright, seaweed and patchouli form an earthy heart, and ebony wood and amberwood give it a warm finish.
Fresh and polished, it is great for everyday wear and the office from spring through fall.

Acqua di Giò Absolu Instinct by Giorgio Armani is a Woody Aquatic fragrance for men's. This is a new fragrance. Acqua di Giò Absolu Instinct was released in 2019. The Master Perfumer for this fragrance is Alberto Morillas. Top notes are Sea Notes, Lemon and Bergamot. Middle Notess are Seaweed and Patchouli. Base Notes are Amberwood and Ebony Wood.

name: Giorgio Armani Acqua Di Gio Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Giorgio Armani Acqua di Giò Eau de Parfum is a fresh, mineral blend of sea notes, sage and vetiver.
Launched in 2022, it opens with sea notes and green mandarin. Clary sage, geranium and lavender form an aromatic heart, and mineral notes, vetiver and patchouli give it a clean finish.
Crisp and easy, it is made for spring and summer days.

Acqua di Giò Eau de Parfum by Giorgio Armani is a Aromatic Aquatic fragrance for men. This is a new fragrance. Acqua di Giò Eau de Parfum was launched in 2022. Top notes are Sea Notes and Green Mandarin; middle notes are Clary Sage, Geranium and Lavender; base notes are Mineral notes, Vetiver and Patchouli.

name: Giorgio Armani Acqua di Gio Eau de Parfum Intense for Men

notes.source_text:
Giorgio Armani Acqua di Giò Eau de Parfum Intense is a fresh, fruity aquatic.
Launched in 2026, it opens with green apple and Calabrian bergamot. Clary sage and marine notes form the heart, and woods and amber give it a warm finish.
Versatile for spring and summer, day or night.

name: Giorgio Armani Acqua di Gio Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
Armani Acqua di Giò Eau de Toilette is the fresh, watery floral that defined a whole style of men's scent.
Edouard Fléchier created it in 1995. Peony, pineapple, lemon, peach and violet open bright, lily-of-the-valley, hyacinth, jasmine, freesia and calone bring a cool, aquatic heart, and musk, cedar, sandalwood, styrax and amber give it a clean finish.
Light and easy, it is made for spring and summer days.

Acqua di Gio by Giorgio Armani is a Floral Fruity fragrance for women's. Acqua di Gio was released in 1995. The Master Perfumer for this fragrance is Edouard Fléchier. Top notes are Peony, Musk Vodka, Pineapple, Lemon, Peach, Banana Leaf and Violet. Middle Notess are Lily-of-the-Valley, Lily, Hiacynth, Jasmine, Freesia, Ylang-Ylang, Calone and Rose. Base Notes are Musk, Cedar, Sandalwood, Amber and Styrax.

name: Giorgio Armani Acqua di Gio Elixir Masculine

notes.source_text:
Giorgio Armani Acqua di Giò Elixir is a richer, leathery take on Acqua di Giò.
Alberto Morillas created it in 2025. Bergamot, green mandarin and nutmeg open bright, violet leaf and water notes form a fresh heart, and leather, patchouli, vetiver and labdanum give it a warm finish.
Smooth and versatile, it works day or night from spring through fall.

name: Giorgio Armani Acqua Di Gio Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Giorgio Armani Acqua di Giò Parfum is a deep, aromatic marine with incense.
Alberto Morillas created it in 2023. Marine notes and bergamot open fresh, rosemary, geranium and clary sage form an aromatic heart, and olibanum and patchouli give it a warm finish.
Fresh yet refined, it works for days and evenings alike.

name: Giorgio Armani Acqua di Gio Profondo Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Giorgio Armani Acqua di Giò Profondo Eau de Parfum is a deep, aromatic marine fragrance.
Alberto Morillas created it in 2020. Sea notes, Aquozone, bergamot and green mandarin open fresh and salty, rosemary, cypress, lavender and mastic add an aromatic heart, and mineral notes, musk, patchouli and amber give it depth.
Cool and confident, it is made for spring and summer days.

Acqua di Giò Profondo by Giorgio Armani is a Aromatic Fougere fragrance for men's. This is a new fragrance. Acqua di Giò Profondo was released in 2020. The Master Perfumer for this fragrance is Alberto Morillas. Top notes are Sea Notes, Aquozone, Bergamot and Green Mandarin. Middle Notess are Rosemary, Cypress, Lavender and Mastic or Lentisque. Base Notes are Mineral notes, Musk, Patchouli and Amber.

name: Giorgio Armani Acqua di Gio Profondo Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
Armani Acqua di Giò Profondo Eau de Toilette is a fresh, mineral aquatic with citrus and cypress.
Alberto Morillas created it in 2025. Lemon, grapefruit and spices open bright, calone, lavender and cypress form a cool, aromatic heart, and mineral notes, woods and patchouli give it a clean finish.
Breezy and easy, it is made for spring and summer days.

name: Giorgio Armani Acqua di Gio Profondo Lights Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Armani Acqua di Giò Profondo Lights is a light, aromatic marine with a fresh, woody base.
Alberto Morillas created it in 2021. Cardamom, green mandarin and sea notes open cool and bright, cypress, fir balsam, rosemary, lavender and mastic form an aromatic heart, and patchouli, vetiver and cedar give it a clean finish.
Breezy and easy, it is made for spring and summer days.

Acqua di Giò Profondo Lights by Giorgio Armani is a Aromatic Aquatic fragrance for men's. This is a new fragrance. Acqua di Giò Profondo Lights was released in 2021. Acqua di Giò Profondo Lights was created by Alberto Morillas and Firmenich. Top notes are Sea Notes, Green Mandarin and Cardamom. Middle Notess are Rosemary, Mastic or Lentisque, Balsam Fir, Cypress and Lavender Extract. Base Notes are Vetiver, Cedar and Patchouli.

name: Giorgio Armani Acqua di Gio Profondo Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Giorgio Armani Acqua di Giò Profondo Parfum is a deep, salty marine with mimosa.
Launched in 2024, it opens with green mandarin and marine notes. Mimosa forms a soft heart, and patchouli and labdanum give it a warm finish.
A daytime favorite for spring and summer.

name: Giorgio Armani Acqua di Gio Profumo Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Giorgio Armani Acqua di Giò Profumo is a deeper, incense-tinged take on Acqua di Giò.
Alberto Morillas created it in 2015. Sea notes and bergamot open fresh, sage, geranium and rosemary form an aromatic heart, and incense and patchouli give it a smoky, mineral finish.
Versatile from spring through fall, for everyday wear and date nights.

name: Giorgio Armani Acqua di Gio Profumo Special Blend Eau de Parfum for Men
tags: Acqua di Gio Profumo Special Blend

notes.source_text:
Giorgio Armani Acqua di Giò Profumo Special Blend is an aromatic blend of sea notes, rosemary and incense.
Alberto Morillas created it in 2017. Sea notes and bergamot open fresh, rosemary, sage and geranium form an herbal heart, and patchouli and incense give it a smoky finish.
Deep and polished, it is perfect for date nights from spring through fall.

Acqua di Gio Profumo Special Blend by Giorgio Armani is a Aromatic Aquatic fragrance for men's. Acqua di Gio Profumo Special Blend was released in 2017. Top notes are Sea Notes and Bergamot. Middle Notess are Rosemary, Sage and Geranium. Base Notes are Patchouli and Incense.

name: Giorgio Armani Acqua di Gioa Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Giorgio Armani Acqua di Gioia is a fresh, green blend of lemon, mint and jasmine.
Anne Flipo, Dominique Ropion and Loc Dong created it in 2010. Amalfi lemon and mint open bright, jasmine, peony and pink pepper form the heart, and cedar, labdanum and brown sugar give it a warm finish.
A summer favorite for daytime.

Acqua di Gioia by Giorgio Armani is a Floral Aquatic fragrance for women's. Acqua di Gioia was released in 2010. Acqua di Gioia was created by Loc Dong, Anne Flipo and Dominique Ropion. Top notes are Amalfi Lemon and Mint. Middle Notess are Jasmine, Peony and Pink Pepper. Base Notes are Virginia Cedar, French labdanum and Brown sugar.

name: Giorgio Armani Acqua di Gioia Intense Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Armani Acqua di Gioia Intense is a fruity floral with red fruits, jasmine and rose.
Launched in 2024, it opens with red fruits and citrus. Jasmine and Damask rose form a soft floral heart, and musk and woods give it a smooth finish.
Fresh yet warm, it is a lovely evening scent from spring through fall.

name: Giorgio Armani ARMANI Code Absolu Femme for Women

notes.source_text:
Armani Code Absolu Femme is a creamy white floral with tuberose, orange blossom and vanilla.
Launched in 2019, it opens with neroli, ginger and mandarin. Tuberose, orange blossom and jasmine form a lush heart, and vanilla, tonka bean and sandalwood give it a warm finish.
Elegant and sensual, it is a great choice for evenings.

name: Giorgio Armani ARMANI Code Absolu Gold Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Armani Code Absolu Gold is a warm, ambery take on Code with iris and saffron.
Antoine Maisondieu created it in 2020. Mandarin and green apple open bright, iris and saffron form a refined heart, and tonka bean, benzoin, guaiac wood and cedar give it a rich finish.
Smooth and luxurious, it is made for fall and winter nights.

Armani Code Absolu Gold by Giorgio Armani is a Amber Spicy fragrance for men's. This is a new fragrance. Armani Code Absolu Gold was released in 2020. The Master Perfumer for this fragrance is Antoine Maisondieu. Top notes are Mandarin Orange and Green Apple. Middle Notess are iris and Saffron. Base Notes are Tonka Bean, Benzoin, Guaiac Wood and Cedar.

name: Giorgio Armani Armani Code Absolu Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Armani Code Absolu Parfum is a smooth, sweet and woody take on the classic Code.
Antoine Maisondieu created it in 2019. Green mandarin and apple open bright, nutmeg, orange blossom and carrot seed form a warm heart, and tonka bean, suede, vanilla and woods give it a soft, rich finish.
Made for fall and winter, it works for date nights, evenings out and everyday wear.

Armani Code Absolu by Giorgio Armani is a Amber Spicy fragrance for men's. This is a new fragrance. Armani Code Absolu was released in 2019. The Master Perfumer for this fragrance is Antoine Maisondieu. Top notes are Green Mandarin and Apple. Middle Notess are Nutmeg, Orange Blossom and Carrot Seeds. Base Notes are Vanilla, Tonka Bean, Suede and Woody Notes.

name: Giorgio Armani Armani Code Colonia Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
Armani Code Colonia is a fresh, citrusy take on Code with a soft, sweet base.
Antoine Maisondieu created it in 2017. Mandarin, bergamot and pink pepper open bright, orange blossom and clary sage form a clean heart, and amberwood, tonka bean and heliotrope give it a warm finish.
Versatile and light, it works for the office, the gym, everyday wear and date nights in spring and summer.

Armani Code Colonia by Giorgio Armani is a Aromatic Fougere fragrance for men's. Armani Code Colonia was released in 2017. The Master Perfumer for this fragrance is Antoine Maisondieu. Top notes are Bergamot, Mandarin Orange and Pink Pepper. Middle Notess are Orange Blossom, Clary Sage and Amyl Salicylate. Base Notes are Tonka Bean, Amberwood and Heliotrope.

name: Giorgio Armani ARMANI Code Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Armani Code Eau de Parfum is a smooth blend of lavender, tonka bean and vanilla.
Launched in 2021, it opens with lavender, lemon and bergamot. Tonka bean forms a sweet, creamy heart, and vanilla, cedar, musk and suede give it a soft, powdery finish.
Elegant and warm, it is made for evenings in spring, fall and winter.

Armani Code Eau de Parfum by Giorgio Armani is a Amber Fougere fragrance for men's. This is a new fragrance. Armani Code Eau de Parfum was released in 2021. The Master Perfumer for this fragrance is Antoine Maisondieu. Top notes are Lavender, Lemon and Bergamot. Middle Notes is Tonka Bean. Base Notes are Vanilla, Suede, Musk and Cedar.

name: Giorgio Armani ARMANI Code Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Giorgio Armani Code for Women is a smooth blend of lavender, tonka and suede.
Antoine Maisondieu created it in 2021. Bergamot, lemon and lavender open fresh, tonka bean forms a sweet heart, and cedar, musk, vanilla and suede give it a soft, leathery finish.
Elegant and cozy, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

name: Giorgio Armani ARMANI Code Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
Armani Code Eau de Toilette is a smooth blend of green mandarin, lavender and tonka bean.
Antoine Lie created this 2023 version. Green mandarin opens fresh, lavender forms an aromatic heart, and cedar and tonka bean give it a warm finish.
Polished and versatile, it suits date nights and everyday wear in fall and winter.

Armani Code by Giorgio Armani is a Amber Spicy fragrance for men's. Armani Code was released in 2004. The Master Perfumer for this fragrance is Antoine Lie. Top notes are Lemon and Bergamot. Middle Notess are Star Anise, Olive Blossom and Guaiac Wood. Base Notes are Leather, Tonka Bean and Tobacco. This perfume is the winner of award FiFi Award Fragrance Of The Year Men`s Luxe 2006.

name: Giorgio Armani Armani Code Ice Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
Giorgio Armani Code Ice is a cool, aromatic blend of mint, lemon and ginger.
Launched in 2014, it opens with mint, lemon and ginger. Geranium and lavender form an aromatic heart, and woods give it a clean finish.
Fresh and easy, it is great for everyday wear, the office and the gym from spring through fall.

Armani Code Ice by Giorgio Armani is a Aromatic fragrance for men's. Armani Code Ice was released in 2014. Top notes are Mint, Ginger and Lemon. Middle Notess are Lavender and Geranium. Base Note is Woody Notes.

name: Giorgio Armani ARMANI Code Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Giorgio Armani Code Parfum is a refined iris and tonka fragrance with a fresh bergamot opening.
Antoine Maisondieu created it in 2022. Bergamot leaf and bergamot open bright, iris, orris, clary sage and aldehydes form a smooth, powdery heart, and tonka bean and cedar give it a warm finish.
Elegant and versatile, it works in every season, day or night.

name: Giorgio Armani Armani Code Profumo Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Armani Code Profumo is a warm, ambery take on Code with a fresh, fruity start.
Antoine Maisondieu created it in 2016. Cardamom, green apple and green mandarin open bright, nutmeg, orange blossom and lavender form an aromatic heart, and amber, tonka bean and leather give it a smooth, sensual finish.
Made for fall and winter nights and date nights.

Armani Code Profumo by Giorgio Armani is a Amber Spicy fragrance for men's. Armani Code Profumo was released in 2016. The Master Perfumer for this fragrance is Antoine Maisondieu. Top notes are Cardamom, Green Apple and Green Mandarin. Middle Notess are Nutmeg, Lavender and Orange Blossom. Base Notes are Tonka Bean, Amber and Leather.

name: Giorgio Armani Bois d'Encens Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Giorgio Armani Bois d'Encens is a dry, smoky blend of incense, cedar and vetiver.
Michel Almairac created it in 2004. Cedar, vetiver, labdanum and spices come together in a calm, musky and smoky woody scent with a warm, ambery depth.
Refined and meditative, it works day or night in fall and winter.

name: Giorgio Armani Code A-List Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
Armani Code A-List is a fresh blend of green mandarin, lavender and tonka bean.
Launched in 2018, it opens with green mandarin and bergamot. Lavender forms an aromatic heart, and tonka bean and guaiac wood give it a smooth, woody finish.
Easy and charming, it is great for date nights in spring, fall and winter.

Armani Code A-List by Giorgio Armani is a Amber Woody fragrance for men's. Armani Code A-List was released in 2018. Top notes are Green Mandarin and Bergamot. Middle Notes is Lavender. Base Notes are Tonka Bean and Guaiac Wood.

name: Giorgio Armani Code Elixir for Men

notes.source_text:
Armani Code Elixir is a rich, sweet blend of green mandarin, leather and liquor.
Launched in 2025, it opens with green mandarin. Leather and liquor form a warm, boozy heart, and tonka bean gives it a creamy, sweet finish.
Bold and seductive, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

name: Giorgio Armani Cuir Amethyste Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Giorgio Armani Cuir Améthyste is a soft leather with violet, birch and vanilla.
Michel Almairac created it in 2005. Bergamot, rose and coriander open bright, violet, birch and patchouli form a smoky heart, and labdanum, benzoin and Bourbon vanilla give it a warm finish.
Elegant and warm, it works day or night in fall and winter.

name: Giorgio Armani Cuir Noir Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Giorgio Armani Cuir Noir is a rich, warm leather with oud, nutmeg and vanilla.
Nathalie Lorson created it in 2011. Leather, guaiac wood, sandalwood, oud, nutmeg, rose, coriander, vanilla, ambergris and benzoin come together in a smooth, spicy and ambery scent.
Refined and sensual, it works day or night in fall and winter.

name: Giorgio Armani Eau d'Aromes Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
Giorgio Armani Eau d'Arômes is a fresh, aromatic blend of citrus, ginger and vetiver.
Launched in 2014, it opens with mandarin and bergamot. Ginger and patchouli form a warm heart, and vetiver, sage and cardamom give it an earthy, aromatic finish.
Clean and easy, it is a great daytime scent from spring through fall.

Armani Eau d’Aromes by Giorgio Armani is a Woody Spicy fragrance for men's. Armani Eau d’Aromes was released in 2014. Top notes are Mandarin Orange and Bergamot. Middle Notess are Ginger and Patchouli. Base Notes are Vetiver, Sage and Cardamom.

name: Giorgio Armani Eau de Cedre Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
Giorgio Armani Eau de Cèdre is a woody, leathery blend of cedar, violet leaf and black tea.
Launched in 2015, it opens with bergamot, lemon and sage. Cardamom, cumin and violet leaf form a spicy heart, and woods, cedar, suede and black tea give it a smooth finish.
Refined and versatile, it works year-round, day or night.

name: Giorgio Armani Eau de Nuit Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
Giorgio Armani Eau de Nuit is a powdery blend of iris, cardamom and tonka.
Marie Salamagne created it in 2013. Pink pepper and bergamot open bright, iris, cardamom, nutmeg and heliotrope form a soft heart, and tonka bean, amber and cedar give it a warm finish.
Smooth and elegant, it is made for fall and winter nights.

Armani Eau de Nuit by Giorgio Armani is a Amber Fougere fragrance for men's. Armani Eau de Nuit was released in 2013. The Master Perfumer for this fragrance is Marie Salamagne. Top notes are Pink Pepper and Bergamot. Middle Notess are iris, Cardamom, Nutmeg and Heliotrope. Base Notes are Tonka Bean, Cedar and Amber.

name: Giorgio Armani Eau Pour Homme Eau de Toilette

notes.source_text:
Armani Eau pour Homme is a classic citrus cologne with herbs, spice and woods.
Roger Pellegrino created it in 1984. Basil, mandarin, bergamot, green orange and lemon open bright, lavender, rose, nutmeg, carnation, jasmine and cinnamon form the heart, and sandalwood, vetiver, cedar, patchouli, musk and oakmoss give it a clean finish.
Timeless and fresh, it is made for spring and summer days.

Armani Eau Pour Homme by Giorgio Armani is a Citrus Aromatic fragrance for men's. Armani Eau Pour Homme was released in 1984. The Master Perfumer for this fragrance is Roger Pellegrino. Top notes are Lemon, Bergamot, Mandarin Orange, Green Orange and Basil. Middle Notess are Nutmeg, Lavender, Carnation, Jasmine, Lily, Rose and Cinnamon. Base Notes are Oakmoss, Vetiver, Sandalwood, Cedar, Musk and Patchouli.

name: Giorgio Armani I Will Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:

Alberto Morillas and Nathalie Lorson created it in 2026. Bergamot and cardamom open fresh and spicy, lavender, sage and violet leaf form an aromatic heart, and woods, vanilla, leather and patchouli give it a smooth, confident finish.

name: Giorgio Armani My Way Intense Eau de Parfum for Women

Refined and gentle, it is a lovely everyday scent.

name: Giorgio Armani Ocean di Gioia Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Armani Ocean di Gioia is a fresh, salty floral with pear and water jasmine.
Sonia Constant and Marypierre Julien created it in 2020. Green notes, pear and citrus open bright, lily-of-the-valley, salt, rose and water jasmine form a breezy heart, and musk and sandalwood give it a soft finish.
Light and refreshing, it is made for spring and summer days.

name: Giorgio Armani Pivoine Suzhou Eau de Toilette for Women

notes.source_text:
Giorgio Armani Pivoine Suzhou is a fresh, fruity floral with raspberry, peony and rose.
Cécile Matton and Julie Massé created it in 2014. Raspberry, pink pepper and mandarin open juicy, peony, May rose and rose form a pretty heart, and musk, patchouli and amber give it a soft finish.
Light and romantic, it is a lovely everyday scent.

name: Giorgio Armani Power Of You Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Giorgio Armani Power of You is a sunny blend of passion fruit, frangipani and vanilla.
Nadège Le Garlantezec and Nisrine Bouazzaoui Grillié created it in 2026. Lemon, bitter orange and passion fruit open bright, frangipani and solar notes form the heart, and Madagascar vanilla, labdanum and benzoin give it a warm finish.
A cheerful daytime scent for spring and summer.

name: Giorgio Armani Prive Ambre Eccentrico Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Giorgio Armani Ambre Eccentrico is a warm, fruity amber with dried fruits and cinnamon.

Cozy and indulgent, it is made for fall and winter nights.

notes.source_text:

Launched in 2016, it opens with bergamot. Cinnamon, nutmeg and saffron form a warm heart, and vanilla and sandalwood give it a smooth, powdery finish.
Cozy and refined, it is perfect for date nights in fall and winter.

The gentleman at his absolute best. Givenchy introduces Gentlemen Only Absolute, the fragrance for the refined man of today. The Gentlemen Only Absolute man is the epitome of uncompromised class and style. This woody spicy oriental scent has notes of sophisticated bergamot, a warm trio of incandescent spices and is topped with sensual vanilla and sandalwood.
Givenchy introduces Gentlemen Only Absolute, the fragrance for the refined man of today. The Gentlemen Only Absolute man is the epitome of uncompromised class and style. This woody, spicy oriental scent has notes of sophisticated bergamot and a warm trio of incandescent spices topped with sensual vanilla and sandalwood.
Notes:
Bergamot, Warm Spices, Sandalwood, Vanilla.
Style:
Refined. Timeless. Sophisticated.

name: Givenchy Gentlemen Only Casual Chic Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
Givenchy Gentlemen Only Casual Chic is an aromatic blend of ginger, birch and lavender.
Jean Jacques created it in 2015. Ginger, juniper, cardamom, nutmeg and geranium open spicy, birch, cedar, lavender and mint form a fresh heart, and ambroxan, sandalwood, vetiver, coumarin and vanilla give it a smooth finish.
Relaxed and polished, it is made for spring and summer days.

Gentlemen Only Casual Chic by Givenchy is a Woody Spicy fragrance for men. Gentlemen Only Casual Chic
was launched in 2015. The nose behind this fragrance is Jean Jacques.
Top notes are Ginger, Juniper, Cardamom, Nutmeg and Geranium; middle
notes are Birch, Cedar, Lavender and Mint; base notes are Ambroxan,
Sandalwood, Cedar, Vetiver, Coumarin and Vanilla.

name: Givenchy Gentlemen Only Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
Givenchy Gentlemen Only is a fresh, smoky blend of citrus, vetiver and incense.
Jean Jacques created it in 2013. Pink pepper, green mandarin, birch leaf, nutmeg and bergamot open crisp, vetiver, cedar, patchouli, violet leaf and elemi form a woody heart, and incense and musk give it a clean finish.
Easy and polished, it is a great everyday scent from spring through fall.

Givenchy introduces Gentlemen Only for the distinguished man of today.
His natural, refined elegance is a reflection of the times.
This fragrance embodies the essential virtues of being a
gentleman: courtesy, elegance, and chivalry. It is modern yet timeless,
capturing the essence of a man who is witty, intelligent, and exceeds
effortlessly in all aspects of life. A state of mind, a way of being a
gentleman under all circumstances.
Gentlemen Only is a distinct, deliberate, and charming
fragrance. It is deliciously disconcerting with its blend of freshness,
sensuality, and masculine qualities. A fragrance for a man of taste—a
fragrance for a gentleman.
Notes:
Green Mandarin, Pink Pepper, Nutmeg, Birch Leaf, Cedarwood Texas, Heart Of Patchouli, Vetiver, Incense.
Style:
Distinct. Deliberate. Charming.

name: Givenchy Gentlemen Only Fraiche Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
Givenchy Gentlemen Only Fraîche is a cool, green blend of citrus, mint and sage.
Launched in 2017, it opens with citrus and lemon. Mint and sage form a fresh, aromatic heart, and ambroxan and vetiver give it a clean finish.
Crisp and easy, it is made for spring and summer days.

Gentlemen Only Fraîche by Givenchy is a Citrus Aromatic fragrance for men. Gentlemen Only Fraîche was launched in 2017. Top notes are Citruses and Lemon; middle notes are Mint and Sage; base notes are Ambroxan and Vetiver.

name: Givenchy Gentlemen Only Intense Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
Givenchy Gentlemen Only Intense is a smoky, leathery blend of pepper, patchouli and incense.
Jean Jacques created it in 2014. Green mandarin, pink pepper, mint, lemon, birch leaf and black pepper open bright, patchouli, leather, violet leaf, coriander and cedar form a dark heart, and vanilla, sandalwood, vetiver, tonka bean, amber and incense give it a warm finish.
Bold and refined, it is made for fall and winter nights.

Gentlemen Only Intense by Givenchy is a Amber Woody fragrance for men. Gentlemen Only Intense
was launched in 2014. The nose behind this fragrance is Jean Jacques.
Top notes are Birch Leaf, Black Pepper, Green Mandarin, Mint, Pink
Pepper and Lemon; middle notes are Leather, Patchouli, Texas Cedar,
Violet Leaf and Coriander; base notes are Tonka Bean, Incense, Amber,
Sandalwood, Vanila and Vetiver.

name: Givenchy Gentlemen Society Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Givenchy Gentlemen Society is an aromatic blend of narcissus, vetiver and vanilla.
Karine Dubreuil-Sereni and Maïa Lernout created it in 2023. Cardamom and sage open fresh, French narcissus and Haitian and Madagascar vetiver form the heart, and vanilla, cedar and palo santo give it a warm finish.
Refined and versatile, it suits the office and evenings alike.

name: Givenchy Insense Ultramarine Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
Givenchy Insensé Ultramarine is a fresh, fruity blend of watermelon, mint and tobacco.
Christian Mathieu created it in 1994. Watermelon, galbanum, black currant and bergamot open juicy, mint, cardamom, iris, sage and magnolia form an aromatic heart, and cedar, tobacco and vetiver give it a woody finish.
Lively and cool, it is made for spring and summer days.

name: Givenchy Irrésistible Eau de Toilette Fraiche for Women

notes.source_text:
Givenchy Irrésistible Fraîche is a light, sweet blend of orange, iris and rose.
Launched in 2021, it opens with orange and pink pepper. Iris and rose form a soft floral heart, and cedar and musk give it a clean finish.
Fresh and pretty, it is made for spring and summer days.

name: Givenchy Irresistible Rose Velvet Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Givenchy Irrésistible Rose Velvet is a soft, powdery rose with black currant and iris.
Anne Flipo, Dominique Ropion and Fanny Bal created it in 2022. Black currant opens juicy, iris, rose and rose water form a velvety heart, and woods and patchouli give it an earthy finish.
Romantic and gentle, it is made for spring and summer days.

name: Givenchy L'Interdit Absolu Eau de Parfum Intense for Women

notes.source_text:
Givenchy L'Interdit Absolu is a dark, rich floral with tuberose, tobacco and rum.
Launched in 2024, it opens with neroli, lavender and Guatemalan cardamom. Indian tuberose, jasmine sambac and orange blossom form a lush heart, and tobacco, rum, Haitian vetiver and patchouli give it a deep finish.
Seductive and intense, it is made for evenings.

name: Givenchy L'Interdit Angélique Rouge Eau de Parfum For Women

notes.source_text:
Givenchy L'Interdit Angélique Rouge is a bright, fruity floral with angelica and prickly pear.
Launched in 2025, it opens with ginger, angelica and prickly pear. Angelica and white flowers form a fresh heart, and Haitian vetiver and patchouli give it a woody finish.
Modern and versatile, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

name: Givenchy L'Interdit Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Givenchy L'Interdit is a white floral with pear, tuberose and a dark, earthy base.
Anne Flipo, Dominique Ropion and Fanny Bal created it in 2018. Bergamot and pear open bright, jasmine sambac, orange blossom and tuberose form a lush heart, and ambroxan, vanilla, vetiver and patchouli give it a warm finish.
Elegant and daring, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

name: Givenchy L'Interdit Elixir Parfum Concentre for Women

notes.source_text:
Givenchy L'Interdit Elixir is a dark, sweet blend of black cherry, tuberose and rum.
Anne Flipo, Dominique Ropion and Meabh McCurtin created it in 2026. Bitter almond and black cherry open rich, jasmine sambac, oak, orange blossom and tuberose form a lush heart, and rum, davana, vanilla, vetiver and patchouli give it a deep finish.
Seductive and intense, it is made for fall and winter nights.

name: Givenchy L’Interdit Le Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Givenchy L'Interdit Le Parfum is a fruity, resinous blend of pear, tuberose and myrrh.
Launched in 2025, it opens with pear, bitter almond and apple. Tuberose, jasmine and mimosa form a floral heart, and benzoin, myrrh, patchouli, opoponax and vetiver give it a warm finish.
Elegant and rich, it works day or night in fall and winter.

name: Givenchy L'Interdit Rouge Ultime Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Givenchy L'Interdit Rouge Ultime is a bold blend of tuberose, cacao and tobacco.
Anne Flipo, Dominique Ropion and Fanny Bal created it in 2023. Jasmine sambac, orange blossom and neroli open bright, tuberose and cacao pod form the heart, and vetiver, patchouli, ambroxan and tobacco give it a dark finish.
Made for fall and winter nights.

name: Givenchy Pi Air Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
Givenchy Pi Air is a light, fresh take on Pi with neroli, ginger and lavender.
Launched in 2017, it opens with neroli and ginger. Florals, lavender and rosemary form an aromatic heart, and cedar, musk and benzoin give it a soft, warm finish.
Easy and fresh, it is great for the office, the gym and everyday wear from spring through fall.

Fragrance Family:
Earthy & Woody
Scent Type:
Citrus & Woods
Key Notes:
Ginger, Paradisone, Cedarwood
About:
The scent of a voyage deep into the clouds. Dive into infinite freshness: a cool blast embraced by magnetic masculinity. The aerial fragrance comes enclosed in an elegant frosted bottle.

name: Givenchy Pi Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
Givenchy Pi is a warm, sweet blend of vanilla, almond and aromatic herbs.
Alberto Morillas created it in 1998. Mandarin, tarragon, rosemary and basil open fresh and herbal, anise, neroli, geranium and lily-of-the-valley form a soft heart, and vanilla, almond, tonka bean, benzoin and cedar give it a cozy finish.
Comforting and smooth, it is a classic choice for fall and winter evenings.

Pi
is a celebration of what makes a man seductive - his intelligence,
courage, and contributions. Pi is more than a name, it's a symbol. The
masculine bottle, designed by Serge Manseau, has a hi-tech closure
system and plays on the contrast between pure lines and perfect
proportion.
Notes:
Mandarin, Pine Needles, Rosemary, Guaiac Wood, Benzoin.
Style:
Adventurous. Sensational. Masculine fragrance.

name: Givenchy Pi Neo Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
Givenchy Pi Neo is a light, fresh citrus with cedar, myrtle and patchouli.
Françoise Donche created it in 2008. Mandarin and bergamot open bright, cedar and myrtle form a clean, aromatic heart, and patchouli gives it a gentle, earthy finish.
Fresh and dependable, it is great for the office, the gym and everyday wear in spring and summer.

Beyond reality. Pi Neo is a fragrance devoted to men who dream of
exploring alternate dimensions - the cyber travelers and heroes of
tomorrow. Neo is a fresh, edgy blend of hi-tech notes centered around
Cedar Wood to reveal sensual and aromatic qualities that are both unique
and inspiring. The updated Pi bottle is futurist and masculine, in the
image of the original, emblematic Pi pyramid.
Top Note: Toscanol
Heart Note: Cedar Wood
Base Notes: Patchouli, Vanillin extracted from Benzoin Siam

name: Givenchy Play Intense Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Givenchy Play Intense for Her is a warm, sweet blend of peach, orchid and tonka.
Lucas Sieuzac and Émilie Bevierre-Coppermann created it in 2010. Orange blossom, pink pepper and peach open bright, amyris, orchid, magnolia and tiare form a soft heart, and benzoin, tonka bean, sandalwood and patchouli give it a warm finish.
Cozy and feminine, it works day or night in fall and winter.

name: Givenchy Play Intense Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
Givenchy Play Intense is a warm, smooth blend of coffee, pink pepper and woods.
Emilie Coppermann and Lucas Sieuzac created it in 2008. Mandarin and bergamot open bright, amyris, coffee and pink pepper form a rich heart, and labdanum, tonka bean, vetiver and patchouli give it a warm finish.
Smooth and sensual, it is great for date nights and evenings in fall and winter.

This fragrant creation Givenchy Play Intense is a work of perfumers Emilie Coppermann and Lucas Sieuzac (Symrise), under direction of Françoise Donche, the perfume nose of the house of Givenchy.
The perfume contains notes of bergamot,
mandarine, pink pepper, coffee flower, amyris wood, labdanum, vetiver,
Tonka and patchouli.

name: Givenchy Play Sport Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
Givenchy Play Sport is a fresh, sporty blend of lemon, ginger flower and mint.
Launched in 2012, it opens with lemon, bergamot, ginger flower and mint. Amyris and pepper form a spicy heart, and musk gives it a clean finish.
Energetic and easy, it is made for spring and summer days.

Play Sport by Givenchy is a Citrus Aromatic fragrance for men. Play Sport
was launched in 2012. Top notes are Lemon, Bergamot, Ginger flower and
Mint; middle notes are Amyris and Pepper; base note is Musk.

name: Goldfield & Banks Australia Mystic Bliss Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Goldfield & Banks Mystic Bliss is a fruity, aromatic blend of fig, mint and kunzea.
Florian Gallo created it in 2024. Fig, mint and cassis open fresh, Australian kunzea forms an herbal heart, and orris, incense and cedar give it a soft, woody finish.
Calm and distinctive, it is a great everyday scent.

name: Goldfield & Banks Australia Tales of Amber Extrait de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Goldfield & Banks Tales of Amber is a warm, musky blend of labdanum, oud and ambergris.
Suzy Le Helley created it in 2025. Orange blossom and moss open soft, cinnamon, labdanum, musk and orris form a warm heart, and oud, labdanum, ambergris and vanilla give it a rich finish.
Smooth and enveloping, it works day or night in fall and winter.

name: Goldfield & Banks Blue Cypres Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Goldfield & Banks Blue Cypress is an aromatic blend of cypress, star anise and lavender.
François Merle-Baudoin created it in 2016. Cypress, star anise, lavender, patchouli leaf and clove come together in a fresh, woody and gently spicy scent.
Calm and refined, it is a great everyday scent.

name: Goldfield & Banks Bohemian Lime Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Goldfield & Banks Bohemian Lime is a zesty, woody citrus.
Launched in 2020, it blends finger lime, bergamot and coriander with Haitian vetiver, Australian sandalwood and Moroccan cedar for a fresh, earthy scent.
Refreshing for warm days.

name: Goldfield & Banks Desert Rosewood Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Goldfield & Banks Desert Rosewood is a warm, balsamic blend of rosewood, cardamom and vanilla.
François Merle-Baudoin created it in 2016. Rosewood, benzoin, patchouli, cardamom, vanilla and Sicilian mandarin come together in a smooth, spicy and ambery scent.
Cozy and elegant, it works day or night in fall and winter.

name: Goldfield & Banks Ingenious Ginger Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Goldfield & Banks Ingenious Ginger is a bright, sunny blend of ginger, citrus and creamy woods.
Hamid Merati-Kashani created it in 2023. Bergamot, lemon and ginger flower open zesty, mandarin, magnolia, rose and jasmine form a soft floral heart, and vanilla, sandalwood, cashmeran, patchouli, musk and amber give it warmth.
Uplifting and easy to wear, it works in every season.

name: Goldfield & Banks Island Lush Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Goldfield & Banks Island Lush is a spicy, woody blend of nutmeg, iris and sandalwood.
Amélie Jacquin created it in 2023. Nutmeg, ginger, pink pepper and bergamot open warm, guaiac wood, iris, cedar and geranium form a powdery heart, and sandalwood, leather, vetiver, benzoin and patchouli give it a rich finish.
Refined and warm, it is a great everyday scent.

name: Goldfield & Banks Pacific Rock Flower Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Goldfield & Banks Pacific Rock Flower is a fresh, coastal blend of lemon, sea salt and mimosa.
Launched in 2025, it opens with lemon, eucalyptus, sea salt and tea. Mimosa, peony and tuberose form a sunny floral heart, and moss, sandalwood, cedar and patchouli give it a woody finish.
Breezy and bright, it is made for spring and summer days.

name: Goldfield & Banks Pacific Rock Moss Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Goldfield & Banks Pacific Rock Moss is a fresh, coastal blend of lemon, sage and moss.
Francois Merle-Baudoin created it in 2016. Italian lemon, sage, moss, geranium and Virginia cedar blend into a clean, herbal and slightly salty scent.
Refreshing for warm days and everyday wear.

name: Goldfield & Banks Purple Suede Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Goldfield & Banks Purple Suede is a bold leather with lavender, hyssop and oud.
Ilias Ermenidis created it in 2022. Leather, lavender and pink pepper open aromatic, leatherwood, hyssop and coriander form the heart, and oud, cashmeran, civet, patchouli, amber and oakmoss give it an animalic finish.
Daring and distinctive, it is a strong choice for evenings.

name: Goldfield & Banks Silky Woods Elixir Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Goldfield & Banks Silky Woods Elixir is a sweet, woody blend of rose, saffron and balsams.
Olivier Cresp created it in 2023. Rose, musk, vanilla, saffron, orris root, fig, guaiac wood, oud, tolu and Peru balsam and ambroxan come together in a smooth, warm and creamy woody scent.
Rich and sensual, it is made for fall and winter nights.

name: Goldfield & Banks Silky Woods Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Goldfield & Banks Silky Woods is a smooth blend of suede, oud and vanilla.
Launched in 2021, it opens with Ceylon cinnamon and saffron. Suede, oud, ylang-ylang and jasmine form the heart, and Tahitian vanilla, Australian sandalwood, tobacco leaf, musk and olibanum give it a creamy finish.
Made for fall and winter, day or night.

Silky Woods by Goldfield & Banks Australia is a Amber Spicy fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Silky Woods was launched in 2021. Top notes are Ceylon Cinnamon and Saffron; middle notes are Suede, Agarwood (Oud), Madagascar Ylang-Ylang and Jasmine; base notes are Tahitian Vanilla, Tobacco Leaf, Australian Sandalwood, Musk and Olibanum.

name: Goldfield & Banks Southern Bloom Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Goldfield & Banks Southern Bloom is a creamy floral with boronia, coconut and sandalwood.
François Merle-Baudoin created it in 2018. Cassis and mandarin open fresh, boronia, coconut, iris, jasmine sambac and ylang-ylang form a powdery heart, and Australian sandalwood, musk, amber and vetiver give it a warm finish.
Sunny and elegant, it is a great daytime scent from spring through fall.

Southern Bloom by Goldfield & Banks Australia is a Floral fragrance for women and men. Southern Bloom was launched in 2018. The nose behind this fragrance is Francois Merle-Baudoin. Top notes are Cassis and Mandarin Orange; middle notes are Boronia, Coconut, Italian Iris, Jasmine Sambac and Ylang-Ylang; base notes are Australian Sandalwood, Musk, Amber and Vetiver.

name: Goldfield & Banks Sunset Hour Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Goldfield & Banks Sunset Hour is a warm, fruity blend of desert peach and sandalwood.
Launched in 2021, it blends quandong, desert peach, raspberry, mandarin and pink pepper with jasmine sambac, cashmere wood, sandalwood, benzoin and ginger for a glowing, sunset-like warmth.
A daytime favorite for spring and summer.

Sunset Hour by Goldfield & Banks Australia is a Aromatic Fruity fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Sunset Hour was launched in 2021.

name: Goldfield & Banks Velvet Splendour Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Goldfield & Banks Velvet Splendour is a powdery floral with mimosa, jasmine and sandalwood.
Wessel-Jan Kos created it in 2019. Mimosa, jasmine sambac, orange blossom and mandarin meet tonka bean, patchouli, Australian sandalwood, vetiver and leather for a soft, sweet and woody scent.
Elegant and smooth, it is a lovely everyday scent.

name: Goldfield & Banks White Sandalwood Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Goldfield & Banks White Sandalwood is a spicy, woody blend of rose, sandalwood and saffron.
François Merle-Baudoin created it in 2016. Turkish rose, Australian sandalwood, saffron, thyme, pepper and amber come together in a warm, aromatic and creamy woody scent.
Refined and versatile, it is a great everyday scent.

name: Goldfield & Banks Wood Infusion Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Goldfield & Banks Wood Infusion is a smooth blend of orange, lavender, iris and oud.
Launched in 2016, it opens with sweet orange. Lavender, iris and amber form a powdery heart, and exotic woods, oud, musk and patchouli give it a deep finish.
Elegant and versatile, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

Wood Infusion by Goldfield & Banks Australia is a Woody Aromatic fragrance for women and men. Wood Infusion was launched in 2016. Top note is Sweet Orange; middle notes are Lavender, Italian Iris and Amber; base notes are Exotic Woods, Agarwood (Oud), Island Musk and Indonesian Patchouli Leaf.

name: Goutal Bois d'Hadrien Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Goutal Bois d'Hadrien is a fresh, woody blend of lime, pine and cypress.
Camille Goutal created it in 2017. Lime, pine, woods, cypress, fir, spices and ivy come together in a green, aromatic and resinous scent.
Crisp and natural, it is a great daytime scent year-round.

Bois d'Hadrien by Annick Goutal is a Woody Aromatic fragrance for men. Bois d'Hadrien was launched in 2017. The nose behind this fragrance is Camille Goutal. The fragrance features fir, ivy, woody notes, spicy notes, lime, cypress and pine.

name: Goutal Eau d'Hadrien Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Goutal Eau d'Hadrien is a classic, sparkling citrus with lemon and cypress.
Annick Goutal and Francis Camail created it in 1980. Grapefruit, lemon, cypress, mandarin, ylang-ylang, Sicilian lemon, aldehydes and citron come together in a bright, aromatic and lightly woody scent.
Fresh and timeless, it is made for spring and summer days.

name: Goutal Eau de Monsieur Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
Goutal Eau de Monsieur is a fresh blend of citrus, mint and patchouli.
Isabelle Doyen created it in 2013. Bergamot, mandarin and mint open bright, geranium forms a green heart, and sandalwood and patchouli give it a woody finish.
Clean and easy, it is made for spring and summer days.

Eau de Monsieur by Annick Goutal is a Citrus Aromatic fragrance for men. Eau de Monsieur was launched in 2013. The nose behind this fragrance is Isabelle Doyen. Top notes are mandarin orange, bergamot and mint; middle note is geranium; base notes are patchouli and sandalwood.

name: Goutal Eau du Sud Eau de Toilette Unisex

notes.source_text:
Goutal Eau du Sud is a sunny, aromatic citrus with basil, verbena and oakmoss.
Annick Goutal created it in 1996. Grapefruit, bergamot, mandarin and basil open bright, lemon verbena, mint, lime and jasmine form a fresh heart, and patchouli, vetiver and oakmoss give it a mossy finish.
Crisp and refreshing, it is made for spring and summer days.

name: Goutal Les Colognes Eau d'Hadrien Eau de Cologne for Men

notes.source_text:
Goutal Eau d'Hadrien Cologne is a bright, crisp citrus with cypress and aldehydes.
Camille Goutal and Isabelle Doyen created it in 2013. Citron, lemon, cypress, grapefruit, aldehydes and mandarin come together in a sparkling, clean and refreshing cologne.
Light and energizing, it is made for summer days.

Les Colognes Eau d'Hadrien by Annick Goutal is a Citrus Aromatic fragrance for women and men. Les Colognes Eau d'Hadrien was launched in 2013. Les Colognes Eau d'Hadrien was created by Isabelle Doyen and Camille Goutal. The fragrance features cypress, lemon, grapefruit, mandarin orange, citron and aldehydes.

name: Goutal Petite Cherie Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Goutal Petite Chérie is a soft, fresh blend of pear, peach and rose.
Annick Goutal created it in 1998. Pear, peach and freshly cut grass open bright, hedione, lilac and rose form a delicate heart, and white musk and vanilla give it a gentle, sweet finish.
Light and tender, it is made for spring and summer days.

Petite Cherie is a fruity fragrance, covered with a ripple of
peach and pear, drunk with the scent of sensual rose musk, standing
royal in its vanilla frame, all sprinkled with the powdery scent of
refreshing cut grass. Sweet, musky and sassy, mischievous and perfect
for springtime!

name: Goutal Rose Pompon Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Goutal Rose Pompon is a playful, fruity rose with raspberry and grapefruit.
Launched in 2018, it opens with raspberry and grapefruit. Damask rose and violet form a soft, powdery heart, and vanilla gives it a gentle, sweet finish.
Cheerful and pretty, it works day or night in spring and fall.

Rose Pompon Eau de Parfum by Annick Goutal is a Floral fragrance for women. Rose Pompon Eau de Parfum was launched in 2018. Top notes are raspberry and grapefruit; middle notes are damask rose and violet; base note is vanilla.

name: Goutal Rose Pompon Eau de Toilette for Women

notes.source_text:
Goutal Rose Pompon is a playful, fruity rose with black currant and raspberry.
Camille Goutal and Philippine Courtière created it in 2016. Black currant, raspberry and pink pepper open juicy, rose and pink peony form a pretty heart, and musk, cedar and patchouli give it a soft finish.
Cheerful and light, it is a lovely everyday scent.

name: Goutal Un Matin D'orage Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Goutal Un Matin d'Orage is a dewy white floral with gardenia, ginger and lemon.
Camille Goutal and Isabelle Doyen created it in 2009. Green notes, Amalfi lemon and ginger open fresh, gardenia, jasmine, magnolia and champaca form a creamy heart, and sandalwood gives it a soft finish.
Fresh and graceful, it is made for spring and summer days.

The house of Annick Goutal launched their floral fragrance which is presented to the market in February 2009. It will take you to pleasant ambient of Japanese floral garden, which abounds in aromas and freshness after rain. This edition was created by Isabelle Doyen, who decided to accentuate gardenia aromas in composition of the new Un Matin d'Orage.
Perfume Un Matin d'Orage is composed of Sicilian lemon, ginger, gardenia, shiso leaves, magnolia, champaca flowers, jasmine from Indonesia and sandalwood.
Un Matin d'Orage was created by Isabelle Doyen and Camille Goutal.

name: Gritti Because I Am Free Extrait de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Gritti Because I Am Free is a sweet, fruity floral with candied fruits, banana flower and caramel.
Luca Gritti created it in 2023. Petitgrain, almond blossom and candied fruits open bright, jasmine, tuberose and banana flower form a lush heart, and caramel, vanilla and amber give it a warm finish.
Playful and sunny, it works day or night from spring through fall.

name: Gritti Chantilly Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Gritti Chantilly is a sweet, fruity blend of melon, strawberry and vanilla.
Luca Gritti created it in 2018. Bergamot, orange, mandarin, melon and strawberry open juicy, apple, florals, cassis and coconut form a creamy heart, and musk, vanilla and powdery notes give it a soft finish.
Cheerful and light, it is made for spring and summer days.

name: Gritti Chantilly Extrait de Parfum

notes.source_text:
Gritti Chantilly Extrait is a richer take on Chantilly with melon, strawberry and coconut.
Luca Gritti created it in 2026. Bergamot, melon and strawberry open juicy, coconut, apple and black currant blossom form a creamy heart, and powdery notes, vanilla and musk give it a soft finish.
Sweet and versatile, it works year-round, day or night.

name: Gritti Duchessa Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Gritti Duchessa is a sweet, spicy blend of saffron, sour cherry and sweet almond.
Luca Gritti created it in 2020. Saffron, peach, bitter orange and sour cherry open juicy, star anise, clove, white flowers and jasmine form a spicy heart, and iris, sugar, sweet almond and patchouli give it a warm finish.
Elegant and indulgent, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

name: Gritti Fenice Extrait de Parfum Unisex

Luca Gritti created it in 2020. Peach and passionfruit open juicy, amber, orange blossom, lily and magnolia form a floral heart, and musk, woods and jasmine give it a soft finish.
Bright and pretty, it is a lovely scent in spring, fall and winter.

name: Gritti Gossip Night Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Gritti Gossip Night is a creamy gourmand of litchi, whipped cream and caramel.
Luca Gritti created it in 2023. Heliotrope, litchi and mango blossom open fruity, whipped cream, white peach and caramel form a sweet heart, and white musk, Madagascar vanilla and cashmeran give it a soft finish.
Playful and cozy, it works day or night from spring through fall.

name: Gritti Mango Aoud Extrait de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Gritti Mango Aoud is a tropical blend of mango, coconut milk and oud.
Luca Gritti created it in 2024. Mango, guava and neroli open juicy, coconut milk, osmanthus and ylang-ylang form a creamy heart, and oud, vanilla and amber give it a warm finish.
Sunny and distinctive, it is made for spring and summer days.

name: Gritti Noctem Arabs Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Gritti Noctem Arabs is a warm, woody blend of tobacco, oud and myrrh.
Launched in 2014, it opens with patchouli, tobacco and cedar. Oud and sandalwood form a woody heart, and musk, myrrh and amber give it a sweet, resinous finish.
Rich and sensual, it works day or night in fall and winter.

name: Gritti Pomelo Assoluto Extrait de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Gritti Pomelo Assoluto is a fresh, sparkling blend of pomelo, grapefruit and green tea.
Luca Gritti created it in 2025. Grapefruit, pink pepper, pomelo and marine notes open bright, cardamom, juniper berries, magnolia, rose and green tea form an aromatic heart, and white woods, musk and amber give it a clean finish.
Crisp and refreshing, it is made for summer days.

name: Gritti Pomelo Sorrento Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Gritti Pomelo Sorrento is a bright, green blend of pomelo, grapefruit and green tea.
Luca Gritti created it in 2017. Grapefruit and pomelo open zesty, green tea, rose and white flowers form a fresh heart, and vetiver, amber and iris give it a soft finish.
Light and refreshing, it is made for summer days.

name: Gritti Tutu Extrait de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Gritti Tutu is a sweet, fruity floral with apple, coconut and raspberry.
Luca Gritti created it in 2019. Grapefruit, apple, coconut and cassis open juicy, heliotrope, jasmine and rose form a soft heart, and raspberry, vanilla, musk and amber give it a sweet finish.
Playful and cheerful, it is a great daytime scent from spring through fall.

name: Gritti Vanilla Tana Extrait de Parfum Unisex

Gritti Vanilla Tana is a rich, creamy vanilla with orchid, sandalwood and amber.
Luca Gritti created it in 2025. Vanilla absolute, vanilla orchid and vanilla caviar meet white orchid, ylang-ylang, baobab, pink pepper, sandalwood, tonka bean, amber and white musk for a warm, powdery and sweet scent.
Cozy and indulgent, it works day or night in fall and winter.

name: Gucci Bamboo Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Gucci Bamboo is a soft, elegant floral with lily, ylang-ylang and vanilla.
Launched in 2015, it opens with bergamot. Casablanca lily, ylang-ylang and orange blossom form a creamy floral heart, and sandalwood, Tahitian vanilla and amber give it a warm finish.
Graceful and modern, it is a lovely everyday scent.

name: Gucci Bamboo Eau de Toilette Women

notes.source_text:
Gucci Bamboo Eau de Toilette is a fresh, sweet floral with orange blossom, lily and vanilla.
Launched in 2016, it opens with Sicilian bergamot, orange blossom, pear and mandarin. Casablanca lily, jasmine and ylang-ylang form a white floral heart, and white musk, ambergris, Tahitian vanilla and sandalwood give it a soft finish.
Elegant and light, it is made for spring and summer days.

name: Gucci Bloom Acqua di Fiori Eau de Toilette for Women

notes.source_text:
Gucci Bloom Acqua di Fiori is a green, fresh take on Bloom with galbanum and honeysuckle.
Alberto Morillas created it in 2018. Galbanum leaf, cassis, lemon and bergamot open green, honeysuckle, tuberose, jasmine, lily-of-the-valley and freesia form a floral heart, and musk, sandalwood and Iso E Super give it a clean finish.
Light and fresh, it is great for everyday wear and the office in spring and summer.

Acqua Di Fiori introduces a new chapter to the world of Gucci Bloom. The addition of green galbanum and dainty cassis buds bring the soft dewy freshness of the early petal and a light, aquatic composition to the signature scent, designed to celebrate the authenticity, vitality and joyful energy of women. Blended by master perfumer Alberto Morillas under the direction of the house’s Creative Director, Gucci Bloom is created to unfold like its name, capturing the rich scent of a thriving garden filled with an abundance of flowers. Tuberose and jasmine combine with Rangoon creeper—a unique flower discovered in South India to create a rich fragrance that transports the wearer to an imaginary garden.
Fragrance Family:
Fresh
Scent Type:
Fresh Floral
Key Notes:
Green Galbanum, Jasmine Closed Buds, Sandalwood

name: Gucci Bloom Ambrosia d'Oro Eau de Parfum for Women

Radiant and sensual, it works day or night from spring through fall.

name: Gucci Bloom Ambrosia Di Fiori Eau de Parfum for Women

Elegant and intense, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

Gucci Bloom Ambrosia di Fiori by Gucci is a Oriental Floral fragrance for women. This is a new fragrance. Gucci Bloom Ambrosia di Fiori
was launched in 2019. The nose behind this fragrance is Alberto
Morillas. Top notes are Jasmine and Honeysuckle; middle note is
Tuberose; base notes are Damask Rose and Orris.

name: Gucci Bloom Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Gucci Bloom is a rich, natural white floral of jasmine and tuberose.
Alberto Morillas created it in 2017. Jasmine opens lush and green, tuberose forms a creamy heart, and Rangoon creeper gives it a soft, powdery finish.
Fresh and feminine, it is a great everyday scent for the office and spring days.

Fragrance Family:
Floral
Scent Type:
Classic Florals
Key Notes:
Rangoon Creeper, Jasmine Bud, Tuberose
About:
Capturing the spirit of the contemporary, diverse, and authentic women
of Gucci, envisioned as a thriving garden of flowers, Bloom Eau de
Parfum For Her is created to unfold like its name. Notes of natural
tuberose and jasmine create an unexpectedly rich white floral scent on
the skin. Rangoon creeper—a plant discovered in south India that changes
color from white to pink and finally to red when it blooms—infuses a
powdery floral edge to the fragrance.
What else you need to know:
This product is an Allure Best of Beauty award winner.

the intimate and authentic character of a woman. Rose and osmanthus

name: Gucci Gucci by Gucci Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
Gucci by Gucci Pour Homme is a warm, smoky blend of incense, leather and woods.
Michel Almairac created it in 2003. Papyrus, ginger, artemisia, basil, bergamot and lavender open fresh, cedar, pink pepper, sandalwood, patchouli, orris and carnation form the heart, and incense, leather, amber, vetiver, labdanum, vanilla and tonka bean give it a rich finish.
Refined and moody, it suits date nights and everyday wear in fall and winter.

A new signature for the modern Gucci man, Gucci by Gucci Pour Homme
combines classic masculine appeal with cool, contemporary elegance. This
iconic fragrance culminates both vision and tradition, encompassing
Gucci's iconic, luxurious heritage. With its warm, intense scent, Gucci
by Gucci Pour Homme speaks to the powerful, sensual man who embodies the
brand's rich legacy.
The top and the heart of this essence
deliver a smooth, crisp freshness with a touch of cypress and calone.
Violet and bergamot create a masculine floralcy for natural and timeless
appeal. A unique heart distinguishes the scent and intensifies its
character with incense, leather accord, and a subtly sweet note of
tobacco. Amber lavishes the aroma with a warm embrace of longevity and
depth, while black pepper adds hints of sparkling effect. The base is
completed with woody layers of patchouli, cedarwood, and amyris. The
sleek horsebit-adorned flacon reflects the undeniably elegant appeal
that is quintessentially Gucci.
Notes:
Bergamot, Cypress, Violet Incense, Jasmine, Tobacco Leaves, Patchouli, Amber.
Style:
Confident. Masculine. Refined.

About:
Created for a man who defines his own masculinity, Gucci introduces a
modern declaration of self-expression and emancipated sexuality. Born
out of a special collaboration between creative director Alessandro
Michele and master perfumeur Alberto Morillas, Gucci Guilty Absolute
embodies the liberated man it is made for—an innovative expression of a
men’s woody scent.
#GuiltyNotGuilty
What else you need to know:

flacon is finished with details inspired by the codes of a refined
lounge; the sensorial textures and colors of cigars and cognac.

notes.source_text:
Gucci Guilty Cologne Pour Homme is a fresh, aromatic blend of juniper, cypress and violet.
Alberto Morillas created it in 2019. Juniper berries, rosemary and Calabrian bergamot open crisp, cypress, heliotrope and violet form a soft heart, and white musk, patchouli leaf and cedar give it a clean finish.

From the declaration of self-expression
and fearlessness embodied in the idea of #ForeverGuilty, the Gucci
Guilty fragrance story opens a new men's chapter. A modern
reinterpretation of a classic cologne a centuries-old Italian scent,
Gucci Guilty Cologne is created with a contemporary dry down featuring
noble woods notes and powerful citruses. A new rendition of a
traditional Italian cologne blend ideated by Alessandro Michele, Gucci
Guilty Cologne features an intense aromatic personality with an
unexpected dry down, conveyed through sensual woods notes.
Master
perfumer Alberto Morillas modernized the freshness of a traditional
cologne by balancing natural aromatics with the standout vibrancy of
Italian citruses. In the top notes, Bergamot sourced from Calabria adds a
luminous layer to inherently masculine Rosemary and Juniper Berries
Essences. The Mediterranean olfactory narrative continues with an
intense heart of Spanish Cypress Essence, its heady resinous tones
uplifted with elegant floral notes including Heliotropine and Violet.
Alberto Morillas unveils Gucci Guilty Cologne's enigmatic newness in the
cologne's dry down. Sensual noble woods notes diffuse slowly on the
skin, developing with Patchouli leaves and the warmth of Cedarwood with
crystalline White Musks.

notes.source_text:
Gucci Guilty Eau de Toilette Intense Pour Homme is a salty, aromatic blend of sea salt, lavender and palo santo.
Launched in 2026, it opens with a crisp salt accord. Lavender forms a fresh, aromatic heart, and palo santo gives it a smooth, gently smoky woody finish.
Fresh and versatile, it works day or night.

Gucci Guilty Intense Pour Homme is an aromatic blend of lavender, orange flower and cedar.
Jacques Huclier created it in 2011. Lavender, coriander and Amalfi lemon open fresh, orange flower and neroli form a floral heart, and amber, Virginia cedar and patchouli give it a warm finish.
Smooth and confident, it is great for date nights and outings in fall and winter.

An intensified olfactory experience, Gucci Guilty Pour Homme Intense
adds a twist to Gucci Guilty Pour Homme, making it more provocative,
more sensual. The top notes seize hold of the senses with an intensified
masculinity. The amplified burst of lemon and lavender combined with
biting new coriander note adds a more icy start to the intense scent.
The herbal freshness of lavender in the middle notes melds with Orange
Flower as the sensual play maker in the heart with a hint of Neroli
reinforcing the crisp and masculine facets. The base notes of addictive
patchouli and cedarwood's dry down have been enriched with dry amber
and leather accents for a darker and more provocative trail. Intense
Pour Homme is earthy, yet suggestively exotic and powerfully masculine.
Gucci
Guilty Pour Homme Intense replicates the sleek fusion of metal and
glass of Gucci Guilty. The original's muted gunmetal metallic casing has
been transformed into a solid, bolder sculpture. The signature
interlocking G's will prove as covetable an accessory as a new pair of
Gucci sunglasses.
Notes:
Lemon, Lavender, Orange Flower, Neroli Floralcy, Cedarwood.
Style:
Audacious. Provocative. Alluring.

name: Gucci Guilty Pour Femme Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Gucci Guilty Pour Femme is a fruity, spicy floral with lilac, peach and patchouli.
Aurélien Guichard created it in 2010. Pink pepper, mandarin and bergamot open bright, lilac, peach, geranium, jasmine and black currant form the heart, and patchouli, amber, white musk and vanilla give it a warm finish.
Confident and versatile, it suits the office and everyday wear in spring, fall and winter.

Created for a contemporary libertine, Gucci Guilty for Her is defined by
a signature Fougère accord of Geranium usually found in men’s scents.
Intimate and magical lilac flower is laced with amber to radiate warmth
and grace at the fragrance’s heart.
Fragrance Family: Floral
Scent Type: Warm Florals
Key Notes: Geranium, Peach, Pink Pepper

name: Gucci Guilty Pour Femme Eau de Toilette for Women

notes.source_text:

name: Gucci Guilty Pour Femme Intense Eau de Parfum

notes.source_text:

name: Gucci Guilty Pour Homme Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Gucci Guilty pour Homme Eau de Parfum is a spicy, floral blend of rose and chili.
Launched in 2020, it opens with rose, balsamic vinegar, red chili pepper and salt. Orange blossom, lavender and neroli form the heart, and cedar and patchouli give it a woody finish.
Versatile in spring, fall and winter, day or night.

The new edition of the reinvented Gucci Gucci Guilty perfume line is an intense version of the masculine fragrance Gucci Guilty Pour Homme Eau de Parfum. The celebration of freedom that the brand pursues through the #ForeverGuilty story continues, and the Gucci Guilty Pour Homme Eau de Parfum offers a reinterpretation of the original scent with accords of hot chili peppers and soothing fresh roses.
Top notes: rose, chilli, vinegar, salt
Heart: orange blossom absolute, neroli, french lavender
Base: cedar, patchouli

name: Gucci Guilty Pour Homme Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
Gucci Guilty Pour Homme Eau de Toilette is a fresh blend of lavender, lemon and orange flower.
Jacques Huclier created it in 2011. Lavender and Amalfi lemon open crisp, orange flower forms a bright floral heart, and Virginia cedar, patchouli and vanilla give it a warm, woody finish.
Versatile and polished, it works day or night from spring through fall.

Gucci Guilty Eau Pour Homme is a fresh, powdery blend of lemon, orris and orange blossom.
Launched in 2015, it opens with lemon and bergamot. Snowberry, orris and orange blossom form a soft heart, and patchouli and musk give it a clean finish.
Light and easy, it is made for spring and summer days.

Gucci Guilty Eau Pour Homme by Gucci is a Woody Aromatic fragrance for men. Gucci Guilty Eau Pour Homme was launched in 2015. Top notes are lemon and bergamot; middle notes are orris, orange blossom and snowberry; base notes are patchouli and musk.

The floral, sensual orange blossom at the heart of Gucci Guilty for Him doesn’t conform to classic male fragrance notes, heightening the scent’s allure. Gucci Guilty for Him opens with invigorating lemon, and is intensified with seductive notes of lavender and patchouli.
A new chapter unfolds in the Gucci Guilty legacy. The generation that inspires Alessandro Michele is characterized by a celebrative anarchy. They don’t believe in conformity or in submitting to labels or gender rules. They break free from common social boundaries. The original Gucci Guilty fragrances embody this new edge and signify freedom by breaking with traditional male and female fragrance ingredients.
#GuiltyNotGuilty
Notes:
Lavender, Lemon, Orange Blossom, Cedarwood, Patchouli.

name: Gucci Guilty Pour Homme Elixir de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Gucci Guilty pour Homme Elixir is a warm, spicy orange blossom fragrance.
Quentin Bisch and Nathalie Gracia-Cetto created it in 2023. Orange blossom, nutmeg and pimento open warm, orange blossom, orris and osmanthus form a floral heart, and benzoin, Ambrofix, vanilla and patchouli give it a rich finish.
Made for spring, fall and winter, day or night.

name: Gucci Guilty Pour Homme Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Gucci Guilty Pour Homme Parfum is a warm, woody lavender with orange blossom and patchouli.
Launched in 2022, it opens with juniper, lavender and lemon. Orange blossom, nutmeg and Spanish labdanum form a rich heart, and patchouli, dry woods and musk give it a smooth finish.
Confident and refined, it is a strong choice for evenings and cooler weather.

name: Gucci Guilty Women Eau de Toilette

notes.source_text:
Gucci Guilty for Women is a spicy, fruity floral with pink pepper, lilac and patchouli.
Aurélien Guichard created it in 2010. Pink pepper, mandarin and bergamot open bright, lilac, peach, geranium, jasmine and black currant form a floral heart, and patchouli, amber, white musk and vanilla give it a warm finish.

name: Gucci Intense Oud Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Gucci Intense Oud is a smoky, resinous oud with incense and leather.
Aurélien Guichard created it in 2016. Oud, incense, olibanum, leather, woods and amber blend into a dark, smoky and warm scent.
Made for fall and winter nights and date nights.

A prized and historic perfume-making ingredient from the Middle East,
olibanum oil’s use can be traced back to ancient Egypt. Also known as
frankincense, the oil is sourced from resin in Boswellia trees,
collected from the bark in spring and autumn. Only the highest quality
resin is steam distilled to produce essential oil for Gucci Intense Oud.
Incense, woods and leather are woven around pivotal notes of an ambery
oud accord and olibanum oil, conjuring an alluring effect on the top
note. The signature heart note is the ambery oud accord, a blend of dry
woods and smoky resinous notes with the addition of an ambergris accord
to enhance the incense signature. A leather note reverberates from the
base, intensifying the dynamic blend of this intoxicating fragrance.

name: Gucci Love At Your Darkest Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:

Alberto Morillas created it in 2022. Black pepper opens sharp, olibanum forms a smoky, resinous heart, and cedar gives it a dry, ambery finish.
Moody and minimal, it is a strong choice for cooler days and evenings.

name: Gucci Made to Measure Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:

Launched in 2013, it opens with anise, Calabrian bergamot, orange blossom and lavender. Water lily, nutmeg, plum, juniper berries and cinnamon form a spicy heart, and labdanum, amber, patchouli and leather give it a rich finish.
Polished and versatile, it is great for everyday wear and the office from spring through fall.

The Gucci Made to Measure fragrance is intensely masculine, created for the
man who demands the very best—a man whom others aspire to be. It's
inspired by the Gucci Made to Measure suit and specially crafted with
the Gucci philosophy of attention to detail.
Notes:
Calabrian Bergamot, French Lavender, Anis Seed, Sri Lankan Nutmeg, Juniper Berry, Cistus Labdanum, Patchouli, Leather.
Style:
Masculine. Sophisticated. Empowered.

name: Gucci Memoire d'Une Odeur Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:

Alberto Morillas created it in 2019. Chamomile and bitter almond open green and gentle, musk and Indian jasmine form a powdery heart, and sandalwood, cedar and vanilla give it a calm, woody finish.
Quiet and comforting, it is a lovely everyday and office scent for spring and summer.

A universal perfume unassigned with a gender or a time, Gucci Mémoire
d’une Odeur is an elixir that transcends gender by its individuality.
Roman chamomile is structured with Indian coral jasmine petals for
tenderness, precious musks for depth, and noble woods—including warm,
luminous sandalwood and airy, subtle cedarwood.
Fragrance Family: Earth & Woody
Scent Type: Earthy Greens & Herbs
Key Notes: Roman Chamomille, Coral Jasmine, Vanilla

name: Gucci Pour Homme II Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:

notes.source_text:
Guerlain Aqua Allegoria Rosa Verde is a green, fresh rose with mint and cucumber.
Delphine Jelk created it in 2025. Bergamot, mint and cucumber open cool, pear, rose and violet form a soft heart, and musk, iris and chypre notes give it a clean finish.
Crisp and refreshing, it is made for spring and summer days.

name: Guerlain Bois Mysterieux Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Guerlain Bois Mystérieux is a dark, woody blend of neroli, patchouli and leather.
Thierry Wasser created it in 2019. Neroli and laurel open fresh, patchouli, Atlas cedar and jasmine form a woody heart, and leather and myrrh give it a smoky, resinous finish.
Elegant and moody, it is made for fall and winter, day or night.

name: Guerlain Cherry Blossom Millesime 2025 Eau de Toilette for Women

notes.source_text:
Guerlain Cherry Blossom Millésime is a soft, fresh floral with green tea and cherry blossom.
