Launched in 2025, it opens with bergamot and green tea. Jasmine, lilac and cherry blossom form a delicate heart, and white musk gives it a clean finish.
Light and graceful, it is a lovely daytime scent in spring.

name: Guerlain Cherry Oud Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Guerlain Cherry Oud is a dark, sweet blend of cherry, rose and oud.
Delphine Jelk created it in 2022. Fruity notes and cherry open sweet, Bulgarian and Turkish rose form the heart, and oud and leather give it a smoky finish.
Made for fall and winter nights.

name: Guerlain Cuir Intense Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Guerlain Cuir Intense is a rich leather with osmanthus, tobacco and sandalwood.
Thierry Wasser created it in 2019. Osmanthus and ylang-ylang open soft, leather and musk form a sensual heart, and tobacco, sandalwood and cedar give it a warm, woody finish.
Bold and refined, it is a strong choice for cooler days and evenings.

name: Guerlain Eau de Bain Eau de Toilette Unisex

notes.source_text:
Guerlain Eau de Bain is a soft, clean blend of orange blossom, almond and vanilla.
Launched in 2019, it opens with orange blossom, bergamot, lemon and green notes. Almond and white musk form a creamy heart, and vanilla and precious woods give it a warm finish.
Comforting and gentle, it is a lovely everyday scent.

name: Guerlain Eau de Tulle Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Guerlain Eau de Tulle is a sweet, musky blend of orange blossom, rose and sugared almond.
Delphine Jelk created it in 2026. Pink pepper, angelica and citrus open bright, orange blossom, rose and a sugared almond accord form a soft heart, and white musk, incense, vanilla and patchouli give it a warm finish.
Tender and elegant, it is a lovely everyday scent.

name: Guerlain Encens Mythique Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Guerlain Encens Mythique is a warm, smoky blend of rose, saffron and incense.
Thierry Wasser created it in 2019. Aldehydes, rose and saffron open bright, pink pepper, vetiver and patchouli form the heart, and ambergris, olibanum and woods give it a resinous finish.
Refined and mysterious, it is a strong choice for evenings and cooler weather.

name: Guerlain Epices Exquises Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Guerlain Épices Exquises is a warm, spicy blend of cardamom, coffee and oud.
Thierry Wasser created it in 2022. Cardamom, angelica and pink pepper open aromatic, black pepper and coffee form a rich heart, and sandalwood, oud and patchouli give it a woody finish.
Refined and warm, it is a great everyday and evening scent.

name: Guerlain Épices Volées Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Guerlain Épices Volées is an aromatic blend of citrus, rose and spice.
Jean-Paul Guerlain created it in 2021. Bergamot, lemon, coriander and artemisia open bright, Bulgarian rose, cardamom, clove and sage form a spicy heart, and labdanum, sandalwood, benzoin and patchouli give it a warm finish.
Elegant and versatile, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

name: Guerlain Habit Rouge Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Guerlain Habit Rouge Parfum is a rich, modern take on a Guerlain classic.
Delphine Jelk created it in 2024. Bergamot, rum, patchouli and vanilla blend into a warm, boozy and softly earthy scent.
Made for fall and winter nights.

name: Guerlain Homme Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Guerlain Homme Eau de Parfum is a fresh, minty mojito-inspired scent.
Thierry Wasser created it in 2016. Rum, lime, spicy mint and peppermint open bright, floral notes form the heart, and vetiver, cedar and patchouli give it a woody finish.
A daytime favorite from spring through fall.

name: Guerlain L'Homme Ideal Cologne Eau de Toilette

notes.source_text:
Guerlain L'Homme Idéal Cologne is a fresh, citrusy take on L'Homme Idéal with almond.
Thierry Wasser created it in 2015. Grapefruit, orange, bergamot and pink pepper open bright, almond and neroli form a soft heart, and vetiver and white musk give it a clean finish.
Light and easy, it is a great everyday scent.

name: Guerlain L'Homme Ideal Cologne Forte Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Guerlain L'Homme Idéal Cologne Forte is a citrusy blend of grapefruit, almond and incense.
Delphine Jelk created it in 2025. Grapefruit, bergamot and lemon peel open bright, almond and cinnamon form a warm heart, and incense, vetiver and vanillin give it a smooth finish.
Fresh and polished, it is a great daytime scent from spring through fall.

name: Guerlain L’Homme Ideal Cool Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
Guerlain L'Homme Idéal Cool is a fresh, green take on L'Homme Idéal with mint and almond.
Thierry Wasser created it in 2019. Mint, anise, orange and bergamot open cool, neroli, water notes and almond form a fresh heart, and ambroxan, vetiver and patchouli give it a clean finish.
Light and crisp, it is made for spring and summer days.

L’Homme Ideal Cool by Guerlain is a Aromatic Fougere fragrance for men. This is a new fragrance. L’Homme Ideal Cool
was launched in 2019. The nose behind this fragrance is Thierry Wasser.
Top notes are Mint, Bergamot, Orange and Anise; middle notes are
Almond, Water Notes and Neroli; base notes are Vetiver, Ambroxan and
Patchouli.

name: Guerlain L'Homme Ideal Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Guerlain L'Homme Idéal Eau de Parfum is a warm, nutty almond and cherry fragrance.
Delphine Jelk and Thierry Wasser created it in 2016. Almond, spices, lavender, bergamot, thyme and rosemary open aromatic, cherry, vanilla, incense and rose form a gourmand heart, and tonka bean, leather and sandalwood give it a smooth finish.
Cozy and seductive, it is made for fall and winter, date nights and evenings out.

Guerlain L'Homme Ideal is a Masculine fragrance, The fragrance launched in 2016, The nose behind this fragrance is Delphine Jelk, Thierry Wasser,
Top Note: Almond, Spices, Lavender, Bergamot, Thyme, Rosemary
Heart Note: Cherry, Vanilla, Incense, Bulgarian Rose
Base Note: Tonka Bean, Leather, Sandalwood

name: Guerlain L'Homme Ideal Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
Guerlain L'Homme Idéal Eau de Toilette is a fresh, nutty blend of citrus and almond.
Thierry Wasser created it in 2014. Citrus, orange blossom, rosemary and bitter orange open bright, almond and tonka bean form the heart, and leather, vetiver and cedar give it a smooth finish.
Made for fall and winter, day or night.

The ideal man is a myth. His fragrance, a
reality. Guerlain decodes men's aspirations and creates for them a
concentrate of ideal. The ideal fragrance is smart, handsome, strong.
Three adjectives, three accords for this fresh woody fragrance that will
trigger your full potential. The ideal bottle is Masculine, luxurious
and distinguished - a mysterious pack, a graphic, black and white
object, a flashcode as a door to a digital universe. The bottle -
square, faceted and streamlined, luxurious. Radical matte black lacquer
side faces. A decidedly masculine, heavy cap that is also matte and
borrows its guilloché detailing from the world of watchmaking. Made in
France.
TOP NOTES
Orange blossom
Mandarin
Lemon
Bergamot
Rosemary
HEART NOTES
Vanilla
Amaretto accord
BASE NOTES
Leather
Patchouli
Vetiver
Cedarwood

name: Guerlain L'Homme Ideal Extreme Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Guerlain L'Homme Idéal Extrême is a darker, richer take on L'Homme Idéal.
Thierry Wasser created it in 2020. Almond, pink pepper and bergamot open warm, plum, cinnamon and heliotrope form a sweet heart, and tobacco, leather, patchouli and cedar give it depth.
A rich, seductive scent for cooler days and evenings.

name: Guerlain L'Homme Ideal L'Intense Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Guerlain L'Homme Idéal L'Intense is a smoky, spicy take on L'Homme Idéal.
Thierry Wasser created it in 2018. Almond, chili pepper and cardamom open warm, leather, Bulgarian rose and labdanum form the heart, and smoke, tonka bean, vanilla, sandalwood and patchouli give it a rich finish.
Made for fall and winter nights.

Guerlain launches L'Homme Idéal L'Intense in spring of
2018 as a new flanker in the masculine line that includes the original
L'Homme Ideal from 2014, L'Homme Ideal Cologne from 2015, L'Homme Idéal
Eau de Parfum from 2016 and L 'Homme Idéal Sport from 2017.
"The Ideal Man is a myth… but thanks to Guerlain, his fragrance is a reality with the new L'Homme Idéal Intense."
The scent is announced as a masculine, luxurious and elegant, with
oriental-woody and spicy composition. Intensity is the high point of
this new interpretation, according to the brand.  It contains notes of
fiery spices like chilli and cardamom at its opening, followed by the
heart of leather and Bulgarian rose, based on smoked woody notes.

name: Guerlain L'Homme Ideal Parfum For Men

notes.source_text:
Guerlain L'Homme Idéal Parfum is a smooth blend of leather, amaretto and patchouli.
Delphine Jelk created it in 2024 around amaretto, leather, patchouli and musk, giving it a rich, nutty and softly leathery warmth.
Versatile in spring, fall and winter, day or night.

name: Guerlain L'Homme Ideal Platine Prive Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Guerlain L'Homme Idéal Platine Privé is a fresh blend of grapefruit, green almond and vetiver.
Delphine Jelk created it in 2023. Grapefruit and bergamot open bright, green almond and neroli form a soft heart, and musk and vetiver give it a clean finish.
Crisp and refined, it works day or night in spring and summer.

name: Guerlain L’Homme Ideal Sport Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
Guerlain L'Homme Idéal Sport is a fresh, aquatic take on L'Homme Idéal with almond and neroli.
Delphine Jelk and Thierry Wasser created it in 2017. Spices, almond and watery notes open fresh, neroli forms a bright heart, and patchouli, vetiver and coumarin give it a woody finish.
Clean and sporty, it is made for spring and summer days.

L’Homme Ideal Sport is created by Thierry Wasser and Delphine Jelk, who
took the almond note and revealed its sporting potential by giving it
vitality with fresh spices and aquatic accords. The heart develops with a
delicate neroli essence, followed by the woody base featuring an
intensive trio of patchouli, vetiver and coumarin.

name: Guerlain La Cologne Du Parfumeur Cologne Unisex

notes.source_text:
Guerlain La Cologne du Parfumeur is a fresh cologne of orange flower, lemon and lavender.
Thierry Wasser created it in 2010. Orange flower, Amalfi lemon, lavender, mint, rosemary, citrus and white musk come together in a clean, aromatic and sparkling scent.
Bright and refreshing, it is made for spring and summer days.

name: Guerlain La Petite Robe Noire Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Guerlain La Petite Robe Noire is a sweet, playful blend of cherry, almond and rose.
Thierry Wasser created it in 2017. Almond, red berries, sour cherry and bergamot open bright, licorice, rose and tea form the heart, and tonka bean, patchouli, vanilla, anise and iris give it a soft finish.
Chic and charming, it is perfect for date nights and the office in fall and winter.

An
absolutely essential and utterly irresistible perfumed creation. The
legendary heart-shaped bottle has been boldly reinterpreted with a
modern touch. Its crystalline transparency, fading from black to powdery
pink, reveals the silhouette of the little, black dress.
Its simple signature enhances and romances several exceptional
materials in a bold overdose—black cherry blinks the first wink. It is
illustrated by a clever blend that extends exquisite almond and
delicious berries. The second wink takes place as rose enters the stage.
Finally, the shadowy temptations of licorice and smoky black tea are
ever-so-revealing and lead to irresistible seduction. For the ultimate
temptation, the entire creation is wrapped in Guerlinade—fresh,
enigmatic, and exhilarating, mischievous and captivating.
Style:
Fresh. Enigmatic. Exhilarating

name: Guerlain La Petite Robe Noire Honey Rose Eau de Parfum For Women

notes.source_text:
Guerlain La Petite Robe Noire Honey Rose is a sweet, warm blend of honey, rose and vanilla.
Launched in 2025, it opens with bergamot and almond. Honey and May rose form a golden floral heart, and vanilla, patchouli and tonka bean give it a cozy finish.
Romantic and sweet, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

name: Guerlain LHeure Bleue 2026 Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Guerlain L'Heure Bleue 2026 is a soft, modern blend of orange blossom, iris and vanilla.
Delphine Jelk created it in 2026. Orange blossom, neroli and airy notes open fresh, iris, jasmine and orris form a powdery heart, and ambroxan, vanilla and musk give it a clean finish.
A delicate daytime scent in any season.

name: Guerlain Mon Guerlain Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Guerlain Mon Guerlain is a soft, elegant blend of lavender, jasmine and vanilla.
Delphine Jelk and Thierry Wasser created it in 2017. Bergamot and lavender open fresh, jasmine sambac, iris and rose form the heart, and Australian sandalwood, Tahitian vanilla, benzoin and coumarin give it a warm finish.
Versatile from spring through winter, for the office and everyday wear.

This fresh, exotic fragrance is for the woman who's ready to take on
the world, with an adventurous spirit that's endlessly fascinating. This
exciting scent is made with sublime ingredients from all over the
world: carla lavender from Provence, sambac jasmine from India, album
sandalwood from Australia and vanilla tahitensis from Papua New Guinea.
The carla lavender adds crisp vibrancy to the notes of smooth and
delightful vanilla tahitensis, while sambac jasmine, gathered at
sunrise, infuses the fragrance with delicate finesse and album
sandalwood expresses energy and mystery.
Style: Fresh, exotic.
Notes: carla lavender, sambac jasmine, album sandalwood, vanilla tahitensis.

name: Guerlain Mon Guerlain Eau de Parfum Intense for Women

notes.source_text:
Guerlain Mon Guerlain Intense is a richer, warmer take on Mon Guerlain.
Delphine Jelk and Thierry Wasser created it in 2019. Bergamot, lavender and mandarin open fresh, rose, iris, Tahitian and Madagascar vanilla and jasmine sambac form the heart, and Australian sandalwood, white musk and benzoin give it a smooth finish.
Made for fall and winter, day or night.

name: Guerlain Néroli Outrenoir Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Guerlain Néroli Outrenoir is a smoky, tea-tinged neroli with citrus and myrrh.
Delphine Jelk and Thierry Wasser created it in 2016. Tangerine, grapefruit, bergamot, petitgrain and lemon open bright, tea, neroli, orange blossom, smoke and earthy notes form the heart, and vanilla, benzoin, myrrh, ambrette and oakmoss give it a soft finish.
Distinctive and fresh, it is a great daytime scent from spring through fall.

name: Guerlain Oud Essentiel Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Guerlain Oud Essentiel is a rich blend of oud, leather and saffron.
Thierry Wasser created it in 2017. Oud, leather, saffron, olibanum, rose and cedar come together in a warm, spicy and smoky woody scent.
Bold and refined, it is a strong choice for cooler days and evenings.

name: Guerlain Oud Khol Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Guerlain Oud Khôl is a sweet, leathery blend of oud, praline and moss.
Thierry Wasser created it in 2022. Leather, oud, moss, praline and aldehydes come together in a dark, earthy and gently sweet scent.
Bold and sensual, it is made for fall and winter nights.

name: Guerlain Oud Nude Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Guerlain Oud Nude is a soft, sweet blend of oud, almond and raspberry.
Delphine Jelk created it in 2022. Sandalwood, oud, almond, Bourbon vanilla, rose, Atlas cedar and raspberry come together in a creamy, fruity and powdery woody scent.
Smooth and elegant, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

name: Guerlain Patchouli Ardent Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Guerlain Patchouli Ardent is a warm, woody patchouli with fig, rose and leather.
Thierry Wasser created it in 2020. Fig, black pepper and pink pepper open spicy, Turkish rose, patchouli and cedar form a rich heart, and leather and musk give it a smooth finish.
Deep and refined, it is a strong choice for evenings and cooler weather.

name: Guerlain Patchouli Paris Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Guerlain Patchouli Paris is a warm, earthy blend of aldehydes, iris and patchouli.
Delphine Jelk created it in 2024. Aldehydes open bright, iris forms a soft, powdery heart, and patchouli, ambergris and vanilla give it a warm, woody finish.
Elegant and versatile, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

name: Guerlain Samsara Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Guerlain Samsara is a rich, opulent sandalwood and jasmine classic.
Jean-Paul Guerlain created it in 1989. Bergamot, lemon, green notes, peach and ylang-ylang open bright, rose, violet, iris, narcissus and jasmine form the heart, and vanilla, sandalwood, tonka bean, musk and amber give it a warm finish.
Made for fall and winter, day or night.

name: Guerlain Samsara Eau de Toilette for Women

notes.source_text:
Guerlain Samsara Eau de Toilette is a warm blend of ylang-ylang, jasmine and sandalwood.
Launched in 2021, it opens with citrus. Ylang-ylang and jasmine form a rich floral heart, and iris, vanilla, tonka bean and sandalwood give it a creamy, powdery finish.
Elegant and cozy, it works day or night in fall and winter.

name: Guerlain Santal Pao Rosa Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Guerlain Santal Pao Rosa is a warm, nutty blend of sandalwood, fig and cardamom.
Delphine Jelk created it in 2021. Sandalwood, oud, cardamom, fig, myrrh and nutty notes come together in a creamy, sweet and gently spicy woody scent.
Cozy and refined, it works day or night in fall and winter.

name: Guerlain Santal Royal Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Guerlain Santal Royal is a rich blend of sandalwood, oud and rose.
Thierry Wasser created it in 2014. Jasmine and neroli open bright, rose, cinnamon and peach form a warm heart, and oud, sandalwood, leather, amber and musk give it a smooth, opulent finish.
Luxurious and warm, it is a strong choice for evenings and cooler weather.

name: Guerlain Shalimar Millesime Rose Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Guerlain Shalimar Millésime Rose is a sweet, rosy take on Shalimar with incense and vanilla.
Delphine Jelk created it in 2026. Bergamot, almond and rose water open bright, Damask rose, incense and May rose form a rich heart, and vanilla and patchouli give it a warm finish.
Romantic and elegant, it is a great everyday and evening scent.

name: Guerlain Tabac Sahara Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Guerlain Tabac Sahara is a sweet, fruity tobacco with raspberry and rose.
Delphine Jelk created it in 2026. Raspberry and citrus open juicy, tobacco, red berries and rose oil form a rich heart, and woods, vanilla, ambergris and amber give it a warm finish.
Cozy and sensual, it works day or night in fall and winter.

name: Haute Fragrance Company Beautiful & Wild Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Haute Fragrance Company Beautiful & Wild is a spicy rose with litchi, freesia and orris.
Vincent Ricord created it in 2018. Rose, geranium and litchi open bright, woods, spices and freesia form the heart, and patchouli, tolu balsam and orris give it a warm finish.
Elegant and bold, it works day or night in fall and winter.

Beautiful & Wild by Haute Fragrance Company HFC is a Floral Woody Musk fragrance for women. This is a new fragrance. Beautiful & Wild was launched in 2018. The nose behind this fragrance is Vincent Ricord. Top notes are Rose, Geranium and Litchi; middle notes are Woody Notes, Spices and Freesia; base notes are Patchouli, Tolu Balsam and Orris.

name: Haute Fragrance Company Black Orris Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Haute Fragrance Company Black Orris is a powdery blend of lavender, iris and black pepper.
Vincent Ricord created it in 2017. Lavender, bergamot and lemon open fresh, iris, black pepper and spices form a powdery heart, and sandalwood, ambergris, musk and labdanum give it a warm finish.
Refined and smooth, it is a great everyday scent.

Black Orris by Haute Fragrance Company HFC is a fragrance for men. Black Orris was launched in 2017. The nose behind this fragrance is Vincent Ricord. Top notes are Lavender, Bergamot and Lemon; middle notes are iris, Black Pepper and Spicy Notes; base notes are Sandalwood, Ambergris, Musk and Labdanum.

name: Haute Fragrance Company Black Princess Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Haute Fragrance Company Black Princess is a powdery floral with ylang-ylang, violet and rose.
Vincent Ricord created it in 2017. Ylang-ylang, violet and neroli open soft, rose, ginger and cardamom form a spicy heart, and maté, ambergris and musk give it a smooth finish.
Elegant and warm, it works day or night in fall.

Black Princess by Haute Fragrance Company HFC is a Floral fragrance for women. Black Princess was launched in 2017. The nose behind this fragrance is Vincent Ricord. Top notes are Ylang-Ylang, Violet and Neroli; middle notes are Rose, Ginger and Cardamom; base notes are Mate, Ambergris and Musk.

name: Haute Fragrance Company Chic Blossom Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Haute Fragrance Company Chic Blossom is a soft white floral with jasmine, lemon and amber.
Vincent Ricord created it in 2017. Indian jasmine, Italian lemon and mandarin open bright, jasmine sambac and amber form a warm heart, and musk, benzoin and tobacco give it a powdery finish.
Graceful and light, it is a lovely daytime scent in spring.

Chic Blossom by Haute Fragrance Company HFC is a fragrance for women. Chic Blossom was launched in 2017. The nose behind this fragrance is Vincent Ricord. Top notes are Indian Jasmine, Italian Lemon and Italian Mandarin; middle notes are Jasmine Sambac and Amber; base notes are Musk, Benzoin and Tobacco.

name: Haute Fragrance Company Closed Gate Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Haute Fragrance Company Closed Gate is a spicy, green blend of Sichuan pepper, sandalwood and vanilla.
Benoît Bergia created it in 2018. Labdanum and Sichuan pepper open warm, green notes, sandalwood and black pepper form the heart, and vanilla, labdanum and musk give it a smooth finish.
Distinctive and cozy, it is a lovely scent for fall and winter.

Closed Gate by Haute Fragrance Company HFC is a Amber Woody fragrance for women. This is a new fragrance. Closed Gate was launched in 2018. The nose behind this fragrance is Benoît Bergia. Top notes are Labdanum and Sichuan Pepper; middle notes are Green Notes, Sandalwood and Black Pepper; base notes are Vanilla, Labdanum and Musk.

name: Haute Fragrance Company Delicious Kisses Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Haute Fragrance Company Delicious Kisses is a powdery, fruity blend of violet, raspberry and iris.
Vincent Ricord created it in 2017. Violet, raspberry and Bulgarian rose open soft, iris, papyrus and sandalwood form a woody heart, and patchouli, cedar, ambrette and musk give it a warm finish.
Pretty and cozy, it works day or night in fall.

Delicious Kisses by Haute Fragrance Company HFC is a Floral fragrance for women. Delicious Kisses was launched in 2017. The nose behind this fragrance is Vincent Ricord. Top notes are Violet, Raspberry and Bulgarian Rose; middle notes are iris, Papyrus and Sandalwood; base notes are Patchouli, Cedar, Ambrette (Musk Mallow) and Musk.

name: Haute Fragrance Company Dry Wood Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Haute Fragrance Company Dry Wood is an earthy blend of sage, incense and vetiver.
Vincent Ricord created it in 2017. Sage, Calabrian bergamot and black pepper open fresh, labdanum, incense and musk form a resinous heart, and vetiver, amber and patchouli give it a dry, woody finish.
Refined and grounded, it is a great everyday scent.

name: Haute Fragrance Company Lover Man Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Haute Fragrance Company Lover Man is a warm blend of saffron, cacao and oud.
Vincent Ricord created it in 2017. Calabrian bergamot, myrrh and saffron open bright, spices, cacao pod and Moroccan cedar form a rich heart, and guaiac wood, oud and cashmere wood give it a smooth finish.
Seductive and warm, it is made for fall and winter nights.

Lover Man by Haute Fragrance Company HFC is a Amber Spicy fragrance for men. Lover Man was launched in 2017. The nose behind this fragrance is Vincent Ricord. Top notes are Calabrian bergamot, Myrrh and Saffron; middle notes are Spicy Notes, Cacao Pod and Moroccan Cedar; base notes are Guaiac Wood, Agarwood (Oud) and Cashmere Wood.

name: Haute Fragrance Company Or Noir Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Haute Fragrance Company Or Noir is an aromatic blend of elemi, cardamom and leather.
Vincent Ricord created it in 2017. Elemi, cardamom and Italian lemon open bright, orange, sandalwood and spices form a warm heart, and leather, musk and cedar give it a smooth finish.
Bold and refined, it is made for fall and winter nights.

Or Noir by Haute Fragrance Company HFC is a Amber fragrance for men. Or Noir was launched in 2017. The nose behind this fragrance is Vincent Ricord. Top notes are elemi, Cardamom and Italian Lemon; middle notes are Orange, Sandalwood and Spicy Notes; base notes are Leather, Musk and Cedar.

name: Haute Fragrance Company Party on the Moon Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Haute Fragrance Company Party on the Moon is a fresh, green blend of citrus, violet leaf and black tea.
Vincent Ricord created it in 2017. Calabrian bergamot, mandarin and violet leaf open bright, black tea, jasmine and cedar form an airy heart, and musk, sandalwood and amber give it a soft finish.
Light and modern, it is made for spring and summer days.

Party on the Moon by Haute Fragrance Company HFC is a fragrance for women. Party on the Moon was launched in 2017. The nose behind this fragrance is Vincent Ricord. Top notes are Calabrian bergamot, Calabrian Mandarin and Violet Leaf; middle notes are Black Tea, Jasmine and Cedar; base notes are Musk, Sandalwood and Amber.

name: Haute Fragrance Company Private Code Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Haute Fragrance Company Private Code is a rich blend of plum, sour cherry, dates and oud.
Vincent Ricord created it in 2022. Olibanum, osmanthus, plum and sour cherry open juicy, rose, dates, leather and orris root form a warm heart, and tolu balsam, oud, benzoin, musk and incense give it a deep finish.
Opulent and seductive, it is made for fall and winter nights.

name: Haute Fragrance Company Proposal Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Haute Fragrance Company Proposal is a soft blend of almond, litchi, heliotrope and iris.
Vincent Ricord created it in 2018. Sweet almond, black currant, litchi and bergamot open bright, heliotrope, dried fruits, black tea and jasmine form a soft heart, and iris, white musk, tonka bean, vanilla and teak give it a powdery finish.
Romantic and versatile, it is a great daytime scent year-round.

Proposal by Haute Fragrance Company HFC is a Floral Woody Musk fragrance for women. Proposal was launched in 2018. The nose behind this fragrance is Vincent Ricord. Top notes are Sweet Almond, Black Currant, Litchi and Bergamot; middle notes are Heliotrope, Dried Fruits, Black Tea, Jasmine Sambac and Italian Jasmine; base notes are iris, White Musk, Tonka Bean, Vanilla, Teak Wood and Patchouli.

name: Haute Fragrance Company Red Iceberg Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Haute Fragrance Company Red Iceberg is a bright blend of citrus, orange blossom and ylang-ylang.
Benoît Bergia created it in 2018. Bergamot, mandarin and tangerine open juicy, orange blossom, ylang-ylang and patchouli form a sunny heart, and amber, cedar and musk give it a soft finish.
Cheerful and fresh, it is a lovely daytime scent in spring.

Red Iceberg by Haute Fragrance Company HFC is a Floral Woody Musk fragrance for women. This is a new fragrance. Red Iceberg was launched in 2018. The nose behind this fragrance is Benoît Bergia. Top notes are Bergamot, Mandarin Orange and Tangerine; middle notes are Orange Blossom, Ylang-Ylang and Patchouli; base notes are Amber, Cedar and Musk.

name: Haute Fragrance Company Shade of Chocolate Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Haute Fragrance Company Shade of Chocolate is a rich blend of cacao, coffee and patchouli.
Vincent Ricord created it in 2017. Cacao, pink pepper and bergamot open warm, coffee, black tea and jasmine form a rich heart, and patchouli, tonka bean and sandalwood give it a woody finish.
Indulgent and cozy, it works day or night in fall and winter.

Shade of Chocolate by Haute Fragrance Company HFC is a Amber Vanilla fragrance for women. Shade of Chocolate was launched in 2017. The nose behind this fragrance is Vincent Ricord. Top notes are Cacao, Pink Pepper and Bergamot; middle notes are Coffee, Black Tea and Jasmine; base notes are Patchouli, Tonka Bean and Sandalwood.

name: Haute Fragrance Company Sweet & Spoiled Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Haute Fragrance Company Sweet & Spoiled is a warm blend of rum, osmanthus and vanilla.
Vincent Ricord created it in 2017. Rum and artemisia open bright, osmanthus, sea fennel and labdanum form a floral heart, and Madagascar vanilla, benzoin and patchouli give it a warm finish.
Sweet and sunny, it is made for spring and summer days.

Sweet & Spoiled by Haute Fragrance Company HFC is a Amber fragrance for women. Sweet & Spoiled was launched in 2017. The nose behind this fragrance is Vincent Ricord. Top notes are Rum and Artemisia; middle notes are Osmanthus, Crithmum and Labdanum; base notes are Madagascar Vanilla, Benzoin and Patchouli.

name: Haute Fragrance Company Sword Dancer Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Haute Fragrance Company Sword Dancer is a warm, boozy blend of rum, labdanum and fir.
Benoît Bergia created it in 2018. Cardamom and bergamot open fresh, rum, labdanum and davana form a rich heart, and balsam fir, sandalwood and vetiver give it a woody finish.
Bold and warming, it is made for fall and winter nights.

Sword Dancer by Haute Fragrance Company HFC is a Amber Woody fragrance for men. This is a new fragrance. Sword Dancer was launched in 2018. The nose behind this fragrance is Benoît Bergia. Top notes are Cardamom and Bergamot; middle notes are Rum, Labdanum and Davana; base notes are Balsam Fir, Sandalwood and Vetiver.

name: Haute Fragrance Company Voodoo Chic Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Haute Fragrance Company Voodoo Chic is a smoky, ambery blend of black tea, myrrh and incense.
Vincent Ricord created it in 2017. Black tea and Calabrian bergamot open fresh, myrrh, incense and cashmere musk form a resinous heart, and amber, benzoin and patchouli give it a warm finish.
Mysterious and warm, it is a lovely scent for fall.

Voodoo Chic by Haute Fragrance Company HFC is a Chypre fragrance for women. Voodoo Chic was launched in 2017. The nose behind this fragrance is Vincent Ricord. Top notes are Black Tea and Calabrian bergamot; middle notes are Myrrh, Incense and Cashmere Musk; base notes are Amber, Benzoin and Patchouli.

name: Haute Fragrance Company Wear Love Everywhere Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Haute Fragrance Company Wear Love Everywhere is a fruity rose with black currant and vanilla.
Vincent Ricord created it in 2017. Black currant, rose and pink pepper open bright, rose, magnolia and rose geranium form a floral heart, and Madagascar vanilla, sandalwood and amber give it a soft finish.
Romantic and easy, it works day or night in spring and summer.

Wear Love Everywhere by Haute Fragrance Company HFC is a Floral fragrance for women. Wear Love Everywhere was launched in 2017. The nose behind this fragrance is Vincent Ricord. Top notes are Black Currant, Rose and Pink Pepper; middle notes are Rose, Magnolia and Rose Geranium; base notes are Madagascar Vanilla, Sandalwood and Amber.

name: Haute Fragrance Company Wrap Me in Dreams Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Haute Fragrance Company Wrap Me in Dreams is a sweet, boozy blend of cherry, rum and vanilla.
Benoît Bergia created it in 2020. Cherry, rum and dried fruits open rich, tonka bean, patchouli and woods form a warm heart, and powdery notes, vanilla, musk and peony give it a soft finish.
Indulgent and cozy, it is made for fall and winter nights.

Wrap Me in Dreams by Haute Fragrance Company HFC is a Amber Vanilla fragrance for women. This is a new fragrance. Wrap Me in Dreams was launched in 2020. The nose behind this fragrance is Benoît Bergia. Top notes are Cherry, Rum and Dried Fruits; middle notes are Tonka Bean, Patchouli and Woody Notes; base notes are Powdery Notes, Vanilla, Musk and Peony.

name: Hawas Pink Eau e Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Rasasi Hawas Pink is a sweet, spicy blend of cinnamon, marshmallow and cotton candy.
Launched in 2025, it opens with neroli, cinnamon and nutmeg. Marshmallow, orange blossom and tuberose form a soft, creamy heart, and cotton candy, vanilla and tonka bean give it a sugary finish.
Playful and cozy, it works day or night.

name: Hermes Barenia Pleine Fleur Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Hermès Barénia Pleine Fleur is a fruity blend of orange blossom, white lily and patchouli.
Christine Nagel created it in 2026. Orange blossom, white lily, miracle berry and patchouli come together in a bright, sweet and gently woody floral scent.
Elegant and radiant, it is a lovely daytime scent in spring and fall.

name: Hermes Bel Ami Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
Hermès Bel Ami is a classic, leathery chypre with aromatic herbs and spice.
Jean-Louis Sieuzac created it in 1986. Sage, bergamot, cardamom, mandarin and lemon open fresh, carnation, patchouli, cedar, basil, orris and jasmine form a spicy heart, and leather, oakmoss, styrax, vetiver, amber and vanilla give it a rich finish.
Timeless and refined, it is made for fall and winter, day or night.

Bel Ami: a reference to Guy de Maupassant's famous novel, Bel Ami celebrates leather in its most authentic expression. The chypre extract, conceived by Jean-Louis Sieuzac in 1986, interprets the material with as much opulence as character, in a register of surprising sensuality.

name: Hermes Bel Ami Vetiver Eau de Toilette Men

notes.source_text:
Hermès Bel Ami Vétiver is a refined blend of leather, vetiver and amber.
Jean-Claude Ellena created it in 2013. Russian leather, vetiver, elemi, amber and styrax meet carnation, cardamom, iris, vanilla, basil and patchouli for a warm, aromatic and polished scent.
Elegant and versatile, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

name: Hermes Concentre D'Orange Verte Men Eau de Toilette Unisex

notes.source_text:
Hermès Concentré d'Orange Verte is a crisp, green citrus with basil and cedar.
Jean Guichard created it in 2004. Orange, basil, cedar, patchouli and amber blend into a zesty, green and gently woody scent.
Fresh and energizing, it is a great everyday scent.

name: Hermes Concentré de Pamplemousse Rose Unisex

notes.source_text:
Hermès Concentré de Pamplemousse Rose is a crisp blend of grapefruit, rose and vetiver.
Jean-Claude Ellena created it in 2011. Grapefruit opens zesty, rose forms a soft heart, and vetiver gives it an earthy, aromatic finish.
Fresh and lively, it is made for spring and summer days.

name: Hermes Eau D'Orange Verte Eau de Cologne Unisex

notes.source_text:
Hermès Eau d'Orange Verte is a crisp, green citrus cologne with mint and oakmoss.
Jean-Claude Ellena created this version in 2009. Orange, Amalfi lemon, mandarin and mint sparkle over cassis, oakmoss and patchouli for a bright, zesty and slightly earthy scent.
Clean and refreshing, it is made for spring and summer days.

name: Hermes Eau de Citron Noir Eau de Cologne Unisex

notes.source_text:
Hermès Eau de Citron Noir is a smoky citrus with lemon, lime and black tea.
Christine Nagel created it. Lemon, guaiac wood, smoke, citron, lime and black tea come together in a bright yet smoky and woody cologne.
Fresh and distinctive, it is made for spring and summer days.

name: Hermes Eau de Mandarine Ambrée Unisex

notes.source_text:
Hermès Eau de Mandarine Ambrée is a juicy blend of mandarin, passionfruit and amber.
Jean-Claude Ellena created it in 2013. Mandarin opens bright, passionfruit forms a tropical heart, and amber gives it a warm, sweet finish.
Sunny and cheerful, it is made for spring and summer days.

name: Hermes Eau de Narcisse Bleu Eau de Cologne Unisex

notes.source_text:
Hermès Eau de Narcisse Bleu is a green, airy blend of narcissus and woods.
Launched in 2013, it pairs fresh, slightly sharp narcissus with clean woods for a light, natural and green scent.
Crisp and unusual, it is made for spring and summer days.

name: Hermes Eau de Pamplemousse Rose Eau de Cologne Unisex

notes.source_text:
Hermès Eau de Pamplemousse Rose is a sparkling cologne of grapefruit, rose and orange.
Jean-Claude Ellena created it in 2009. Grapefruit, rose and orange come together in a crisp, juicy and lightly floral citrus scent.
Light and refreshing, it is made for spring and summer days.

name: Hermes Eau de Rhubarbe Ecarlate Eau de Cologne Unisex

notes.source_text:
Hermès Eau de Rhubarbe Écarlate is a bright, juicy blend of rhubarb and red berries.
Christine Nagel created it in 2016. Tart rhubarb meets sweet red berries for a sparkling, fruity heart, and white musk gives it a soft, clean finish.
Fresh and playful, it is made for spring and summer days.

name: Hermes Eau des Merveilles Eau de Toilette for Women

notes.source_text:
Hermès Eau des Merveilles is a sparkling blend of citrus, ambergris and woods.
Ralf Schwieger and Nathalie Feisthauer created it in 2004. Lemon, orange and elemi open bright, amber, violet and pepper form a salty, warm heart, and cedar, fir, vetiver and oakmoss give it a woody finish.
Unique and radiant, it is a lovely daytime scent from spring through fall.

name: Hermes Equipage Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
Hermès Équipage is a classic, woody blend of spice, carnation and oakmoss.
Guy Robert created it in 1970. Rosewood, clary sage, nutmeg flower, aldehydes, bergamot and tarragon open aromatic, carnation, pine needles, cinnamon and jasmine form a spicy heart, and oakmoss, vetiver, patchouli, tonka bean, musk and amber give it a warm finish.
Timeless and refined, it is perfect for fall days.

Équipage: created by Guy Robert in 1970, the first masculine perfume from Hermès is characterized by an ambiance that is both sober and virile. Aromatic spicy and woody, its fragrance is an equal balance between strength and delicacy, the liveliness of herbs and the power of spices, on a base of smooth wood notes.

name: Hermes H24 Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Hermès H24 Eau de Parfum is a mossy, aromatic take on H24.
Christine Nagel created it in 2022 around oakmoss, clary sage, sclarene, narcissus and Brazilian rosewood, giving it a green, earthy and softly floral character.
A refined, modern scent for everyday wear.

name: Hermes H24 Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
Hermès H24 is a fresh, green and slightly metallic scent built around clary sage.
Christine Nagel created it in 2021. Clary sage and narcissus meet rosewood and sclarene for a clean, modern scent that feels airy, aromatic and a little mineral.
Light and contemporary, it is made for spring and summer days.

name: Hermes H24 Herbes Vives Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Hermès H24 Herbes Vives is a fresh, cooling blend of herbs and pear.
Christine Nagel created it in 2024. Herbal notes open green, pear adds a juicy heart, and a cooling Physcool note gives it a crisp, refreshing finish.
Light and refreshing for warm days.

name: Hermes Hermessence Agar Ebene Unisex

notes.source_text:
Hermès Agar Ébène is a fresh, woody blend of balsam fir and oud.
Christine Nagel created it in 2018. Balsam fir and oud come together in a sweet, aromatic and smooth woody scent with a cool, resinous feel.
Refined and versatile, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

name: Hermes Hermessence Iris Ukiyoé Eau de Toilette Unisex

notes.source_text:
Hermès Iris Ukiyoé is a soft, powdery blend of iris, orange flower and mandarin.
Jean-Claude Ellena created it in 2010. Iris, orange flower, rose and mandarin come together in a delicate, sweet and airy floral scent.
Graceful and light, it is made for spring and summer days.

name: Hermes Hermessence Oud Alezan Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Hermès Oud Alezan is a soft, rosy oud with rose water.
Christine Nagel created it in 2024. Rose, rose water and oud come together in a smooth, floral and quietly woody scent.
Elegant and versatile, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

name: Hermes Hermessence Rose Ikebana Eau de Toilette Unisex

notes.source_text:
Hermès Rose Ikebana is a fresh, fruity rose with tea and rhubarb.
Jean-Claude Ellena created it in 2004. Cassia, tea, fruity notes, rhubarb, rose, lemon, orange, musk and spices come together in a light, crisp and airy floral scent.
Delicate and fresh, it is made for spring and summer days.

name: Hermes Jour d'Hermes Absolu Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Hermès Jour d'Hermès Absolu is a radiant floral with grapefruit, gardenia and oakmoss.
Jean-Claude Ellena created it in 2014. Grapefruit and apricot blossom open bright, gardenia, florals and jasmine sambac form a lush heart, and woods and oakmoss give it a mossy finish.
Elegant and luminous, it is a lovely everyday scent.

name: Hermes Jour d'Hermes Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Hermès Jour d'Hermès is a fresh, green floral with citrus, gardenia and sweet pea.
Jean-Claude Ellena created it in 2013. Grapefruit, lemon and watery notes open bright, white flowers, gardenia, green notes and sweet pea form an airy heart, and musk and woods give it a soft finish.
Light and elegant, it is a lovely everyday scent.

name: Hermes Kelly Caleche Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Hermès Kelly Calèche is a powdery blend of leather, rose and iris.
Jean-Claude Ellena created it in 2009. Leather, rose, violet, mimosa, iris, vanilla and tuberose come together in a soft, elegant and slightly leathery floral scent.
Refined and graceful, it is a lovely everyday scent.

name: Hermes L’Ambre des Merveilles Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Hermès L'Ambre des Merveilles is a warm blend of amber, vanilla and labdanum.
Jean-Claude Ellena created it in 2012. Amber, vanilla, labdanum and patchouli come together in a soft, powdery and woody amber scent.
Cozy and elegant, it is a great everyday and evening scent.

name: Hermes L'Ombre des Merveilles Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Hermès L'Ombre des Merveilles is a smoky blend of black tea, incense and tonka.
Christine Nagel created it in 2020. Black tea opens green and smoky, incense forms a resinous heart, and tonka bean gives it a warm, sweet finish.
Calm and versatile, it works day or night from spring through fall.

L'Ombre Des Merveilles by Hermès is a Amber Woody fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. L'Ombre Des Merveilles was launched in 2020. The nose behind this fragrance is Christine Nagel. Top note is Black Tea; middle note is Incense; base note is Tonka Bean.

name: Hermes Le Jardin de Monsieur Li Eau de Toilette Unisex

notes.source_text:
Hermès Le Jardin de Monsieur Li is a fresh, airy blend of kumquat, jasmine and mint.
Jean-Claude Ellena created it in 2015. Kumquat, jasmine, mint and green sap come together in a light, watery and serene garden scent.
Calm and refreshing, it is made for spring and summer days.

Le Jardin de Monsieur Li by Hermès is a Citrus Aromatic fragrance for women and men. Le Jardin de Monsieur Li was launched in 2015. The nose behind this fragrance is Jean-Claude Ellena. The fragrance features kumquat, jasmine and mint.

name: Hermes Myrrhe Eglantine Eau de Toilette Unisex

notes.source_text:
Hermès Myrrhe Églantine is a soft, balsamic blend of wild rose and myrrh.
Christine Nagel created it in 2018. Wild rose and myrrh come together in a warm, gently spicy and ambery floral scent.
Delicate and refined, it is a great daytime scent from spring through fall.

name: Hermes Rocabar Eau de Toilette for Men

top: ending on a spicy signature note of cypress
key: ending on a spicy signature note of cypress
notes.source_text:
Hermès Rocabar is a warm, woody blend of cedar, juniper and spice.
Gilles Romey created it in 1998. Cedar, juniper, coriander, bergamot and lemon open fresh, cypress, cardamom, carnation and violet form an aromatic heart, and benzoin, balsam, oakmoss, vanilla and patchouli give it a smooth finish.
Rugged and refined, it is made for fall and winter, day or night.

Rocabar: the name a contraction of “rug” and “à barres” (striped in French), this masculine perfume is inspired by the traditional saffron colored, red and blue striped horse blankets manufactured in Hermès’ saddlery workshops. Signed by Gilles Romey in 1998, the perfume reveals its strongest facets in woody, balm and resin top notes, ending on a spicy signature note of cypress.

name: Hermes Terre d'Hermes Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
Hermès Terre d'Hermès is an earthy, mineral citrus-woody classic.
Jean-Claude Ellena created it in 2006. Orange and grapefruit open bright and bitter, pepper and geranium add a dry, spicy heart, and vetiver, cedar, patchouli and benzoin give it a grounded, woody finish.
Terre d'Hermès is grown-up and understated, a quiet signal of good taste. It is a refined daytime scent for spring and fall and a natural fit for the office.

Terre d’Hermès: conceived in 2006 by Jean-Claude Ellena, Terre d’Hermès is a metaphor for materials, a matrix that speaks of territory as well as matter, earth, and roots.This vertically structured scent is based on an alchemy of wood, the scent first introduces the gaity of orange, the bitterness of grapefruit and the vivacity of pepper and of fresh spices. This “vegetality” flirts with the mineral effect of flint and the coarseness of vetiver. Dominated by cedar, the fragrance goes deeper with the sweetness of resins and the impalpable voluptuousness of benzoin.

name: Hermes Terre d'Hermes Eau Givree Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Hermès Terre d'Hermès Eau Givrée is an icy, citrus take on the Terre d'Hermès line.
Christine Nagel created it in 2022. Citron opens bright and frosty, juniper berries and timur pepper add a cool, peppery heart, and woods and mineral notes give it a crisp, clean finish.
Refreshing and refined, it is a daytime choice for spring and summer.

Terre d'Hermes Eau Givree by Hermès is a Citrus Aromatic fragrance for men. This is a new fragrance. Terre d'Hermes Eau Givree
was launched in 2022. The nose behind this fragrance is Christine
Nagel.
Top note is Citron.
Middle notes are Juniper Berries and Timur.
Base notes are Woody Notes and Mineral notes.

name: Hermes Terre d'Hermes Eau Intense Vetiver Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Hermès Terre d'Hermès Eau Intense Vétiver is a fresh, earthy vetiver with citrus and pepper.
Christine Nagel created it in 2018. Bergamot, lemon and grapefruit open bright, Sichuan pepper and geranium form a spicy heart, and vetiver, olibanum, amberwood and patchouli give it a deep, earthy finish.
A polished daytime scent from spring through fall.

Terre D'Hermes Eau Intense Vetiver is created by Christine Nagel around the notes of vetiver, Sichuan pepper and vetiver. It is a fresher interpretation of the original.
Terre D'Hermes Eau Intense Vetiver was launched in 2018.

name: Hermes Terre d'Hermes Eau Tres Fraiche Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
Terre d'Hermès Eau Très Fraîche is a lighter, citrusy take on Terre d'Hermès.
Jean-Claude Ellena created it in 2014. Water notes, orange and citrus open bright, geranium forms a fresh heart, and cedar, woods and patchouli give it a clean, earthy finish.
Crisp and easy, it is made for spring and summer days.

Terre d'Hermes Eau Tres Fraiche by Hermès is a Woody Aromatic fragrance for men. Terre d'Hermes Eau Tres Fraiche was launched in 2014. The nose behind this fragrance is Jean-Claude Ellena. Top notes are Orange, Citruses and Water Notes; middle note is Geranium; base notes are Woody Notes, Cedar and Patchouli.

name: Hermes Terre d’Hermes Intense Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Hermès Terre d'Hermès Intense is a warmer, darker take on Terre d'Hermès with coffee.
Christine Nagel created it in 2025. Bergamot and black pepper open bright, coffee and licorice form a rich heart, and woods, lava and stone give it a mineral finish.
Versatile in spring, fall and winter, day or night.

name: Hermes Terre d'Hermes Pure Perfume Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Hermès Terre d'Hermès Parfum is the deeper, more mineral version of the earthy classic.
Jean-Claude Ellena created it in 2009. Orange and grapefruit open bright, a flinty mineral note forms the heart, and woods, oakmoss and benzoin give it a grounded, resinous finish.
Refined and versatile, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

Terre d'Hermes Parfum by Hermès is a Woody Chypre fragrance for men. Terre d'Hermes Parfum was launched in 2009. The nose behind this fragrance is Jean-Claude Ellena. Top notes are grapefruit and orange; middle note is flint; base notes are woodsy notes, oak moss and benzoin.

name: Hermes Twilly d'Hermes Eau Ginger Hermes Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Hermès Twilly d'Hermès Eau Ginger is a fresh blend of peony, candied ginger and cedar.
Christine Nagel created it in 2021. Peony opens soft, candied ginger and ginger form a sweet, spicy heart, and cedar gives it a clean, woody finish.
Playful and light, it is a great daytime scent from spring through fall.

name: Hermes Twilly d'Hermes Eau Poivree Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Hermès Twilly d'Hermès Eau Poivrée is a spicy white floral with ginger and tuberose.
Christine Nagel created it in 2017. Ginger, bitter orange and bergamot open bright, tuberose, orange blossom and jasmine form a lush heart, and sandalwood and vanilla give it a creamy finish.
Lively and elegant, it is a lovely daytime scent in spring and fall.

Twilly d’Hermès by Hermès is a Floral fragrance for women. Twilly d’Hermès was launched in 2017. The nose behind this fragrance is Christine Nagel. Top notes are Ginger, Bitter Orange and Bergamot; middle notes are Tuberose, Orange Blossom and Jasmine; base notes are Sandalwood and Vanilla.

name: Hermes Un Jardin a Cythere Eau de Toilette Unisex

notes.source_text:
Hermès Un Jardin à Cythère is a fresh, green blend of olive tree, pistachio and citrus.
Christine Nagel created it in 2023. Olive tree, pistachio, citrus and a green accord come together in a calm, nutty and gently woody scent.
Relaxed and fresh, it is made for spring and summer days.

name: Hermes Un Jardin Apres La Mousson Eau de Toilette Unisex

notes.source_text:
Hermès Un Jardin après la Mousson is a spicy, watery blend of ginger, cardamom and vetiver.
Jean-Claude Ellena created it in 2008. Ginger, ginger flower, cardamom, pepper, coriander, water notes, citrus, vetiver and florals come together in a cool, spicy and fresh scent.
Light and refreshing, it is made for summer days.

Un Jardin après la Mousson: created in 2008, it explores the facets of an unexpected India, when the monsoon restores to the earth what the sun has taken, chasing away the burning breath of drought. Ginger, cardamom, coriander, pepper and vetiver speak of the rebirth of nature captured in Kerala, a universe engorged with water. The nose behind this fragrance is Jean-Claude Ellena.

name: Hermes Un Jardin en Mediterranee Eau de Toilette Unisex

notes.source_text:
Hermès Un Jardin en Méditerranée is a fresh, green blend of citrus, fig leaf and woods.
Jean-Claude Ellena created it in 2003. Bergamot, lemon and mandarin open bright, orange blossom and oleander form a floral heart, and fig leaf, cypress, cedar, juniper, pistachio and musk give it a cool, woody finish.
Light and sunny, it is made for summer days.

Un Jardin en Méditerranée: conceived as a watercolour, this perfume, composed in 2003 is inspired by a hint of the poetic in the Tunisian garden of Leïla Menchari (Director of displays for Hermès). Like a travel journal, it evokes that paradise-like universe of shade,water and light, based on the theme of a fig tree in the morning and Mediterranean citrus. The nose behind this fragrance is Jean-Claude Ellena.

name: Hermes Un Jardin Sous la Mer Eau de Toilette Unisex

notes.source_text:
Hermès Un Jardin sous la Mer is a soft, musky blend of tiare flower, mineral notes and tamanu.
Christine Nagel created it in 2026. Musk, tiare flower, mineral notes and tamanu come together in a creamy, salty and gently sweet floral scent.
Sunny and serene, it is made for summer days.

name: Hermes Un Jardin Sur La Lagune Eau de Toilette Unisex

notes.source_text:
Hermès Un Jardin sur la Lagune is a fresh, marine floral with magnolia and lily.
Christine Nagel created it in 2019. Sea notes, magnolia, woods, lily and pittosporum come together in a breezy, salty and luminous white floral scent.
Light and calm, it is made for spring and summer days.

Hermès presents news coming from the Jardin Collection - Un Jardin sur la Lagune - launching in March 2019. The illustration for the packaging of the new perfume is signed by the famous Bosnian artist Safet Zec. The fragrance is conceived as vibrant, caressing, distinctive and a bit nostalgic.
Un Jardin sur la Lagune leads us to Venice and reveals the magic of a hidden place behind a stone wall. Perfumer Christine Nagel uses floral notes of magnolia and Madonna lily along with sea and wood nuances to conjure up a secret garden on the water. The story is about a mysterious garden that an English Lord built on the water, inside a lagoon in Venice.
Notes: magnolia, pittosporum, Madonna lily, sea breeze, samphire, woody notes.

name: Hermes Un Jardin Sur Le Nil Eau de Toilette Unisex

notes.source_text:
Hermès Un Jardin sur le Nil is a fresh, green blend of green mango and lotus.
Jean-Claude Ellena created it in 2005. Grapefruit, green mango, tomato and carrot open crisp, lotus, bulrush, orange, hyacinth and peony form the heart, and musk, iris, incense and labdanum give it a soft finish.
A refreshing daytime scent for spring and summer.

Un Jardin Sur Le Nil by Hermès is a Floral Fruity fragrance for women and men. Un Jardin Sur Le Nil was launched in 2005. The nose behind this fragrance is Jean-Claude Ellena. Top notes are Grapefruit, Green Mango, Tomato and Carrot; middle notes are Lotus, Bulrush, Orange, Hiacynth and Peony; base notes are Musk, iris, Incense, Labdanum and Cinnamon.

name: Hermes Un Jardin Sur Le Toit Eau de Toilette Unisex

notes.source_text:
Hermès Un Jardin sur le Toit is a fresh, green blend of grass, apple and pear.
Jean-Claude Ellena created it in 2011. Freshly cut grass, red apple, pear, rose, rosemary and magnolia come together in a crisp, natural garden scent.
Light and refreshing, it is made for spring and summer days.

Hermes launches the fourth fragrance from the collection of garden-inspired fragrances Un Jardin, named Un Jardin Sur Le Toit or “A Garden on the Roof” in 2011. Un Jardin Sur Le Toit
refers to the especially luxurious garden located on the Hermes’
headquarters building roof at 24 Rue Faubourg Saint-Honore in Paris.
The garden is full of aromatic herbs, flowers, and fruits whose
flavors vary as they pass through the metamorphosis induced by the
seasons. Its fresh and sweet-smelling atmosphere is captured by apple,
pear, rose, green grass, basil, magnolia, and compost notes.

name: Hermes Voyage d'Hermes Eau de Toilette Unisex

notes.source_text:
Hermès Voyage d'Hermès Eau de Toilette is a fresh, spicy blend of cardamom, lemon and tea.
Jean-Claude Ellena created it in 2010. Cardamom, Amalfi lemon, spices and juniper berries open bright, tea, green notes and florals form an airy heart, and woods, musk and cedar give it a clean finish.
Crisp and versatile, it is made for spring and summer days.

Voyage d'Hermes by Hermès is a Woody Floral Musk fragrance for women and men. Voyage d'Hermes was launched in 2010. The nose behind this fragrance is Jean-Claude Ellena. Top notes are Cardamom, Amalfi Lemon, Spices and Juniper Berries; middle notes are Tea, Green Notes and Floral Notes; base notes are Woodsy Notes, Musk and Cedar.

name: Hermes Voyage d'Hermes Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Voyage d'Hermes Parfum by Hermès is a Woody Floral Musk fragrance for women and men. Voyage d'Hermes Parfum was launched in 2012. The nose behind this fragrance is Jean-Claude Ellena. Top notes are Cardamom, Lemon, Spices and Juniper; middle notes are Tea, Green Notes, Rose, Floral Notes and Hedione; base notes are Woodsy Notes, Musk, Amber and Sandalwood.

name: Hermetica Darkoud Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Hermetica Darkoud is a warm blend of oud, rose and saffron.
Launched in 2019, it pairs oud with rose and saffron for a rich, spicy and smooth floral wood.
Bold and elegant, it is made for fall and winter nights.

name: Hermetica Patchoulight Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Hermetica Patchoulight is a soft, powdery patchouli with rose, violet and iris.
Launched in 2018, it blends patchouli with rose, violet, lemon and iris for a light, elegant and gently woody scent.
Refined and easy, it is a lovely daytime scent in spring, fall and winter.

name: Hermetica Woodysandal Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Hermetica Woodysandal is a warm, powdery blend of sandalwood, clove and iris.
Launched in 2021, it blends sandalwood, clove leaf, cedar, iris, labdanum, vanilla, black currant, ambrette and tonka bean into a creamy, spicy woody scent.
Cozy and refined, it works day or night in fall and winter.

name: Hind Al Oud Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Hind Al Oud is a pure, spicy oud.
Launched in 2021, it centers on oud with a fresh, spicy edge, giving a rich, smoky and woody scent with real depth.
Bold and distinctive, it is a strong choice for cooler days and evenings.

name: Houbigant Duc de Vervins L'Extreme Eau de Parfum for Man

notes.source_text:
Houbigant Duc de Vervins L'Extrême is a classic aromatic blend of citrus, lavender and oakmoss.
Launched in 1991, it opens with bergamot, orange blossom and lemon. Lavender and spices form an aromatic heart, and oakmoss, lavender and amber give it a mossy finish.
Polished and timeless, it is a great everyday scent.

name: Houbigant Quelques Fleurs L'Original Eau de Parfum for Woman

notes.source_text:
Houbigant Quelques Fleurs L'Original is a classic, lush bouquet of over a dozen flowers.
Robert Bienaimé created it in 1913. Green notes, orange blossom, tarragon and citrus open fresh, lilac, jasmine, lily-of-the-valley, rose, tuberose, ylang-ylang, violet, iris and orchid form a rich heart, and oakmoss, honey, musk, sandalwood, amber and vanilla give it a warm finish.
Elegant and timeless, it is a lovely everyday scent.

name: House Of Sillage Benevolence Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
House of Sillage Benevolence is a sweet, soft blend of bitter almond, orange blossom and vanilla.
Francis Camail created it in 2012. Bergamot, star anise and bitter almond open bright, orange blossom, lavender and jasmine form a floral heart, and musk, sugar and Madagascar vanilla give it a powdery finish.
Cozy and elegant, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

name: House Of Sillage Love is in the Air Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
House of Sillage Love Is in the Air is a fruity floral with plum, rose and jasmine.
Mark Buxton created it in 2012. Orange, green notes, plum and citrus open juicy, cedar, rose and jasmine form a floral heart, and white musk and patchouli give it a soft finish.
Romantic and pretty, it is a lovely daytime scent in spring and fall.

name: House Of Sillage Whispers of Innocence for Women

notes.source_text:
House of Sillage Whispers of Innocence is a soft, sweet blend of linden blossom, jasmine and vanilla.
Launched in 2017, it opens with violet leaf and linden blossom. Egyptian jasmine and beeswax form a honeyed heart, and amber and vanilla give it a warm, powdery finish.
Gentle and sweet, it is made for spring and summer days.

name: Huda Beauty Easy Bake Intense Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Huda Beauty Easy Bake Intense is a sweet gourmand of cherry, caramel and cinnamon.
Hamid Merati-Kashani created it in 2026. Cherry opens juicy, caramel, cinnamon, milk and white flowers form a warm, bakery-sweet heart, and vanilla gives it a soft, powdery finish.
Playful and cozy, it works year-round, day or night.

name: Huda Kayali Fleur Majesty Rose Royale 31 Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Huda Kayali Fleur Majesty Rose Royale 31 is a sweet, fruity rose with peach and praline.
Launched in 2025, it opens with pear, peach, mandarin and orange. Peony, rose, violet and magnolia form a pretty floral heart, and vanilla, praline, musk, ambrox and vetiver give it a creamy finish.
Romantic and bright, it is made for spring and summer days.

name: Huda Kayali Vanilla Candy Rock Sugar 42 Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Kayali Vanilla Candy Rock Sugar 42 is a sweet, candy-like blend of vanilla, marshmallow and caramel.
Gabriela Chelariu and Fabrice Pellegrin created it in 2024. Vanilla, pear, marshmallow, rum and ylang-ylang open sweet, bubble gum, jellybean, caramel and jasmine form a playful heart, and sugar, patchouli, tonka, cashmere wood and sandalwood give it a warm finish.
Fun and indulgent, it works year-round, day or night.

name: Hugo Boss Boss Bottled Beyond Eau de Toilette Intense for Men

notes.source_text:
Hugo Boss Bottled Beyond Eau de Toilette Intense is a smooth blend of orange blossom and leather.
Frank Voelkl, Bruno Jovanovic and Daphné Bugey created it in 2026 around orange blossom and leather, giving it a sweet, slightly smoky and polished character.
Easy to wear in every season, day or night.

name: Hugo Boss Boss Bottled Bold Citrus Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Boss Bottled Bold Citrus is a bright, zesty citrus with a clean woody base.
Honorine Blanc and Sophie Labbé created it in 2025. Bergamot and lemon open sparkling, bourbon geranium and elemi resin form an aromatic heart, and vetiver and patchouli give it an earthy finish.
Fresh and energetic, it is made for spring and summer days.

name: Hugo Boss Boss The Scent Le Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Boss The Scent Le Parfum is a warm, leathery blend of maninka, ginger and iris.
Launched in 2022, it opens with maninka and ginger. Iris forms a smooth, powdery heart, and woods and leather give it a rich finish.
Seductive and refined, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

name: Hugo Boss Bottled Absolu Parfum Intense for Men

notes.source_text:
Hugo Boss Bottled Absolu is a dark, smoky leather built for evenings.
Annick Menardo and Suzy Le Helley created it in 2024. Leather and incense open bold and smoky, patchouli and myrrh deepen the heart, and davana and cedarwood leave a resinous, woody trail.
Bottled Absolu is moody and intense, a clear step away from the fresher Boss Bottled styles. It is made for fall and winter nights, when you want something dark and memorable.

name: Hugo Boss Bottled Beyond Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Hugo Boss Bottled Beyond is a fresh, leathery take on Boss Bottled.
Launched in 2025, it opens with ginger, moves into a leather heart and settles into warm woods.
Versatile from spring through fall, day or night.

name: Hugo Boss Bottled Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Boss Bottled Eau de Parfum is a warm, spicy take on Bottled with apple and cinnamon.
Honorine Blanc created it in 2020. Apple, black pepper and bergamot open bright, cinnamon, chestnut and cardamom form a cozy heart, and musk and vetiver give it a clean finish.
Dependable and smooth, it works day or night in spring and fall.

Boss Bottled Eau de Parfum by Hugo Boss is a Woody Spicy fragrance for men. This is a new fragrance. Boss Bottled Eau de Parfum was launched in 2020. The nose behind this fragrance is Honorine Blanc. Top notes are apple, bergamot and black pepper; middle notes are chestnut, cardamom and cinnamon; base notes are vetiver and musk.

name: Hugo Boss Bottled Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
Hugo Boss Bottled is a warm, fruity and woody classic with a touch of cinnamon.
Annick Menardo created it in 1998. Apple, plum, bergamot, lemon, oakmoss and geranium open fresh, cinnamon, mahogany and carnation form a spicy heart, and vanilla, sandalwood, cedar, vetiver and olive tree give it a smooth finish.
Dependable and easy to wear, it is great for the office in spring and fall.

The BOSS man is primed to succeed - competitive, driven &
ambitious. His daily preparation rituals are integral to his personal
quest for success and BOSS BOTTLED has become an established part of his
daily armor. BOSS BOTTLED is an oriental fougere fragrance. Its fresh
top notes include apple and citrus fruits and are balanced in the heart
with a warm spicy middle note dominated by geranium, cinnamon and
cloves. In the base notes, dry spicy scents of sandalwood, vetiver,
cedarwood, olivewood, amber and musk create a distinctly masculine dry
down. BOSS BOTTLED is the encapsulation of BOSS in a fragrance.
Notes: Bergamot, Cinnamon, Tagetes, Geranium, Clove, Cedarwood, Sandalwood, Vetiver, Olivewood.

name: Hugo Boss Bottled Elixir Parfum Intense for Men

notes.source_text:
Hugo Boss Bottled Elixir is a dense, warm blend of incense and woods.
Annick Menardo and Suzy Le Helley created it in 2023. Cardamom and frankincense open warm, patchouli and vetiver form an earthy heart, and labdanum and cedar give it a resinous finish.
A rich choice for cooler days and evenings.

name: Hugo Boss Bottled Infinite Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Boss Bottled Infinite is a fresh, aromatic blend of apple, lavender and sandalwood.
Launched in 2019, it opens with apple, cinnamon, sage and mandarin. Lavender, rosemary and patchouli form an aromatic heart, and sandalwood and olive tree give it a smooth, woody finish.
Easy and versatile, it is a great daytime scent from spring through fall.

Boss Bottled Infinite by Hugo Boss is a Woody Aromatic fragrance for men. This is a new fragrance. Boss Bottled Infinite
was launched in 2019. Top notes are Apple, Cinnamon, Sage and Mandarin
Orange; middle notes are Lavender, Rosemary and Patchouli; base notes
are Sandalwood and Olive Tree.

name: Hugo Boss Bottled Intense Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Boss Bottled Intense is a warm, spicy take on Bottled with vanilla and sandalwood.
Launched in 2015, it opens with apple, orange blossom and bergamot. Cinnamon, clove, cardamom, geranium and lavender form a spicy heart, and vanilla, sandalwood, coumarin, cedar and vetiver give it a rich finish.
Warm and dependable, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

HUGO BOSS Bottled Intense is a Masculine fragrance, The fragrance launched in 2015
Top Note: Apple, Orange Blossom, Bergamot
Heart Note: Cinnamon, Cloves, Cardamom, Geranium, Lavender
Base Note: Vanilla, Sandalwood, Coumarin, Cedar, Vetiver

name: Hugo Boss Bottled Marine Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
Boss Bottled Marine is a cool, fresh blend of frosted apple, mint and cinnamon.
Launched in 2022, it opens with frosted apple and mint. Cinnamon and clary sage form an aromatic heart, and cashmere wood and patchouli give it a warm finish.
Breezy and easy, it works day or night from spring through fall.

Boss Bottled Marine by Hugo Boss is a Woody Aromatic fragrance for men. This is a new fragrance. Boss Bottled Marine was launched in 2022. Top notes are Frosted Apple and Mint; middle notes are Cinnamon and Clary Sage; base notes are Cashmere Wood and Patchouli.

name: Hugo Boss Bottled Night Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
Boss Bottled Night is a soft, woody blend of lavender, birch and violet.
Launched in 2010, it opens with lavender and birch. Violet forms a smooth, powdery heart, and woods and musk give it a quiet, sensual finish.
Relaxed and easy, it is a great evening scent in spring and fall.

Boss Bottled Night by Hugo Boss is a Woody Aromatic fragrance for men. Boss Bottled Night was launched in 2010. Top notes are Lavender and Birch; middle note is Violet; base notes are Woodsy Notes and Musk.

name: Hugo Boss Bottled Oud Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Boss Bottled Oud is a warm, spicy blend of apple, saffron and oud.
Launched in 2015, it opens with apple and citrus. Cinnamon, saffron, clove and labdanum form a rich heart, and oud, sandalwood and cypriol give it a deep, woody finish.
Bold and warm, it is great for date nights and evenings in fall and winter.

Hugo Boss launches a limited edition of its fragrance Boss Bottled from 1998. Boss Bottled Oud
is available at certain retail outlets from May 2015. It represents a
luxurious, high-quality release that contains 100% natural oud.
The scent is described as masculine with a touch of luxury, intense and
opulent, symbolic and refined. It opens with fresh notes of citruses and
apple. The heart includes saffron, clove, cinnamon and labdanum, while
the oriental – wooy based features intensive oud, sandalwood and
cypriola.

name: Hugo Boss Bottled Oud Saffron Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Boss Bottled Oud Saffron is a warm, spicy blend of saffron, cacao and vanilla.
Roja Dove created it in 2016. Lemon opens bright, heliotrope, rose, violet, jasmine and tuberose form a floral heart, and orris root, ginger, cacao, saffron, vanilla, coffee and ambergris give it a rich finish.
Smooth and luxurious, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

name: Hugo Boss Bottled Pacific Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
Boss Bottled Pacific is a salty, sunny blend of coconut, cypress and woods.
Sophie Labbé created it in 2023. Salt, coconut and lemon meet cypress, patchouli, cashmeran and sandalwood for a relaxed, beachy and woody scent.
Easygoing and warm-weather ready, it is a great casual everyday scent.

name: Hugo Boss Bottled Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Boss Bottled Parfum is a smooth, powdery blend of mandarin, orris and leather.
Suzy Le Helley and Annick Menardo created it in 2022. Mandarin and olibanum open bright, orris and fig tree form a soft heart, and leather and cedar give it a warm, woody finish.
Polished and versatile, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

name: Hugo Boss Bottled Sport Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
Boss Bottled Sport is a fresh, aromatic blend of grapefruit, lavender and vetiver.
Calice Becker created it in 2012. Grapefruit and aldehydes open bright, lavender and cardamom form an aromatic heart, and vetiver gives it a clean, woody finish.
Sporty and easy, it is a great everyday scent.

name: Hugo Boss Bottled Striking Lavender Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Hugo Boss Bottled Striking Lavender is a fresh, mineral blend of lavender and moss.
Launched in 2026, it blends lavender and blue lavender with moss, woods and mineral notes for a clean, aromatic scent.
A daytime favorite from spring through fall.

name: Hugo Boss Bottled Tonic Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
Boss Bottled Tonic is a bright, zesty citrus with ginger and spice.
Launched in 2017, it opens with apple, bitter orange, grapefruit and lemon. Ginger, cinnamon, clove and geranium form a spicy heart, and vetiver and woods give it a clean finish.
Fresh and energetic, it is made for spring and summer days.

Boss Bottled Tonic, refreshing and not too intense, is described as an ideal scent for work and for everyday occasions. It contains notes of grapefruit, bitter orange, lemon and apple that provide zestiness at the top, with the spicy heart of ginger and cinnamon. The signature woody base of the fragrance line features a vetiver accord, described as dry, earthy and elegant.

name: Hugo Boss Bottled Triumph Elixir Parfum Intense for Men

notes.source_text:
Boss Bottled Triumph Elixir is a green, earthy blend of violet leaf, vetiver and patchouli.
Annick Menardo and Suzy Le Helley created it in 2024. Violet leaf opens green and crisp, vetiver forms a smoky, earthy heart, and patchouli leaf gives it a deep finish.
Intense and modern, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

name: Hugo Boss Bottled United Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Boss Bottled United is a fresh blend of blood orange, mint and vetiver.
Launched in 2021, it opens with blood orange and buchu. Mint and orris form a cool, powdery heart, and cashmeran, vetiver and patchouli give it a musky, woody finish.
Clean and easy, it is a great daytime scent from spring through fall.

name: Hugo Boss Bottled Unlimited Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
Boss Bottled Unlimited is a fresh, fruity blend of mint, grapefruit and pineapple.
Launched in 2014, it opens with mint, grapefruit and violet leaf. Pineapple, cinnamon and rose form a sweet heart, and labdanum, white musk and sandalwood give it a smooth finish.
Light and cheerful, it is made for spring and summer days.

Boss Bottled Unlimited by Hugo Boss is a Aromatic Fougere fragrance for men. Boss Bottled Unlimited
was launched in 2014. Top notes are Mint, Grapefruit and Violet Leaf;
middle notes are Pineapple, Cinnamon and Rose; base notes are Labdanum,
White Musk and Sandalwood.

name: Hugo Boss Hugo Iced Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
Hugo Iced is a cool, fresh blend of mint, tea and juniper.
Launched in 2017, it opens with mint and tea. Bitter orange and juniper form a crisp heart, and vetiver gives it a clean, woody finish.
Refreshing and easy, it is great for the office, the gym and casual days in spring and summer.

Hugo Boss launches a new fragrance from the Hugo line in January 2017. The new Hugo Iced
is a refreshing aromatic - woody fragrance that supposedly brings a
wave of icy freshness and energy, designed for modern and urban men.
Top notes of iced mint, both sweet and fresh, lead to the heart
dominated by notes of wild tea. The base features woody and green
character of Indian vetiver root.

name: Hugo Boss The Collection Confident Oud Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Boss The Collection Confident Oud is a fresh, spicy take on oud.
Launched in 2021, it centers on oud with an aromatic, fresh and spicy character for a smooth, modern woody scent.
Bold and refined, it is made for winter nights.

name: Hugo Boss The Collection Cotton & Verbena Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
Boss The Collection Cotton & Verbena is a fresh, mossy blend of verbena, vetiver and oakmoss.
Launched in 2011, it blends lemon verbena, vetiver and oakmoss into a crisp, earthy and aromatic citrus scent.
Clean and easy, it is a great everyday scent.

name: Hugo Boss The Collection Daring Saffiano Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Boss The Collection Daring Saffiano is an aromatic blend of davana, osmanthus and leather.
Dominique Ropion created it in 2021. Davana opens fruity, osmanthus and geranium form a floral heart, and leather and patchouli give it a smooth, warm finish.
Refined and distinctive, it is a great everyday scent.

name: Hugo Boss The Collection Sensual Geranium Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Boss The Collection Sensual Geranium is an herbal blend of artemisia, geranium and sandalwood.
Olivia Giacobetti created it in 2021. Artemisia and angelica open green, geranium and rose form a fresh floral heart, and sandalwood and white musk give it a soft, powdery finish.
Calm and refined, it is a great everyday scent.

name: Hugo Boss The Collection Silk & Jasmine Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
Boss The Collection Silk & Jasmine is a sweet, honeyed blend of jasmine, vanilla and clove.
Launched in 2011, it blends white honey, jasmine, vanilla and clove into a warm, smooth and gently spicy floral scent.
Elegant and warm, it is a great everyday and evening scent.

name: Hugo Boss The Scent Elixir Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Hugo Boss The Scent Elixir is a warm, spicy blend of red pepper, lavender and sandalwood.
Launched in 2024, it opens with red pepper, moves into an aromatic lavender heart, and settles into smooth, creamy sandalwood.
Intense and modern, it is made for evenings in spring, fall and winter.

name: Hugo Boss The Scent Le Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Boss The Scent Le Parfum for Her is a warm, sweet blend of orange blossom and pink pepper.
Launched in 2022, it opens with orange blossom and pink pepper. Vetiver forms a smooth heart, and Akigalawood and patchouli give it a warm, woody finish.
Sensual and elegant, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

name: Initio Parfums Absolute Aphrodisiac Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Initio Absolute Aphrodisiac is a warm, sensual blend of vanilla, leather and musk.
Alexandra Kosinski created it in 2015. Vanilla, amber, castoreum, leather and white flowers blend into a rich, animalic warmth, with musk and amber lingering for hours.
Made for fall and winter nights and date nights.

Absolute Aphrodisiac Eau de Parfum is a potent and musky fragrance
from Initio. Soft vanilla is intimately intertwined with animal musk
and castoreum for a truly aphrodisiac essence.
Key notes: Vanilla, musk, castoreum

name: Initio Parfums Addictive Vibration Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Initio Addictive Vibration is a sweet, honeyed floral with soft musk and vanilla.
Maurice Roucel and Pierre-Constantin Guéros created it in 2016. Honey, apple blossom and orange blossom blend with musk and vanilla orchid for a warm, glowing scent that feels both sweet and sensual.
Radiant and inviting, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

Addictive Vibration by Initio Parfums Prives is a Floral fragrance for women. Addictive Vibration was launched in 2016. Addictive Vibration was created by Pierre-Constantin Guéros and Maurice Roucel. The fragrance features apple blossom, orange blossom, vanilla orchid, musk and honey.

name: Initio Parfums Atomic Rose Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Initio Atomic Rose is a bright, modern rose with a creamy vanilla glow.
Launched in 2019, it opens with hedione, bergamot and pink pepper. Bulgarian and Turkish rose with Egyptian jasmine form a lush heart, and Madagascar vanilla and amber give it a soft, warm finish.
Easy to wear year-round, day or night.

Atomic Rose by Initio Parfums Prives is a Oriental Floral fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Atomic Rose
was launched in 2019. Top notes are bergamot, pink pepper and hedione;
middle notes are bulgarian rose, turkish rose and egyptian jasmine; base
notes are madagascar vanilla and amber.

name: Initio Parfums Blessed Baraka Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Initio Blessed Baraka is a soft, powdery blend of amber, musk and sandalwood.
Alberto Morillas created it in 2015. Amber, musk and sandalwood blend into a warm, skin-like and softly powdery scent.
Made for fall and winter, perfect for date nights.

Your aura intoxicates the crowd to madness.
Sandalwood and musk envelop you in a divine adornment, summon luck.
The fragrance is a bittersweet potion
that makes sanity ...
Blessed Baraka was launched in 2015. The nose behind this fragrance is Alberto Morillas.

name: Initio Parfums Can't Get Enough Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Initio Can't Get Enough is a bright, boozy blend of citrus, cognac and cinnamon.
Launched in 2025, it opens with aldehydes, bitter orange, grapefruit, bergamot and lemon. An icy accord and cognac form the heart, and cinnamon, tonka bean, oak and amber give it a warm finish.
