Fresh and versatile, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

name: Initio Parfums Divine Attraction Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Initio Divine Attraction is a smooth blend of leather and vetiver.
Guillaume Flavigny created it in 2015. Leather and vetiver come together in a sensual, earthy and slightly animalic scent with a refined finish.
Confident and intimate, it is perfect for date nights in fall and winter.

From "The absolute" collection, Initio presents their creation "Divine Attraction" - the divine power of attraction. This power may be of divine origin and smoky vetiver recalls the ancient incense offerings to the gods, but this has a very earthly aspect like two people who are magically attracted to each other.
The smoky and slightly wicked double chord of leather and vetiver dominates "Divine Attraction" and fires the most sensual and audacious fantasies. A provocative perfume - worn by a man, it enchants, worn by a woman, it fascinates and bewitches.
Leather and Vetiver blend beauty, strength and the supernatural within an accord that loves to provoke. The fragrance that feeds fantasies.
Ambivalent powers, supernatural vibrations
Ginger electrifies while incense hypnotises
A fragrance to feed fantasies, assault dreams
Bewildering provocation, it intoxicates the senses...
Main accord: leather, vetiver, Cedarwood, Iso E Super

name: Initio Parfums High Frequency Eau de Parfum Unisex

name: Initio Parfums Oud for Greatness Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Initio Oud for Greatness is a bold, spiced oud with saffron and lavender.
Launched in 2018, it opens with saffron, nutmeg and lavender. Oud forms a deep, smoky heart, and patchouli and musk give it a rich, lasting finish.
A statement scent for fall and winter, perfect for date nights.

Oud for Greatness by Initio Parfums Privés is the new fragrance from the Black Gold collection. Based on the purest natural Oud oil in high concentrations, "Oud for Greatness" is a very prestigious Oud with a strong character. Drawing its perfection and energy from the sources of sacred geometry, Oud for Greatness emanates the power of nature, the reawakening of greatness. Rarely the natural essence of oud wood has been so sublimated as in this formula, enhanced by the presence of patchouli and musk, almost wanting to repel any distraction from the senses. Superbly interwoven, surprisingly natural, the oud wood has been managed by the creator in a fresh register (lavender) and spicy (nutmeg, saffron). Oud for Greatness, is a fragrance that enchants and excites, making any dream possible.
Oud for Greatness  Notes
Lavender, Saffron, Nutmeg, Natural Oud Wood, Natural Agarwood oil, Patchouli, Muscs

Psychedelic Love Eau de Parfum from Initio is a highly addictive
fragrance. With its creamy, powdery and floral facets, wavering between
vanilla, almond and heliotropin, Psychedelic Love will drive you
obsessively into addiction.
Eau de Parfum
Top notes: Bergamot, ylang-ylang
Middle notes: Bulgarian rose, heliotrope, hedione
Base notes: Myrrh, sandalwood

name: Initio Parfums Rehab Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Initio Rehab is a clean, aromatic blend of lavender and woods.
Marie Salamagne created it in 2018. Lavender and bergamot open fresh, cedar, vetiver and patchouli form a woody heart, and sandalwood, guaiac wood and musk give it a smooth finish.
Versatile in spring, fall and winter, from everyday wear to date nights.

The Scoop
What is the scent of compulsion? The
fragrance that represents the deepest yearning, desire for which there
is no solution but to give in? We'd find it hard to top Rehab, a
sweet-yet-smoky stunner possessed of an almost primally compelling
magnetism. The perfection lies in the sophisticated simplicity of the
compostion- rich, sophisticated lavender and smoothly spiced tobacco set
a vibrant yet refined tone, masculine-leaning but drop-dead sexy on
just about anybody. As Rehab dries, smoky, creamy patchouli and vanilla
create a warmly ambered aura that lingers for hours. We can't tell you
how to use the dangerously seductive power at your fingertips- but
you've been warned.
Rehab  Notes
Bergamot, lavender, tobacco, cedar, patchouli, gaiac, sandalwood, vanilla, musks

name: Initio Parfums Side Effect Eau de Parfum Unisex

Side Effect is seductive and attention-grabbing, made for fall and winter nights, date nights and evenings out. It suits anyone who loves sweet, boozy scents with a smoky edge.

Thrilling, rich, and deeply sexy,
Side Effect is a harmonious blend of tobacco, vanilla, rum and coffee
that tantalizes the senses and awakens the spirit. Ignited with spices
and anchored by a warm base with elements of leather and woods, it
invites you in with vibrant energy, then soothes and seduces with smooth
confidence. With an undeniable animal magnetism, Side Effect is
guaranteed to garner attention- but maybe that was your intention all
along?
Side Effect  Notes
Tobacco, vanilla, rum, cinnamon

notes.source_text:
Jean Paul Gaultier Le Beau Le Parfum is a sweet, tropical blend of pineapple, coconut and woods.
Quentin Bisch created it in 2022. Pineapple, ginger, iris and cypress open bright, coconut and woods form a creamy heart, and amber, tonka bean, sandalwood and ambergris leave a warm finish.
Fun and inviting, it works in every season, day or night.

name: Jean Paul Gaultier Le Beau Male Intensely Fresh Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
Jean Paul Gaultier Le Beau Mâle Intensely Fresh is a cool, aromatic blend of mint, lavender and sage.
Francis Kurkdjian created it in 2013. Mint and wormwood open cool, lavender, orange blossom and sage form an aromatic heart, and musk gives it a clean finish.
Fresh and easy, it is a great everyday scent.

name: Jean Paul Gaultier Le Beau Narcisse Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Jean Paul Gaultier Le Beau Narcisse is a soft, musky blend of bergamot and tonka.
Launched in 2026, it opens with bergamot, moves into a clean musk heart and settles into a warm tonka finish.
Easy to wear in every season, day or night.

name: Jean Paul Gaultier Le Beau Paradise Garden Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Jean Paul Gaultier Le Beau Paradise Garden is a green, tropical blend of coconut and fig.
Quentin Bisch created it in 2024. Watery notes, green notes, mint and ginger open fresh, coconut, fig and salt form a creamy heart, and sandalwood and tonka bean give it a warm finish.
Fun and fresh, it is perfect for warm days.

name: Jean Paul Gaultier Le Male Airlines Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
Jean Paul Gaultier Le Male Airlines is a collector's edition of Le Male with mint, lavender and vanilla.
Francis Kurkdjian created it in 2020. Cardamom, mint, lavender, bergamot and artemisia open fresh, cinnamon, orange blossom and caraway form a spicy heart, and vanilla, cedar, sandalwood, tonka bean and amber give it a warm finish.
Classic and versatile, it is a great everyday scent.

name: Jean Paul Gaultier Le Male Aviator Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
Jean Paul Gaultier Le Male Aviator is a green, airy blend of mint, violet leaf and woods.
Launched in 2020, it opens with cool mint. Violet leaf forms a green, aquatic heart, and woods give it a clean finish.
Fresh and easy, it works day or night in spring and fall.

Le Male Aviator by Jean Paul Gaultier is a Aromatic Fougere fragrance for men. This is a new fragrance. Le Male Aviator was launched in 2020. Top note is Mint; middle note is Violet Leaf; base note is Woodsy Notes.

notes.source_text:
Jean Paul Gaultier Le Male is the iconic lavender, mint and vanilla fougère.
Francis Kurkdjian created it in 1995. Lavender, mint, cardamom, bergamot and artemisia open fresh, cinnamon, orange blossom and caraway form the heart, and vanilla, tonka bean, amber, sandalwood and cedar give it a warm finish.
Made for fall and winter, from everyday wear to date nights.

The sculpted body is a model of virility and expresses power. LE MALE is strength andsensuality. It gets under your skin. Top notes: Strength expressed by the freshness of mint. Heart notes: Traditional lavender is used with a twist. Reminiscent of old time barber shops, this old classic is revisited in a fresh-warm version. Base notes: The sensuality of vanilla expresses tenderness.
Recommended Use: evening

name: Jean Paul Gaultier Le Male Elixir Absolu Masculine

notes.source_text:
Jean Paul Gaultier Le Male Elixir Absolu is a rich blend of lavender, plum and tonka.
Launched in 2025, it opens with lavender, moves into a juicy plum heart and settles into warm tonka bean.
Made for nights in spring, fall and winter.

name: Jean Paul Gaultier Le Male Elixir Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Jean Paul Gaultier Le Male Elixir is a rich, honeyed take on the Le Male signature.
Launched in 2023, it opens with lavender and mint, moves into a warm heart of vanilla and benzoin, and settles into honey, tobacco and tonka bean for a sweet, intense finish.
Le Male Elixir is sweet and dense, with a honeyed warmth that turns heads. It is a bold choice when you want to make an impression.

name: Jean Paul Gaultier Le Male Essence de Parfum Eau de Parfum

notes.source_text:
Jean Paul Gaultier Le Male Essence de Parfum is a warm, spicy blend of cardamom, leather and vanilla.
Quentin Bisch created it in 2016. Artemisia, cardamom, pepper and bergamot open bright, leather, sage, lavender and cinnamon form an aromatic heart, and costus, vanilla, amberwood, musk and coumarin give it a rich finish.
Seductive and cozy, it works day or night in fall and winter.

Le Male Essence de Parfum by Jean Paul Gaultier is a Oriental Fougere fragrance for men. Le Male Essence de Parfum was launched in 2016. The nose behind this fragrance is Quentin Bisch. Top notes are Cardamom, Pepper, Bergamot and Artemisia; middle notes are Leather, Lavender, Cinnamon and Sage; base notes are Vanilla, Coumarin, Amberwood, Musk and Costus.

name: Jean Paul Gaultier Le Male Holiday Collector Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
Jean Paul Gaultier Le Male Holiday Collector is Le Male's lavender, mint and vanilla in a festive edition.
Francis Kurkdjian created it in 2022. Lavender, mint, cardamom, bergamot and artemisia open fresh, cinnamon, orange blossom and caraway form a spicy heart, and vanilla, tonka bean, amber, sandalwood and cedar give it a warm finish.
Classic and versatile, it is a great everyday scent.

name: Jean Paul Gaultier Le Male In Blue Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Jean Paul Gaultier Le Male in Blue is a sweet, aromatic blend of lavender, anise and benzoin.
Launched in 2026, it opens with lavender. Anise forms a soft, spicy heart, and benzoin gives it a warm, musky and sweet finish.
Smooth and versatile, it works year-round, day or night.

name: Jean Paul Gaultier Le Male In The Navy Eau de Toilette

notes.source_text:
Jean Paul Gaultier Le Male in the Navy is a cool, aquatic blend of mint, sea notes and vanilla.
Nathalie Gracia-Cetto and Quentin Bisch created it in 2018. Mint and watery notes open fresh, sea notes form a breezy heart, and vanilla and ambergris give it a soft, salty-sweet finish.
Easygoing and fresh, it is great for casual days and date nights in spring and summer.

Le Male In The Navy is the embodiment of sexiness. A splash of icy
peppermint invigorated by the salty freshness of an oceanic accord and
contrasted with vanilla and ambergris notes. All of which characterize
the ultimate sexy sailor.
Top Note: Peppermint
Heart Note: Oceanic Accord
Base Note: Vanilla & Amber Gris
Mood: Powerful & Masculine

name: Jean Paul Gaultier Le Male Le Parfum Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Jean Paul Gaultier Le Male Le Parfum is the darker, more elegant evening version of Le Male.
Quentin Bisch and Nathalie Gracia-Cetto created it in 2020. Cardamom opens warm and spicy, lavender and iris form a smooth, powdery heart, and vanilla, warm amber notes and woods give it a rich, creamy finish.
Le Male Le Parfum is smoother and more grown-up than the original, with a creamy warmth that feels made for evenings. It is a strong pick for nights out from fall through spring.

Le Male Le Parfum by Jean Paul Gaultier is a Oriental fragrance for men. This is a new fragrance. Le Male Le Parfum
was launched in 2020. Le Male Le Parfum was created by Quentin Bisch
and Nathalie Gracia-Cetto. Top note is Cardamom; middle notes are
Lavender and iris; base notes are Vanilla, Oriental notes and Woodsy
Notes.

name: Jean Paul Gaultier Le Male On Board Eau de Toilette For Men

notes.source_text:
Jean Paul Gaultier Le Male On Board is a fresh blend of bergamot, geranium and tonka bean.
Christophe Raynaud created it in 2021. Bergamot opens bright, tonka bean and geranium form an aromatic, slightly sweet heart, and amber gives it a warm finish.
Light and easy, it is made for spring and summer days.

Le Male On Board by Jean Paul Gaultier is a fragrance for men. This is a new fragrance. Le Male On Board was launched in 2021. The nose behind this fragrance is Christophe Raynaud. Top note is Bergamot; middle notes are Tonka Bean and Geranium; base note is Amber.

name: Jean Paul Gaultier Le Male Pride Collector's Edition Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
Jean Paul Gaultier Le Male Pride Collector's Edition is a fresh blend of yuzu, blood orange and orange blossom.
Quentin Bisch and Natalie Gracia-Cetto created it in 2022. Yuzu and blood orange open bright, orange blossom and neroli form a sweet floral heart, and musk and white woods give it a soft finish.
Cheerful and easy, it is a great daytime scent from spring through fall.

name: Jean Paul Gaultier Le Male Pride Edition Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
Jean Paul Gaultier Le Male Pride Edition is a bright blend of yuzu, neroli and musk.
Natalie Gracia-Cetto and Quentin Bisch created it in 2022. Yuzu and blood orange open juicy, neroli and orange blossom form a white floral heart, and musk and white woods give it a clean finish.
Fresh and cheerful, it is a great everyday scent.

name: Jean Paul Gaultier Le Male Superman Eau Fraiche Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
Jean Paul Gaultier Le Male Superman Eau Fraîche is a fresh, aromatic blend of mint, sage and vanilla.
Natalie Gracia-Cetto created it in 2017. Mint, aldehydes and neroli open cool, sage, clary sage, amber and woods form an aromatic heart, and vanilla, tonka bean and sandalwood give it a warm finish.
Crisp and easy, it is made for spring and summer days.

Le Male Superman Eau Fraiche by Jean Paul Gaultier is a Aromatic Fougere fragrance for men. Le Male Superman Eau Fraiche was launched in 2017. The nose behind this fragrance is Natalie Gracia-Cetto. Top notes are Mint, Aldehydes and Neroli; middle notes are Sage, Clary Sage, Amber and Woody Notes; base notes are Vanilla, Tonka Bean and Sandalwood.

name: Jean Paul Gaultier Scandal Absolu Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Jean Paul Gaultier Scandal Absolu is a warm blend of tuberose, black fig and sandalwood.
Launched in 2024, it opens with creamy tuberose. Black fig forms a fruity, sweet heart, and sandalwood gives it a smooth, powdery finish.
Sensual and versatile, it works year-round, day or night.

name: Jean Paul Gaultier Scandal By Night Intense Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Jean Paul Gaultier Scandal by Night Intense is a sweet blend of honey, cherry and tuberose.
Daphné Bugey created it in 2018. Honey, bitter orange and citrus open golden, cherry, tuberose, orange blossom, pear and spikenard form a rich heart, and tonka bean, vanilla, patchouli, sandalwood and white musk give it a warm finish.
Seductive and bold, it is a great choice for evenings.

name: Jean Paul Gaultier Scandal Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Jean Paul Gaultier Scandal is a rich, sweet blend of honey, gardenia and caramel.
Daphné Bugey, Fabrice Pellegrin and Christophe Raynaud created it in 2017. Blood orange and mandarin open bright, honey, gardenia, orange blossom, jasmine and peach form a golden heart, and beeswax, caramel, patchouli and licorice give it a warm finish.
Bold and seductive, it is a great choice for evenings.

name: Jean Paul Gaultier Scandal Gold Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Jean Paul Gaultier Scandal Gold is a warm, spicy blend of honey, saffron and leather.
Daphné Bugey, Fabrice Pellegrin and Hamid Merati-Kashani created it in 2021. Honey, saffron and cardamom open warm, cypriol, rose and jasmine sambac form an earthy heart, and sandalwood, leather and patchouli give it a rich finish.
Glamorous and bold, it is a great everyday and evening scent.

name: Jean Paul Gaultier Scandal Le Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Jean Paul Gaultier Scandal Le Parfum is a creamy blend of jasmine, salted caramel and vanilla.
Fabrice Pellegrin, Daphné Bugey and Ane Ayo created it in 2022. Jasmine opens bright, salt and caramel form a sweet, salty heart, and vanilla gives it a smooth, powdery finish.
Indulgent and warm, it works day or night in fall and winter.

name: Jean Paul Gaultier Scandal Pour Homme Absolu Parfum Concentre for Men

notes.source_text:
Jean Paul Gaultier Scandal pour Homme Absolu is a sweet blend of mirabelle, chestnut and sandalwood.
Launched in 2024, it opens with mirabelle plum, moves into a warm chestnut heart and settles into creamy sandalwood.
Made for fall and winter nights.

name: Jean Paul Gaultier Scandal Pour Homme Eau de Toilette For Men

notes.source_text:
Jean Paul Gaultier Scandal Pour Homme is a sweet blend of caramel, tonka bean and clary sage.
Quentin Bisch, Christophe Raynaud and Nathalie Gracia-Cetto created it in 2021. Clary sage and mandarin open fresh, caramel and tonka bean form a rich, sweet heart, and vetiver gives it a clean, earthy finish.
Warm and playful, it is made for fall and winter nights.

Scandal Pour Homme by Jean Paul Gaultier is a Amber Woody fragrance for men. This is a new fragrance. Scandal Pour Homme was launched in 2021. Scandal Pour Homme was created by Quentin Bisch, Christophe Raynaud and Nathalie Gracia-Cetto. Top notes are Clary Sage and Mandarin Orange; middle notes are Caramel and Tonka Bean; base note is Vetiver.

name: Jean Paul Gaultier Scandal Pour Homme Elixir

notes.source_text:
Jean Paul Gaultier Scandal Pour Homme Elixir is a sweet, boozy blend of black cherry, rum and tonka.
Christophe Raynaud, Quentin Bisch, Natalie Gracia-Cetto and Louise Turner created it in 2026. Bergamot, lemon, clary sage and black cherry open bright, lavender, patchouli, rum, geranium and spearmint form the heart, and tonka, vanilla and Akigalawood give it a warm finish.
Seductive and rich, it is made for fall and winter nights.

name: Jean Paul Gaultier Scandal Pour Homme Le Parfum Eau de Parfum

notes.source_text:
Jean Paul Gaultier Scandal Pour Homme Le Parfum is a warm, woody take on Scandal.
Christophe Raynaud, Quentin Bisch and Nathalie Gracia-Cetto created it in 2022. Geranium opens aromatic and fresh, tonka bean brings a sweet, creamy heart, and sandalwood gives it a smooth, woody finish.
Easy to like, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

name: Jean Paul Gaultier So Scandal Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Jean Paul Gaultier So Scandal! is a creamy white floral with raspberry, tuberose and milk.
Fabrice Pellegrin and Daphné Bugey created it in 2020. Raspberry, tuberose, orange blossom, jasmine sambac and a milky accord come together in a sweet, lush and lactonic floral scent.
Playful and sensual, it is a great everyday and evening scent.

name: Jean Paul Gaultier Ultra Male Eau de Toilette

notes.source_text:
Jean Paul Gaultier Ultra Male is a sweet, intense blend of pear, lavender and vanilla.
Francis Kurkdjian created it in 2015. Pear, bergamot, mint, lemon and lavender open fresh and fruity, caraway, clary sage and cinnamon form the heart, and cedar, amber, black vanilla and patchouli give it a rich finish.
Made for fall and winter nights and date nights.

A powerful, virile, and masculine fragrance, this tasty aromatic
enraptures with juicy lemon and pear, powerful black lavender, and
masculine amber wood. It is finished with sensual vanilla for an
experience that is ultra-fresh, ultra-lasting, and ultra-delicious.
"I worked on this new version by reinterpreting the sensuality of the
original fragrance with the codes of our modern era. Gourmand effects,
which Mr. Gaultier loves so much, interplay with modern woody notes and
lavender aromatic notes, the heart of the original fragrance that was
composed in 1995."—Francis Kurkdjian, Perfumer
Dressed for desire, the bottle sports the classic deep blue sailor shirt
and dark black stripes. The metal can appears in a black satin matte
finish with a bold red stamp to call out the rebel bad boy nature of the
eau.
Notes:
Lemon, Pear, Dark Lavender, Amber Wood, Tasty Vanilla.
Style:
Intense. Seductive. Masculine.

name: Jimmy Choo I Want Choo Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Jimmy Choo I Want Choo is a sweet, fruity blend of mandarin, peach and vanilla.
Antoine Maisondieu, Louise Turner and Sonia Constant created it in 2020. Mandarin and peach open juicy, jasmine and red lily form a floral heart, and vanilla gives it a warm finish.
Glamorous and versatile, it works year-round, day or night.

name: Jimmy Choo I Want Choo Forever Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Jimmy Choo I Want Choo Forever is a sweet, fruity blend of cherry, almond and vanilla.
Louise Turner and Sonia Constant created it in 2022. Rose and bitter almond open soft, cherry, vetiver and jasmine form a fruity heart, and vanilla, amber, tonka bean and oakmoss give it a warm finish.
Glamorous and cozy, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

name: Jimmy Choo I Want Choo Le Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Jimmy Choo I Want Choo Le Parfum is a fruity, gourmand blend of pear, blackberry and praline.
Amandine Clerc-Marie and Marie Salamagne created it in 2024. Pear, blackberry and gardenia open juicy, ambrette, jasmine and patchouli form a musky heart, and praline, moss and sandalwood give it a warm finish.
Sweet and versatile, it works year-round, day or night.

name: Jimmy Choo I Want Choo Midnight Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Jimmy Choo I Want Choo Midnight is a fruity blend of berries, orchid and benzoin.
Launched in 2026, it opens with pink pepper, blackberry and black currant. Orchid, rose and violet leaf form a floral heart, and benzoin, cedarwood and Ambrofix give it a smooth finish.
Glamorous and juicy, it is a great everyday and evening scent.

name: Jimmy Choo I Want Choo With Love Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Jimmy Choo I Want Choo With Love is a sweet, fruity floral with raspberry, hibiscus and vanilla.
Amandine Clerc-Marie and Gabriela Chelariu created it in 2025. Orange blossom, mandarin and raspberry open juicy, rose, freesia and hibiscus form a pretty heart, and vanilla, sandalwood and musk give it a soft finish.
Romantic and versatile, it works year-round, day or night.

name: Jimmy Choo Jimmy Choo Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Jimmy Choo Eau de Parfum is a sweet, fruity blend of pear, orchid and toffee.
Olivier Polge created it in 2011. Pear, mandarin and green notes open fresh, orchid forms a soft floral heart, and toffee and patchouli give it a warm, sweet finish.
Glamorous and easy, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

Jimmy Choo by Jimmy Choo is a Chypre Fruity fragrance for women. Jimmy Choo was launched in 2011. The nose behind this fragrance is Olivier Polge. Top notes are Pear, Mandarin Orange and Green Notes; middle note is Orchid; base notes are Toffee and Patchouli.

name: Jimmy Choo Jimmy Choo L'eau Eau de Toilette for Women

notes.source_text:
Jimmy Choo L'Eau is a light, fruity floral with hibiscus, nectarine and peony.
Juliette Karagueuzoglou created it in 2017. Hibiscus and bergamot open fresh, nectarine and peony form a juicy floral heart, and cedar and musk give it a clean finish.
Light and easy, it is a great everyday scent for summer.

The house of Jimmy Choo launches Jimmy Choo L’Eau at the beginning of 2017 as a new edition of the Signature line.
Jimmy Choo L’Eau is signed by perfumer Juliette Karagueuzoglou who explains: “Jimmy Choo L'Eau
captures the scent of a delicious thirst-quenching hibiscus flower
blended with barks, fruits and vibrant woods, to create a radiant
feminine sensuality.” The scent is floral with a hint of fruit and
musk. It opens with notes of bergamot and hibiscus that lead to the
heart of nectarine and peony, based on cedarwood and musk.

name: Jimmy Choo Man Aqua Eau de Toilette

notes.source_text:
Jimmy Choo Man Aqua is a fresh, aromatic blend of grapefruit, clary sage and sea water.
Julien Rasquinet and Paul Guerlain created it in 2022. Grapefruit and cardamom open bright, clary sage and sea water form a cool heart, and moss and patchouli give it an earthy finish.
Crisp and easy, it is made for spring and summer days.

name: Jimmy Choo Man Blue Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
Jimmy Choo Man Blue is an aromatic blend of lavender, leather and vanilla.
Nathalie Lorson created it in 2018. Lavender, black pepper, clary sage and bergamot open fresh, ambergris, leather, cypress, apple and pineapple form the heart, and vanilla, sandalwood, vetiver and patchouli give it a warm finish.
Smooth and versatile, it works day or night from spring through fall.

name: Jimmy Choo Man Extreme Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Jimmy Choo Man Extreme is a warm, aromatic blend of black pepper, thyme and sage.
Anne Flipo created it in 2024. Black pepper and red thyme open spicy, nutmeg, sage and geranium form an aromatic heart, and woods give it a smooth finish.
Confident and versatile, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

name: Jimmy Choo Man Ice Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
Jimmy Choo Man Ice is a cool, crisp citrus with clean woods and musk.
Michel Almairac created it in 2017. Citron, bergamot and mandarin open bright, apple, vetiver, cedar and patchouli form a fresh heart, and musk, ambroxan and moss give it a clean finish.
Fresh and easy, it is made for spring and summer days.

name: Jimmy Choo Man Intense Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
Jimmy Choo Man Intense is a fresh, aromatic blend of melon, lavender and tonka.
Launched in 2016, it opens with melon, lavender and mandarin. Geranium, black pepper and artemisia form the heart, and tonka bean, patchouli and labdanum give it a warm finish.
Easy and smooth, it works day or night in spring and fall.

Jimmy Choo Man Intense by Jimmy Choo is a fragrance for men. Jimmy Choo Man Intense was launched in 2016. Top notes are Melon, Lavender and Mandarin Orange; middle notes are Geranium, Black Pepper and Artemisia; base notes are Tonka Bean, Patchouli and Labdanum.

name: Jimmy Choo Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Jimmy Choo Parfum for Men is a warm, spicy blend of bergamot, black pepper and patchouli.
Launched in 2026, it pairs bright bergamot with black pepper and patchouli for an aromatic, woody and gently spicy scent.
Confident and versatile, it works day or night from summer through winter.

name: Jimmy Choo Rose Passion Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Jimmy Choo Rose Passion is a sweet, creamy floral with frangipani, coconut milk and vanilla.
Nathalie Lorson created it in 2023. Jasmine and frangipani open bright, orchid and coconut milk form a creamy heart, and vanilla and sandalwood give it a warm, powdery finish.
Sunny and pretty, it is made for spring and summer days.

name: Jimmy Choo Urban Hero Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Jimmy Choo Urban Hero is a fresh, peppery blend of finger lime, vetiver and leather.
Launched in 2019, it opens with black pepper and finger lime. Vetiver and rosewood form a woody heart, and leather and ambergris give it a smooth finish.
Modern and versatile, it suits the office and casual days from spring through fall.

Experience the new woody aromatic fragrance Jimmy Choo Urban Hero
Eau de Parfum. Inspired by the urban environment, this scent embodies a
modern man with a contemporary and masculine spirit, revealing the
mysterious and confident Jimmy Choo man.

name: Jimmy Choo Urban Hero Gold Edition Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Jimmy Choo Urban Hero Gold Edition is a sweet blend of pineapple, lavender and tonka.
Juliette Karagueuzoglou created it in 2021. Pineapple and blood orange open juicy, tonka bean and lavender form a sweet, aromatic heart, and sandalwood and oakmoss give it a woody finish.
Smooth and versatile, it works year-round, day or night.

Urban Hero Gold Edition by Jimmy Choo is a Woody fragrance for men. This is a new fragrance. Urban Hero Gold Edition
was launched in 2021. The nose behind this fragrance is Juliette
Karagueuzoglou. Top notes are Pineapple and Blood Orange; middle notes
are Tonka Bean and Lavender; base notes are Sandalwood and Oakmoss.

name: Jo Malone 154 Cologne Unisex

notes.source_text:
Jo Malone 154 is an aromatic blend of citrus, nutmeg and vetiver.
Jo Malone created it in 2001. Grapefruit, bergamot and mandarin open bright, nutmeg, lavender and basil form a spicy, herbal heart, and vetiver, patchouli, musk and vanilla give it an earthy finish.
Refined and versatile, it is a great daytime scent in spring, fall and winter.

name: Jo Malone Amber & Lavender Cologne Unisex

notes.source_text:
Jo Malone Amber & Lavender is a warm, aromatic blend of lavender, clove and amber.
Jo Malone created it in 1995. Lavender, bergamot and mint open fresh, clove, lily-of-the-valley and cinnamon form a spicy heart, and amber, patchouli and myrrh give it a warm finish.
Classic and comforting, it works day or night in spring and fall.

Amber & Lavender by Jo Malone London is a Oriental Fougere fragrance for men. Amber & Lavender was launched in 1995. The nose behind this fragrance is Jo Malone. Top notes are bergamot, lavender and mint; middle notes are lily-of-the-valley, clove and cinnamon; base notes are myrhh, patchouli and amber.

name: Jo Malone Basil & Neroli Eau de Cologne Unisex

notes.source_text:
Jo Malone Basil & Neroli is a fresh, green blend of basil and neroli.
Anne Flipo created it in 2016. Basil opens bright and herbal, neroli forms a clean floral heart, and vetiver and white musk give it a soft finish.
Light and uplifting, it is a great everyday scent for spring and summer.

name: Jo Malone Bitter Mandarin Cologne Unisex

notes.source_text:
Jo Malone Bitter Mandarin is a crisp citrus with mandarin, petitgrain and amber.
Michel Almairac created it in 2022. Bergamot, mandarin and petitgrain open zesty, orange forms a bright heart, and amber and iris give it a soft finish.
Fresh and lively, it is made for spring and summer days.

Bitter Mandarin by Jo Malone London is a Citrus fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Bitter Mandarin was launched in 2022. The nose behind this fragrance is Michel Almairac. Top notes are Bergamot, Mandarin Orange and Petitgrain; middle note is Orange; base notes are Amber and iris.

name: Jo Malone Blackberry & Bay Cologne for Women

notes.source_text:
Jo Malone Blackberry & Bay is a juicy, green blend of blackberry and bay leaf.
Fabrice Pellegrin created it in 2012. Blackberry and bay leaf meet bright grapefruit, soft florals, cedar and vetiver for a fresh, fruity and gently woody scent.
Light and playful, it is made for spring and summer days.

Blackberry & Bay by Jo Malone London is a Floral Fruity fragrance for women. Blackberry & Bay was launched in 2012. The nose behind this fragrance is Fabrice Pellegrin.

name: Jo Malone Bronze Wood & Leather Cologne Intense Unisex

notes.source_text:
Jo Malone Bronze Wood & Leather is a smoky blend of juniper, leather and vetiver.
Launched in 2019, it opens with grapefruit. Smoke and juniper form an aromatic heart, and leather and vetiver give it a dark, woody finish.
Bold and moody, it works day or night in fall and winter.

name: Jo Malone Dark Amber & Ginger Cologne Intense for Women

notes.source_text:
Jo Malone Dark Amber & Ginger Lily is a warm blend of ginger, orchid and black amber.
Andrea Lupo created it in 2008. Ginger, black cardamom and pink pepper open spicy, water lily, orchid, jasmine and rose form a floral heart, and sandalwood, black amber, incense, patchouli and leather give it a rich finish.

Another
Oud evokes all the modernity, exuberance, and grandeur of the Middle
East. The fragrance is a deep woody composition built around an
ultramodern interpretation of the famous ingredient.
"Another Oud? An original name for an original fragrance. A name
evidently playing with the multitude of oud already present on the
market. By saying out loud what people think silently, it draws a
certain curiosity."—Romano Ricci, Brand Founder and Perfumer
Juliette has a gun Another Oud unisex Eau de Parfum is the perfect

Mysterious. Original. Modern.

A
lightly sparkling floral, Anyway goes right back to basics with just 15
of the best ingredients. The blend of musks, woods, and citrus notes
come together for a bright, subtle, and persistent trail. Far from an
anonymous scent, the fragrance is a brand signature, ready to unite with
the feminine as much as the masculine.
"Anyway is not about running away from reality, just adopting a
different state of mind, that of the crazy optimist…anyway."—Romano
Ricci, Brand Founder and Perfumer
Juliette has a gun Anyway unisex Eau de Parfum is the perfect

name: Juliette Has a Gun Lady Vengeance Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Juliette Has a Gun Lady Vengeance is a rich rose with patchouli and soft vanilla.
Francis Kurkdjian created it in 2006. Lavender and bergamot open fresh, Bulgarian and Moroccan rose, patchouli and geranium form a deep heart, and white musk, ambroxan and vanilla give it a smooth finish.
Bold and romantic, it suits everyday wear and date nights in spring, fall and winter.

The Scoop
Elegant yet bristling with wild, thorny rose, Lady Vengeance hides its claws under velvety rose petals, soft patchouli and seductive vanilla. She's not a dominatrix in leather…this beauty is clad in a waist cinching, blood red corset, silk stockings and carries a satin whip. Sly and charming under her rosy exterior, Lady Vengeance lays waste to the non-believers in the seductive powers of rose by wrapping her legs around an earthy patchouli and dipping her fingers in the time honored man slayer of golden vanilla, a combination that's impossible to deny. Resistance is futile!
Lady Vengeance  Notes
Bulgarian rose, vanilla, patchouli

Juliette Has a Gun Mad Madame is a rich rose with black currant, patchouli and castoreum.
Launched in 2012, it opens with rose, black currant, amber and freesia. Patchouli, moss, tuberose, peony and jasmine form the heart, and castoreum, white musk, tolu balsam and vanilla give it a leathery finish.

Audacious

notes of rose oxyde, blackcurrant bud absolute, and woody, modern
ambroxan. Fusing explosive and feminine traits, it leaves no doubt about
its intentions. Mad Madame has the knack of getting herself talked
about, and she likes it.

name: Juliette Has a Gun Midnight Oud Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:

Romano Ricci created it in 2009. Damask rose, saffron, papyrus and bergamot open bright, oud, Moroccan rose, castoreum and geranium form a deep heart, and patchouli, musk, amber and sandalwood give it a warm finish.

This
woody, sensual fragrance captures the danger and seduction of the
midnight hour. It captivates the senses, mixing majesty and allure into
the mysterious character of oud. The hallmark is a unique blend of
luxurious amber and invigorating patchouli built around the complexity
and deepness of oud wood.

Rose, Saffron, Oud, Amber, Sandalwood.

Sensual. Seductive. Mysterious.

Fun and easy, it is great for everyday wear, the office and the gym in spring.

Miss
Charming is a fragrance that embodies a young, natural, and charmingly
innocent woman who is nonetheless surprising. The sweetness of rose and
ripe fruit plays over a bewitching base of musk. One of the first
fragrances in the collection, Miss Charming encompasses the
juxtaposition of the modern woman: innocence and sultriness.
”The perfume of a virgin witch, docile and provocative, elegant and
sensual. At first glance, the miss appears rather innocent. But don't
trust your intuition...If she's a rose, don't forget she got
spines.”—Romano Ricci, Brand Founder and Perfumer
Juliette Has a Gun Miss Charming Eau de Parfum is a feminine fragrance that will make you are unforgettable wherever you go.
Notes:
Moroccan Rose, Musk, Wild Fruits.
Style:
Musky. Floral. Fruity.

name: Juliette Has a Gun Mmmm... Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Juliette Has a Gun Mmmm... is a soft, powdery floral with vanilla and caramel.
Romano Ricci created it in 2016. Raspberry, geranium and neroli open bright, tuberose, iris, orange blossom and jasmine sambac form a creamy heart, and vanilla, caramel, sandalwood, heliotrope and musk give it a sweet finish.
Comforting and versatile, it suits the office, everyday wear and date nights in fall and winter.

For
a sheer bliss, mix 10 grams of distilled neroli, an ounce of jasmine
sambac, and a knob of iris butter. Melt a little caramel, add some fresh
raspberries, and slowly bring to the boil. Gently stir in a pinch of
ground Sandalwood and a dash of patchouli, sprinkle a few grams of icing
sugar, and whisk until a delicious sigh is achieved.
The bottle awakens the senses and waters the mouth. Its bright pink
hue seduces the gaze, while its matte finish charms the hand. Beyond the
opacity of the bottle, like an impenetrable window, is a sensual force
of attraction that only a few silvery letters can express.
Juliette has a gun Mmmm... Eau de Parfum is a feminine fragrance that will make you are unforgettable wherever you go.
Notes:
Vanilla, Neroli, Sandalwood, Jasmine Sambac.
Style:
Delicious. Sensual. Elegant.

This minimalist, fresh, and clean fragrance is hypoallergenic and ideal
for those who don’t normally wear perfume. It is composed of a single
note, called cetalox, which is usually used in perfumery as a base note.
Here it plays the lead role for a fragrance that will easily satisfy
the most difficult tastes, and particularly those preferring discretion
over complexity.
Juliette has a gun Not a Perfume Eau de Parfum is a feminine fragrance that will make you are unforgettable wherever you go.
Fragrance Family:
Woody & Earthy
Scent Type:
Warm Woods
Key Notes:
Cetalox (Synthetic Ambergris)

name: Juliette Has a Gun Romantina Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Juliette Has a Gun Romantina is a soft, powdery rose with iris and musk.
Romano Ricci created it in 2011. Turkish rose and bergamot open bright, patchouli, iris, orange blossom, vetiver and tuberose form a soft heart, and musk, Cetalox, castoreum, vanilla, tonka bean and benzoin give it a warm finish.

Romantina
is a musky composition upon which is laid a delicate bouquet of white
flowers. It begins as an ode to insouciance, but suddenly reveals its
true personality, flirting with patchouli and sweet notes. The result is
an elegant floral fragrance that is reminiscent of a modern romance. It
is the portrait of a free woman who loves to seduce.
Notes:

name: Juliette Has a Gun Sunny Side Up Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:

Romano Ricci created it in 2017. Vanilla absolute, amyris and jasmine open warm, sandalwood, coconut milk and orris root form a creamy heart, and Iso E Super and ambrette give it a soft, musky finish.

The perfume envelops and comforts in the same way the midday sun warms
the skin. Top notes of amyris sandalwood and lactones are lengthened on a
sandalwood cream accord as the heart note. The impression concludes
with ambrette and vanilla absolute as the base notes. The addictive
scent features a gourmand facet, honored at its heart by iris butter and
sambac jasmine notes.
Juliette has a gun Sunny Side Up Eau de Parfum pays homage to
natural beauty, femininity and elegance. It perfectly accentuates your
natural charm and relaxed sophistication.

Warm & Spicy
Scent Type:
Cool Spices
Key Notes:
Sandalwood, Musk

name: Lalique Encre Noire A L'Extreme Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Lalique Encre Noire à l'Extrême is a deep, resinous vetiver.
Nathalie Lorson created it in 2015. Cypress, elemi and bergamot open fresh, Haitian vetiver, incense and orris form the heart, and benzoin, sandalwood and patchouli give it a warm finish.
Made for fall and winter, perfect for date nights.

As the new successor to fragrance Encre Noire by Lalique presented in 2006, the market welcomes ENCRE NOIRE A L'Extreme,
an intense masculine edition available since October 2015. With its
design, the new edition reminds us of the famous "Encrier" designed by
Rene Lalique in 1913, which served for design of the first
fragrance Encre Noir and its successors Encre Noire Pour Elle in 2009
and Encre Noire Sport in 2013. The latest edition after moving towards a
lighter interpretation and ‘sporty’ version of the original, the accent
is now placed on intensive woodsy blend of cypress and vetiver.

name: Lalique Encre Noire Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
Lalique Encre Noire is a dark, earthy blend of cypress, vetiver and cashmere wood.
Nathalie Lorson created it in 2006. Cypress opens green and woody, vetiver forms a smoky, earthy heart, and cashmere wood and musk give it a smooth finish.

name: Lalique Encre Noire Sport Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:

name: Lalique Pour Homme Eau de Parfum for Men

Polished and versatile, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

Lalique Pour Homme by Lalique is a Woody Aromatic fragrance for men. Lalique Pour Homme was launched in 1997. The nose behind this fragrance is Maurice Roucel. Top notes are Lavender, Rosemary, Grapefruit, Bergamot, Pomelo, Mandarin Orange and Tangerine; middle notes are Cedar, iris, Lily-of-the-Valley and Jasmine; base notes are Oakmoss, Sandalwood, Vanilla, Patchouli and Amber.

name: Lalique Pour Homme Eau de Toilette for Men

name: Le Labo Another 13 Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:

Another 13 is subtle up close but leaves a soft, addictive trail that people often ask about. It is easy to wear every day in spring, summer and fall, and it layers beautifully with other scents.

Another 13 by Le Labo is a Amber Woody fragrance for women and men. Another 13 was launched in 2010. The nose behind this fragrance is Nathalie Lorson.

Rose 31 by Le Labo is a Floral Woody Musk fragrance for women and men. Rose 31 was launched in 2006. The nose behind this fragrance is Daphne Bugey. Top notes are Rose and Cumin; middle notes are Rose, Vetiver and Cedar; base notes are Musk, Guaiac Wood, Agarwood (Oud), Olibanum and Labdanum.

name: Le Labo Santal 33 Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Le Labo Santal 33 is the creamy, smoky sandalwood that became a modern cult favorite.
Frank Voelkl created it in 2011. Sandalwood, papyrus and cedar are warmed by cardamom, violet and iris, with a leathery, slightly smoky edge that settles into a soft amber-woody finish.
Santal 33 is comforting and instantly recognizable, a unisex signature that works for the office and everyday wear. It is at its best from spring through winter, day or night.

The man, firelight in his face, leaning on the worn leather saddle,
alone with the desert wind—an icon so powerful that every man wanted to
be him and every woman wanted to have him. From this memory is born
Santal 33, the ambition to create an olfactive form inspired by the
great American myth that is still a source of fantasy for the rest of
the world. A perfume that touches the sensual universality of this icon,
that would intoxicate a man as much as a woman. It introduces the
brand's use of cardamom, iris, violet and ambrox, which crackle in the
formula and bring to this smoking wood alloy—Australian sandalwood,
papyrus, cedarwood—some spicy, leathery, musky notes and gives this
parfum its unisex signature and addictive comfort. Here is, in a few
words, what Santal 33 is. An open fire. The soft drift of smoke. Where
sensuality rises after the light has gone.
Notes:
- Top: violet accord, cardamom.
- Middle: iris, papyrus, ambrox.
- Base: cedarwood, leather, sandalwood.

name: Le Labo Tabac 28 Miami Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Maison Francis Kurkdjian À la Rose is a fresh, luminous rose.
Francis Kurkdjian created it in 2014. Calabrian bergamot and California orange open bright, Bulgarian and Grasse rose, violet and magnolia form the heart, and cedar and musk give it a soft finish.
A daytime favorite for spring and summer.

À la rose is a declaration of love
for all women captured in a fragrance. Queen of flowers, the rose knows
no boundaries and has inspired those in the creative arts for centuries.
Poets, painters, musicians... and perfumers alike. All have sought to
capture its aura, its magic and its secrets.
Two varieties of rose have bestowed the radiance and richness of
their petals on this Eau de parfum: two hundred and fifty Centifolia
roses from Grasse (May Rose) in the form of an absolute produce a very
floral base note with sweet honeyed and carnal accents. One hundred and
fifty Damascena roses from Bulgaria in the form of an essential oil
create a top note with a playful blend of pear and lychee. À la rose has
the crisp tenderness of rose petals, a whimsical free-spirited style
and an elegance that radiates femininity.
A La Rose  Notes
Damascena rose, bergamot, orange, violet, magnolia blossom, cedar, musk, Centifolia rose.

name: Maison Francis Kurkdjian Amyris Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Maison Francis Kurkdjian Amyris Femme is a soft, woody blend of citrus, amyris and iris.
Francis Kurkdjian created it in 2012. Lemon blossom and California orange open bright, amyris and iris form a smooth heart, and vetiver, musk and amber give it a warm finish.
Elegant and easy, it is great for everyday wear, the office and the gym in spring and summer.

Francis Kurkdjian conceives his
fragrances with people in mind, and what he wanted for Amyris femme was
to express the quintessence of the Parisian woman, which he defines as
primesautière, a word that means “perky” and “impulsive”.
He also conceives his collection as a fragrance wardrobe for
every moment of the day and with the Amyris his'n'hers duo, he wanted
scents that could be shrugged on for daywear: chic, but comfortable
enough not to demand major commitment before spritzing.
Amyris is a wood formerly known as West Indies sandalwood, which
draws its name from the Greek amyron, “intensely fragrant”: it was in
rediscovering its scent during exercises with his apprentice that
Francis Kurkdjian was inspired to use it. The word itself included
“iris”, which yields the core accord of the fragrance: orris butter – a
high-quality variety with no rooty-earthy facets – and amyris, which
teeters between sandalwood and cedar. To make the austere iris smile
like an impish Parisienne, the perfumer wraps it in a sweet, plush lemon
blossom and leaves accord and dabs it with a powder puff.
Amyris femme is a Holly Golightly of a fragrance, which sparkles
and charms without trying too hard. Slip into it for the office, and
it'll carry you effortlessly into champagne hour.
Amyris Pour Femme  Notes
Californian orange, Jamaican amyris, Florentine iris, Haitian vetiver, musky amber

Amyris is a luminous fragrance steeped in natural, urban elegance, reflecting a vibrant parisian lifestyle. In this new Extrait de parfum composition, Francis Kurkdjian infused new energy to the duo featuring amyris from Jamaica and iris from Florence: a floral-sunny accent for her, heightened by jasmine absolute, a playful whirlwind of the senses. Made in France.
NOTES
Mandarin blossom
Pear accord
Jasmine absolute from Egypt
Iris oil from Florence
Amyris oil from Caribbean
Woody ambery accord

name: Maison Francis Kurkdjian Amyris Homme Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
Maison Francis Kurkdjian Amyris Homme is a smooth, creamy woody fragrance.
Francis Kurkdjian created it in 2012. Sicilian mandarin and rosemary open fresh, amyris, iris, coconut, milk chocolate and coffee form a soft heart, and tonka bean and oud give it a warm finish.
Easy to wear from spring through fall, from everyday to date nights.

The Scoop
Francis Kurkdjian conceives his fragrances with people in mind, and what he wanted for Amyris homme was to express the quintessence of the good-bad guy. He also conceives his collection as a fragrance wardrobe for every moment of the day and with the Amyris his'n'hers duo, he wanted scents that could be shrugged on for daywear: chic, but comfortable enough not to demand major commitment before spritzing.
Amyris is a wood formerly known as West Indies sandalwood, which draws its name from the Greek amyron, “intensely fragrant”: it was in rediscovering its scent during exercises with his apprentice that Francis Kurkdjian was inspired to use it. The word itself included “iris”, which yields the core accord of the fragrance with amyris, which straddles cedar and sandalwood.
Amyris homme plays on the tough-tender duality with an aromatic opening brightened by a squirt of mandarin. For his iris note, the perfumer uses iris resinoid, which develops striking dark chocolate facets. It is this non-gourmand chocolate effect that Amyris homme plays on to express dusky masculine tenderness by setting the iris resinoid in a coconut, coffee and tonka bean, with its hay and tobacco facets suffused with a bitter-almond flavor.
Unapologetically masculine – but with a twist – Amyris homme is as easy to slip on as a favorite white shirt and jeans outfit, yet chic enough to carry you into the cocktail hour. A classic.
Amyris Pour Homme  Notes
Moroccan rosemary, Sicilian mandarin, Jamaican Amyris, Florentine Iris, Brazilian Tonka bean absolute, modern woods

name: Maison Francis Kurkdjian Amyris Homme Extrait de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Maison Francis Kurkdjian Amyris Homme Extrait is a smooth blend of amyris, iris and spice.
Francis Kurkdjian created it in 2019. Amyris, Sicilian mandarin, saffron and cinnamon open warm, Tuscan iris forms a soft heart, and tonka bean and vanilla give it a creamy finish.
A refined daytime scent from spring through fall.

Amyris is a luminous fragrance steeped in natural, urban elegance,
reflecting a vibrant Parisian lifestyle. In this new Extrait de parfum
composition, Maison Francic Kurkdjian infused new energy to the duo
featuring amyris from Jamaica and iris from Florence: a floral-sunny
accent for her, heightened by jasmine absolute, and an ambery-woody note
for him, enhanced by the warmth of a spicy vanilla. The Amyris Extrait
de parfum couple conjures two liberated silhouettes in a playful
whirlwind of the senses, for him and for her.

name: Maison Francis Kurkdjian Aqua Celestia Eau de Toilette Unisex

notes.source_text:
Maison Francis Kurkdjian Aqua Celestia is a fresh, green blend of lime, mint and mimosa.
Francis Kurkdjian created it in 2017. Lime, mint, black currant and neroli open crisp, mimosa, green notes and rose form a soft heart, and white musk gives it a clean finish.
Light and airy, it is great for everyday wear, the office and the gym in spring and summer.

The Scoop
While his beloved creations now span
across every conceivable fragrance family, from gourmand orientals to
dark, modern florals, we'll always think of Francis Kurkdjian first and
foremost as the creator of impossibly lovely, ultra-fresh musks that
you'd wish your entire life could smell like. And with Aqua Celestia,
the master gives us another all-encompassing musk obsession, a rich yet
delicate blend of air and sea freshness, spiked with lime and cool mint,
caressed by tart, juicy blackcurrant, softened with deliciously full
mimosa blossoms from Provençe. Plenty of fragrances advertise themselves
as versatile, but you genuinely can't go wrong here- spray it over
jeans and a t-shirt for a casually sexy burst of style, marvel at how
intimate and confident it presents with formalwear, or even spritz it
over your sheets for a truly lovely slumber. Francis Kurkdjian will
doubtlessly continue to innovate and push boundaries as his legend grows
ever larger, but between us, we hope he never abandons lovely,
perfectly fresh scents like Aqua Celestia.
Aqua Celestia  Notes
Lime, cool mint mitcham, blackcurrant bud absolute, mimosa absolute, musk accord

name: Maison Francis Kurkdjian Aqua Celestia Forte Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Maison Francis Kurkdjian Aqua Celestia Forte is a richer take on Aqua Celestia with lime and mimosa.
Francis Kurkdjian created it in 2018. Lime, petitgrain, lemon and mint open fresh, black currant blossom, jasmine, hedione, mimosa and lily-of-the-valley form a soft heart, and musk gives it a clean finish.
Fresh and airy, it is great for everyday wear, the office and the gym in spring and summer.

Gazing at the horizon in an ambiance of absolute serenity, you notice a dazzling space between the blue of the sky and the blue of the sea. It widens to allow a sparkling sun to burst forth, featuring accents of petitgrain and jasmine. Aqua Celestia forte embodies the radiance of a fresh, citrusy fragrance.
Lime from MexicoCool Mint (Mitcham)Petitgrain Bigarade from ItalyBlackcurrant bud absolute from BurgundyMimosa absolute from ProvenceJasmine absolute from EgyptMusk accord

name: Maison Francis Kurkdjian Aqua Universalis Eau de Toilette Unisex

notes.source_text:
Maison Francis Kurkdjian Aqua Universalis is a clean, sparkling blend of citrus and white flowers.
Francis Kurkdjian created it in 2009. Lily of the valley, Amalfi lemon, bergamot and orange blossom open fresh, and musk and light woods give it a pure, clean finish.
Easy to wear for spring and summer days, the office and everyday.

The name is Latin for Universal Water,
and the scent does what it says on the bottle. Francis Kurkdjian calls
it the missing link between skin, clothes, bed linen and the air and
he's spot on. This light, sparkling eau de toilette could be spritzed by
anyone, anywhere, anytime – but you'll probably want to save it for
your skin, since you can scent your house with the Aqua Universalis
candle or incense paper, and launder your clothes with the matching
detergent.
With its sweet-as-a-kiss orange blossom and lily of the valley
bouquet, brightened with citrus notes and a burst of aldehydes on a
cottony cloud of white musks, Aqua Universalis is possibly the most
refined interpretation ever of the fresh-out-of-the-shower,
fresh-out-of-the-dryer smell. In a word, the ultimate stealth scent.
Aqua Universalis  Notes
Bergamot, Sicilian lemon, lily of the valley, sweet mock orange, light and musky woods.

name: Maison Francis Kurkdjian Aqua Universalis Forte Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Maison Francis Kurkdjian Aqua Universalis Forte is a fresh blend of lemon, white flowers and musk.
Francis Kurkdjian created it in 2011. Amalfi lemon and bergamot open bright, white flowers, jasmine and rose form a soft heart, and musk and woods give it a clean finish.
Clean and easy, it is great for everyday wear and the office in spring and summer.

An aerial fragrance, at once light
an powerful, like gold in the summer. With an exceptional concentration
of 40%, it is on a par with a perfume extract.
The olfactory composition has the same "sunny" emotions of the
"classical" Aqua Universalis, but adds sparkle and intensity to its
citrus charm. The nobility of its bouquet of white flowers is elevated
by absolutes of rare Egyptian jasmin flower and Moroccan roses.
The result is a fabulous, precious "sillage" or lingering trail left by this precious eau de parfum.
Aqua Universalis Forte  Notes
Bergamot, Sicilian citron, bouquet of white flowers, absolutes of Egyptian jasmin flowers and Moroccan roses, light woods.

name: Maison Francis Kurkdjian Aqua Vitae Forte Eau de Parfum Unisex

top: to complement the vibrant citrus blend of Sicilian mandarin
key: to complement the vibrant citrus blend of Sicilian mandarin
notes.source_text:
Maison Francis Kurkdjian Aqua Vitae Forte is a sunny, spicy citrus with ylang-ylang and vetiver.
Francis Kurkdjian created it in 2015. Lemon, cardamom, mandarin, cinnamon, bergamot and pink pepper open bright, ylang-ylang and orange blossom form a golden heart, and sandalwood and Haitian vetiver give it a woody finish.
Radiant and easy, it is great for everyday wear, the office and the gym in spring and summer.

Francis Kurkdjian's original Aqua
Vitae EDT has long been a favorite of ours here at Luckyscent- a clean,
fresh, incredibly bright citrus fragrance that captures the spirit of
summer sunshine without ever falling back on “beachy” cliché. So we're
beyond thrilled to report that Aqua Vitae Forte, a new, stronger version
of the beloved original, shines even more brightly than its
predecessor. So what's changed for this new edition? For starters, a
dynamic bouquet of spices- cinnamon, cardamom and pink pepper- in the
top notes to complement the vibrant citrus blend of Sicilian mandarin,
Calabrian bergamot and bright, zesty lemon. In the enhanced floral
heart, Tunisian orange blossom extract and sweet ylang deliver rich,
sumptuous depth, setting up the velvety woods of the drydown, now
infused with rich vetiver. Bright, beautiful, and now strong enough to
bring out the summer rays even in the dreary dead of winter, Aqua Vitae
Forte is the kind of delight that will have you smiling all day long.
Aqua Vitae Forte  Notes
Mandarin, bergamot, lemon, cinnamon, cardamom, pink pepper, ylang-ylang, orange blossom, sandalwood, vetiver

name: Maison Francis Kurkdjian Baccarat Rouge 540 Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:

Francis Kurkdjian created it in 2015. Saffron and jasmine open with an airy glow, amberwood and ambergris give the heart its signature radiance, and fir resin and cedar add a crisp, woody finish.
Light, airy and unmistakable, it leaves a sweet, mineral trail that lingers in a room. It is unisex and easy to wear day or night in spring, fall and winter, and a sample is the perfect way to see how it develops on your skin.

Baccarat Rouge 540 by Maison Francis Kurkdjian is a Oriental Floral fragrance for women and men. Baccarat Rouge 540
was launched in 2015. The nose behind this fragrance is Francis
Kurkdjian. Top notes are Saffron and Jasmine; middle notes are Amberwood
and Ambergris; base notes are Fir Resin and Cedar.

Francis Kurkdjian released the extrait in 2017. Bitter almond and saffron open with a glowing warmth, Egyptian jasmine and cedar form the heart, and ambergris, woods and musk leave the radiant amber trail the fragrance is known for.
It is denser and sweeter than the eau de parfum, with more almond and a deeper amber glow. Wear it for date nights, special evenings or everyday luxury in spring, fall and winter, day or night.

name: Maison Francis Kurkdjian Feminin Pluriel Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Maison Francis Kurkdjian Féminin Pluriel is a powdery floral with iris, violet and rose.
Francis Kurkdjian created it in 2014. Iris, rose, violet, lily-of-the-valley and orange blossom open soft, iris, jasmine and orange blossom form a floral heart, and patchouli and vetiver give it a gentle, earthy finish.
Elegant and graceful, it is a lovely everyday scent in spring.

Pluriel. A beautiful creation
composed of a multitude of facets, designed to evolve with freedom and
sensuality, unbound from fleeting fashions. A challenge to time and a
search for timelessness, the recognizable quality of major classics.
Féminin Pluriel is a grand floral bouquet that unfolds from
Florentine iris to violet, from Grasse rose to Egyptian jasmine, from
lily-of-the-valley to orange blossom. It is upheld by the simplicity of
chypre accents blending a vetiver note with Indonesian patchouli.
Feminin Pluriel  Notes
Iris, violet, rose, jasmine, lily-of-the-valley, orange blossom, vetiver and indonesian patchouli leaf

name: Maison Francis Kurkdjian Grand Soir Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Maison Francis Kurkdjian Grand Soir is a warm, glowing amber made for evenings.
Francis Kurkdjian created it in 2016 around Spanish labdanum, Siam benzoin, tonka bean and vanilla. The result is a smooth, resinous amber that feels plush and enveloping from the first spray to the last hours of wear.
Grand Soir is like a cashmere coat in fragrance form, warm, plush and polished. It is made for fall and winter nights, special dinners and anyone who loves rich amber scents, and it is soft enough for everyday luxury too.

Dress in your finest attire and polish your look. Wander in a never-ending night and enjoy the daring radiance of a magnificent Parisian evening, over and over again. Bridges and monuments shine like a thousand stars, standing majestic in a twilit sky carried away by the soft vanilla warmth of benzoin from Siam and a tonka bean from Brazil that has been jostled by the deep darkness of cistus labdanum from Spain.
Cistus Labdanum from Spain
Benzoin from Siam
Tonka bean from Brazil
Vanilla and amber accord

A trademark of major men's fragrance classics, the fougère accord is reinterpreted into a timeless version. The quest for an eternal masculine, a challenge to time and a search for timelessness.
Grapefruit from California
Lemon from Sicily
Lavender absolute from Provence
Soft leathery accord
Cedar wood from Morocco
Patchouli from Indonesia
Vetiver from Haiti

name: Maison Francis Kurkdjian Oud Cashmere Mood Extrait de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Maison Francis Kurkdjian Oud Cashmere Mood is a warm, balsamic blend of oud, labdanum and vanilla.
Francis Kurkdjian created it in 2013. Oud, labdanum, benzoin and vanilla come together in a smooth, ambery and velvety scent.
Rich and sensual, it is perfect for date nights in fall and winter.

Kurkdjian imagined the OUD mood
collection as feelings, sensations, rather like those one would have
when wrapped in a fragrant stole. They play on shimmer, comfort and
warmth. They are precious, intense and concentrated.
This Oriental fragrance is woven with all the gentleness of a
“second skin”, soft and balmy. The Oud is enhanced with Moroccan
labdanum, Laotian benzoin and vanilla, creating a tender, yet animalic
experience. Quite extraordinary.
Oud Cashmere Mood  Notes
Labdanum from Morocco, Benzoin, Oud from Laos, Vanilla

notes.source_text:
Maison Francis Kurkdjian Oud is a smooth, spicy oud with saffron, elemi and woods.
Francis Kurkdjian created it in 2012. Saffron and elemi open bright and resinous, and oud, cedar and patchouli give it a warm, dry and refined woody depth.
Elegant and warm, it is perfect for date nights in fall and winter.

Maison Francis Kurkdjian Oud is a Unisex fragrance, The fragrance launched in 2012, The nose behind this fragrance is Francis Kurkdjian,
Top Note: Saffron, elemi, Agarwood (Oud), Cedar, Patchouli
Heart Note: Elemi
Base Note: Agar Wood, Cedar, Patchouli

name: Maison Francis Kurkdjian Oud Extrait de Parfum Extrait de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Maison Francis Kurkdjian Oud Extrait de Parfum is a rich, velvety blend of oud, saffron and vanilla.
Francis Kurkdjian created it in 2018. Saffron and elemi open warm, vanilla, ambrette and Atlas cedar form a soft heart, and Laotian oud and Indonesian patchouli leaf give it a deep finish.
Luxurious and smooth, it suits date nights and everyday wear in fall and winter.

From the Orient, oud conveys mystery
and sensuality. From Laos, its land of origin, it draws purity and
refinement. This extrait de parfum interpretation is built on a
dream of oud—a supremely elegant, precious and rare natural ingredient.
It has wrapped itself in a musk and vanilla accord that releases a
harmony of spicy rich aromas. An olfactory treasure born of sand, wind
and gold.
Oud - Extrait de Parfum  Notes
Saffron, Elemi
from the Philippines, Ambrettolide, Cedar wood from Morocco, Sweet
vanilla accord, Oud from Laos, Patchouli from Indonesia

name: Maison Francis Kurkdjian Oud Satin Mood Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Maison Francis Kurkdjian Oud Satin Mood is a velvety blend of rose, oud and vanilla.
Francis Kurkdjian created it in 2015. Bulgarian and Turkish rose, violet and vanilla wrap around oud and benzoin, creating a soft, plush, almost satiny warmth.
Luxurious for fall and winter nights, date nights and special occasions.

OUD satin mood conveys the desire to bring a shimmering Orient to life.
You'll want to wrap it around you, lose yourself in the depth of the
moment and suspend time.
Violet accord
Rose essence from Bulgaria
Rose absolute from Turkey
Natural oud from Laos
Benzoin from Siam
Amber and vanilla accord

name: Maison Francis Kurkdjian Oud Satin Mood Extrait Extrait de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Maison Francis Kurkdjian Oud Satin Mood Extrait is a deeper, richer version of the rose-oud classic.
Francis Kurkdjian created it in 2017. Damask and Turkish rose, violet, geranium and cinnamon open lush and warm, Bulgarian rose, Laotian oud and centifolia rose form the heart, and amber and vanilla give it a plush finish.
Made for fall and winter nights and date nights.

Of the many fragrances to attempt to
reinterpret oud for the western palette, very few have been as much a
runaway success as Francis Kurkdjians Oud Satin Mood, a gorgeously
textured, impossibly smooth tapestry of delicate spice, elegant florals,
and mouthwatering vanilla layered with an exquisite specimen of pure
Laotian oud. Now, for the first time ever, this sumptuous delight is
available in a sinfully concentrated extrait de parfum, where the rose
(now a decadent combination of Turkish and Bulgarian roses) is lusher,
the vanilla creamier, and the oud richer and smoother than ever before. A
holy grail for oud and gourmand lovers alike, Oud Satin Mood Extrait
might be the most deliciously sensual scent to ever emerge from Francis
Kurkdjian's magical workshop.
Oud Satin Mood Extrait  Notes
Agarwood, Bulgarian rose, benzoin, Turkish rose, violet and vanilla.

Kurkdjian imagined the OUD mood collection as feelings, sensations, rather like those one would have when wrapped in a fragrant stole. They play on shimmer, comfort and warmth. They are precious, intense and concentrated.
OUD silk mood is a light, airy fragrance reminiscent of the rustle of silk or the soft touch of a rose petal. The fragrance is full of charm and mystery, sketched in Bulgarian rose, with blue chamomile from Morocco and papyrus. Sensitive and intriguing.
Bulgarian rose, Camomille from Marocco, Oud from Laos, Papyrus

name: Mancera Cedrat Boise Eau de Parfum Unisex

Versatile from spring through fall, at the office, the gym or on a date.

The Scoop
Fresh, fruity and yet utterly
masculine, Cedrat Boise has received a steady buzz of excitement amongst
fragrance aficionados since its release, not least for a purported
resemblance to a certain holy grail fruity men's scent with a bit of a
more expensive pedigree. And while we see several key differences
between the two, what can't be denied is that Cedrat Boise is the equal
to any casual-yet-sophisticated masculine on the market. Opening with a
bright, zesty burst of blackcurrant and citrus, Cedrat Boise quickly
layers on a sexy heart of jasmine and patchouli underneath the
still-lingering fruity freshness, staying crisp for hours before slowly
easing into a sumptuous drydown of cedar, sandalwood, leather and musky
mosses. Gorgeously blended and all-season appropriate, Cedrat Boise is a
remarkably versatile and enjoyable masculine- the one to reach for when
you can only reach for one.
Cedrat Boise  Notes
Bergamot,
lemon, blackcurrant, cold spices, fruit basket, aquatic jasmine,
patchouli, sandalwood, cedar, leather, moss, white musk, vanilla

Mancera Hindu Kush is a smoky, resinous blend of incense, spices and amber.

Moody and distinctive, it is made for fall and winter, day or night.

Rugged, imposing, and central to military history both ancient and modern, the Hindu Kush mountain range in Central Asia is a formidable sight indeed. It's a border not merely between Pakistan and Afghanistan, but between heaven and earth itself. To honor this wild location, Mancera presents a uniquely resinous scent, rich with spice and incense, perfect for the adventurous spirit in all of us.
Hindu Kush opens with a sweet and complex layer of exotic spice, with prominent notes of saffron and clove reinforced with the energy of black pepper and the earthy resinousness of another famed export of the region- a cannabis essential oil harvested from authentic Afghan-grown plants. Oud, patchouli and woods dominate the heart, but their heaviest and darkest tones are played down, keeping the robust spiciness at the center of the composition. A vanilla and musk base works along the same concept, reinforcing the resins and spices without drowning them in overly rich or earthy tones and presenting Hindu Kush as that rarest of oriental fragrances- one with more subtlety than opulence. And as a result, it's hard to think of a human being alive that wouldn't smell unbelievable wearing it.
Hindu Kush Fragrance Notes
Saffron, cumin, cloves, black pepper, labdanum, davana, cannabis, agarwood, patchouli, sandalwood, cedarwood, amber, white musk, gaiac, vanilla

When we call a fragrance
“breathtaking, ” do we really mean it? As in, a sumptuous, gorgeous,
flowery-creamy-musky indulgence that interrupts our very respiration as
we dive greedily back in for a second sniff? With Roses Vanille, we do.
Sweet enough to capture us, rich enough to keep us and complex enough
to seduce us, Roses Vanille is an absolute standout of the Mancera line
and one of the sexiest floral gourmands we've ever smelled. We're still
catching our breath.
