Just like Aoud Blue Notes which we announced just a few days ago, the new perfume So Blue also comes in a beautiful blue flacon, iridescent in shades from dark to light, making fragrant liquid even more attractive.
Composition of the fragrance SO BLUE opens with luminous citruses (bergamot, mandarin, Calabrian lemon), spiced with tart notes of pepper and sweetness of fruity notes. The heart of the composition encompasses floral scents of Bulgarian rose and violet, which deepen the flavors of patchouli leaves and sea aromas. The base incorporates rich amber, oak moss, Mysore sandalwood, vanilla and musk.

name: Mancera soleil d'italie eau de parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Mancera Soleil d'Italie is a bright, sunny citrus with a cool, watery heart.
Launched in 2019, it opens with bitter orange, lime, mandarin, Calabrian bergamot, cardamom and pink pepper. Watery notes, Bulgarian rose and patchouli leaf form the heart, and white musk, ambergris, vetiver, cedar and guaiac wood give it a clean finish.
Fresh and breezy, it is made for spring and summer days.

Soleil d'Italie by Mancera is a Floral Woody Musk fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Soleil d'Italie was launched in 2019. Top notes are Bitter Orange, Lime, Mandarin Orange, Calabrian bergamot, Cardamom and Pink Pepper; middle notes are Watery Notes, Bulgarian Rose and Patchouli Leaf; base notes are White Musk, Ambergris, Vetiver, Cedar and Guaiac Wood.

name: Mancera The Aoud Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Mancera The Aoud is a spicy, rich blend of rose, saffron and oud.
Pierre Montale created it in 2011. Clove, cinnamon, white pepper and bergamot open warm, rose, saffron and geranium form a floral heart, and oud, leather, sandalwood, cedar and white musk give it a deep, woody finish.
Intense and opulent, it works day or night in fall and winter.

The Aoud by Mancera is a Oriental Woody fragrance for women and men. The Aoud
was launched in 2011. The nose behind this fragrance is Pierre Montale.
Top notes are Cloves, Cinnamon, White Pepper and Bergamot; middle notes
are Rose, Saffron and Geranium; base notes are Agarwood (Oud), Leather,
Sandalwood, Woody Notes, Cedar and White Musk.

name: Mancera Tonka Cola Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Mancera Tonka Cola is a fizzy, sweet blend of cola, cherry and cinnamon.
Launched in 2022, it opens with cinnamon, cherry, Sicilian lemon and nutmeg. A cola accord, patchouli leaf and orange blossom form the heart, and tonka bean, vanilla, benzoin and labdanum give it a warm finish.
Fun and cozy, it is a great everyday and evening scent.

name: Mancera Vanille Exclusive Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Mancera Vanille Exclusive is a creamy, sweet vanilla with peach, whipped cream and tuberose.
Launched in 2018, it opens with white peach, osmanthus, whipped cream and brown sugar. Indian tuberose, violet and jasmine form a floral heart, and Madagascar vanilla, amber, white musk and woods give it a smooth finish.
Indulgent and soft, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

Vanille Exclusif by Mancera is a Amber Floral fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Vanille Exclusif was launched in 2018. Top notes are White Peach, Osmanthus, Whipped cream and Brown sugar; middle notes are Indian Tuberose, Violet and Egyptian Jasmine; base notes are Madagascar Vanilla, Amber, White Musk and Woodsy Notes.

name: Mancera Velvet Vanilla Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Mancera Velvet Vanilla is a creamy blend of white flowers and vanilla.
Pierre Montale created it in 2016. Pear, angelica, black currant, mandarin, pink pepper and clove open bright, tuberose, jasmine, neroli and rose form a lush heart, and vanilla and white musk give it a soft finish.
Versatile and comforting, it suits the office, everyday wear and date nights in spring, fall and winter.

Mancera Velvet Vanilla is a Unisex fragrance, The fragrance launched in 2016, The nose behind this fragrance is Pierre Montale,
Top Note: Pear, Angelica, Black Currant, Mandarin Orange, Pink Pepper, Clove
Heart Note: Tuberose, Jasmine, Neroli, Rose
Base Note: Vanilla, White Musk

name: Mancera Vetiver Sensuel Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Mancera Vetiver Sensuel is a bright, zesty citrus with an earthy vetiver base.
Pierre Montale created it in 2020. Lime, orange, bergamot, lemon and pepper open crisp and lively, orchid, mint and patchouli form a fresh heart, and vetiver, woods, amber, oakmoss and white musk give it a clean, green finish.
Fresh and easy, it is a great daytime scent from spring through fall.

Vetiver Sensuel by Mancera is a Woody Floral Musk fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Vetiver Sensuel
was launched in 2020.
Top notes are Lime, Orange, Bergamot, Lemon and
Pepper;
Middle notes are Orchid, Mint and Patchouli;
Base notes are
Vetiver, Woody Notes, Amber, Oakmoss and White Musk.

name: Mancera Wave Musk Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Mancera Wave Musk is a salty, marine blend of grapefruit, sea notes and white musk.
Pierre Montale created it in 2011. Grapefruit, grass and black currant open fresh, sea notes, sea salt, orange blossom and driftwood form a breezy heart, and white musk and seaweed give it a clean finish.
Cool and refreshing, it is made for spring and summer days.

Wave Musk by Mancera is a Woody Aromatic fragrance for women and men. Wave Musk was launched in 2011. The nose behind this fragrance is Pierre Montale. Top notes are Grapefruit, Grass and Black Currant; middle notes are Sea Notes, Sea Salt, Orange Blossom and Driftwood; base notes are White Musk and Seaweed.

name: Mancera Wild Cherry Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Mancera Wild Cherry is a sweet, musky blend of cherry, heliotrope and vanilla.
Pierre Montale created it in 2016. Bergamot, lemon and cherry open juicy, heliotrope, patchouli, orris and jasmine form a powdery heart, and white musk and Madagascar vanilla give it a soft finish.
Playful and cozy, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

name: Mancera Wild Fruits Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Mancera Wild Fruits is a juicy, fresh blend of citrus, peach and black currant.
Pierre Montale created it in 2011. Kumquat, lemon and grapefruit open bright, black currant, peach, apple and violet form a fruity heart, and white musk and cedar give it a clean finish.
Lively and easy, it is made for spring and summer days.

name: Mancera Wild Leather Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Mancera Wild Leather is an earthy blend of patchouli, rose and leather.
Pierre Montale created it in 2014. Sicilian bergamot opens bright, patchouli, Bulgarian rose and violet form a rich heart, and leather, oakmoss, guaiac wood, white musk and amber give it a mossy finish.
Bold and seductive, it is perfect for date nights in fall and winter.

Mancera Wild Leather is a Unisex fragrance, The fragrance launched in 2014, The nose behind this fragrance is Pierre Montale,
Top Note: Sicilian Bergamot
Heart Note: Patchouli, Bulgarian Rose, Violet
Base Note: Leather, Oakmoss, Guaiac Wood, White Musk, Amber

name: Mancera Wild Python Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Mancera Wild Python is a rich white floral with tuberose, osmanthus and peach.
Launched in 2018, it opens with Indian tuberose, osmanthus, peach and bergamot. Jasmine, orange blossom and patchouli leaf form a lush heart, and white musk and vanilla give it a smooth finish.
Bold and sensual, it works day or night in spring and fall.

name: Mancera Wild Rose Oud Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Mancera Wild Rose Oud is a rich rose with jasmine and oud.
Pierre Montale created it in 2014. Bergamot and lemon open bright, Turkish rose, patchouli and Egyptian jasmine form a lush heart, and oud, musk, amber and vanilla pod give it a warm finish.
Romantic and bold, it is great for outings in fall and winter.

Wild Rose Oud opens with citruses, this time as a cocktail of
sparkling bergamot and Calabrian lemon. The heart of the composition
puts Turkish rose on a pedestal, whose opulence of aromas is beautified
with sweet-honey jasmine from Egypt and Sumatran patchouli. The base of
the composition softens and subtly warms floral shades with amber and
musk, along with precious oud from Nepal and vanilla beans.

name: Mancera Wind Wood Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Mancera Wind Wood is a green, woody blend of violet, vetiver and leather.
Pierre Montale created it in 2014. Green notes, mandarin and pink pepper open fresh, violet and patchouli form a powdery heart, and cedar, vetiver, oakmoss, leather, white musk and amber give it an earthy finish.
Easy and fresh, it is a great daytime scent from spring through fall.

Wind Wood by Mancera is a Leather fragrance for men. Wind Wood was launched in 2014. The nose behind this fragrance is Pierre Montale. Top notes are mandarin orange, pink pepper and green notes; middle notes are violet and patchouli; base notes are vetiver, cedar, oakmoss, amber, leather and white musk.

name: Mancera Xplicit Vanilla Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Mancera Xplicit Vanilla is a rich blend of Mexican vanilla, dark chocolate and oud.
Pierre Montale created it in 2025. Mexican vanilla and dark chocolate open sweet, Cambodian oud, brown sugar, Australian sandalwood and cedarwood form a warm heart, and tonka bean, amber and benzoin give it a cozy finish.
Indulgent and smooth, it works day or night in fall and winter.

name: Marc Jacobs Daisy Wild Eau So Intense for Women

notes.source_text:
Marc Jacobs Daisy Wild Eau So Intense is a sunny blend of banana flower, jasmine and sandalwood.
Launched in 2025, it opens with banana flower. Jasmine forms a soft floral heart, and amber and sandalwood give it a warm, creamy finish.
Bright and cheerful, it is made for spring and summer days.

name: Marc Jacobs Honey Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Marc Jacobs Honey is a sweet, fruity floral with pear, honeysuckle and honey.
Ann Gottlieb and Annie Buzantian created it in 2013. Punch, pear and mandarin open juicy, honeysuckle, orange blossom and peach form a sunny heart, and honey, vanilla and woods give it a warm finish.
Cheerful and bright, it is made for spring and summer days.

Honey by Marc Jacobs is a Floral Fruity fragrance for women. Honey
was launched in 2013. Honey was created by Annie Buzantian and Ann
Gottlieb. Top notes are Punch, Pear and Mandarin Orange; middle notes
are Honeysuckle, Orange Blossom and Peach; base notes are Honey, Vanilla
and Woodsy Notes.

name: Marc Jacobs Perfect Absolute Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Marc Jacobs Perfect Absolute is a warm, sweet blend of fig, caramel and jasmine.
Launched in 2025, it opens with fig and caramel. Jasmine forms a soft floral heart, and amber gives it a warm, glowing finish.
Cozy and confident, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

name: Marc Jacobs Perfect Elixir Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Marc Jacobs Perfect Elixir is a warm blend of plum, honey and vanilla.
Domitille Michalon Bertier created it in 2024. Plum, honey and rhubarb open fruity, amber and orange blossom form a glowing heart, and vanilla, resin and patchouli give it a rich finish.
Cozy and confident, it is a great everyday and evening scent.

name: Marc-Antoine Barrois Aldebaran Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Marc-Antoine Barrois Aldebaran is a fresh, spicy blend of tuberose, paprika and maté.
Quentin Bisch created it in 2025. Tuberose opens creamy, paprika and maté form an aromatic, spicy heart, and tonka bean gives it a soft, sweet finish.
Distinctive and modern, it is a great everyday scent.

name: Marc-Antoine Barrois B683 Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Marc-Antoine Barrois B683 Eau de Parfum is a spicy, ambery blend of saffron, chili and violet leaf.
Quentin Bisch created it in 2016. Saffron, nutmeg, black pepper and red chili open hot and spicy, violet leaf, musk, labdanum and amber form a warm heart, and ambroxan, sandalwood, patchouli and oakmoss give it a woody finish.
Bold and refined, it is a great everyday and evening scent.

name: Marc-Antoine Barrois B683 Extrait de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Marc-Antoine Barrois B683 is a spicy, woody blend of oud, green apple and patchouli.
Quentin Bisch created it in 2020. Safraleine, oud, green apple, violet leaf, Australian sandalwood, patchouli, pink pepper, cumin and vanilla come together in a bold, airy and warm scent.
Distinctive and powerful, it is a great everyday and evening scent.

name: Marc-Antoine Barrois Encelade Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Marc-Antoine Barrois Encelade is a green, woody blend of rhubarb, vetiver and sandalwood.
Quentin Bisch created it in 2022. Rhubarb, vetiver, sandalwood, tonka bean and cedar come together in a fresh, aromatic and earthy woody scent.
Clean and modern, it is a great everyday scent.

name: Marc-Antoine Barrois Ganymede Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Marc-Antoine Barrois Ganymede is a mineral, suede-like scent with a futuristic feel.
Quentin Bisch created it in 2019. Mineral notes, saffron, suede, violet leaf, akigalawood, immortelle, mandarin and osmanthus blend into a smooth, metallic and softly leathery scent.
Distinctive and modern, it works in any season.

name: Marc-Antoine Barrois Ganymede Extrait de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Marc-Antoine Barrois Ganymede Extrait is a warm, resinous take on Ganymede with incense and myrrh.
Quentin Bisch created it in 2023. Incense, myrrh and mandarin open rich and bright, immortelle forms a honeyed, herbal heart, and Akigalawood and Safraleine give it a smooth, spicy woody finish.
Distinctive and elegant, it is a strong choice for evenings and cooler weather.

name: Marc-Antoine Barrois Tilia Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Marc-Antoine Barrois Tilia is a sunny, green floral built around linden blossom.
Quentin Bisch created it in 2024. Linden blossom, jasmine sambac, heliotrope and broom meet vetiver, Ambrofix and Georgywood for a soft, honeyed and slightly powdery scent.
Light and luminous, it is perfect for spring and summer days.

name: Masque Milano Dolceacqua Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Masque Milano Dolceacqua is a soft floral with lily-of-the-valley, mimosa and almond blossom.
Delphine Thierry created it in 2020. Lily-of-the-valley, sea notes, ivy and marjoram open green, mimosa, almond blossom, white rose and ylang-ylang form a powdery heart, and musk, oakmoss, cedar, benzoin and saffron give it a warm finish.
Graceful and calm, it is a lovely everyday scent.

name: Masque Milano Kintsugi Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Masque Milano Kintsugi is a soft, fruity floral with magnolia, rose and suede.
Vanina Muracciole created it in 2019. Magnolia, bergamot and amber open bright, suede, rose and violet leaf form a velvety heart, and raspberry leaf, patchouli, benzoin and vanilla give it a warm finish.
Elegant and gentle, it is a lovely everyday scent.

name: Masque Milano L'Attesa Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Masque Milano L'Attesa is a powdery, elegant blend of champagne, iris and leather.
Luca Maffei created it in 2016. Champagne, bergamot and neroli open sparkling, iris, orris root, ylang-ylang and tuberose form a soft heart, and leather, oakmoss and sandalwood give it an earthy finish.
Refined and graceful, it is a lovely everyday scent.

name: Masque Milano Lost Alice Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Masque Milano Lost Alice is a soft, milky blend of tea, orris and white rose.
Mackenzie Reilly created it in 2021. Ambrette, bergamot, black pepper and clary sage open fresh, black tea, orris, carrot and white rose form a powdery heart, and milk, sandalwood and broom give it a creamy finish.
Dreamy and elegant, it is a lovely daytime scent in spring, fall and winter.

Lost Alice by Masque Milano is a fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Lost Alice was launched in 2021. The nose behind this fragrance is Mackenzie Reilly. Top notes are Ambrette (Musk Mallow), Bergamot, Black Pepper and Clary Sage; middle notes are Black Tea, Orris, Carrot and White Rose; base notes are Milk, Sandalwood and Broom.

name: Masque Milano Love Kills Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Masque Milano Love Kills is a spicy rose with geranium, ambrette and patchouli.
Caroline Dumur created it in 2019. Turkish rose oil, rose, geranium and ambrette open bright, Turkish rose and patchouli form a deep heart, and Ambrarome, cedar and musk give it a woody finish.
Romantic and bold, it works day or night in spring and fall.

Love Kills by Masque Milano is a Floral fragrance for women and men. Love Kills was launched in 2019. The nose behind this fragrance is Caroline Dumur. Top notes are Turkish Rose Oil, Rose, African Geranium and Ambrette (Musk Mallow); middle notes are Turkish Rose and Patchouli; base notes are Ambrarome, Cedar Essence and Musk.

name: Masque Milano Madeleine Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Masque Milano Madeleine is a creamy gourmand of chestnut, whipped cream and milk.
Fanny Bal created it in 2020. Chestnut, whipped cream and cumin open warm, tuberose, geranium and cypress form an unusual heart, and milk, vanilla pod, musk and tonka bean give it a soft finish.
Cozy and nostalgic, it is a lovely everyday scent.

name: Masque Milano Mandala Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Masque Milano Mandala is a resinous blend of olibanum, incense and myrrh.
Christian Carbonnel created it in 2017. Olibanum, angelica and nutmeg open aromatic, incense, cardamom, labdanum, cedar, cinnamon and clove form a spicy heart, and myrrh, ambergris, sandalwood and oakmoss give it a warm finish.
Contemplative and warm, it is a strong choice for cooler days and evenings.

name: Masque Milano Petra Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Masque Milano Petra is a warm, ambery blend of rose, myrrh and incense.
Cécile Zarokian created it in 2020. Pink pepper, yellow mandarin and bergamot open bright, sweet and fruity notes, jasmine sambac and Moroccan rose form a soft heart, and ambergris, patchouli, myrrh, incense, benzoin and leather give it a rich finish.
Rich and refined, it is a strong choice for cooler days and evenings.

name: Masque Milano Russian Tea Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Masque Milano Russian Tea is a smoky blend of black tea, leather and mint.
Julien Rasquinet created it in 2014. Black tea, leather, mint, birch, incense, raspberry, immortelle, black pepper, labdanum and magnolia come together in a fresh, smoky and green scent.
Distinctive and refined, it is a great daytime scent in fall and winter.

Russian Tea by Masque Milano is a Aromatic Spicy fragrance for women and men. Russian Tea was launched in 2014. The nose behind this fragrance is Julien Rasquinet.

name: Masque Milano Tango Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Masque Milano Tango is a warm, spicy amber with cumin, cinnamon and rose.
Cécile Zarokian created it in 2013. Amber, cumin, benzoin, tonka bean, cinnamon and cardamom meet guaiac wood, sandalwood, Turkish rose, jasmine sambac and cedar for a rich, sensual scent.
Bold and seductive, it is made for fall and winter nights.

Tango by Masque Milano is a Amber Floral fragrance for women and men. Tango was launched in 2013. The nose behind this fragrance is Cécile Zarokian.

name: Masque Milano Times Square Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Masque Milano Times Square is a powdery floral with violet, hazelnut and osmanthus.
Bruno Jovanovic created it in 2017. Violet, hazelnut and rose open soft, osmanthus and tuberose form a floral heart, and styrax, guaiac wood and sandalwood give it a warm, woody finish.
Elegant and unusual, it is a lovely everyday scent.

name: Matiere Premiere Bois d'Ebene Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Matière Première Bois d'Ébène is an earthy blend of juniper, guaiac wood and patchouli.
Aurélien Guichard created it in 2019. Juniper berries open fresh, guaiac wood forms a smoky heart, and cypriol and patchouli give it a deep, earthy finish.
Refined and grounded, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

name: Matiere Premiere Crystal Saffron Extrait de Perfume Unisex

notes.source_text:
Matière Première Crystal Saffron is a musky, metallic blend of saffron, myrrh and frankincense.
Aurélien Guichard created it in 2024. Habanolide opens clean and musky, saffron forms a warm, leathery heart, and myrrh, ambroxan and frankincense give it a resinous finish.
Modern and distinctive, it works day or night in fall and winter.

name: Matiere Premiere Falcon Leather Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Matière Première Falcon Leather is a dark, smoky leather with saffron and oud.
Aurélien Guichard created it in 2019. Labdanum and saffron open warm, birch tar forms a smoky heart, and oud and benzoin give it a rich, animalic finish.
Intense and bold, it is made for fall and winter nights.

name: Matiere Premiere Metal Lavender Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Matière Première Metal Lavender is a musky, woody take on lavender with cashmeran.
Aurélien Guichard created it in 2026. Lavender, wild lavender, musk and cashmeran come together in a powdery, ambery and smooth aromatic scent.
Clean and modern, it is a great everyday scent.

name: Matiere Premiere Vanilla Powder Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Matière Première Vanilla Powder is a soft, powdery vanilla with coconut and musk.
Aurélien Guichard created it in 2023. Heliotrope and coconut powder open soft, Madagascar vanilla forms the heart, and palo santo, white musk, vanilla absolute and coconut give it a creamy finish.
Comforting in spring, fall and winter, day or night.

name: Matiere Premiere Vanilla Powder Extrait de Perfume Unisex

notes.source_text: Vanilla Powder by Matiere Premiere is an Oriental Vanilla scent designed for both women and men. This fragrance, which debuted in 2025, was crafted by perfumer Aurelien Guichard.

name: Memo Paris African Leather Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Memo Paris African Leather is a bold, spicy leather with saffron and cumin.
Launched in 2015, it blends cardamom, saffron, cumin and bergamot with leather, oud, patchouli, vetiver and musk for a warm, earthy and spicy scent.
Made for fall and winter, day or night.

For the fourth installment of the
Cuirs Nomades series, exploring various facets of leather scents through
a global journey, MEMO has abandoned the peculiar comforts of Europe
(previous editions in this series were French, Italian and Irish) for a
taste of the wild. Like the bright Kenyan sun above the plains of the
Serengeti, African Leather is at once impossibly vibrant and undeniably
full of life, a deeply aromatic, richly spiced floral leather with all
the soulfulness and natural magnetism of the world's last unspoiled
habitat.
African Leather opens with a burst of gorgeously vivid exoticism, as
stunningly bright bergamot illuminates a wondrous and wild blend of
green, herbal spices, cardamom, cumin and saffron combining for a hugely
evocative, ruggedly sensual set of top notes. In the grassy, floral
heart, wild vetiver combines with a stunning geranium absolute that
delivers commanding depth and a feral edge that rolls perfectly into the
titular leather, a majestically unpolished, animalic leather that
evokes tooth and fur, hide and claw, feeling as savagely regal as the
great beasts of the savannah. Take an unforgettable journey with African
Leather, and get in touch with your wild side.
African Leather  Notes
Bergamot, cardamom, saffron, cumin, geranium, patchouli, oud, leather, vetiver, musk

name: Memo Paris Argentina Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Memo Paris Argentina is a rich floral with rose, jasmine and oud.
Aliénor Massenet created it in 2021. Rose, Turkish rose, ambrette, oud, pink pepper, jasmine sambac, Egyptian jasmine, magnolia and cypriol come together in a lush, musky and woody floral scent.
Opulent and elegant, it is a great everyday and evening scent.

name: Memo Paris Cap Camarat Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Memo Paris Cap Camarat is a fruity, warm blend of apple, jasmine and vanilla.
Nadège Le Garlantezec created it in 2026. Pink pepper, fruity notes, watery notes and apple open bright, jasmine, vanilla and ylang-ylang form a sweet heart, and amyris, labdanum, sandalwood, benzoin, patchouli and musk give it a warm finish.
Sunny and smooth, it is a lovely everyday scent.

name: Memo Paris Corfu Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Memo Paris Corfu is a bright, fruity blend of rhubarb, citrus and rose.
Launched in 2021, it opens with rhubarb, lemon, grapefruit, black currant, mandarin and basil. Rose oil, lily-of-the-valley, geranium, peach, raspberry, jasmine and orris form a fresh heart, and musk, cashmere wood, patchouli, cedar and moss give it a clean finish.
Fresh and lively, it is a great everyday scent.

name: Memo Paris Eau de Memo Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Memo Paris Eau de Memo is a fresh blend of green tea, iris and leather.
Aliénor Massenet created it in 2017. Green tea, bergamot and lemon open bright, jasmine, iris and saffron form a soft heart, and leather, moss and white musk give it a smooth finish.
Light and refined, it is a great everyday scent for spring and summer.

Eau de Memo by Memo Paris is a Oriental Floral fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Eau de Memo was launched in 2017. The nose behind this fragrance is Alienor Massenet. Top notes are bergamot, lemon and green tea; middle notes are jasmine, iris and saffron; base notes are white musk, moss and leather.

name: Memo Paris Flam Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Memo Paris Flam is a warm white floral with jasmine sambac and vanilla.
Launched in 2021, it blends jasmine sambac, Madagascar vanilla, florals and bergamot with ambrettolide, amber, cedar and cashmeran for a radiant, ambery and woody floral scent.
Elegant and warm, it is a lovely everyday scent.

name: Memo Paris French Leather Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Memo Paris French Leather is a fresh, musky blend of rose, suede and clary sage.
Aliénor Massenet created it in 2014. Rose water, lime, juniper and pink pepper open bright, clary sage, rose and suede form a soft heart, and cedarwood, musk and vetiver give it a woody finish.
Elegant and easy, it works for date nights, everyday wear and outings in spring and fall.

The essence of French style lies not
in wild extravagance or gauche flights of fantasy, but in the
deceptively casual, elegant everyday fashion that exudes the wordly,
confident sensuality that Parisians are known for. With French Leather,
MEMO delivers a leather fragrance that feels quintessentially Parisian-
luscious suede and elegant rose combining in a gently charming
concoction made all the more irresistible by its everyday accessibility.
Like the effortless style of a true Parisian, French Leather
accentuates the comfortable with the bold, in this case focusing on a
butter-soft suede accord that comes to life with exquisitely rationed
bursts of color- bright, vibrant lime, lively pink pepper and juniper,
and rich, sensual rose. The result is sheer loveliness, the sort of
lived-in elegance that projects comfort and confidence in equal measure.
For the ingénue who never wants to be seen as trying too hard, French
Leather is your new secret weapon.
French Leather  Notes
Lime, pink pepper, juniper, rose, clary sage, cedar, styrax resin, vetiver, musk, suede accord.

name: Memo Paris Granada Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Memo Paris Granada is a sweet, sunny floral with orange flower and grenadine.
Aliénor Massenet created it in 2011. Orange flower, grenadine and bergamot open bright, jasmine and heliotrope form a soft heart, and vanilla, tonka bean, musk and woods give it a powdery finish.
Cheerful and feminine, it is great for everyday wear and outings in spring and summer.

A feminine white floral with hidden complexities, Granada is an ultra romantic, surprisingly sensual late night dance through the gardens of the Alhambra. Inspired by late evenings beneath the walls of the famed red castle, the nighttime air redolent with Andalusian jasmine, Granada seduces us with a lightly resinous mix of clean and dirty florals that balance purity and carnality with expert precision.
Granada opens sweet and bright, with bergamot and African orange flower balancing atop a delightfully dry grenadine note. The jasmine emerges, first virginally clean, then lightly indolic, its transition smoothed with a hazy heliotrope. A delicately woodsy base of tonka, vanilla and musks gives longevity and swings the balance back towards sexiness. Like Spain itself, Granada proves itself complex enough to represent many different facets of beauty.
Granada Fragrance Notes
Oil of bergamot, pomegranate, orange blossom, jasmine sambac, héliotrope, musk, amber wood accord.

name: Memo Paris Iberian Leather Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Memo Paris Iberian Leather is a spicy leather with saffron, iris and oud.
Launched in 2022, it opens with geranium, coriander, rosemary and bergamot. Clove, saffron, cinnamon, iris, osmanthus, jasmine and rose form a spicy heart, and leather, oud, patchouli, vetiver, oakmoss and sandalwood give it a rich finish.
Bold and refined, it is a strong choice for cooler days and evenings.

name: Memo Paris Ilha Do Mel Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Memo Paris Ilha do Mel is a sweet, honeyed floral with jasmine and orange blossom.
Aliénor Massenet created it in 2015. Vanilla, jasmine, honey, orange blossom, broom, iris, hyacinth, mandarin and juniper come together in a golden, sunny and soft floral scent.
Warm and cheerful, it is made for spring and summer days.

Ilha do Mel by Memo Paris is a Floral fragrance for women and men. Ilha do Mel
was launched in 2015. The nose behind this fragrance is Alienor
Massenet. Top notes are Hyacinth, Mandarin Orange and Juniper; middle
notes are Jasmine, Honey, Orange Blossom, Broom and iris; base note is
Vanilla.

name: Memo Paris Inle Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Memo Paris Inlé is a fresh floral with osmanthus, maté and mint.
Aliénor Massenet created it in 2007. Bergamot, mint and artemisia open fresh, osmanthus, maté, jasmine and spices form a fruity heart, and iris, musk and cedar give it a soft finish.
Calm and graceful, it is made for spring and summer days.

The Memo Paris fragrance collection inspired by distant
travels brings aromas from each of them and includes four fragrances:
Inle, Lalibela, Siwa i Sundance.
Inlé is the fragrance that reminds her of the lake Inlé, and it features notes of bergamot, osmanthus, iris, artemisia, mint, spices, musk and cedarwood accords.

name: Memo Paris Irish Leather Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Memo Paris Irish Leather is a fresh, green leather with juniper and maté.
Aliénor Massenet created it in 2013. Leather, juniper berries, maté, amber and tonka bean open aromatic, iris and tonka form a soft heart, and birch and leather give it a smoky, rugged finish.
Distinctive and versatile, it works for everyday wear and date nights in spring and fall.

“It's one of those icy, biting
mornings. The sun scarcely manages to break through the heavy grey
clouds. The air is crisp and dry, and the wind slips beneath my clothes.
The North wind whips the grass that sticks to my boots. I walk into the
stable and swing open the wooden tack room doors, freeing the burning
scent of leather, wood, amber and honey. Its age-old odor stands out
sharply in the frozen morning air. My horse whinnies softly. It's the
smell of her freedom. The leather gathers in the wind, the grass warms
with the wood. Irish Leather gallops off into the horizon.”
MEMO co-founder John Molloy is understandably proud of his rural
Irish upbringing, and Irish Leather, the first of MEMO's Cuirs Nomades
series, positively sings of Ireland's rustic beauty. Opening notes of
juniper, pink pepper and clary sage whisk us away to the wild
countryside, while the leather- sharp, well-worn and deeply animalic-
gives us the barn, the saddle and the horse all at once. Comforting yet
forlorn, stark yet vibrantly beautiful, Irish Leather is among the most
wonderfully wearable leathers we've ever experienced.
Irish Leather  Notes
Pink pepper,
clary sage, juniper berry, green maté absolute, flouve, iris concrete,
tonka bean absolute, leather, birch, amber accord.

name: Memo Paris Irish Oud Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Memo Paris Irish Leather is an aromatic blend of juniper, maté and leather.
Launched in 2015, it opens with juniper, leather, maté, birch, pink pepper and clary sage. Maté and juniper form a green heart, and amber, birch, leather and tonka bean give it a smoky finish.
Bold and fresh, it is great for nights out in spring, fall and winter.

Irish Oud Perfume by Memo, Irish Oud is a unisex fragrance released in 2015, with an alluring combination of floral, spice and wood notes that make it day and night appropriate for both men and women. First, you’ll notice the zesty, energizing pink pepper note at the top of this scent. The heart is comprised of an eclectic blend of juniper berry, iris and birch wood notes. Beneath, you’ll notice notes of leather and the oud for which the fragrance is named. This dark, sensual wood, sometimes called agarwood, is often used in incense.

name: Memo Paris Italian Leather Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Memo Paris Italian Leather is a green, smooth leather with tomato leaf and vanilla.
Aliénor Massenet created it in 2013. Leather, tomato leaf and vanilla open fresh, galbanum, clary sage, orris and labdanum form a green heart, and leather, vanilla, benzoin, tolu balsam, myrrh and sandalwood give it a warm finish.
Distinctive and versatile, it suits everyday wear and date nights in fall and winter.

The smell of leather can represent
so much in Italian culture, from a couture jacket to ancient Roman
armor. But for the Italian edition of their Cuirs Nomades series, MEMO
and Alienor Massenet chose the ultimate depiction of the
quintessentially Italian la bella vita- the leather-wrapped steering
wheel of a top-down cabriolet hugging the curves on a coastal highway,
young lovers tucked into the seats, hair whipping in the
countryside-scented wind, a sumptuous picnic packed into a basket in the
backseat.
The first impressions of Italian Leather are fresh and green:
tomato leaf and soft, lightly herbal vanilla, accompanied by a sharp,
young leather that invigorates. As the leather matures and mixes with
orris root and resinous galbanum, the warm, spicy outdoorsy qualities
give off a hint of motor oil and coastal air, leaving us relaxed and
excited all at once. Italians, as they say, are the French in a good
mood- and one sniff of Italian Leather is bound to put you in a good
mood all your own.
Italian Leather  Notes
Green tomato
leaf, vanilla, leather, rockrose absolute, galbanum, clary sage, iris
concrete, vanilla bean absolute, sandalwood, tolu balsam resin, opoponax
resin, myrrh resin, benzoin resin, leather accord, musk.

name: Memo Paris Jannat Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Memo Paris Jannat is a fresh, aromatic blend of neroli, citrus and frangipani.
Aliénor Massenet created it in 2008. Neroli, petitgrain, bergamot, Amalfi lemon, frangipani, mandarin, musk, clary sage, liatris and tonka bean come together in a bright, green and gently floral scent.
Fresh and uplifting, it is a great everyday scent.

name: Memo Paris Kedu Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Memo Paris Kedu is a fresh, musky floral with grapefruit, maté and sesame.
Aliénor Massenet created it in 2014. Grapefruit, neroli and mandarin open bright, maté, freesia, rose and peony form an airy heart, and sesame, white musk and moss give it a soft finish.
Light and easy, it is great for everyday wear and the office in spring and summer.

Kedu, nicknamed "the garden of Java" in Indonesia, is a plain bordered by a volcano. Its soil, which has been made fertile by the ash, is sacred.
Borobudur arises shrouded in mist, a site of prayer constructed on a magical square. Tradition has it that you can purify your soul by throwing sesame seeds?one seed for each passion?into one of its flaming domes. The burnt sesame aromas rise up to the heavens. The husky accents of the seeds, which are symbols of longevity, set the sparkling freshness of grapefruit alight.
It unfolds on contact with grapefruit, neroli, white musk and moss to form an enchanting spell. Sesame and grapefruit come together and merge like the landscape that inspired them, the high plain of Kedu. Nestled on the island of Java, at the heart of Indonesia, this land is fertile, luxuriant and volcanic in one.
OLFACTIVE PYRAMID:
Top note: Oil of grapefruit, neroli, oil of mandarin.
Heart note: Maté absolute, fressia accord, rose-peony accord.
Base note: Sesame absolute, white musk, moss.
3 KEY NOTES:
OIL OF GRAPEFRUIT, SESAME ABSOLUTE & WHITE MUSK.

name: Memo Paris Lalibela Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Memo Paris Lalibela is a warm floral with incense, tobacco and coconut.
Aliénor Massenet created it in 2007. Incense, precious woods and tobacco leaf open smoky, vanilla, patchouli, jasmine and labdanum form a warm heart, and coconut, orchid, rose and peony give it a soft, sweet finish.
Exotic and cozy, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

Lalibela by Memo Paris is a Chypre Floral fragrance for women. Lalibela
was launched in 2007. The nose behind this fragrance is Alienor
Massenet. Top notes are Coconut, Orchid, Rose and Peony; middle notes
are Vanilla, Patchouli, Jasmine and Labdanum; base notes are Incense,
Precious Woods and Tobacco Leaf.

name: Memo Paris Luxor Oud Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Memo Paris Luxor Oud is a fruity, floral oud with mandarin and desert rose.
Aliénor Massenet created it in 2012. Mandarin and patchouli open bright, fruits and desert rose form a sweet floral heart, and oud and labdanum give it a warm, ambery finish.
Elegant and smooth, it is a great everyday scent in fall and winter.

The collection of Memo Paris will be expanded this autumn with
another fragrant journey through Egypt and the fantastic city of Luxor,
a town on the River Nile, famous for temples and alleys of sphinxes
that have been resisting time for thousands of years. Remains of prayer
and memorial temples including the magnificent Karnak are a symbol of a
powerful civilization that left its mark and to this day causes our
admiration.
The new fragrance LUXOR OUD celebrates the strength and power of the ancient, indicating that the heat of the desert surrounding Luxor offers a picturesque view of the heat and harshness of the climate. Sunny notes provided by tangerine give light to robust patchouli accords. Rose flower in the center of the composition is sweetened with fruit zest and heated with labdanum absolute united with warm oud wood aromas. Perfumer of the new edition is Alienor Massenet. Luxor Oud was launched in 2012.

name: Memo Paris Madurai Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Memo Paris Madurai is a lush white floral with jasmine, tuberose and sandalwood.
Gaël Montero created it in 2022. Jasmine sambac, Indian and Egyptian jasmine, Australian sandalwood, peach, suede, tuberose, marigold, turmeric, bergamot and clary sage come together in a rich, powdery and spicy floral scent.
Radiant and sensual, it is a lovely everyday scent.

name: Memo Paris Marfa Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Memo Paris Marfa is a creamy, sunlit tuberose with orange blossom and agave.
Aliénor Massenet created it in 2016. Orange blossom and mandarin open bright, tuberose, ylang-ylang and agave form a warm, desert-inspired heart, and vanilla, sandalwood, white musk and cedar give it a smooth finish.
Radiant and elegant, it is great for the office and everyday wear in spring and fall.

A arid tuberose as singularly
inspired as the West Texas oasis whose name it bears. Marfa, the new
scent from MEMO, captures the elusive totality of this small, isolated
city- modern art mecca, historic frontiertown, legendary nexus of
paranormal and extraterrestrial activity- melding the glowing warmth of
desert twilight with surprisingly sweet florals and modern musks to
paint a portrait of a locale that straddles regions, cultures and time
itself.
Marfa opens with an immediate punch of orange blossom and
tuberose, fruity and sweet but also surprisingly dry, imbued with
surreal weightlessness. A highway of dry, gently smooth woods stretches
ahead of us, and the haunting lights of the creamy, musky base glow with
quiet intensity. The notes don't seem to make sense together, and yet
the collective impression is undeniably cohesive, a place that shouldn't
exist and yet thrives, replacing the logic of the rest of the world
with something distinctive, alien, and unexpectedly beautiful. Equal
parts austere and unabashed, bold and understated, challenging and
downright lovely, Marfa isn't meant to be understood- at least, not
until you find yourself deep in its heart, and realizing that you never
want to leave.
Marfa  Notes
Mandarin, orange blossom, agave, tuberose, ylang ylang, sandalwood, cedar, vanilla, white musk

name: Memo Paris Marfa Spices Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Memo Paris Marfa is a creamy blend of tuberose, agave and cardamom.
Aliénor Massenet created it in 2018. Tuberose, cardamom, orange blossom and agave open warm, agave and cardamom form a spicy heart, and cedar, sandalwood and white musk give it a powdery, woody finish.
Sensual and distinctive, it is great for date nights and outings in fall and winter.

MARFA SPICES | (The eye of a tuberose) Your eyes riveted on the sky, the desert is forgotten. Tuberose is your star and your shepherd. There will be mystery, the infinite hidden behind the decor, silence beneath the cacti. A slo-mo Western in a series of artistically edited sequence shots. As the milky way blazes an azure trail, you fly by so quickly; the road, half-cedar, half-sandalwood, rises before you. Monolithic shadows come to greet you, sculptures or dream-like rocky mountains, their worlds intertwining. You know how to stop the wind, meld musk with the strident and striped colour of neon light, lift the dust from orange blossom. It matters not that you are oppressed by the heat, drunk on blue, driven by memories. Guided by the final gleam of ylang, you take vanilla’s hand. Here your life is a storybook. Marfa: your theatre, your poem, your creation, your invention.
OLFACTIVE PYRAMID: Oil of mandarin, Orange blossom absolute, Agave accord, Tuberose absolute, Oil of ylang ylang, Oil of sandalwood, Oil of cedar, Vanilla seed, White musk

name: Memo Paris Moon Fever Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Memo Paris Moon Fever is a fresh blend of citrus, verbena and leather.
Launched in 2012, it opens with bitter orange, lemon and grapefruit. Lemon verbena, clary sage and neroli form an aromatic heart, and tonka bean, leather and vetiver give it a smooth finish.
Bright and easy, it is great for everyday wear and outings in spring and summer.

Is Moon Fever the fragrance of an
imaginary safari on the mysterious dark side of the moon, as MEMO's
promotional concept suggests? Or does it perhaps simply represent the
multitude of stars visible in the perpetual dusk of the Serengeti night,
where the planet's most majestic wildlife stares up at the same
brilliant tapestry that you do? Either way, there's only one word
appropriate to describe the crisp depths of Moon Fever: luminous.
Moon Fever draws you in with a crisp, full citrus opening,
blending fresh juicy mandarin with tart grapefruit, bright lemon and a
lovely bitter orange for a citrus blend that's unexpectedly cool and
full-bodied. The lightly earthy heart of verbena, primrose, vetiver and
sage gives an almost tea-like smoothness, keeping the enchanting
contrast between the black night sky and the sparkling stars as an
enrapturing tonka bean drydown connects earth to heaven. Once again,
MEMO has given us a scent with the power not only to transport, but to
inspire.
Moon Fever  Notes
Bitter orange,
grapefruit, primofiore lemon, neroli blossom absolute, clary sage,
verbena, vetiver, leather, tonka bean absolute.

name: Memo Paris Moroccan Leather Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Memo Paris Moroccan Leather is a green, aromatic leather with iris, galbanum and vetiver.
Launched in 2018, it blends galbanum, leather, iris, vetiver, cypress, ginger, mandarin and ylang-ylang with amber, tonka bean, styrax and musk for a fresh yet warm leathery scent.
Refined and versatile, it works day or night in fall and winter.

Key Notes: Iris butter, Vetiver fraction oil, Leather accord
Ingredients: Mandarin oil, Ginger oil, Cypress oil, Ylang-ylang, Iris butter, Orange blossom absolute, Vetiver Fraction oil, Ambrofix, Galbanum resin, Leather accord, Styrax, Tonka bean, Musk.

name: Memo Paris Ocean Leather Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Memo Paris Ocean Leather is a fresh, aromatic leather with vetiver, sage and citrus.
Aliénor Massenet created it in 2020. Vetiver, leather and nutmeg meet sage, elemi and cedar, while mandarin, basil and violet keep it bright and green.
Breezy yet substantial, it is made for spring and summer days.

Ocean Leather by Memo Paris is a Leather fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Ocean Leather
was launched in 2020. The nose behind this fragrance is Alienor
Massenet. Top notes are Mandarin Orange, Basil and Violet; middle notes
are Sage, elemi and Cedar; base notes are Vetiver, Leather and Nutmeg.

name: Memo Paris Oriental Leather Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Memo Paris Oriental Leather is a spicy blend of lavender, chili pepper and leather.
Launched in 2019, it opens with lavender, red chili pepper and cilantro. Geranium, anise, cinnamon and tea form an aromatic heart, and leather, patchouli, clove, benzoin and vanilla give it a warm finish.
Bold and warm, it is made for fall and winter nights.

Oriental Leather by Memo Paris is a Leather fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Oriental Leather was launched in 2019. Top notes are cilantro, red chilli pepper and lavender; middle notes are anise, geranium, tea and cinnamon; base notes are leather, patchouli, benzoin, vanilla and clove.

name: Memo Paris Russian Leather Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Memo Paris Russian Leather is a green, aromatic leather with pine, lavender and herbs.
Aliénor Massenet created it in 2016. Pine, leather, cypress, basil and fern open fresh, Provençal lavender and rosemary form an aromatic heart, and guaiac wood, nutmeg, patchouli and tonka bean give it a warm finish.
Polished and versatile, it suits the office, everyday wear and date nights in spring, fall and winter.

Russian Leather conjures up a
picture of an army marching through the dark, snow-covered pine forests
of the freezing tundra. These boys are made of tough material, and so
are their boots.
Green, smoky, and aromatic, the leather accord is tough and
satisfying. A fougere accord of pine, ferns, cedar, mint, lavender and
coumarin brings the forest into focus, filling your lungs with the scent
of pine needles trampled underfoot and the bite of the cold, Northern
night air. The smell of gaiac wood being burned in a far off campfire
snakes through the forest and mingles with the dark, oily smoke of the
men’s black leather boots. A challenging, deeply evocative fragrance,
this will unsettle everyone but men with adventure-seeking souls.
Russian Leather  Notes
Basil, pine
tree, rosemary, clary sage, fern, lavender, cedar needles, coriander,
mint, patchouli, guaiac, cypress, tonka bean, nutmeg, Russian leather
accord

name: Memo Paris Shams Oud Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Memo Paris Shams Oud is a warm, spicy oud with saffron and balsams.
Launched in 2011, it opens with pepper, saffron and ginger. Cypriol and vetiver form an earthy heart, and oud, labdanum, tolu balsam, birch, styrax and tonka bean give it a rich, resinous finish.
Opulent and warm, it works day or night in fall and winter.

Shams Oud by Memo Paris is a Oriental fragrance for women and men. Shams Oud was launched in 2011. Top notes are saffron, ginger and pepper; middle notes are vetiver and cypriol oil or nagarmotha; base notes are french labdanum, birch, styrax, tolu balsam, tonka bean and agarwood (oud).

name: Memo Paris Sicilian Leather Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Memo Paris Sicilian Leather is a bright leather with citrus, cardamom and fir.
Launched in 2021, it opens with leather, lemon, cedar and bitter orange. Bergamot, lime, cardamom, violet leaf and coriander form a fresh heart, and guaiac wood, balsam fir, Akigalawood and patchouli give it a woody finish.
Fresh and refined, it is a great daytime scent from spring through fall.

name: Memo Paris Sintra Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Memo Paris Sintra is a sweet, milky blend of orange blossom, marshmallow and caramel.
Philippe Paparella-Paris created it in 2020. Neroli, petitgrain, red fruits and bergamot open bright, milk, orange blossom, cinnamon, jasmine and rose form a creamy heart, and marshmallow, vanilla, caramel, musk and cedar give it a soft finish.
Sweet and comforting, it is a lovely everyday scent.

name: Memo Paris Siwa Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Memo Paris Siwa is an unusual blend of popcorn, narcissus and whiskey.
Aliénor Massenet created it in 2007. Popcorn and musk open warm, narcissus, whiskey and cinnamon form a golden heart, and violet leaf and aldehydes give it a green, powdery finish.
Playful and distinctive, it is made for spring and summer days.

name: Memo Paris Tamarindo Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Memo Paris Tamarindo is a sweet, tropical blend of pineapple, tuberose and coconut.
Sophie Labbé created it in 2018. Bergamot, cardamom, mandarin and orange open bright, pineapple, jasmine, tuberose, ylang-ylang, peach and coconut form a lush heart, and patchouli, vanilla and benzoin give it a warm finish.
Sunny and cheerful, it is great for outings and the office in spring and summer.

Parisian fragrance house Memo Paris see fragrance as a journey around magical destinations and potent raw materials.
Tamarindo Eau De Parfum is the olfactive memory of the Pacific coast of Costa Rica, surrounded by tropical rainforests and macaws. With notes of pineapple, jasmine and vanilla, Tamarindo is a heady floral and fruity scent that takes the breath away.

name: Memo Paris The Flying Collection London Tweed Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Memo Paris London Tweed is a warm, spicy blend of bergamot, ginger and cardamom.
Sophie Labbé created it in 2019. Bergamot opens bright, ginger forms a warm, spicy heart, and cardamom gives it an aromatic finish.
Fresh and refined, it is a lovely scent for spring.

London Tweed by Memo Paris is a Aromatic Spicy fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. London Tweed was launched in 2019. The nose behind this fragrance is Sophie Labbe. Top note is Bergamot; middle note is Ginger; base note is Cardamom.

name: Memo Paris Tiger's Nest Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Memo Paris Tiger's Nest is a warm, smoky blend of incense, saffron and osmanthus.
Launched in 2018, it blends incense, tolu balsam, amber, absinthe, vanilla, aldehydes and papyrus with saffron, osmanthus, rose, lime and ylang-ylang for a powdery, balsamic and smoky scent.
Rich and serene, it is great for everyday wear and outings in fall and winter.

Nestled high in the mountain cliffs
of Bhutan, the Paro Taktsang is a Buddhist holy site of breathtaking
beauty, seemingly suspended between heaven and earth. With Tiger's Nest,
MEMO draws on the full beauty of this sacred place- spiritual,
cultural, and geographic- to deliver a sublime incense scent both
joyfully bright and richly nuanced. Sparkling citrus and aldehyde notes
contrast against a bitter, herbaceous absinthe accord, elevating the
consciousness and opening the way for a gorgeous incense- cool,
ethereal, gently smoky- that weaves in delicate spice and subtly sweet,
transparent florals for a profoundly transportative mood. Papyrus
extends the verisimilitude, evoking treasured texts, and tolu balsam
furthers the feeling of ancient structures embraced by the earth. We
don't travel merely to see places we've never been before, but to
experience the unique energy that they give to the world. As such,
Tiger's Nest is not merely a visit to Bhutan, but a brush with
enlightenment.
Tiger's Nest  Notes
Oil of absinthe, aldehyde, lime, saffron, incense, osmanthus, ylang ylang, rose, papyrus, vanilla, tolu balsam

name: Memo Paris Vaadhoo Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Memo Paris Vaadhoo is an aromatic blend of ginger, immortelle and vetiver.
Aliénor Massenet created it in 2019. Ginger, basil and cassis open bright, geranium, immortelle and jasmine form a warm heart, and vetiver, patchouli and moss give it an earthy finish.
Distinctive and warm, it works day or night in fall.

Vaadhoo by Memo Paris is a Chypre Floral fragrance for women and men. Vaadhoo was launched in 2019. The nose behind this fragrance is Alienor Massenet. Top notes are Ginger, Basil and Cassis; middle notes are Geranium, Immortelle and Jasmine; base notes are Vetiver, Patchouli and Moss.

name: Memo Paris Winter Palace Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Memo Paris Winter Palace is a warm, citrusy blend of red tea, vanilla and balsams.
Aliénor Massenet created it in 2019. Orange, lemon, grapefruit and bergamot brighten red tea and maté, while tolu balsam, vanilla, tonka bean, amber, benzoin, labdanum and musk give it a cozy, glowing depth.
Comforting and easy, it works year-round as a daytime scent.

"The awakening of the dragon, imperial. Eyes sparkling with icy fire.
Oil of orange. He rises above my cup of red tea, his breath swirling
the flavor of bergamot. His trembling shadow stretches out to my place
in the hall of honor. Suddenly the heat swells, and the atmosphere
shifts from citrus to intense wood. Soaring into the air, he vanishes
from the palace in a flash of powder. Benzoin. What is he looking for?
All of a sudden, it stops snowing outside. I can see him in the
distance, undulating in sync with the Great Wall of China. The dragon is
dancing with joy, drunk on freedom. He sows an everlasting spring, maté
tea, grapefruit, and yet leaves a wake of passionate amber and vanilla.

name: Mercedes Benz Club Black Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
Mercedes-Benz Club Black is a smooth, smoky vanilla with incense.
Launched in 2017, it opens with bergamot. Incense and jasmine form a smoky heart, and vanilla, benzoin, ambroxan and woods give it a warm, sweet finish.
Made for fall and winter nights.

Mercedes Benz Club Black by Mercedes-Benz is a Amber fragrance for men. Mercedes Benz Club Black was launched in 2017. Top note is Bergamot; middle notes are Incense and Jasmine; base notes are Vanilla, Benzoin, Ambroxan and Woodsy Notes.

name: Mercedes Benz Club Eau de Toilette Spray for Men

notes.source_text:
Mercedes-Benz Club is an aromatic blend of rhubarb, juniper and cardamom.
Olivier Cresp created it in 2013. Rhubarb and citrus open bright, spices, juniper berries, water notes and cardamom form an aromatic heart, and ambroxan, woods, patchouli and tonka bean give it a warm finish.
Fresh and versatile, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

Youthful, colorful, sophisticated, and unique, the first fragrance from
Miu Miu offers a contemporary vision of lily of the valley twisted with
Akigalawood, bringing a rich, brooding mystery to the subtle sparkle
of the floral.
Miuccia Prada is a master of the
counterintuitive. She mixes the common and the ultra-refined to create
something surprising and yet never contrived. Inspired by her vision,
perfumer Daniela Andrier created a study in contrast, beginning with an
elegant, sensual floral, lily of the valley, and continuing with real
jasmine, real rose absolute, and synthetic green notes. The soft, fresh
scent is set against a deep earth-toned background, the wood and pepper
of Akigalawood, an extract of patchouli.
Fragrance Family:
Fresh
Scent Type:
Fresh Florals
Key Notes:
Lily of the Valley

name: Miu Miu MIU MIU L'eau Bleue Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Miu Miu L'Eau Bleue is a dewy, green white floral with lily-of-the-valley and wild rose.
Daniela Andrier created it in 2016. Lily-of-the-valley opens fresh, green notes, a dew accord, white flowers, wild rose, jasmine and hedione form an airy heart, and Akigalawood and white musk give it a clean finish.
Light and fresh, it is great for everyday wear and outings in spring and summer.

The Miu Miu woman revels in her contradictions: forthright and coy,
playful and rebellious, delicate yet daring. For her, Miuccia Prada
imagined a fragrance that is surprising and supremely refined, yet
uncontrived. She shared her inspiration with perfumer Daniela Andrier,
who went on to create this study in contrasts. Miu Miu L'Eau Bleue is a
perfume that evokes the essence of early spring and new beginnings. This
fresh floral Eau de Parfum captures the essence of lily of the valley

cool spring dawn. A transparent tint of honeysuckle lends a touch of
fragile femininity to the fragrance. As it dries down, L'Eau Bleue
reveals the richness of a reawakened Earth, thanks to the depth and
spice of an exclusive Akigalawood accord.

The Scoop
To say aoud and musk loom large in
the house of Montale would be an understatement: both star in several
fragrances, and it was only a matter of time before they properly
introduced to each other...
Aoud Musk, one of Montale's recently launched Brown Collection,
plays on the contrasting warmth of its two main notes. The plushness of
the musk settles like a sweet haze on the skin, wrapping the more
forceful oud in its sensuous languor. Saffron bolsters the leathery
facets of agarwood and vetiver adds a further touch of smokiness, while
amber adds a soft, powdery touch to the blend. This is oud tamed and
stroked into a throaty purr, with just the barest tip of a claw showing.

but don't confuse that with overly strong. It's medium bodied and very
rich, a bubbling potion of velvety rose and the old leather feel of

The Scoop
Do you ever find yourself lingering
in the coffee aisle at the grocery store? Taking in deep breaths by the
grinder? You're not alone. There may be no smell more comforting and
compelling than the bitter, deep, mouthwatering fragrance of the coffee
bean. Montale's Intense Cafe opens with a perfect waft of fresh brewing
coffee that will take your breath away.
The flourish of coffee bean is paired with a fresh, vegetal
rose. The two combine for an unexpectedly dry and refreshing top note.
As the coffee softens, a vanillic white musk emerges, slightly
sweetening the brew with just a hint of cream and sugar. Even in the
final ambery drydown the coffee remains as a rich and nutty presence.

We didn't think it was possible to come up with something innovative in the time-honored, traditional vetiver genre. Leave it to Montale to prove us wrong and to excite our jaded senses with their new rendition of the note. In Red Vetiver, the dry roots and cedarwood are set on fire by a red-hot mix of spices. The contrast of the cool greenness of vetiver and of the sizzling pepper is irresistible. A cold wave is followed by a hot one, the sensations change over and over again, making the blend dangerously addictive. A must have for vetiver connoisseurs and lovers of spicy fragrances.
