The Scoop
"The fragrance aims to evoke the
best quality of Hashish. The result of a quest to arouse the effects of
temporary bliss." The Nose.
The journey down to the inky heart of Black Afgano is a scent
trip only for the daring among you. If you're a lover of light, bright
and airy fragrances, then you'll want to stop reading right about...now.
Aiming to capture the qualities of hashish (without the police banging
down your door), mystery and intrigue has followed this perfume since
its inception. Rumors swirled that the debut of Afgano was held up for
months due to the necessary procurement and smuggling of the.. eh, “raw
material” (nudge nudge, wink wink). But it was definitely worth the
wait. For those asking the obvious, no, it doesn't smell exactly like
burning hashish... or so we hear, of course. Black Afgano is meant to
capture some of the scent qualities and all of the effects of the herb:
smoky, smooth and deep; a mellow yet deep and distinct fragrance high.
The black colored perfume is a study in how to arouse the effects of
temporary bliss, without all the side effects. Rich and hypnotic, with
dark and dangerous notes, this is a beautifully relentless and utterly
enveloping scent. Black Afgano is a strong smoke and incense fragrance
that is surprisingly never overpowering. We can honestly say, this
fragrance is dope.

name: Nasomatto Blamage Parfum Extrait Unisex

notes.source_text:
Nasomatto Blamage is a smoky, leathery blend of birch, musk and white woods.
Alessandro Gualtieri created it in 2014. Birch, musk, white woods and leather come together in a dry, smoky and slightly animalic scent.
Bold and distinctive, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

Blamage by Nasomatto is a fragrance for women and men. Blamage was launched in 2014. The nose behind this fragrance is Alessandro Gualtieri. The fragrance features white woods, leather, birch and musk.

name: Nasomatto China White Parfum Extrait Unisex

notes.source_text:
Nasomatto China White is a soft, powdery blend of florals, rose and musk.
Alessandro Gualtieri created it in 2008. Powdery notes, woods, musk, florals and rose come together in a delicate, clean and elegant scent.
Quiet and refined, it is a lovely daytime scent in spring and fall.

Nasomatto China White was presented in 2008 as a floral-woody fragrance for women, composed of powdery notes of fresh flowers and woody accords. The perfume is available in a bottle with a shiny white cap in amount 30 ml perfume extract. Perfumer is Alessandro Gualtieri.

name: Nasomatto Duro Parfum Extrait Unisex

notes.source_text:
Nasomatto Duro is a dark, smoky blend of woods, leather and spice.
Alessandro Gualtieri created it in 2007. Woods, leather and spices come together in a dense, animalic and smoky scent with real presence.
Bold and rugged, it works day or night in fall and winter.

The fragrance aims to enhance all the manifestations of male strength.  The nose behind this fragrance is Alessandro Gualtieri.

name: Nasomatto Fantomas Extrait de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Nasomatto Fantomas is a strange, playful blend of rubber, smoke, melon and caramel.
Alessandro Gualtieri created it in 2020. Rubber, plastic, melon, smoke, gunpowder and caramel meet tropical fruit, cashmeran and patchouli for a surprising, sweet and smoky scent unlike anything else.
Bold and unconventional, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

Fantomas by Nasomatto is a fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Fantomas was launched in 2020. The nose behind this fragrance is Alessandro Gualtieri.

name: Nasomatto Narcotic Venus Parfum Extrait Unisex

notes.source_text:
Nasomatto Narcotic Venus is a lush, heady blend of tuberose, jasmine and lily.
Alessandro Gualtieri created it in 2007. Tuberose, jasmine and lily meet warm spices for a rich, intoxicating white floral with an animalic edge.
Seductive and powerful, it works day or night in spring and fall.

The fragrance is the result of a quest for the overwhelming addictive intensity of female sexual power. . The nose behind this fragrance is Alessandro Gualtieri.

name: Nasomatto Nudiflorum Extrait de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Nasomatto Nudiflorum is a mossy, leathery blend of rhubarb, raspberry and rose.
Alessandro Gualtieri created it in 2018. Rhubarb opens tart and green, raspberry and rose form a fruity floral heart, and oakmoss, leather, cedar and animalic notes give it a dark, earthy finish.
Unusual and sensual, it works day or night.

Nudiflorum by Nasomatto is a Floral Woody Musk fragrance for women and men. Nudiflorum was launched in 2018. The nose behind this fragrance is Alessandro Gualtieri.

name: Nasomatto Pardon Extrait de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Nasomatto Pardon is a rich blend of dark chocolate, cinnamon and oud.
Alessandro Gualtieri created it in 2011. Magnolia and flowers open soft, dark chocolate, tonka bean and cinnamon form a gourmand heart, and oud and sandalwood give it a deep finish.
Made for fall and winter, day or night.

Pardon by Nasomatto is a fragrance for men. Pardon
was launched in 2011. The nose behind this fragrance is Alessandro
Gualtieri. Top notes are Magnolia and Flowers; middle notes are Dark
Chocolate, Tonka Bean and Cinnamon; base notes are Agarwood (Oud) and
Sandalwood.

name: Nasomatto Sadonaso Extrait de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Nasomatto Sadonaso is a dark, sweet blend of coffee, tobacco and vanilla.
Alessandro Gualtieri created it in 2023. Coffee opens rich and roasted, musk, sandalwood and tobacco form a smoky heart, and tonka bean, vanilla, amber and animalic notes give it a warm, powdery finish.
Intense and seductive, it is made for nights out.

name: Nasomatto Silver Musk Parfum Extrait Unisex

notes.source_text:
Nasomatto Silver Musk is a clean, soft and powdery musk.
Alessandro Gualtieri created it in 2007. Built around musk, it feels smooth, airy and close to the skin, like freshly washed linen warmed by the sun.
Quiet and comforting, it is lovely on spring and summer days.

The fragrance aims to evoke superhero magnetism. It is the result of a quest for mercurian liquid love sensation. The nose behind this fragrance is Alessandro Gualtieri.

name: Nautica Voyage Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
Nautica Voyage is a fresh, green blend of apple, lotus and oakmoss.
Maurice Roucel created it in 2006. Apple and green leaves open crisp, lotus and mimosa form a soft, aquatic heart, and musk, cedar, oakmoss and amber give it a clean finish.
Light and easy, it is made for spring and summer days.

Nautica Voyage is a fresh and salty sea breeze,that carries romantic scents of coastal herbs and woods, and awakes the man's instinct to measure his power with wild nature. This is a fragrance for an active and romantic man who lives by his own rules. The face of the scent is TV host Caster Oosterhouse, a truly romantic person and a good nautician.

name: Nautica Voyage Heritage Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
Nautica Voyage Heritage is an aromatic blend of mint, lavender and ginger.
Launched in 2018, it opens with mint and rosemary. Lavender and ginger form a fresh, spicy heart, and sandalwood and guaiac wood give it a woody finish.
Fresh and easy, it is made for spring and summer days.

Nautica Voyage Heritage by Nautica is a Woody Aromatic fragrance for men. This is a new fragrance. Nautica Voyage Heritage
was launched in 2018. Top notes are Mint and Rosemary; middle notes are
Lavender and Ginger; base notes are Sandalwood and Guaiac Wood.

name: Nautica Voyage N-83 Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
Nautica Voyage N-83 is a marine blend of sea notes, mint and lavender.
Launched in 2013, it opens with sea notes, spicy mint and petitgrain. Lavender, cardamom and nutmeg form an aromatic heart, and musk, cedar and sandalwood give it a clean finish.
Breezy and crisp, it is made for spring and summer days.

Nautica Voyage N-83 by Nautica is a Aromatic Aquatic fragrance for men. Nautica Voyage N-83 was launched in 2013. Top notes are sea notes, spicy mint and petitgrain; middle notes are cardamom, nutmeg and lavender; base notes are musk, sandalwood and cedar.

name: Nautica Voyage Sport Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
Nautica Voyage Sport is a fresh, marine blend of sea salt, apple and vetiver.
Launched in 2016, it opens with sea notes, citrus, sea salt and coriander. Apple, geranium, palm leaf and green pepper form a green heart, and musk, patchouli, redwood and vetiver give it a woody finish.
Sporty and fresh, it is made for spring and summer days.

Nautica Voyage Sport by Nautica is a Woody Aromatic fragrance for men. Nautica Voyage Sport
was launched in 2016. Top notes are Sea Notes, Citruses, Sea Salt and
Coriander; middle notes are Apple, Geranium, Palm Leaf and Green Pepper;
base notes are Musk, Patchouli, Brazilian Redwood and Vetiver.

name: Navitus Parfums Absolutio Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Navitus Absolutio is a rich, spicy gourmand of saffron, toffee and dark chocolate.
Bertrand Duchaufour created it in 2019. Saffron, cinnamon and almond open warm, toffee and apple form a sweet heart, and driftwood, musk, ambergris, caramel, dark chocolate and oakmoss give it a deep finish.
Indulgent and cozy, it is made for fall and winter nights.

Absolutio by Navitus Parfums is a fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Absolutio was launched in 2019. The nose behind this fragrance is Bertrand Duchaufour. Top notes are Saffron, Cinnamon and Almond; middle notes are Toffee and Apple; base notes are Driftwood, Musk, Ambergris, Caramel, Dark Chocolate and Oakmoss.
"“Veritas Nunquam Perit”
Veritas nunquam perit. A state of absolution is a state of truthfulness of self. A release from consequence liberates the spirit and allows it to roam without limiting fear. However, temptation persists, and the power lies within us to either take the bait or evade it. A luscious opening of cherry and almond reminds us of the tantalizing nature of
the earthy delights that tempt. Cinnamon swoons and beckons with a spicy warmth that is carried throughout the long-lasting fragrance. A heart of apple and sweet toffee starts to stray away from temptation and into a realm of truth and mercy. A base of caramel and chocolate serves as a reminder of our lascivious way until grounding and meditative notes of musk, ambergris, and oakmoss bring us back to sensibility. In this tug of war between temperance and intoxication, Absolutio is the rope. Tempt or be tempted; the choice is yours. The truth never
perishes." - a note from the brand.

name: Navitus Parfums Arcanum Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Navitus Parfums Arcanum is a warm, spicy blend of cinnamon, oud and vanilla.
Jorge Lee created it in 2020. Cinnamon, olibanum and coconut open rich, osmanthus, Laotian oud and labdanum form a resinous heart, and vanilla, tonka bean and amberwood give it a sweet finish.
Bold and cozy, it is made for fall and winter nights.

Arcanum by Navitus Parfums is a fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Arcanum was launched in 2020. The nose behind this fragrance is Jorge Lee. Top notes are Cinnamon, Olibanum and Coconut; middle notes are Osmanthus, Laotian Oud and Labdanum; base notes are Vanilla, Tonka Bean and Amberwood.
"Carpe Noctem
The moonlight is cast on the illuminated city. The whir of luxury automobiles and bleeding dialogues add to the soundtrack of the city after dusk. Neon lights and towering skyscrapers define the aesthetic of the landscape in which our protagonist is found wandering. Enshrouded in an air of mystery, we follow our obscure figure through crowded streets to an unknown destination. Meaning “mystery” or “secret,” Arcanum opens up with a dash of alluring cinnamon spice and delicious coconut before settling on a bed of sensual osmanthus and mysterious agarwood from Laos. A medley of incense anchors the enigmatic and cryptic aura of the fragrance until dark amberwoods, intoxicating vanilla, and beguiling tonka bean conclude the olfactory aria. Seize the night!" - a note from the brand.

name: Navitus Parfums Carte Blanche Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Navitus Carte Blanche is a smooth blend of citrus, roasted almond and vanilla.
Bertrand Duchaufour created it in 2021. Italian mandarin, Sicilian bergamot and cardamom open bright, roasted almond, benzoin, driftwood and vetiver form a warm heart, and patchouli, Bourbon vanilla, Peru balsam, musk and ambergris give it a rich finish.
Versatile and refined, it works day or night from spring through fall.

Carte Blanche is a unique all year fragrance opening with a unique freshness of Italian mandarin, Sicilian Bergamot, Guatemalan cardamom and an agrest accord combined with the warmth of grilled almonds, driftwood, benzoin, vanilla and other ingredients.
Created by Master Perfumer:
Bertrand Duchaufour
Created with the creative vision of Monika Cioch, Carte Blanche was imagined as a depiction of the feeling of being relaxed and enjoying the time with those you care about. The fragrance opens with a unique freshness brought to life through the alliance of Italian mandarin, Sicilian bergamot, Guatemalan cardamom and an agrest accord. This unique opening then combines with the warmth of grilled almonds and the light saltiness of driftwood, along with benzoin and Java vetiver in the heart. Furthermore, as the fragrances develops, one encounters Madagascar vanilla mixed with ambergris, Indonesian patchouli, Peru balsam and musk encompassing this whole fragrance into a blanket of intricate refinement.

name: Navitus Parfums Champagne Royale Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Navitus Champagne Royale is a sparkling blend of champagne, plum and leather.
Julien Rasquinet created it in 2021. Sicilian lemon, Italian mandarin and a champagne accord open bright, plum, iris, cypress, cinnamon, nutmeg and geranium form a spicy heart, and fir balsam, guaiac wood, cedar and leather give it a woody finish.
Festive and polished, it works day or night in spring and summer.

Champagne Royale is a new perfume by Navitus Parfums for men and was released in 2021. The scent is woody-spicy.

name: Navitus Parfums Creme Imperiale Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Navitus Parfums Crème Impériale is a creamy, spicy floral with jasmine, plum and iris.
Julien Rasquinet created it in 2021. Sicilian lemon and Indian jasmine sambac open bright, plum, iris, Ceylon cinnamon, Turkish rose and geranium form a rich heart, and jasmine, guaiac wood, benzoin and Virginia cedar give it a warm finish.
Elegant and versatile, it works day or night from spring through fall.

Creme Imperiale is a new perfume by Navitus Parfums for women and men and was released in 2021. The scent is floral-resinous.

name: Navitus Parfums Eidola Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Navitus Eidola is a lush, fruity rose with citrus and peach.
Francis Kurkdjian and Jérôme Di Marino created it in 2020. Italian mandarin, orange and bergamot open bright, French and Bulgarian rose, jasmine and peach form a rich heart, and vanilla, cedar, patchouli and Haitian vetiver give it a warm finish.
Romantic and elegant, it works day or night in spring and fall.

Eidola by Navitus Parfums is a Amber Floral fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Eidola was launched in 2020. Eidola was created by Francis Kurkdjian and Jerome Di Marino. Top notes are Italian Mandarin, Orange and Bergamot; middle notes are French Rose, Bulgarian Rose, Jasmine and Peach; base notes are Vanilla, Cedar, Patchouli and Haitian Vetiver.

name: Navitus Parfums Elation Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Navitus Elation is a bright, aromatic blend of citrus, lavender and juniper.
Bertrand Duchaufour created it in 2020. Clementine, yuzu, bergamot, lime, pomelo and orange open sparkling, geranium, lavender, clary sage, juniper and petitgrain form an herbal heart, and amberwood, fern, patchouli, nutmeg, driftwood and moss give it a woody finish.
Fresh and uplifting, it is made for spring and summer days.

Elation by Navitus Parfums is a Citrus Aromatic fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Elation was launched in 2020. The nose behind this fragrance is Bertrand Duchaufour. Top notes are Clementine, Yuzu, Bergamot, Lime, Pomelo and Brazilian Orange; middle notes are Geranium, Lavender, Clary Sage, Juniper Berries and Petitgrain; base notes are Amberwood, Fern, Patchouli, Nutmeg, Driftwood, Moss and Musk.

name: Navitus Parfums Exalt Nuit Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Navitus Parfums Exalt Nuit is a dark, sweet blend of cacao, incense and tobacco.
Francis Kurkdjian and Jérôme Di Marino created it in 2020. Cacao, bergamot, olibanum and nutmeg open rich, jasmine, anise, benzoin, Madagascar pepper and labdanum form the heart, and tobacco, cedar and Haitian vetiver give it a deep finish.
Mysterious and warm, it is made for fall and winter nights.

Exalt Nuit by Navitus Parfums is a Amber Spicy fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Exalt Nuit was launched in 2020. Exalt Nuit was created by Francis Kurkdjian and Jerome Di Marino. Top notes are Cacao, Bergamot, Olibanum and Nutmeg; middle notes are Jasmine, Anise, Benzoin, Madagascar Pepper and Labdanum; base notes are Tobacco, Cedar and Haitian Vetiver.

name: Navitus Parfums Intimus Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Navitus Intimus is a sweet blend of apple, spun sugar and vanilla.
Christian Carbonnel created it in 2019. Apple, bergamot, florals, lemon, orange and pink pepper open bright, lily-of-the-valley, amber and geranium form the heart, and spun sugar, vanilla, patchouli, woods, musk and oakmoss give it a sweet finish.
Cozy and seductive, it is made for fall and winter nights.

Intimus by Navitus Parfums is a fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Intimus was launched in 2019. The nose behind this fragrance is Christian Carbonnel. Top notes are Apple, Bergamot, Floral Notes, Lemon, Orange and Pink Pepper; middle notes are Lily-of-the-Valley, Amber and Geranium; base notes are spun sugar, Vanilla, Patchouli, Woody Notes, Musk and Oakmoss.
"Amor Vincit Omnia
Amor vincit omnia. Borrowed from the Latin word for intimate, Intimus is a romantic composition that woos and sways its wearer into an amorous dimension. Undying love is represented through the infinity symbol, and only the truest love may stand the test of time. Beguiling notes of toasted sugar and vanilla entice you with their decadent aromas. Geranium and amber seduce their way into the blend and create a dichotomous yet balanced essence. The composition concludes with an earthy duality of oakmoss and patchouli that is both grounding and virile. For the most intimate occasions throughout the course of your adventures, Intimus is the perfect companion. Love conquers all!" - a note from the brand.

name: Navitus Parfums Lautus Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Navitus Lautus is a fresh, woody blend of lavender, yuzu and orris.
Bertrand Duchaufour created it in 2020. Lavender, yuzu, lemon verbena and neroli open bright, cascarilla, orris root, juniper and freesia form an aromatic heart, and sandalwood, vanilla, rosewood, patchouli and ambergris give it a smooth finish.
Clean and refined, it is a great daytime scent in spring and fall.

Lautus by Navitus Parfums is a fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Lautus was launched in 2020. The nose behind this fragrance is Bertrand Duchaufour. Top notes are Lavender, Yuzu, Lemon Verbena and Neroli; middle notes are Cascarilla, Orris Root, Juniper Berries and Freesia; base notes are Sandalwood, Vanilla, Palisander Rosewood, Patchouli, Ambergris and Musk.
"Esse Quam Videri
Borrowed from the Latin word for “chic” or “elegant,” Lautus is the olfactory expression of unquestionable distinction and unrelenting elegance. The chypré genre is rife with mossy undertones and camphoraceous and woody touches. This modern expression of the classic genre couples these familiar elements with invigorating and unconventional yuzu citrus, enchanting cascarilla flower, and a touch of natural vanilla absolute. These infusions catapult the fragrance into a modern dimension where the fragrance is both timeless and novel. Lavender carries out an elaborate performance before warm patchouli and exotic ambergris in the base add dimension and non-linearity to create complexity and intrigue. Allow the energy of this dignified creation to transform your spirit so that you are elegant beyond your scent. Allow yourself to be, rather than to seem" - a note from the brand.

name: Navitus Parfums Lyrik Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Navitus Lyrik is a warm, spicy blend of cardamom, almond and toffee.
Dominique Ropion and Julien Rasquinet created it in 2021. Sicilian lemon, bergamot and Indian cardamom open bright, almond, caraway, jasmine and pepper form the heart, and toffee, cinnamon, frankincense and musk give it a warm finish.
Smooth and distinctive, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

Lyrik by Navitus Parfums is a fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Aubade was launched in 2021. Aubade was created by Dominique Ropion and Julien Rasquinet.

name: Navitus Parfums Oud Imperium Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Navitus Oud Imperium is a smooth blend of apple, vanilla and oud.
Christian Carbonnel created it in 2019. Apple, lavender and lemon open fresh, vanilla, jasmine, lily-of-the-valley and woods form a soft heart, and cypriol, oud, amber, guaiac wood, tonka bean and sandalwood give it a warm finish.
Opulent and smooth, it is made for fall and winter nights.

Oud Imperium by Navitus Parfums is a fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Oud Imperium was launched in 2019. The nose behind this fragrance is Christian Carbonnel. Top notes are Apple, Lavender and Lemon; middle notes are Vanilla, Jasmine, Lily-of-the-Valley and Woody Notes; base notes are Cypriol Oil or Nagarmotha, Agarwood (Oud), Amber, Guaiac Wood, Tonka Bean, Musk and Sandalwood.
"Per Aspera, Ad Astra
Per aspera, ad astra. In this olfactory tale, Oud is the protagonist on his epic journey towards a most triumphant finale. Imperium is Latin for “command” or “empire,” and Oud Imperium is a most regal take on one of the most sought after and elusive raw materials. Strength and boundless unity are the themes of the story, and they are conveyed in the most majestic way. A natural oud blend is accented with notes of lavender and ripe apple. A powerful fruity and aromatic introduction eventually transitions into a heart of jasmine, lily of the valley, and vanilla that preserves the vigor of the refined blend. Amber, sandalwood, tonka bean, and nagarmotha fuse to form a resolution that is as engaging as the scent’s introduction. Oud Imperium is the perfect fragrance to help you conquer your day. Whatever challenges you may face, may you find your way through the thorns to the stars." - a note from the brand.

name: Navitus Parfums Oud Luxuria Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Navitus Oud Luxuria is a spicy rose with saffron, leather and oud.
Christian Carbonnel created it in 2019. Turkish rose, saffron, leather, pink pepper and cinnamon open warm, rose, geranium, jasmine and osmanthus form a floral heart, and oud, incense, musk, labdanum and amber give it a rich finish.
Opulent and bold, it is made for fall and winter nights.

Oud Luxuria by Navitus Parfums is a fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Oud Luxuria was launched in 2019. The nose behind this fragrance is Christian Carbonnel. Top notes are Turkish Rose, Saffron, Leather, Pink Pepper and Cinnamon; middle notes are Rose, Geranium, Jasmine and Osmanthus; base notes are Agarwood (Oud), Incense, Musk, Labdanum and Amber.
"Luceat Lux Vestra
Luceat lux vestra. Extravagant displays of wealth and opulence mark the aroma of this exquisite perfume. There is no denying the grandeur and expensiveness of rose, and Oud Luxuria spotlights two varieties of the natural ingredient. A lush opening of Turkish rose, pink berries, and saffron carry the lavishness of the blend while jasmine, osmanthus, and geranium intensify the luxurious nature of the scent with their rich and inviting appeal. A base of musk, incense, labdanum, and natural oud proffer their tribute to the practices of perfumery from times past. With a name borrowed from the word “luxury,” which originally meant “lust,” there is no denying the sensuality and carnality of this lush and captivating perfume. This illuminating fragrance will grant you brilliance and splendor. Let your light shine!" - a note from the brand.

name: Navitus Parfums Prima Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Navitus Prima is a tropical, woody blend of green mango, bergamot and patchouli.
Jorge Lee created it in 2019. Green mango, bergamot, grapefruit and rosewood open bright, patchouli, cedar and jasmine form an earthy heart, and oakmoss, musk, amberwood and labdanum give it a warm finish.
Fresh and lively, it is made for spring and summer days.

Primas by Navitus Parfums is a fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Primas was launched in 2019. The nose behind this fragrance is Jorge Lee. Top notes are Green Mango, Bergamot, Grapefruit and Palisander Rosewood; middle notes are Patchouli, Cedar and Jasmine; base notes are Oakmoss, Musk, Amberwood and Labdanum.
"Semper Paratus
Semper paratus. Whether in body or mind, a readiness to adapt is a skill requisite for success. Primas is the beginning, and it signals the start of a new journey. An awakening blend of green, ripe mango is complemented by the juicy freshness of grapefruit and invigorating bergamot. Jasmine and patchouli establish an earthly warmth that is peaceful yet adventurous. A base comprised of dark amberwoods and musk breathes spirit and vitality into the blend for an odyssey whose travels are as exciting as the embarkation. Be always prepared." - a note from the brand.

name: Navitus Parfums Reve Nuit Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Navitus Rêve Nuit is an aromatic blend of neroli, custard and vetiver.
Lucas Sieuzac created it in 2020. Lemon, custard, neroli, cardamom and bergamot open bright, rosemary, cypress, jasmine and freesia form an herbal heart, and cedar, vanilla, Haitian vetiver and labdanum give it a warm finish.
Smooth and distinctive, it is a great night scent in spring and fall.

Reve Nuit by Navitus Parfums is a Aromatic Fruity fragrance for women and men. Reve Nuit was launched in 2020. Reve Nuit was created by Lucas Sieuzac and Olaf Larsen. Top notes are Lemon, Custard, Tunisian Neroli, Guatemalan Cardamom and Calabrian bergamot; middle notes are Rosemary, Cypress, Jasmine and Freesia; base notes are Cedar, Vanilla, Haitian Vetiver and Spanish Labdanum.

name: Navitus Parfums Soir Exclusif Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Navitus Parfums Soir Exclusif is a sweet, powdery blend of almond, coffee and marshmallow.
Bertrand Duchaufour created it in 2020. Almond, coffee and orange open rich, orchid, marshmallow, tonka bean and licorice form a soft heart, and driftwood, vanilla, tolu balsam, ambergris, musk and oakmoss give it a warm finish.
Indulgent and elegant, it is made for fall and winter nights.

Soir Exclusif by Navitus Parfums is a Amber Vanilla fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Soir Exclusif was launched in 2020. The nose behind this fragrance is Bertrand Duchaufour. Top notes are Almond, Coffee, Blood Orange and Brazilian Orange; middle notes are Orchid, Marshmallow, Tonka Bean and Licorice; base notes are Driftwood, Vanilla, Tolu Balsam, Ambergris, Musk and Oakmoss.

name: Navitus Parfums Soleil Matin Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Navitus Soleil Matin is a sparkling citrus with mandarin, pepper and cedar.
Francis Kurkdjian and Jérôme Di Marino created it in 2020. Italian mandarin, lime, orange, grapefruit and lemon open bright, Madagascar pepper and jasmine form a spicy heart, and Atlas cedar, ambroxan, musk and sandalwood give it a clean finish.
Fresh and lively, it works day or night in spring and fall.

Soleil Matin by Navitus Parfums is a Citrus Aromatic fragrance for women and men. Soleil Matin was launched in 2020. Soleil Matin was created by Francis Kurkdjian and Jerome Di Marino. Top notes are Italian Mandarin, Lime, Orange, Grapefruit and Lemon; middle notes are Madagascar Pepper, Lemon, Pepper and Jasmine; base notes are Atlas Cedar, Ambroxan, Musk and Sandalwood.

name: Navitus Parfums The Embrace Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Navitus Parfums The Embrace is a warm, honeyed blend of coffee, sesame and vanilla.
Sidonie Lancesseur created it in 2021. Italian mandarin, Sicilian bergamot and Indian sesame absolute open bright, honey and coffee absolute form a rich heart, and Virginian cedarwood, Haitian vetiver and Madagascar vanilla give it a cozy finish.
Comforting and gourmand, it is made for fall and winter, day or night.

The Embrace is an intense, addictive and seductive scent that combines unique ingredients of Sesame Absolute, Honey, Coffee Absolute and South African almonds, to create a memorable and unique fragrance experience.
Created by Master Perfumer:
Sidonie Lancesseur
Created with the creative vision of Monika Cioch, The Embrace is an intoxicating and seductive unisex fragrance that contains a very unexpected set of ingredients aimed at creating a warm and addictive experience for the wearer and those around. The Embrace opens with bitter orange hidden behind Indian Sesame Absolute, a very rarely used natural ingredient in perfumery, and South African almonds capturing attention from the first spray. A unique honey accord combined with coffee absolute add further warmth to the opening, with Madagascar vanilla, Haitian vetiver and Virginian cedarwood adding depth in the fragrance.

name: Navitus Parfums Verve Matin Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Navitus Verve Matin is a fresh blend of citrus, clary sage and saffron.
Bertrand Duchaufour created it in 2020. Sicilian lemon, orange, bergamot, grapefruit and cardamom open bright, clary sage, bay leaf, juniper and saffron form an aromatic heart, and ambergris, myrrh, cinnamon, musk and driftwood give it a warm finish.

"Veni, Vidi, Vici
Veni, vidi, vici. Carrying connotations of courage and valor, Virtus is a most powerful composition fit for the brave. As the infinity symbol represents strength, Virtus is an unapologetic and powerful blend containing notes of tobacco, beeswax absolute, cinnamon, and ambergris. What opens as a spicy concoction of saffron, nutmeg, and cardamom wonderfully evolves into an enigmatic heart of mango flesh, fig milk, cinnamon, and honey. The wearer of this omnipotent composition will undoubtedly be noticed with its complex and compelling aroma, which will eventually settle into an intoxicating base of vanilla, ambergris, labdanum absolute, caramel, and driftwood. Don’t
just admire the occasion, conquer it!" - a note from the brand.

name: Nishane Hacivat Extrait de Parfum Unisex

Nishane Hacivat is a bright pineapple chypre with a mossy, woody backbone.
Jorge Lee created it in 2017. Pineapple, grapefruit and bergamot open juicy and sparkling, cedar, patchouli and jasmine add depth, and oakmoss and woods give it a classic, slightly bitter finish.
Hacivat is clean, sophisticated and professional, with a sparkle that keeps it modern. It is a daytime favorite from spring through fall.

Don’t be afraid of that pineapple note. Rich and natural-smelling rather than sporty or cheap, the pineapple note is so well done here that it redeems the reputation of the much-maligned fruit. Hacivat wears on the skin as lightly as a white linen shirt in summer. It is discreet, professional, and sparklingly clean, but possessed of just enough bitter moss and woods for gravitas. A rare, classically-built woody chypre with a contemporary edge, Hacivat just smells really wonderful and will make other people think you smell great too. Bookmark this scent if you love a modern classic.

KARAGOZ (meaning “black eye” in Turkish) and HACIVAT (shortened in time from "Haci Ivaz" meaning "Ivaz the Pilgrim"), ZENNE (the common name of the generally beautiful and flirty women featuring in various plays) are the lead characters of the traditional Turkish shadow play, popularized during the Ottoman period and then spread to most nation states that comprised the Ottoman Empire and most prominently in Turkey and Greece. The creative directors Mert Güzel and Murat Katran dreamed of bringing the legend of Karagoz & Hacivat into the today’s world. Under the inspiration of their playful characters, the perfume trilogy has been created together with the perfumer Jorge Lee. Just like the theme of these shadow plays, the main objective of NISHANE was to emphasize the contrasting interaction of the people that we can see in every single culture.

name: Orlov Paris Red Shield Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Orlov Paris Red Shield is a powdery blend of honey, iris and leather.
Quentin Bisch created it in 2018. Honey, black pepper, ambrette and cedar open warm, iris, leather, vetiver and freesia form a powdery heart, and vanilla, tonka bean, amber and musk give it a sweet finish.
Elegant and cozy, it works day or night in fall and winter.

Red Shield by Orlov Paris is a Leather fragrance for women and men. Red Shield was launched in 2018. The nose behind this fragrance is Quentin Bisch. Top notes are Honey, Black Pepper, Ambrette (Musk Mallow) and Cedar; middle notes are iris, Leather, Vetiver and Freesia; base notes are Vanilla, Tonka Bean, Amber and Musk.

name: Orlov Paris Sea of Light Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Orlov Paris Sea of Light is a fresh, salty blend of citrus, peach and sea notes.
Dominique Ropion created it in 2015. Lemon, citrus, mandarin and petitgrain open bright, black currant and peach form a fruity heart, and sea notes, salt and white musk give it a breezy finish.
Light and refreshing, it is a great everyday scent.

name: Orlov Paris Star of the Season Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Orlov Paris Star of the Season is a powdery blend of orange blossom, iris and vanilla.
Dominique Ropion created it in 2015. Orange blossom opens bright, iris and rose form a powdery heart, and vanilla, sandalwood and patchouli give it a warm, woody finish.
Elegant and smooth, it is a lovely everyday scent.

name: Orlov Paris Sun Drop Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Orlov Paris Sun Drop is a spicy blend of saffron, rose and oud.
Jordi Fernández created it in 2020. Nutmeg, saffron, cardamom and cinnamon open warm, oud, rose and clove form a rich heart, and sandalwood, musk and patchouli give it a woody finish.
Opulent and warm, it is a great everyday and evening scent.

name: Orlov Paris Supreme Star Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Orlov Paris Supreme Star is a fresh blend of grapefruit, rhubarb and vetiver.
Launched in 2018, it opens with grapefruit, bergamot and cardamom. Vetiver, apple and rhubarb form a crisp heart, and musk and woods give it a clean finish.
Fresh and easy, it is a lovely daytime scent in spring.

Supreme Star by Orlov Paris is a Woody Floral Musk fragrance for women and men. Supreme Star was launched in 2018. Top notes are Grapefruit, Bergamot and Cardamom; middle notes are Vetiver, Apple and Rhubarb; base notes are Musk and Woody Notes.

name: Orlov Paris The Best of Me Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Orlov Paris The Best of Me is an earthy rose with barley, sesame and vetiver.
Amélie Jacquin created it in 2020. Yellow mandarin and bergamot open bright, Pomarose and rose form a floral heart, and tonka bean, vetiver, barley, sesame, bran and patchouli give it a warm finish.
Distinctive and cozy, it is a lovely everyday scent.

name: Orlov Paris Walk On The Wild Side Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Orlov Paris Walk on the Wild Side is a spicy leather with ginger, saffron and caramel.
Jordi Fernández created it in 2020. Ginger, pink pepper, saffron, bergamot and cypress open spicy, jasmine, white amber and iris form a soft heart, and leather, musk, caramel and Haitian vetiver give it a sensual finish.
Bold and seductive, it is a great everyday and evening scent.

name: Ormonde Jayne 1 Qi Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Ormonde Jayne Qi is a fresh, green floral with neroli, tea and osmanthus.
Geza Schoen created it in 2012. Lemon blossom, neroli and freesia open bright, tea, osmanthus, hedione, rose and violet form an airy heart, and maté, moss, musk, benzoin and myrrh give it a soft finish.
Calm and fresh, it is a lovely everyday scent.

name: Ormonde Jayne 4. Montabaco Intensivo Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Ormonde Jayne Montabaco Intensivo is a fresh, aromatic tobacco with tea and suede.
Geza Schoen created it in 2013. Mountain air, orange oil, cardamom, bergamot, juniper and clary sage open crisp, tea, hedione, magnolia, violet and rose form the heart, and tobacco, sandalwood, suede, ambergris, moss and tonka bean give it depth.
Refined and versatile, it works year-round, day or night.

4. Montabaco Intensivo by Ormonde Jayne is a Woody Spicy fragrance for women and men. 4. Montabaco Intensivo was launched in 2013. The nose behind this fragrance is Geza Schoen. Top notes are Mountain Air, Orange Oil, Cardamom, Bergamot, Juniper and Clary Sage; middle notes are Tea, Hedione, Magnolia, Violet and Rose; base notes are Tobacco, Iso E Super, Sandalwood, Suede, Ambergris, Moss and Tonka Bean.

name: Ormonde Jayne 4. Montabaco Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Ormonde Jayne Montabaco is a fresh, aromatic tobacco with tea, suede and woods.
Geza Schoen created it in 2012. Cardamom, mountain air, juniper, bergamot, clary sage and orange open crisp, tea, hedione, magnolia, rose and violet form the heart, and tobacco leaf, suede, ambergris, sandalwood, tonka bean and moss give it a smooth finish.
Refined and easy, it is a great everyday scent.

name: Ormonde Jayne Ambre Royal Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Ormonde Jayne Ambre Royal is a soft, floral amber with osmanthus, rose and orris.
Geza Schoen created it in 2016. Green notes, orange absolute and bergamot open bright, jasmine, osmanthus, rose, amber, orris butter and orchid form a rich heart, and cedarwood, ambroxan, tonka, patchouli and musk give it a smooth finish.
Elegant and warm, it is a lovely daytime scent in spring and fall.

Ambre Royal by Ormonde Jayne is a Amber fragrance for women and men. Ambre Royal was launched in 2016.

name: Ormonde Jayne Byzance Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Ormonde Jayne Byzance is a creamy, woody blend of milk, iris and vanilla.
Launched in 2020, it opens with milk, cassis and pink pepper. White woods, cashmere wood and iris form a soft heart, and Madagascar vanilla, resins, suede and moss give it a warm finish.
Cozy and elegant, it is a lovely everyday scent.

name: Ormonde Jayne Champaca Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Ormonde Jayne Champaca is a soft, airy floral with champaca, bamboo and rice.
Geza Schoen created it in 2002. Bamboo, neroli and pink pepper open fresh, champaca, freesia and rice form a gentle heart, and green tea, musk and myrrh give it a smooth finish.
Calm and graceful, it is made for spring and summer days.

Champaca by Ormonde Jayne is a Floral fragrance for women and men. Champaca
was launched in 2002. The nose behind this fragrance is Geza Schoen.
Top notes are Bamboo, Neroli and Pink Pepper; middle notes are Champaca,
Freesia and Rice; base notes are Green Tea, Musk and Myrhh.

name: Ormonde Jayne Frangipani Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Ormonde Jayne Frangipani is a sunny, tropical floral with frangipani and lime.
Geza Schoen created it in 2003. Lime, linden blossom and magnolia open bright, frangipani, water lily, plum, tuberose and rose form a lush heart, and musk, amber, Madagascar vanilla and cedar give it a warm finish.
Radiant and cheerful, it is made for spring and summer days.

Frangipani by Ormonde Jayne is a Floral Fruity fragrance for women and men. Frangipani
was launched in 2003. The nose behind this fragrance is Geza Schoen.
Top notes are Lime, Lime (Linden) Blossom and Magnolia; middle notes are
Frangipani, Water Lily, Plum, Tuberose and Rose; base notes are Musk,
Amber, Madagascar Vanilla and Cedar.

name: Ormonde Jayne Indus Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Ormonde Jayne Indus is a fruity, spicy blend of litchi, rose and plum.
Linda Pilkington created it in 2020. Nutmeg, black currant blossom and litchi open bright, rose forms a floral heart, and musk, patchouli, plum and incense give it a warm finish.
Elegant and warm, it is a great daytime scent from spring through fall.

name: Ormonde Jayne Nawab of Oudh Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Ormonde Jayne Nawab of Oudh is a bright, spicy oud with rose and orchid.
Geza Schoen created it in 2012. Bergamot, orange, cardamom, green notes and aldehydes open fresh, hedione, rose, magnolia, pimento, orchid, bay leaf and cinnamon form a spicy heart, and labdanum, oud, vetiver, ambergris and musk give it a rich finish.
Refined and versatile, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

name: Ormonde Jayne Ormonde Elixir Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Ormonde Jayne Ormonde Elixir is a green, woody blend of black hemlock, violet and Cambodian oud.
Launched in 2019, it opens with cardamom, grass and coriander. Black hemlock, violet and jasmine form a dark, green heart, and Cambodian oud, cedar, vetiver, sandalwood and amber give it a rich finish.
Distinctive and deep, it is a strong choice for cooler days and evenings.

name: Ormonde Jayne Ormonde Man Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Ormonde Jayne Ormonde Man is a dark, green woody scent with hemlock and oud.
Geza Schoen created it in 2004. Cardamom, pink pepper, bergamot, juniper and coriander open fresh, black hemlock and oud form a woody heart, and cedar, sandalwood, vetiver and musk give it a smooth finish.
Refined and distinctive, it is a great daytime scent for spring and summer.

Ormonde Man by Ormonde Jayne is a Woody Spicy fragrance for men. Ormonde Man
was launched in 2004. The nose behind this fragrance is Geza Schoen.
Top notes are Cardamom, Pink Pepper, Bergamot, Juniper Berries and
Coriander; middle notes are Black hemlock or Tsuga and Agarwood (Oud);
base notes are Cedar, Sandalwood, Vetiver and Musk.

name: Ormonde Jayne Ormonde Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Ormonde Jayne Ormonde Man is a dark, green blend of black hemlock, oud and cardamom.
Geza Schoen created it in 2004. Black hemlock and oud meet juniper berry, bergamot, pink pepper, cardamom and coriander, with vetiver, cedar, sandalwood and musk for a deep, woody and aromatic scent.
Distinctive and versatile, it works year-round, day or night.

name: Ormonde Jayne Ormonde Woman Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Ormonde Jayne Ormonde Woman is a green, woody blend of black hemlock, violet and cardamom.
Geza Schoen created it in 2002. Grass, coriander and cardamom open green, black hemlock, violet and jasmine form a mysterious heart, and vetiver, cedar, sandalwood and amber give it a warm finish.
Elegant and unusual, it is a lovely daytime scent in spring and fall.

Ormonde Woman by Ormonde Jayne is a Chypre fragrance for women. Ormonde Woman
was launched in 2002. The nose behind this fragrance is Geza Schoen.
Top notes are Grass, Coriander and Cardamom; middle notes are Black
hemlock or Tsuga, Violet and Jasmine; base notes are Vetiver, Cedar,
Sandalwood and Amber.

name: Ormonde Jayne Osmanthus Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Ormonde Jayne Osmanthus is a fresh, fruity floral built around apricot-scented osmanthus.
Geza Schoen created it in 2006. Pomelo, artemisia and pimento open bright, osmanthus, water lily and jasmine sambac form a delicate heart, and vetiver, musk, cedar and labdanum give it a soft finish.
Light and elegant, it is made for spring and summer days.

Osmanthus by Ormonde Jayne is a Floral Fruity fragrance for women and men. Osmanthus
was launched in 2006. The nose behind this fragrance is Geza Schoen.
Top notes are Pomelo, Artemisia and Pimento; middle notes are Osmanthus,
Water Lily and Jasmine Sambac; base notes are Vetiver, Musk, Cedar and
French labdanum.

name: Ormonde Jayne Tolu Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Ormonde Jayne Tolu is a warm, balsamic blend of tolu, orchid and incense.
Geza Schoen created it in 2002. Orange blossom, juniper and clary sage open bright, orchid, rose and lily-of-the-valley form a soft heart, and tolu balsam, amber, tonka bean and olibanum give it a rich, sweet finish.
Cozy and elegant, it works day or night in fall and winter.

Tolu by Ormonde Jayne is a Amber Woody fragrance for women and men. Tolu was launched in 2002. The nose behind this fragrance is Geza Schoen. Top notes are Orange Blossom, Juniper and Clary Sage; middle notes are Orchid, Rose and Lily-of-the-Valley; base notes are Tolu Balsam, Amber, Tonka Bean and Olibanum.

name: Ormonde Jayne Tsarina Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Ormonde Jayne Tsarina is a soft, suede-like floral with cassis, iris and vanilla.
Geza Schoen created it in 2012. Bergamot, coriander, mandarin and cassis open bright, hedione, suede, iris, freesia and jasmine sambac form a smooth heart, and vanilla bean, labdanum, sandalwood, cedar and musk give it a warm finish.
Elegant and versatile, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

name: Orto Parisi Boccanera Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Orto Parisi Boccanera is a dark, spicy blend of chocolate, chili and sandalwood.
Alessandro Gualtieri created it in 2014. Dark chocolate, sandalwood, chili pepper, black pepper, ginger and musk come together in a warm, powdery and unexpectedly spicy scent.
Bold and unusual, it is a strong choice for evenings and cooler weather.

name: Orto Parisi Brutus Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Orto Parisi Brutus is an earthy, intense patchouli with bright citrus.
Alessandro Gualtieri created it in 2014. Dark patchouli meets bergamot and mandarin for a dense, warm and woody scent with a raw, earthy character.
Bold and uncompromising, it is a strong choice for cooler days and evenings.

name: Orto Parisi Cuoium Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Orto Parisi Cuoium is a dark, animalic leather with incense and smoke.
Alessandro Gualtieri created it in 2021. Leather, incense, cade oil, labdanum, ambergris, black pepper, patchouli, cedar, styrax, violet, mandarin and vanilla come together in a smoky, rich and untamed scent.
Intense and daring, it is best for cooler evenings.

name: Orto Parisi Megamare Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Orto Parisi Megamare is a powerful marine blend of citrus, seaweed and ambroxan.
Alessandro Gualtieri created it in 2019. Bergamot and lemon open bright, calone, hedione and seaweed form a salty, oceanic heart, and ambroxan, cedar and musk give it a radiant finish.
Bold and fresh, it works day or night.

name: Orto Parisi Risvelium Extrait de Perfume Unisex

notes.source_text:
Orto Parisi Risvelium is a fruity, musky blend of grapefruit, black currant and pineapple.
Alessandro Gualtieri created it in 2025. Grapefruit and bergamot open bright, black currant and pineapple form a juicy heart, and musk, ambroxan and amber give it a radiant finish.
Fresh and bold, it works day or night from spring through fall.

name: Orto Parisi Seminalis Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Seminalis by Orto Parisi is a fragrance for women and men. Seminalis was launched in 2016. The nose behind this fragrance is Alessandro Gualtieri.

name: Orto Parisi Stercus Extrait de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Orto Parisi Stercus is a dark, sweet blend of anise, leather and oud.
Alessandro Gualtieri created it in 2014. Anise, almond and aldehydes open sweet, rose forms the heart, and oud, leather, musk, vanilla, cedar and heliotrope give it a powdery, animalic finish.
Daring and unusual, it is a strong choice for evenings.

name: Orto Parisi Terroni Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Orto Parisi Terroni is a fresh, aromatic blend of orange, cardamom and juniper.
Alessandro Gualtieri created it in 2017. A mountain air accord, orange oil, cardamom, bergamot, juniper and clary sage come together in a bright yet earthy aromatic scent.
Distinctive and deep, it is made for fall and winter nights.

Terroni by Orto Parisi is a Amber Woody fragrance for women and men. Terroni was launched in 2017. The nose behind this fragrance is Alessandro Gualtieri.

name: Orto Parisi Viride Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Orto Parisi Viride is a green, woody blend of herbs and woods.
Alessandro Gualtieri created it in 2014. Herbal notes and woods come together in a raw, green and natural scent that feels like crushed leaves and wet bark.
Unusual and grounding, it is a great everyday scent for those who like green fragrances.

name: Paco Rabanne 1 Million Absolutely Gold Parfum for Men

top: vanilla combine with its bottom tone of fresh
key: vanilla combine with its bottom tone of fresh
notes.source_text:
Paco Rabanne 1 Million Absolutely Gold is a rich, smoky blend of mandarin, flowers and leather.
Christophe Raynaud, Michel Girard and Olivier Pescheux created it in 2012. Mandarin opens bright, a floral heart adds softness, and leather gives it a warm, animalic and smoky finish.
Bold and confident, it works for date nights, everyday wear and outings in fall and winter.

Perfect
for the sophisticated man, 1 Million Absolutely Gold by Paco Rabanne is
a fragrance that is sure to turn heads. Launched in 2012, this cologne
comes in a striking gold bottle that will stop you in your tracks. Its
top notes of mandarin and vanilla combine with its bottom tone of fresh
leather, creating a scent that defines masculinity and power. Suitable
for everyday wear, this long-lasting scent will leave you feeling both
strong and confident.
For men.
Design house: Paco Rabanne.
Year introduced: 2012.
Ingredients
Fragrance notes: Mandarin, Vanilla, And Fresh Leather.
Directions
Recommended use: Daytime.

name: Paco Rabanne 1 Million Black Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Paco Rabanne 1 Million Black is a sweet, tropical vanilla with a bright fruity opening.
Christophe Raynaud and Quentin Bisch created it in 2026. Pineapple, blood orange and cardamom open juicy and lively, a rich blend of vanillas with coconut and clary sage forms the heart, and tonka bean, ebony wood and patchouli give it a warm base.
1 Million Black is playful and inviting, with a sunny sweetness that feels made for good times. It works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

name: Paco Rabanne 1 Million Cologne Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
In 2008 Paco Rabanne presented masculine fragrance 1 Million
that soon became extremely popular. Flankers like 1 Million Absolutely
Gold in 2012 and 1 Million Intense in 2013, as well as limited edition
packaging 1 Million $, were made for the many fans of the fragrance.
All those who found the original to be too heavy might like the new
version 1 Million Cologne, coming out in summer 2015. The scent is
fresher and more energetic, seductive and charming. It supposes to be
fun. Opening with marine notes, citrus cocktail of mandarin and
cardamom, it mixes floral notes of rose with juniper berries in the
heart. The base consists of patchouli, tonka bean and leather.

name: Paco Rabanne 1 Million Elixir Eau de Parfum Intense for Men

notes.source_text:
Paco Rabanne 1 Million Elixir is a rich, fruity blend of apple, rose and vanilla.
Launched in 2022, it opens with apple and davana. Osmanthus, Damask rose and cedar form the heart, and vanilla absolute, tonka bean and patchouli give it a warm finish.
Made for fall and winter nights.

1 Million Elixir by Paco Rabanne is a fragrance for men. This is a new fragrance. 1 Million Elixir was launched in 2022. Top notes are Apple and Davana; middle notes are Osmanthus, Damask Rose and Cedar; base notes are Vanilla Absolute, Tonka Bean and Patchouli.

name: Paco Rabanne 1 Million Golden Oud Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Paco Rabanne 1 Million Golden Oud is a spicy, leathery oud with saffron and sandalwood.
Christophe Raynaud created it in 2023. Bergamot, saffron, nutmeg and black pepper open bright, labdanum, iris, gurjan balsam and cedarwood form the heart, and oud, sandalwood, leather and patchouli give it a rich finish.
Bold and versatile, it works year-round, day or night.

name: Paco Rabanne 1 Million Lucky Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
Paco Rabanne 1 Million Lucky is a sweet, nutty blend of hazelnut, honey and plum.
Nathalie Gracia-Cetto created it in 2018. Plum, grapefruit and bergamot open bright, hazelnut, honey, cedar and orange blossom form a sweet heart, and amberwood, patchouli, oakmoss and vetiver give it depth.
Versatile in spring, fall and winter, from the office to date night.

Fragrance Family:
Earthy & Woody
Scent Type:
Warm Woods
Key Notes:
Hazelnut, Green Plum, Cedar
About:
With unlimited potential and endless fun, life is a game. 1 Million
Lucky is a fragrance that stimulates the senses with grapefruit and
green plum. Warm hazelnut captivates and creates an instant addiction.
Intriguing cedarwood and patchouli exude lasting sensuality and
excitement.

name: Paco Rabanne 1 Million Night Elixir Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Paco Rabanne 1 Million Night Elixir is a sweet blend of citrus, cinnamon and maple.
Launched in 2026, it opens with bergamot, lemon and mandarin. Cinnamon and maple syrup form a warm heart, and labdanum, vanilla and benzoin give it a rich finish.
Made for nights in spring, fall and winter.

name: Paco Rabanne 1 Million Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Paco Rabanne 1 Million Parfum is a warm, salty and floral take on the 1 Million line.
Christophe Raynaud and Quentin Bisch created it in 2020. Tuberose, monoi oil, salt and solar notes meet ambergris, leather, cashmeran, pine and labdanum for a sunny, sensual and slightly animalic scent.
Bold and modern, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

Sun-drenched leather with salty effects. A
warm deliberate scent on the edge of the extreme. Salty pulse:
"tuberous salty" textured by amber woods. Leather opulence: accord
"solar leather" patinated with notes of resin and pine.
"The original idea of this one comes from an accident: back from
vacation I had two bottles broken in my leather bag... one was my
sunscreen and the other a sample of cistus. The smell was absolutely
divine! I captured it with one simple formula: a contrasted smell of
salty monoï-tuberose blended with resinous leather...
1 Million Parfum was launched in 2020. 1 Million Parfum was created by Quentin Bisch and Christophe Raynaud.

name: Paco Rabanne 1 Million Prive Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Paco Rabanne 1 Million Privé is a warm, spicy blend of cinnamon, tobacco and tonka.
Christophe Raynaud created it in 2016. Cinnamon and blood mandarin open bright, tobacco and myrrh form a rich heart, and tonka bean and patchouli give it a sweet, ambery finish.
Cozy and seductive, it is perfect for date nights and evenings in fall and winter.

1 Million Prive by Paco Rabanne Cologne. The legendary fashion house of
Paco Rabanne collaborated with the nose of Christophe Raynaud to create 1
Million Prive. Sophistication and depth of experience take the
forefront in a symphony between the endurance of patchouli and the
complicated freshness of high blood orange notes. Tonka bean and myrrh
evoke the tobacco and incense that comprise the core of this aroma. The
whole experience is set against spicy cinnamon elements. The ingredients
in the
mixture come back to life during moments of excitement or passion when
applied to pulse points. This allows a lasting and responsive night of
wear for anyone wishing to convey an air of intensity and opulence.
The
Rabanne family of scents is produced under the direction of Paco
himself, survivor of the prolonged Basque conflict in Spain and
associate of legends such as Givenchy and Cardin. The aromas often
complement the ideals of refinement treasured in the designer's clothing
and accessories.

name: Paco Rabanne 1 Million Royal Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Paco Rabanne 1 Million Royal is a warm, spicy and aromatic take on 1 Million.
Quentin Bisch and Christophe Raynaud created it in 2023. Cardamom, tangerine and bergamot open bright, lavender, sage and violet leaf form an aromatic heart, and benzoin, cedar and patchouli give it a rich, ambery finish.
Confident and smooth, it is a strong choice for evenings and cooler weather.

name: Paco Rabanne Black XS Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Paco Rabanne Black XS for Her is a fruity, spicy blend of cranberry, cacao and black violet.
Launched in 2018, it opens with tamarind, cranberry and pink pepper. Black violet, cacao and rose form a rich heart, and massoia wood, sandalwood and black vanilla husk give it a warm finish.
Playful and seductive, it works day or night in fall and winter.

name: Paco Rabanne Black XS Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
Paco Rabanne Black XS for Men is a sweet, spicy blend of praline, cinnamon and black amber.
Olivier Cresp and Rosendo Mateu created it in 2005. Lemon and sage open fresh, praline, cinnamon, tolu balsam and black cardamom form a sweet heart, and rosewood, patchouli and black amber give it a warm finish.
Seductive and bold, it is perfect for date nights in fall and winter.

Black Xs Cologne by Paco Rabanne, Black XS for men is a crisp and aromatic cologne launched in 2005 by Paco Rabanne . This sweet and spicy fragrance opens with citrusy lemon and sage. The heart contains warm notes of cinnamon, black cardamom, praline and tolu balsam. The scent closes with dark base notes of black amber, patchouli and Brazilian rosewood.

name: Paco Rabanne Dangerous Me Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Paco Rabanne Dangerous Me is a warm blend of ambergris, cedar and vanilla.
Marie Salamagne created it in 2019. Ambergris, cedar, vanilla and ginger come together in a smooth, powdery and slightly animalic woody scent.
Sensual and cozy, it works day or night in fall and winter.

name: Paco Rabanne Erotic Me Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Paco Rabanne Erotic Me is a sweet, milky blend of leather, osmanthus and fruit.
Quentin Bisch created it in 2019. Leather, florals, milk, osmanthus and fruits come together in a soft, fruity and creamy leather scent.
Sensual and playful, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

name: Paco Rabanne Fabulous Me Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Paco Rabanne Fabulous Me is an unusual blend of pumpkin, rhubarb and sandalwood.
Aliénor Massenet created it in 2019. Pumpkin opens sweet and earthy, rhubarb forms a tangy heart, and sandalwood gives it a smooth, woody finish.
Cozy and distinctive, it is a lovely daytime scent in fall.

name: Paco Rabanne Fame Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Paco Rabanne Fame is a fruity, sweet blend of mango, jasmine and olibanum.
Alberto Morillas, Fabrice Pellegrin, Marie Salamagne and Dora Baghriche created it in 2022. Bergamot and mango open juicy, olibanum and jasmine form a creamy, smoky heart, and vanilla and sandalwood give it a warm finish.
Modern and versatile, it works day or night from spring through fall.

name: Paco Rabanne Genius Me Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Paco Rabanne Genius Me is a fresh blend of orange peel, rosemary and moss.
Dominique Ropion created it in 2019. Orange peel opens bright, rosemary forms an aromatic heart, and metallic notes and moss give it a cool, woody finish.
Crisp and distinctive, it is made for spring and summer days.

name: Paco Rabanne Invictus Aqua (2018) Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
Paco Rabanne Invictus Aqua is a fresh, marine blend of grapefruit, sea notes and ambergris.
Juliette Karagueuzoglou and Nicolas Beaulieu created it in 2018. Grapefruit and violet leaf open crisp, sea notes, rosewood and violet form a cool heart, and amberwood and ambergris give it a warm finish.
Breezy and sporty, it is great for date nights and outings in spring and summer.

name: Paco Rabanne Invictus Aqua 2016 Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
Paco Rabanne Invictus Aqua (2016) is a fresh, marine blend of yuzu, sea water and ambergris.
Launched in 2016, it opens with yuzu, grapefruit and pink pepper. Sea water and violet leaf form a cool, aquatic heart, and ambergris, amberwood and guaiac wood give it a warm finish.
Breezy and sporty, it is made for spring and summer days.

Paco Rabanne brings back the trend of aquatic fragrances with
editions inspired by the athletic spirit, competition and victory,
Invictus from 2013 and Olympéa from 2015. The new releases Invictus
Aqua and Olympéa Aqua are out in early 2016, further emphasizing the
aquatic character of these compositions.
Top Notes:
Pink pepper, Yuzu, Grapefruit
Heart Notes:
Violet leaf, Marine accord
Base notes:
Ambergris, Amber wood, Guaiac wood

name: Paco Rabanne Invictus Aqua Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
Invictus Aqua, a dive into the abyss. Deep, intense and swept-up
sensuality. An overdose of powerful woods, an iodized crashing wave and a
surge of vibrant amber wood.
Top: Frozen Grapefruit, Marine Accord
Heart: Ambergris
Base: Ambery Woods

name: Paco Rabanne Invictus Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
Paco Rabanne Invictus is a fresh, marine blend of grapefruit, bay leaf and ambergris.
Véronique Nyberg, Anne Flipo, Olivier Polge and Dominique Ropion created it in 2013. Sea notes, grapefruit and mandarin open bright, bay leaf and jasmine form an aromatic heart, and ambergris, guaiac wood, oakmoss and patchouli give it a woody finish.
Sporty and confident, it is a great everyday scent.

name: Paco Rabanne Invictus Elixir Parfum Elixir for Men

notes.source_text:
Paco Rabanne Invictus Elixir is a mineral, woody blend of cypress and vanilla.
Launched in 2026, it opens with mineral notes. Cypress forms an aromatic heart, and vanilla caviar gives it a sweet, smooth finish.
Versatile in spring, fall and winter, day or night.

name: Paco Rabanne Invictus Intense Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
Paco Rabanne Invictus Intense is a warm blend of orange blossom, whiskey and amber.
Juliette Karagueuzoglou and Nicolas Beaulieu created it in 2016. Orange blossom and black pepper open bright, whiskey and laurel form a boozy heart, and amber, ambergris and salt give it a warm finish.
Bold and confident, it is great for date nights and outings in spring, fall and winter.

Fragrance Family:
Warm & Spicy
Scent Type:
Cool Spices
Key Notes:
Orange Flower, Whiskey Cream, Salty Black Amber
About:
Intensity takes over in this powerful smash-up of spicy sophistication.
Neroli oil blends with stimulating pepper and is heated through with a
malt salty-amber accord, and dynamic wood notes. Salt, the hallmark of
Invictus, and amber are added for an intensified, sensual effect and to
create balance. Once again, two forces come face to face and then merge
in a magnetic duel.

name: Paco Rabanne Invictus Legend Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Paco Rabanne Invictus Legend is a salty, marine take on Invictus with a warm amber base.
Domitille Michalon Bertier and Nicolas Beaulieu created it in 2019. Sea notes, sea salt and grapefruit open fresh, spices, geranium and bay leaf form an aromatic heart, and red amber and guaiac wood give it a warm finish.
Versatile and easy, it is great for everyday wear from spring through fall.

The ultimate hero. Made for glory
Burning like desert heat, Invictus triumphs effortlessly and speeds
towards glory. INVICTUS LEGEND. A blazing duel. Two forces clash. Fresh
adrenaline rides a whirlwind of hot woods A fragrance with power.
Thrilling like victory. A trophy for winners.Lacquered glass, dark like
the night, capped in chrome. Bold like victory. Made for legends.

name: Paco Rabanne Invictus Onyx Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
Paco Rabanne Invictus Onyx is a fresh, woody take on Invictus with jasmine and patchouli.
Anne Flipo, Dominique Ropion, Olivier Polge and Véronique Nyberg created it in 2020. Sea notes, grapefruit and mandarin open bright, jasmine and laurel form an aromatic heart, and patchouli, ambergris, moss and guaiac wood give it a woody finish.
Fresh and versatile, it works day or night in spring and summer.

Invictus Onyx Collector Edition by Paco Rabanne is a fragrance for men. This is a new fragrance. Invictus Onyx Collector Edition was launched in 2020. Invictus Onyx Collector Edition was created by Veronique Nyberg, Anne Flipo, Dominique Ropion and Olivier Polge. Top notes are grapefruit, sea notes and mandarin orange; middle notes are laurels and jasmine; base notes are guaiac wood, moss, patchouli and ambergris.

name: Paco Rabanne Invictus Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Paco Rabanne Invictus Parfum is a clean, musky blend of lavender, marine notes and woods.
Anne Flipo and Caroline Dumur created it in 2024. Lavender, pink pepper and marine notes open fresh, soap, violet leaf and myrtle form a clean heart, and cashmeran, musk and sandalwood give it a smooth finish.
Fresh and easy, it works year-round, day or night.

name: Paco Rabanne Invictus Platinum Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Paco Rabanne Invictus Platinum is a cool, green blend of absinthe, mint and lavender.
Launched in 2022, it opens with absinthe and grapefruit. Mint and lavender form a fresh, aromatic heart, and cypress and patchouli give it a clean, woody finish.
Crisp and energetic, it is great for spring and summer, day or night.

Invictus Platinum by Paco Rabanne is a Woody Aromatic fragrance for men. This is a new fragrance. Invictus Platinum
was launched in 2022. Top notes are Absinthe and Grapefruit; middle
notes are Mint and Lavender; base notes are Cypress and Patchouli.

name: Paco Rabanne Invictus Victory Absolu Parfum Intense For Men

notes.source_text:
Paco Rabanne Invictus Victory Absolu is a warm, woody blend of black pepper, amber and frankincense.
Anne Flipo and Caroline Dumur created it in 2025. Black pepper opens spicy, amber, ambergris and woods form a warm heart, and sandalwood, frankincense and patchouli give it a smooth, powdery finish.
Powerful and seductive, it is made for fall and winter nights.

name: Paco Rabanne Invictus Victory Eau de Parfum Extreme for Men

notes.source_text:
Paco Rabanne Invictus Victory is a sweet, ambery lavender with vanilla and incense.
Launched in 2021, it opens with lemon and pink pepper. Lavender and olibanum form an aromatic, smoky heart, and vanilla, tonka bean and amber give it a rich, sweet finish.
Warm and powerful, it is made for evenings in spring, fall and winter.

Invictus Victory by Paco Rabanne is a Amber fragrance for men. This is a new fragrance. Invictus Victory
was launched in 2021. Top notes are Lemon and Pink Pepper; middle notes
are Lavender and Olibanum; base notes are Vanilla, Tonka Bean and
Amber.

name: Paco Rabanne Invictus Victory Elixir Parfum Intense for Men

notes.source_text:
Paco Rabanne Invictus Victory Elixir is a rich, warm blend of olibanum, vanilla and amber.
Launched in 2023, it wraps olibanum, vanilla, amber and tonka bean into a dense, sweet and resinous scent with real presence.
A bold choice for cooler days and nights out.

name: Paco Rabanne Lady Million Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Paco Rabanne Lady Million is a sweet, fruity floral with raspberry, gardenia and honey.
Béatrice Piquet, Anne Flipo, Bruno Jovanovic and Dominique Ropion created it in 2010. Neroli, Amalfi lemon and raspberry open juicy, gardenia, orange flower and jasmine form a white floral heart, and white honey, amber and patchouli give it a warm finish.
Glamorous and bold, it works day or night in fall and winter.

name: Paco Rabanne Lady Million Fabulous Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Paco Rabanne Lady Million Fabulous is a warm floral with tuberose, ylang-ylang and vanilla.
Anne Flipo created it in 2021. Pink pepper and mandarin open bright, ylang-ylang, tuberose, solar notes and jasmine form a sunny heart, and tonka bean, vanilla and moss give it a warm finish.
Glamorous and cozy, it works day or night in fall and winter.

name: Paco Rabanne Million Gold Eau de Parfum Intense for Men

notes.source_text:
Paco Rabanne Million Gold Intense is a warm, woody blend of mandarin, spice and sandalwood.
Launched in 2024, it pairs bright mandarin with warm spices, creamy sandalwood and cedarwood for a smooth, glowing scent.
Rich and polished, it is made for fall and winter, day or night.

name: Paco Rabanne Million Gold Elixir Parfum Intense for Men

notes.source_text:
Paco Rabanne Million Gold Elixir is a sweet blend of yellow mandarin, sandalwood and vanilla.
Launched in 2025, it opens with yellow mandarin. Sandalwood forms a creamy heart, and vanilla gives it a warm, sweet finish.
Smooth and confident, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

name: Paco Rabanne Million Gold For Her Feminine

notes.source_text:
Paco Rabanne Million Gold for Her is a fruity floral with pear, rose and vanilla.
Aliénor Massenet, Loc Dong, Suzy Le Helley and Nathalie Benareau created it in 2024. Rose, lavender and pear open bright, jasmine and ylang-ylang form a floral heart, and moss, vanilla and musk give it a soft finish.
Elegant and sweet, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

name: Paco Rabanne Million Red Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Paco Rabanne Million Red is a sweet blend of coconut, lavender and vanilla.
Aliénor Massenet, Loc Dong, Suzy Le Helley and Nathalie Benareau created it in 2026. Bergamot and coconut open creamy, lavender, ylang-ylang and white flowers form a floral heart, and coumarin and vanilla give it a warm finish.
Cozy and bold, it is a great everyday and evening scent.

name: Paco Rabanne Phantom Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
Paco Rabanne Phantom is a fresh, smooth blend of lavender, lemon and vanilla.
Anne Flipo, Dominique Ropion, Loc Dong and Juliette Karagueuzoglou created it in 2021. Lavender, lemon zest and Amalfi lemon open bright, lavender, apple, patchouli and smoky, earthy notes form the heart, and vanilla, lavender and vetiver give it a creamy finish.
Modern and versatile, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

Phantom by Paco Rabanne is a Woody Aromatic fragrance for men. This is a new fragrance. Phantom was launched in 2021. Phantom was created by Anne Flipo, Dominique Ropion, Loc Dong and Juliette Karagueuzoglou. Top notes are Lavender, Lemon Zest and Amalfi Lemon; middle notes are Lavender, Apple, Patchouli, Smoke and Earthy Notes; base notes are Vanilla, Lavender and Vetiver.

name: Paco Rabanne Phantom Elixir Men Parfum Intense

notes.source_text:
Paco Rabanne Phantom Elixir is a marine, powdery blend of sea notes, oud and vanilla.
Launched in 2025, it opens with sea notes. Mineral notes and oud form a cool, woody heart, and vanilla bean gives it a soft, powdery finish.
Modern and smooth, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

name: Paco Rabanne Phantom in Red Elixir For Men

notes.source_text:
Paco Rabanne Phantom in Red Elixir is a fruity blend of saffron, plum liqueur and tobacco.
Anne Flipo, Juliette Karagueuzoglou and Nicolas Beaulieu created it in 2025. Bergamot, saffron and plum liqueur open rich, lavender, orange blossom and sage form an aromatic heart, and oud, amberwood, tobacco and benzoin give it a warm finish.
Bold and versatile, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

name: Paco Rabanne Phantom Intense Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Paco Rabanne Phantom Intense is a warm blend of orange blossom, lavender and vanilla.
Anne Flipo, Dominique Ropion, Juliette Karagueuzoglou and Paul Guerlain created it in 2024. Frosted orange blossom opens bright, lavender oil forms an aromatic heart, and vanilla bean gives it a creamy finish.
Modern and smooth, it works year-round, day or night.

name: Paco Rabanne Phantom Legion Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
Paco Rabanne Phantom Legion is a fresh, earthy blend of lemon, lavender and smoke.
Anne Flipo, Dominique Ropion, Juliette Karagueuzoglou and Loc Dong created it in 2022. Lemon zest and lavender open bright, smoke, patchouli, apple and earthy notes form the heart, and vetiver and vanilla give it a warm finish.
Modern and versatile, it is a great everyday scent.

name: Paco Rabanne Phantom Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Paco Rabanne Phantom Parfum is an aromatic blend of cardamom, lavender and vanilla.
Juliette Karagueuzoglou, Dominique Ropion and Anne Flipo created it in 2023. Cardamom, rhubarb, bergamot and lemon open bright, lavender, patchouli, geranium and cedarwood form an aromatic heart, and vanilla, Haitian vetiver and tolu balsam give it a warm finish.
Smooth and modern, it is a great everyday scent.

name: Paco Rabanne Pure XS Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
Paco Rabanne Pure XS is a warm, sweet blend of vanilla, cinnamon and myrrh.
Anne Flipo, Bruno Jovanovic and Caroline Dumur created it in 2017. Ginger, thyme, grapefruit and bergamot open fresh, vanilla, liquor, cinnamon, leather and apple form a rich heart, and myrrh, sugar, cedar and patchouli give it a sensual finish.
Seductive and cozy, it is great for date nights and evenings in fall and winter.

Pure XS is a vibrant, magnetic and fresh oriental with a permanent in-and-out between cold and hot, gentle and intense. Two sensations on edge, brushing against, attracting and echoing each other. The first excess: explosive freshness. During this foreplay, the senses go wild and the palate tingles with an overdose of almost icy ginger. A juicy, delicious, bite inducing,aphrodisiac. A carnal second wind: the green creaminess of vegetal sap and ultra-masculine thyme. The second excess and double indecency: smouldering sensuality. Cinnamon adds a piquant touch and makes mouths water. A spicy sin!Followed by a surge of power with deep, noble vanilla infused with leather-liquor-musk inflections. Sweet animality. Finally, it’s time to let go and sink into the pulsing warmth of myrrh dusted with sugar. A sensation of overheated skin to enter an altered state. And, quickly, a pure longing to indulge once again.

name: Paco Rabanne Pure XS Night Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Paco Rabanne Pure XS Night is a sweet, spicy blend of ginger, cacao and caramel.
Anne Flipo, Bruno Jovanovic and Caroline Dumur created it in 2019. Ginseng and ginger open spicy, cacao, vanilla and cinnamon form a rich heart, and myrrh and caramel give it a warm, gourmand finish.
Seductive and indulgent, it is perfect for date nights in fall and winter.

Pure XS Night. continues the story of a seductive young man,
and the action takes place at night: Be warned! At night our instincts
are awakened. And our thoughts catch fire. A look at the object of our
desire awakens a forbidden feeling in us, tempting and dangerous.
Confusing. Arousing. The scent of danger. The desire to play with the
fire gets out of control...Dive into the unknown. Yes to excess.
"With Pure XS, the return of sex, or rather eroticism, strikes again. And once more, Paco Rabanne plays and provokes."
The composition, created by perfumers Caroline Dumur , with the support of Anne Flipo
and Bruno Jovanic, has been announced as a fiery exotic. The duality of
hot and cool notes of originals is even more profound. The fragrance
contains an overdose of ginger, vanilla, and myrrh resin.

name: Paco Rabanne XS (2018) Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
Paco Rabanne XS (2018) is a fresh, aromatic blend of citrus, mint and juniper.
Rosendo Mateu and Gérard Anthony created it in 2018. Bergamot, lemon and mint open crisp, geranium, coriander and juniper berries form an herbal heart, and sandalwood, rosemary and oakmoss give it a woody finish.
Clean and easy, it is a great daytime scent from spring through fall.

name: Parfums de Marly Akaster Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Parfums de Marly Akaster is an aromatic blend of cypress, rose and oud.
Launched in 2015, it opens with cypress and lemon. Bulgarian rose and African geranium form a floral heart, and oud, musk and cardamom give it a spicy, woody finish.
Refined and distinctive, it works day or night in fall and winter.

Akaster by Parfums de Marly is a Oriental fragrance for women and men. Akaster
was launched in 2015. Top notes are Cypress and Lemon; middle notes are
Bulgarian Rose and African Geranium; base notes are Agarwood (Oud),
Musk and Cardamom.

name: Parfums de Marly Althair Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Parfums de Marly Althaïr is a creamy vanilla-praline gourmand lifted by orange blossom and spice.
Created in 2023 by Hamid Merati-Kashani and Ilias Ermenidis, it opens with orange blossom, bergamot, cinnamon and cardamom. Bourbon vanilla and elemi make a smooth heart, and praline, ambroxan, musk and guaiac wood give it a sweet, airy finish.
Althaïr wraps you in something soft, sweet and inviting rather than heavy. It is a cozy pick for spring, fall and winter, equally at home in the daytime or on a relaxed evening out.

name: Parfums de Marly Althair Exclusif Parfum For Men

notes.source_text:
Parfums de Marly Althaïr Exclusif is a richer, more indulgent take on Althaïr.
Hamid Merati-Kashani created it in 2026. Bergamot, saffron and amaretto open warm, cardamom, cinnamon, orange blossom and praline form a sweet heart, and guaiac wood, Bourbon vanilla and Ambrox Super give it a smooth finish.
Made for fall and winter, day or night.

name: Parfums de Marly Athalia Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Parfums de Marly Athalia is a soft, powdery blend of orange blossom and iris.
Launched in 2016, it opens with orange blossom, moves into a powdery iris heart and settles into white musk and amber.
Elegant in spring, fall and winter, day or night.

Athalia by Parfums de Marly is a Floral Woody Musk fragrance for women. Athalia was launched in 2016. Top note is orange blossom; middle note is iris; base notes are amber and white musk.
Enchanting Athalia opens with a
mysterious swirl of smoky incense blended with the softness of rose and
the sting of bitter orange. Femininity and sophistication abound in the
heart of the fragrance through its signature iris accord accented by
juicy orange blossom adding a beautiful contrast. Warm amber tones and
creamy vanilla bring an inviting richness to the base of the fragrance,
exuding potent beauty but with a hint of rebellion.Style: Velvety, white floral.
Notes:
- Top: incense, rose, bitter orange.
- Middle: iris, suede, orange blossom, cashmeran.
- Base: amber, vanilla, vetiver.

name: Parfums de Marly Athénaïs Feminine

notes.source_text:
Parfums de Marly Athénaïs is a bright, luminous floral with neroli, yuzu and orange blossom.
Launched in 2026, it opens with neroli, bergamot and yuzu. Mahonial, orange blossom and jasmine sambac form a radiant heart, and tonka bean, vanilla and amber give it a soft, warm finish.
Elegant and uplifting, it is a lovely everyday scent.

name: Parfums de Marly Byerley Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Parfums de Marly Byerley is a smooth, woody blend of cardamom, guaiac wood and vetiver.
Launched in 2014, it opens with cardamom and bergamot. Guaiac wood and cedar form a warm, smoky heart, and vetiver and resins give it an earthy finish.
Refined and easy, it is a great everyday scent in spring, fall and winter.

Sensual and spicy with a touch of smoke, Byerley opens with a fresh
introduction of juicy bergamot and a wonderfully spiced cardamom.The
heart of the fragrance beats a steady and strong combination of fresh
cedar and lightly smoky, nuanced gaiac wood. This rich and elegant
fragrance finishes with earthy vetiver and rich balsams bringing
substance and character while still maintaining a fresh brightness. A
