refined and distinguished fragrance, just like the wearer.
Style: Fresh, wood.
Notes:
- Top: bergamot, cardamom.
- Middle: cedarwood, guaiac wood.
- Base: vetiver, balsams.
Mood: Rich, refined, woody, distinguished.

name: Parfums de Marly Carios Extrait de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Parfums de Marly Carios is a spicy, woody blend of saffron, black pepper and ambroxan.
Launched in 2025, it opens with saffron, mandarin, pink pepper and bergamot. Black pepper, geranium and red thyme form an aromatic heart, and ambroxan, tonka bean, cedarwood and vetiver give it a smooth finish.
Confident and versatile, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

name: Parfums de Marly Carlisle Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Parfums de Marly Carlisle is a rich, warm blend of green apple, spice and vanilla.
Launched in 2015, it opens with green apple and nutmeg. Tonka bean and rose form a smooth, sweet heart, and patchouli and vanilla give it a deep, lasting finish.
Made for fall and winter, perfect for date nights and evenings out.

Christened from a majestic
17th-century English steed, Carlisle is a warmly spiced,
gourmand-inflected oriental reserved only for the bold. Opening with a
colorful burst of juicy, tart green apple spiked with fiery saffron and
earthy nutmeg, Carlisle immediately sets itself apart from even Marly's
other wondrous gourmands with a grounded, sophisticated earthiness
evident from the very first sniff- this is less indulgent dessert
pudding and more the aromas of a grand ballroom soiree in full swing,
mouthwatering treats mingled with well-groomed aristocracy, elaborate
decor and the general spirit of revelry. A richer-yet heart reveals
warm, smooth tonka bean and creamy osmanthus- but also gently bitter
davana and luscious rose, leading into a true patchouli note that
doesn't hold back on the earthiness. However, lovers of Herod and Oajan
need not worry, either- alongside that earthy patchouli, a warmly
emergent vein of creamy vanilla and sweet opoponax resinoid are every
bit as enchantingly seductive as they are in Marly's other masterpieces.
As they all reach an enduring harmony in Carlisle's final stages, the
glow is enough to make you feel like you, yourself are descended from
royalty.
Carlisle  Notes
Green apple, saffron, nutmeg, tonka bean, osmanthus, davana, rose, patchouli, vanilla, opoponax

name: Parfums de Marly Cassili Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Parfums de Marly Cassili is a sweet, fruity floral with plum and vanilla.
Launched in 2019, it opens with red currant, floral notes and Bulgarian rose. Plum, frangipani, petalia and mimosa form the heart, and tonka bean, vanilla and sandalwood give it a warm finish.
A daytime favorite for spring and summer.

At the intersection of desire and
delicacy, Cassili is a fruity-floral beauty that reminds us that Parfums
de Marly does feminine scents with every bit as much
modern-meets-classic complexity as their much-heralded masculines.
Exploding with triumphant fruitiness, yet anchored by a sophisticated
woodsy gourmand base, Cassili is both fashion-forward and refined, with a
true Parfums de Marly signature.
From the first spray, Cassili leaps off the skin with joyful
abandon, featuring mouthwatering notes of plum and redcurrant set
against lushly textured florals- romantic rose, fresh mimosa and peachy
plumeria, a delightful bouquet with enough sweetness to swoon over, but
also enough floral firepower to seduce. As the complexly gourmand
drydown- a creamy blend of vanilla and sandalwood- develops, we find
ourselves completely under its spell. Fresh and sweet, classic and
modern, fun and sexy- Cassili is a scent for women who don't need to
compromise.
Cassili  Notes
Red currant, rose, white flowers, plum, mimosa, plumeria, petalia, sandalwood, tonka, vanilla

name: Parfums de Marly Castley Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Parfums de Marly Castley is a bright, peppery citrus fragrance with warm woods.
Launched in 2025, it opens with bergamot, black pepper and ginger. Neroli, pepper, timur and petitgrain form a fresh, spicy heart, and akigalawood, benzoin and labdanum give it a warm finish.
A daytime favorite from spring through fall.

name: Parfums de Marly Crecy Extrait de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Parfums de Marly Crécy is a fruity, musky blend of lavender, black currant and iris.
Launched in 2026, it opens with lavender and black currant. Iris and rose form a powdery heart, and ambroxan, woods and benzoin give it a warm finish.
Refined and modern, it is a great everyday scent.

name: Parfums de Marly Darcy Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Parfums de Marly Darcy is a bright, sweet blend of citrus, rose and patchouli.
Hamid Merati-Kashani created it in 2014. Citrus, orange and lemon open fresh, rose and jasmine form a floral heart, and patchouli, sweet notes, white musk and woods give it a warm finish.
Elegant and easy, it works for date nights and outings in spring, fall and winter.

Named for the Royal Mare, one of the
earliest and most renowned thoroughbred horses of the British monarchy,
Darcy is, appropriately, a fragrance of great refinement and powerful
simplicity. Based around a gorgeous combination of rich patchouli and
full-bodied florals, Darcy stands out in the category with its subtlety,
expert blending, and deep, intoxicating praline drydown. Opening crisp
and fresh with a juicy citrus blend, Darcy's deeply floral heart- rose
flanked with jasmine- feels at once hypnotically lush and also lightly
green and naturalistic. As the patchouli blends in- soft, sweet and
smooth- the effect is swooningly elegant. A lightly gourmand drydown of
sweet praline and sexy white musk only completes the portrait of a lady
of rarefied taste and royal bearing. For any lady who prefers to let her
fragrance complete her outfit, rather than shout over it, Darcy is a
royal treasure.
Darcy  Notes
Citrus, bergamot, orange, rose, jasmine, woods, patchouli, praline, white musk

name: Parfums de Marly Darley Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Parfums de Marly Darley is a fresh, minty lavender with a warm, woody base.
Francis Deleamont created it in 2009. Mint, bergamot and Amalfi lemon open crisp, lavender, cinnamon, orange flower, rose and rosemary form an aromatic heart, and tonka bean, sandalwood, guaiac wood, amber and patchouli give it a smooth finish.
Polished and versatile, it works day or night from spring through fall.

What it is: Pretty, pink and purely feminine, Delina Eau de Parfum will warm your heart and make you feel like royalty.
Fragrance story: A floral explosion of Turkish rose, lily of the valley and peony creates a girlish, feminine fragrance accented with bright and tangy notes of lychee, rhubarb and bergamot. Vanilla, musk and cashmeran will wrap you in a feeling of warmth and sensuality.
Style: Floral.
Notes:
- Top: bergamot, nutmeg, rhubarb, lychee.
- Middle: Turkish rose, vetiver, incense, cedarwood.
- Base: vanilla, cashmeran, musk.
Mood: Feminine, delicate, sensual.

name: Parfums de Marly Delina Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Parfums de Marly Delina is a radiant rose with a sparkling, fruity twist.
Quentin Bisch created it in 2017. Lychee, rhubarb, bergamot and nutmeg open fresh and juicy, Turkish rose and peony bloom at the heart with musk and vanilla, and cashmeran, cedar, vetiver and incense give it a soft, elegant base.
Delina is pretty, modern and feminine without feeling sugary. It is a daytime favorite for spring and summer and a lovely pick for date nights.

Details & Care
What it is: Pretty, pink and purely feminine, Delina Eau de Parfum will warm your heart and make you feel like royalty.
Fragrance story:
A floral explosion of Turkish rose, lily of the valley and peony
creates a girlish, feminine fragrance accented with bright and tangy
notes of lychee, rhubarb and bergamot. Vanilla, musk and cashmeran will
wrap you in a feeling of warmth and sensuality.
Style: Floral.
Notes:
- Top: bergamot, nutmeg, rhubarb, lychee.
- Middle: Turkish rose, vetiver, incense, cedarwood.
- Base: vanilla, cashmeran, musk.
Mood: Feminine, delicate, sensual.

name: Parfums de Marly Delina Exclusif Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Parfums de Marly Delina Exclusif is a deeper, more intense rose with lychee and oud.
Quentin Bisch created it in 2018. Lychee, pear and bergamot open juicy, Turkish rose, oud and incense form a rich heart, and vanilla, amber and woods give it a lasting finish.
Elegant and bold, it is beautiful for date nights in spring, fall and winter.

Parfums de Marly Delina Exclusif is a Feminine fragrance, The fragrance launched in 2018, The nose behind this fragrance is Quentin Bisch,
Top Note: Litchi, Pear, Bergamot
Heart Note: Turkish Rose, Agarwood (Oud), Incense
Base Note: Vanilla, Amber, Woody Notes

name: Parfums de Marly Delina La Rosee Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Parfums de Marly Delina La Rosée is a fresh, dewy version of the famous Delina rose.
Quentin Bisch created it in 2021. Pear, lychee and bergamot open juicy, Turkish rose, peony and watery notes form a fresh floral heart, and white musk, vetiver and woods give it a clean finish.
Light and pretty for spring and summer days, and lovely for date nights.

Delina La Rosée by Parfums de Marly is a Floral Fruity fragrance for women. This is a new fragrance. Delina La Rosée
was launched in 2021. The nose behind this fragrance is Quentin Bisch.
Top notes are Pear, Litchi and Bergamot; middle notes are Peony, Turkish
Rose, Watery Notes and Floral Notes; base notes are White Musk, Haitian
Vetiver and Woody Notes.

name: Parfums de Marly Dorval Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Parfums de Marly Dorval is a warm, spiced amber-woody fragrance for evenings.
Olivier Cresp created it in 2026. Bergamot, cardamom and pink peppercorn open bright, cinnamon, copaiba balsam and clary sage form a warm heart, and guaiac wood, ambroxan, tonka bean, vanilla and praline give it a smooth, sweet finish.
Dorval is smooth and sweet with a polished, grown-up warmth. It is made for fall and winter nights, formal evenings and nights out.

name: Parfums de Marly Eragon Extrait de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Parfums de Marly Eragon is a warm, sweet blend of cardamom, cinnamon and leather.
Launched in 2025, it opens with cardamom, mandarin and bergamot. Cinnamon, cypriol and davana form a spicy heart, and leather, tonka bean, vanilla bean and patchouli give it a rich finish.
Bold and sensual, it is made for fall and winter nights.

name: Parfums de Marly Galloway Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Parfums de Marly Galloway is a fresh, clean blend of citrus, orange blossom and iris.
Launched in 2014, it opens with pepper and citrus. Orange blossom and iris form a soft heart, and musk and amber give it a clean finish.
Easy to wear for spring and summer days, from everyday to date nights.

Galloway Eau de Parfum, a spicy, fresh fragrance for a wearer who favors
classic and enduring style. A unique take on a traditionally structured
fragrance structure, Galloway's spicy-fresh blend of juicy citrus
fruits, pepper, florals and musk, is equally as invigorating as it is
powerful. An earthy iris heart keeps us grounded in the rolling hills of
Scotland, while the dry down of sexy musk and amber creates a long
lasting, powerful yet easygoing statement.
- Top notes: hesperides, pepper
- Middle notes: iris, orange blossom
- Base notes: amber, musk

name: Parfums de Marly Godolphin Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Parfums de Marly Godolphin is a smooth, leathery blend of saffron, iris and woods.
Michele Saramito created it in 2010. Saffron, fruity notes, maté, thyme, green notes and cypress open aromatic, orris, rose and jasmine form an elegant heart, and vetiver, leather, musk, amber, Virginia cedar and vanilla give it a rich finish.
Refined and versatile, it suits date nights, everyday wear and evenings out in spring, fall and winter.

The Godolphin Arabian, as the
progenitor of the modern thoroughbred- it's estimated that at least a
third of modern racehorses descend from his line- would have to be
considered one of the most singularly influential horses in world
history. To honor this incredible stallion, Parfums de Marly has created
a fragrance every bit as regal, dignified and sophisticated as the
Godolphin himself, an elegant leather scent of undeniable power.
Godolphin is based around a sumptuous leather accord, equal
parts rich, sweet, powdery, spicy and distinct. The opening is fresh,
with thyme, saffron and cypress, while a rich, jammy rose combines with
jasmine and buttery orris to anchor a smooth, sensual heart. You don't
have to own prizewinning thoroughbreds to wear Godolphin- but you'll be
smelling so powerful, you'll feel like you do anyway.
Godolphin  Notes
Aromatic notes,
thyme, spices, saffron, green notes, cypress, mate, fruit notes, rose,
orris, jasmine, white cedar, vetiver, amber

name: Parfums de Marly Greenley Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Parfums de Marly Greenley is a fresh green apple and citrus scent with a mossy, woody base.
Launched in 2020, it opens with green apple, Calabrian bergamot and mandarin. Cashmeran, petitgrain, pomarose, violet and cedar form a soft, woody heart, and oakmoss, musk and amberwood give it a clean, earthy finish.
Greenley is fresh, green and easygoing, like a crisp walk through an orchard. It is a daytime favorite from spring through fall.

Greenley by Parfums de Marly is a Citrus Aromatic fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Greenley
was launched in 2020. Top notes are Green Apple, Calabrian bergamot and
Mandarin Orange; middle notes are Cashmeran, Petitgrain, Pomarose,
Violet and Cedar; base notes are Oakmoss, Musk and Amberwood.

name: Parfums de Marly Habdan Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Parfums de Marly Habdan is a warm, spicy blend of saffron, incense and caramel.
Guillaume Flavigny created it in 2013. Saffron and olibanum open rich and resinous, apple, rose and woods form a smooth heart, and myrrh, caramel and ambergris give it a sweet, ambery finish.
A refined choice for date nights and evenings out in spring, fall and winter.

"An Arabian will take care of its
owner as no other horse will, for it has not only been raised to
physical perfection, but has been instilled with a spirit of loyalty
unparalleled by that of any other breed."
As one of the five primary purebred Arabian strains, the Habdan
is a symbol of grace and power, a horse that has distinguished itself
many times over on both the battlefield and the race track. Habdan the
fragrance is similarly versatile, a wondrous swirl of thick, balsamic
notes and warm spices, sweet caramel and crisp fruit, all combining to
create a rich unisex scent as indulgent as a gourmand but as sexy as an
oriental. Opening with a gorgeous, complex saffron stretched across
regal frankincense, Habdan then moves into a heart of smoky agarwood
buoyed by fragrant rose and crisp, juicy apple, leading into an extended
drydown of warm amber and opoponax. Noble, elegant and majestic, Habdan
is an exotic delight.
Habdan  Notes
Frankincense, saffron, apple, agarwood, rose, amber, maltol, opoponax

name: Parfums de Marly Haltane Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Parfums de Marly Haltane is a sweet, smoky oud with lavender and praline.
Launched in 2021, it opens with lavender, bergamot and clary sage. Praline and saffron form a warm, gourmand heart, and oud and cedar give it a rich, woody depth.
A luxurious night scent for spring, fall and winter.

Haltane by Parfums de Marly is a Woody Aromatic fragrance for men. This is a new fragrance. Haltane was launched in 2021. Top notes are Lavender, Bergamot and Clary Sage; middle notes are Praline and Saffron; base notes are Agarwood (Oud) and Cedar.

name: Parfums de Marly Hamdani Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Parfums de Marly Hamdani is a warm, resinous blend of incense, honey and leather.
Fabrice Pellegrin created it in 2013. Olibanum and myrrh open rich and smoky, guaiac wood, clove and honey form a sweet heart, and styrax, leather, papyrus, tobacco, benzoin and sandalwood give it a deep finish.
Opulent and warm, it is perfect for date nights in fall and winter.

The Hamdani was often considered as the symbol of power and beauty and was thought to be a pure and athletic horse. The
fragrance divulges an elegant masculinity as the firmness of the
Leather and Tobacco notes are mergd with Honey and Cloves delivering an
authentic scent.
Hamdani is a masculine fragrance by Parfums
de Marly. The scent was launched in 2013 and the fragrance was created
by perfumer Fabrice Pellegrin
Top Notes
Myrrh, Frankincense
Heart Notes
Lignum vitae, Honey, Clove
Base notes
Benzoin, Leather, Papyrus, Sandalwood, Smoke, Styrax

name: Parfums de Marly Herod Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Parfums de Marly Herod is a rich blend of cinnamon, tobacco and vanilla.
Olivier Pescheux created it in 2012. Cinnamon and pepper open warm and spicy, tobacco leaf, incense, osmanthus and labdanum form a smoky-sweet heart, and vanilla, cedar, vetiver and musk give it a smooth, lasting base.
Herod is warm, smoky and sweet, with real presence on the skin. It is made for fall and winter nights and date nights, and it suits anyone who loves tobacco and vanilla scents.

The Scoop
One of the most accomplished
racehorses (and prolific studs) of 18th century Europe, Herod was a
horse of uncommon achievement descended from a famous line of Turkish
warhorses. To honor him, Parfums de Marly has created a truly
spectacular fragrance, one that combines robustly masculine tobacco,
wood and patchouli notes with an alluring spice blend and a sumptuous
vanilla.
Herod opens with an attention-grabbing spicy mix of cinnamon and
peppercorns, and quickly introduces a resinous, sultry heart of incense
and tobacco, combined with such smoky-sweet artistry that it makes our
mouths water and pulses race all at once. In the base, the woodsier and
earthier aspects are enhanced with rich patchouli and vetiver, while a
creamy, delectable vanilla keeps things from ever getting too dark or
deep. Rich enough to wear on a cold winter night but well-rounded enough
for year-round, Herod is a luxurious addition to any gentleman's
arsenal- and we think it would be drop-dead sexy on any lady who loves
tobacco scents as well.
Herod  Notes
Cinnamon, pepperwood, osmanthus, tobacco leaves, frankincense, cistus, vanilla, cedar, vetiver, patchouli, musk

name: Parfums de Marly Kalan Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Parfums de Marly Kalan is a spicy, citrusy lavender with a warm, woody base.
Launched in 2019, it opens with spices, blood orange and black pepper. Lavender and orange blossom form an aromatic heart, and woods, moss, tonka bean, white sandalwood and amber give it a smooth, warm finish.
Confident and easy to wear, it is great for date nights and evenings out in cooler weather.

Parfums de Marly Kalan
eau de parfum is a truly captivating composition.  An extremely fresh
start of blood orange, black pepper and spices give it a kick, while
lavender and orange blossom absolute in the heart evoke the majesty of
French formal gardens. To finish, white sandalwood draped in moss, wood
notes, amber and roasted tonka bean merge on the skin and fire the
imagination.

name: Parfums de Marly Kuhuyan Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Parfums de Marly Kuhuyan is a leathery blend of violet leaf, heliotrope and oud.
Alexandra Kosinski created it in 2013. Violet leaf and jasmine open fresh, heliotrope and leather form a soft heart, and tonka bean, oud and ambergris give it an animalic, sweet finish.
Bold and sensual, it is great for date nights and outings in fall and winter.

The masculine Kuhuyan Eau de Parfum opens with a refreshing duo of violet and jasmine with the heart revealing its intensity through rich leather accords before enveloping into a base of agwardwood, tonka bean and the gourmand warmth of amber.
Top Notes: Cinnamon, pepperwood
Middle Notes: Osmantinus, tobacco leaves
Base Notes: Vanilla pods, cedarwood
Eau de Parfum

name: Parfums de Marly Layton Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Parfums de Marly Layton pairs crisp apple and lavender with a warm, spiced vanilla heart.
Hamid Merati-Kashani composed it in 2016. Apple, lavender, mandarin and bergamot open bright and fresh, geranium, violet and jasmine add a floral lift, and the base settles into vanilla, cardamom, pepper, sandalwood, patchouli and guaiac wood.
Layton is sweet, fresh and spicy all at once, so it rarely misses. Reach for it on date nights and evenings out, and enjoy it most when the air turns cooler in spring, fall and winter.

The Scoop
Inspired by the colorful bustle of
the Royal Court of Versailles, Layton, the newest fragrance from Parfums
de Marly, bursts forth with a fresh, dynamic masculine elegance that
perfectly embodies the festive yet elegant atmosphere of the 18th
century's most important and luxurious seat of power.
Layton opens with a dazzling splash of juicy, tangy bergamot and
apple, tilted towards the alluringly masculine with fresh lavender,
geranium and violet. Warm amber tones lend richness to the spicy heart,
while a drydown of precious woods and vanilla up the opulence even
further- perfect for a fragrance meant to evoke a name still synonymous
with gloriously high-end excess. Life at Versailles must surely have
been a dazzling mix of business, statecraft, leisure and celebration- it
should come as no surprise that Layton presents itself as a perfect
fragrance for any and all of those pursuits.
Layton  Notes
Bergamot, lavender, apple, mandarin, violet, jasmine, geranium, gaiac, patchouli, sandalwood, cardamom, vanilla, pepper

name: Parfums de Marly Layton Exclusif Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Parfums de Marly Layton Exclusif is a deeper, richer take on Layton with oud and coffee.
Hamid Merati-Kashani created it in 2017. Almond, mandarin, bergamot and watery notes open bright, geranium, rose and gardenia form the heart, and guaiac wood, oud, vanilla, coffee, sandalwood and patchouli give it a deep finish.
Made for fall and winter, perfect for date nights.

When we first heard that Parfums de
Marly had a new version of their cult favorite Layton, we admit we were
at a bit of a loss: how could they possibly improve on the fruity,
spicy, gloriously lively luxuriousness of this ode to the splendor of
Versailles?
Now that we have it in our hands, we're pleased to
announce this is no mere flanker. Instead, perhaps inspired by Marie
Antoinette's extensive remodeling of the palace and grounds in the 18th
century, Marly has rebuilt Layton from the ground up, delivering a
companion piece to the fresh, sporty original that surrounds the
signature blend of fruits and spices with deep, animalic woods and
resins for a darkly seductive experience.
In Layton Exclusif, a
heavy dose of civet hums through the rich floral heart, delivering a new
layer of sensuality. And the already opulent vanilla and woods base is
further enhanced, with resinous amber and an alluringly powerful coffee
note to invigorate the senses and heighten the passion. Does Layton
Exclusif take the place of our beloved Layton? It's not meant to.
Instead, we think of the two as the ultimate pair- Layton, a gentleman's
perfect match for a day of royal festivities, and Layton Exclusif, a
dangerously seductive secret weapon when day turns to evening.
Layton EXCLUSIF  Notes
Bergamot,
mandarin, water accord, grapefruit, rose, geranium, waterlily, gardenia,
civet, cardamom, sandalwood, gaiac, amber, pink pepper, vanilla,
coffee, musk

name: Parfums de Marly Lippizan Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Parfums de Marly Lippizan is a classic, aromatic blend of herbs, cedar and oakmoss.
Sidonie Lancesseur created it in 2009. Clary sage, thyme, tarragon, cardamom, lemon and bergamot open fresh, cedar, vetiver, galbanum, rose, iris and patchouli form an earthy heart, and oakmoss, leather, musk and amber give it a warm finish.
Refined and timeless, it is a great everyday scent in fall and winter.

Lipizzan Inspired by the daring horse race that charmed France during the King Louis XV’s era, is a captivating woody earthy fragrance that opens up with Bergamot, Cardamom, the heart note is a gentle blend of Rose, Patchouli, leading to a cedar-leather base. Top notes: bergamot, lemon, cardamom, thyme, tarragon and Clary Sage. Heart: jasmine, rose, iris, galbanum, patchouli, cedar and vetiver. Base: moss, vanilla, leather, amber and musk.

name: Parfums de Marly Meliora Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Parfums de Marly Meliora is a fresh, fruity rose with red berries.
Nathalie Lorson created it in 2013. Black currant, red berries and cassis open juicy, rose, ylang-ylang and lily of the valley form the heart, and vanilla and musk give it a soft finish.
A daytime favorite for spring and summer, lovely for date nights.

Mother of the famous stallion
Tartar, the brood mare Meliora gets her own tribute in this ravishingly
mouthwatering, stunningly natural-feeling fruity floral from Parfums de
Marly. Meliora opens with a delightful burst of fruits, blackcurrant,
raspberry and a red fruits accord, juicy-sweet but not at all artificial
or cloying. In the heart, luscious rose blends with sweet ylang and
green lily for a fresh, natural feminine core, while a woody, musky
vanilla base lingers in the air for hours to come. Gorgeous, restrained
and full of life, Meliora is a fragrance worthy of its name.
Meliora  Notes
Red fruits, raspberry, blackcurrant, rose, lily, ylang, woods, vanilla, musk

name: Parfums de Marly Nisean Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Parfums de Marly Nisean is a warm, spicy blend of saffron, incense and woods.
Launched in 2016, it opens with pink pepper, grapefruit and lime. Saffron, labdanum, olibanum, rose and geranium form a rich heart, and precious woods, patchouli leaf, amber and cedar give it a smooth finish.
Elegant and warm, it is great for date nights and evenings in fall and winter.

Powerful, elegant and confidently
exotic, Nisean is a masculine oriental with refinement to spare. Named
for a legendary breed of ancient Persian horse, Nisean features an
effortless balance of smoky, spicy, and woodsy notes, for a stylish and
striking gentleman who knows how to leave a lasting impression.
Nisean opens with a rich burst of resinous florals and sweet
woods balanced with a rich vein of saffron, imbuing a familiar set of
notes with uncommonly refined quality. As the deep, earthy patchouli
emerges to balance the sweetness, an airy incense-like quality emanates
forth, keeping everything balanced with surprising agility. Yes, you've
smelled a masculine oriental before. But Nisean, with its power, dignity
and subtlety, towers above its competitors.
Nisean  Notes
Saffron, labdanum, flowers, patchouli, precious woods

name: Parfums de Marly Oajan Eau de Parfum for Men

middle: vanilla deliciously sweetened by honey and
key: vanilla deliciously sweetened by honey and
notes.source_text:
Parfums de Marly Oajan is a warm, honeyed amber with cinnamon and tonka.
Shyamala Maisondieu created it in 2013. Cinnamon, honey and osmanthus open sweet, benzoin, ambergris, labdanum and artemisia form a resinous heart, and tonka bean, vanilla, patchouli and musk give it a cozy finish.
Made for fall and winter nights and date nights.

"An Arabian will take care of its
owner as no other horse will, for it has not only been raised to
physical perfection, but has been instilled with a spirit of loyalty
unparalleled by that of any other breed."
The Oajan: a feared war mount, beloved race champion, and all
around beautiful stallion. Oajan: a sumptuous, mouthwateringly spiced
gourmand that projects majestic power and sophisticated, exotic taste.
Opening with Parfums de Marly's ravishingly spicy cinnamon and rich,
warm labdanum, Oajan flourishes as the creamy warmth of the heart notes
emerge, benzoin, tonka and vanilla deliciously sweetened by honey and
davana. Rich and lovely, Oajan is an East-meets-West gourmand delight.
Oajan  Notes
Cinnamon, honey, osmanthus, benzoin, labdanum, amber, davana, patchouli, musk, vanilla, tonka bean

name: Parfums de Marly Oriana Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Parfums de Marly Oriana is a sweet, fluffy blend of red fruits and marshmallow.
Nathalie Lorson and Hamid Merati-Kashani created it in 2021. Mandarin, bergamot and grapefruit open bright, orange blossom, raspberry and black currant form a fruity heart, and marshmallow, whipped cream, musk and ambrette give it a soft finish.
Playful and feminine, it is a delight for everyday wear.

Oriana by Parfums de Marly is a Floral Fruity Gourmand fragrance for women. This is a new fragrance. Oriana was launched in 2021. Oriana was created by Nathalie Lorson and Hamid Merati-Kashani. Top notes are Mandarin Orange, Bergamot and Grapefruit; middle notes are Orange Blossom, Raspberry and Black Currant; base notes are Marshamallow, Whipped cream, Musk and Ambrette (Musk Mallow).

name: Parfums de Marly Palatine Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Parfums de Marly Palatine is a fresh, fruity blend of pear, mandarin and violet.
Launched in 2024, it opens with pear, mandarin and bergamot. Violet forms a soft, powdery heart, and musk and sandalwood give it a clean, creamy finish.
Light and elegant, it works day or night from spring through fall.

name: Parfums de Marly Pegasus Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Parfums de Marly Pegasus is a creamy blend of almond, heliotrope and vanilla.
Hamid Merati-Kashani created it in 2011. Heliotrope, cumin and bergamot open soft, lavender, bitter almond and jasmine form the heart, and amber, vanilla and sandalwood give it a smooth finish.
Versatile in spring, fall and winter, perfect for date nights.

The Scoop
Pegasus- the horse God, the heavenly
stallion portrayed in Coustou's famed statue. A creature of such power,
refinement and nobility that only a God himself would dare attempt to
ride him. In this spirit, Parfums de Marly's Pegasus is, itself,
fragrance nobility- a skillfully refined take on the fougere style
featuring unexpected notes of almond and vanilla that give it unique
lasting power and striking dignity.
Pegasus opens with the aforementioned almond note- lightly
sweet, somewhat bitter, and warm, given juicy heft by a more
traditionally fougere-like bergamot. The heart of the fragrance further
expands on the almonds' sweet, marzipan-like depth, while an unlisted
floral accord (lavender and jasmine?)exudes gentle, refined masculinity.
In the base, vanilla is the clear star of the show, replacing a
traditional fougere's mossiness with creamy warmth supplemented by amber
notes, while a light, sharp sandalwood keeps everything airy enough to
still earn the genre. To read the notes of Pegasus is to wonder how it
earns a categorization as a men's fougere- to smell it, on the other
hand, is to be so swept up in its sophistication and majesty that you've
no choice but to understand.
Pegasus  Notes
Bergamot, heliotrope, spice, almond, amber, vanilla, sandalwood

name: Parfums de Marly Pegasus Exclusif Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Parfums de Marly Pegasus Exclusif is a richer, deeper take on Pegasus.
Launched in 2020, it opens with cardamom, heliotrope, pink pepper and bergamot. Bitter almond, lavender, jasmine and geranium form the heart, and vanilla, guaiac wood, sandalwood, oud and amber give it a warm finish.
Made for fall and winter, day or night.

Pegasus Exclusif by Parfums de Marly is a Oriental Woody fragrance for men. This is a new fragrance. Pegasus Exclusif
was launched in 2020. Top notes are Heliotrope, Cardamom, Pink Pepper
and Bergamot; middle notes are Bitter Almond, Jasmine, Geranium and
Lavender; base notes are Vanilla, Guaiac Wood, Sandalwood, Agarwood
(Oud) and Amber.

name: Parfums de Marly Percival Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Parfums de Marly Percival is a bright, clean citrus-aromatic that works almost anywhere.
Hamid Merati-Kashani created it in 2018. Mandarin, bergamot, lavender and geranium open fresh, violet, jasmine, coriander, cinnamon and hedione add a soft, airy heart, and ambroxan, amberwood, balsam fir and musk leave a clean, modern trail.
Percival is clean, fresh and easy to like, which makes it one of the most versatile scents in the Parfums de Marly line. Wear it from spring through fall, from the office to the gym to date night.

Named for a mythical French thoroughbred, Percival is that rarest of wonders- a truly ageless masculine. Sure, we can picture a dashing racing horse thundering around an 18th century track to the delight of the aristocracy, but Percival is every bit as appropriate on a debonair gentleman in a pristine late-model luxury sedan, stylishly cutting his way through the bustling city night on his way to an exclusive gathering. With a subtle yet striking balance between citrus and aromatic notes, a richly masculine floral heart of lavender, violet and geranium, and a spiced, deeply woodsy base, this is the kind of scent that wears as perfectly on any man as an impeccably tailored three-piece suit- a timeless signifier of dignity and taste. Fresh, sensual and refined, Percival is bound to leave a lasting impression.
Percival  Notes
Bergamot, mandarin, aromatic notes, jasmine, violet, geranium, lavender, pink pepper, coriander, cinnamon, musk, woody notes, spices, pepper, nutmeg, tonka

name: Parfums de Marly Perseus Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Parfums de Marly Perseus is a crisp, clean citrus with woody depth.
Launched in 2024, it opens with grapefruit, bergamot and black currant. Green mandarin, vetiver and geranium form a fresh heart, and dry woods, ambergris and cashmere wood give it a smooth finish.
A daytime favorite for spring and summer.

name: Parfums de Marly Safanad Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Parfums de Marly Safanad is a creamy, sunny white floral with vanilla.
Fabrice Pellegrin created it in 2013. Pear and orange open bright, orange blossom, ylang-ylang and iris form a soft heart, and vanilla, sandalwood and amber give it a warm finish.
Elegant in spring, fall and winter, and lovely for date nights.

The grace of a thoroughbred lies not
only in its sheer power but also the stunning economy of that power-
the perfection of each movement, the efficiency of every step. Safanad,
with its delicate, subtly complex floral warmth, is a reflection of this
grace, taking advantage of a quieter, more restrained composition to
truly showcase each note and impress on us a form of beauty all the more
ravishing for its dignity. Opening with bright orange and a lusciously
three-dimensional pear note, Safanad then stuns us with a floral heart
led by sweet ylang and lightly earthy iris. A warm, rich base of
vanilla, woods and amber cradles these florals, keeping a fresh
femininity to the composition throughout its life. Lush and gorgeous,
Safanad is proof that gentle and stunning are not mutually exclusive
terms.
Safanad  Notes
Orange, pear, orange blossom, orris, ylang, amber, sandalwood, vanilla

name: Parfums de Marly Sedbury Eau de Parfum for Women

middle: have been fashioned out of Vanilla Pod
key: have been fashioned out of Vanilla Pod
notes.source_text:
Parfums de Marly Sedbury is an aromatic white floral with lavender, tuberose and vanilla.
Launched in 2015, it opens with clary sage, lavender, tangerine and bergamot. Tuberose, jasmine and iris form a creamy heart, and benzoin, vanilla, ambergris, vetiver and patchouli give it a warm finish.
Elegant and smooth, it is a lovely daytime scent in spring and fall.

Described as a steed of exquisite beauty, fine shape and form, Sedbury was said to be the best of his size in his day. The perfume replicates these values and is a flawless blend of floral goodness with contemporary notes. Sedbury blends top notes of Mandarin Italy, Bergamot Italy, Sauge Sclaree and Lavande Orpur with middle notes of Turbereuse D’inde, Jasmin Exotique and Iris. The heart notes have been fashioned out of Vanilla Pod, Santal, Amber, Benzoin Laos, Patchouli, Indonesie and Vetiver Haiti.

name: Parfums de Marly Sedley Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Parfums de Marly Sedley is a crisp, minty-fresh aromatic for warm days.
Hamid Merati-Kashani and Olivier Cresp created it in 2019. Mint, lemon, bergamot, grapefruit and mandarin open cool and sparkling, lavender, rosemary, geranium and olibanum add an aromatic heart, and ambroxan, vetiver, cashmeran, sandalwood and cedar keep it clean and lasting.
Sedley is crisp, clean and instantly refreshing, the kind of scent that feels like a cool breeze on a hot day. It is a spring and summer go-to for the office and everyday wear.

Sedley by Parfums de Marly is a Woody Aromatic fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Sedley was launched in 2019. The nose behind this fragrance is Olivier Cresp. Top notes are bergamot, mandarin orange, grapefruit, lemon and mint; middle notes are rosemary, geranium, lavender and olibanum; base notes are sandalowood, cedar, vetiver, patchouli, cashmeran and ambroxan.

name: Parfums de Marly Shagya Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Parfums de Marly Shagya is a fresh, woody blend of lime, oud and vetiver.
Sidonie Lancesseur created it in 2009. Lime, bergamot and pink pepper open bright, oud, Virginia cedar and geranium form a woody heart, and vetiver, guaiac wood, papyrus and musk give it a dry finish.
Refined and versatile, it is great for date nights and outings in spring, fall and winter.

Parfums
De Marly Shagya Royal Essence Eau de Parfum is a conspicuously
masculine fragrance that will give you self-confidence at any time of
the day.
a woody fragrance
for the modern, self-confident man
for both everyday wear and special occasions

name: Parfums de Marly Valaya Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Parfums de Marly Valaya is a luminous white floral with a soft, musky glow.
Quentin Bisch created it in 2023. Mandarin, white peach, bergamot and aldehydes open bright and airy, orange blossom and lily of the valley bloom at the heart, and musk, ambroxan, akigalawood and vanilla leave a clean, skin-like finish.
Elegant and feminine, it feels like freshly laundered silk and suits everyday wear and special moments alike.

name: Parfums de Marly Valaya Exclusif Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Parfums de Marly Valaya Exclusif is a soft, creamy floral with almond and vanilla.
Launched in 2025, it opens with mandarin, almond and bergamot. Orange blossom, white flowers and powdery notes form the heart, and vanilla, akigalawood, ambroxan and sandalwood leave a smooth, warm finish.
Elegant and easy to wear in every season.

name: Parfums de Marly Valero Extrait de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Parfums de Marly Valero is a fresh, aromatic blend of citron, juniper and lavender.
Launched in 2025, it opens with citron, bergamot and juniper. Lavender, geranium, nutmeg and cypress form an aromatic heart, and ambrox, patchouli and sandalwood give it a clean, woody finish.
Crisp and polished, it is a great daytime scent from spring through fall.

name: Penhaligon's AIUla Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Penhaligon's AlUla is a warm, spicy blend of cardamom, saffron and plum.
Launched in 2024, it opens with black pepper, Guatemalan cardamom and frankincense. Saffron, tobacco and plum form a rich heart, and turmeric and vanilla give it a warm finish.
Opulent and cozy, it works day or night in fall and winter.

name: Penhaligon's Alizarin Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Penhaligon's Alizarin is a smoky floral with narcissus, mimosa and leather.
Christian Provenzano created it in 2016. Narcissus and mandarin open bright, mimosa, tuberose and iris form a floral heart, and leather, oud, incense and vetiver give it a smoky finish.
Bold and elegant, it works for date nights, everyday wear and outings in fall and winter.

An intriguing and intense Oud inspired by the red dye, Alizarin,
cultivated in Egypt since antiquity. The distinctive red color would
continue to be worn for centuries giving British soldiers the nickname
of "redcoats". Intense and mysterious, Alizarin conjures whispers of
oud, precious vetiver and rare resins. A homage to the millenary
tradition of fragrance in Egypt, it is reminiscent of ancient and
traditional perfumes

name: Penhaligon's Amaranthine Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Penhaligon's Amaranthine is a spicy, milky floral with tea, carnation and sandalwood.
Bertrand Duchaufour created it in 2009. Palm leaf, cardamom, freesia, coriander and tea open green, ylang-ylang, carnation, clove, jasmine, orange flower and rose form a spicy heart, and milk, vanilla, sandalwood, musk and tonka bean give it a creamy finish.
Sensual and unusual, it is a lovely everyday scent.

name: Penhaligon's Artemisia Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Penhaligon's Artemisia is a soft, powdery blend of nectarine, violet and vanilla.
Launched in 2002, it opens with nectarine and green notes. Violet, vanilla, lily-of-the-valley, tea, jasmine and green apple form a gentle heart, and musk, sandalwood, oakmoss and amber give it a soft finish.
Graceful and fresh, it is a lovely daytime scent in spring.

name: Penhaligon's Babylon Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Penhaligon's Babylon is a warm, spicy blend of nutmeg, saffron and vanilla.
Launched in 2019, it opens with nutmeg, saffron and coriander. Cypriol forms an earthy heart, and vanilla, cedar and sandalwood give it a powdery, woody finish.
Cozy and refined, it is made for fall and winter nights.

name: Penhaligon's Bayolea Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
Penhaligon's Bayolea is a fresh, spicy blend of citrus, black pepper and lavender.
Launched in 2014, it opens with lemongrass, mandarin and tangerine. Black pepper, lavender, neroli and cardamom form an aromatic heart, and cedar, moss, sandalwood, amber, musk and patchouli give it a woody finish.
Polished and fresh, it is made for spring and summer days.

name: Penhaligon's Bold Blend Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Penhaligon's Bold Blend is a fresh, woody blend of black pepper, mint and palo santo.
Launched in 2026, it opens with black pepper and peppermint. Clary sage and violet leaf form a green heart, and palo santo, cypress and cypriol give it a smoky, woody finish.
Crisp and versatile, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

name: Penhaligon's Cairo Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Penhaligon's Cairo is a warm blend of Damask rose, saffron and vanilla.
Christophe Raynaud created it in 2019. Damask rose and saffron open rich, vanilla, cypriol and labdanum form a warm heart, and sandalwood, patchouli and cedar give it an earthy finish.
Opulent and sensual, it is made for fall and winter nights.

name: Penhaligon's Castile Eau de Toilette Unisex

notes.source_text:
Penhaligon's Castile is a fresh, clean blend of orange blossom, petitgrain and rose.
Launched in 1998, it opens with orange blossom and petitgrain. Bergamot, orange blossom and rose form a soft heart, and musk and woods give it a clean finish.
Light and elegant, it is great for everyday wear and the office in spring and summer.

Penhaligon's understands the emotive power of scent. It can unlock
memories and open doors; it can stop us in our tracks, lost somewhere
for a moment in time. The fragrant adventure began in the Victorian era
of decadence and carries us into the future as Penhaligon's strive to
create original scents for the discerning eccentrics of today. True
modern dandies and bold women who are proud to go their own way. Created
in 1998, Castile is a classic citrus shot through with the intoxicating
thrill of neroli. Fresh and bursting with the dusky sensuality of warm
Mediterranean nights, the neroli marries perfectly with the aromatic
tang of bergamot and delicate rose. The citrus notes flood the senses,
uplifting and soothing. Woods and musk round off Castile, smoothing
everything into a warm lick of marmalade and sunshine, perfect for
summer, piquant enough to warm you through in the winter months.
Top notes are petitgrain and orange blossom; middle notes are bergamot,
rose and orange blossom; base notes are woodsy notes and musk.

name: Penhaligon's Changing Constance Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Penhaligon's Changing Constance is a warm gourmand of cardamom, salted caramel and tobacco.
Launched in 2018, it opens with cardamom and pimento. Caramel and salt form a sweet, salty heart, and vanilla, cashmeran and tobacco give it a smooth finish.
Cozy and indulgent, it is great for outings in fall and winter.

Sister to Lady Blanche, Constance is
what one would call a very modern woman. Her opening blend of cool
cardamom and hot pimento is modern, to say the least, and is bound to
deliver a dynamically fresh and spicy thrill. Still possessing a mild
affinity to her favourite childhood treat, Constance can always be found
sucking on a butter salted caramel as she twirls her Turkish cigar,
clad in perfectly tailored cashmere trousers. Irreverent, stylish, and
unquestionably contemporary, Changing Constance isn't a fragrance for
every woman, which is assuredly exactly the way she likes it.
Changing Constance  Notes
Cardamom, pimento, salted butter, caramel, tobacco, vanilla, cashmeran

name: Penhaligon's Clandestine Clara 2017 Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Penhaligon's Clandestine Clara is a warm, sweet blend of rum, cinnamon and vanilla.
Launched in 2017, it blends amber, patchouli, vanilla, woods, cinnamon and rum into a rich, spicy and comforting scent.
Cozy and warm, it works day or night in fall and winter.

name: Penhaligon's Constantinople Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Penhaligon's Constantinople is a woody blend of vanilla, iris and pine.
Christophe Raynaud and Marie Salamagne created it in 2021. Vanilla, iris, pine, lavender, patchouli, geranium, pink pepper and moss come together in a powdery, aromatic and earthy woody scent.
Refined and distinctive, it is a great everyday scent.

name: Penhaligon's Eau Sans Pareil Eau de Toilette for Women

notes.source_text:
Penhaligon's Eau Sans Pareil is a fruity, classic floral with citrus, licorice and orris.
Bertrand Duchaufour created it in 2011. Bergamot, neroli, cypress, mandarin, raspberry, pineapple and aldehydes open bright, ylang-ylang, clove, rose, orange flower, licorice, jasmine and orris form a rich heart, and oakmoss, labdanum, vetiver, benzoin and vanilla give it a warm finish.
Elegant and lively, it is a lovely daytime scent in spring and fall.

name: Penhaligon's Elisabethan Rose Eau de Parfum for Women

middle: chamomile for a light powdery tone
key: chamomile for a light powdery tone
notes.source_text:
Penhaligon's Elisabethan Rose is a fresh, classic rose with chamomile and violet.
Michael Pickthall created it in 1984. Geranium and aldehydes open bright, rose, chamomile and violet form a soft, herbal heart, and musk, amber and sandalwood give it a smooth finish.
Elegant and gentle, it is great for everyday wear and the office in spring.

Elisabethan Rose Perfume by Penhaligon's, In 1984, the women’s fragrance Elisabethan Rose was released
. This fresh and herbal
perfume opens with a blend of aldehydes and geranium. The middle notes
contain subtle violet, rose and chamomile for a light powdery tone. The
scent closes with a warm combination of amber, musk and sandalwood.
Michael Pickthall is the designer behind this aroma.
In 1870, Penhaligon’s was established in Britain by William Penhaligon. This company was first
established as a barbershop until 1872 when the first fragrance was
offered. The small shop maintained operation until The Blitz of 1941
during World War II. The shop was destroyed, but the fragrances remained
popular.
Fifteen years later, the company was granted
a Royal Warrant by the Duke of Edinburgh for its contribution of
high-quality toiletries. A new store was finally established in 1975 in
Covenant Gardens. The brand now offers a selection of luxury grooming,
shaving, bath and beauty care products.

name: Penhaligon's Endymion Concentre Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Penhaligon's Endymion Concentré is a smooth blend of lavender, suede and leather.
Launched in 2016, it opens with lavender, sage and bergamot. Suede and geranium form a soft, refined heart, and leather, nutmeg and incense give it a warm, slightly smoky finish.
Polished and versatile, it suits the office, everyday wear and date nights in fall and winter.

Penhaligon's Endymion Concentre is a Masculine fragrance, The fragrance launched in 2016
Top Note: Lavender, Sage, Bergamot
Heart Note: Suede, Geranium
Base Note: Leather, Nutmeg, Incense

name: Penhaligon's Endymion Eau de Cologne for Men

notes.source_text:
Penhaligon's Endymion is an aromatic blend of lavender, coffee and incense.
Launched in 2003, it opens with mandarin, sage, bergamot and lavender. Coffee and geranium form a warm heart, and olibanum, nutmeg, cardamom, sandalwood, vetiver, myrrh, leather, black pepper and incense give it a spicy finish.
Polished and versatile, it works for the office, date nights and casual days in spring, fall and winter.

The Scoop
The romantic, aromatic partner to
Artemisia. Endymion in ancient myth was a mortal who was so loved by the
Goddess of the Moon that she put him to sleep forever so she alone
could visit him every night.
A sexy, modern fusion of citrus, spices and leather. Endymion
opens with a burst of sweetened mandarin wrapped gently in sage and
lavender, this settles and smoothes gently into a dark coffee heart. As
the skin warms up, mysterious resins rise up with hints of creamy nutmeg
and cardamom, all wrapped in the softest leather.
Spicy and fresh, it is a fragrance of contrast. Light and dark.
Sweet and sharp. But above all, sensual, like walking in a moonlit
garden thinking thoughts of velvet seduction.
Endymion  Notes
Bergamot,
Mandarin, Lavender and Sage Geranium and Coffee Absolute, Vetiver,
Nutmeg, Black pepper, Cardamom, Musk, Leather, Sandalwood, Incense,
Frankincense and Myrrh

name: Penhaligon's Halfeti Cedar Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Penhaligon's Halfeti Cedar is a warm, fruity cedar with rum and spice.
Christian Provenzano created it in 2020. Rum, peach, saffron and cardamom open warm, Virginia cedar, dried fruits, cinnamon and immortelle form the heart, and Atlas cedar, vanilla, patchouli, tonka bean and labdanum give it depth.
Made for fall and winter nights.

Halfeti Cedar by Penhaligon's is a Woody Spicy fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Halfeti Cedar was launched in 2020. The nose behind this fragrance is Christian Provenzano. Top notes are Rum, Peach, Saffron and Cardamom; middle notes are Virginia Cedar, Dried Fruits, Cinnamon, Mineral notes and Immortelle; base notes are Atlas Cedar, Vanilla, Patchouli, Tonka Bean and Labdanum.

name: Penhaligon's Halfeti Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Penhaligon's Halfeti is a dark, spiced rose with oud, leather and warm woods.
Christian Provenzano created it in 2015. Saffron, cardamom, cypress, artemisia, bergamot and grapefruit open bright and spicy, Bulgarian rose, nutmeg and jasmine form the heart, and oud, leather, sandalwood, amber, tonka and vanilla give it a rich finish.
Made for fall and winter, perfect for date nights and evenings out.

Halfeti draws inspiration from
the lavish goods traded with Turkey: exotic florals, spices, soft
leathers and precious fabrics. The fragrance is named for the small
Turkish village of Halfeti, where enchanting "black" roses grow on the
banks of the Euphrates river. Dark and mysterious, the roses are an
intense shade of crimson, so dusky they appear to be black.
Halfeti is an exquisitely opulent woody floral, dazzling in the glow of
luxurious golden saffron, decorated with bright citrus, green armoise
and woody cypress. An exquisitely multifaceted rose is set like a
precious jewel amongst a silken bouquet of sweet florals. The lavish
drydown with its overdose of dusky patchouli heart leads into a melange
of decadent resins, oud and amber, alongside velvet textured sandalwood
and a suede-like leather.

name: Penhaligon's Halfeti Leather Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Penhaligon's Halfeti Leather is a dark, spicy blend of plum, leather and oud.
Christian Provenzano created it in 2020. Cardamom, plum, lavender and citrus open bright, cumin, rose, cinnamon, nutmeg and jasmine form a spicy heart, and leather, oud, incense, cedar and patchouli give it a smoky finish.
Rich and mysterious, it is made for fall and winter nights.

name: Penhaligon's Heartless Helen Eau de Parfum for women

notes.source_text:
Penhaligon's Heartless Helen is a bright blend of mandarin, tuberose and woods.
Launched in 2019, it opens with mandarin. Tuberose forms a creamy, lush heart, and woods give it a smooth finish.
Elegant and sunny, it is made for spring and summer days.

name: Penhaligon's Jubilee Bouquet Eau de Toilette for Women

notes.source_text:
Penhaligon's Jubilee Bouquet is a classic, powdery floral with rose, violet and oakmoss.
Launched in 1977, it opens with chamomile, bergamot and clove. Rose, violet, iris, ylang-ylang and jasmine form a soft heart, and oakmoss, musk, sandalwood and amber give it a mossy finish.
Timeless and graceful, it is a lovely everyday scent.

name: Penhaligon's Kensington Amber Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Penhaligon's Kensington Amber is a warm amber with cinnamon, vanilla and benzoin.
Fabrice Pellegrin created it in 2018. Bergamot opens bright, cinnamon forms a spicy heart, and vanilla, benzoin, labdanum, cedar and tonka bean give it a rich finish.
Cozy and seductive, it is great for date nights and outings in fall and winter.

Kensington Amber Perfume by Penhaligon's,
Inspired by the history of the West London region of the same name,
Kensington Amber is a charming scent
for women designed to
evoke nostalgic memories of elegant strolls. The top opens with the
refreshing scent of bergamot before giving way to the heart of cinnamon.
The spiciness is then sweetened by the alluring scent of vanilla,
finishing off on warm tones of benzoin, labdanum, cedar and tonka bean.
Romantic and enticing, this perfume is best suited
for evening wear, making a perfect finishing touch to any romantic date night outfit.
Penhaligon's is a perfumery based in the United Kingdom. Established
over a century ago in the year 1870, the company has been creating
top-quality fragrances for many years. The company has created many
classic scents, many of which are still popular to this day. Presently,
this manufacturer has over 70 perfumes on the market along with luxury
bath and body products.

name: Penhaligon's Legacy of Petra Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Penhaligon's Legacy of Petra is a resinous blend of green tea, licorice and myrrh.
Natalie Gracia-Cetto created it in 2022. Green tea, fennel and bergamot open fresh, licorice, myrrh, olibanum and rosemary form a warm heart, and benzoin, woods and vanilla give it a balsamic finish.
Warm and contemplative, it is a great everyday and evening scent.

name: Penhaligon's Levantium Eau de Toilette Unisex

notes.source_text:
Penhaligon's Levantium is a warm, spicy blend of saffron, rose and oud.
Christian Provenzano created it in 2014. Saffron, wormwood, artemisia and bergamot open aromatic, rose, clove, cardamom, jasmine, violet and peach form a spicy heart, and oud, patchouli, guaiac wood, sandalwood, myrrh and vanilla give it a rich finish.
Opulent and refined, it works day or night in fall and winter.

name: Penhaligon's LP No.9 Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
Penhaligon's LP No. 9 is a warm, aromatic blend of tarragon, carnation and cinnamon.
Christian Provenzano created it in 1998. Tarragon, geranium, lavender, bergamot and Amalfi lemon open fresh, carnation, rose and jasmine form a spicy floral heart, and cedar, cinnamon, amber, patchouli, musk and vanilla give it a warm finish.
Classic and refined, it works day or night in fall and winter.

name: Penhaligon's Monsieur Beauregard Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Penhaligon's Monsieur Beauregard is a warm, powdery blend of orris, cinnamon and tonka.
Launched in 2017, it opens with lemon and pink pepper. Benzoin, orris root and cinnamon form a spicy, powdery heart, and sandalwood, tonka bean and patchouli give it a warm finish.
Refined and cozy, it works for date nights, everyday wear and outings in fall and winter.

“Our French friend” is how this
unknown but over-familiar houseguest Monsieur Beauregard is typically
introduced. His lingering gaze lets you know he’ll take things from
here. A special kind of perfection that with its strong caressing
silence speaks volumes!
Confidently quiet, and mysteriously sexy, Monsieur Beauregard’s
namesake fragrance opens with subtle vivacity, a silky burst of pink
pepper, lemon, and spicy cinnamon. But this dashing young French heir
never gives it all away – the veil of mystery is always there, in a
creamy base of orris and enough woodsy musk to make your knees weak. The
warm benzoin and tonka is downright seductive, with the most French
allure we’ve seen out of the Penhaligons Portraits series. Masculine,
musky, and sexy, it’s a statement made in one dramatic glance – one look
is all it takes.
Monsieur Beauregard  Notes
Lemon, pink pepper, orris, cinnamon, benzoin, sandalwood, tonka bean, patchouli

name: Penhaligon's Night Scented Stock Eau de Toilette for Women

notes.source_text:
Penhaligon's Night Scented Stock is a warm, spicy floral with clove and vanilla.
Launched in 1976, it opens with clove and cinnamon. Ylang-ylang, lily, heliotrope, violet and jasmine form a soft, powdery heart, and tonka bean, benzoin, musk, sandalwood and vanilla give it a cozy finish.
Gentle and comforting, it is lovely for evenings and cooler days.

name: Penhaligon's Oud de Nil Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Penhaligon's Oud de Nil is a fresh, floral oud with grapefruit and rose.
Christian Provenzano created it in 2016. Bergamot and grapefruit open bright, rose, jasmine, orange blossom and geranium form a soft floral heart, and oud, guaiac wood, papyrus, resins and amber give it a warm finish.
Elegant and versatile, it suits everyday wear and date nights in the fall.

What could possibly be more dazzling and exotic than a cruise down the
Nile?! The daringly modern travelers are traveling light: trunks of
silver, china cups, leather bound books, petticoats, umbrellas and hard
hats. Through the gentle, hazy glow of dawn, the past draws into sight:
Pyramids a-hoy! A crisp morning breeze carries the scent of luminous
grapefruit, steeped in solar jasmine inside this watery Oud. Sweet
orange blossom entwines with rose.
The dancing white sails of
the Felucca find a contrast in the structuring mast that calmly
transports Victorian explorers, Egyptologists and archaeologists
fascinated by the Ancient tombs, the pharaohs and the fecund banks of
the longest river. Guaiac wood and deep amber-Oud bring a reassuring
depth.
A light-filled sail journey across the Orient--with a light-filled Oriental.
KEY NOTES:
- Top notes: bergamot, grapefruit
- Middle notes: jasmine, rose, geranium, orange blossom
- Base notes: oud, papyrus, guaiac wood, resins, amber

name: Penhaligon's Quercus Cologne Unisex

notes.source_text:
Penhaligon's Quercus is a crisp, classic citrus cologne with a mossy, woody base.
Christian Provenzano created it in 1996. Amalfi lemon, lime, bergamot and mandarin open sparkling, lily-of-the-valley, jasmine and cardamom form a soft heart, and oakmoss, sandalwood, galbanum, musk and amber give it a refined finish.
Clean and elegant, it is made for spring and summer days.

Quercus by Penhaligon's is a Chypre fragrance for women and men. Quercus was launched in 1996. The nose behind this fragrance is Christian Provenzano. Top notes are Amalfi Lemon, Lime, Bergamot and Mandarin Orange; middle notes are Lily-of-the-Valley, Jasmine and Cardamom; base notes are Oakmoss, Sandalwood, Galbanum, Musk and Amber.

name: Penhaligon's Racquets Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Penhaligon's Racquets is a clean, woody blend of lemon, ambroxan and guaiac wood.
Launched in 2021, it opens with bright lemon. Ambroxan and guaiac wood form a smooth, musky heart, and leatherwood gives it a dry finish.
Fresh and sporty, it is made for spring and summer days.

name: Penhaligon's Roaring Radcliff Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Penhaligon's Roaring Radcliff is a warm, boozy blend of rum, tobacco and honey.
Daphné Bugey created it in 2016. Rum, bergamot and tarragon open bright, tobacco, ginger and rose form a warm heart, and honey, beeswax, cinnamon, tonka bean, amberwood and leather give it a rich finish.
Cozy and bold, it is made for fall and winter nights.

name: Penhaligon's Solaris Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Penhaligon's Solaris is a sunny blend of neroli, tiare and vanilla.
Launched in 2023, it opens with neroli, lemon and black currant. Jasmine, ylang-ylang and tiare form a radiant heart, and vanilla, sandalwood and cedarwood give it a warm finish.
Bright and cheerful, it is made for spring and summer days.

name: Penhaligon's Sports Car Club Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Penhaligon's Sports Car Club is a fresh, woody blend of pine, cypress and eucalyptus.
Launched in 2022, it opens with pine and pink pepper. Cypress and eucalyptus form a cool, aromatic heart, and ambroxan, patchouli and musk give it a clean finish.
Crisp and invigorating, it is a great everyday scent.

name: Penhaligon's The Bewitching Yasmine Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Penhaligon's The Bewitching Yasmine is a warm blend of coffee, jasmine and oud.
Launched in 2017, it opens with cardamom and coffee. Jasmine sambac and fir form a rich, slightly resinous heart, and Laotian oud, Tahitian vanilla and incense give it a deep, sensual finish.
Mysterious and elegant, it is made for fall and winter nights.

Penhaligon's - Bewitching Yasmine
She is by all appearances soft and quiet. Yet at the same time, she conducts herself with a rare force. Some, the less determined, would find her distant, maybe cold, but appearances are notoriously misleading. Like all intriguing (and bewitching) women, the perfume of Yasmine is hot and cold. The unique sharpness of rich, strong coffee is set off against a creamy spice accord.

name: Penhaligon's The Blazing Mr Sam Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Penhaligon's The Blazing Mr Sam is a warm, spicy blend of cinnamon, saffron and tobacco.
Launched in 2018, it opens with cardamom and cinnamon. Saffron, cumin and black pepper form a hot, spicy heart, and vanilla, tobacco, cedar and patchouli give it a rich finish.
Bold and cozy, it is made for fall and winter date nights.

The Blazing Mister Sam belongs to the Penhaligon's Portrait
collection and is inspired by an American aboard who lives fast, spends
freely and speaks loudly. The fragrance opens with notes of cardamom and
cinnamon before revealing a spicy heart and woody floral harmonies. The
composition also includes cumin, saffron, black pepper, vanilla,
patchouli, cedar and tobacco.
Top notes: Cardamom, cinnamon
Middle notes: Cumin, saffron, black pepper
Base notes: Vanilla, patchouli, cedarwood, tobacco

name: Penhaligon's The Coveted Duchess Rose Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:

Elegant and easy, it is a great daytime scent from spring through fall.

name: Penhaligon's The Cut Eau de Parfun for Men

notes.source_text:

Launched in 2025, it blends cypress, clary sage, lavender, cedarwood, basil, mint and fir into a crisp, aromatic and woody scent.
A daytime favorite from spring through fall.

name: Penhaligon's The Dandy Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:

Charming and warm, it works day or night in fall and winter.

name: Penhaligon's The Favourite Eau de Parfum for Women

Penhaligon's The Favourite is a powdery floral with violet, mimosa and iris.

Graceful and light, it is made for spring and summer days.

notes.source_text:
Penhaligon's The Impudent Cousin Matthew is a fresh blend of mandarin, petitgrain and patchouli.
Launched in 2019, it opens with mandarin. Petitgrain forms a green, citrusy heart, and patchouli gives it an earthy, woody finish.

name: Penhaligon's The Ingenue Cousin Flora Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:

The Ingénue Cousin Flora by Penhaligon's is a Citrus Aromatic fragrance for women. This is a new fragrance. The Ingénue Cousin Flora was launched in 2019. Top note is Citruses; middle note is Musk; base note is Ambroxan.

name: Penhaligon's The Inimitable William Penhaligon Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Penhaligon's The Inimitable William Penhaligon is a smooth blend of incense, vetiver and sandalwood.
Alberto Morillas created it in 2020. Bergamot and jasmine open bright, vetiver, incense and cedar form a woody heart, and sandalwood and ambroxan give it a warm, ambery finish.
Refined and versatile, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

name: Penhaligon's The Omniscient Mr Thompson Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Penhaligon's The Omniscient Mr Thompson is a woody blend of lavender, orris and sesame.
Launched in 2023, it opens with pink pepper, elemi and lavender. Black pepper, geranium and orris form an aromatic heart, and vanilla, sesame and oak give it a warm finish.
Refined and versatile, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

name: Penhaligon's The Revenge Of Lady Blanche Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Penhaligon's The Revenge of Lady Blanche is a green, powdery blend of hyacinth, narcissus and iris.
Daphné Bugey created it in 2016. Hyacinth, narcissus and iris come together in a cool, earthy and elegant floral scent.
Refined and unusual, it is a great daytime scent from spring through fall.

name: Penhaligon's The Ruthless Countess Dorothea Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Penhaligon's The Ruthless Countess Dorothea is a warm blend of ginger, cinnamon wood and beeswax.
Launched in 2017, it opens with ginger, cinnamon wood and bergamot. Beeswax, maté and clary sage form an aromatic heart, and white wine, vanilla and cashmeran give it a smooth finish.
Warm and elegant, it works for date nights, everyday wear and outings in fall and winter.

The Ruthless Countess Dorothea is a
most ferocious matriarch, known for her sharp mind, even sharper wit and
a secret fondness for the company of young men and scones! She knows
how to host and receive, with impeccable manners, without question.
And her scent is similarly refined, reassuring – but you can’t
help but notice the surreptitious flame. She opens with a hit of
uplifting citrus bergamot that recalls the finest Earl Grey tea. Drink
deeper, and you notice the honeyed spice in the air, with red ginger and
cinnamon. It's deliciously wearable, with an inviting, creamy vanilla
like buttery scones at tea-time. But don't get too comfortable - the
furtive glances belie the cozy gourmands - for it seems there's some
sherry in the tea and always, the potential of new romance.
The Ruthless Countess Dorothea  Notes
Bergamot, red ginger, cinnamon, beeswax, clary sage, mate, vanilla, sherry, cashmere wood

name: Penhaligon's The Tragedy Of Lord George Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Penhaligon's The Tragedy of Lord George is a warm blend of brandy, tonka and shaving soap.
Alberto Morillas created it in 2016. Brandy, woods, tonka bean and amber blend with a clean shaving-soap accord for a smooth, sweet and slightly boozy scent.
Made for fall and winter, from everyday wear to date nights.

The Scoop
"Lord George is a wealthy and
respected man, the archetypical patriarch. He seems to emboy the noblest
values of the aristocracy- virtue, respect, loyalty and faithfulness."
...but of course, in the subversive universe of Penhaligon's
Portraits, not all is as it seems, and Lord George has secret dalliances
that could threaten the reputation of his household. As such, his
fragrance is both perfectly, properly British- clean, sophisticated
shaving soap and warm, lightly powdery tonka- and, with an intriguing
vein of rich, boozy brandy, a bit dangerous as well. The perfect scent
for a gentleman with something dark hidden away.
The Tragedy of Lord George  Notes
Brandy, shaving soap, tonka bean,

notes.source_text:

Polo Blue evokes a feeling of the freedom of the big, blue sky and the
energy of the open waters, combined with an invigorating blast of fresh
air. This lush fragrance for men is a fresh blend of aquatic accords
combined with spicy basil, verbena, and clary sage, softened with
soothing notes of washed suede, velvety moss, and sheer musk.
Notes:
Melon de Cavaillon, Lush Accord, Lush Watery Melon, Fresh Sliced
Cucumber, Tangerine, Clary Sage Absolute, Geranium, Basil Verbena,
Washed Suede, Velvety Moss, Amber Wood, Patchouli Coeur, Sheer Musk.
Style:
A crystal blue sensation.

Hawas for Him blends cinnamon, bergamot, orange blossom, grey amber and sandalwood to create an aquatic scent designed to embody masculine strength and vigour. This fresh elegant woody perfume combines the premium Italian citrus and the fruity freshness of pear and pineapple. The heart of this modern fougere is based on aquatic elements combined with melon and violet. It is a mix of sandalwood, cedar wood, musk with generous ambergris. The fragrance is inflected with fresh marine aromatic notes that melt into amber woods. The fragrance captures the adventurous, exploratory and evocative spirit of the modern man. The contemporary notes of this chic fragrance come with an attitude to match. The clear grey bottle has a python wrapped around the stopper while a textured python on the pack captures the sensuality of the species with a flamboyance redolent of haute couture. Hawas for Him was launched in 2015.

La Yuqawam, in Arabic means Irresistible. LaYuqawam series extends a classic yet modern feel full of elegance, refinement and prestige to oriental perfumery. The series which includes six fragrances has become a classic that never goes out of fashion. The love for this series transcends beyond the originally targeted Arab nationalities to international connoisseurs of perfumes, looking for a sophisticated and modern exhilarating oriental experience.
Ambregris Showers, men fragrance of LaYuqawam III, true to the DNA of the series celebrates confidence, irresistibility and timeless elegance through a highly distinguishing olfactory signature. The perfume pays homage to the famed Middle Eastern tradition of elegant intoxicating fragrant trail; a la scent signature that announces a weaver much before the arrival while leaving behind a mysteriously lingering aura.
Leather accord which is at the core of LaYuqawam's masculine series culminates into an opus of uplifting freshness quintessential of crystalline aura of ambroxan, made greener and spicier with an Occidental touch of Orris and Galbanum. A heady and intoxicating mix of woody ambrox and sparkling freshness, the scent’s heart is infused with opposing herbaceous notes, creating a differentiating scent signature as intense as crystal. La Yuqawam Ambergris Showers was launched in 2016.

Jasmine Wisp, women fragrance of LaYuqawam edition III, true to the DNA of the series celebrates confidence, irresistibility and timeless elegance through a highly distinguishing olfactory signature. The perfume pays homage to the famed Middle Eastern tradition of elegant intoxicating fragrant trail; a la scent signature that announces a weaver much before the arrival while leaving behind a mysteriously lingering aura.
A distinctive white floral vanilla scent laced with generous ambry pear juice and hints of citrus along with appetizing notes of Bourbon vanilla, coumarine and maltol giving the scent a gourmand touch. The accentuated note of amber with strawberry imparts it an irresistible young, vivacious and feisty signature while the sweetness of Anjou infused with overwhelming floral scent of the Starkrimson pear gives it a sensuous appeal.
The Jasmine Wisp woman is a young, modern, cosmopolitan dreamer with a love for discovery. The lovely trail of the fragrance heightens her inner confidence while enveloping her in an aura of sensuous mystery. The long lasting fruity floral fragrance brimming with happiness and promise is ideal for woman with a vivacious personality, one who is always at the centre of attention. La Yuqawam Jasmine Wisp was launched in 2016.

Innuendo was made by Roja Dove as an
“homage to everything feminine: a lingerie drawer, make-up, and a
knowing look.” So if you were to go into this expecting all the
sturm-und-drang of a woman’s dresser before a big night out – spilled
face powder and perfumed soaps rustling in their scented papers - then
you’d be right.
But that’s only half of the story. Innuendo is full of twists
and turns that take you from the jet fuel thrust of rose chypres to
soft, musky body powders and then finally to a sweet, almost soapy tonka
and sandalwood drydown that feels 180 degrees removed from the opening
act.
Innuendo more than lives up to its name. There is something
sexy-- forbidden almost-- about being privy to a woman’s intimate
grooming rituals. Innuendo allows us a peek at it, from the soaping of
flesh to the powdering of the nose and finally, to the generous spraying
of a lush, 80’s-style power chypre dripping with moss, patchouli, and
roses. For those actively looking for something a little old-fashioned
and a little sexy at the same time, look no further.
Innuendo Pour Femme  Notes
Bergamot, lemon, orange, jasmine, rose, violet, ylang ylang, labdanum, musk, orris, patchouli, sandalwood, tonka bean

name: Roja Parfums Musk Aoud Crystal Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Roja Musk Aoud Crystal is a powdery blend of rose, musk, leather and oud.
Roja Dove created it in 2013. Bergamot and lemon open bright, rose, jasmine and ylang-ylang form a floral heart, and musk, oud, leather, ambrette, birch, precious woods, tonka bean, vanilla, oakmoss and sandalwood give it a smooth finish.
Luxurious and refined, it works day or night in fall and winter.

Musk Aoud Crystal by Roja Dove is a Chypre Floral fragrance for women and men. Top notes are bergamot and lemon; middle notes are jasmine, rose and ylang-ylang; base notes are agarwood (oud), ambrette (musk mallow), birch, leather, musk, nutmeg, oakmoss, precious woods, sandalwood, tonka bean and vanilla.

name: Roja Parfums Musk Aoud Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Roja Musk Aoud is a smooth blend of rose, musk and oud.
Bergamot and lemon open bright, rose, jasmine and ylang-ylang form a soft floral heart, and musk, oud, leather, ambrette, birch, precious woods, tonka bean, vanilla, nutmeg and sandalwood give it a warm, powdery finish.
Elegant and sensual, it works day or night in fall and winter.

name: Roja Parfums NuWa Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Roja NüWa is a rich floral with rose, osmanthus and immortelle.
Roja Dove created it in 2014. Lemon and bergamot open bright, rose, ylang-ylang, osmanthus, jasmine, immortelle and currant buds form a lush heart, and cumin, birch, ambergris, oakmoss, vetiver, labdanum, orris root and styrax give it a deep finish.
Opulent and distinctive, it works day or night in spring and fall.

“Inspired by the legend of Nüwa, the gentle and kindly Chinese goddess, who is said to have created woman and man; and according to the myth she taught her people to be creative and wise, introduced beauty through music, song and dance, and filled the field flowers with fragrance. This tender liquid narrative will seduce the soul.” - a note from the brand.
Nüwa was launched in 2014.

name: Roja Parfums Oceania Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Roja Parfums Oceania is a bright, sparkling citrus with herbs, florals and soft woods.
Roja Dove created it in 2019. Lavender, grapefruit, mandarin, lemon, bergamot, lime, rosemary and thyme open fresh, violet, geranium, ylang-ylang and jasmine form the heart, and musk, cedar, moss, iris, vetiver, sandalwood and vanilla give it a smooth finish.
Fresh and luxurious, it is a great everyday scent.

name: Roja Parfums Parfum de La Nuit No 1 Pure Perfume Unisex

notes.source_text:

name: Roja Parfums Qatar Parfum Unisex

Luxurious and warm, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

name: Roja Parfums Reckless Pour Femme Essence de Parfum for women

notes.source_text:
Roja Reckless Pour Femme is a bright floral with citrus, jasmine and vanilla.
Launched in 2021, it opens with mandarin, orange and bergamot. Jasmine, neroli, May rose and geranium form a floral heart, and vanilla, musk, benzoin, cinnamon, sandalwood and pink pepper give it a warm, powdery finish.
Radiant and elegant, it is a great daytime scent from spring through fall.

name: Roja Parfums Reckless Pour Femme Parfum for Women

Roja Dove created it in 2011. Aldehydes, bergamot, citrus and tarragon open bright, jasmine, ylang-ylang, peach, rose, violet and geranium form a rich heart, and oakmoss, musk, tonka bean, leather, sandalwood and orris root give it a warm finish.
Elegant and timeless, it is a great daytime scent in spring, fall and winter.

Reckless by Roja Dove is a Amber Floral fragrance for women. Reckless
was launched in 2011. The nose behind this fragrance is Roja Dove. Top
notes are Aldehydes, Bergamot, Citruses and Tarragon; middle notes are
Jasmine, Ylang-Ylang, Peach, Rose, Violet, Geranium and Amaryllis; base
notes are oak moss, Musk, Tonka Bean, Leather, Sandalwood, Orris Root,
Vetiver, Castoreum, Cinnamon and Clove.

name: Roja Parfums Risque Pour Femme Essence de Parfum for Women

Roja Risqué Pour Femme Essence de Parfum is a mossy floral with peach, hyacinth and vetiver.

Elegant and fresh, it is a great daytime scent in spring, fall and winter.

name: Roja Parfums Risque Pour Femme Parfum for Women

Hyacinth, Rose, Jasmine and Ylang-Ylang; base notes are Oakmoss, Civet,
Patchouli, Vetiver, Labdanum and Cedar.

name: Roja Parfums Scandal Pour Femme Essence de Parfum For Women

notes.source_text:
Roja Scandal Pour Femme Essence de Parfum is a lush white floral with gardenia and tuberose.
Launched in 2021, it opens with bergamot. Gardenia, freesia, jasmine, orange blossom, tuberose, lily-of-the-valley and May rose form a rich heart, and orris, sandalwood and musk give it a powdery finish.
Radiant and elegant, it is made for spring and summer days.

Roja Scandal Pour Femme is a rich white floral with tuberose, gardenia and orris.
