name: Roja Parfums Scandal Pour Homme Parfum Cologne for Men

notes.source_text:
Roja Parfums Scandal Pour Homme is a fresh, aromatic blend of citrus, herbs and woods.
Roja Dove created it in 2019. Lemon, lavender, mint, tarragon, petitgrain, bergamot and basil open crisp, lily-of-the-valley, jasmine, violet and rose form a soft heart, and moss, ambergris, patchouli, vetiver, tonka bean, cedar and sandalwood give it depth.
Refined and clean, it is a great daytime scent for spring and fall.

“When a scandal hits, heads turn and secrets unravel. Everything is exposed as barriers are pushed and limits are tested. You either hide, or embrace it. A true head-turner, Scandal opens with an exciting burst of Lemon, Spearmint and Lavender, which flirts with an unusual Rhubarb note spread across a rich and sensual bed woven around the indulgent nuances of Tonka Bean. Tempted to do something which causes a scandal, it ensures you are talked about.” - a note from the brand.

name: Roja Parfums Scandal Pour Homme Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Roja Scandal Pour Homme is a fresh, aromatic blend of herbs, citrus and oakmoss.
Roja Dove created it in 2011. Lemon, lavender, bergamot, petitgrain, tarragon, basil and mint open fresh, lily-of-the-valley, jasmine, May rose and violet form the heart, and oakmoss, ambergris, musk, clove, cardamom, vetiver and sandalwood give it a woody finish.
Classic and refined, it is a great daytime scent from spring through fall.

Scandal Pour Homme by Roja Dove is a Aromatic Fougere fragrance for men. Scandal Pour Homme was launched in 2011. The nose behind this fragrance is Roja Dove. Top notes are bergamot, lemon, basil, petitgrain, lavender, mint and tarragon; middle notes are jasmine, violet, lily-of-the-valley and may rose; base notes are cardamom, cashmere wood, cedar, cloves, oakmoss, nutmeg, patchouli, rhubarb, sandalwood, vetiver, ambergris, labdanum, musk and tonka bean.

name: Roja Parfums Serenity Blend Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Roja Serenity Blend is a calm, fresh blend of tea, clary sage and magnolia.
Launched in 2026, it opens with bergamot, lemon and tea. Clary sage, jasmine, magnolia, rhubarb, violet, chamomile and gardenia form a soft heart, and tea, maté, ginger, tonka bean, cardamom, vanilla, sandalwood and musk give it a smooth finish.
Serene and light, it is made for spring and summer days.

name: Roja Parfums Sultanate of Oman Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:

Opulent and intense, it works day or night in fall and winter.

name: Roja Parfums Sweetie Aoud Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Roja Parfums Sweetie Aoud is a smooth, aromatic oud with rose and warm resins.
Roja Dove created it in 2015. Artemisia and bergamot open herbal and fresh, rose forms a soft heart, and cardamom, oud, olibanum, juniper, patchouli, labdanum, guaiac wood, cumin and cedar give it a rich, woody finish.
Warm and sophisticated, it is great for date nights in fall and winter.

Sweetie Aoud by Roja Dove is a Oriental Floral fragrance for women and men. Sweetie Aoud was launched in 2015. The nose behind this fragrance is Roja Dove. Top notes are artemisia and bergamot; middle note is rose; base notes are amyris, agarwood (oud), cardamom, cedar, labdanum, cumin, cypriol oil or nagarmotha, olibanum, guaiac wood, gurjan balsam, juniper, patchouli and spanish labdanum.

name: Roja Parfums Taif Aoud Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Roja Taif Aoud is a fresh, rich blend of Taif rose, cassis and oud.
Roja Dove created it in 2023. Bergamot and aldehydes open bright, ylang-ylang, clove, cassis, geranium, jasmine and Taif rose form a lush heart, and labdanum, vanilla, oud, benzoin, patchouli, musk and incense give it a warm finish.
Elegant and versatile, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

name: Roja Parfums Ti Amo Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Roja Ti Amo is a warm, powdery blend of florals, cacao and spice.
Roja Dove created it in 2016. Mandarin and bergamot open bright, heliotrope, ylang-ylang, pineapple, orange blossom, jasmine and rose form a lush heart, and cacao, orris root, tonka bean, vanilla, sandalwood, cinnamon and saffron give it a rich finish.
Romantic and opulent, it is perfect for date nights in fall.

A soft, sensual base of Vanilla, Cocoa, and Tonka Bean mingle with
leather-like Labdanum and Cistus, Ambergris, and Musk, warmed by
Patchouli, Vetiver, Guaiacwood and Sandalwood, enlivened by Ginger, Pink
Pepper, Saffron, Cinnamon and Cumin, sublimated by a bouquet of Lily of
the Valley, Rose, Neroli, Orange Blossom, Jasmine, Ylang Ylang and
Heliotrope, further sweetened by fruity Pineapple, the whole freshened
by citrus Bergamot, Mandarin, and leafy Galbanum, nestling on a powdery
base of Carrot Seed and Orris.
Top Notes: Bergamot, Mandarin
Heart Notes: Lily of the Valley, Rose, Neroli, Orange Blossom, Jasmine, Ylang Ylang, Cistus, Heliotrope, Pineapple
Base
Notes: Galbanum, Ginger, Pink Pepper, Cinnamon, Cumin, Saffron,
Patchouli, Vetiver, Guaiacwood, Sandalwood, Vanilla, Cocoa, Tonka Bean,
Carrot Seed, Orris, Labdanum, Ambergris, Musk

name: Roja Parfums Un Amore Eterno Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Roja Un Amore Eterno is a warm, powdery blend of florals, cacao and coffee.
Roja Dove created it in 2016. Lemon opens bright, heliotrope, violet, tuberose, rose and jasmine form a soft heart, and cacao, coffee, orris root, cashmeran, ambergris, ginger, vanilla and saffron give it a rich finish.
Romantic and cozy, it is great for date nights and outings in spring, fall and winter.

Lemon adds its brightness to a blend of Rose, Jasmine, Tuberose,
Heliotrope, and Violet, enlivened by Ginger, Clove, and Saffron, warmed
by Patchouli, Cedar and Casmir Woods, softened by Vanilla, Coffee, and
Cocoa, the whole made powdery through the inclusion of precious Orris,
with Ambergris and Musk adding their sensuality.
Top Notes: Lemon
Heart Notes: Rose, Jasmine, Tuberose, Heliotrope, Violet
Base Notes: Ginger, Clove, Saffron, Patchouli, Cedarwood, Casmir Wood, Coffee, Vanilla, Cocoa, Orris, Ambergris, Musk

name: Roja Parfums United Arab Emirates Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:

Opulent and bold, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

name: Roja Parfums Vetiver Pour Homme Parfum Cologne for Men

notes.source_text:
Roja Parfums Vetiver Pour Homme is a crisp, green vetiver with fresh citrus and spice.
Roja Dove created it in 2019. Bergamot and lemon open bright, jasmine, rose and labdanum form a smooth heart, and vetiver, cedar, oakmoss, galbanum, caraway, pink pepper, guaiac wood and nutmeg give it an earthy, aromatic finish.
Clean and elegant, it is made for spring and summer days.

“There is no material in perfumery quite like Vetiver – it is at once earthy, smoky and leathery all in perfect harmony. Sophisticated and incredibly versatile, those who wear it are confident and self-assured – a presence in any room. Vibrant Citrus notes create a lively freshness around the dry warmth of Vetiver, whilst both Cedar Wood and Needles, and Oakmoss add heat and complexity. Everybody wants to be near him. It is the ultimate example of how a modern man should smell. The Vetiver wearer doesn’t provoke envy but instead, adoration.” - a note from the brand.

name: Roja Parfums Vetiver Pour Homme Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Roja Vetiver Pour Homme is an earthy, aromatic blend of vetiver, oakmoss and spice.
Roja Dove created it in 2012. Bergamot and lemon open bright, labdanum, rose de mai and jasmine form the heart, and vetiver, oakmoss, galbanum, cedar, nutmeg, celery seed, caraway, pepper and guaiac wood give it a green, woody finish.
Refined and natural, it is a great daytime scent in spring and fall.

Rojas Vetiver Pour Homme is a Masculine fragrance, The fragrance launched in 2012, The nose behind this fragrance is Roja Dove,
Top Note: Bergamot, Lemon
Heart Note: Labdanum, Rose de Mai, Jasmine
Base Note: Vetiver, Oakmoss, Labdanum, Galbanum, Cedar, Cedar Needles, Nutmeg, Celery Seeds, Caraway, Pink Pepper, Pepper, Guaiac Wood, Amyris

Graceful and cozy, it is a lovely daytime scent in spring and fall.

name: Royal Crown Oud Jasmine Extrait de Parfum Unisex

Heart Notes: Rose, Ylang-ylang, Rosemary
Base Notes: Algae absolute, Patchouli, Mysore sandalwood

name: Royal Crown Sultan Extrait de Parfum Unisex

name: Royal Crown Upper Class Extrait de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Royal Crown Upper Class is a sweet, woody blend of raspberry, leather and iris.

name: Royal Crown Ytzma Extrait de Parfum Unisex

name: Rue Broca Pride Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Rue Broca Pride is a woody, mossy blend of apple, lavender and sandalwood.
Launched in 2015, it opens with apple, lavender and geranium. Sandalwood, patchouli and amber form a smooth heart, and musk, oakmoss and cedar give it an earthy, powdery finish.
Classic and easy, it is a great everyday scent.

name: Rue Broca Theoreme Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Rue Broca Théorème is a fresh, woody blend of citrus, amber and spice.
Launched in 2022, it opens with bright citrus. Amber and woods form a warm heart, and spices, musk and patchouli give it a smooth finish.
Fresh and easy, it is a great everyday scent.

name: Rue Broca Touche Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Rue Broca Touché is a warm blend of apple, cinnamon and vanilla.
Launched in 2019, it opens with bergamot, cinnamon and apple. White flowers form a soft heart, and patchouli, amber, vanilla and tonka bean give it a sweet finish.
Cozy and easy, it is a great everyday scent.

name: Serge Lutens Ambre Sultan Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Serge Lutens Ambre Sultan is a rich, herbal amber with resins and spice.
Christopher Sheldrake created it in 2000. Resins, amber, bay leaf, myrrh, benzoin, sandalwood and vanilla blend with coriander, oregano, patchouli and myrtle for a warm, aromatic and deeply resinous scent.
Made for fall and winter, day or night.

name: Serge Lutens Arabie Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Serge Lutens Arabie is a rich, spicy blend of dates, dried fruits and myrrh.
Christopher Sheldrake created it in 2000. Dried fruits, clove, dates, nutmeg, caraway, bay leaf and mandarin open spicy and sweet, and myrrh, benzoin, fig, resin, sandalwood, tonka bean and cedar give it a warm, resinous depth.
Exotic and cozy, it is great for outings in fall and winter.

Many of the Serge Lutens fragrances were inspired by journeys around Middle East. Arabie
was inspired by eastern spice shops; it is an exquisitely warm spicy
fragrance, dense and sweet from aromatic resins, temperamental, sunny,
yet mysterious like East itself. Precious notes of cedar and sandal
blend in with sweet notes of candied mandarin, dried fig and date.
Nutmeg, cumin and clove at the heart pervade the composition with hot
spicy notes. Aromatic bay-leaf, harsh and pleasant, joins the spices,
dwelling in dense resin waves of Tonka, Siamese benzoina and myrrh. The
final accord of labdanum joins aromatic opulence into a harmonic
wholeness.

name: Serge Lutens Bapteme Du Feu Eau de Parfum Unisex

Christopher Sheldrake created it in 2016. Tangerine, gingerbread, woods, castoreum, powdery notes and osmanthus come together in a sweet, fruity and gently smoky scent.
Cozy and festive, it works day or night in fall and winter.

Baptême du Feu by Serge Lutens is a Oriental fragrance for women and men. Baptême du Feu was launched in 2016. The nose behind this fragrance is Christopher Sheldrake.

name: Serge Lutens Borneo 1834 Eau de Parfum Unisex

name: Serge Lutens Clair de Musc Eau de Parfum Unisex

name: Serge Lutens Cuir Mauresque Eau de Parfum Unisex

name: Sisley Eau du Soir Eau de Parfum for Women

Eau Du Soir Perfume by Sisley, This fragrance was created by the house
of Sisley with perfumer Jeannine Mongin and released in 1990.
This perfume has become a
timeless treasure. A sophisticated spicy floral scent that will
brighten up any day or evening. It is a rich blend of notes that create
this irresistible sexy perfume. Seduction in a bottle. The top notes are
mandarin, spruce, grapefruit and carnation. The heart notes are
jasmine, lily of the valley, French labdanum, oak moss,
lilac, pepper, rose, juniper and Spanish seringo. The finishing notes are ambergris, patchouli and musk

Stella McCartney is relaunching her first fragrance, Stella,
from 2003, whose composition remains unchanged while changes occurred in

Cozy and romantic, it is made for fall and winter, day or night.

name: Tiziana Terenzi Dionisio Extrait de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:

Paolo Terenzi created it in 2018. Madagascar and Tahitian vanilla meet ambergris, oud, musk, jasmine and lily-of-the-valley for a smooth, warm and sensual scent.
Indulgent and long-lasting, it is made for fall and winter, day or night.

Dionisio by Tiziana Terenzi is a Oriental Vanilla fragrance for women and men. Dionisio was launched in 2018. The nose behind this fragrance is Paolo Terenzi.

name: Tiziana Terenzi Draco Extrait de Parfum Unisex

Paolo Terenzi created it in 2015. Bergamot, lemon, orange and green notes open fresh, peach, magnolia, jasmine, cedar and patchouli form the heart, and musk, pear, vanilla, tonka bean and heliotrope give it a sweet finish.
Gentle and charming, it is a lovely daytime scent in spring and fall.

Draco by Tiziana Terenzi is a Oriental fragrance for women and men. Draco
was launched in 2015. The nose behind this fragrance is Paolo Terenzi.
Top notes are Bergamot, Lemon, Orange and Green Notes; middle notes are
Peach, Magnolia, Jasmine, Cedar and Patchouli; base notes are Musk,
Pear, Vanilla, Tonka Bean and Heliotrope.

name: Tiziana Terenzi Draconis Extrait de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Tiziana Terenzi Draconis is a fresh, earthy blend of citrus, pepper and vetiver.
Paolo Terenzi created it in 2019. Lemon, grapefruit and bergamot open bright, pepper and geranium form an aromatic heart, and vetiver, patchouli, olibanum and amber give it an earthy finish.
Clean and grounded, it is made for spring and summer days.

name: Tiziana Terenzi Eclix Extrait de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Tiziana Terenzi Eclix is a soft, powdery blend of iris, almond and violet.
Paolo Terenzi created it in 2017. Iris, almond, lemon, tangerine and Tahitian vanilla open soft, violet, white lily and petitgrain form a floral heart, and orris root, sandalwood, cedar, amber and musk give it a smooth finish.
Elegant and gentle, it works day or night in fall and winter.

Eclix by Tiziana Terenzi is a Floral Woody Musk fragrance for women and men. Eclix

middle notes are Lemon, Violet, White Lily and Petitgrain; base notes

name: Tiziana Terenzi Ecstasy Extrait de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Tiziana Terenzi Ecstasy is a smoky, resinous blend of spruce, pine and incense.
Paolo Terenzi created it in 2012. Spruce, pine and a mineral pebble accord open fresh, incense, rose, patchouli and violet form a smoky heart, and amber, woods, labdanum, sandalwood and tonka bean give it a warm finish.
Deep and atmospheric, it is made for fall and winter nights.

Ecstasy by Tiziana Terenzi is a Amber Woody fragrance for women and men. Ecstasy

Top notes are Spruce, Pine Tree and Pebbles; middle notes are Incense,

name: Tiziana Terenzi Foconero Extrait de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Tiziana Terenzi Foconero is a fresh, aromatic blend of lime, juniper and salt.
Paolo Terenzi created it in 2017. Lime, juniper, Italian lemon, lavender, bergamot and thyme open crisp, salt, ozonic notes, cardamom, ylang-ylang, hyacinth and lily-of-the-valley form a breezy heart, and oakmoss, cedar, sandalwood and patchouli give it a woody finish.
Clean and lively, it is made for spring and summer days.

name: Tiziana Terenzi Gold Rose Oudh Extrait de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Tiziana Terenzi Gold Rose Oudh is a rich blend of rose, honey and oud.
Paolo Terenzi created it in 2012. Fir, a sand accord and bergamot open fresh, rose, patchouli and black pepper form a spicy floral heart, and oud, honey, amber, musk and sandalwood give it a warm finish.
Opulent and versatile, it works day or night in fall and winter.

Gold Rose Oudh symbolizes Fire in a desert camp. It depicts charm, mystery and sensual spicy notes of a night in wilderness.
Top notes: bergamot, fir, ember, sand. Heart: rose, patchouli, black pepper. Base: oud, amber, sandalwood, musk, honey.

name: Tiziana Terenzi Gumin Extrait de Parfum Unisex

Paolo Terenzi created it in 2016. Mandarin, pineapple, orange and bergamot open juicy, ozonic notes, violet, amber, jasmine and rose form an airy heart, and sandalwood, musk, birch and oud give it a woody finish.
Bright and cheerful, it is made for spring and summer days.

Gumin by Tiziana Terenzi is a fragrance for women and men. Gumin

Top notes are Mandarin Orange, Pineapple, Orange and Bergamot; middle

name: Tiziana Terenzi Hale Bopp Extrait de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:

Paolo Terenzi created it in 2019. Nutmeg, cinnamon and lemon open spicy, vanilla, geranium, patchouli and sage form an aromatic heart, and amber, labdanum, sandalwood and musk give it a warm finish.

name: Tiziana Terenzi Halley Extrait de Parfum Unisex

Tiziana Terenzi Halley is a juicy, fruity blend of passionfruit, cassis and raspberry.
Paolo Terenzi created it in 2019. Passionfruit, cassis, rose and lemon open bright, peach, raspberry, green and floral notes and cinnamon form the heart, and musk, vanilla, woods and amber give it a soft finish.
Cheerful and playful, it works day or night from spring through fall.

name: Tiziana Terenzi Hyakutake Extrait de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:

Paolo Terenzi created it in 2023. Lemon, cardamom, eucalyptus and bergamot open fresh, orris, ambergris, incense and pansy form a soft heart, and tobacco, Australian sandalwood, musk, Haitian vetiver and larch give it a woody finish.
Distinctive and smooth, it works day or night.

name: Tiziana Terenzi Kaff Extrait de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Tiziana Terenzi Kaff is a powdery, woody blend of juniper, iris and leather.
Paolo Terenzi created it in 2017. Juniper, white iris, pink pepper, ginger and bergamot open fresh, leather, iris, orris root, ambergris and magnolia form a soft heart, and vetiver, cedar, sandalwood and tonka bean give it an earthy finish.

was launched in 2017. The nose behind this fragrance is Paolo Terenzi.
Top notes are Juniper, White Iris, Pink Pepper, Ginger and Bergamot;
middle notes are Leather, iris, Orris Root, Ambergris and Magnolia; base

name: Tiziana Terenzi Kirke Extrait de Parfum Unisex

Paolo Terenzi created it in 2015. Peach, pear, cassis, raspberry, passionfruit and a sandy accord open bright and sweet, lily-of-the-valley adds a fresh floral touch, and vanilla, sandalwood, heliotrope, patchouli and musk give it a soft finish.
Cheerful and long-lasting, it is a lovely daytime scent from spring through fall.

Kirke by Tiziana Terenzi is a Chypre Fruity fragrance for women and men. Kirke was launched in 2015. The nose behind this fragrance is Paolo Terenzi. Top notes are passionfruit, peach, raspberry, cassis, pear and sand; middle note is lily-of-the-valley; base notes are heliotrope, sandalwood, vanilla, patchouli and musk.

name: Tiziana Terenzi Kirke Overdose Extrait de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:

Paolo Terenzi created it in 2025. Bulgarian rose, peach, raspberry and passionfruit open juicy, jasmine sambac, a sand accord, gardenia, lily-of-the-valley and black currant form a lush heart, and patchouli, heliotrope, ambergris, musk, vanilla and sandalwood give it a warm finish.
Bold and sweet, it works year-round, day or night.

Tiziana Terenzi Laudano Nero is a dark, smoky blend of cognac, tobacco and incense.

and men. Laudano Nero was launched in 2014. The nose behind this
fragrance is Paolo Terenzi. Top notes are wormwood, cognac, rosemary,
tobacco, myrtle and amber; middle notes are red rose, black locust

cashmere musk, laurels, incense, camphor, agarwood (oud), vetiver, musk,
oak, vanilla and labdanum.

name: Tiziana Terenzi Leo Extrait de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:

Paolo Terenzi created it in 2022. Sicilian mandarin, Brazilian orange, kumquat and bergamot open sunny, ambergris, myrrh, violet leaves, magnolia, Bulgarian rose and jasmine sambac form a rich heart, and musk, tonka bean, cedar, oak, sandalwood and benzoin give it a warm finish.
Radiant and refined, it is a great everyday scent.

name: Tiziana Terenzi Libra Extrait de Parfum Unisex

Elegant and versatile, it is a great everyday scent.

Distinctive and refined, it is a great daytime scent in spring, fall and winter.

Tonka Bean, Tobacco, Birch, Patchouli and White Musk.

Soft and dreamy, it is a lovely spring daytime scent.

Top notes are bergamot, grass, ylang-ylang and water jasmine; middle notes are lily, violet leaf, damask rose, pear blossom, white heliotrope and peach; base notes are coconut, amber, vanilla, cashmere wood, ebony, tonka bean and sugar.

middle notes are Honey, Persimmon, Agarwood (Oud), Cumin, iris and

Rosewood and Labdanum.

Elegant and fresh, it is a lovely everyday scent.

Playful and versatile, it works year-round, day or night.

Cheerful and versatile, it works year-round, day or night.

Bulgarian Rose, Incense, Patchouli and Poppy; base notes are Myrrh,
Musk, Amber, Benzoin and Chestnut.

Elegant and fresh, it is a lovely everyday scent.

Light and elegant, it is a great daytime scent from spring through fall.

Rose; middle notes are Floral Notes, Green Notes, Passionfruit, iris and
Cedar; base notes are Vanilla, Amber, Musk, Patchouli and Vetiver.

Base Note: White Musk, Leather, Sandalwood, Birch, Patchouli

Notes, Sand and Coconut; base notes are Cotton Candy, Musk, Amber, Woody
Notes and Vanilla.

Unusual and versatile, it works year-round, day or night.

Top notes are Green Leaves, Mango, Passionfruit, Fir and Red Currant;
middle notes are Heliotrope, Ylang-Ylang, Hyacinth, Jasmine and Rose; base notes are Papaya, Vanilla, Musk,
Princess Tree or Paulownia, Amber and Allspice.

name: Tiziana Terenzi White Fire Extrait de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Tiziana Terenzi White Fire is a fresh, watery white floral with jasmine and fern.
Paolo Terenzi created it in 2012. Watery notes and green leaves open fresh, Chinese jasmine, fern and white amber form a clean heart, and musk, amber and sandalwood give it a soft, powdery finish.
Light and serene, it is made for spring and summer days.

White Fire by Tiziana Terenzi is a Woody Aquatic fragrance for women and men. White Fire
was launched in 2012. The nose behind this fragrance is Paolo Terenzi.
Top notes are Watery Notes and Green Leaves; middle notes are Chinese
Jasmine, Fern and White Amber; base notes are Musk, Amber and
Sandalwood.

name: Tiziana Terenzi Wirtaner Extrait de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Tiziana Terenzi Wirtaner is a spicy rose with oud, peony and caramel.
Paolo Terenzi created it in 2019. Rose, ylang-ylang and bergamot open bright, oud, pepper, peony and jasmine form a spicy heart, and sandalwood, caramel, vanilla and amber give it a warm finish.
Opulent and versatile, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

name: Tiziana Terenzi XIX March Extrait de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Tiziana Terenzi XIX March is a green, aromatic blend of nettle, mint and lavender.
Paolo Terenzi created it in 2012. Green leaves, nettle, mint and orange open fresh, lavender, jasmine, clove and cinnamon form a spicy heart, and rosemary, vetiver, musk, sandalwood and cedar give it a woody finish.
Fresh and natural, it is made for spring and summer days.

XIX March by Tiziana Terenzi is a Woody Aromatic fragrance for women and men. XIX March
was launched in 2012. The nose behind this fragrance is Paolo Terenzi.
Top notes are Green Leaves, Nettle, Mint and Orange; middle notes are
Lavender, Jasmine, Clove and Cinnamon; base notes are Rosemary, Vetiver,
Musk, Sandalwood, Nutmeg and Cedar.

name: TOCCA Cleopatra Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Tocca Cleopatra is a fruity, musky floral with grapefruit, peach and tuberose.
Launched in 2007, it opens with grapefruit, black currant, green notes and cassis. Jasmine, peach and tuberose form a lush heart, and musk, patchouli, amber and vanilla give it a warm finish.
Sensual and pretty, it is great for outings and the office in spring and fall.

Cleopatra, the iconic seductress, commanded ships and the hearts of men
in equal measure. Her fragrance memorably combines some of her personal
favorites, including enticing grapefruit, luxuriant Egyptian jasmine,
and rich Indian patchouli.
The bottle is inspired by the beauty
of antique crystal and the whimsical shape of Cinderella’s pumpkin
carriage. The decorated metal cap is hand finished, so no two are the
same. The brand motto "Love yourself" is a hidden message found on each
product.
Fragrance Family:
Floral
Scent Type:
Warm Florals
Key Notes:
Amber, Jasmine, Patchouli, Tuberose

name: TOCCA Florence Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Tocca Florence is a fresh, fruity white floral with pear, gardenia and tuberose.
Ellen Molner created it in 2006. Pear, apple, bergamot and grapefruit leaf open crisp, gardenia, tuberose, jasmine, violet leaf and iris form a lush heart, and musk and white woods give it a soft finish.
Pretty and feminine, it is great for everyday wear and outings in spring and summer.

Like her modern classic fragrance, Florence is quintessentially French.
A sophisticated green garden floral with a perfectly manicured bouquet
of gardenia, tuberose, and iris in her secret heart, Florence makes us
fall in love with Paris, the city of love, again.
Fragrance Family:
Floral
Scent Type:
Classic Florals
Key Notes:
Gardenia, Tuberose, Iris

name: TOCCA Maya Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Tocca Maya is a woody floral with black currant, iris and patchouli.
Launched in 2018, it opens with black currant and violet leaf. Iris flower, jasmine and Damask rose form a powdery heart, and patchouli, sandalwood and oakmoss give it an earthy finish.
Elegant and versatile, it is great for everyday wear and the office in spring and fall.

Distinctive and confident, Maya exudes strength of character with a rare
joining of wild iris, sweet violet leaf, and black currant. The scent
is cocooned in elegance as rose damascena and jasmine wrapped with
patchouli heart and oakmoss, creating the ultimate expression of
thoughtfulness in beauty.
The bottle is inspired by the beauty
of antique crystal and the whimsical shape of Cinderella’s pumpkin
carriage. The decorated metal cap is hand finished—no two are the same.
The brand motto "Love yourself" is a hidden message found on each
product.
Fragrance Family:
Floral
Scent Type:
Warm Floral
Key Notes:
Wild Iris, Blackcurrant, Patchouli Heart

name: TOCCA Stella Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Tocca Stella is a sparkling blend of blood orange, lily and orchid.
Launched in 2006, it opens with blood orange, bitter orange and watery notes. Lily, freesia and wild orchid form a fresh floral heart, and sandalwood and musk give it a soft finish.
Bright and cheerful, it is great for everyday wear and outings in spring and summer.

Young and beguiling, breezy and bright, Stella’s fragrance echoes her
sweet, spontaneous charm with a lavish Italian citrus that weaves in and
out of a flirtatious floral heart. Wear generously and live life
Italian style.
The bottle is inspired by the beauty of antique
crystal and the whimsical shape of Cinderella’s pumpkin carriage. The
decorated metal cap is hand finished, no two are the same. The brand
motto "Love yourself" is a hidden message found on each product.
Fragrance Family:
Fresh
Scent Type:
Fresh Florals
Key Notes:
Freesia, Lily, Orchid

name: Tom Daxon Crushing Bloom Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Tom Daxon Crushing Bloom is a bright white floral with citrus, orange blossom and oakmoss.
Launched in 2019, it opens with mandarin and bergamot. Orange blossom and jasmine form a lush heart, and amber, oakmoss, patchouli and woods give it a warm finish.
Elegant and radiant, it is a lovely everyday scent.

name: Tom Daxon Midnight Saffron Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Tom Daxon Midnight Saffron is a powdery floral with pepper, rose and iris.
Launched in 2013, it opens with lily-of-the-valley, pink pepper, cardamom and black pepper. Rose, iris and jasmine form a soft heart, and oakmoss, vetiver and musk give it an earthy finish.
Refined and calm, it is a lovely everyday scent.

name: Tom Daxon VSOP Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Tom Daxon VSOP is a spicy, woody blend of cognac, ginger and vetiver.
Launched in 2013, it opens with bergamot, cognac and geranium. Elemi, black pepper, ginger, pink pepper and cinnamon form a spicy heart, and vetiver, cashmeran, musk and sandalwood give it a smooth finish.
Refined and warm, it is a great everyday and evening scent.

name: Tom Ford Amber Intrigue Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Tom Ford Amber Intrigue is a warm blend of dates, cinnamon and amber.
Julien Rasquinet and Pascal Gaurin created it in 2024. Dates, cinnamon and olibanum open sweet and spicy, sandalwood and vetiver form a woody heart, and amber and labdanum give it a rich finish.
Cozy and seductive, it is made for fall and winter nights.

name: Tom Ford Azure Lime Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Tom Ford Azure Lime is a fresh, musky blend of citrus, buchu and sandalwood.
Antoine Lie and Ellen Molner created it in 2010. Citrus, buchu, florals, musk, woods and sandalwood come together in a clean, aromatic and gently woody scent.
Crisp and easy, it is made for spring and summer days.

name: Tom Ford Beau de Jour Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Tom Ford Beau de Jour is a refined, classic lavender fougère.
Launched in 2019, it opens with lavender. Rosemary, oakmoss, mint, basil and geranium form a green, aromatic heart, and patchouli and amber give it a warm finish.
Polished and versatile in every season, day or night.

Beau De Jour Eau de Parfum by Tom Ford is a Aromatic Fougere fragrance for men. This is a new fragrance. Beau De Jour Eau de Parfum was launched in 2020. Top notes are lavender extract and lavender; middle notes are rosemary, geranium, mint, oakmoss and basil; base notes are patchouli and amber.

name: Tom Ford Bitter Peach Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Tom Ford Bitter Peach is a juicy, boozy peach with rum, cognac and warm woods.
Launched in 2020, it opens with peach, blood orange, cardamom and heliotrope. Rum, cognac, davana and jasmine form a rich heart, and patchouli, sandalwood, vanilla, tonka bean, cashmeran, benzoin and vetiver give it a sensual finish.
Lush and seductive, it is a lovely daytime scent from spring through fall.

Bitter Peach by Tom Ford is a Oriental Vanilla fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Bitter Peach
was launched in 2020. Top notes are Peach, Blood Orange, Cardamom and
Heliotrope; middle notes are Rum, Cognac, Davana and Jasmine; base notes
are Indonesian Patchouli Leaf, Sandalwood, Vanilla, Tonka Bean,
Cashmeran, Benzoin, Labdanum, Styrax and Vetiver.

name: Tom Ford Black Lacquer Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Tom Ford Black Lacquer is a dark, modern blend of ink, vinyl, rum and black pepper.
Launched in 2024, it opens with ink, vinyl, rum and black pepper. Ebony wood, peony, elemi and apricot form the heart, and olibanum gives it a smoky, resinous finish.
Edgy and distinctive, it works year-round, day or night.

name: Tom Ford Black Orchid Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Tom Ford Black Orchid is a dark, luxurious blend of black truffle, orchid and chocolate.
Launched in 2006, it opens with truffle, gardenia, black currant, ylang-ylang and citrus. Orchid, spices and lotus form the heart, and Mexican chocolate, patchouli, vanilla, incense and sandalwood give it a rich finish.
Made for fall and winter nights and date nights.

Iconic. Elusive. Seductive. A luxurious and sensual fragrance of
rich, dark accords and an alluring potion of black orchids and spice,
TOM FORD's Black Orchid is both modern and timeless. Bottled in fluted,
black-glass, Black Orchid makes an unforgettable statement of iconic
style and worldly glamour.
"Black Orchid is a rich blend of spice and darkness to revolve
around you, to be closer, and closer to you. Unleash its perfect power -
both rare and extraordinary."—Tom Ford

name: Tom Ford Black Orchid Eau de Toilette for Women

notes.source_text:
Tom Ford Black Orchid Eau de Toilette is a lighter, darkly floral take on Black Orchid.
Launched in 2015, it opens with black currant, truffle, ylang-ylang and bergamot. Tuberose, black orchid and fruity notes form a rich heart, and vanilla, sandalwood, vetiver, patchouli and incense give it an earthy finish.
Seductive and moody, it is perfect for date nights in fall and winter.

A luxurious and sensual fragrance of rich, dark accords and an alluring

and timeless. Bottled in fluted, black glass, BLACK ORCHID makes an
unforgettable statement of iconic style and worldly glamour.

name: Tom Ford Black Orchid Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Tom Ford Black Orchid Parfum is a deeper, darker take on Black Orchid.
Launched in 2020, it opens with truffle and plum. Ylang-ylang, rum and black orchid form the heart, and patchouli gives it an earthy finish.
Made for fall and winter nights.

Black Orchid is the lavish and luxurious debut of designer Tom Ford
from 2006; the extremely sensual scent of imaginary black orchid,
flowers, spices, chocolate, balsamic notes and black truffle. Very
potent and long-lasting, this fragrance gets its "most powerful version
so far" in the summer of 2020 in the form of the Black Orchid Parfum edition.
Tom Ford Black Orchid Parfum emphasizes the iconic
sensuality of the original and its aphrodisiac effect of the black
orchid with a new, potent seductive accords -  ylang-ylang flower dipped
in golden rum. It offers an enhanced presence of precious essential
oils and reveals the new olfactory dimension of black orchid and
ylang-ylang with accords of black plum, black truffle and patchouli.

name: Tom Ford Black Orchid Reserve Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Tom Ford Black Orchid Reserve is a rich blend of truffle, black orchid and dark chocolate.
Launched in 2025, it opens with bergamot and truffle. Black orchid and ylang-ylang form a lush heart, and dark chocolate, tonka, patchouli and vanilla give it a sweet, warm finish.
Seductive and versatile, it works year-round, day or night.

name: Tom Ford Bois Marocain Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Tom Ford Bois Marocain is a dry, smoky blend of incense, cedar and vetiver.
Shyamala Maisondieu created it in 2009. Incense, Virginia cedar, cypress, thuja, vetiver, pepper, pink pepper, patchouli and bergamot come together in a woody, aromatic and resinous scent.
Refined and moody, it works day or night in fall and winter.

name: Tom Ford Bois Pacifique Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Tom Ford Bois Pacifique is a warm, spiced woody fragrance with iris and vanilla.
Launched in 2024, it opens with cardamom, akigalawood and turmeric. Frankincense, oak, iris, sandalwood and cedar form the heart, and amber and vanilla give it a smooth finish.
Versatile in spring, fall and winter, day or night.

name: Tom Ford Cafe Rose (2023) Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Tom Ford Café Rose (2023) is a warm blend of Turkish rose, coffee and frankincense.
Antoine Lie created it in 2023. Turkish rose and coffee open rich, ylang-ylang, patchouli, cardamom, coriander and Bulgarian rose form a spicy heart, and sandalwood and frankincense give it a smoky finish.
Elegant and warm, it works day or night in fall and winter.

name: Tom Ford Cafe Rose Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Tom Ford Café Rose is a warm, spicy rose with coffee, saffron and incense.
Launched in 2012, it opens with May rose, saffron and black pepper. Turkish and Bulgarian rose and coffee form a rich heart, and patchouli, incense, sandalwood and amber give it a deep, smoky finish.
Elegant and warm, it is perfect for date nights in fall and winter.

Café Rose descends into a hidden labyrinth, where rose's fine breeding gives way to darker pleasures. Three precious rose essences dance with exotic spices and dark coffee. Saffron and black pepper entice the tight blossoms of rose de mai to unfurl. Then, the lush and saturated heart of precious Turkish rose oil and Bulgarian rose absolute creates an enveloping, narcotic haze—until a teasing bite of coffee essence cuts through the romance and awakens dervish passion. Incense resin, amber, sandalwood, and patchouli surround this dance with sensual, creamy depth.
"Turkish rose, Bulgarian rose and coffee essence descend into a hidden labyrinth, where rose’s fine breeding gives way to darker pleasures."—Tom Ford
Notes:
Turkish Rose Oil, Bulgarian Rose Absolute, Coffee Essence, Incense Resin, Sandalwood, Patchouli Oil Fraction.
Style:
Enticing. Exotic. Seductive.

name: Tom Ford Champaca Absolute Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Tom Ford Champaca Absolute is a warm floral with champaca, cognac and marron glacé.
Launched in 2009, it opens with cognac, dyer's greenweed and bergamot. Champaca, orchid, jasmine and violet form a lush floral heart, and marron glacé, vanilla, sandalwood and amber give it a sweet, nutty finish.
Elegant and sensual, it works day or night in spring and fall.

name: Tom Ford Cherry Smoke Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Tom Ford Cherry Smoke is a dark, smoky take on black cherry.
Louise Turner created it in 2022. Bitter almond, liqueur and black cherry open rich, sour cherry, plum, Turkish rose and jasmine sambac form the heart, and tonka bean, vanilla, cinnamon and woods give it a warm finish.
A rich choice for cooler evenings.

name: Tom Ford Costa Azzurra 2021 Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Tom Ford Costa Azzurra is a salty, woody aquatic inspired by the Mediterranean coast.
Launched in 2021, it opens with driftwood, seaweed, cardamom and celery seed. Lemon, cypress, mandarin, lavender, myrtle and artemisia form an aromatic heart, and vetiver, incense, oak, olibanum and vanilla give it depth.
A refined daytime scent for spring and summer.

name: Tom Ford Costa Azzurra 2021 Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Tom Ford Costa Azzurra Parfum is a woody blend of lemon, cypress and labdanum.
Launched in 2022, it opens with Italian lemon. Cypress and oak form a dry, woody heart, and amber and labdanum give it a warm finish.
Refined and aromatic, it is a great everyday scent.

name: Tom Ford Costa Azzurra Acqua Eau de Toilette Unisex

notes.source_text:
Tom Ford Costa Azzurra Acqua is a fresh blend of juniper, cypress and pine.
Launched in 2019, it opens with juniper berries, lemon and myrtle. Cypress and pine needles form a green heart, and mastic, amber and labdanum give it a warm finish.
Breezy and easy, it is great for everyday wear and outings in spring and summer.

This? woody aromatic fragrance with fresh fougère and citrus facets is
cool, salty, and refreshing. Merging cool air and refreshing waters as
one, the salty waves of wind and sea collide with the warmth of the sun
on the body, tempering its pulsating, red-blooded heat. An instant hit
of exhilarating sea air mixes saltiness with the woody macchia of the
beach, a wild tangle of cypress, juniper and myrtle. Like shafts of
sunlight on wet skin, lemon’s citrus breath brightens the crisp earth of
pine cones and needles at the scent’s core. The liquid amber facets of
cistus absolute drip with lentisque resinoid, capturing the denouement
of the Costa Azzurra Acqua experience, when the water that remains pools
on the body’s languid muscles.
Fragrance Family: Earthy & Woody
Scent Type: Citrus & Woods
Key Notes: Juniper Berry, Lemon, Oakwood extract

name: Tom Ford Costa Azzurra Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Tom Ford Costa Azzurra is a salty, woody blend of driftwood, seaweed and cypress.
Launched in 2014, it opens with driftwood, oud, seaweed, cardamom, celery seed and ambrette. Cypress, lemon, mandarin, artemisia, myrtle and lavender form an aromatic heart, and oak, olibanum, incense, vetiver and vanilla give it a smoky finish.
Fresh and refined, it is made for spring and summer days.

Costa Azzurra by Tom Ford is a Woody Aromatic fragrance for women and men. Costa Azzurra was launched in 2014. Top notes are seaweed, driftwood, agarwood (oud), ambrette (musk mallow), celery seeds and cardamom; middle notes are juniper, myrtle, lavender, lemon, yellow mandarin and artemisia; base notes are mastic or lentisque, olibanum, incense, vanilla, vetiver and oak.

name: Tom Ford Eau d'Ombre Leather Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
Tom Ford Eau d'Ombré Leather is a lighter, spicier take on Ombré Leather.
Sonia Constant and Olivier Gillotin created it in 2024. Cardamom, ginger and coriander open fresh, vanilla and leather form a smooth heart, and Ambrofix gives it a clean finish.
Versatile in spring, fall and winter, day or night.

name: Tom Ford Eau de Soleil Blanc 2025 Eau de Toilette Unisex

notes.source_text:
Tom Ford Eau de Soleil Blanc 2025 is a sunny blend of citrus, pistachio and coconut.
Launched in 2025, it opens with bergamot, neroli, petitgrain, cardamom, pink pepper, pistachio and bitter orange. Galbanum, jasmine, tuberose, orange blossom and ylang-ylang form a lush heart, and tonka bean, vanilla, benzoin, amber and coconut give it a warm finish.
Bright and cheerful, it is made for spring and summer days.

name: Tom Ford Eau de Soleil Blanc Eau de Toilette Unisex

notes.source_text:
Tom Ford Eau de Soleil Blanc is a sunny blend of citrus, white flowers and coconut.
Launched in 2018, it opens with bitter orange, neroli, pistachio, bergamot, cardamom and pink pepper. Tuberose, orange blossom, ylang-ylang and jasmine form a radiant heart, and coconut, vanilla, tonka bean and amber give it a warm, beachy finish.
Relaxed and glowing, it is a great everyday summer scent for the office, the gym or a day out.

Fragrance Family:FreshScent Type:Fresh FloralKey Notes:Vert de Bergamot, Orange Bitter, Petitgrain Bigarde, Ylang-Ylang, Pistachio Accord, Coco de Mer AccordAbout:Eau de Soleil Blanc embodies a refreshing illumination on Private Blend Soleil Blanc, bright, crisp, and drenched with sparkling citrus. The vibrant twist on the floral amber warmth mirrors the crystalline reflection of the white sun, a sensuous gleam of sky on water.Beauty Tip:Spray once or twice on clean skin. Do not rub the fragrance, as this will alter how the fragrance develops.

name: Tom Ford Ebene Fume Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Tom Ford Ébène Fumé is a dark, smoky blend of palo santo, leather and incense.
Launched in 2021, it opens with palo santo, incense, violet leaf and black pepper. Leather, papyrus, labdanum, cade oil and rose form a smoky heart, and ebony wood, resins and guaiac wood give it a balsamic finish.
Mysterious and refined, it is made for fall and winter nights.

name: Tom Ford Electric Cherry Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Tom Ford Electric Cherry is a juicy, sparkling cherry with almond and warm spice.
Louise Turner created it in 2022. Bitter almond, liquor and black cherry open bright, sour cherry, plum, Turkish rose and jasmine sambac form a fruity heart, and tonka bean, vanilla, cinnamon, Peru balsam, sandalwood and patchouli give it a smooth finish.
Playful and vibrant, it is a fun everyday scent.

name: Tom Ford Figue Érotique Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Tom Ford Figue Érotique is a sweet, salty fig with ylang-ylang and brown sugar.
Shyamala Maisondieu created it in 2025. Fig leaf, bergamot, mandarin and pink pepper open green and bright, a Kadota fig accord, ylang-ylang and salt form a juicy heart, and muscovado sugar, vetiver, patchouli and licorice give it a warm finish.
Sensual and inviting, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

name: Tom Ford Fleur de Chine Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Tom Ford Fleur de Chine is a fresh, fruity floral with peach, peony and tea.
Rodrigo Flores-Roux created it in 2013. Hyacinth, clementine, tea, jasmine, magnolia, peony, white peach, bergamot, plum and wisteria meet amber, styrax, benzoin, hinoki and cedar for a light, fruity and woody scent.
Graceful and fresh, it is a great daytime scent from spring through fall.

name: Tom Ford Fleur de Portofino Acqua Eau de Toilette Unisex

notes.source_text:
Tom Ford Fleur de Portofino Acqua is a sunny floral with citrus, acacia and honey.
Launched in 2019, it opens with tangerine, mandarin, bergamot, bitter orange, lemon and violet leaf. Acacia, jasmine, magnolia, Moroccan rose and orange blossom form a bright heart, and honey gives it a sweet finish.
Light and cheerful, it is great for everyday wear and outings in spring and summer.

Tom Ford Fleur de Portofino Acqua is a Unisex fragrance, The fragrance launched in 2019
Top Note: Tangerine, Mandarin Orange, Bergamot, Bitter Orange, Lemon, Violet Leaf
Heart Note: Acacia, Jasmine, Magnolia, Moroccan Rose, Orange Blossom
Base Note: Honey

name: Tom Ford Fleur de Portofino Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Tom Ford Fleur de Portofino is a bright white floral with citrus, acacia and honey.
Launched in 2015, it opens with lilac, tangerine, bergamot, Sicilian lemon, orange leaf and violet leaf. Acacia, jasmine, orange blossom, magnolia, osmanthus and Moroccan rose form a lush heart, and acacia honey, ambrette, civet, vanilla and labdanum give it a warm finish.
Radiant and elegant, it is great for everyday wear and outings in spring and summer.

Vibrant, sparkling, and transportive, Neroli Portofino transports you
with fresh citrus and fruits. This reinvention of a classic eau de
Cologne features crisp citrus oils, surprising floral notes and amber
undertones to leave a splashy yet substantive impression.
Fragrance Family: Fresh
Scent Type: Fresh Citrus & Fruits
Key Notes: Italian Bergamot, Orange Flower, Lavender

name: Tom Ford for Men Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
Tom Ford for Men is a polished blend of citrus, tobacco leaf and amber.
Yves Cassar created it in 2007. Lemon leaf, ginger, mandarin, bergamot, basil and violet leaf open fresh, tobacco leaf, pepper, orange blossom and grapefruit blossom form a warm heart, and amber, cedar, patchouli, vetiver, oakmoss and leather give it a woody finish.
Classic and versatile, it is a great daytime scent from spring through fall.

name: Tom Ford Fougere d'Argent Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Tom Ford Fougère d'Argent is a modern, woody lavender fougère.
Linda Song and Olivier Gillotin created it in 2018. Lavender, ginger and mandarin open fresh, akigalawood and labdanum form a warm heart, and coumarin gives it a smooth finish.
Versatile in spring, fall and winter, day or night.

Fougère d’Argent by Tom Ford is a Oriental Fougere fragrance for women and men. Fougère d’Argent was launched in 2018. Fougère d’Argent was created by Olivier Gillotin and Linda Song. Top notes are mandarin orange, lavender and ginger; middle notes are labdanum and akigalawood; base note is coumarin.

name: Tom Ford Fougere Platine Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Tom Ford Fougère Platine is an aromatic blend of lavender, clary sage and tobacco.
Olivier Gillotin and Linda Song created it in 2018. Clary sage, lavender, basil and bergamot open fresh, artemisia, honey, olibanum and labdanum form a warm heart, and tobacco, woods and cedar give it a dry finish.
Polished and modern, it is a great everyday scent.

name: Tom Ford Fucking Fabulous Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Tom Ford Fucking Fabulous is a bold blend of leather, almond and vanilla.
Launched in 2017, it opens with clary sage and lavender. Bitter almond, leather, orris and vanilla form the heart, and tonka bean, cashmeran, white woods and amber give it a smooth finish.
Made for fall and winter, perfect for date nights.

Fragrance Family:Warm & SpicyScent Type:Woody SpiceKey Notes:Fresh lavender, Bitter Almond , Vanilla , Orris Root, Irris Flower, LeatherAbout:Capturing a rarefied air this fragrance evokes the private exchanges and insider moments where fantasies come true. The scent can only be described in one way: with a name that says it all. The vibrant opening makes an instant statement as clary sage and fresh lavender command attention with aromatic foreplay.Delectable bitter almond and vanilla inflections infuse textural richness to the leather heart. Drenched in orris root from the iris flower, the full luscious body of the supple Italian plunge reveals its exquisite beauty. Addictive tonka bean and lavish leather drive the scent as amber undertones reverberate with a warm glow. Ultra-fine blonde woods create a confident expression of pure luxury with a creamy finish.

name: Tom Ford Fucking Fabulous Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Tom Ford F*cking Fabulous is a sweet, leathery blend of lavender, almond and vanilla.
Launched in 2017, it opens with clary sage and lavender. Orris, leather, vanilla and bitter almond form a creamy heart, and white woods, leather, tonka bean, cashmeran and amber give it a smooth finish.
Bold and polished, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

name: Tom Ford Grey Vetiver Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Tom Ford Grey Vetiver is a crisp, elegant vetiver for everyday sophistication.
Harry Fremont created it in 2009. Grapefruit, orange blossom and sage open fresh and clean, nutmeg, orris root and pimento add a dry, spicy heart, and vetiver, woods, oakmoss and amber give it a refined, earthy finish.
Grey Vetiver is clean, sharp and elegant, the scent of a crisp white shirt and a good suit. It is a polished daytime choice for spring and summer.

With its elegant and refined heart of natural vetiver superbly blended with sun-drenched citrus, rich spices and prized woods, TOM FORD Grey Vetiver captures the essence of debonair, charismatic, and provocative masculinity.
"Grey Vetiver captures the essence of debonair, charismatic, and provocative masculinity."—Tom Ford
Notes:
Sage, Grapefruit, Orange Flower, Orris, Nutmeg, Vetyver, Oakmoss.
Style:
Elegant. Fresh. Charismatic.
Alcohol Denat., Water, Fragrance, Butyl Methoxydibenzoylmethane,
Alpha-Isomethyl Ionone, Linalool, Butylphenyl Methylpropional,
Hydroxyisohexyl 3-Cyclohexene Carboxaldehyde, Limonene, Eugenol, Citral,

name: Tom Ford Grey Vetiver Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Tom Ford Grey Vetiver Parfum is a deeper, spicier take on Grey Vetiver.
Launched in 2023, it opens with orange blossom, moves into a warm saffron heart and settles into Haitian vetiver for a refined, earthy finish.
A polished choice for the office and evenings.

name: Tom Ford Italian Cypress Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Tom Ford Italian Cypress is a fresh, green blend of basil, cypress and mint.
Carlos Benaim created it in 2008. Basil, woods, Italian cypress, mint and citrus come together in a crisp, aromatic and woody scent.
Clean and versatile, it works year-round, day or night.

name: Tom Ford Jasmin Rouge Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Tom Ford Jasmin Rouge is a spicy, sensual jasmine with cinnamon and leather.
Rodrigo Flores-Roux created it in 2011. Cinnamon, ginger, bergamot, cardamom, pepper and mandarin open spicy, jasmine, ylang-ylang, neroli, broom and clary sage form a lush heart, and amber, woods, vanilla, leather and labdanum give it a warm finish.
Glamorous and seductive, it is great for date nights and outings in spring and fall.

It features an unexpected blend of precious sambac jasmine sepals
absolute, an ingredient never used before in perfumery, with dusky clary
sage and rich spices. It unveils a new facet of jasmine’s erotic
decadence. Jasmin Rouge is as audacious as lacquered red lips with a
deep red bottle that evokes the lush and hedonistic glamour.Notes: black and white peppercorn, clary sage, sambac jasmine sepals absolute, ylang-ylang, labdanum resin, amber.

name: Tom Ford Jonquille de Nuit Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Tom Ford Jonquille de Nuit is a green, powdery floral with mimosa, narcissus and orris.
Launched in 2012, it opens with mimosa, angelica, violet leaf, cyclamen and bitter orange blossom. Narcissus forms a green floral heart, and orris and amber give it a powdery finish.
Elegant and fresh, it is a lovely daytime scent in spring.

name: Tom Ford Lavender Extreme Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Tom Ford Lavender Extreme is a sweet, aromatic blend of lavender, cinnamon and tonka.
Olivier Gillotin created it in 2019. Violet and lemon open bright, lavender, cinnamon, geranium and rose form an aromatic heart, and tonka bean and coumarin give it a warm, sweet finish.
Cozy and refined, it is a great daytime scent in spring, fall and winter.

name: Tom Ford Lavender Palm Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Tom Ford Lavender Palm is a fresh blend of lavender, palm leaf and vetiver.
Yann Vasnier created it in 2011. Bergamot, Amalfi lemon, lavender and clary sage open fresh, aldehydes, pink pepper, palm leaf, linden blossom and oleander form an airy heart, and tonka bean, olibanum, vetiver, cedar and oakmoss give it a woody finish.
Crisp and sunny, it is made for spring and summer days.

name: Tom Ford Lost Cherry Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Tom Ford Lost Cherry is a decadent blend of black cherry, almond and liqueur.
Louise Turner created it in 2018. Sour cherry, bitter almond and liqueur open rich, plum, Turkish rose and jasmine sambac form a lush heart, and tonka bean, vanilla, Peru balsam, benzoin and cinnamon give it a warm finish.
Made for fall and winter, perfect for date nights.

Fragrance Family:
Warm & Spicy
Scent Type:
Warm & Sweet Gourmands
Key Notes:
Black Cherry Accord, Rose Absolute Orpur, Roasted Tonka Orpur
About:
Tom Ford Lost Cherry is a full-bodied journey into the once-forbidden, a contrasting scent that reveals a tempting dichotomy of playful, candy-like gleam on the outside and luscious flesh on the inside.
Innocence intersects indulgence with an opening that captures the classic perfection of the exotic cherry fruit—black cherry’s ripe flesh dripping in cherry liqueur glistens with a teasing touch of bitter almond. The heart bursts forth in cherry waves of sweet and tart. Griotte syrup expresses the textured maceration of voluptuous fruits while breathtaking florals Turkish rose and jasmine sambac penetrate the senses and soul. Peru balsam and roasted tonka at the drydown suggest a new portrait of an iconic symbol. When blended with an unexpected mélange of sandalwood, vetiver, and cedar, the finish reaches fantasy-inspiring levels of insatiability.

name: Tom Ford Lys Fume Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Tom Ford Lys Fumé is a warm, smoky lily with rum, turmeric and vanilla.
Launched in 2012, it opens with nutmeg, Italian mandarin, pink pepper and turmeric. White lily, rum, ylang-ylang and artemisia form a lush heart, and Madagascar vanilla, labdanum, oak and styrax give it a smoky finish.
Distinctive and versatile, it works year-round, day or night.

name: Tom Ford Mandarino di Amalfi Acqua Eau de Toilette Unisex

notes.source_text:
Tom Ford Mandarino di Amalfi Acqua is a crisp, herbal citrus with mint and basil.
Launched in 2017, it opens with mandarin, grapefruit, mint, bergamot, tarragon and black currant. Orange blossom, lemon leaf, basil, clary sage, thyme, shiso and jasmine form a green heart, and vetiver, musk, labdanum and amber give it a clean finish.
Fresh and energizing, it is great for summer days, the office and the gym.

Fragrance Family:
Fresh
Scent Type:
Fresh Citrus & Fruits
Key Notes:
Mandarin, Lemon, Basil, Spearmint, Shisho Leaf, Jasmine
About:
Effervescent.
Textured. Luminous. A serene perspective of the Amalfi cliffsides, with
their citrus fruits and calm idyll, captures the bright tranquility. At
day’s close, the air, scented with mint, thyme, and wildflowers,
mingles with a warm breeze of night-blooming flowers.
"Mandarino di Amalfi Acqua invites you to experience a sparkling
expression of the Italian coastal paradise from a new point of
view."—Tom Ford
Alcohol Denat., Water, Fragrance, Limonene, Linalool, Benzyl Salicylate,

name: Tom Ford Mandarino di Amalfi Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Tom Ford Mandarino di Amalfi is a zesty, green blend of mandarin, mint and basil.
Calice Becker created it in 2014. Tarragon, grapefruit, basil, mint, lemon and black currant open sparkling, clary sage, black pepper, coriander, jasmine, orange blossom and shiso form an herbal heart, and civet, labdanum, vetiver, musk and amber give it a sensual finish.
Fresh and lively, it is made for spring and summer days.

name: Tom Ford Metallique Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Tom Ford Métallique is a powdery, aldehydic floral with heliotrope and vanilla.
Launched in 2019, it opens with aldehydes, pink pepper and bergamot. Heliotrope, hawthorn and lily-of-the-valley form a soft heart, and vanilla, ambrette, Peru balsam and sandalwood give it a warm finish.
Elegant and cozy, it is great for date nights and outings in fall and winter.

The soft scent of vanilla and creamy sandalwood layer an addictive,
contrasting finish that further drives the metallic opening of
Métallique. This addictive floral fragrance reverberates with a core of
white flowers, while lighter-than-air aldehydes open the scent like a
second skin.
Fragrance Family: Floral
Scent Type: Powdery Florals
Key Notes: Pink Peppercorn, Heliotrope, Balsam

name: Tom Ford Myrrhe Mystere Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Tom Ford Myrrhe Mystère is a warm, powdery blend of myrrh, sandalwood and vanilla.
Launched in 2023, it pairs resinous myrrh with creamy sandalwood, soft vanilla and musk for a smooth, glowing and gently spicy scent.
Elegant and cozy, it is a strong choice for evenings and cooler weather.

name: Tom Ford Neroli Portofino Acqua Eau de Toilette Unisex

notes.source_text:
Tom Ford Neroli Portofino Acqua is a light, sparkling blend of citrus and neroli.
Rodrigo Flores-Roux created it in 2016. Lemon, bergamot and petitgrain open bright, neroli and orange blossom form a white floral heart, and amberwood and white musk give it a clean finish.
Fresh and easy, it is great for everyday wear, the office and the gym in summer.

Neroli Portofino Acqua is an invitation into the seductive atmosphere of the Italian Riviera from a new perspective—afloat in the coastline’s idyllic azure waters, with endless skies overhead and steep, verdant hillsides just within view. A fresher expression of Neroli Portofino’s clear and sparkling facets, it is an irresistibly light way to wear the fragrance’s citrus-and-amber signature.
"Acqua is a fresher expression of Neroli Portofino’s clear and sparkling facets. To me, it has a lighter, more effortless touch that reminds me of the endless skies overhead."—Tom Ford
Notes:
Citrus, Amber.
Style:
Vibrant. Sparkling. Transportive.
Alcohol Denat., Water, Fragrance, Limonene, Linalool, Hydroxycitronellal, Citral, Geraniol, Farnesol, Citronellol

name: Tom Ford Neroli Portofino Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Tom Ford Neroli Portofino is a sparkling Mediterranean citrus and neroli fragrance.
Rodrigo Flores-Roux created it in 2011. Bergamot, mandarin, bitter orange, lemon, lavender, rosemary and myrtle open bright, orange flower, neroli, jasmine and pittosporum form the heart, and amber, angelica and ambrette give it a soft finish.
A summer favorite for daytime, the office and everyday wear.

Vibrant. Sparkling. Transportive. To Tom Ford, this scent perfectly
captures the cool breezes, sparkling clear water, and lush foliage of
the Italian Rivera. His reinvention of a classic eau de cologne features
crisp citrus oils, surprising floral notes, and amber undertones to
leave a splashy yet substantive impression.
"Portofino has always been a magical place for me. There are few
cities in the world that evoke such strong emotions and memories. The
sounds, sights, and smells of the city are so poignant. I tried to
capture this in the scent."—Tom Ford
Notes:
Tunisian Neroli, Italian Bergamot, Sicilian Lemon, Winter Yellow Mandarin, Orange Flower, Lavender.
Style:
Vibrant. Sparkling. Transportive.

name: Tom Ford Neroli Portofino Forte Eau de Parfum Unisex

where the delicate scents of jasmine
adding an unexpected layer of sophistication
key: delicately balanced with a surprising floral heart

notes.source_text:
Vibrant. Sparkling. Transportive.
Immerse yourself in the essence of the Italian Riviera with this exquisite fragrance by Tom Ford. Inspired by the enchanting coastal landscape, this scent captures the cool breezes, pristine azure waters, and lush greenery that define this Mediterranean paradise.
Tom Ford’s masterful reinvention of the classic eau de cologne is a sensory journey that begins with a burst of invigorating citrus. Crisp notes of lemon, bergamot, and mandarin mingle to create a refreshing and uplifting introduction. These sparkling top notes are delicately balanced with a surprising floral heart, where the delicate scents of jasmine, neroli, and orange blossom come into play, adding an unexpected layer of sophistication and elegance.
As the fragrance unfolds, it reveals a deeper, more substantive character. Warm amber undertones blend seamlessly with earthy hints of vetiver and moss, evoking the sun-drenched cliffs and verdant hillsides of the Riviera. This rich, complex base ensures a lasting impression, leaving a trail that is both splashy and enduring.
Experience the luxury and allure of the Italian Riviera with every spritz. This scent is not just a fragrance; it is a transportive escape to a world of beauty, elegance, and timeless charm.

name: Tom Ford Neroli Portofino Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Tom Ford Neroli Portofino Parfum is a richer, musky take on neroli and citrus.
Rodrigo Flores-Roux created it in 2024. Neroli, bergamot, lemon and blood orange open bright, Tunisian neroli, pittosporum, clary sage and jasmine sambac form a radiant heart, and Sylkolide, musk and amber give it a soft finish.
Fresh and refined, it is made for summer days.

name: Tom Ford Noir Anthracite Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Tom Ford Noir Anthracite is a dark, spicy blend of Sichuan pepper, ebony and leather.
Honorine Blanc created it in 2017. Sichuan pepper, ginger and bergamot open bright, spices, galbanum and jasmine form the heart, and ebony, cedar, birch, sandalwood, leather and amberwood give it a woody finish.
Bold and seductive, it is perfect for date nights in fall and winter.

TOM FORD introduces the new Noir fragrance for fall 2017, Noir
Anthracite. The latest icon of seduction, Noir Anthracite reflects the
light in the dark, featuring the brilliance of bergamot and spice
against rich black woods such as cedarwood, macassar ebony, and santal
Sri Lanka.
Polished, dark, and reflective, the duality of the
Noir man mirrors the dynamic tension between contrasts, where the
high-shine glare plays against gray metal and the black veins of
macassar ebony pour into primal night.
Fragrance Family:
Warm & Spicy
Scent Type:
Woody Spices
Key Notes:
Bergamot Essence, Tuberose Fleur, Cedarwood from Alaska

name: Tom Ford Noir de Noir Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Tom Ford Noir de Noir is a dark, opulent blend of black rose, truffle and oud.
Harry Fremont and Jacques Cavallier Belletrud created it in 2007. Saffron opens warm, black rose and truffle form a dark heart, and patchouli, vanilla, oud and oakmoss give it a rich finish.
Made for fall and winter nights and date nights.

Encompassing and celebrating the yin and the yang, this rich oriental
scent reveals TOM FORD’s feminine side. Rich feminine florals and the
masculine earthiness of black truffle, vanilla, patchouli, oud wood, and
tree moss add a warm sensuality to this dark chypre oriental.
"Noir de Noir is dark, sexy, and indulgent. Yin collides with
yang, featuring black rose, black truffle, and patchouli for an intense,
sensual awakening."—Tom Ford
Notes:
Saffron, Black Rose, Black Truffle, Vanilla, Patchouli, Oud Wood, Crocus Flower.
Style:
Dark. Sexy. Indulgent.
Alcohol Denat., Water, Fragrance, Linalool, Benzyl Benzoate, Geraniol,
Limonene, Cinnamyl Alcohol, Citronellol, Eugenol, Benzyl Alcohol,
Citral, Farnesol

name: Tom Ford Noir Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Tom Ford Noir is a warm, powdery oriental with spice, iris and amber.
Launched in 2012, it opens with violet, pink pepper, caraway, bergamot and verbena. Tuscan iris, Bulgarian rose, black pepper and nutmeg form a refined heart, and patchouli, amber, vanilla, leather, opoponax and benzoin give it a rich finish.
Sophisticated and sensual, it is made for fall and winter nights.

An
oriental sensual fragrance, TOM FORD Noir teems with masculine
sensuality. As with all TOM FORD creations, the fragrance is composed of
the finest ingredients and iconic accords, re-imagined as only tom ford
can do.
The fragrance structure is two part—evoking the refined
and perfected outer appearance of a stylish urban gentleman, but giving
way to the wild eroticism and carnal sensuality of what lies beneath
the bespoke suit. This epic contrast of outer and inner worlds defines
the experience of the fragrance.
"Noir captures how for many men there is a sophisticated outer
persona and yet there is also that private side only a few know. This
contrast is what makes him fascinating."—Tom Ford
Notes:
Bergamot, Violet Flower, Tuscan Iris, Black Pepper Oil, Benzoin Resin, Opoponax.
Style:
Refined. Confident. Distinctive.

name: Tom Ford Noir Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
Tom Ford Noir Eau de Toilette is a fresh, spicy take on Noir with citrus and mint.
Launched in 2013, it opens with citrus, mint and Italian lemon. Oriental notes, spices and herbs form a warm heart, and musk and woods give it a smooth finish.
Refined and versatile, it is great for date nights in spring, fall and winter.

TOM FORD Noir Eau De Toilette presents a dynamic new expression of Noir
as pure citrus oils and herbal notes come to the forefront, brightened
and heightened in their impact.
An olfactory portrait of cool and unstudied confidence that hints at
carnal sensuality beneath the surface, it offers a fresh and energized
way to wear the TOM FORD Noir fragrance.
Notes:
Lemon, Clary Sage, Baie Rose, Lavender Oil, Cardamom.
Style:
Refined. Sophisticated. Intriguing.

name: Tom Ford Noir Extreme Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Tom Ford Noir Extreme is a rich, spiced gourmand with a creamy, sweet heart.
Sonia Constant created it in 2015. Cardamom, nutmeg, saffron, mandarin and neroli open warm and bright, kulfi, rose, jasmine, mastic and orange blossom form a creamy heart, and vanilla, amber, sandalwood and woods leave a smooth, lasting finish.
Noir Extreme is cozy, sweet and refined, with a creamy richness that feels made for evenings. It is perfect for fall and winter nights and date nights.

An intense yet gentlemanly interpretation of sensuality, Extreme exudes
impeccable style and fearless confidence. Tom Ford presents his sublime
version of a classic woody men's scent by fusing intriguing elements of
black fig and dark spices with smooth woods and rich essences that are
hand selected and prized for centuries by artisanal perfumers.
"A classic woody scent for a gentleman exudes impeccable style."—Tom Ford
Notes:
Coriander, Black Plum, Black Fig, Black Truffle, Shoyeido Incense, Patchouli, Leather Accord.
Style:
Intriguing. Sublime. Impeccable.
Alcohol Denat., Water, Fragrance, Tocopherol, Benzyl Salicylate,
Hydroxycitronellal, Butylphenyl Methylpropional, Alpha-Isomethyl Ionone,
Coumarin, Limonene, Linalool, Eugenol, Farnesol, Cinnamal, Geraniol,
Citronellol, Benzyl Benzoate, Cinnamyl Alcohol, Citral, Phenoxyethanol

name: Tom Ford Noir Extreme Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Tom Ford Noir Extreme Parfum is a richer, leathery take on Noir Extreme.
Launched in 2022, it opens with cardamom, neroli, ginger and mandarin. Kulfi, Bulgarian rose, jasmine and orange blossom form a creamy heart, and suede, vanilla, leather, amber, guaiac wood and tonka bean give it depth.
Made for fall and winter nights.

name: Tom Ford Noir Pour Femme Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Tom Ford Noir Pour Femme is a creamy, sweet blend of kulfi, rose and vanilla.
Sonia Constant created it in 2015. Ginger, bitter orange, mandarin and bergamot open bright, kulfi, rose, orange blossom and jasmine form a milky floral heart, and vanilla, amber, sandalwood and mastic give it a warm finish.
Luxurious and seductive, it is perfect for fall and winter date nights.

Tom Ford Noir fuses dramatic and decadent floralcy, the signature of a
refined sophisticate with mysterious Eastern delicacies and sensual
amber and woods. It's an ode to the woman who artfully balances her
strong and accomplished womanliness with a softer femininity she keeps
enigmatically out of reach. The feminine complement to Tom Ford Noir and
its theme of masculine duality, Noir Pour Femme evokes the twin facets
of the woman. It is suggestive as a jet-black dress that is slashed to
reveal the curve of a woman's shoulder, or the kissable dip of her back.
Style: Floral oriental.
Notes: bitter orange oil, ginger extract, rose absolute, Indian kulfi, vanilla Madagascar, amber.
Mood: Provocative, daring, extravagant.

name: Tom Ford Ombre de Hyacinth Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Tom Ford Ombré de Hyacinth is a green, airy floral with hyacinth, galbanum and olibanum.
Calice Becker created it in 2012. Violet leaf, galbanum, magnolia petals and olibanum open green, hyacinth, pink pepper and jasmine form a cool heart, and galbanum, musk and benzoin give it a soft finish.
Fresh and elegant, it is a lovely everyday scent.

name: Tom Ford Ombre Leather Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Tom Ford Ombré Leather is a smooth, modern leather with a soft floral edge.
Sonia Constant created it in 2018. Cardamom opens with a light spice, leather and jasmine sambac form a supple heart, and amber, moss and patchouli give it a warm, earthy finish.
Ombré Leather feels cool and effortless rather than heavy, a leather you can wear every day. It suits fall and winter, day or night, and makes a strong pick for date nights.

Fragrance Family:
Warm & Spicy
Scent Type:
Woody Spice
Key Notes:
Jasmine Sambac, Black Leather, White Moss
About:
Floral leather and cool spices reveal an untethered scent for men and women.—vast, untethered, and driven.
Freedom
comes from within, the desert heart of the west is wrapped in leather.
It moves forward, untethered, through the still air of wide-open space.
Dust on wind, skin on skin, Ombré Leather reveals itself like a
landscape in layers, where stretches of rock transform into sunrise
blonde low on the horizon.

name: Tom Ford Ombre Leather Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Tom Ford Ombré Leather Parfum is a richer, deeper version of Ombré Leather.
Sonia Constant created it in 2021. Violet leaf and cedar open fresh, jasmine sambac and orris form a soft heart, and leather, woods and tobacco give it a warm finish.
Versatile in spring, fall and winter, day or night.

name: Tom Ford Ombre Leather Reserve Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Tom Ford Ombré Leather Reserve is a green, peppery take on Ombré Leather.
Launched in 2026, it opens with cypress, black pepper and juniper. Vetiver, floral notes, a green accord and Pepperwood form the heart, and benzoin and black leather give it a smooth finish.
Versatile in spring, fall and winter, day or night.

name: Tom Ford Orchid Soleil Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Tom Ford Orchid Soleil is a creamy white floral with tuberose, chestnut and whipped cream.
Sonia Constant created it in 2016. Cypress, pink pepper and bitter orange open bright, tuberose and red lily form a lush heart, and whipped cream, chestnut, vanilla, orchid and patchouli give it a sweet finish.
Sensual and cozy, it works day or night from spring through fall.

name: Tom Ford Oud Fleur Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Tom Ford Oud Fleur is a rich blend of oud, rose and resins.
Yann Vasnier created it in 2013. Oud, rose, resins, patchouli and sandalwood come together in a deep, balsamic and smooth woody floral scent.
Opulent and sensual, it is perfect for date nights in fall and winter.

Oud Fleur unfolds like a brocaded silk damask of two deeply iconic
Arabian ingredients: rose and oud wood. The gloriously rich and aged
complexity of oud is contrasted with a symphony of rose effects
orchestrated to capture every dimension of the flower.
"Oud Fleur unfolds like a brocaded silk damask of rose and oud,
revealing a symphony of nuance and every dimension of rose."—Tom Ford
Notes:
Oud Wood, Sandalwood, Patchouli, Cardamom, Turkish Rose, Incense Woods.
Style:
Noble. Luxurious. Distinct.
