name: Tom Ford Oud Minerale 2023 Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Tom Ford Oud Minérale is a salty, marine take on oud.
Launched in 2023, it blends marine notes and oud with a soft ambergris accord for a cool, mineral and gently woody scent.
Unusual and refreshing, it works for days and evenings alike.

name: Tom Ford Oud Minerale Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Tom Ford Oud Minérale is a salty, marine oud with seaweed and pink pepper.
Shyamala Maisondieu created it in 2017. Sea salt, sea notes, seaweed and oud open fresh and mineral, pepperwood and pink pepper form a lively heart, and oud, ambergris, fir balsam and styrax give it a warm, resinous finish.
Unusual and refreshing, it is great for date nights from spring through fall.

Fragrance Family:
Warm & Spicy
Scent Type:
Cool Spices
Key Notes:
Salty Seaweed, Pink Peppercorn, Oud Blend, Styrax, Ambergris Accord, Fir Balsam
About:
Original. Oceanic. Elemental. Private Blend Oud Mine´rale merges rare and precious oud with the fresh exuberance of the ocean, capturing the refreshing play of surf and sea against the burning flame of smoked wood. Tom Ford’s reinvention of oud marks an olfactive watershed that pairs two of the world’s most intriguing elements to reveal tonalities both exhilarating and powerfully transcendent.
"By combining two elements from different worlds, smoked oud and fresh ocean, I wanted to create something surprising and unprecedented, as addictive as it is inventive."—Tom Ford
Alcohol Denat., Fragrance, Water, Benzyl Salicylate, Tocopherol,
Farnesol, Limonene, Eugenol, Linalool, Benzyl Alcohol, Isoeugenol,
Citric Acid, Pentaerythrityl Tetra-Di-T-Butyl Hydroxyhydrocinnamate,
Bht, Phenoxyethanol

name: Tom Ford Oud Voyager Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Tom Ford Oud Voyager is a fresh, spicy oud with red peony and saffron.
Launched in 2025, it opens with geranium, pink pepper and citrus. Red peony, cardamom and saffron form a floral, spicy heart, and oud, cypriol, patchouli, vetiver and musk give it a woody finish.
Modern and versatile, it works year-round, day or night.

name: Tom Ford Oud Wood Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Tom Ford Oud Wood is a smooth, refined introduction to oud.
Richard Herpin created it in 2007. Rosewood, cardamom and Sichuan pepper open the way to a polished blend of oud, sandalwood and vetiver, while tonka bean, vanilla and amber add warmth and a soft, creamy depth.
Oud Wood is the oud for people who think they do not like oud: smooth, clean and never harsh. It is especially good on fall and winter evenings and makes an elegant choice for date nights.

One of the most rare, precious, and expensive ingredients in a perfumer’s arsenal, Oud Wood is often burned in incense-filled temples. Exotic rose wood and cardamom give way to a smoky blend of rare oud wood, sandalwood, and vetiver. Tonka bean and amber add warmth and sensuality.
"Oud Wood envelops you in rare oud, exotic spices and cardamom, then exposes its rich and dark blend of sensuality."—Tom Ford
Notes:
Rare Oud Wood, Sandalwood, Chinese Pepper, Rosewood, Tonka Bean, Vanilla.
Alcohol Denat., Fragrance, Water, Linalool, Bht, Limonene, Coumarin,
Cinnamyl Alcohol, Farnesol, Hydroxyisohexyl 3-Cyclohexene
Carboxaldehyde, Butylphenyl Methylpropional

name: Tom Ford Oud Wood Intense Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Tom Ford Oud Wood Intense is a deeper, smokier take on Oud Wood with castoreum and ginger.
Launched in 2017, it opens with castoreum, oud, cypress, juniper, angelica and ginger. Ginger warms the heart, and oud, castoreum and cypress give it a rich, leathery finish.
Dark and refined, it is perfect for fall and winter date nights.

In celebration of the 10th
anniversary of Oud Wood, a game-changer in its use of oud for Western
perfumery, Tom Ford has come out with a confident, commanding new take
with Oud Wood Intense. If you’re expecting the same old song but with a
different tune, you’ll be pleasantly, outrageously surprised – it’s no
flanker here. Indeed, with the higher extrait concentration, the
amped-up rugged texture is entirely its own doing, with a fresh new set
of notes.

name: Tom Ford Oud Wood Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Tom Ford Oud Wood Parfum is a deeper, richer take on Oud Wood.
Launched in 2024, it opens with cardamom, pink pepper and rosemary. Sandalwood, patchouli, oud and vetiver form a woody heart, and vanilla, tonka and amber give it a creamy finish.
Versatile in spring, fall and winter, day or night.

name: Tom Ford Patchouli Absolu Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Tom Ford Patchouli Absolu is a rich, leathery patchouli with rosemary and woods.
Launched in 2014, it blends patchouli with leather, guaiac wood, cypriol, rosemary, cashmere wood, bay leaf, moss, amber, musk and tonka bean for a deep, aromatic and warm scent.
Bold and refined, it works day or night in fall and winter.

name: Tom Ford Plum Japonais Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Tom Ford Plum Japonais is a rich blend of plum, immortelle and oud.
Yann Vasnier created it in 2013. Cinnamon and saffron open spicy, Japanese plum, immortelle, plum blossom, liqueur, camellia and cypress form a fruity heart, and fir, vanilla, oud, benzoin and amber give it a warm finish.
Opulent and cozy, it works day or night in fall and winter.

name: Tom Ford Private Blend Ombre Leather 16 Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Tom Ford Ombré Leather 16 is a smooth, earthy leather with violet leaf and cardamom.
Sonia Constant created it in 2016. Leather, violet leaf, oakmoss, patchouli, jasmine sambac and cardamom come together in a rugged, warm and slightly floral scent.
Bold and polished, it is made for fall and winter, day or night.

name: Tom Ford Rive d’Ambre Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Tom Ford Rive d'Ambre is a fresh, boozy blend of citrus, cognac and tolu balsam.
Olivier Gillotin created it in 2013. Tarragon, tolu balsam, cognac, bergamot, mint, lemon, amber, cardamom and bitter orange come together in a bright, aromatic and gently warm scent.
Fresh and refined, it is made for spring and summer days.

name: Tom Ford Rose D'Amalfi Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Tom Ford Rose d'Amalfi is a bright, powdery rose with mandarin and almond.
Launched in 2022, it opens with pink pepper, bergamot and Indian mandarin. Rose forms a fresh, airy heart, and heliotrope and almond give it a soft, powdery finish.
Light and elegant, it is a lovely daytime scent in spring and fall.

name: Tom Ford Rose de Chine Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Tom Ford Rose de Chine is a fresh, balsamic rose with peony, myrrh and labdanum.
Launched in 2022, it opens with Chinese peony. Rose forms a romantic heart, and myrrh and labdanum give it a warm, ambery finish.
Elegant and fresh, it is a lovely daytime scent in spring and fall.

name: Tom Ford Rose de Russie Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Tom Ford Rose de Russie is a dark rose with white pepper and leather.
Launched in 2022, it opens with white pepper. Rose forms a rich heart, and leather and woods give it a smooth, animalic finish.
Bold and elegant, it works day or night in fall and winter.

name: Tom Ford Rose Exposed Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Tom Ford Rose Exposed is a spicy, leathery rose with pepper and olibanum.
Launched in 2025, it opens with white and pink pepper. Rose water, rose oil and orange blossom form a soft heart, and leather, olibanum, sandalwood, musk and cashmeran give it a warm, woody finish.
Modern and sensual, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

name: Tom Ford Rose Prick Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Tom Ford Rose Prick is a spicy rose with Sichuan pepper, turmeric and patchouli.
Launched in 2020, it opens with Sichuan pepper and turmeric. May rose, Bulgarian rose and Turkish rose form a lush heart, and patchouli and tonka bean give it an earthy, warm finish.
Bold and elegant, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

Rose Prick comes in a dusky pink
matte bottle of the standard shape of a chess piece of the line and
handles the rose note in a "juicy, flowery and full-bodied" way.
Top notes: Sichuan pepper, turmeric
Heart: May rose, Turkish rose, Bulgarian rose
Base: patchouli, tonka bean
Rose Prick was launched in 2020.

name: Tom Ford Santal Blush Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Tom Ford Santal Blush is a creamy, spiced sandalwood with soft florals.
Yann Vasnier created it in 2011. Spices, caraway, cinnamon, fenugreek and carrot seed open warm, ylang-ylang, jasmine and rose form the heart, and sandalwood, benzoin, cedar, musk and oud give it a smooth finish.
A cozy everyday scent for fall.

Tom Ford Santal Blush is a mesmerizing, spicy wood oriental. A textured
fusion of creamy sandalwood and exotic eastern spices is enhanced with
intoxicating florals and sumptuous woods to create soft, naked glamour
with a mysterious spirit of modern earthiness.

name: Tom Ford Shanghai Lily for Eau de Parfum Women

notes.source_text:
Tom Ford Shanghai Lily is a spicy, musky floral with tuberose, incense and vanilla.
Antoine Maisondieu created it in 2013. Jasmine, tuberose and rose meet clove, pink pepper, black pepper and bitter orange, with guaiac wood, vetiver, vanilla, labdanum, olibanum, benzoin and castoreum for a warm, smoky depth.
Exotic and sensual, it works day or night in fall and winter.

name: Tom Ford Sole di Positano Acqua Eau de Toilette Unisex

notes.source_text:
Tom Ford Sole di Positano Acqua is a light, sunny blend of citrus, jasmine and shiso.
Launched in 2019, it opens with mandarin, lemon leaf and petitgrain. Orange blossom, jasmine, lily-of-the-valley, shiso and ylang-ylang form a bright heart, and moss, musk and sandalwood give it a soft finish.
Fresh and cheerful, it is made for spring and summer days.

Sole Di Positano Acqua by Tom Ford is a fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Sole Di Positano Acqua
was launched in 2019. Top notes are Lemon Leaf, Petitgrain and Mandarin
Orange; middle notes are Orange Blossom, Jasmine, Lily-of-the-Valley,
Shiso and Ylang-Ylang; base notes are Moss, Musk and Sandalwood.

name: Tom Ford Sole di Positano Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Tom Ford Sole di Positano is a radiant blend of citrus, neroli and shiso.
Launched in 2017, it opens with bitter orange, mandarin, lemon, Calabrian bergamot and petitgrain. Neroli, orange blossom, jasmine, shiso, ylang-ylang and lily-of-the-valley form a sunny heart, and moss gives it a green finish.
Bright and elegant, it is made for spring and summer days.

Sole di Positano by Tom Ford is a Citrus fragrance for women and men. Sole di Positano
was launched in 2017.
Top notes are Bitter Orange, Mandarin Orange,
Lemon, Calabrian bergamot and Petitgrain;
Middle notes are Neroli,
Orange Blossom, Jasmine, Shiso, Ylang-Ylang and Lily-of-the-Valley;
Base
note is Moss.

name: Tom Ford Soleil Blanc Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Tom Ford Soleil Blanc is a sunny, creamy blend of coconut and white flowers.
Nathalie Gracia-Cetto created it in 2016. Pistachio, bergamot, cardamom and pink pepper open bright, tuberose, ylang-ylang and jasmine form the heart, and coconut, amber, tonka bean and benzoin give it a warm finish.
A summer favorite for daytime.

name: Tom Ford Soleil Brulant Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Tom Ford Soleil Brûlant is a warm, sunny blend of honey, orange blossom and amber.
Launched in 2021, it opens with pink pepper, mandarin and bergamot. Honey and orange blossom form a golden heart, and resins, olibanum, amber, woods, leather and vetiver give it a rich finish.
Radiant and sensual, it works day or night from spring through fall.

Soleil Brûlant by Tom Ford is a Amber Woody fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Soleil Brûlant was launched in 2021. Top notes are Pink Pepper, Mandarin Orange and Bergamot; middle notes are Honey and Orange Blossom; base notes are Resin, Olibanum, Amber, Woody Notes, Leather and Vetiver.
Soleil Brûlant belongs to the Private Blend line, launched in March 2021. The opening notes combines bergamot, mandarin orange and pink pepper, leading us to the rich heart of orange blossom absolute and black honey. The composition is settled on a deep and warm oriental - woody blend (leather, vetiver, resins, frankinsence, amber and woodsy notes) which reflect the warmness of enveloping Sun.

name: Tom Ford Soleil de Feu Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Tom Ford Soleil de Feu is a warm, ambery blend of sandalwood, benzoin and tuberose.
Launched in 2023, it blends sandalwood, amber, benzoin and tuberose into a glowing, powdery and creamy scent.
Warm and sensual, it is a lovely everyday scent.

name: Tom Ford Soleil Neige Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Tom Ford Soleil Neige is a soft, snowy blend of white flowers and warm amber.
Launched in 2019, it opens with bergamot and carrot seed. Orange blossom, white flowers, jasmine and rose form the heart, and benzoin, vanilla and labdanum give it a glowing finish.
Versatile for spring, fall and winter days, the office and everyday.

The bright opening of bergamot and carrot seed mirrors the winter light.
The floral heart blends white blooms with the rich warmth of Turkish
rose. The drydown melts onto skin with undertones of skin-gripping musk,
as benzoin and creamy vanilla finish with sun-kissed warmth.
Fragrance Family: Fresh
Scent Type: Fresh Florals
Key Notes: Bergamot, Jasmine, Benzoin

name: Tom Ford Taormina Orange Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Tom Ford Taormina Orange is a fresh, musky blend of blood orange, cardamom and oakmoss.
Anne Flipo created it in 2026. Cardamom, blood orange, lime and green mandarin open bright, bitter orange, orange blossom and florals form a sunny heart, and oakmoss, patchouli and musk give it an earthy finish.
Fresh and refined, it is made for spring and summer days.

name: Tom Ford Tobacco Chocolat Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Tom Ford Tobacco Chocolat is a rich blend of cacao, dark chocolate and tobacco.
Launched in 2026, it opens with orange and akigalawood. Cacao and dark chocolate form a gourmand heart, and Peru balsam, tobacco, patchouli and Ambrofix give it a deep finish.
Made for fall and winter, day or night.

name: Tom Ford Tobacco Oud Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Tom Ford Tobacco Oud is a dark, boozy blend of whiskey, tobacco and oud.
Olivier Gillotin created it in 2013. Whiskey opens warm, spices, cinnamon and coriander form the heart, and tobacco, oud, sandalwood, patchouli, incense and vanilla give it a rich finish.
Made for fall and winter nights and date nights.

A private blend, Tobacco Oud explores the secret history of an addictive Arabic passion for crafting fragrances from precious oud wood resin and the smoke of aromatic tobacco. The fragrance intertwines mesmerizing oud with an idealized Arabic tobacco accord inspired by "dokha," a blend of herbs, flowers and spice-laden tobacco. Notes: Oud Wood, Sandalwood, Patchouli, Tobacco Absolute, Roasted Tonka Beans Absolute, Olibanum Oil. Style: Regal. Rich. Addictive.
Alcohol Denat., Water, Fragrance, Linalool, Limonene, Farnesol, Geraniol, Eugenol, Benzyl Benzoate, Benzoic Acid

name: Tom Ford Tobacco Oud Intense Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Tom Ford Tobacco Oud Intense is a rich blend of tobacco, oud and castoreum.
Launched in 2017, it blends tobacco, oud, castoreum, amber, tonka bean, labdanum, patchouli, sandalwood, coriander and cedar into a deep, leathery and warm scent.
Bold and intense, it is perfect for nights out in fall and winter.

Tobacco Oud Intense by Tom Ford is a Woody Spicy fragrance for women and men. Tobacco Oud Intense was launched in 2017.

name: Tom Ford Tobacco Vanille Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Tom Ford Tobacco Vanille is an opulent blend of sweet tobacco, vanilla and spice.
Olivier Gillotin created it in 2007. Tobacco leaf and spices open warm and rich, vanilla, cacao, tonka bean and tobacco blossom form a creamy heart, and dried fruits and woods round out a deep, lingering finish.
Tobacco Vanille is rich, cozy and unapologetically luxurious. It is best on fall and winter nights and special occasions, and it lasts for hours, so a little goes a long way.

Tom Ford’s affection for London inspired this scent, reminiscent of an English gentlemen’s club, redolent with spice. He reinvents a classic fragrance genre by adding creamy tonka bean, vanilla, cocoa, dry fruit accords, and sweet wood sap for a modern, opulent, and almost heady impression that’s all man, unless worn by a woman.
"Tobacco Vanille is opulent, warm, and iconic. Reminiscent of an English gentleman’s club and blended with rich spices, vanilla, and tobacco flower, it leaves a powerful impression."—Tom Ford
Notes:
Tobacco Leaf, Ginger, Spice Notes, Tonka Bean, Cocoa, Fruit Accord.
Style:
Opulent. Warm. Iconic.
Alcohol Denat., Fragrance, Water, Linalool, Benzyl Benzoate, Geraniol,
Limonene, Coumarin, Citronellol, Eugenol, Isoeugenol, Benzyl Alcohol,
Citral, Cinnamal

name: Tom Ford Tubereuse Nue Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Tom Ford Tubéreuse Nue is a dark white floral with Sichuan pepper, tuberose and cacao.
Launched in 2021, it opens with jasmine, Sichuan pepper and lily. Tuberose, styrax, benzoin and cacao form a rich heart, and musk, suede, tonka bean and oud give it a sensual finish.
Seductive and unusual, it is a great night scent from spring through fall.

Tubéreuse Nue by Tom Ford is a Oriental Floral fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Tubéreuse Nue
was launched in 2021. Top notes are Jasmine, Sichuan Pepper and Lily;
middle notes are Tuberose, Styrax, Benzoin and Cacao; base notes are
Musk, Suede, Tonka Bean and Agarwood (Oud).

name: Tom Ford Tuscan Leather Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Tom Ford Tuscan Leather is a bold, luxurious leather with raspberry and saffron.
Harry Fremont created it in 2007. Raspberry, saffron and thyme open rich and fruity, olibanum and jasmine form the heart, and leather, suede, woods and amber give it a smoky, opulent finish.
Made for fall and winter, perfect for date nights.

This ultra-sexy interpretation of leather captures its primal,
animalistic scent and smooth, voluptuous qualities. The addition of
olibanum, night blooming jasmine, and black suede gives it a
distinctive, modern spin that is raw yet refined, sensual yet
sophisticated.
Notes:
Saffron, Thyme, Olibanum, Leather, Black Suede, Amberwood.
Style:
Supple. Primal. Extravagant.

name: Tom Ford Vanilla Sex Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Tom Ford Vanilla Sex is a creamy vanilla with bitter almond and sandalwood.
Launched in 2023, it opens with bitter almond. Florals and vanilla form a soft heart, and tonka bean, sandalwood, vanilla absolute and Ultravanil give it a rich, powdery finish.
Indulgent and sensual, it works day or night in fall and winter.

name: Tom Ford Vanille Fatale (2024) Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Tom Ford Vanille Fatale (2024) is a warm, smoky vanilla with coffee and suede.
Launched in 2024, it opens with saffron and coriander. Frangipani, coffee, barley and narcissus form a rich heart, and Madagascar vanilla, suede, mahogany and tobacco give it a leathery finish.
Seductive and cozy, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

name: Tom Ford Vanille Fatale Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Tom Ford Vanille Fatale is a rich, smoky vanilla with rum, coffee and tobacco.
Yann Vasnier created it in 2017. Myrrh, rum, olibanum, coriander, saffron, orange and lime open warm, barley, coffee, frangipani, plum, narcissus and rose form a gourmand heart, and vanilla, suede, tobacco, mahogany, patchouli and oakmoss give it a deep finish.
Seductive and warm, it works for date nights and outings in fall and winter.

The stirring spice of saffron and coriander opens the scent,
infiltrating the senses with the gripping incense of myrrh and olibanum.
Reverberating with the tobacco-like pull of roasted barley, the heart
of Vanille Fatale is a perfect storm of roasted coffee absolute,
narcissus, and frangipani that seduces with grounded floralcy.
Madagascan Vanilla blends with rich mahogany, its smoky glamour made all
the more exotic with primal suede at the finish for a scent that is
impassioned, transfixing, and defiant.
Fragrance Family: Warm & Spicy
Scent Type: Woody Spices
Key Notes: Safraleine, Frangipani, Coffee Absolute, Mahogany, Roasted Barley, Vanilla

name: Tom Ford Velvet Gardenia Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Tom Ford Velvet Gardenia is a lush, honeyed gardenia with plum and incense.
Launched in 2007, it opens with gardenia and orange. Rose, honey, plum, jasmine, lily-of-the-valley, tuberose and beeswax form a creamy heart, and labdanum and incense give it a warm, resinous finish.
Opulent and sensual, it works day or night in fall and winter.

name: Tom Ford Velvet Orchid Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Tom Ford Velvet Orchid is a rich, honeyed floral with rum, orchid and vanilla.
Antoine Maisondieu, Calice Becker, Shyamala Maisondieu and Yann Vasnier created it in 2014. Rum, honey, mandarin and bergamot open warm, black orchid, jasmine, heliotrope, rose and orange blossom form a lush heart, and vanilla, myrrh, suede and sandalwood give it a velvety finish.
Glamorous and warm, it is perfect for fall and winter date nights.

Brilliant. Lavish. Refined. Velvet Orchid is a fragrance that lives in the black orchid world of glamorous mystique, sharing its aura yet standing apart with its own compelling identity. It pushes the D.N.A. of the original Black Orchid into new territory, evolving hidden facets of the original's olfactive structure with extravagant ingredients to reveal even more brilliance, femininity, and attractive force.
In Velvet Orchid, the daring and dramatic floral signature of black orchid is the inspiration for a warm and enveloping fragrance that is lavished with shimmering freshness, dramatic petals, honey, and rum. The woods and spices of the original scent recede and a contrasting veil of petallyfloralcy casts a shadow of ultra-femininity throughout. A new character emerges: one that pulls rather than pushes; and that is more harmonious than mysterious—elegantly refined and polished. Velvet Orchid has an addicting beauty that seduces with a fluid and textured touch. It is the rippling black silk next to black orchid's sleek marble. Velvet Orchid masterfully embellishes and evolves the Black Orchid legacy.
"To this day, velvet is my favorite fabric. The woman who wears this is not a wildflower. She’s an urban flower, she’s a hothouse flower, she’s an orchid."—Tom Ford
Notes:
Orange Blossom, Hyacinth, Jonquil, Cattleya Leopoldii Orchid, Suede Accord, Vanilla Tincture.
Style:
Lavish. Dramatic. Seductive.
Alcohol Denat., Water, Fragrance, Benzyl Salicylate, Linalool, Hexyl
Cinnamal, Alpha-Isomethyl Ionone, Hydroxycitronellal, Benzyl Benzoate,
Geraniol, Limonene, Coumarin, Cinnamyl Alcohol, Citronellol, Eugenol,
Isoeugenol, Benzyl Alcohol, Citral, Amyl Cinnamal, Farnesol, Cinnamal,
Amylcinnamyl Alcohol, Butylphenyl Methylpropional, Anise Alcohol,
Hydroxyisohexyl 3-Cyclohexene Carboxaldehyde, Methyl 2-Octynoate,
Evernia Prunastri (Oakmoss) Extract, Evernia Furfuracea (Treemoss)
Extract, Benzyl Cinnamate

name: Tom Ford Velvet Orchid Lumiere Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Tom Ford Velvet Orchid Lumière is a sweet blend of rum, honey and black orchid.
Launched in 2016, it opens with rum, honey, mandarin and bergamot. Black orchid, rose and jasmine form a lush heart, and myrrh, vanilla and sandalwood give it a warm, powdery finish.
Glamorous and cozy, it works day or night in fall and winter.

name: Tom Ford Venetian Bergamot Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Tom Ford Venetian Bergamot is a bright blend of bergamot, ginger and gardenia.
Launched in 2015, it opens with bergamot, ginger, black pepper and pink pepper. Gardenia, ylang-ylang, magnolia and cedar form a floral heart, and sandalwood, cashmeran, tonka bean and amber give it a smooth finish.
Sunny and polished, it is great for everyday wear and the office in spring and summer.

Private blend Venetian Bergamot is TOM FORD’s singular interpretation of the ingredient known as the "Prince of Citrus." With Venetian Bergamot, the sun-drenched citrus from Italy’s south is transported to the northern city of grand palazzos, remarkable canals, and the famous confluence of trade in rich florals, precious woods, and warm spices. Bergamot’s fresh elegance is underscored and intermingled with the intriguing sensuality of Venice.
Notes:
Bergamot Essence Italy Orpur, Petitgrain Citronnier Oil Orpur, Ylang Madagascar Organic Essence, Magnolia China Orpur Essence, Cedarwood Virginia Essence Orpur, Tonka Bean Venezuela Roasted Absolute.
Style:
Elegant. Sparkling. Sensual.

name: Tom Ford Vert Boheme Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Tom Ford Vert Bohème is a green, fruity floral with honeysuckle, magnolia and galbanum.
Olivier Gillotin created it in 2016. Honeysuckle, woods, magnolia, galbanum, violet leaf and Sicilian mandarin come together in a fresh, juicy and green scent.
Light and natural, it is made for spring and summer days.

name: Tom Ford Vert d'Encens Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Tom Ford Vert d'Encens is a green, resinous blend of pine, fir and incense.
Olivier Gillotin created it in 2016. Wood resin, pine, balsam fir, incense, heliotrope and boxwood come together in a cool, balsamic and woody scent.
Calm and atmospheric, it works day or night in fall and winter.

Vert d'Encens by Tom Ford is a Oriental Woody fragrance for women and men. Vert d'Encens was launched in 2016. The nose behind this fragrance is Olivier Gillotin.

name: Tom Ford Vert de Fleur Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Tom Ford Vert de Fleur is a green, earthy blend of vetiver, florals and galbanum.
Olivier Gillotin created it in 2016. Vetiver, florals and galbanum come together in a crisp, aromatic and earthy green scent.
Fresh and refined, it is a great daytime scent in spring and fall.

name: Tom Ford Vert des Bois Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Tom Ford Vert des Bois is a woody blend of anise, plum and poplar buds.
Olivier Gillotin created it in 2016. Anise, plum, poplar buds and olive tree open green, mastic and jasmine form a resinous heart, and woods, tonka bean and patchouli give it a warm finish.
Distinctive and calm, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

name: Tom Ford Violet Blonde Eau de Parfum For Women

notes.source_text:
Tom Ford Violet Blonde is a soft, powdery blend of violet leaf, iris and suede.
Launched in 2011, it opens with violet leaf, pink pepper and mandarin. Iris, orris root and jasmine form a powdery heart, and suede, benzoin, musk, vetiver and cedar give it a smooth finish.
Elegant and refined, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

name: Tom Ford White Patchouli Eau de Parfum Unisex

top: capture attention with their sleek freshness
key: capture attention with their sleek freshness
notes.source_text:
Tom Ford White Patchouli is a soft, floral take on patchouli with incense and woods.
Created with Givaudan in 2008, it opens with white flowers, coriander, peony and bergamot. Ambrette, rose and jasmine form a delicate heart, and patchouli, incense and woods give it a smoky, earthy finish.
Elegant and a little mysterious, it is lovely for date nights in spring, fall and winter.

With its sensuous core of patchouli, TOM FORD White Patchouli perfectly captures the myth of a generation. Sleek wood blends with the essence of elegant white flowers to create this modern retro-classic fragrance that embodies a sophisticated interpretation of bohemian chic. Citrus and coriander top notes capture attention with their sleek freshness and unfold into a floral trio, revealing intoxicating jasmine, refined muguet, and sensual rose absolute. An alluring base of patchouli oprur delivers rich depth and mingles with tempering sandalwood, dramatic incense, and golden amber for a compelling, seductive appeal.Notes:White Patchouli, Rose Absolute, Coriander, Patchouli, Incense.
