Amandine Clerc-Marie created it in 2011. Pink pepper and bergamot open bright, tuberose, incense and jasmine form a lush heart, and oud, sandalwood, patchouli, ambergris and vetiver give it a deep finish.
Opulent and elegant, it is a strong choice for evenings.

name: Van Cleef & Arpels Collection Extraordinaire Rose Rouge Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Van Cleef & Arpels Rose Rouge is a fruity, sweet rose with raspberry and cacao.
Julien Rasquinet created it in 2018. Black currant, pink pepper and bergamot open juicy, rose, raspberry and vetiver form a rich heart, and vanilla, cacao pod, patchouli, benzoin and musk give it a warm finish.
Romantic and cozy, it is a great everyday and evening scent.

name: Vera Wang for Men Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
Vera Wang for Men is a fresh, spicy blend of yuzu, leather and tobacco.
Launched in 2004, it opens with yuzu and mandarin leaf. Nutmeg, leather and anise form a warm heart, and tobacco and sandalwood give it a smooth finish.
Easy and versatile, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

name: Veronique Gabai Cap d'Antibes Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Véronique Gabai Cap d'Antibes is a fresh, Mediterranean blend of bergamot, pine and sea notes.
Launched in 2019, it blends bergamot, cedar, florals, pine, sea notes and wood resin into a breezy, green and woody scent.
Fresh and sunny, it is made for spring and summer days.

name: Veronique Gabai Eau de La Nuit Booster Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Véronique Gabai Eau de la Nuit Booster is a warm, musky blend of amber and woods.
Launched in 2019, it blends amber, musk and woods into a smooth, powdery and slightly animalic skin scent.
Intimate and warm, it is a lovely scent from summer through winter.

name: Veronique Gabai Eau du Jour Booster Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Véronique Gabai Eau du Jour Booster is a fresh blend of citrus and woods.
Launched in 2019, it pairs bright citrus with clean woods for a light, easy and uplifting scent.
Fresh and simple, it is a great daytime scent from spring through fall.

name: Veronique Gabai Jasmin de Minuit Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Véronique Gabai Jasmin de Minuit is a woody blend of jasmine, patchouli and sea notes.
Launched in 2019, it blends jasmine, patchouli, vetiver and sea notes into an aromatic, salty and woody floral scent.
Elegant and versatile, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

name: Veronique Gabai Le Point G Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Véronique Gabai Le Point G is a powdery blend of iris, rose and vanilla.
Launched in 2021, it blends iris, amber, vanilla, Virginia cedar, tonka bean, pink pepper, white musk and rose de mai into a soft, musky and earthy scent.
Sensual and elegant, it works day or night in spring and fall.

name: Veronique Gabai Noire de Mai Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Véronique Gabai Noire de Mai is a mossy rose with dew and sea notes.
Launched in 2019, it opens with a dewy accord. Sea notes and rose de mai form a fresh heart, and woods, amber and oakmoss give it an earthy finish.
Calm and versatile, it works year-round, day or night.

name: Veronique Gabai Sexy Garrigue Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Véronique Gabai Sexy Garrigue is a warm, resinous blend of patchouli, labdanum and pine.
Launched in 2019, it blends amber, patchouli, labdanum, herbal notes, pine and wood resin into a green, balsamic and woody scent.
Sensual and natural, it is made for fall and winter nights.

name: Veronique Gabai Souvenirs de Tunisie Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Véronique Gabai Souvenirs de Tunisie is a sunny blend of orange blossom, neroli and almond.
Launched in 2019, it blends orange blossom, bergamot, neroli, sandalwood, orange wood, watery notes and fresh almond into a sweet, fresh and woody scent.
Bright and nostalgic, it is made for spring and summer days.

name: Veronique Gabai Sur La Plage Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Véronique Gabai Sur la Plage is a sunny blend of jasmine, magnolia and sea notes.
Launched in 2019, it blends jasmine, magnolia, orange blossom, sea notes and a skin accord into a warm, salty and floral beach scent.
Relaxed and cheerful, it is made for summer days.

name: Veronique Gabai Vert Desir Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Véronique Gabai Vert Désir is a fresh, green blend of absinthe, mint and leaves.
Launched in 2019, it blends absinthe, woods, mint, water notes and green leaves into a cool, aromatic and herbal scent.
Crisp and refreshing, it is made for spring and summer days.

name: Versace Atelier Cedrat de Diamante Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Versace Atelier Cédrat de Diamante is a crisp citrus with lemon, grapefruit and vetiver.
Marie Salamagne created it in 2019. Italian lemon, pink grapefruit, cedar and vetiver come together in a bright, aromatic and earthy citrus scent.
Clean and refreshing, it is made for spring and summer days.

Versace launches the Atelier Versace collection of six perfumes in October 2019. The fragrances bear the names Cédrat de Diamante, Éclat de Rose, Figue Blanche, Jasmin au Soleil, Santal Boisé and Vanille Rouge. Each of the creations has one ingredient as a theme, and five perfumers worked on the development of the compositions.
Marie Salamagne developed Cédrat de Diamante, a citrusy Mediterranean-inspired essence that combines Italian notes of lemon and grapefruit with aromatic cedar and vetiver.

name: Versace Atelier Eclat de Rose Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Versace Atelier Éclat de Rose is a soft, ambery rose with musk and incense.
Nathalie Lorson created it in 2019. Musk, Moroccan rose, ambroxan, amber, incense, woods and tobacco come together in a warm, powdery and elegant scent.
Graceful and calm, it is a lovely spring daytime scent.

Versace launches the Atelier Versace collection of six perfumes in October 2019. The fragrances bear the names Cédrat de Diamante, Éclat de Rose, Figue Blanche, Jasmin au Soleil, Santal Boisé and Vanille Rouge. Each of the creations has one ingredient as a theme, and five perfumers worked on the development of the compositions.
Nathalie Lorson is behind the fragrance Éclat de Rose, which is brings Moroccan Centifolia rose complete with Ambrox - a blend that reveals shades of amber, incense, woods, tobacco and musk.

name: Versace Atelier Figue Blanche Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Versace Atelier Figue Blanche is a fresh blend of fig, citrus and white flowers.
Marypierre Julien created it in 2019. Fig, mandarin, bergamot, neroli, jasmine and rose come together in a bright, fruity and softly floral scent.
Light and cheerful, it is a great daytime scent year-round.

Versace launches the Atelier Versace collection of six perfumes in October 2019. The fragrances bear the names Cédrat de Diamante, Éclat de Rose, Figue Blanche, Jasmin au Soleil, Santal Boisé and Vanille Rouge. Each of the creations has one ingredient as a theme, and five perfumers worked on the development of the compositions.
Marypierre Julien created Figue Blanche, blending fresh figs with essential oils of mandarin, bergamot, neroli, jasmine and rose.

name: Versace Atelier Gingembre Petillant Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Versace Atelier Gingembre Pétillant is a sweet blend of ginger, white flowers and praline.
Jordi Fernández created it in 2021. Ginger opens sparkling, white flowers form a soft heart, and vanilla and praline give it a sweet finish.
Fresh and cozy, it works year-round, day or night.

name: Versace Atelier Jasmin au Soleil Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Versace Atelier Jasmin au Soleil is a warm jasmine with tobacco, beeswax and hay.
Nathalie Lorson created it in 2019. Indian jasmine, tobacco, beeswax, cedar, hay and lemon come together in a sunny, honeyed and gently woody floral scent.
Warm and elegant, it is a lovely daytime scent in spring and fall.

Versace launches the Atelier Versace collection of six perfumes in October 2019. The fragrances bear the names Cédrat de Diamante, Éclat de Rose, Figue Blanche, Jasmin au Soleil, Santal Boisé and Vanille Rouge. Each of the creations has one ingredient as a theme, and five perfumers worked on the development of the compositions.
Nathalie Lorson is credited with Jasmine au Soleil, which combines beeswax with Indian jasmine flowers, lemon, hay, tobacco and cedar.

name: Versace Atelier Safran Royal Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Versace Atelier Safran Royal is a leathery blend of saffron, amber and patchouli.
Jordi Fernández created it in 2021. Amber, leather, saffron, cypriol, patchouli, cistus and wormwood come together in a warm, earthy and spicy scent.
Bold and refined, it is made for fall and winter nights.

name: Versace Atelier Santal Boise Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Versace Atelier Santal Boisé is a warm blend of sandalwood, cypriol and saffron.
Christophe Raynaud created it in 2019. Sandalwood, cypriol and saffron come together in a smooth, spicy and powdery woody scent.
Refined and warm, it works day or night in fall and winter.

Santal Boisé by Versace is a Woody Spicy fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Santal Boisé was launched in 2019. The nose behind this fragrance is Christophe Raynaud.

name: Versace Atelier Vanille Rouge Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Versace Atelier Vanille Rouge is a sweet, powdery vanilla with almond and rose.
Jordi Fernández created it in 2019. Madagascar vanilla, almond, rose and musk come together in a soft, creamy and gently floral gourmand scent.
Cozy and seductive, it is made for fall and winter nights.

Versace launches the Atelier Versace collection of six perfumes in October 2019. The fragrances bear the names Cédrat de Diamante, Éclat de Rose, Figue Blanche, Jasmin au Soleil, Santal Boisé and Vanille Rouge. Each of the creations has one ingredient as a theme, and five perfumers worked on the development of the compositions.
Jordi Fernandez designed Vanille Rouge blending Madagascar vanilla with powdered musk accords, almonds and rose.

name: Versace Bright Crystal Absolu Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Versace Bright Crystal Absolu is a richer take on Bright Crystal with raspberry and peony.
Alberto Morillas created it in 2013. Pomegranate, yuzu and water notes open fresh, peony, raspberry, lotus and magnolia form a sweet floral heart, and musk, mahogany and amber give it a warm finish.
Pretty and bright, it is made for spring and summer days.

Based on popularity of Bright Crystal edition, Versace and
Euroitalia are launching a stronger version of the original fragrance
with hope that it will thrill fans of the original edition. "After the
amazing success of Bright Crystal worldwide we wanted to respond to the
wish of very demanding customers and launch and intense version.“ – as
stated by Giovanni Sgariboldi, president of Euroitalia.
Creative director of the Versace brand - Donatella Versace
accentuates that this is a fragrance with enhanced intensity and
longevity, the composition of which provides a vibrant perfume full of
love.
Absolute sensuality. Absolute
transparency. Absolute brightness. An absolute temptation. Versace
Bright Crystal Absolu Eau de Parfum, the intense version of one of the
most beloved jewel-fragrances in the world, where the essence of bright
crystal is enhanced to the extreme. The amazing vibrancy of yuzu
immediately stands out between coloured and juicy pomegranate seeds
creating an unusual freshness, pure and natural. The heart is enriched
with inviting and velvety accents of raspberry, accented by the elegance
of peony along with refined notes of magnolia and lotus flowers. Then a
trail evokes an intense and voluptuous sensuality, with precious
vegetal amber, deep acajou wood, bright and vibrant musk.
Fragrance Notes:
Top - yuzu, pomegranate
Middle - raspberry, peony, magnolia, lotus flowers
Base - vegetal amber, deep acajou wood, bright and vibrant musk
Notes:
Yuzu, Pomegranate, Raspberry, Peony, Magnolia And Lotus Flowers, Precious Vegetal Amber, Deep Acajou Wood, Musk.
Style:
Intense. Vibrant. Luxurious.

name: Versace Bright Crystal Eau de Toilette for Women

notes.source_text:
Versace Bright Crystal is a fresh, aquatic floral with pomegranate, peony and lotus.
Alberto Morillas created it in 2006. Yuzu, pomegranate and water notes open crisp, peony, lotus and magnolia form a soft heart, and musk, mahogany and amber give it a clean finish.
Light and pretty, it is great for everyday wear and date nights in spring and summer.

Inspired
by a mixture of Donatella Versace's favorite floral fragrances, Bright
Crystal is a fresh, sensual blend of refreshing chilled yuzu and
pomegranate mingled with soothing blossoms of peony, magnolia, and lotus
flower, warmed with notes of musk and amber.
Notes:
Iced Accord, Yuzu, Pomegranate, Peony, Magnolia, Lotus Flower, Acajou, Vegetal Amber, Musk.
Style:
Sheer. Sensual. Luminous.

name: Versace Bright Crystal Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Versace Bright Crystal Parfum is a sweet, fruity floral with red fruits, yuzu and peony.
Launched in 2024, it opens with red fruits, yuzu, caramel and pomegranate. Peony, magnolia and lotus form a soft floral heart, and ambrox, woods and musk give it a clean finish.
Bright and feminine, it is made for spring and summer days.

name: Versace Couture Jasmin Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Versace Couture Jasmin is a lush floral with jasmine, ylang-ylang and benzoin.
Antoine Maisondieu created it in 2014. Jasmine, ylang-ylang, rose and benzoin come together in a rich, sunny and gently ambery floral scent.
Radiant and elegant, it works day or night from spring through fall.

Couture Jasmine by Versace is a Floral fragrance for women. Couture Jasmine was launched in 2014. The nose behind this fragrance is Antoine Maisondieu.

name: Versace Couture Tuberose Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Versace Couture Tubéreuse is a creamy blend of tuberose, almond and ambroxan.
Aurélien Guichard created it in 2014. Tuberose, almond and ambroxan come together in a lush, nutty and ambery white floral scent.
Sensual and smooth, it works day or night in spring and winter.

Couture Tuberose by Versace is a Floral fragrance for women. Couture Tuberose was launched in 2014. The nose behind this fragrance is Aurelien Guichard.

name: Versace Couture Violet Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Versace Couture Violet is a soft, powdery blend of violet, heliotrope and mimosa.
Alexandra Kosinski created it in 2014. Violet, musk, heliotrope and mimosa come together in a delicate, sweet and powdery floral scent.
Gentle and graceful, it is a lovely daytime scent in spring.

Couture Violet by Versace is a Floral fragrance for women. Couture Violet was launched in 2014. The nose behind this fragrance is Alexandra Kosinski.

name: Versace Crystal Emerald Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Versace Crystal Emerald is a fruity floral with peach, rosebud and raspberry.
Launched in 2025, it opens with bergamot, peach and pink pepper. Rosebud, a sorbet accord, jasmine and raspberry form a juicy heart, and white musk, incense and tonka bean give it a soft finish.
Bright and pretty, it is a lovely everyday scent.

name: Versace Crystal Noir Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Versace Crystal Noir is a dark, creamy blend of gardenia, coconut and spice.
Antoine Lie created it in 2004. Pepper, ginger and cardamom open warm, coconut, gardenia, orange blossom and peony form the heart, and sandalwood, musk and amber give it a soft finish.
Made for fall and winter nights and date nights.

A
fragrance for the true Versace woman. She’s effortlessly sexy,
confident, and loves fashion, sumptuousness, and eccentricity. The
fragrance is a magical perfume, sheer and sensual at the same time. A
floral-oriental scent, it’s absolutely feminine, gentle, and leaves a
lasting impression.
Notes:
Gardenia, Amber.
Style:
Magical. Sheer. Senusal.

name: Versace Crystal Noir Eau de Toilette for Women

notes.source_text:
Versace Crystal Noir Eau de Toilette is a spicy floral with cardamom, gardenia and sandalwood.
Antoine Lie created it in 2004. Cardamom, ginger and pepper open spicy, orange blossom, peony and gardenia form a creamy white floral heart, and sandalwood, musk and amber give it a warm finish.
Seductive and smooth, it works day or night.

Crystal Noir by Versace is a Oriental Floral fragrance for women. Crystal Noir
was launched in 2004. The nose behind this fragrance is Antoine Lie.
Top notes are Pepper, Ginger and Cardamom; middle notes are Coconut,
Gardenia, Orange Blossom and Peony; base notes are Sandalwood, Musk and
Amber.

name: Versace Crystal Noir Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Versace Crystal Noir Parfum is a warm, sweet blend of spices, caramel and tuberose.
Launched in 2024, it opens with spices, pink pepper and black currant. Caramel, tuberose and lily-of-the-valley form a rich heart, and amber, sandalwood, vanilla, Akigalawood and orchid give it a warm finish.
Seductive and cozy, it is made for fall and winter nights.

name: Versace Dreamer Eau de Toilette for Men

base: end the fragrance with a blend of cedar
key: end the fragrance with a blend of cedar
notes.source_text:
Versace Dreamer is a soft, aromatic blend of lavender, tobacco and tonka.
Jean-Pierre Bethouart created it in 1996. Lavender, sage and mandarin open fresh, tobacco, rose, carnation and geranium form a warm heart, and tonka bean, fir, vetiver and cedar give it a smooth finish.
Gentle and versatile, it is great for the office and everyday wear in spring, fall and winter.

Product Details
Dreamer is an oriental fougere perfume that was released by Versace in 1996 . This aromatic fragrance has top notes that consist of clary sage, lavender, and mandarin orange. Its middle notes feature geranium, rose, and tobacco. Its base notes end the fragrance with a blend of cedar and tonka bean. Dreamer is a long-lasting fragrance with moderate sillage.

name: Versace Dylan Blue Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
Versace Dylan Blue is a fresh, aquatic woody fragrance with modern appeal.
Alberto Morillas created it in 2016. Calabrian bergamot, grapefruit, water notes and fig leaf open fresh, ambroxan, patchouli, black pepper and violet leaf form the heart, and incense, musk, tonka bean and saffron give it warmth.
Easy to wear for the office, the gym and everyday, from spring through fall.

A classic bottle
with bright blue and gold that preciously guards this fragrance for him,
treasuring all its vibrant notes. The design uses painted glass to
reinterpret the color blue. Once again, the allusion to the
Mediterranean Sea and its culture is apparent: modern, fresh, incisive,
intense, profound and sensual. New and exquisite qualities of natural
citrus, aquatic notes and violet leaves combine with modern hints of fig
leaf to give an incisive, Mediterranean freshness. A fougère, woody,
aromatic fragrance.
Fragrance Notes:
Top - Bergamot, grapefruit, aquatic notes, fig Leaves
Middle - Violet leaves, black pepper, papyrus wood, patchuli bio
Base - Mineral musk, Tonka bean, saffron
Style:
Masculine. Sexy. Powerful.??

name: Versace Dylan Blush Pink Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Versace Dylan Blush Pink is a sweet, fruity blend of strawberry, marshmallow and vanilla.
Olivier Cresp created it in 2025. Strawberry, apple, freesia and bergamot open fresh, tonka bean, orange blossom and marshmallow form a soft heart, and Madagascar vanilla and musk give it a creamy finish.
Playful and feminine, it is made for spring and summer days.

name: Versace Eros Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Versace Eros Eau de Parfum is a richer, warmer take on the bold Eros signature.
Launched in 2020, it opens with mint, candy apple, lemon and mandarin. Ambroxan, geranium and clary sage form the heart, and vanilla, leather, sandalwood, cedar and patchouli give it a deep, sweet finish.
Confident and attention-grabbing, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

Eros Eau De Parfum by Versace is a Oriental Woody fragrance for men. This is a new fragrance. Eros Eau De Parfum was launched in 2020. Top notes are lemon, mandarin orange, mint and candy apple; middle notes are geranium, clary sage and ambroxan; base notes are leather, bitter orange, vanilla, cedar, patchouli and sandalwood.

name: Versace Eros Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
Versace Eros is a fresh, sweet blend of mint, green apple and vanilla.
Aurélien Guichard created it in 2012. Mint, green apple and lemon open bright and crisp, tonka bean, ambroxan and geranium form the heart, and Madagascar vanilla, Virginian and Atlas cedar, vetiver and oakmoss give it a warm finish.
Bold and attention-grabbing, it is made for date nights and evenings out.

Love,
passion, beauty, and desire are the key concepts behind the new men’s
fragrance by Versace. As Greek mythology and classic sculpture have
characterized the Versace world since the beginning, so the perfection
of the male body is evoked with an allusion to Eros, the god of love.
Versace Eros is a fragrance for a strong, passionate man, who is master
of himself.
Eros interprets the sublime masculine through a luminous aura with an
intense, vibrant, and glowing combination of fresh mint leaves, Italian
lemon zest, and green apple. An addictive sensuality accented by
oriental, intriguing, and enveloping notes like tonka beans, amrboxan
amber, geranium flower, and vanilla melds with a racy virility
symbolized by woods—such as cedarwood from Atlas and Virginia—while
vetiver and oak moss provide intensity and power.
Notes:
Mint Oil, Italian Lemon, Green Apple, Tonka Bean, Geranium Flower, Vanilla, Vetiver, Moss, Cedarwood.
Style:
Passionate. Sexy. Strong.

name: Versace Eros Energy Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Versace Eros Energy is a bright, zesty citrus with a mossy base.
Launched in 2024, it opens with blood orange, grapefruit, lemon, lime, mandarin and Sicilian bergamot. Pink pepper, white amber and black currant form the heart, and musk, patchouli and oakmoss give it a fresh, lasting finish.
Energetic and versatile for everyday wear.

name: Versace Eros Flame Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Versace Eros Flame is a spicy, citrusy take on Eros with a warm vanilla base.
Olivier Pescheux created it in 2018. Mandarin, black pepper, chinotto, lemon and rosemary open bright, pepper, geranium and rose form the heart, and vanilla, tonka bean, cedar, sandalwood and patchouli give it a warm, sweet finish.
Perfect for date nights and evenings out in spring, fall and winter.

Versace Eros Flame, is a flanker to the original masculine Eros from 2012. While the pillar is an aromatic-fougère, the new scent goes into a totally different direction with citrusy, spicy, woody, and ambery accords, described as "cold and hot, sweet and spicy, light and shadow."
The concept is based on an interpretation of passionate love, marketed as a fragrance for a "strong, passionate, self-confident man who is deeply in touch with his emotions."
Olivier Pescheux developed the composition as one of contrasts; the head notes are made to be vivacious and fresh with italian citruses, black pepper and rosemary. Pepperwood, geranium and rose facets are in the heart, before a warm base of woods, blended with tonka and vanilla.
Eros Flame was launched in 2018.

name: Versace Eros Najim Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Versace Eros Najim is a warm, sweet blend of caramel, mandarin and oud.
Launched in 2024, it opens with caramel and Italian mandarin. Oud and cardamom form a spicy, woody heart, and incense, patchouli and vetiver give it a smoky, earthy finish.
Rich and attention-grabbing, it is made for evenings in spring, fall and winter.

name: Versace Eros Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Versace Eros Parfum is a deeper, ambery take on Eros with mint and green apple.
Launched in 2021, it opens with lemon and mint. Green apple and geranium form a fresh, fruity heart, and amber and tonka bean give it a warm, sweet finish.
Bold and versatile, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

name: Versace Eros Pour Femme Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Versace Eros Pour Femme Eau de Parfum is a bright floral with lemon, pomegranate and jasmine.
Alberto Morillas, Nathalie Lorson and Olivier Cresp created it in 2014. Sicilian lemon, pomegranate and Calabrian bergamot open bright, lemon blossom, jasmine sambac, jasmine and peony form a white floral heart, and musk, ambroxan, woods and sandalwood give it a smooth finish.
Glamorous and easy, it is great for everyday wear, outings and the office in spring and summer.

The
primal power of woman is captured in this radiant, sensual essence.
Attraction, desire, and passion intertwine in an alchemical mix of
tempting, bright, and feminine notes. A refined accord of lemon and
jasmine is exalted by sensual and smooth woods for a fragrance of
strength, individuality, and seduction.
Notes:
Sicilian Lemon, Calabrian Bergamot, Pomegranate, Lemon Flower,
Sambac Jasmine Absolute, Jasmine infusion, Peony, Sandlewood, Ambrox,
Musks, Sensual Wood.
Style:
Vibrant. Feminine. Enchanting.

name: Versace Eros Pour Femme Eau de Toilette for Women

notes.source_text:
Versace Eros Pour Femme Eau de Toilette is a fruity floral with raspberry, lemon and magnolia.
Launched in 2016, it opens with raspberry, Sicilian lemon, white currant, mandarin and calone. Magnolia, jasmine, orange blossom and freesia form a bright heart, and musk, ambroxan, woods and patchouli give it a clean finish.
Fresh and lively, it is great for everyday wear, the office and the gym in spring and summer.

Eros
Pour Femme Eau de Toilette offers a new sensual and addictive freshness
based on the association of precious citrus notes—Sicilian lemon and
mandarin—with crisp, fruity notes of raspberry and blackberry. A touch
of calone creates the icy effect of a temping sorbet. Velvety floral
petals of magnolia and jasmine confer femininity, while a touch of
orange blossom adds intensity and character. The dry down offers notes
of white woods, musk, and ambrox to convey elegance and add a sensual
dimension.
Notes:
Sicilian Lemon, Mandarin, Raspberry Sorbet, Blackberry, Magnolia, Orange Blossom, Jasmine Petals, Ambrox, White Woods, Musk.
Style:
Sensual. Addictive. Elegant.

name: Versace L'Homme Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
Versace L'Homme is a classic blend of citrus, spice and leather.
Roger Pellegrino created it in 1984. Bergamot, petitgrain, lemon, green notes and basil open fresh, cedar, cinnamon, jasmine, patchouli, rose, sandalwood and carnation form a spicy heart, and tonka bean, oakmoss, labdanum, vanilla, leather and amber give it a warm finish.
Timeless and refined, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

name: Versace Man Eau Fraiche Extreme Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Versace Man Eau Fraîche Extrême is a fresh, aromatic blend of lemon, lavender and cedar.
Olivier Cresp created it in 2025. Orange blossom, lemon and pink pepper open bright, clary sage, lavender and geranium form an aromatic heart, and ambroxan, musk and Virginia cedar give it a clean finish.
Crisp and easy, it is a great daytime scent from spring through fall.

name: Versace Pour Femme Dylan Blue Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Versace Pour Femme Dylan Blue is a bright, fruity floral with green apple and rose.
Calice Becker created it in 2017. Granny Smith apple, black currant, clover, forget-me-not and shiso open fresh, peach, rose hip, rose and jasmine form a soft heart, and musk, white woods, styrax and patchouli give it a clean finish.
Fresh and feminine, it is a great everyday scent for spring and summer.

An alchemy of irresistible notes that dance, arouse, come together, and
embrace, this fragrance is a refreshing blackcurrant sorbet with Granny
Smith apple and a contemporary floral bouquet. Woody base notes
playfully mix together to create a unique, captivating, sensuous, and
vibrant movement.
Fragrance Family:
Floral
Scent Type:
Fruity Florals
Key Notes:
Blackcurrant, Rosyfolia, Patchouli

name: Versace Pour Femme Dylan Purple Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Versace Pour Femme Dylan Purple is a bright, fruity floral with a clean, musky base.
Launched in 2022, it opens with pear, bitter orange and bergamot. Mahonia, freesia and pomarose form a fresh floral heart, and ambroxan, Iso E Super, musk and Virginia cedar give it a smooth, airy finish.
Feminine and easy, it is a great everyday scent.

name: Versace Pour Femme Dylan Turquoise Eau de Toilette for Women

notes.source_text:
Versace Pour Femme Dylan Turquoise is a fresh, juicy blend of citrus, guava and freesia.
Sophie Labbé created it in 2020. Lemon, mandarin and pink pepper open bright, guava, freesia, cassis and jasmine form a fruity heart, and Clearwood, musk and cedar give it a clean finish.
Cheerful and light, it is made for spring and summer days.

Versace Pour Femme Dylan Turquoise by Versace is a Floral Fruity fragrance for women. This is a new fragrance. Versace Pour Femme Dylan Turquoise
was launched in 2020. The nose behind this fragrance is Sophie Labbe.
Top notes are Lemon, Mandarin Orange and Pink Pepper; middle notes are
Guava, Freesia, Cassis and Jasmine; base notes are Clearwood, Musk and
Cedar.

name: Versace Pour Femme Eau de Parfum for Women

top: a freshness of the morning dew along with purple wisteria
key: a freshness of the morning dew along with purple wisteria
notes.source_text:
Versace Pour Femme is a fresh floral with lilac, guava and lotus.
Launched in 2007, it opens with lilac, guava, wisteria, black currant and a dew accord. Jasmine, lotus, orchid and rhododendron form a soft heart, and musk, cashmere wood, Bourbon vetiver and Atlas cedar give it a woody finish.
Light and pretty, it is great for everyday wear, outings and the office in spring.

Donatella Versace wanted to launch a different kind of fragrance, that would be trendy, fresh and feminine, but at the same time classic. A blend of soft and fresh flowers is dedicated to a woman of a new millennium. Top notes include a freshness of the morning dew along with purple wisteria and tropical, succulent guava and white lilacs. Its heart is composed of wet and translucent flowers; Angel Wing jasmine, lotus flowers, orchid and azaleas. The drydown is built of vetiver, cedarwood and musk.

name: Versace Pour Femme Oud Oriental Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Versace Pour Femme Oud Oriental is a powdery blend of rose, saffron and oud.
Launched in 2014, it opens with rose, saffron and freesia. Heliotrope, patchouli and violet form a powdery heart, and oud, leather, sandalwood and vanilla give it a warm finish.
Opulent and elegant, it works day or night in fall and winter.

Luxurious and very feminine edition launched last year as the pair to the last year's oriental edition which has its exclusive presentation in the Middle East - Versace Pour Homme Oud Noir, just before 2014 was presented to us as a female fragrant story from the Orient, sunny, luxurious, hot, seductive and sensual Versace Pour Femme Our Oriental! Bearing on mind the trend in gold that we've recently written about (article: In Shades of gold) new Versace bottle takes recognizable shape of its antecedents Versace and Versence, completely covered with gold. Typical emblem engraved in the shape of a jellyfish is set in the central part of the body of the bottles, while the cap is discreetly decorated with a Greek motif.
This time, Italy will be the first to have the opportunity to try the "golden" composition created for woman of strong personality! Versace cleverly linked male and female version with an intense and aphrodisiac signature of a blend composed of oud and leather. Luxurious composition opens with oriental notes of rose, which is accentuated with cheeky saffron and framed with flowers of freesia. The heart of the composition is powdery, feminine, soft and deep, created of patchouli, heliotrope and violet succeeded by intense notes of oud and leather with creamy vanilla and sandalwood, which have the task to seduce you, and soften base notes.

name: Versace Pour Homme Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
Versace pour Homme is a bright, Mediterranean citrus with aromatic freshness.
Alberto Morillas created it in 2008. Lemon, neroli, bergamot and rose de mai open fresh, hyacinth, cedar, clary sage and geranium form the heart, and tonka bean, musk and amber give it a clean finish.
A spring and summer favorite for the office, the gym and everyday wear.

The new fragrance for men, Versace Pour
Homme, blends essential ingredients of Mediterranean origin to hit
aromatic notes that match the man of today: knowledgeable and
self-confident, he has the ability to live in harmony with the natural
world. Dynamic and entrepreneurial, the Versace Pour Homme man
communicates his forceful and passionate character through this
decidedly masculine fragrance.
Notes:
Bergamot,
Neroli, Citron of Diamante, Bitter Orange Leaves, Geranium, Clary Sage,
Blue Hyacinth, Cedarwood, Old Wood, Mineral Amber, Tonka Bean, Musk.
Style:
Strong. Virtuosic. Unique.

name: Versace Pour Homme Oud Noir Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Versace pour Homme Oud Noir is a dark, spicy oud with leather.
Launched in 2013, it opens with black pepper, bitter orange and neroli. Saffron, cardamom and olibanum form the heart, and oud, patchouli and leatherwood give it a rich finish.
Made for fall and winter nights and date nights.

The seduction of a sunset on a desert, a warm breeze in the air
giving a feeling of well-being. Versace pour Homme Oud Noir is a
sensual, heady aroma, almost aphrodisiacal. One of the finest
ingredients of perfumery craftsmanship gives life to this new fragrance
for men, designed for lovers of oriental fragrances and for the man with
a strong personality. Woody, oriental, crisp, virile, elegant and
hypnotic.
Notes:
- Top: bitter orange, neroli, black pepper.
- Middle: cardamom, saffron, olibanum.
- Base: oud wood, patchouli, leatherwood.

name: Versace Vanitas Eau de Toilette for Women

notes.source_text:
Versace Vanitas Eau de Toilette is a fresh, sweet floral with lime, tiare and tonka.
Dora Baghriche created it in 2011. Lime opens bright, tiare and freesia form a soft white floral heart, and Virginia cedar and tonka bean give it a warm finish.
Light and pretty, it is a lovely daytime scent in spring.

The new fragrance is named Vanitas EDT. We can expect a luminous and fresh composition, created of shiny notes of lime, floral wave of tiare and freesia along with a pleasant and sensual trail of tonka and woody accords of cedar.

name: Versace Versace Man Eau de Toilette for Men

base: saffron combine to create an everyday scent that fosters confidence in nearly every situation
from a day at the office to a vacation at the beach
key: saffron combine to create an everyday scent that fosters confidence in nearly every situation
from a day at the office to a vacation at the beach
notes.source_text:
Versace Man is a warm, spicy blend of angelica, saffron and tobacco.
Domitille Bertier created it. Angelica flowers, bergamot, black pepper and neroli open fresh, cardamom and saffron form a spicy heart, and amber, cashmere wood, labdanum and tobacco leaves give it a warm finish.
Polished and warm, it is great for everyday wear and the office in fall and winter.

Versace Man Cologne by Versace, Versace Man, released in 2006, is a Mediterranean-inspired fragrance, the scent of which hints at summer days by the water. The cologne’s fresh and clean top notes of lemon, bergamot, rosewood and rose give way to an alluring heart of cedar, tarragon, sage and pepper. The base notes of amber, musk, tobacco, sycamore and saffron combine to create an everyday scent that fosters confidence in nearly every situation, from a day at the office to a vacation at the beach.
Versace is an Italian fashion house that debuted in 1978 with an instantly successful women’s clothing line, followed by a men’s line and boutique in Milan the same year. Its luxury items draw inspiration from sources ranging from pop art to classical Mediterranean architecture. The company introduced its first fragrance in 1981, and its collection of fashion couture, accessories and cosmetics remains popular among celebrities including Elton John, Madonna, Ashton Kutcher, Britney Spears and Halle Berry.

name: Versace Versace Man Eau Fraiche Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
Versace Man Eau Fraîche is a crisp, fruity citrus with clean woods.
Olivier Cresp created it in 2006. Lemon, bergamot, star fruit, cardamom and rosewood open fresh, cedar, tarragon, pepper and sage form an aromatic heart, and musk, woods, saffron, amber and sycamore give it a light finish.
Cool and easy, it is great for the office, the gym and everyday wear in spring and summer.

This fresh, sexy interpretation of the
Versace Man fragrance is a softer, more subtly sexy version of the
original. Smooth fruits spiced with green leaves and warm notes of musk,
amber, and sycamore wood, make this a scent for today's more
introspective man.
Notes:
White Lemon, Rosewood, Carambola, Tarragon, Cedar Leaves, Clary Sage, Musk, Amber, Sycamore Wood.
Style:
Elegant. Seductive. Charismatic.

name: Versace Versense Eau de Toilette for Women

notes.source_text:
Versace Versense is a fresh, Mediterranean blend of citrus, fig and olive tree.
Launched in 2009, it opens with bergamot, citrus, green mandarin, fig and pear. Cardamom, lily, jasmine and narcissus form a floral heart, and cedar, olive tree, musk and sandalwood give it a woody finish.
Light and sunny, it is made for spring and summer days.

This modern fragrance of a beautiful and rare floral bouquet is composed of elements of the Mediterranean and it represents Versace woman perfectly with its authentic expression and a fusion of freshness and energy. The new fragrance by the house of Versace was named Versace Versense and it promises a lot with its name and composition. It is created for irresistible experience for all senses.
The fragrance Versace Versense is composed of natural
tones and it is a picture of awakening of nature, evoking feeling of
freedom, movement and balance of internal energy with surroundings and
nature. Versense is a walk in a fragrant garden, which
contributes to freshness and a stream of feelings, as well as to
self-esteem and vitality.

name: Versace Woman Eau de Parfum

notes.source_text:
Versace Woman is a fruity, musky blend of raspberry, plum and lotus.
Christine Nagel created it in 2000. Jasmine leaf, bergamot and rose open bright, lotus, cedar, raspberry and plum form a juicy heart, and musk and amber give it a soft finish.
Elegant and easy, it is a great daytime scent from spring through fall.

name: Versace Yellow Diamond Eau de Toilette for Women

notes.source_text:
Versace Yellow Diamond is a bright, sunny floral with lemon, pear and mimosa.
Launched in 2011, it opens with Amalfi lemon, pear, bergamot and neroli. Mimosa, freesia, water lily and orange flower form a soft heart, and musk, guaiac wood and amber give it a clean finish.
Fresh and cheerful, it is made for spring and summer days.

Versace started its glamorous fragrance line inspired by crystals in 2004 with Crystal Noir perfume, and then launched the lighter and fruitier Bright Crystal in 2006. In 2011, a new fragrance of the collection emerges, "a crystal that turns into a diamond," named Yellow Diamond.
Yellow Diamond is crafted as a pure, transparent and airy floral fragrance, sparkling and intense as the yellow color, while being luxurious and feminine like a diamond. Its composition opens with luminous freshness of lemon, bergamot, neroli and pear sorbet. The heart features airy orange blossom, freesia, mimosa and water lily. The base is made of amber, precious musk and guaiac wood.

name: Versace Yellow Diamond Intense Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Versace Yellow Diamond Intense is a richer take on Yellow Diamond with osmanthus and benzoin.
Launched in 2014, it opens with citron, pear, neroli and bergamot. Orange blossom, freesia, osmanthus and jasmine form a white floral heart, and guaiac wood, musk, amber and benzoin give it a warm finish.
Radiant and fresh, it is made for spring and summer days.

Yellow Diamond Intense by Versace is a Floral fragrance for women. Yellow Diamond Intense
was launched in 2014. Top notes are Citron, Pear, Neroli and Bergamot;
middle notes are Orange Blossom, Freesia, Osmanthus and Jasmine; base
notes are Guaiac Wood, Musk, Amber and Benzoin.

name: Vertus 1001 Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Vertus 1001 is a warm, spicy blend of saffron, rose and orris.
Launched in 2015, it opens with cinnamon, cardamom, saffron, ginger, bergamot and lime. Damask rose, violet, orris, mimosa, carnation, magnolia and tuberose form a powdery heart, and amber, cedar, patchouli, vetiver, sandalwood and vanilla give it a rich finish.
Opulent and refined, it is a lovely night scent in fall.

name: Vertus Amber Elixir Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Vertus Amber Elixir is a boozy, woody blend of dried fruits, rum and amber.
Launched in 2015, it opens with dried fruits, rum, black pepper, grapefruit and artemisia. Amber, labdanum, cashmere wood, cedar and saffron form a warm heart, and musk, sandalwood, tonka bean, teak and castoreum give it a rich finish.
Cozy and bold, it is made for fall and winter nights.

name: Vertus Chaos Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Vertus Chaos is a marine, woody blend of sea notes, jasmine and ambergris.
Launched in 2021, it opens with sea notes and lemon. Patchouli, white flowers and jasmine form a floral heart, and ambergris, woods and oakmoss give it a salty finish.
Versatile and distinctive, it works year-round, day or night.

name: Vertus Eau de Cyan Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Vertus Eau de Cyan is a fresh, marine blend of sea notes, sage and seaweed.
Launched in 2016, it opens with sea notes, sage, cypress and galbanum. Seaweed, gardenia and jasmine form a breezy heart, and oakmoss, musk, patchouli and amber give it a woody finish.
Cool and refreshing, it is made for spring and summer days.

name: Vertus Fresh Orient Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Vertus Fresh Orient is a powdery blend of lavender, saffron and orris.
Launched in 2015, it opens with lavender, olibanum, cardamom, saffron and lemon. Rose, orris, violet, guaiac wood, patchouli and clove form a spicy heart, and musk, amber, vetiver, vanilla and sandalwood give it a warm finish.
Elegant and versatile, it works day or night in spring and fall.

name: Vertus Night Dose Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Vertus Night Dose is a fruity, powdery blend of plum, coconut and tobacco.
Launched in 2015, it opens with saffron, plum, mirabelle, apple and grapefruit. Damask rose, coconut, orris root, peach, heliotrope and jasmine form a soft heart, and musk, sandalwood, oakmoss, patchouli, tobacco and tonka bean give it a warm finish.
Sweet and elegant, it is a great daytime scent in spring and fall.

name: Vertus Ombre Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Vertus Ombre is a woody blend of oregano, patchouli and oud.
Launched in 2016, it opens with oregano and bergamot. Patchouli, labdanum, vanilla and cedar form a warm heart, and oud, woods, sandalwood and musk give it a deep finish.
Bold and distinctive, it is made for fall and winter nights.

name: Vertus Oriental Rose Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Vertus Oriental Rose is a spicy, powdery rose with saffron, orris and vanilla.
Launched in 2015, it opens with lavender, olibanum, cardamom, saffron and lemon. Rose, orris, violet, guaiac wood and clove form a soft, spicy heart, and musk, amber, vetiver, vanilla, cedar and sandalwood give it a smooth finish.
Romantic and warm, it works day or night in spring and fall.

name: Vertus Oud Noir Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Vertus Oud Noir is a fruity, spicy blend of plum, saffron and oud.
Launched in 2015, it opens with plum, apple, saffron, rhubarb, lemon and grapefruit. Rose, geranium, cyclamen, cedar, carnation, magnolia and orris form the heart, and vetiver, guaiac wood, oud, vanilla, sandalwood and castoreum give it a deep finish.
Bold and versatile, it works year-round, day or night.

name: Vertus Paradox Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Vertus Paradox is a fruity, spicy blend of pepper, rose and labdanum.
Launched in 2017, it opens with fruity, spicy and green notes. Pepper, rose, lily-of-the-valley and jasmine form a floral heart, and labdanum, sandalwood, vetiver and vanilla give it a warm finish.
Smooth and versatile, it works day or night in fall.

name: Vertus Paris Auramber Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Vertus Auramber is a smoky, animalic blend of amber, labdanum and patchouli.
Launched in 2021, it opens with amber, animalic notes and smoke. Amber and dry woods form a warm heart, and amber, labdanum and patchouli give it a rich finish.
Deep and sensual, it works day or night in fall and winter.

name: Vertus Rose Morocco Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Vertus Rose Morocco is a woody rose with saffron, peach and oud.
Launched in 2015, it opens with cardamom, saffron and apple. Rose, cashmere wood, geranium, peach, violet, cedar and magnolia form a lush heart, and musk, oud, sandalwood, tonka bean, vanilla and amber give it a warm finish.
Romantic and rich, it works day or night in fall and winter.

name: Vertus Rose Prive Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Vertus Rose Privé is a warm rose with saffron, melon and raspberry.
Launched in 2015, it opens with saffron, lemon, melon, ginger and apple. Rose, cashmere wood, orris, amber, patchouli, lily and jasmine form a rich heart, and guaiac wood, benzoin, sandalwood, raspberry, musk and vanilla give it a sweet finish.
Opulent and warm, it is a lovely night scent in fall.

name: Vertus Silhouette Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Vertus Silhouette is a fresh, leathery blend of aldehydes, violet and patchouli.
Launched in 2017, it opens with aldehydes, citrus and fruity notes. Violet, neroli and jasmine form a soft heart, and patchouli, leather, incense and sandalwood give it a woody finish.
Refined and distinctive, it is a great daytime scent in fall and winter.

name: Vertus Vanilla Oud Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Vertus Vanilla Oud is a rich, sweet blend of oud, caramel and vanilla.
Launched in 2015, it opens with saffron, apple, rhubarb and bergamot. Oud, cashmere wood, jasmine, rose and violet form a smooth heart, and caramel, vanilla, sandalwood, tonka bean and guaiac wood give it a warm finish.
Deep and indulgent, it is made for fall and winter nights.

name: Vertus XXIV Carat Gold Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Vertus XXIV Carat Gold is a fresh, woody blend of juniper, cypress and vetiver.
Launched in 2015, it opens with juniper berries, cypress and aldehydes. Pink pepper and violet form a soft heart, and vetiver, sandalwood, cedar, tobacco and musk give it an earthy finish.
Refined and versatile, it is a great daytime scent in spring, fall and winter.

name: Viktor & Rolf Flowerbomb Extreme Eau de Parfum Intense for Women

notes.source_text:
Viktor&Rolf Flowerbomb Extreme is a sweet floral with raspberry, rose and vanilla bean.
Launched in 2025, it opens with juicy raspberry. Rose, jasmine and orange blossom form a lush heart, and vanilla bean gives it a warm, powdery finish.
Glamorous and versatile, it works year-round, day or night.

name: Viktor & Rolf Spicebomb Dark Leather Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Viktor&Rolf Spicebomb Dark Leather is a warm, spicy blend of leather and tobacco.
Launched in 2024, it opens with nutmeg and black pepper. Cinnamon and frankincense form a smoky, spicy heart, and black leather and tobacco give it a rich, sweet finish.
Bold and intense, it is a great choice for evenings and cooler weather.

name: Viktor&Rolf Bonbon Couture Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Viktor&Rolf Bonbon Couture is a sweet blend of peach, caramel and white tobacco.
Cécile Matton and Serge Majoullier created it in 2016. Neroli, mandarin and peach open bright, jasmine sambac, orange blossom and caramel form a sweet heart, and white tobacco, vanilla, sandalwood and patchouli give it a warm finish.
Indulgent and playful, it works day or night in fall and winter.

name: Viktor&Rolf Flowerbomb Bloom Eau de Toilette for Women

notes.source_text:
Viktor&Rolf Flowerbomb Bloom is a fresh floral with pomegranate, freesia and rose.
Domitille Michalon Bertier created it in 2017. Pomegranate and mandarin open bright, freesia, a mountain air accord, Damask rose and jasmine form an airy heart, and woods give it a soft finish.
Light and pretty, it is great for everyday wear, outings and the office in spring.

Flowerbomb Bloom by Viktor&Rolf is a Floral fragrance for women's. Flowerbomb Bloom was released in 2017. The Master Perfumer for this fragrance is Domitille Michalon Bertier. Top notes are Pomegranate and Mandarin Orange. Middle Notess are Freesia, Mountain Air, Damask Rose and Jasmine. Base Note is Woody Notes.

name: Viktor&Rolf Flowerbomb Dew Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Viktor&Rolf Flowerbomb Dew is a soft, powdery blend of pear, iris and rose.
Launched in 2020, it opens with pear, ambrette, a dew accord and bergamot. Iris and rose form a powdery heart, and white musk, cashmeran and heliotrope give it a soft finish.
Delicate and elegant, it is a great daytime scent in spring, fall and winter.

Flowerbomb Dew by Viktor&Rolf is a Floral fragrance for women's. This is a new fragrance. Flowerbomb Dew was released in 2020. Top notes are Pear, Ambrette (Musk Mallow), Dew Drop and Bergamot. Middle Notess are iris and Rose. Base Notes are White Musk, Cashmeran and Heliotrope.

name: Viktor&Rolf Flowerbomb Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Viktor&Rolf Flowerbomb is an explosive, sweet floral bouquet.
Carlos Benaïm, Dominique Ropion, Domitille Michalon-Bertier and Olivier Polge created it in 2005. Tea, bergamot and osmanthus open bright, orchid, jasmine, rose, freesia and orange flower form the heart, and patchouli and musk give it a warm finish.
Made for fall and winter, perfect for date nights.

Flowerbomb by Viktor&Rolf is a Amber Floral fragrance for women's. Flowerbomb was released in 2005. Flowerbomb was created by Olivier Polge, Carlos Benaim, Domitille Michalon Bertier and Dominique Ropion. Top notes are Tea, Bergamot and Osmanthus. Middle Notess are Orchid, Jasmine, Rose, Freesia and African Orange flower. Base Notes are Patchouli, Musk and Vanilla. This perfume is the winner of award FiFi Award Best National Advertising Campaign / Print 2006.

name: Viktor&Rolf Flowerbomb In The Sky Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Viktor&Rolf Flowerbomb in the Sky is a fresh blend of citrus, currant buds and rose.
Domitille Michalon Bertier created it in 2020. Grapefruit, bergamot and mandarin open bright, currant buds, lily-of-the-valley and rose form a green heart, and jasmine sambac and patchouli give it a warm finish.
Fresh and lively, it is made for spring and summer days.

name: Viktor&Rolf Flowerbomb Mariage Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Viktor&Rolf Flowerbomb Mariage is a sweet floral with osmanthus, tea and orchid.
Olivier Polge, Domitille Michalon Bertier, Carlos Benaim and Dominique Ropion created it in 2021. Bergamot, osmanthus and tea open soft, rose, freesia, jasmine, orange blossom and orchid form a lush heart, and musk and patchouli give it a warm finish.
Romantic and versatile, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

name: Viktor&Rolf Flowerbomb Midnight Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Viktor&Rolf Flowerbomb Midnight is a fruity floral with black currant, jasmine and vanilla.
Carlos Benaim, Fanny Bal, Dominique Ropion and Domitille Michalon Bertier created it in 2019. Black currant and pomegranate open juicy, night-blooming jasmine and peony form a floral heart, and white musk and vanilla give it a soft finish.
Seductive and pretty, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

name: Viktor&Rolf Flowerbomb Pretty Peony Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Viktor&Rolf Flowerbomb Pretty Peony is a fruity blend of strawberry, peony and vanilla.
Launched in 2025, it opens with juicy strawberry. Peony forms a soft floral heart, and vanilla and musk give it a sweet finish.
Light and playful, it is made for spring and summer days.

name: Viktor&Rolf Flowerbomb Ruby Orchid Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Viktor&Rolf Flowerbomb Ruby Orchid is a fruity blend of peach, orchid and vanilla.
Domitille Michalon Bertier created it in 2021. Peach and vine leaves open juicy, orchid forms a lush heart, and vanilla bean gives it a warm, powdery finish.
Sweet and versatile, it works year-round, day or night.

name: Viktor&Rolf Flowerbomb Tiger Lily Feminine

notes.source_text:
Viktor&Rolf Flowerbomb Tiger Lily is a creamy blend of coconut milk, tiger lily and mango.
Launched in 2024, it opens with coconut milk and bergamot. Tiger lily, jasmine and freesia form a floral heart, and mango and benzoin give it a sweet, warm finish.
Sunny and playful, it is made for spring and summer days.

name: Viktor&Rolf Good Fortune Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Viktor&Rolf Good Fortune is a sweet white floral with fennel, jasmine and vanilla.
Nicolas Beaulieu and Anne Flipo created it in 2022. Fennel and gentian open fresh and slightly bitter, jasmine forms a radiant heart, and Madagascar vanilla gives it a warm finish.
Elegant and versatile, it works year-round, day or night.

name: Viktor&Rolf Spicebomb Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
Viktor&Rolf Spicebomb is a warm blend of cinnamon, saffron and tobacco.
Olivier Polge created it in 2012. Pink pepper, elemi, bergamot and grapefruit open bright, cinnamon, saffron and paprika form a spicy heart, and tobacco, leather and vetiver give it a rich finish.
Made for fall and winter, from everyday wear to date nights.

Spicebomb by Viktor&Rolf is a Woody Spicy fragrance for men's. Spicebomb was released in 2012. The Master Perfumer for this fragrance is Olivier Polge. Top notes are Pink Pepper, elemi, Bergamot and Grapefruit. Middle Notess are Cinnamon, Saffron and Paprika. Base Notes are Tobacco, Leather and Vetiver.

name: Viktor&Rolf Spicebomb Extreme Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Viktor&Rolf Spicebomb Extreme is a warm, explosive mix of tobacco, vanilla and spice.
Olivier Polge created it in 2015. Black pepper, caraway and lavender open with a peppery kick, cinnamon, cumin and saffron add heat, and tobacco, black vanilla, cistus and amber leave a rich, smoldering trail.
Spicebomb Extreme is warm, bold and cozy, with plenty of projection for cold nights. It is made for fall and winter evenings, date nights and nights out.

Spicebomb Extreme by Viktor&Rolf is a Amber Spicy fragrance for men's. Spicebomb Extreme was released in 2015.

name: Viktor&Rolf Spicebomb Fresh Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
Viktor&Rolf Spicebomb Fresh is a cool, spicy blend of grapefruit, pepper and sea salt.
Olivier Polge created it in 2014. Pink pepper, grapefruit and pepper open bright, sea salt, elemi and lavender form an aromatic heart, and tobacco, moss and amber give it a warm finish.
Versatile and easy, it works for the office, the gym, date nights and casual days from spring through fall.

Spicebomb Eau Fraiche by Viktor&Rolf is a Aromatic Spicy fragrance for men's. Spicebomb Eau Fraiche was released in 2014. Top notes are Pink Pepper, Grapefruit and Pepper. Middle Notess are Sea Salt, elemi and Lavender. Base Notes are Tobacco, Moss and Amber.

name: Viktor&Rolf Spicebomb Infrared Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Viktor&Rolf Spicebomb Infrared is a fiery blend of chili pepper, cinnamon and leather.
Carlos Benaim, Nicolas Beaulieu and Jean-Christophe Hérault created it in 2023. Cinnamon, pink pepper and chili pepper open hot and spicy, leather forms a smooth heart, and resins and woods give it a warm finish.
Intense and bold, it is made for fall and winter nights.

name: Viktor&Rolf Spicebomb Infrared Eau de Toilette For Men

notes.source_text:
Viktor&Rolf Spicebomb Infrared Eau de Toilette is a sweet, spicy blend of red fruits, cinnamon and tobacco.
Launched in 2021, it opens with red fruits, pink pepper and saffron. Cinnamon and red pepper form a hot, spicy heart, and tobacco and benzoin give it a warm finish.
Bold and cozy, it is made for fall and winter nights.

Spicebomb Infrared by Viktor&Rolf is a Amber Spicy fragrance for men's. This is a new fragrance. Spicebomb Infrared was released in 2021. Top notes are Red Fruits, Pink Pepper and Saffron. Middle Notess are Cinnamon and Red Pepper. Base Notes are Tobacco and Benzoin.

name: Viktor&Rolf Spicebomb Metallic Musk Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Viktor&Rolf Spicebomb Metallic Musk is a fresh, spicy musk with a leathery edge.
Jean-Christophe Hérault created it in 2025. Aldehydes, black pepper, elemi and bergamot open bright, cinnamon, pepper and lavender form a spicy heart, and musk, leather, ambrette and labdanum give it a smooth finish.
Versatile in every season, day or night.

name: Viktor&Rolf Spicebomb Night Vision Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Viktor&Rolf Spicebomb Night Vision is a fresh, spicy blend with a warm pistachio base.
Launched in 2020, it opens with green apple, cardamom, black pepper, chili, nutmeg, clove and citrus. Clary sage, lavender, mint, rosemary and mastic form an aromatic heart, and pistachio, benzoin, fir balsam, cedar and olibanum give it a rich finish.
Bold and warming, it is made for fall and winter, day or night.

name: Viktor&Rolf Spicebomb Night Vision Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
Viktor&Rolf Spicebomb Night Vision is a fruity, spicy blend of apple, chili pepper and tonka.
Nathalie Lorson and Pierre Negrin created it in 2019. Granny Smith apple, green mandarin, cardamom and grapefruit open fresh, sage, pepper, red chili, geranium, nutmeg and clove form a spicy heart, and tonka bean, almond and woods give it a warm finish.
Lively and seductive, it is great for date nights and outings in spring and fall.

Spicebomb Night Vision Eau de Toilette by Viktor&Rolf is a Amber Fougere fragrance for men's. This is a new fragrance. Spicebomb Night Vision Eau de Toilette was released in 2019. Spicebomb Night Vision Eau de Toilette was created by Nathalie Lorson and Pierre Negrin. Top notes are Granny Smith apple, Green Mandarin, Cardamom and Grapefruit. Middle Notess are Pepper, Sage, Nutmeg, Red Chilli Pepper, Clove and Geranium. Base Notes are Tonka Bean, Almond and Woody Notes.

name: Vilhelm Parfumerie 125th & Bloom Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Vilhelm Parfumerie 125th & Bloom is a powdery rose with saffron, violet and suede.
Launched in 2017, it opens with saffron and angelica. Damask rose and violet form a powdery heart, and suede and ebony give it a smooth, leathery finish.
Elegant and sensual, it is a lovely everyday scent.

name: Vilhelm Parfumerie Basilico & Fellini Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Vilhelm Parfumerie Basilico & Fellini is a green blend of basil, fig and hay.
Launched in 2017, it opens with basil and dragon fruit. Fig and violet form a soft green heart, and grass, hay and vetiver give it a fresh, earthy finish.
Natural and refreshing, it is a great everyday scent.

name: Vilhelm Parfumerie Body Paint Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Vilhelm Parfumerie Body Paint is a spicy, green blend of green pepper, pear and clove.
Marc-Antoine Corticchiato created it in 2020. Green pepper, pear, red chili and lemon open bright, clove, Iso E Super and nutmeg form a warm heart, and oakmoss, ambroxan and cedar give it a woody finish.
Distinctive and modern, it is a great everyday scent.

name: Vilhelm Parfumerie Chicago High Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Vilhelm Parfumerie Chicago High is a sweet, boozy blend of champagne, tobacco and honey.
Launched in 2020, it opens with champagne, pineapple and bergamot. Tobacco and honey form a warm, golden heart, and leather, patchouli and amber give it a rich finish.
Glamorous and inviting, it is a great choice for evenings.

name: Vilhelm Parfumerie Darling Nikki Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Vilhelm Parfumerie Darling Nikki is a smoky blend of black pepper, saffron and leather.
Launched in 2017, it opens with black pepper, cassis and Sicilian mandarin. Indian saffron and lotus form a warm heart, and smoke, woods and leather give it a dark finish.
Bold and moody, it is a great everyday and evening scent.

name: Vilhelm Parfumerie Dirty Velvet Eau de Parfum Unisex

Vilhelm Parfumerie Dirty Velvet is a warm blend of pomelo, tobacco leaf and fig.
Jérôme Épinette created it in 2016. Pomelo opens bright, tobacco leaf and fig form a sweet, green heart, and vetiver, salt and sandalwood give it a woody finish.
Smooth and distinctive, it is a great everyday scent.

name: Vilhelm Parfumerie Do Not Disturb Eau de Parfum for Women

Vilhelm Parfumerie Do Not Disturb is a fruity, woody floral with black currant and ylang-ylang.
Jérôme Épinette created it in 2016. Black currant, carnation, ylang-ylang, Haitian vetiver and papyrus come together in a rich, fruity and gently spicy floral wood.
Sensual and elegant, it is a lovely everyday scent.

name: Vilhelm Parfumerie Don't Tell Jasmine Eau de Parfum Unisex

Light and fun, it is a lovely everyday scent.

name: Vilhelm Parfumerie London Funk Eau de Parfum Unisex

Crisp and modern, it is a great everyday scent.

name: Vilhelm Parfumerie Modest Mimosa Eau de Parfum Unisex

name: Vilhelm Parfumerie Stockholm 1978 Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Vince Camuto Virtù is a smoky, woody blend of pepper, birch and leather.

Top notes: Turkish Cardamom, Crushed Peppercorn, Fresh Papyrus
Heart notes:Fresh Tree Moss, White Birch, Haitian Vetiver

name: WIDIAN Velvet Collection Delma Parfum Unisex

name: WIDIAN Velvet Collection Hili Extrait de Parfum Unisex

name: Xerjoff 17/17 Damarose Eau de Parfum for Women

name: Xerjoff 40 Knots Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:

Launched in 2012, it blends sea breeze and seawater with woods and a touch of honey for a fresh, salty and slightly sweet scent.
Refreshing and versatile, it works day or night from spring through fall.

40 Knots by Xerjoff is a Aromatic Aquatic fragrance for women and men. 40 Knots was launched in 2012.

name: Xerjoff Accento Eau de Parfum Unisex

Elegant and easy, it works day or night from spring through fall.

name: Xerjoff Accento Overdose Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Xerjoff Accento Overdose is a green, fruity floral with jasmine and a fresh pine finish.
Christian Carbonnel created it in 2019. Fruity notes, a green accord and aldehydes open bright, Egyptian jasmine, lily-of-the-valley and Bulgarian rose form a lush heart, and eucalyptus and pine give it a cool, woody finish.
Radiant and fresh, it works day or night from spring through fall.

name: Xerjoff Alexandria II Anniversary Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Xerjoff Alexandria II Anniversary is an aromatic blend of lavender, oud and vanilla.

name: Xerjoff Alexandria Orientale Parfum Unisex

name: Xerjoff Amabile Eau de Parfum Unisex

Fresh and elegant, it is a great daytime scent from spring through fall.

name: Xerjoff Amber Gold Eau de Parfum Unisex

name: Xerjoff Aurum Parfum Unisex

name: Xerjoff Blue Hope Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Xerjoff Blue Hope is a soft, musky blend of mandarin, saffron and vanilla.

Smooth and refined, it works day or night in spring and fall.

Blue Hope by Xerjoff is a Woody Floral Musk fragrance for women and men. Blue Hope was launched in 2014. Top notes are bergamot and mandarin orange; middle notes are saffron, cedar and jasmine; base notes are vanilla, castoreum and musk.

name: Xerjoff Casamorati 1888 Bouquet Ideale Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Xerjoff Casamorati Bouquet Ideale is a warm, spicy woody scent with vanilla and tobacco blossom.
Jacques Flori created it in 2010. Cinnamon and nutmeg open warm, guaiac wood, sandalwood, cedar and papyrus form a dry woody heart, and vanilla, coumarin, tobacco blossom, labdanum and musk give it a powdery finish.
Comforting and refined, it is made for fall and winter, day or night.

Bouquet Ideale by Xerjoff is a Oriental Woody fragrance for women. Bouquet Ideale
was launched in 2010. The nose behind this fragrance is Jacques Flori.
Top notes are Cinnamon and Nutmeg; middle notes are Guaiac Wood,
Sandalwood, Virginia Cedar and Papyrus; base notes are Vanille,
Coumarin, Tobacco blossom, French labdanum and Musk.

name: Xerjoff Casamorati 1888 Dama Bianca Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:

Dama Bianca by Xerjoff is a Floral Woody Musk fragrance for women. Dama Bianca

Italian Iris, Violet, Egyptian Jasmine, Lilac and Lily-of-the-Valley;

Sandalwood and Cedar.

name: Xerjoff Casamorati 1888 Dolce Amalfi Eau de Parfum Unisex

Cozy and inviting, it is a lovely daytime scent from spring through fall.

Dolce Amalfi by Xerjoff is a Oriental fragrance for women and men. Dolce Amalfi
was launched in 2017. The nose behind this fragrance is Miroslav
Petkov. Top notes are Quince, Cardamom, Apple and Saffron; middle notes
are Cloves, Tolu Balsam and Incense; base notes are Vanilla, Tonka Bean,
Amber, Cedar and Musk.

name: Xerjoff Casamorati 1888 Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Xerjoff Casamorati 1888 is a warm, spicy floral with carnation, saffron and amber.
Launched in 2013, it opens with carnation, pepper, coriander and saffron. Ylang-ylang, neroli and rose form a floral heart, and amber, sandalwood, birch and patchouli give it a woody finish.
Elegant and warm, it works day or night in fall and winter.

From the exquisite house of Xerjoff
comes a rare and unique scent based on a never before released blend
from the ancient perfume house of Casamorati, 1888, a rare and ethereal
blend that transports the wearer to a bygone era of elegance and grace.
Coriander, cloves, green pepper and Iranian saffron are gently
married with a masterful blend of Bulgarian rose from Grasse, Moroccan
neroli and Indonesian ylang ylang. This intoxicating bouquet is gently
layered over a rich and creamy base of Mysore sandalwood, patchouly,
amber, and rich leather notes from the Russian birch tree.
1888  Notes
coriander,
cloves, green pepper, Iranian saffron, rose from Grasse, Moroccan
neroli, Indonesian ylang ylang, mysore sandalwood, patchouly, amber,
Russian birch tree

name: Xerjoff Casamorati 1888 Mefisto Gentiluomo Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Xerjoff Casamorati Mefisto Gentiluomo is a fresh, powdery citrus with violet and iris.
Launched in 2018, it opens with lavender, grapefruit, bergamot and lemon. Violet, iris and rose form a soft heart, and musk, cedar and amber give it a clean finish.
Easy to wear for spring and summer days, from the office to the gym.

Mefisto Gentiluomo is, as the name
suggests, a gentleman’s cologne, composed in the style of the eaux de
cologne used in upscale barbershop joints in Italy circa 1888. Like its
progenitor, Mefisto, Gentiluomo takes what seems to have become a dirty
word in perfumery – clean – and makes it sexy again. Think the steamy
aromas in a traditional Italian barbershop after a shave – triple-milled
soap, plush white towels, $500 handmade leather loafers, and the sweet
creaminess of sandalwood lotion massaged into warm skin. Yes, Gentiluomo
wins the day by being gorgeously, luxuriously clean without leaning on
cheap musks or powder.
Right off the bat, Mefisto Gentiluomo playfully updates its
predecessor’s model by brushing its bright, salty citrus notes with icy
mint and a burst of bitter green leaves. It wows on the basis of just
how natural and mouth-wateringly fresh it smells. Salty lavender lends a
subtle ozonic feel – not marine or aquatic per se, but rather a
hillside of leathery herbs brushed by sea air. We’re impressed with the
bubble of sweetness that floats up here, a slightly candied citrus or
lavender note that serves to balance out the sharper notes, giving it a
polished, modern vibe. But if Mefisto Gentiluomo starts out in the
maquis of a Mediterranean hillside, and lingers in the luxuriantly
bright, clean atmosphere of a traditional barbershop, it ultimately
comes to rest in the milieu of a Florentine artisan’s workshop, where
the scent of suede mingles companionably with the patina of
centuries-old wood. The flowers contribute only a softness of texture,
but the iris stands out, bathing the aromatics in its spectral glow.
Handsome, refined, and full of Italian braggadocio, Mefisto Gentiluomo
is a fresh barbershop fougere with a hidden creamy floral-citrus core
that pulls it out of 1888 and right into 2018.
