Launched in 2025, it opens with raspberry and mandarin. Orange blossom and lavender form a floral heart, and Bourbon vanilla, musk and coconut give it a sweet finish.
Playful and warm, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

name: Yves Saint Laurent Libre Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Yves Saint Laurent Libre Eau de Parfum is a bold blend of lavender, orange blossom and vanilla.
Anne Flipo and Carlos Benaïm created it in 2019. Lavender, mandarin, black currant and petitgrain open fresh, lavender, orange blossom and jasmine form the heart, and Madagascar vanilla, ambergris, musk and cedar give it a warm finish.
Versatile from spring through winter, from everyday wear to date nights.

Libre by Yves Saint Laurent is a Amber Fougere fragrance for women's. This is a new fragrance. Libre was released in 2019. Libre was created by Anne Flipo and Carlos Benaim. Top notes are Lavender, Mandarin Orange, Black Currant and Petitgrain. Middle Notess are Lavender, Orange Blossom and Jasmine. Base Notes are Madagascar Vanilla, Musk, Cedar and Ambergris.

name: Yves Saint Laurent Libre Eau de Parfum Intense for Women

notes.source_text:
Yves Saint Laurent Libre Intense is a warm, sensual lavender and orange blossom fragrance.
Anne Flipo and Carlos Benaïm created it in 2020. Lavender, mandarin and bergamot open fresh, lavender, orange blossom, jasmine sambac and orchid form the heart, and Madagascar vanilla, tonka bean, ambergris and vetiver give it a rich finish.
Made for fall and winter, day or night.

Libre Intense by Yves Saint Laurent is a Amber Fougere fragrance for women's. This is a new fragrance. Libre Intense was released in 2020. Libre Intense was created by Anne Flipo and Carlos Benaim. Top notes are Lavender, Mandarin Orange and Bergamot. Middle Notess are Lavender, Tunisian Orange Blossom, Jasmine Sambac and Orchid. Base Notes are Madagascar Vanilla, Tonka Bean, Ambergris and Vetiver.

name: Yves Saint Laurent Libre Eau de Toilette for Women

notes.source_text:
Yves Saint Laurent Libre Eau de Toilette is a lighter, fresher take on Libre with lavender and orange blossom.
Anne Flipo and Carlos Benaim created it in 2021. Lavender, bergamot and mandarin open bright, orange blossom, jasmine tea and jasmine form a floral heart, and musk, vanilla and ambergris give it a soft finish.
Fresh and confident, it is made for spring and summer days.

name: Yves Saint Laurent Libre Flowers & Flames Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Yves Saint Laurent Libre Flowers & Flames is a sunny blend of lavender, lily and coconut.
Launched in 2024, it opens with bergamot and lavender. Orange blossom, lily, lavender, palm and coconut form a bright heart, and vanilla gives it a warm finish.
Radiant and cheerful, it works day or night from spring through fall.

name: Yves Saint Laurent Libre L'Absolu Platine Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Yves Saint Laurent Libre L'Absolu Platine is an aldehydic blend of lavender, orange blossom and amber.
Launched in 2023, it opens with aldehydes, bergamot and mandarin. Lavender, blue lavender and orange blossom form a crisp heart, and amber and vanilla give it a warm finish.
Bright and confident, it is a great everyday scent.

name: Yves Saint Laurent Libre L’Eau Nue Parfum de Peau for Women

notes.source_text:
Yves Saint Laurent Libre L'Eau Nue is a soft skin scent of citrus, orange blossom and lavender.
Launched in 2025, it opens with mandarin and lemon. Orange blossom forms a gentle floral heart, and lavender gives it a clean, aromatic finish.
Light and intimate, it is made for spring and summer days.

name: Yves Saint Laurent Libre Le Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Yves Saint Laurent Libre Le Parfum is a warm, honeyed take on Libre.
Anne Flipo and Carlos Benaïm created it in 2022. Saffron, ginger, mandarin and bergamot open warm, lavender and orange blossom form the heart, and Bourbon vanilla, honey, tonka bean and vetiver give it a rich finish.
Made for fall and winter nights.

name: Yves Saint Laurent Libre Santal Couture Eau de Parfum For Women

notes.source_text:
Yves Saint Laurent Libre Santal Couture is a creamy blend of lavender, orange blossom and sandalwood.
Anne Flipo created it in 2026. Lavender opens fresh, orange blossom forms a soft heart, and sandalwood gives it a creamy, woody finish.
Made for fall and winter, day or night.

name: Yves Saint Laurent Libre Vanille Couture Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Yves Saint Laurent Libre Vanille Couture is a rich, boozy take on Libre with vanilla.
Launched in 2025, it blends Bourbon vanilla, orange blossom, lavender, vanilla caviar and rum into a warm, sweet and smooth scent.
Made for fall and winter, day or night.

name: Yves Saint Laurent M7 Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
Yves Saint Laurent M7 is a smoky, musky blend of citrus, vetiver and oud.
Alberto Morillas and Jacques Cavallier created it in 2002. Bergamot, mandarin and rosemary open fresh, vetiver and oud form a woody heart, and musk and amber give it a warm finish.
Bold and sensual, it is made for fall and winter nights.

name: Yves Saint Laurent Manifesto Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Yves Saint Laurent Manifesto is a sweet floral with black currant, jasmine and vanilla.
Anne Flipo and Loc Dong created it in 2012. Black currant, bergamot and green notes open bright, jasmine sambac and lily-of-the-valley form a white floral heart, and vanilla, tonka bean, sandalwood and cedar give it a warm finish.
Elegant and cozy, it works day or night in fall and winter.

name: Yves Saint Laurent Mon Paris Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Yves Saint Laurent Mon Paris is a sweet, fruity floral with strawberry, peony and patchouli.
Dora Baghriche, Harry Fremont and Olivier Cresp created it in 2016. Strawberry, raspberry, pear and citrus open juicy, peony, jasmine and datura form a lush heart, and patchouli, white musk, vanilla and ambroxan give it a warm finish.
Romantic and versatile, it suits everyday wear and the office in spring and fall.

Mon Paris by Yves Saint Laurent is a Chypre Fruity fragrance for women's. Mon Paris was released in 2016. Mon Paris was created by Olivier Cresp, Harry Fremont and Dora Baghriche. Top notes are Strawberry, Raspberry, Pear, Orange, Tangerine, Calabrian bergamot and Calone. Middle Notess are Peony, Jasmine Sambac, Chinese Jasmine, Datura and Orange Blossom. Base Notes are Indonesian Patchouli Leaf, Patchouli, White Musk, Vanila, Ambroxan, Moss and Cedar.

name: Yves Saint Laurent Mon Paris Eau de Toilette for Women

notes.source_text:
Yves Saint Laurent Mon Paris Eau de Toilette is a fruity floral with raspberry, peony and musk.
Dora Baghriche, Harry Frémont and Olivier Cresp created it in 2017. Raspberry, blackberry, bergamot and pink pepper open juicy, peony, datura, jasmine sambac and orange blossom form a lush heart, and patchouli, white musk, cashmeran and ambroxan give it a clean finish.
Light and romantic, it is great for everyday wear, the office and the gym in spring.

Mon Paris Eau de Toilette by Yves Saint Laurent is a Chypre Fruity fragrance for women's. Mon Paris Eau de Toilette was released in 2017. Mon Paris Eau de Toilette was created by Olivier Cresp, Harry Fremont and Dora Baghriche. Top notes are Raspberry, Blackberry, Pink Pepper and Bergamot. Middle Notess are Peony, Datura, Jasmine Sambac and Orange Blossom. Base Notes are Patchouli, White Musk, Cashmeran and Ambroxan.

name: Yves Saint Laurent Mon Paris Intensement Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Yves Saint Laurent Mon Paris Intensément is a deeper, richer take on Mon Paris with berries and rose.
Olivier Cresp, Dora Baghriche and Harry Fremont created it in 2020. Raspberry, black currant, pear, orange and bergamot open juicy, May rose, Bulgarian rose, peony, datura and freesia form the heart, and vanilla, white musk, patchouli, cashmeran and benzoin give it a warm finish.
Romantic and versatile, it works year-round, day or night.

name: Yves Saint Laurent Muse Inspiring Ink Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Yves Saint Laurent Muse Inspiring Ink is an aromatic blend of lavender, incense and orris.
Marie Salamagne created it in 2025. Lavender, incense and clary sage open aromatic, orris, Bourbon vanilla and ambrette form a soft heart, and an ink accord and amberwood give it a woody finish.
Modern and distinctive, it is a great everyday scent.

name: Yves Saint Laurent Myslf Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Yves Saint Laurent MYSLF is a modern, luminous blend of orange blossom and woods.
Christophe Raynaud created it in 2023. Calabrian bergamot opens bright and clean, Tunisian orange blossom gives it a soft floral heart, and Ambrofix and patchouli leave a warm, woody trail.
MYSLF is clean, modern and polished, an easy signature for everyday wear. It suits the office, weekends and evenings alike.

name: Yves Saint Laurent Myslf Eau de Toilette Intense For Men

notes.source_text:
Yves Saint Laurent MYSLF Eau de Toilette Intense is a fresh, musky orange blossom.
Daniela Andrier created it in 2026. Bergamot opens bright, orange blossom, patchouli and Ambrofix form the heart, and white musk gives it a clean finish.
Versatile from spring through fall, day or night.

name: Yves Saint Laurent Myslf L’Absolu Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Yves Saint Laurent MYSLF L'Absolu is a deeper, spicier take on MYSLF.
Christophe Raynaud created it in 2025. Ginger, bergamot and cardamom open bright and spicy, orange blossom and floral notes form the heart, and patchouli gives it a warm, woody finish.
Versatile in every season, day or night.

name: Yves Saint Laurent MYSLF Le Parfum Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Yves Saint Laurent MYSLF Le Parfum is a warmer, spicier take on MYSLF.
Launched in 2024, it opens with black pepper, moves into a soft orange blossom heart and settles into amber, patchouli, Bourbon vanilla and woods for a smooth, sensual finish.
Versatile and polished, it works in every season, day or night.

name: Yves Saint Laurent Opium 2009 Eau de Toilette for Women

notes.source_text:
Yves Saint Laurent Opium (2009) Eau de Toilette is a warm blend of tangerine, myrrh and vanilla.
Launched in 2009, it opens with tangerine, lily-of-the-valley and bergamot. Myrrh, carnation and jasmine form a spicy heart, and amber, vanilla and patchouli give it a warm finish.
Seductive and warm, it works day or night in fall and winter.

name: Yves Saint Laurent Opium Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Yves Saint Laurent Opium Eau de Parfum is a warm, spicy amber with myrrh and opoponax.
Launched in 2009, it opens with mandarin, bergamot and lily-of-the-valley. Myrrh and jasmine form a resinous heart, and opoponax, amber, patchouli and vanilla give it a rich, balsamic finish.
Seductive and opulent, it is made for fall and winter nights.

name: Yves Saint Laurent Opium Pour Homme Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
Yves Saint Laurent Opium Pour Homme is a spicy blend of black currant, star anise and vanilla.
Jacques Cavallier created it in 1995. Black currant and star anise open bright, pepper and galangal form a spicy heart, and Bourbon vanilla, tolu balsam and Atlas cedar give it a warm, powdery finish.
Distinctive and warm, it is made for fall and winter nights.

name: Yves Saint Laurent Paris Eau de Toilette for Women

notes.source_text:
Yves Saint Laurent Paris is the classic powdery rose with violet and mimosa.
Sophia Grojsman created it in 1983. Rose, mimosa, hyacinth, geranium, nasturtium, orange blossom and bergamot open lush, rose, violet, lily, linden blossom, ylang-ylang and orris root form a romantic heart, and iris, musk, heliotrope, sandalwood and oakmoss give it a soft finish.
Romantic and timeless, it is a lovely everyday scent.

name: Yves Saint Laurent Parisienne Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Yves Saint Laurent Parisienne is a fruity rose with blackberry, violet and a vinyl accord.
Sophia Grojsman and Sophie Labbé created it in 2009. Blackberry, cranberry and a vinyl accord open bright, Damask rose, violet and peony form a powdery heart, and musk, sandalwood, vetiver and patchouli give it a soft finish.
Chic and modern, it is a lovely everyday scent.

name: Yves Saint Laurent Rive Gauche Women Eau de Toilette for Women

notes.source_text:
Yves Saint Laurent Rive Gauche is a classic, aldehydic floral with rose and vetiver.
Launched in 1971, it opens with aldehydes, green notes, honeysuckle, bergamot, peach and lemon. Rose, iris, geranium, ylang-ylang, jasmine, magnolia and gardenia form the heart, and oakmoss, vetiver, musk, sandalwood, tonka bean and amber give it a woody finish.
Elegant and timeless, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

name: Yves Saint Laurent Rouge Velours Le Vestaire des Parfumes Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Yves Saint Laurent Rouge Velours is a woody rose with pink pepper, white tea and patchouli.
Launched in 2021, it opens with pink pepper and white tea. Rose, jasmine and iris form a velvety heart, and patchouli, vetiver and musk give it an earthy finish.
Elegant and versatile, it works day or night in spring, fall and winter.

name: Yves Saint Laurent Saharienne Le Vestaire des Parfumes Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Yves Saint Laurent Saharienne is a fresh, green blend of citrus, orange flower and ginger.
Launched in 2011, it opens with Amalfi lemon, bergamot and mandarin. White flowers, orange flower, cassis, galbanum and petitgrain form a green heart, and ginger and pink pepper give it a spicy finish.
Crisp and elegant, it is a great daytime scent from spring through fall.

Saharienne by Yves Saint Laurent is a Citrus Aromatic fragrance for women's. Saharienne was released in 2011. Top notes are Amalfi Lemon, Bergamot and Mandarin Orange. Middle Notess are White Flowers, African Orange flower, Cassis, Galbanum and Petitgrain. Base Notes are Ginger and Pink Pepper.

name: Yves Saint Laurent Splendid Wood Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Yves Saint Laurent Splendid Wood is a spicy, woody blend of cardamom, incense and oud.
Marie Salamagne and Amandine Clerc-Marie created it in 2017. Cardamom and incense open warm, rose and jasmine sambac form a floral heart, and oud, cedar and cypriol give it a dry, woody finish.
Refined and warm, it is a great daytime scent in fall and winter.

name: Yves Saint Laurent Supreme Bouquet Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Yves Saint Laurent Supreme Bouquet is a lush, fruity white floral with tuberose and pear.
Dominique Ropion created it in 2013. Fruity notes, pear and pink pepper open bright, tuberose, ylang-ylang and jasmine form a rich heart, and amber, patchouli and musk give it a warm finish.
Glamorous and radiant, it is a lovely everyday scent.

name: Yves Saint Laurent Trench Le Vestaire des Parfumes Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Yves Saint Laurent Trench is a powdery blend of tangerine, fig and iris.
Amandine Clerc-Marie created it in 2015. Tangerine, bergamot and fig open bright, iris and neroli form a powdery heart, and musk, cedar and ambrette give it a soft finish.
Elegant and calm, it is a great daytime scent in spring and fall.

Trench by Yves Saint Laurent is a Floral Fruity fragrance for women's and men. Trench was released in 2015. The Master Perfumer for this fragrance is Amandine Clerc-Marie. Top notes are Tangerine, Bergamot and Fig. Middle Notess are iris and Neroli. Base Notes are Musk, Cedar and Ambrette (Musk Mallow).

name: Yves Saint Laurent Tuxedo Le Vestaire des Parfumes Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Yves Saint Laurent Tuxedo is a refined, spicy fragrance with a vanilla and patchouli base.
Juliette Karagueuzoglou created it in 2015. Bergamot, coriander and violet leaf open fresh, black pepper, lily of the valley and rose form the heart, and ambergris, patchouli and vanilla give it a smooth finish.
Elegant in every season, from the office to date night.

Tuxedo by Yves Saint Laurent is a Chypre fragrance for women's and men. Tuxedo was released in 2015. The Master Perfumer for this fragrance is Juliette Karagueuzoglou. Top notes are Violet Leaf, Coriander and Bergamot. Middle Notess are Rose, Black Pepper and Lily-of-the-Valley. Base Notes are Ambergris, Patchouli and Bourbon Vanilla.

name: Yves Saint Laurent Tuxedo Sharp Patchouli Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Yves Saint Laurent Tuxedo Sharp Patchouli is a crisp, modern patchouli with a floral twist.
Launched in 2025, it opens with violet leaf, coriander and bergamot. Rose, lily of the valley and black pepper form a bright heart, and patchouli, ambergris and Bourbon vanilla give it a smooth, earthy finish.
Elegant and versatile, it works in every season, day or night.

name: Yves Saint Laurent Vinyle Le Vestaire des Parfumes Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Yves Saint Laurent Vinyle is a warm, sweet blend of immortelle, myrrh and vanilla.
Juliette Karagueuzoglou created it in 2016. Pink pepper and bergamot open bright, immortelle and myrrh form a resinous heart, and vanilla, resins and anise give it a sweet finish.
Cozy and distinctive, it works day or night in fall and winter.

Vinyle by Yves Saint Laurent is a Amber fragrance for women's and men. Vinyle was released in 2016. The Master Perfumer for this fragrance is Juliette Karagueuzoglou. Top notes are Pink Pepper and Bergamot. Middle Notess are Myrrh and Immortelle. Base Notes are Vanilla, resins and Anise.

name: Yves Saint Laurent Wild Leather Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Yves Saint Laurent Wild Leather is a rich blend of leather, licorice and saffron.
Fanny Bal created it in 2021. Leather, suede, licorice, saffron, guaiac wood, Bourbon vanilla, bergamot, black pepper, orange blossom, thyme and lavender come together in a warm, spicy and slightly animalic scent.
Bold and refined, it is a strong choice for cooler days and evenings.

name: Yves Saint Laurent Y 2022 Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
Yves Saint Laurent Y Eau de Toilette is a fresh, aromatic fougère with a clean woody base.
Dominique Ropion created this 2022 version. Aldehydes, bergamot and ginger open bright, geranium, clary sage and lavender form a herbal heart, and cedar, vanilla, olibanum and ambergris give it a smooth finish.
Versatile and fresh, it works for the office, everyday, the gym and casual days in spring and summer.

name: Yves Saint Laurent Y Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Yves Saint Laurent Y Eau de Parfum is a fresh, modern fougère with a warm woody base.
Dominique Ropion created it in 2018. Apple, ginger and bergamot open bright and lively, sage, juniper berries and geranium add an aromatic heart, and amberwood, tonka bean, cedar, vetiver and olibanum give it depth.
Y Eau de Parfum is fresh enough for the office and deep enough for an evening out, which makes it a true all-rounder. It works in every season, day or night, and is one of the safest blind picks around.

Y Eau de Parfum by Yves Saint Laurent is a Aromatic Fougere fragrance for men's. This is a new fragrance. Y Eau de Parfum was released in 2018. The Master Perfumer for this fragrance is Dominique Ropion. Top notes are Apple, Ginger and Bergamot. Middle Notess are Sage, Juniper Berries and Geranium. Base Notes are Amberwood, Tonka Bean, Cedar, Vetiver and Olibanum.

name: Yves Saint Laurent Y Eau de Parfum Intense for Men

notes.source_text:
Yves Saint Laurent Y Eau de Parfum Intense is a deeper, woodier take on the Y line.
Dominique Ropion created it in 2023. Ginger, bergamot and juniper berries open crisp, sage, geranium and lavender form an aromatic heart, and vetiver, patchouli and cedar give it an earthy, woody finish.
Confident and modern, it is a strong choice for evenings and cooler days.

name: Yves Saint Laurent Y Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text: Yves Saint Laurent Y by Yves Saint Laurent is a Woody Aromatic fragrance for men's. Yves Saint Laurent Y was released in 2017. The Master Perfumer for this fragrance is Dominique Ropion. Top notes are Aldehydes, Bergamot, Ginger, Mint and Lemon. Middle Notess are Apple, Violet Leaf, Sage, Pineapple and Geranium. Base Notes are Ambergris, Musk, Cedar, Balsam Fir, Vetiver and Incense.

name: Yves Saint Laurent Y Eau Fraiche Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
Yves Saint Laurent Y Eau Fraîche is a light, crisp citrus with mint and lavender.
Launched in 2020, it opens with lemon, ginger and pepper. Geranium, lavender, mint and juniper berries form a cool, aromatic heart, and cedar and olibanum give it a clean, woody finish.
Refreshing and easy, it is made for spring and summer days.

Y Eau Fraiche by Yves Saint Laurent is a Woody Aromatic fragrance for men's. This is a new fragrance. Y Eau Fraiche was released in 2020. Top notes are Lemon, Ginger and Pepper. Middle Notess are Geranium, Mint, Lavender and Juniper Berries. Base Notes are Cedar and Olibanum.

name: Yves Saint Laurent Y Elixir for Men

notes.source_text:
Yves Saint Laurent Y Elixir is a deep, smoky blend of lavender, oud and frankincense.
Dominique Ropion created it in 2024. Lavender opens aromatic, geranium forms a fresh heart, and oud and frankincense give it a rich, resinous finish.
Intense and modern, it works year-round, day or night.

name: Yves Saint Laurent Y Iced Cologne Eau de Toilette Intense for Men

notes.source_text:
Yves Saint Laurent Y Iced Cologne is an icy, minty take on Y.
Dominique Ropion created it in 2025. Mint and an icy accord open cool, mint tea and blue sage form the heart, and patchouli and ambroxan give it a clean finish.
Refreshing for hot days and active wear.

name: Yves Saint Laurent Y Le Parfum 2025 for Men

notes.source_text:
Yves Saint Laurent Y Le Parfum 2025 is a fresh, resinous take on Y.
Dominique Ropion created it in 2025. Ginger and bergamot open bright, pine needles and balsam fir form a resinous heart, and amber and patchouli give it a warm finish.
Versatile in every season, day or night.

name: Yves Saint Laurent Y Le Parfum Eau de Parfum for Men

notes.source_text:
Yves Saint Laurent Y Le Parfum is a deep, aromatic fougère with a fresh, sparkling start.
Launched in 2021, it opens with aldehydes, grapefruit, ginger and apple. Geranium, sage and lavender form a clean, herbal heart, and cedar, olibanum, tonka bean and patchouli give it a warm, woody base.
Polished and confident, it shines in the evening from spring through fall.

name: Yves Saint Laurent Y Le Parfum for Men

notes.source_text: Y Le Parfum by Yves Saint Laurent is a Amber Fougere fragrance for men's. This is a new fragrance. Y Le Parfum was released in 2021. Top notes are Apple, Aldehydes, Grapefruit and Ginger. Middle Notess are Sage, Lavender and Geranium. Base Notes are Tonka Bean, Cedar, Olibanum and Patchouli.

name: Yves Saint Laurent Y Live Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
Yves Saint Laurent Y Live is a fresh, bright blend of orange blossom, ginger and sage.
Dominique Ropion created it in 2019. Orange blossom opens light and floral, bergamot and ginger form a zesty heart, and juniper and sage give it a clean, aromatic finish.
Easy and energetic, it suits everyday wear and date nights from spring through fall.

Y Live by Yves Saint Laurent is a Aromatic Spicy fragrance for men's. This is a new fragrance. Y Live was released in 2019. Top note is Orange Blossom. Middle Notess are Ginger and Bergamot. Base Notes are Juniper and Sage.

name: Yves Saint Laurent Yvresse Eau de Toilette for Women

notes.source_text:
Yves Saint Laurent Yvresse is a fresh, fruity blend of nectarine, lychee and violet.
Launched in 2011, it opens with nectarine and lychee. Violet and rose form a soft, powdery heart, and patchouli gives it a gentle, earthy finish.
Charming and light, it is a lovely daytime scent in spring, fall and winter.

name: Zadig & Voltaire Girls Can Say Anything Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Zadig & Voltaire Girls Can Say Anything is a soft, powdery blend of iris, peony and vanilla.
Quentin Bisch created it in 2018. Iris and peony open soft, tonka bean forms a sweet heart, and vanilla, musk, fern and amber give it a warm finish.
Cozy and playful, it is a lovely everyday scent.

name: Zadig & Voltaire This is Her! Eau de Parfum for Women

notes.source_text:
Zadig & Voltaire This is Her! is a creamy, sweet blend of whipped cream, vanilla and chestnut.
Sidonie Lancesseur and Michel Almairac created it in 2016. Pink pepper, silkwood blossom and jasmine sambac open bright, whipped cream, vanilla and chestnut form a gourmand heart, and sandalwood and cashmere wood give it a warm finish.
Soft and comforting, it is lovely for evenings and cooler days.

name: Zadig & Voltaire This is Him! Pour Lui Eau de Toilette for Men

notes.source_text:
Zadig & Voltaire This is Him! is a warm, spicy blend of black pepper, incense and vanilla.
Nathalie Lorson and Aurélien Guichard created it in 2016. Black pepper and grapefruit open bright, incense and vanilla form a warm heart, and sandalwood gives it a creamy finish.
Smooth and easy, it is a great everyday scent.

name: ZARKOPERFUME BUDDHA-WOOD Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Zarkoperfume Buddha-Wood is a smooth, woody blend of buddha wood and sandalwood.
Zarko Ahlmann Pavlov created it. Buddha wood and Australian sandalwood come together in a soft, creamy and calm woody scent.
Simple and serene, it is a great everyday scent.

name: ZARKOPERFUME CLOUD COLLECTION No.1 Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text: Verified fragrance notes for ZARKOPERFUME CLOUD COLLECTION No.1 Eau de Parfum Unisex: Danish Sea-Buckthorn, French Jasmin Absolute, Driftwood Accord.

name: ZARKOPERFUME CLOUD COLLECTION No.2 Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Zarkoperfume Cloud Collection No. 2 is a fresh blend of lemongrass, jasmine leaf and sea water.
Zarko Ahlmann Pavlov created it in 2018. Lemongrass opens bright, jasmine leaf forms a green heart, and sea water, white musk and woods give it a clean, marine finish.
Fresh and easy, it is a great everyday scent.

name: ZARKOPERFUME CLOUD COLLECTION No.3 Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Zarkoperfume Cloud Collection No. 3 is a fruity, airy blend of berries, magnolia and oud.
Zarko Ahlmann Pavlov created it in 2019. Red berries, mandarin and pear open juicy, ozonic notes, magnolia, tulip and black rose form an airy heart, and sandalwood, white musk, white wood, oud and vanilla give it a soft finish.
Light and distinctive, it is a great everyday scent.

name: ZARKOPERFUME e'L Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Zarkoperfume e'L is a fresh, green blend of pomegranate, sea notes and green tea.
Launched in 2013, it opens with white flowers and pomegranate. Sea notes, green notes and green tea form a fresh heart, and white musk and white woods give it a clean finish.
Calm and refreshing, it is a great everyday scent.

name: ZARKOPERFUME INCEPTION Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Zarkoperfume Inception is a fresh, marine blend of sea notes, citrus and woods.
Launched in 2013, it blends sea notes, citrus, green notes, woods, florals and spices into a crisp, aromatic and breezy scent.
Fresh and versatile, it is a great everyday scent.

name: ZARKOPERFUME MOLeCULE No.8 Wodden Chips Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Zarkoperfume Molecule No. 8 Wooden Chips is a woody blend of mandarin, patchouli and oud.
Launched in 2015, it blends woods, mandarin, patchouli, oud and rose into a dry, citrusy and smooth woody scent.
Clean and modern, it is a great everyday scent.

name: ZARKOPERFUME OUD'ISH Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Zarkoperfume Oud'ish is a musky blend of ambergris, green tea and oud.
Launched in 2013, it blends ambergris, green tea, white musk and oud into a soft, salty and lightly animalic woody scent.
Modern and smooth, it is a great everyday scent.

name: ZARKOPERFUME PINK MOLeCULE 090.09 Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Zarkoperfume Pink Molécule 090.09 is a sweet blend of champagne, apricot and whipped cream.
Launched in 2014, it opens with champagne, apricot, black elder and black orchid, and whipped cream, blackwood and mahogany give it a creamy, sweet and gently woody finish.
Playful and soft, it is a lovely everyday scent.

name: ZARKOPERFUME PURPLE MOLéCULE 070.07 Eau de Parfum Unisex

notes.source_text:
Zarkoperfume Purple Molécule 070.07 is a creamy floral with magnolia, orchid and vanilla.
Zarko Ahlmann Pavlov created it in 2019. Magnolia, white orchid and wildflowers open soft and fruity, and Madagascar vanilla, musk and sandalwood give it a warm, ambery finish.
Gentle and sweet, it is a lovely everyday scent.
